Experiments on three LRMs show that SaLT-DPO consistently reduces unsafe rates for both reasoning and answer segments while mitigating degradation in benign compliance and preserving general reasoning performance. Ablation studies demonstrate the complementary contributions of its components.

articles.title: Multilingual Agent System for Inclusive Wildfire Evacuation Guidance
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03301v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wildfire seasons have become 84 days longer in the current days than in the 1970s, causing enormous threats to one's financial status and short- and long-term health. During the fire, public agencies send out emergency messages to provide warnings and orders. Although 26 million people in the US have limited English proficiency, over 80% of those messages are only delivered in English, which can cause disproportionate information distribution and awareness. In order to better serve marginalized communities during emergencies, the authors developed BEACON, a service that provides comprehensive and personalized evacuation guidance, including navigation routes, personalized checklists, and a chatbot in the language that a user uses. Our current system ingests data including fire perimeter information, evacuation order status, and shelter information from Watch Duty. When a user is within a certain proximity from the fire, the system utilizes real-time GPS locations and nearby weather data from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) to predict fire danger levels. The assessment model refreshment are dynamically scheduled based on fire progress and trends using XGBoost. If the location has a likelihood of fire danger, the system sends alerts with evacuation routes outputted from a polygon-avoidant routing pipeline. The application provides a context-aware multilingual agent that users can communicate with and is tightly connected to other features of the application. In addition, based on data that the user entered, the system dynamically generates and checks off personalized reminder items to provide an organized evacuation plan. The system's user interface dynamically changes its language settings based on the language the user most recently used in either setting or chatbot conversation for all the application elements.

articles.title: Is Bash All You Need? An Empirical Study of Tool Interfaces for Enterprise Digital Worker Agents
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11999v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this study, we examine whether a general shell can outperform specialized tools on enterprise tasks. Shell-based agents have shown strong results in coding, but enterprise work also involves moving between applications and services, coordinating with coworkers, and performing professional analysis. We compare five tool interfaces on TheAgentCompany and APEX-Agents using Opus-4.8 and GPT-5.5: typed tools, typed tools plus bash, bash alone, bash with persistent agent-synthesized tools, and programmatic tool calling (PTC), which runs programs whose actions are restricted to a typed tool catalog. Bash alone outperforms typed tools on both benchmarks, improving score by 21.8-24.5 pp on TheAgentCompany and 4.8-7.4 pp on APEX-Agents while using 19-72% fewer total tokens. Adding typed tools or persistent tool synthesis to bash produces no detectable pooled score gain. PTC uses fewer tokens than direct typed calls with broadly similar task performance, but generally underperforms bash alone in both quality and cost efficiency. For enterprise practitioners, these results favor bash alone when arbitrary execution can be isolated and PTC when security or compliance policies require a fixed tool catalog.

articles.title: The Agentic Company OS: Substrate Inversion for Sustained Enterprise Agent Deployment
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13334v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Enterprise AI agents often succeed in a demonstration and then stall once they must operate day after day. An industry report estimates that most pilots never reach production and that deployed systems rarely retain feedback or improve over time, while agent benchmarks show single-run successes masking unreliable repetition. We argue that these failure modes share a common architectural root: agents reason over data structured for human operators and traditional applications, not for the language models that power them. This position paper proposes that companies deploying agents in sustained operation should rebuild their cognitive substrate, the shared environment agents read as working context, around representations matched to that reasoning surface, isolating schema translation to the action boundary. Markdown is the instantiation available today, not a proven agent-native primitive. Two mechanisms ground the argument: context-bandwidth asymmetry, the gap between one-pass reading of connected prose and field-by-field typed access that strips relations; and cross-loop coupling, the claim that action, skill, and policy loops compound only if they share one substrate. A four-layer framework (Data, Knowledge, Intelligence, Governance) operationalizes the position, with a Sync Agent enforcing the action boundary and a per-skill trust gradient, making governance and auditability structural properties of the substrate. The position revives the shared-substrate tradition of classical multi-agent systems under LLM-era economics. We analyze the main objections and risks, including indirect prompt injection on the compile path, and outline a research agenda for evaluating substrates directly.

articles.title: Biomechanical effects of attachment configuration and clear aligner thickness on mandibular second premolar derotation: a three-dimensional finite element analysis
articles.abstract: Background Mandibular premolar derotation with clear aligners remains biomechanically challenging. This study evaluated whether the effects of attachment configuration on initial displacement and stress distribution vary with aligner thickness during derotation of a mandibular second premolar.Methods A cone-beam computed tomography–based mandibular finite element model was used to simulate a 2° derotation activation with 0.5- and 0.75-mm aligners and six attachment configurations: no attachment (DZ), unilateral buccal vertical (Z1), bilateral vertical (Z2), bilateral horizontal (Z3), buccal vertical–lingual horizontal (Z4), and buccal horizontal–lingual vertical (Z5). Target-tooth and four reference-point displacements, target-tooth periodontal ligament (PDL) and alveolar bone stresses, and adjacent-tooth displacement and PDL stress were recorded.Results Attachment models produced greater target-tooth displacement than DZ; bilateral configurations generally exceeded Z1. At 0.5 mm, Z2, Z3, and Z4 showed closely grouped displacement and supporting-tissue stresses; Z3 produced the greatest displacement (0.03320 mm). At 0.75 mm, Z4 produced the greatest target-tooth displacement (0.04557 mm), PDL von Mises stress (0.07713 MPa), alveolar bone von Mises stress (0.27229 MPa), and displacement and PDL stress in both adjacent teeth. Z2, Z3, and Z5 had displacement near 0.040 mm, with lower supporting-tissue stresses than Z4. Reference-point displacement indicated intrusion and distal and buccal crown tipping in Z4.Conclusions Attachment models produced greater initial displacement than the no-attachment model, and bilateral attachment configurations generally produced greater displacement than the unilateral configuration. Aligner thickness altered the relative responses of attachment configurations. Z2, Z3, and Z4 differed little at 0.5 mm. At 0.75 mm, Z4 produced the greatest displacement, including intrusion and crown tipping, and the highest supporting-tissue stresses and adjacent-tooth responses.

articles.title: Synthesis of MnO2 Nanostructures for Supercapacitor is an Efficient Electrode Material to Improve Energy Storage: Effect of Annealing Temperature
articles.abstract: To assess the impact on the physicochemical and electrochemical characteristics of manganese oxide (MnO2) nanostructures (NSs), a hydrothermal technique was used to synthesize nanostructures, which were then thermally annealed at different temperatures. The successful synthesis of MnO2 NSs was confirmed by structural and morphological characterization. According to electrochemical characterisation, the pseudocapacitive behaviour of the MnO2-based electrode is significantly influenced by the annealing temperature, with 400°C (MO-1), 500°C (MO-2), and 600°C (MO-3) as the respective temperatures. In a 1 M KOH electrolyte, the optimized MO-1 electrode showed a specific capacitance of 280 F/g at 10 mA/g. Additionally, after 5000 GCD cycles, the MO-1 electrode showed outstanding cycling stability, with nearly 98.3% retention of its initial capacitance. An asymmetric supercapacitor (ASSC) device assembled with MO-1 as the positive electrode and activated carbon as the negative electrode delivered a specific capacitance of 126.7 F/g at 10 mA/g and maintained 95.4% of its capacitance over 5000 cycles. The ASSC device also achieved an energy density of 39.6 W h/kg and a power density of 3750 W/kg at 10 mA/g.

articles.title: Trace Elements Enrichment and Source Apportionment in Soils along an Urban-Rural Gradient in Xinxiang, China
articles.abstract: Rapid urbanization drives the enrichment of trace elements in soils along urban–rural gradients, posing serious threats to soil environmental safety. However, quantitative source apportionment of such pollution remains a challenge. This study focused on Xinxiang City, a typical industrial and agricultural city in Henan Province, China. Surface soil samples were collected along an urban–suburban–rural gradient and analyzed for 12 trace elements (Cu, Pb, Zn, Cr, Cd, As, Ni, Hg, F, Mn, Co, and V). Using an integrated approach combining geostatistics, the Nemerow Pollution Index, the Geoaccumulation Index, and Positive Matrix Factorization (PMF) modeling, we systematically investigated the spatial enrichment patterns, pollution levels, and sources of these elements. The results showed that the mean concentrations of all elements except As exceeded the background values for Henan Province, with Cd being the most severely contaminated. The pollution degree of Cd decreased in the order: suburban > urban > rural, whereas the other 11 elements followed urban > suburban > rural. PMF analysis identified four main sources: natural sources (71.03%), traffic-related sources (20.09%, mainly contributing to Cu, Pb, and Zn), industrial activities (3.74%, primarily responsible for Cd enrichment), and coal combustion (5.14%, mainly influencing Hg). This work clarifies the key anthropogenic sources and their spatial variability of soil trace elements along an urbanization gradient, providing a scientific basis for targeted soil pollution control and land-use management in similar regions.

articles.title: Assembly of the Peganum harmala microbiome across plant compartments and growing seasons
articles.abstract: Peganum harmala L. is a medicinal plant adapted to arid environments, but little is known about how its associated microbiome is assembled and structured. We characterised bacterial and fungal communities associated with P. harmala across rhizospheric soil, roots, and surface-sterilised leaves over two consecutive growing seasons, integrating community profiling with soil physicochemical analyses. The P. harmala microbiome showed a clear hierarchical structure, with soil harbouring the highest microbial diversity and plant compartments progressively selecting a smaller subset of microorganisms. Compartment identity was the primary driver of bacterial (PERMANOVA R² = 0.204, p = 0.001) and fungal (R² = 0.187, p = 0.001) community composition. Bacterial diversity declined from rhizosphere to leaf endosphere, whereas fungal diversity increased markedly in the second year, indicating contrasting temporal dynamics between bacterial and fungal communities. Despite substantial interannual turnover, a stable bacterial core microbiome persisted across seasons. Source tracking revealed increasing environmental recruitment over time, suggesting dynamic, soil-driven microbiome reassembly under continued host selection. The strong dominance of Leveillula in first-year leaf endospheres further suggests host-associated fungal colonisation of alkaloid-rich tissues. Overall, these findings reveal strong compartmental and temporal filtering shaping the P. harmala microbiome.

articles.title: Design and Fabrication of All-Perovskite Solid-State Supercapacitors Using MAPbI₃ Electrodes and 2D-BA₂PbI₄-Doped PEO Gel Polymer Electrolytes
articles.abstract: The flexible solid-state supercapacitors need materials with a high ionic conductivity, high mechanical stability and effective charge transport at their interfaces. In this work, a solid-state supercapacitor with all-perovskite electrodes was fabricated with the addition of two-dimensional (2D) BA₂PbI₄ into a polyethylene oxide (PEO) gel polymer electrolyte. The PEO matrix was optimized by incorporating a filler such as the BA₂PbI₄ (0–15 wt%). The pure MAPbI3 and layered BA2PbI4 were checked using X-ray diffraction. The reduced crystallinity of PEO helped improve ion movement. FESEM images showed the compact MAPbI3 electrodes and even spread of the filler. The electrolyte with 10% BA2PbI4 had the most even structure. The best electrolyte had an ionic conductivity of 3.8 × 10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹, a bulk resistance of 263 ohms, an activation energy of 0.32 eV, and good flexibility with a tensile strength of 6.8 MPa. The symmetric MAPbI3/10% BA2PbI4-PEO GPE/MAPbI3 device showed electric double-layer and pseudocapacitive behavior. It had a high Cs of 312 F/g⁻¹ at 1 A/g⁻¹, an ED of 34.7 Wh/kg⁻¹, and a PD of 5.8 kW/kg⁻¹. After 5000 charge-discharge cycles, the device kept 91% of its initial capacitance with high coulombic efficiency, showing excellent long-term stability of layered perovskite-based GPEs for future flexible energy storage devices.

articles.title: Signatures of quantum chaos in phonon-polariton billiards
articles.abstract: We use scanning near-field optical microscopy to study hyperbolic phonon polaritons in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) cavities with regular and chaotic geometries . In Sinai billiards, we observe quasi-periodic edge modes, quantum scarring, and irregular patterns that evolve as the probe-sample coupling is varied. The random-wave features coexist with non-chaotic one-dimensional boundary modes arising from non-trivial polariton reflection at the billiard edge. In successive iterations of Koch snowflake billiards, we find polaritonic interference patterns of progressively finer structure. The Fourier transforms of polaritonic images reveal densely populated circles in the reciprocal space, in agreement with Berry’s random-wave conjecture. We develop a numerical framework based on the two-dimensional Helmholtz equation with boundary conditions that encode angle-dependent reflection phase shifts. Theoretical analysis of dissipative Green’s function qualitatively reproduces the observations. The calculated level statistics exhibit a crossover from Poisson-like behavior in integrable billiards to Wigner-Dyson-like behavior in chaotic ones. These results establish van der Waals cavities as a rich platform for studying generalized chaotic dynamics of light-matter hybrid polaritons.

articles.title: Large Pore-mediated deformability and mechano-molecular gating in MFI zeolites
articles.abstract: Silicon-oxygen-bonded ceramics are considered intrinsically brittle1–3, yet their deformation behaviour upon topological ordering into zeolitic sub‑nanopores remains mechanistically unclear. Prior studies have characterized the elastic properties of zeolites 4 and revealed that excessive compression eventually causes framework collapse and amorphization 5,6. However, the atomic-scale deformation pathway bridging these two regimes, and the mechanisms that enable large yet reversible structural changes, remain largely unexplored due to the lack of direct real-space observations. Here we show that individual crystallites of pure-silica MFI zeolite sustain compressive strains of up to ~ 50% while exhibiting remarkable elasticity. In situ atomic-resolution imaging and molecular dynamics simulations reveal that the strain is accommodated by reversible elliptization of the sub-nanometer channels, in which rigid SiO4 tetrahedra rotate about compliant Si-O-Si hinges. Because the same channels confine guest molecules, cyclic compression acts as a molecular gate. Flexible n-octane is squeezed out within five cycles, whereas rigid p-xylene remains confined. These findings reveal the atomic origin of MFI zeolite deformability and establish a mechano-gating mechanism for molecular sieving, demonstrating that mechanical response can serve as a new design parameter for regulating molecular transport in porous crystalline frameworks.

articles.title: Security evaluation of quantum distance-bounding protocols via semidefinite programming
articles.abstract: Quantum distance-bounding (QDB) protocols use a timed fast phase of quantum communication to check that a prover is genuine and physically nearby. Comparing protocols is difficult because optimal attacks depend on protocol structure, so we isolate the fast phase and study one-round distance-fraud and mafia-fraud games. For discrete-variable QDB, semidefinite programs represent every allowed strategy in these games; each mafia-fraud value comes with an attack achieving it and a certificate that no attack does better. This contrasts with quantum position verification, where the attack splits between two separated parties and the optimization is nonconvex. The best one-round distance-fraud attack succeeds with probability 1/2 for all discrete-variable protocols studied, while mafia-fraud values differ; two of the four benchmarked protocols receive their first one-round results, and the other two receive stronger attacks than previously reported. For continuous-variable QDB, we report estimates from a calibrated Gaussian attack model.

articles.title: A Declining Longwave Cloud Radiative Effect over Iraq: Satellite-Based Climatology and Dynamical Attribution
articles.abstract: The longwave cloud radiative effect (LWCRE) over Iraq during spring remains poorly constrained by independent observation, given the region's climatological complexity and the internal-consistency limits of reanalysis-based cloud diagnostics. This study presents a multi-source, satellite-based characterization of spring LWCRE over Iraq for 2001–2024, combining CERES EBAF radiation and cloud retrievals with ERA5 used exclusively for dynamical attribution. Spring LWCRE averages 26.5 W/m² and peaks at 29.7 W/m² in April, with a northeast-to-southwest gradient consistent with orographically enhanced cloud development along the Zagros foothills (37.4 W/m² maximum) versus subsidence over the southwestern desert (16.5 W/m² minimum). A significant declining trend of 1.72 W/m² per decade (p = 0.044) is found, with cloud-top warming plausibly contributing about half. Deep convective clouds dominate spring cloudiness (62.5% of months), but thin cirrus show ~ 37% higher LWCRE per unit optical thickness. LWCRE shows no significant association with ENSO (r = − 0.02, p = 0.92); a composite analysis instead links the most extreme years to upper-level trough positioning, with 250-hPa heights 51.6 m lower and ascent significantly stronger in high- versus low-LWCRE years (p < 0.05). Iraq's inland lakes show a nearly five-fold enhancement in surface latent heat flux relative to the surrounding desert, consistent with a role as local moisture sources. These findings establish an independently observed, physically coherent picture of high-cloud radiative behavior over Iraq and provide a benchmark for evaluating cloud–radiation representation in regional reanalysis and climate models.

articles.title: Response timing and the cost of delay: a model-based policy counterfactual of the 2025 Foshan chikungunya outbreak in China
articles.abstract: Background Between June and December 2025, Guangdong Province, China, experienced the largest chikungunya outbreak ever recorded in the country, with Foshan City as its epicentre. The emergency response was unprecedented in scale, but the contribution of response timing and intensity to the outcome has not been quantified. We developed a model-based policy counterfactual to ask how the outbreak would have differed under alternative response scenarios.Methods We coupled a weather-driven mechanistic model of Aedes albopictus density with a two-zone host-vector transmission model in which temperature-dependent extrinsic incubation and vector competence followed published trait surfaces. The response was encoded as a two-step schedule matching the documented timeline (case finding from 8 July 2025; citywide vector control from 19 July 2025). Parameters were estimated against post-detection-wave surveillance anchors only, with uncertainty represented by a six-start envelope. Five scenarios were compared: the fitted actual response, no response, the actual response advanced or delayed by two weeks, and a Breteau-index-triggered response.Results The fitted model reproduced the observed outbreak (11,988 cases; envelope 10,695 to 13,018) against approximately 10,819 officially reported for Foshan. Growth of reported cases between 15 July and 9 August 2025 was dominated by a detection wave from active case finding rather than by incidence; by 15 July true infections exceeded reported cases by a factor of 5.1 to 14.5. Removing the response gave a median of 95,182 reported cases (78,084 to 127,785), 7.9 times the fitted actual level. Advancing the response by two weeks reduced final size by 27%, a two-week delay increased it by 42%, and a Breteau-index threshold trigger reduced it by approximately half.Conclusions Within this reconstruction, response timing determined the scale of the 2025 Foshan outbreak more than any other single factor. Entomological thresholds were crossed weeks before the epidemic was detected, and acting on them could have substantially reduced the outbreak. The framework offers a reusable instrument for evaluating response policy in cities facing Aedes-borne outbreak risk.

articles.title: Runtime Risk Detection and Control for AI Agents and LLM Applications
articles.abstract: Agent-oriented large language model applications require runtime controls that connect detection, risk representation, proportionate response, human oversight, and reviewable evidence. This article reports an artefact-based software case study of AgentGuard AI v2.4.0, a research prototype that operationalises the Secure Runtime Monitoring Protocol (SRMP), Adaptive Agent Risk Scoring (AARS), and Risk-Adaptive Scheduling and State Control (RASS). Evidence was triangulated from author-supplied design records, the public deployment inspected on 27 August 2026, and a downloaded archive from one 25-event synthetic smoke test. The prototype combines a 23-rule monitoring library, six risk dimensions, four control states, role-based access, privacy options, audit chaining, replay, statistical views, standards traceability, and report export in a Python 3.11 Streamlit application. The inspected deployment exposed 23 functional pages plus an overview, extending the documented 17-page baseline. The synthetic run completed and produced raw events, alerts, risk scores, actions, configuration, metrics, and checksums. It also exposed material reproducibility defects: the interface and archive disagreed on the active AARS version; seed and source-commit fields were absent; and the exported high-risk action records did not match the exported policy mapping. These observations show that AgentGuard AI is an inspectable, governance-aware research instrument, but do not establish detection effectiveness, production enforcement, or operational reliability. The contribution is a bounded reference pattern for connecting runtime risk analytics with human review and evidence, together with an explicit account of the validation work still required.

articles.title: Stacking faults from a different angle - Overcoming the edge-on limit in high-resolution defect analysis
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.15510v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The nature of stacking faults (SF) - whether intrinsic or extrinsic - plays a pivotal role in defect-mediated processes in crystalline materials. Yet, transmission electron microscopy (TEM) techniques for their reliable analysis remain limited to either conventional fringe-contrast imaging of inclined faults or atomic-resolution imaging of edge-on configurations. Here, we overcome this long-standing geometric constraint by introducing a high-resolution scanning TEM method that enables full structural discrimination of inclined SFs, as demonstrated in fcc, L1₂, and sphalerite crystals. This approach complements edge-on analysis and provides access to SFs on all glide planes along commonly utilized zone axes. We demonstrate the method's robustness in a CoNi-based superalloy by discriminating fault types even in overlapping configurations and for foil thicknesses exceeding 100 nm, and extend its application to analyzing bounding partial dislocations in inclined geometries to reveal the fault formation mechanism. Probe propagation simulations reveal that fault-induced de-channeling is key to contrast formation and is strongly governed by the fault's depth within the sample. Leveraging this effect, we further establish a route to artificially generate ultrathin TEM lamellae - bounded by the SF itself - enhancing contrast for atomic-scale studies of long-range ordering and compositional fluctuations.

articles.title: Non-local edge mode hybridization in the long-range interacting Kitaev chain
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.26447v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In one-dimensional p-wave superconductors with short-range interactions, topologically protected Majorana modes emerge, whose mass decays exponentially with system size, as first shown by Kitaev. In this work, we extend this prototypical model by including power law long-range interactions within a self-consistent framework, leading to the self-consistent long-range Kitaev chain (seco-LRKC). In this model, the gap matrix acquires a rich structure where short-range superconducting correlations coexist with long-range correlations that are exponentially localized at both chain edges simultaneously. As a direct consequence, the topological edge modes hybridize even if their wavefunction overlap vanishes, and the edge mode mass inherits the asymptotic scaling of the interaction. In contrast to models with imposed power law pairing, where massive Dirac modes emerge for exponents ν < d, we analytically motivate and numerically demonstrate that, in the fully self-consistent model, algebraic edge mode decay with system size persists for all interaction exponents ν > 0, despite exponential wave function localization. While the edge mode remains massless in the thermodynamic limit, finite-size corrections can be experimentally relevant in mesoscopic systems with effective long-range interactions that decay sufficiently slowly. Our findings have direct implications for quantum simulations of ultracold microwave-shielded dipolar molecules in one-dimensional optical lattices.

articles.title: Competing Ring-Opening and Hofmann Elimination Pathways in Aqueous TEMPO Catholytes: A First-Principles Study
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.08721v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Aqueous redox-flow batteries based on TEMPO derivatives are promising for large-scale energy storage, but their practical use is limited by the chemical instability of the oxidized N -oxoammonium state. In this work, we investigate the degradation of five TEMPO derivatives using ab initio molecular dynamics combined with enhanced sampling. Two proposed degradation mechanisms, ring opening and Hofmann elimination, are examined and their corresponding activation free energies are compared. For all derivatives considered, ring opening exhibits a lower activation free energy than Hofmann elimination, identifying it as the kinetically preferred degradation pathway. The magnitude of the ring-opening barrier, however, varies significantly between molecules, showing that different functionalizations strongly influence its stability toward degradation. The predicted preference for ring opening is consistent with available experimental studies, which have identified or inferred ring-opening degradation for several TEMPO-based catholytes. These results provide an atomistic picture of degradation pathways that are difficult to resolve experimentally and highlight the importance of molecular structure in controlling the kinetic stability of TEMPO derivatives in aqueous electrolytes.

articles.title: Anomalous supercurrents in the presence of particle losses
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.21085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We show that supercurrent properties in a superfluid or superconducting junction are significantly modified by single-particle losses in a conduction channel. In the presence of a spin-independent particle loss, we find regimes where the Josephson current I_N(φ) can develop additional zeros within 0<φ<π and the direction of the supercurrent is reversed. Although the region is narrow, we also find a regime in which the critical current is enhanced by dissipation. Such anomalous behaviors in the Josephson current are attributed to a subtle interplay between the contribution that is present regardless of dissipation and the unconventional one that is absent without dissipation and is associated with the quantum jump term of the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equation. In the presence of a spin-selective particle loss, it is shown that a dissipation-induced spin supercurrent and its reversal occur. The proposed system is analyzed by means of the Keldysh field theory approach based on the GKSL master equation and may be realized in ultracold atomic gases and solid-state systems.

articles.title: Stacking and the triviality of invertible phases
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.08382v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the superselection sectors of two quantum lattice systems stacked onto each other in the operator algebraic framework. We show in particular that all irreducible sectors of a stacked system are unitarily equivalent to a product of irreducible sectors of the factors. This naturally leads to a faithful functor between the categories for each system and the category of the stacked system. We construct an intermediate `product' category which we then show is equivalent to the stacked system category. As a consequence, the sectors associated with an invertible state are trivial, namely, invertible states support no anyonic quasi-particles.

articles.title: Information-theoretic appraisal of electron densities
articles.abstract: We present an information-theoretic assessment of atomic and molecular densities in the ground state and under a range of physical scenarios—excitation, confinement, and ensemblization. Comparisons across densities obtained from single-reference methods are facilitated through information entropy measures evaluated in position space. We demonstrate that the J-divergence serves as a key metric for benchmarking electron densities against coupled cluster and configuration interaction references. Mean-field orbital information is further compared with that of Brueckner and Dyson orbitals, and informational changes in multiple self-consistent-field solutions are examined under various symmetry-breaking conditions. We also explore the relationship between the entropic measures of electron delocalization and the accuracy of the CO dipole moment computed with different methods. Our work offers insights into the selection of optimal reference determinants for a given chemical application and highlights potential benefits of incorporating information-entropy concepts in the development of new density functionals.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Deep potential modeling of oxygen adsorption and surface reconstruction on silica
articles.abstract: The binding energy of atomic oxygen on silica has remained uncertain for decades. This quantity directly governs catalytic heating during atmospheric re-entry. Classical potentials overestimate it by an order of magnitude (ReaxFFSiOGSI: ∼31 eV vs experiment: ∼3 eV), while first-principles methods cannot reach the scales required for adsorption equilibration. Although neural network potentials bridge this accuracy–efficiency gap, conventional sampling fails to provide training data spanning rare reactive events within collective phase transitions. Here, we train a neural-network potential (HyGSI) using a hybrid enhanced sampling-machine learning framework coupling on-the-fly probability enhanced sampling with deep potential molecular dynamics. HyGSI covers SiO 2 melting, pressure-dependent surface reconstruction, and oxygen adsorption–recombination. The predicted adsorption energy is 2.96 ± 0.15 eV, consistent with the 1991 experimental estimate (3.00 ± 0.31 eV) and an order of magnitude lower than ReaxFFSiOGSI predictions. Furthermore, surface reconstruction reshapes available catalytic sites, coupling structural evolution to reaction chemistry. These findings provide corrected energetics for hypersonic re-entry heat-flux models and validated force fields for semiconductor plasma etching and fusion reactor wall modeling.

articles.title: Molecular origins of pH gradients in charge-regulated biomolecular condensates
articles.abstract: Biomolecular condensates exhibit spontaneous electrochemical microenvironments characterized by asymmetric ion distributions and pH gradients that emerge from protein-sequence-dependent charge regulation. Despite their biological importance, mechanistic understanding of these microenvironments has been constrained by the absence of computationally tractable frameworks capable of treating proton exchange, counterion partitioning, and buffer equilibria on consistent thermodynamic footing. Here, we introduce the buffered Charge-Regulation Monte Carlo (b-CR-MC) framework, which couples grand-canonical exchange of ions and buffer species with explicit charge regulation of titratable residues. By extending the CR-MC ion-merging strategy to multicomponent reservoirs and employing the restricted primitive model, b-CR-MC achieves computational efficiency while maintaining thermodynamic rigor, achieving quantitative agreement with the more expensive generalized grand-reaction Monte Carlo approach. Applied to full-length FUS (net positive) and PGL-3 (net negative) under physiological conditions, the framework reveals sequence-dependent pH gradients: the dense phase of FUS exhibits an alkaline shift, while that of PGL-3 exhibits an acidic shift, in both cases driving the condensate interior toward the protein's isoelectric point. Slab-geometry simulations further resolve the Donnan potential and continuous ion profiles across the condensate interface, confirming the direction of these electrochemical shifts. Additionally, we identify spatially resolved buffer depletion within dense phases, establishing that dynamic charge regulation is a primary determinant rather than a secondary correction to condensate electrochemistry. By establishing a sequence-resolved, thermodynamically consistent computational platform, b-CR-MC enables quantitative prediction of how mutations and post-translational modifications reprogram condensate microenvironments across biological and pathophysiological contexts.

articles.title: Fixed-configuration inversion of interaction potentials from equilibrium configurations at fixed state points
articles.abstract: Recovering interaction potentials from structural information is a fundamental inverse problem in statistical physics and soft-matter research. We investigate a force-sampling implementation of fixed-configuration inversion for particle-resolved equilibrium configurations. A distance-histogram estimate from 10 000 configurations provides a fixed, potential-independent target, whereas forces recalculated from the current trial potential on fixed coordinate subsets generate smooth, potential-dependent responses. Disjoint training and validation subsets of 200 configurations each enable validation-controlled checkpoint selection and termination without generating new equilibrium trajectories. We test the method for a three-dimensional Lennard-Jones system at reduced inverse temperature β*=ε/kBT=1.0 and reduced number densities ρ*=ρσ3 of 0.01, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, and 0.90, where ρ is the number density and ε and σ are the energy and length scales. Over the reliable radial interval, the inversion recovers the principal features of the reference potential and reproduces the target structure within statistical resolution. A trajectory block bootstrap that repeats the complete inversion quantifies uncertainty in the target radial distribution function, validation response, and recovered potential, identifying sparse low-density pair statistics and limited pair occupancy near the repulsive core as important sources. Independent forward molecular dynamics simulations at ρ*=0.80 and 0.90 confirm reproduction under renewed sampling. At ρ*=0.80, a matched comparison showed an ∼204-fold reduction in wall-clock cost relative to conventional iterative Boltzmann inversion under the present implementations and validation-controlled stopping protocol. These results establish force sampling as an efficient, statistically controlled response estimator for fixed-configuration pair-potential inversion.

articles.title: A benchmark dataset for ground-state protonic densities and energies
articles.abstract: In this work, we present a benchmark set of protonic densities and energies aimed at testing and validating quantum chemical methods. In particular, we discuss the use of said data for benchmarking multicomponent calculations and the choice of nuclear basis functions. We selected 28 systems, spanning varying degrees of symmetry and acidity, from strongly acidic protons up to hydrides. The reference data were constructed through variational calculations on computed 1-particle potentials, fitted from Born–Oppenheimer 3D-grids. The chemical variety allows for more general fitting of electron–proton correlation functionals and/or basis sets for use in multicomponent calculations. As an illustration, we use the dataset to evaluate nuclear basis functions. Instead of fitting exponents to self-consistent numerical calculations, we evaluate different sets by observing how well the reference densities can be directly fitted. The basis sets under analysis are all based on Gaussian functions, for which we show the importance of higher-angular momentum (at least d-type functions). We also present a procedure for basis-set construction based on vibrational theory. Finally, we propose two series of nuclear basis sets, vc1-PBnZ and vc1-PBnZ+t, and recommend the latter for routine multicomponent calculations.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Proton-transfer dictated supramolecular hydrogen bonded architecture in cytosine with substituted carboxylic acid coformers: Experimental and theoretical investigation by density functional approximations, DLPNO-CCSD(T)-F12, and G 0 W 0 calculations
articles.abstract: The nucleobase cytosine has been utilized for co-crystallization with three coformers (gallic acid, aspirin, and thiazole-4-carboxylic acid) by the solvent grinding method. The resulting salts CYT-GAL, CYT-SAL, and CYT-TCA were characterized by the single-crystal x-ray diffraction technique. Structural analysis reveals that the salts are stabilized by N–H⋯O and N–H⋯N hydrogen bonds (HBs). Protonation of cytosine (N3) leads to the formation of R22(8) ring sets, which violates the Watson–Crick pair formation. Furthermore, all the features of these salts were confirmed by PXRD, TGA, NMR, and FTIR. HOMO–LUMO gaps were benchmarked using 65 DFAs against the HF/VTZ-F12 HOMO–LUMO gaps because DLPNO-CCSD(T)-F12, such as MP2, retains the HF orbitals and does not alter orbital energies. HOMO–LUMO gaps obtained at this level are the same as the HF/VTZ-F12 HOMO–LUMO gaps. Range-separated double-hybrid DFAs (RSX-QIDH, SCS-RSX-QIDH, and SOS-RSX-QIDH) showed the best agreement with these gaps. G 0 W 0 calculations using several DFAs and HF starting points were additionally performed to assess their reliability for predicting these gaps. Bonding analysis using quantum theory of atoms in molecules (QTAIM), non-covalent interaction (NCI), natural bond orbital, and molecular electrostatic potential was carried out at the DSD-PBEP86-D3BJ/def2-TZVP level of theory, validated against seven additional DFAs. QTAIM reveals that CYT-GAL is stabilized by N–H⋯O intermolecular HBs, CYT-SAL is stabilized by a partially covalent O–H⋯O intramolecular HB (delocalization index 0.1128), and CYT-TCA is stabilized by weaker van der Waals interactions (C⋯C, C⋯N, and S⋯N). Furthermore, NCI analysis reveals new interactions, including intramolecular HBs of type O–H⋯O and H⋯O interactions in CYT-GAL, a new H⋯O interaction in the case of CYT-SAL, and a new C⋯C interaction in the case of CYT-TCA.

articles.title: Q-ADC(2): A parallel quadrature-based second-order algebraic diagrammatic construction method for electronic excitations with fourth-order scaling
articles.abstract: A quadrature-based formulation of the second-order algebraic diagrammatic construction [ADC(2)] scheme for electronic excitations is presented, reducing its formal computational scaling and memory requirements by one order to quartic and cubic, respectively. The resulting Q-ADC(2) method explicitly accounts for both opposite-spin and same-spin contributions, thereby retaining a fully ab initio nature. The approach is based on a seminumerical decomposition of the four-index electron-repulsion integrals into products of molecular-orbital amplitudes evaluated on a molecular integration grid and a three-center electric-field integral over the remaining orbital pair. In combination with a Laplace transform treatment of the energy denominators, this enables more efficient contraction schemes through decoupling of orbital indices. Construction of the large virtual-virtual block of the three-index integrals is avoided, improving computational efficiency. In addition, the formulation is well suited for parallelization on distributed-memory architectures. A mixed-order Q-ADC(2/1) scheme is developed, providing access to ground-to-excited-state transition moments at an additional computational cost that scales only cubically. The accuracy of the method with respect to ADC(2) is assessed for excitation energies and oscillator strengths across different molecular integration grids. Its applicability is further demonstrated by calculations on larger representative fluorophores with up to 2806 basis functions.

articles.title: Diagonal Pair Coulomb Density Matrix on a Sphere: a numerical study
articles.title_zh: 球面上的对角线成对库仑密度矩阵：数值研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We tabulate, on the diagonal, the nth power of the primitive approximation for the pair Coulomb density matrix on a sphere, with up to n=5, and we discuss its behavior at particles contact as n grows. Our results show that even on a curved surface quantum statistical physics is fundamentally different from its classical counterpart. If in the latter one needs to artificially introduce a regularization of the divergent attractive Coulomb potential preventing particles contact, for example with a hard core, in the former this is not necessary.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在球面上对成对库仑密度矩阵的原始近似的幂次进行了对角线数值列表整理，最高达到n=5，并讨论了随着n增大其在粒子接触处的行为。结果表明，即使在曲面上，量子统计物理也与经典对应物存在根本差异；经典情况下需要人为引入硬核等正则化来阻止粒子接触，而量子情况下则不需要这样做。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在对角线上列出了球面上成对库仑密度矩阵的原始近似的第n次幂，最高达到n=5，并讨论了随着n增大该矩阵在粒子接触处的行为。我们的结果表明，即使在曲面上，量子统计物理也与其经典对应物存在根本差异。在经典情况下，人们需要人为引入一种正则化，以防止具有发散吸引性库仑势的粒子发生接触，例如采用硬核；而在量子情况下，则没有必要这样做。

articles.title: Optimized quantum state transfer in a quasiperiodic ultracold atomic gas
articles.title_zh: 准周期超冷原子气体中的优化量子态转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultracold atomic systems offer a highly controllable platform for investigating quantum state transfer through the precise dynamical manipulation of system parameters. While quantized Thouless pumping has been extensively explored in these systems, adiabatic edge-to-edge transfer of localized quantum states remains largely unexplored. Here, we consider a one-dimensional ultracold atomic gas confined in a bichromatic optical lattice realizing a quasiperiodic Aubry--André--Harper system. We use its edge-localized winding states to implement quantum state transfer between opposite boundaries. Starting from the instantaneous spectral properties of the corresponding tight-binding model, we construct locally adiabatic protocols and extend the approach to higher protocol orders. We then simulate their dynamics under the full continuum bichromatic-lattice Hamiltonian. Our results reveal a tradeoff between edge localization and the minimum spectral gap: strongly localized states require longer transfer times, but can benefit substantially from higher protocol orders. We are also able to capture the main fidelity trends and coherent oscillations over a broad parameter regime using an effective two-level Landau--Zener description. Our results provide practical guidelines for selecting experimentally accessible parameters and tailoring quantum transfer protocols in quasiperiodic ultracold atomic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用双色光学晶格中的准周期 Aubry–André–Harper 系统，通过边缘局域绕数态实现量子态在相反边界之间的转移。作者构造了局域绝热及高阶协议，并在完整连续模型中模拟其动力学，揭示了边缘局域性、最小能隙与转移时间之间的权衡关系。有效的两能级 Landau–Zener 描述能够在较宽参数范围内捕捉保真度趋势和相干振荡，为实验参数选择与协议设计提供指导。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超冷原子系统能够通过对系统参数进行精确的动力学操控，为研究量子态转移提供高度可控的平台。尽管量子化 Thouless 泵浦已在这些系统中得到广泛研究，但局域量子态从一个边缘绝热转移到另一个边缘的过程仍基本未被探索。在这里，我们研究了一种被限制在双色光学晶格中的一维超冷原子气体，该晶格实现了准周期 Aubry–André–Harper 系统。我们利用其中边缘局域的绕数态，实现了量子态在相反边界之间的转移。基于相应紧束缚模型的瞬时谱性质，我们构造了局域绝热协议，并将这一方法扩展到更高阶的协议。随后，我们在完整的连续双色晶格哈密顿量下模拟了这些协议的动力学。结果揭示了边缘局域性与最小能隙之间的权衡关系：强局域态需要更长的转移时间，但能够显著受益于更高阶的协议。在较宽的参数范围内，我们还能够利用有效的两能级 Landau–Zener 描述捕捉主要的保真度变化趋势和相干振荡。我们的结果为在准周期超冷原子系统中选择实验可实现的参数以及定制量子转移协议提供了实用指导。

articles.title: Real-space Visualization of Emergent Electron Crystals in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱方石墨烯中涌现电子晶体的实空间可视化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly interacting electrons can spontaneously break spatial symmetries to form electron crystals, exemplified by the Wigner crystal. Recent studies of topological flat bands in rhombohedral graphene have suggested more exotic forms of crystallization, including anomalous Hall crystals that entangle charge order with nontrivial topology and metallic electron crystals in which localized and itinerant carriers coexist. Direct real-space observation of these states, however, has remained elusive. Here we use scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy to visualize emergent electron crystals in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene. At low electric fields and over a finite range of hole doping, we observe electronic lattice patterns that evolve from honeycomb to oblique order through a first-order quantum phase transition with increasing hole density. The Fermi surface extracted from quasiparticle-interference measurements lacks the geometry needed to account for these patterns through conventional nesting. Together with metallic transport and a crystal-site density much lower than the doped carrier density, this supports metallic electron crystals in which a subset of carriers crystallizes. The honeycomb crystal occupies the same phase space as the multiferroic orbital magnetism observed previously in transport and exhibits domain stabilization by a small magnetic field, which may suggest a possible metallic anomalous Hall crystal. With increasing magnetic field, the oblique phase develops a sqrt2×sqrt2 reconstruction with a crystal-sublattice energy splitting that increases linearly with field, corresponding to a g-factor of 16. This may reflect an orbital-antiferromagnetic electron crystal with alternating orbital magnetization across the lattice. These results establish a new paradigm of electron crystallization in which charge order is intertwined with orbital magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用扫描隧道显微镜和扫描隧道谱，直接观察了菱方六层石墨烯中的涌现电子晶体。随着空穴密度增加，电子晶格图案经历从蜂窝序到斜格序的一阶量子相变，且其形成不能由常规费米面嵌套解释。结果支持部分载流子结晶形成金属电子晶体，并表明电荷序与轨道磁性相互交织。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强相互作用电子能够自发破缺空间对称性而形成电子晶体，典型例子是 Wigner 晶体。近期对菱方石墨烯中拓扑平带的研究提出了更奇异的结晶形式，包括将电荷序与非平凡拓扑纠缠在一起的反常霍尔晶体，以及局域载流子与巡游载流子共存的金属电子晶体。然而，这些态的直接实空间观测一直难以实现。在这里，我们利用扫描隧道显微镜和扫描隧道谱，对菱方六层石墨烯中的涌现电子晶体进行了可视化。在低电场和有限范围的空穴掺杂下，我们观察到电子晶格图案随着空穴密度增加，经由一阶量子相变从蜂窝序演化为斜格序。通过准粒子干涉测量提取的费米面缺乏通过常规嵌套解释这些图案所需的几何形状。结合金属输运性质以及远低于掺杂载流子密度的晶格位点密度，这些结果支持一种金属电子晶体，其中只有部分载流子发生结晶。蜂窝晶体所占据的相空间与此前在输运实验中观察到的多铁轨道磁性相同，并且其畴能够被微弱磁场稳定，这可能暗示一种金属反常霍尔晶体。在磁场增强时，斜格相形成 sqrt2×sqrt2 重构，其晶格子能量分裂随磁场线性增加，对应的 g 因子为 16。这可能反映了一种轨道反铁磁电子晶体，其中轨道磁化强度在晶格上交替排列。这些结果确立了电子结晶的新范式，其中电荷序与轨道磁性相互交织。

articles.title: Breakdown of Multipole Expansion in Emergent Electromagnetism
articles.title_zh: 涌现电磁学中的多极展开失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We find a striking departure from simple electrostatics in a family of two-dimensional lattice models whose effective description takes the form of an emergent electromagnetism: a high-order multipolar charge configuration can induce an electric field characteristic of a lower-order multipole. Studying the archetypical hardcore dimer and U(1) spin-1/2 link models, we trace this to a breakdown of the superposition principle: for dense charge configurations, there can be a nonlinear suppression, or even enhancement, of the far field compared to the linear expectation. Our work establishes that microscopic lattice-scale constraints in models for emergent electromagnetism can change the far-field behaviour to differ from often utilized long-wavelength descriptions in standard effective continuum models.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究发现，在一类具有涌现电磁学有效描述的二维晶格模型中，高阶多极电荷构型可能产生具有低阶多极特征的电场。以硬核二聚体模型和 U(1) 自旋-1/2 链接模型为例，作者将其归因于叠加原理的失效：对于高密度电荷构型，远场相较线性预期可能受到非线性抑制，甚至得到增强。结果表明，晶格尺度的微观约束能够显著改变涌现电磁学的远场行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在一类二维晶格模型中发现了对简单静电学的显著偏离，这些模型的有效描述具有涌现电磁学的形式：高阶多极电荷构型能够产生具有低阶多极特征的电场。通过研究典型的硬核二聚体模型和 U(1) 自旋-1/2 链接模型，我们将这一现象追溯到叠加原理的失效：对于高密度电荷构型，远场相较于线性预期可能出现非线性抑制，甚至增强。我们的工作表明，用于描述涌现电磁学的微观晶格尺度约束，能够改变远场行为，使其不同于标准有效连续模型中常用的长波长描述。

articles.title: Unusual phase coexistence regime across the ferroelectric - paraelectric transition
articles.title_zh: 铁电—顺电相变过程中的异常相共存区间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A PbTiO3 epitaxial thin film grown on a DyScO3 substrate was studied by x-ray diffraction in the temperature range of 20-500 degrees Celsius. It is found that the ferroelectric to paraelectric phase transition proceeds through a peculiar transitional coexistence state extending between 402 degrees Celsius and 414 degrees Celsius. Within this temperature interval, at a temperature of 405 degrees Celsius, a domain structure transition occurs, at which the three-domain c/a1/a2 polytwin phase transforms into an ordinary c/a2 twinned phase. It is proposed that the coexistence of two independent twinned phases with the paraelectric phase is enabled by vertical strain gradients in the film.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究通过 X 射线衍射考察了生长于 DyScO3 衬底上的 PbTiO3 外延薄膜在 20–500 摄氏度范围内的结构变化。结果发现，铁电到顺电的相变经过 402–414 摄氏度的特殊过渡性共存态，并在 405 摄氏度发生畴结构转变。作者提出，薄膜中的垂直应变梯度可能使两种独立孪晶相与顺电相共存。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究人员通过 X 射线衍射，研究了生长在 DyScO3 衬底上的 PbTiO3 外延薄膜在 20–500 摄氏度温度范围内的性质。研究发现，铁电到顺电的相变经历了一个特殊的过渡性共存态，该状态延伸于 402 摄氏度和 414 摄氏度之间。在这一温区内、405 摄氏度处发生了畴结构转变，即三畴 c/a1/a2 多孪晶相转变为普通的 c/a2 孪晶相。研究提出，薄膜中的垂直应变梯度可能使两种相互独立的孪晶相与顺电相实现共存。

articles.title: Orbital-geometric spin response: inter-band coherence versus orbital-to-spin conversion
articles.title_zh: 轨道几何自旋响应：能带间相干与轨道到自旋的转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbitronics seeks to convert orbital angular momentum (OAM) into spin, but its microscopic dynamics is not understood. Here I show that, at moderate spin-orbit coupling, an electrically induced spin density contains a direct term and an orbital-geometric spin response (OGSR) due to inter-band coherence of the spinless parent Hamiltonian---related to OAM but not descended from it. In massive Dirac fermions the OGSR survives as the net OAM vanishes, and generates counterflow, opposing the direct response. These results provide guidelines for optimising orbitronic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究表明，在中等自旋轨道耦合下，电场诱导的自旋密度包含直接项和轨道几何自旋响应，后者源于无自旋母哈密顿量的能带间相干，虽与轨道角动量有关，却并非由其直接转化而来。在有质量 Dirac 费米子中，即使净轨道角动量为零，该响应仍然存在，并可产生与直接响应方向相反的反向流。研究结果为优化轨道电子学体系提供了指导。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道电子学旨在将轨道角动量转换为自旋，但其微观动力学尚未得到理解。在这里，我表明，在中等自旋轨道耦合下，电场诱导的自旋密度包含一个直接项和一个轨道几何自旋响应。后者源于无自旋母哈密顿量的能带间相干，与轨道角动量有关，但并非由轨道角动量转化而来。在有质量 Dirac 费米子中，即使净轨道角动量为零，轨道几何自旋响应仍然存在，并产生与直接响应相反的反向流。这些结果为优化轨道电子学系统提供了指导。

articles.title: Functionalization-Driven Charge Redistribution Enabling Ultra-High-Capacity V2B MBene Anode for Li/Na ion batteries: A First-Principles study
articles.title_zh: 功能化驱动的电荷重排实现超高容量 V2B MBene 锂/钠离子电池负极：第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amid increasing global demand for clean, sustainable energy, the search for novel electrode materials has emerged as a crucial link to advancing future energy storage technologies. Here, we explored the potential of N-functionalized 2D MBene V2BN2 as anode materials for Li- and Na-ion batteries using first-principles calculations. Phonon dispersion and ab initio molecular dynamics calculations were employed to assess the dynamic and thermal stability of the material. The intrinsic metallic properties of V2BN2 were revealed through electronic band structures and density of states analyses. Importantly, Bader charge analysis demonstrates substantial charge redistribution upon Li/Na adsorption, leading to stronger ion-substrate interactions compared to the pristine counterpart. This redistribution plays a decisive role in enhancing Li/Na ion adsorption and stabilizing ion accommodation. Furthermore, owing to favorable multilayer adsorption of Li and Na ions, V2BN2 exhibited high theoretical specific capacities of 1524 and 762 mAh/g, as well as low open circuit voltages of 0.73 and 0.23 V for Li and Na, respectively. In addition, the energy barriers were calculated to be 0.49 and 0.29 eV for Li- and Na-ion transport, respectively, indicating rapid ion transport and excellent rate capability. These results indicate that V2BN2 holds significant potential as an anode material for next-generation rechargeable ion batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用第一性原理计算探讨了氮功能化二维 MBene V2BN2 作为锂离子和钠离子电池负极材料的潜力，并通过声子色散和从头算分子动力学评估其稳定性。Bader 电荷分析显示，Li/Na 吸附会引起显著电荷重排，从而增强离子与基底的相互作用。V2BN2 具有较高理论比容量、较低开路电压和较小离子迁移能垒，显示出用于下一代可充电离子电池的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着全球对清洁、可持续能源需求的不断增加，寻找新型电极材料已成为推动未来储能技术发展的关键环节。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算，探究了氮功能化二维 MBene V2BN2 作为锂离子和钠离子电池负极材料的潜力。我们采用声子色散和从头算分子动力学计算来评估该材料的动力学稳定性和热稳定性。通过电子能带结构和态密度分析，揭示了 V2BN2 的本征金属性。重要的是，Bader 电荷分析表明，吸附 Li/Na 后会发生显著的电荷重排，从而使其与基底之间的相互作用强于未功能化的对应材料。这种电荷重排在增强 Li/Na 离子吸附和稳定离子容纳方面发挥了决定性作用。此外，由于 Li 和 Na 离子能够进行有利的多层吸附，V2BN2 分别表现出 1524 和 762 mAh/g 的高理论比容量，以及分别为 0.73 和 0.23 V 的低开路电压。除此之外，计算得到 Li 离子和 Na 离子传输的能垒分别为 0.49 和 0.29 eV，表明其具有快速离子传输能力和优异的倍率性能。这些结果表明，V2BN2 作为下一代可充电离子电池的负极材料具有重要潜力。
articles.focus_summary: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究N功能化二维V2BN2 MBene作为锂、钠离子电池负极的结构稳定性、电子性质、离子吸附和电荷转移。结果表明，功能化引起的电荷重新分布增强了离子—基底相互作用，并带来较高理论容量和较低开路电压。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的二维材料、锂电池材料、能源存储、第一性原理计算、电子结构和电荷转移方向高度相关。其声子谱、第一性原理分子动力学、吸附能、Bader电荷及多层吸附分析可直接作为相关材料筛选的参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步评估缺陷、应变、层间耦合、离子扩散势垒、充放电过程中的结构演化及界面稳定性，并结合机器学习势开展更大尺度的离子迁移模拟。还应通过更高精度泛函和实验数据检验容量、开路电压及长期循环稳定性。

articles.title: Different critical exponents on two sides of the magnetic transition in two dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维磁性相变两侧的不同临界指数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The possibility of different critical exponents on two sides of a magnetic transition has been theoretically predicted [PRB 13, 2222 (1976), PRL 115, 200601 (2015)] and experimentally realized [PRL 128, 015703 (2022)] in three-dimensional systems. However, the emergence of such a scenario in two dimensions is not yet established. Here, we report distinct two-dimensional (2D) critical exponents below and above the magnetic transition temperature (TC) through critical scaling analysis in a quasi-2D non-centrosymmetric, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) active hybrid perovskite (C7H9NBr)2CuBr4. The system exhibits critical exponents of 2D Ising-type below TC and 2D XY-type above TC . In contrast, isostructural Cl and centrosymmetric Br analogs, in which the DMI effect is expected to be weaker, exhibit symmetric 2D critical behavior. These results highlight the crucial role of DMI in (C7H9NBr)2CuBr4 as a symmetry-breaking perturbation that alters the magnetic critical behavior differently above and below TC . Our study is the experimental realization of hitherto unreported asymmetric 2D critical behavior in structurally flexible and dimensionally tunable hybrid perovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究在准二维、非中心对称且具有 Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya 相互作用的杂化钙钛矿中，通过临界标度分析观察到磁性转变温度两侧不同的二维临界指数。转变温度以下呈现二维 Ising 型临界行为，以上则呈现二维 XY 型行为。对比样品表现出较为对称的二维临界行为，说明 DMI 这一破缺对称性的扰动可能是造成临界行为不对称的关键。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在三维系统中，磁性相变两侧出现不同临界指数的可能性已在理论上得到预测，并已通过实验实现。然而，这种情形在二维系统中的出现尚未得到确立。在这里，我们通过对准二维、非中心对称且具有 Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya 相互作用的杂化钙钛矿 (C7H9NBr)2CuBr4 进行临界标度分析，报道了磁性转变温度 TC 以下和以上不同的二维临界指数。该系统在 TC 以下表现出二维 Ising 型临界指数，在 TC 以上则表现出二维 XY 型临界指数。相比之下，同结构的 Cl 类比物和中心对称的 Br 类比物中，DMI 效应预计较弱，它们表现出对称的二维临界行为。这些结果突出表明，在 (C7H9NBr)2CuBr4 中，DMI 作为一种破缺对称性的扰动发挥了关键作用，以不同方式改变了 TC 以上和以下的磁性临界行为。我们的研究在结构可调、维度可调的杂化钙钛矿中，实现了此前尚未报道的不对称二维临界行为。

articles.title: Pseudo-hybrid density functional ACBN0 for Hubbard U correction in a numeric atom-centered orbital basis
articles.title_zh: 数值原子中心轨道基组中的 Hubbard U 修正赝杂化密度泛函 ACBN0
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12198v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a formulation and implementation of the Agapito-Curtarolo-Buongiorno Nardelli (ACBN0) pseudo-hybrid density functional in a numeric atom-centered orbital basis. The method is realized in the all-electron, full-potential electronic-structure package FHI-aims. The implementation uses a Löwdin-orthogonalized projector, which improved the stability of the self-consistent ACBN0 iterations for the tested systems. For a benchmark set of materials including metal oxides and nitrides, ACBN0 with the fully localized limit (FLL) as the double-counting treatment reduces the aggregate band gap errors relative to the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) and strongly constrained and appropriately normed (SCAN) functionals, reaching an accuracy comparable to the Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof functional (HSE06). For six bulk transition metal oxides calculated with the same numerical settings, an HSE06 iteration is approximately 13-33 times as expensive as the corresponding ACBN0@PBE iteration with Petukhov mixing. The applicability of the localized-basis implementation to low-dimensional systems is demonstrated by calculations of adsorption and the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) overpotential on a β-NiOOH(001) surface. On regularized SCAN (rSCAN) relaxed structures, single point ACBN0 based on rSCAN (ACBN0@rSCAN) with the ``tight'' numerical settings reduces the mean absolute deviation of the reaction-step energies from HSE06 and shifts the estimated overpotential toward the HSE06 and Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof hybrid (PBE0) reference results.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究给出了适用于数值原子中心轨道基组的 ACBN0 赝杂化密度泛函公式，并将其实现于全电子全势电子结构软件 FHI-aims 中。采用 Löwdin 正交化投影器提高了自洽迭代的稳定性；对多种材料的基准测试表明，结合完全局域化极限双计数处理的 ACBN0 可显著改善带隙误差，精度接近 HSE06，而计算成本明显更低。对低维体系的应用也显示，该方法能够改进表面吸附和析氧反应过电势的预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出并实现了适用于数值原子中心轨道基组的 Agapito–Curtarolo–Buongiorno Nardelli（ACBN0）赝杂化密度泛函。该方法被实现于全电子、全势电子结构软件包 FHI-aims 中。该实现采用 Löwdin 正交化投影器，提高了所测试体系中 ACBN0 自洽迭代的稳定性。对于包括金属氧化物和氮化物在内的一组基准材料，采用完全局域化极限（FLL）作为双计数处理的 ACBN0，相较于 Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof（PBE）和强约束且适当归一化（SCAN）泛函，降低了总体带隙误差，并达到了与 Heyd–Scuseria–Ernzerhof 泛函（HSE06）相当的精度。对于使用相同数值设置计算的六种块体过渡金属氧化物，采用 Petukhov 混合的 HSE06 迭代，其计算成本约为相应 ACBN0@PBE 迭代的 13–33 倍。通过计算 β-NiOOH(001) 表面的吸附和析氧反应（OER）过电势，展示了该局域基组实现对低维体系的适用性。在经过正则化 SCAN（rSCAN）弛豫的结构上，采用 rSCAN 的单点 ACBN0 计算（ACBN0@rSCAN）并使用紧致数值设置，可以降低反应步骤能量相对于 HSE06 的平均绝对偏差，并使估算的过电势向 HSE06 和 Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof 杂化泛函（PBE0）的参考结果移动。

articles.title: Selective coupling of coherent phonons to intertwined charge-orbital and magnetic orders in doped manganites
articles.title_zh: 掺杂锰氧化物中相干声子与交织电荷—轨道序和磁序的选择性耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly correlated materials feature technologically relevant functionalities such as high-temperature superconductivity and colossal magnetoresistance, which emerges from the competition and coexistence of electronic and magnetic phases. Uncovering the microscopic interactions underlying these phenomena remains challenging because spin, orbital, charge, and lattice degrees of freedom are inherently intertwined. Here, by combining time-resolved X-ray diffraction and polarization-resolved ultrafast optical reflectivity in La1/4Pr3/8Ca3/8MnO3, we reveal that coherent phonon modes can selectively track different ordered phases: the in-plane phonon response is predominantly sensitive to charge/orbital order, and the c-axis phonon response is sensitive to magnetic order. Moreover, a ferromagnetic-related hysteresis emerges even when solely probing the charge/orbital-ordered phase, indicating a strong microscopic coupling between the spatially separated charge/orbital-ordered and ferromagnetic-ordered phases. These results demonstrate that coherent phonons provide a direct time-domain route to disentangle intertwined electronic and magnetic dynamics in coupled phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究结合时间分辨 X 射线衍射和偏振分辨超快光学反射率，在 La1/4Pr3/8Ca3/8MnO3 中揭示相干声子能够选择性追踪不同有序相。面内声子响应主要对电荷/轨道序敏感，而 c 轴声子响应则对磁序敏感。即使仅探测电荷/轨道有序相，也观察到与铁磁性相关的磁滞，表明空间分离的电荷/轨道序与铁磁序之间存在强微观耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强关联材料具有高温超导和庞磁阻等具有技术意义的功能，这些功能源于电子相和磁性相之间的竞争与共存。由于自旋、轨道、电荷和晶格自由度本质上相互交织，揭示支配这些现象的微观相互作用仍然具有挑战性。在这里，通过结合时间分辨 X 射线衍射和偏振分辨超快光学反射率，我们在 La1/4Pr3/8Ca3/8MnO3 中揭示，相干声子模式能够选择性地追踪不同的有序相。面内声子响应主要对电荷/轨道序敏感，而 c 轴声子响应则对磁序敏感。此外，即使仅探测电荷/轨道有序相，也会出现与铁磁性相关的磁滞，这表明空间分离的电荷/轨道有序相与铁磁有序相之间存在强烈的微观耦合。这些结果表明，相干声子为解开耦合相中交织的电子和磁性动力学提供了一条直接的时间域途径。

articles.title: Geometric Approach to the High-Throughput Identification of Honeycomb Materials
articles.title_zh: 用于高通量识别蜂窝材料的几何方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The honeycomb lattice is an iconic structural motif in condensed matter physics. However, emerging theoretical models require the identification of new honeycomb lattice materials with strict specification on their structural, magnetic, and electronic characteristics. In this work, we introduce a filtering algorithm using simple geometric arguments to detect materials with honeycomb structural motifs. We classify four unique categories of lattices: conventional honeycombs, hyperhoneycombs, staircase or zigzag honeycombs, and fully 3D honeycombs. We also identify several distortion motifs in the conventional honeycomb set: elongated, sheared, and buckled honeycombs. We describe several screening criteria for further analysis of honeycomb systems, specifically the quantification of exfoliability in 2D materials, the identification of magnetic honeycombs, and a density-of-states peak quality metric for identification of electronic instabilities. The database containing the results of the filters and subsequent analysis is a useful tool for identifying novel materials for targeted physical phenomena for experimental characterization.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出了一种基于简单几何论证的筛选算法，用于从材料数据库中识别具有蜂窝结构基元的材料。作者将晶格分为常规蜂窝、超蜂窝、阶梯或之字形蜂窝以及完全三维蜂窝四类，并进一步识别出伸长、剪切和翘曲等畸变模式。研究还提出了用于评估二维材料可剥离性、识别磁性蜂窝以及筛选电子不稳定性的指标，为目标物理现象的材料发现和实验表征提供数据库工具。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蜂窝晶格是凝聚态物理中具有标志性的结构基元。然而，新兴理论模型要求识别出在结构、磁性和电子特性方面具有严格规定的新型蜂窝晶格材料。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种利用简单几何论证的筛选算法，用于检测具有蜂窝结构基元的材料。我们将晶格分为四种独特类别：常规蜂窝、超蜂窝、阶梯或之字形蜂窝，以及完全三维蜂窝。我们还在常规蜂窝类别中识别出若干畸变模式，包括伸长蜂窝、剪切蜂窝和翘曲蜂窝。我们描述了用于进一步分析蜂窝体系的若干筛选标准，具体包括对二维材料可剥离性的量化、磁性蜂窝的识别，以及用于识别电子不稳定性的态密度峰质量指标。包含筛选结果及后续分析的数据库，是寻找具有目标物理现象、供实验表征的新型材料的有用工具。

articles.title: Irreducible sub-nm² ferroelectric domains by 2D-flat polar band in perovskite superlattices
articles.title_zh: 钙钛矿超晶格中二维平坦极性带产生的不可约亚平方纳米铁电畴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flat polar phonon bands in ferroelectrics have been envisioned to realize irreducibly small domains for achieving the highest memory density. However, such bands are extremely rare, with only a one-dimensional flat polar band discovered in ferroelectric hafnia, which gives rise to irreducibly narrow, line-type domains with a half-unit-cell width of 2.7 Angstrom. Here, we report the discovery of a two-dimensional flat polar band in the ferroelectric (BaTiO₃)₁/(BaXO₃)₁ superlattice (X = Zr, Sn), which generates extremely localized, noninteracting dipoles within its quarter-unit-cell area that form quasi-degenerate states of irreducible sub-nm² ferroelectric domains. The estimated ferroelectric domain density, exceeding 300 Tbit/cm² (assuming one bit per domain) represents a record high among the known ferroelectrics, with independently switchable dipoles at low voltages. The ferroelectric phase hosting two-dimensional flat bands constitutes a competing ground state across superlattice stacking directions and thus can be experimentally realized in both freestanding structures and epitaxial growth on MgO substrates. This discovery opens unprecedented opportunities to explore multidimensional flat polar bands in ferroelectrics and to engineer ultra-dense and low-power memory devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究发现，铁电 (BaTiO3)1/(BaXO3)1 超晶格（X = Zr、Sn）中存在二维平坦极性声子带，可在四分之一晶胞面积内形成高度局域且相互独立的偶极子。由此产生的准简并态对应不可约的亚平方纳米铁电畴，估算的铁电畴密度超过 300 Tbit/cm2，并可在低电压下独立切换。该铁电相在不同超晶格堆垛方向上都是竞争性基态，有望通过自由悬浮结构或在 MgO 衬底上的外延生长实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们一直设想，铁电体中的平坦极性声子带能够实现不可约的小尺寸畴，从而达到最高的存储密度。然而，这类能带极其罕见；目前仅在铁电铪氧化物中发现了一维平坦极性带，并由此产生宽度为 2.7 埃、不可约的狭窄线型畴，即半个晶胞宽度。在这里，我们报道了在铁电 (BaTiO3)1/(BaXO3)1 超晶格（X = Zr、Sn）中发现二维平坦极性带。该平坦带在四分之一晶胞面积内产生高度局域且相互不作用的偶极子，并形成不可约亚平方纳米铁电畴的准简并态。估算的铁电畴密度超过 300 Tbit/cm2（假设每个畴对应一个比特），在已知铁电体中达到创纪录的高水平，同时这些偶极子能够在低电压下独立切换。承载二维平坦带的铁电相在超晶格的不同堆垛方向上构成竞争性基态，因此既可以在自由悬浮结构中实现，也可以通过在 MgO 衬底上外延生长实现。这一发现为探索铁电体中的多维平坦极性带以及设计超高密度、低功耗存储器件开辟了前所未有的机会。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文报道钙钛矿超晶格中二维平坦极性声子带，并由此产生不可约的亚纳米平方铁电畴。作者认为这些局域、近简并且可独立翻转的偶极可实现超过 300 Tbit/cm² 的超高密度铁电存储，并可在自由悬空或外延条件下实现。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在铁电畴、钙钛矿超晶格、极化翻转、声子软模和高密度铁电存储方向高度直接相关。其二维平坦极性带机制也可与 HfO2 中一维平坦极性带和窄畴壁研究形成对照。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点核查其声子谱、畴形成能、翻转势垒和外延应变稳定性结果。后续可使用第一性原理有效哈密顿量或机器学习势模拟有限温下亚纳米畴的稳定性、相互作用和读写动力学。

articles.title: Mechanical control of competing magnetic order in crystalline MnPtGa membranes
articles.title_zh: 晶体 MnPtGa 薄膜中的竞争磁序的机械调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: MnPtGa hosts competing magnetic states, including ferromagnetic, canted antiferromagnetic, and spin density wave (SDW) order in the centrosymmetric P6₃/mmc structure, while a related inversion-broken structure supports chiral skyrmions. Controlling this competition motivates materials platforms that enable tunable strain and symmetry breaking, together with probes of SDW order compatible with ultrathin samples. Here, we demonstrate single crystalline MnPtGa membranes grown by molecular beam epitaxy on graphene/Ge(111) and released by mechanical exfoliation. X-ray and electron diffraction confirm high crystalline quality. SQUID magnetometry reveals a 140 K anomaly in the zero-field-cooled dM/dT that persists after exfoliation, while time-resolved reflectivity shows a coincident peak in the electronic relaxation time consistent with a quasiparticle phonon bottleneck associated with a putative SDW gap. Intentional rippling suppresses the sim 140 K magnetic anomaly, demonstrating mechanical control of the low-temperature state. These results establish MnPtGa membranes as a platform for detecting and strain-tuning competing magnetic orders.
articles.abstract_zh: MnPtGa 在中心对称的 P63/mmc 结构中具有铁磁、倾斜反铁磁和自旋密度波等竞争磁态，而相关的破缺反演对称结构则支持手性斯格明子。研究制备了生长于石墨烯/Ge(111)上的单晶 MnPtGa 薄膜，并通过机械剥离释放薄膜；衍射结果证实其具有较高晶体质量。磁化率和时间分辨反射率测量表明约 140 K 的异常与可能的自旋密度波能隙有关，而人为引入褶皱能够抑制该异常，显示出机械调控低温磁态的能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: MnPtGa 在中心对称的 P63/mmc 结构中具有相互竞争的磁性态，包括铁磁序、倾斜反铁磁序和自旋密度波（SDW）序，而一种相关的破缺反演对称结构则支持手性斯格明子。对这种竞争进行调控，需要能够实现可调应变和对称性破缺的材料平台，同时还需要适用于超薄样品的 SDW 序探测手段。在这里，我们展示了通过分子束外延在石墨烯/Ge(111)上生长、并通过机械剥离释放的单晶 MnPtGa 薄膜。X 射线和电子衍射证实了其较高的晶体质量。SQUID 磁强计测量显示，在零场冷却条件下，dM/dT 中位于 140 K 的异常在剥离后仍然存在，而时间分辨反射率测量显示，电子弛豫时间在同一温度处出现峰值，这与可能由假定的 SDW 能隙引起的准粒子—声子瓶颈相一致。人为引入褶皱会抑制约 140 K 的磁性异常，证明机械作用能够控制低温态。这些结果确立了 MnPtGa 薄膜作为探测和通过应变调控竞争磁序的平台。

articles.title: Chirality in Condensed Matter: Symmetry, Waves, and Quasiparticles
articles.title_zh: 凝聚态物质中的手性：对称性、波与准粒子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality has become a recurring concept throughout condensed-matter physics, appearing in contexts ranging from optical activity and chiral phonons to magnetic excitations and hybrid quasiparticles. As its use has expanded, however, the concept has often become intertwined with related notions such as angular momentum, polarization, helicity, and nonreciprocity, obscuring its precise symmetry-based meaning. Although chirality is universally associated with broken spatial-inversion (P) symmetry and preserved time-reversal (T) symmetry, its physical manifestation and quantitative characterization strongly depend on the system and phenomenon under consideration. In this review, we examine chirality across photons, phonons, magnons, and hybrid excitations. We show that, while no universal measure of chirality exists, different physical systems admit different P-odd and T-even quantities that characterize specific chiral phenomena. We further argue that chirality is often best understood through chirality-selective interactions between waves, matter, and quasiparticles rather than as an intrinsic property of isolated excitations. From this perspective, hybridization provides a particularly promising setting for the emergence, transfer, and control of chirality in condensed-matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性广泛存在于凝聚态物理的光学活性、手性声子、磁激发和混合准粒子等现象中，但其含义常与角动量、偏振、螺旋度和非互易性相混淆。本文从光子、声子、磁振子及混合激发的角度综述手性，指出不存在普适的手性度量，不同体系需采用特定的宇称奇、时间反演偶物理量进行刻画。作者认为，手性往往应通过波、物质与准粒子之间的手性选择性相互作用来理解，而非视为孤立激发的内禀性质；混成则为手性的产生、传递与调控提供了重要平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性已经成为贯穿凝聚态物理的一个反复出现的概念，涉及从光学活性和手性声子到磁激发与混合准粒子等一系列领域。然而，随着其应用范围不断扩大，这一概念常常与角动量、偏振、螺旋度和非互易性等相关概念交织在一起，从而模糊了其基于对称性的确切含义。尽管手性普遍与空间反演对称性破缺，即宇称对称性P破缺，以及时间反演对称性T保持联系在一起，但其物理表现和定量表征在很大程度上取决于所考察的体系和现象。在这篇综述中，我们考察了光子、声子、磁振子和混合激发中的手性。我们表明，虽然不存在统一的手性度量，但不同物理体系可以采用不同的宇称奇且时间反演偶的物理量，来表征特定的手性现象。我们进一步认为，与其把手性视为孤立激发的内禀性质，不如通过波、物质和准粒子之间的手性选择性相互作用来理解它。从这一角度看，混成是凝聚态体系中手性产生、传递和调控的一个尤其有前景的场景。

articles.title: Enhanced anomalous Nernst effect in Pr-doped kagome and honeycomb magnet LaCo₅
articles.title_zh: Pr掺杂Kagome与蜂窝磁体LaCo₅中的增强反常能斯特效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we report the successful synthesis of La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅ (x = 0.09, 0.21, 0.45) single crystals. Magnetic field-dependent magnetization measurements reveal that Pr substitution induces negligible changes in the magnetic properties of LaCo₅, with the ferromagnetic ordering predominantly governed by the Co sublattices. Remarkably, the doped systems exhibit significant enhancements in the anomalous Nernst effect. At 300~K, the anomalous Nernst thermopower S^Ayₓ reaches 6.5~μ V/K in La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅, corresponding to a sim 40 % enhancement compared to the parent compound. This significant improvement can be predominantly attributed to Pr-doping-induced Fermi level modification, which directly leads to a redistribution of Berry curvature across the Fermi surface. This work highlights the effectiveness of Pr doping in boosting the anomalous Nernst effect of La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅, offering a practical strategy to design advanced materials for room-temperature energy-harvesting technologies and high-efficiency thermal sensing devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文成功制备了La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅（x = 0.09、0.21、0.45）单晶。磁场依赖的磁化测量表明，Pr替代对LaCo₅磁性的影响很小，铁磁有序主要由Co子晶格决定。掺杂体系的反常能斯特效应显著增强，在300 K时La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅的反常能斯特热电势达到6.5 μV/K，较母体材料提高约40%。这种增强主要归因于Pr掺杂引起的费米能级调节及费米面上贝里曲率的重新分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本工作中，我们成功制备了La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅（x = 0.09、0.21、0.45）单晶。磁场依赖的磁化测量显示，Pr替代对LaCo₅磁性性质的影响可以忽略，铁磁有序主要由Co子晶格控制。值得注意的是，掺杂体系表现出显著增强的反常能斯特效应。在300 K时，La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅中的反常能斯特热电势S^A_yx达到6.5 μV/K，相比母体化合物提高了约40%。这种显著改善主要可归因于Pr掺杂诱导的费米能级调节，该调节直接导致费米面上贝里曲率的重新分布。本工作凸显了Pr掺杂在增强La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅反常能斯特效应方面的有效性，并为设计用于室温能量收集技术和高效热传感器件的先进材料提供了实用策略。

articles.title: Tensor-network Monte Carlo approach based on time-evolving block decimation
articles.title_zh: 基于时间演化块解耦的张量网络蒙特卡洛方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a tensor-network Monte Carlo (TNMC) approach for unitary evolution following the compression sequence of the time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) algorithm. In the TNMC approach, the obtained results contain evaluable statistical errors rather than truncation errors, unlike ordinary singular-value-decomposition-based methods such as the TEBD algorithm. Consequently, one can estimate unbiased expectation values within statistical errors even with a finite bond dimension. Since the sampling scheme is introduced in the simulations of unitary evolution, the proposed Monte Carlo scheme may suffer from a sign problem. We observe that the sign problem can be mitigated by increasing the bond dimension. We apply the proposed TNMC approach to the Hamiltonian and the Floquet dynamics. Numerical experiments show that the TNMC approach can estimate accurate expectation values of observables even when the TEBD method with the same bond dimension cannot. The proposed approach can be a new direction for improving the classical simulatability of unitary evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种张量网络蒙特卡洛方法，用于按照时间演化块解耦算法的压缩序列进行幺正演化。与基于奇异值分解的常规方法不同，该方法产生的是可评估的统计误差而非截断误差，因此即使键维数有限，也能在统计误差范围内估计无偏期望值。数值结果表明，在相同键维数下，该方法能够在时间演化块解耦方法失效时仍准确估计观测量，并可应用于哈密顿量动力学和Floquet动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种张量网络蒙特卡洛方法，用于按照时间演化块解耦算法的压缩序列进行幺正演化。在张量网络蒙特卡洛方法中，所得结果包含可评估的统计误差，而不是像时间演化块解耦算法等基于奇异值分解的常规方法那样包含截断误差。因此，即使在有限键维数下，也可以在统计误差范围内估计无偏的期望值。由于采样方案被引入幺正演化的模拟中，所提出的蒙特卡洛方案可能遭遇符号问题。我们观察到，增大键维数可以减弱符号问题。我们将所提出的张量网络蒙特卡洛方法应用于哈密顿量动力学和Floquet动力学。数值实验表明，即使相同键维数下的时间演化块解耦方法无法做到这一点，张量网络蒙特卡洛方法仍能准确估计观测量的期望值。所提出的方法可以成为提高幺正演化经典可模拟性的新方向。

articles.title: Spin-polarized Superconductivity and High-Chern Insulators in Twisted Rhombohedral Graphene Family
articles.title_zh: 扭转菱方石墨烯家族中的自旋极化超导与高陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene has emerged as a remarkably versatile platform for exploring strong correlation driven quantum states arising from low-energy topological flat bands. When reconstructed by the moire superlattice, these bands host a wide range of emergent novel states, including integer and fractional Chern insulators and unconventional superconductivity. Here, we firstly report the simultaneous emergence of widespread spin polarized SC and high Chern insulators in twisted bilayer multilayer RMG system 2+n where n=4,5,6. The SC states in 2+n system exhibit different responses to the in plane magnetic field, with SC being suppressed, enhanced and induced by in plane magnetic field . The latter two are consistent with spin-triplet pairing. Along with SC, angle and layer dependent HCIs with tunable Chern numbers emerge. Moreover, the fractional high Chern insulator in the system survives under high in plane magnetic field which can induce SC in the same device. Our work not only establishs twisted bilayer multilayer rhombohedral graphene as a unified platform for studying SC and high Chern insulators, but also opens a pathway towards multiple copropagating chiral Majorana channels by coupling spin-polarized SC to high Chern insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱方多层石墨烯为研究低能拓扑平带中强关联驱动的量子态提供了多功能平台。本文首次报道了扭转双层-多层菱方石墨烯2+n体系（n = 4、5、6）中广泛出现的自旋极化超导和高陈绝缘体。超导态对面内磁场表现出抑制、增强和诱导等不同响应，其中后两种现象与自旋三重态配对相一致；同时还出现了角度和层依赖、陈数可调的高陈绝缘体。该体系中的分数高陈绝缘体可在较强面内磁场下保持稳定，为通过自旋极化超导与高陈绝缘体耦合实现多条共传播手性马约拉纳通道提供了可能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 菱方多层石墨烯已经成为探索低能拓扑平带中强关联驱动量子态的极其多功能的平台。当这些能带被莫尔超晶格重构后，它们可以承载一系列新兴的新颖态，包括整数和分数陈绝缘体以及非常规超导态。在这里，我们首次报道了扭转双层-多层菱方石墨烯2+n体系（其中n = 4、5、6）中广泛出现的自旋极化超导和高陈绝缘体。2+n体系中的超导态对面内磁场表现出不同响应，包括被面内磁场抑制、增强以及由面内磁场诱导产生，其中后两种现象与自旋三重态配对相一致。与超导态同时出现的还有依赖于扭转角和层数、且陈数可调的高陈绝缘体。此外，该体系中的分数高陈绝缘体能够在较强面内磁场下保持稳定，而该磁场又可以在同一器件中诱导超导态。我们的工作不仅确立了扭转双层-多层菱方石墨烯作为研究超导与高陈绝缘体的统一平台，也为通过将自旋极化超导与高陈绝缘体耦合来实现多条共传播手性马约拉纳通道开辟了路径。

articles.title: Critical current anisotropy pf practical superconductors: analysis methods and application cases
articles.title_zh: 实用超导体的临界电流各向异性：分析方法与应用案例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The analysis of critical current anisotropy is important for improving superconductor-based devices. This article critically evaluates contemporary techniques for analyzing the angular dependence of critical current in practical superconductors, focusing on second-generation high-temperature superconducting tapes (coated conductors). These techniques are based on the scaling model, vortex path model, or anisotropic pinning model. We present empirical findings on critical current angular dependencies in coated conductors of different chemical compositions. Distinctive features are highlighted: the complex effect of rare-earth substitution in the HTS composition on the pinning landscape, peak asymmetry, and the dependence of critical current on Lorentz force direction at fixed magnetic field direction. The described techniques are then applied to the experimental dataset. A refined anisotropic pinning model is introduced to accurately describe certain observed phenomena. Approximation accuracy of the models is assessed using the coefficient of determination adjusted for the number of fitting variables. The fundamental disparity in interpreting angular dependencies with different models is emphasized. No universal methodology yet comprehensively explains all features or links them to the defective structure of the HTS material. This is a critical gap in understanding superconductor behavior under varying conditions and highlights the need for further research.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统评估了实用超导体，尤其是第二代高温超导带材临界电流角度依赖性的现代分析方法，包括标度模型、涡旋路径模型和各向异性钉扎模型。作者分析了不同化学成分涂层导体中的实验结果，讨论了稀土替代对钉扎景观、峰值不对称性以及洛伦兹力方向依赖性的复杂影响。研究还提出了改进的各向异性钉扎模型，并使用校正决定系数比较不同模型的拟合精度，指出目前尚无一种统一方法能够解释全部角度依赖特征及其与高温超导体缺陷结构的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分析临界电流各向异性对于改进基于超导体的器件具有重要意义。本文批判性地评估了分析实用超导体中临界电流角度依赖性的当代技术，重点关注第二代高温超导带材，即涂层导体。这些技术建立在标度模型、涡旋路径模型或各向异性钉扎模型的基础上。我们给出了不同化学成分涂层导体中临界电流角度依赖性的经验结果。研究突出了若干特征，包括高温超导成分中的稀土替代对钉扎景观的复杂影响、峰值不对称性，以及在磁场方向固定时临界电流对洛伦兹力方向的依赖性。随后，我们将所述技术应用于实验数据集。我们引入了一种改进的各向异性钉扎模型，以准确描述某些观测到的现象。我们使用根据拟合变量数量进行调整的决定系数来评估各模型的近似精度。本文强调，不同模型对角度依赖性的解释存在根本差异。目前还没有一种通用方法能够全面解释所有特征，或将这些特征与高温超导材料的缺陷结构联系起来。这是理解超导体在变化条件下行为时的一个关键缺口，也凸显了进一步研究的必要性。

articles.title: Universal transverse diode effects in superconducting unconventional magnet hybrids
articles.title_zh: 非常规超导磁体杂化体系中的普适横向二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.12523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that superconducting unconventional magnet junctions harbor transverse spin and charge diode effects with perfect rectification efficiencies.
