Furthermore, using a CrPS4/In2Se3 heterostructure, we demonstrate that the anomaly associated with the coupled degrees of freedom in CrPS4 also influences the adjacent In2Se3 layer. The lattice dynamics of In2Se3 is significantly modified across the magnetic anomaly of CrPS4, and the coupled dynamics is observed at T*. These interfacial manifestation opens up new possibilities for achieving correlated multifunctionalities in artificially designed heterostructure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在低维范德华反铁磁体CrPS4中发现了一种由短程自旋关联驱动、并在奈尔温度以上远距离持续存在的强耦合自旋-声子-电子状态。拉曼、光致发光、电输运和光电响应结果表明，在约120 K的特征温度T*附近发生局域晶格畸变及电子-声子耦合增强。CrPS4/In2Se3异质结构还显示，CrPS4中的耦合异常能够显著调制邻近In2Se3层的晶格动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在低维范德华反铁磁体CrPS4中，我们鉴定出一种由短程自旋关联驱动的强相互耦合自旋-声子-电子状态，该状态存在于远高于TN（约38 K）的温度范围。温度依赖拉曼光谱揭示，自旋-声子耦合可持续至T*约120 K，同时伴随局域晶格畸变。光致发光光谱中振电子级数的出现表明，T*附近电子-声子耦合得到增强。此外，电输运和光电响应在T*处也发生显著变化。结果表明，CrPS4中TN以上的自旋-声子耦合源于短程磁关联诱导的局域晶格畸变，而该畸变进一步增强了电子-声子相互作用。进一步地，利用CrPS4/In2Se3异质结构，我们证明CrPS4中与这些耦合自由度相关的异常同样会影响相邻的In2Se3层。In2Se3的晶格动力学在跨越CrPS4的磁异常时发生显著改变，并且在T*处观察到耦合动力学。这种界面表现为在人工设计的异质结构中实现关联多功能性开辟了新的可能性。

articles.title: Enhancing charge stability of Ge quantum well heterostructures via SiGe layer composition engineering
articles.title_zh: 通过SiGe层组分工程提升锗量子阱异质结构的电荷稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Composition modulation is a powerful technique for designing materials with tailored properties, fueling the development of advanced semiconductor devices. In this work, we have implemented this technique into Ge quantum well heterostructures, offering a promising avenue to address the critical challenge of charge stability in spin qubit devices. Harnessing the atomic-scale precision of molecular beam epitaxy, we have engineered the band structure of the SiGe top barrier via graded composition modulation, thereby reducing charge accumulation states at the SiGe-dielectric interface and strengthening the effective confinement to the hole gases in the Ge quantum wells. The enhanced charge stability of composition-modulated SiGe/Ge quantum well heterostructures is confirmed in Hall devices, featuring an enlarged stable gate voltage range. We have further fabricated quantum dot devices from the composition-modulated SiGe/Ge quantum well heterostructures and observed remarkably low charge noise with an averaged amplitude of 0.46,μ eV/mathrmsqrtHz at 1,Hz---the lowest reported value for Ge quantum wells grown on silicon. This exceptional charge stability of the quantum dots persists in the few-hole regime, with no observable voltage drift over simhours. With reduced charge noise and enhanced energy stability, composition-modulated SiGe/Ge heterostructures exhibit significant potential for applications in building high-performance quantum devices, including spin qubits with a long coherence time.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过对SiGe顶部势垒进行梯度组分调制，设计并制备了具有更高电荷稳定性的SiGe/Ge量子阱异质结构。该策略减少了SiGe-介电层界面的电荷积累态，并增强了对Ge量子阱空穴气的有效限制；霍尔器件显示出更宽的稳定栅压范围。基于该异质结构的量子点在1 Hz处具有平均0.46 μeV/√Hz的低电荷噪声，并在少空穴区保持数小时无可观测电压漂移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 组分调制是一种强大的材料设计技术，可用于获得具有定制性质的材料，并推动先进半导体器件的发展。在本工作中，我们将这一技术应用于Ge量子阱异质结构，为解决自旋量子比特器件中至关重要的电荷稳定性挑战提供了一条很有前景的途径。借助分子束外延的原子尺度精确性，我们通过梯度组分调制对SiGe顶部势垒的能带结构进行了工程设计，从而减少SiGe-介电层界面的电荷积累态，并增强对Ge量子阱中空穴气的有效限制。霍尔器件证实，组分调制SiGe/Ge量子阱异质结构具有增强的电荷稳定性，表现为稳定栅压范围扩大。我们进一步利用组分调制SiGe/Ge量子阱异质结构制备了量子点器件，并观测到显著低的电荷噪声：在1 Hz处，其平均幅值为0.46 μeV/√Hz，这是在硅上生长的Ge量子阱所报道的最低数值。这种量子点出色的电荷稳定性在少空穴区仍然保持，在数小时内未观察到电压漂移。凭借降低的电荷噪声和增强的能量稳定性，组分调制SiGe/Ge异质结构在构建高性能量子器件方面展现出显著潜力，包括具有长相干时间的自旋量子比特。

articles.title: Interface-Controlled Phase Stability in Polymorphic HfO₂ Revealed by Machine-Learning Atomistic Simulations
articles.title_zh: 机器学习原子模拟揭示多晶型 HfO₂ 中由界面控制的相稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: HfO₂ exhibits rich polymorphism, and competition among different phases underpins many of its functional properties. Yet bulk free-energy relations alone cannot explain phase selection at mixed-phase boundaries, where interface orientation and structural continuity constrain collective rearrangements. Here, using machine-learning atomistic simulations and a Hf-centered local phase classification scheme, we show that crystallographic interface matching redirects phase competition and accessible transformation pathways. The M(100)/T(100) interface remains pinned as an M/T mixture throughout 3 ns simulations from 300 to 1800 K. M/PO, M/AO, and PO/AO interfaces retain two-phase coexistence up to 900 K, whereas all T/PO interfaces become PO-dominant. At 1800 K, all non-M interfaces become T-dominant, while M-containing interfaces retain a monoclinic majority. Nudged elastic band calculations reveal lower-barrier routes through interface states. For M(100)→T(100), the interface-mediated route in a long cell (sim12 nm) yields a barrier of 136.03 meV/f.u., 29.2 % lower than the direct route in a short cell (sim3 nm). This difference is associated with sequential phase-front motion absent from the short cell. These results identify phase boundaries as active participants in phase stability and transformation and establish interface orientation and crystallographic matching as variables for stabilizing metastable polymorphs and directing phase conversion in HfO₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用机器学习原子模拟和以 Hf 为中心的局域相分类方法，揭示了晶体学界面匹配会重定向 HfO₂ 中的相竞争及可达的相变路径。不同界面在不同温度下表现出显著不同的两相共存和相主导行为，且界面介导的转变路径可显著降低能垒。研究表明，相界面是相稳定性与相变的主动参与者，界面取向和晶体学匹配可用于稳定亚稳多型并引导相转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: HfO₂ 具有丰富的多型结构，不同相之间的竞争是其许多功能性质的基础。然而，在混合相边界处，仅凭体相自由能关系无法解释相的选择，因为界面取向和结构连续性会限制集体重排。在本研究中，我们采用机器学习原子模拟以及一种以 Hf 为中心的局域相分类方法，表明晶体学界面匹配会重定向相竞争和可实现的转变路径。在 300 至 1800 K 的 3 ns 模拟过程中，M(100)/T(100) 界面始终保持为 M/T 混合态。M/PO、M/AO 和 PO/AO 界面在 900 K 及以下温度仍保持两相共存，而所有 T/PO 界面均转变为以 PO 为主。在 1800 K 时，所有不含 M 相的界面均转变为以 T 相为主，而含 M 相的界面仍保持单斜相占多数。通过最小能量路径计算，我们发现经由界面态的路径具有更低的能垒。对于 M(100)→T(100) 转变，长晶胞中的界面介导路径（约 12 nm）能垒为 136.03 meV/f.u.，比短晶胞（约 3 nm）中的直接路径低 29.2%。这一差异与短晶胞中不存在的连续相变前沿运动有关。这些结果表明，相边界是相稳定性和相变的主动参与者，并确立了界面取向与晶体学匹配作为稳定 HfO₂ 亚稳多型和引导相转变的变量。

articles.title: Universal sampling of spin systems across quenched disorder
articles.title_zh: 跨越淬火无序自旋系统的通用采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Statistical physics extracts macroscopic laws by averaging over the many microscopic degrees of freedom of a system. Disordered systems demand a second and far harder average, one over the quenched randomness itself. The classic analytical routes, the replica and cavity methods, become uncontrolled outside mean-field or tree-like limits, and conventional numerical algorithms like parallel tempering require expensive, independent equilibration for every disorder realization. In this work, we introduce a universal neural variational framework that amortizes inference across the disorder ensemble, eliminating both the need for per-instance Markov chain equilibration and the cost of retraining instance-specific variational ansatzes. Built on an encoder-decoder Transformer architecture, after training once, it produces an explicit approximation to the Boltzmann distribution given previously unseen disorder realizations without further optimization. We validate this framework on 2D Edwards-Anderson models, and apply it to the random-bond Ising model, successfully capturing the Binder cumulant crossings near the Nishimori multicritical point. These results shift the object of variational inference from the single instance to the disorder ensemble, opening a route to frustrated many-body systems where instance-by-instance computation is prohibitive.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于编码器—解码器 Transformer 的通用神经变分框架，可在无序系综上摊销推断成本。模型训练一次后，即可针对此前未见过的无序实现直接生成玻尔兹曼分布的显式近似，无需逐实例进行马尔可夫链平衡或重新优化。该方法在二维 Edwards–Anderson 模型和随机键 Ising 模型上得到验证，并成功捕捉 Nishimori 多临界点附近的 Binder 累积量交叉。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 统计物理通过对系统中大量微观自由度进行平均来提取宏观规律。无序系统还要求进行第二种、也更加困难的平均，即对淬火随机性本身进行平均。经典的解析方法，包括复制方法和腔方法，在超出平均场或类树极限时便不再受控；而并行回火等传统数值算法则需要针对每个无序实现进行昂贵且相互独立的平衡化。在本研究中，我们提出一种通用神经变分框架，可在无序系综上摊销推断成本，从而同时消除逐实例进行马尔可夫链平衡的需求，以及为每个实例重新训练特定变分拟设的成本。该框架建立在编码器—解码器 Transformer 架构之上；训练一次后，对于此前未见过的无序实现，它无需进一步优化即可生成玻尔兹曼分布的显式近似。我们在二维 Edwards–Anderson 模型上验证了该框架，并将其应用于随机键 Ising 模型，成功捕捉到 Nishimori 多临界点附近的 Binder 累积量交叉。这些结果将变分推断的对象从单个实例转向无序系综，为逐实例计算成本难以承受的受挫多体系统开辟了一条路径。

articles.title: Information-Theoretic Characterization of Macroscopic Chaos Emerging from the Chemical Master Equation
articles.title_zh: 化学主方程中宏观混沌涌现的信息论刻画
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open chemical reaction networks exhibit stochastic concentration dynamics at finite system sizes, whereas their macroscopic limit is governed by deterministic rate equations that can display chaos. In this Letter, we show theoretically that a rate of information loss constructed from two-time mutual information recovers the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy in the deterministic limit. We verify this result through numerical simulations of a Markov jump process for a three-species system involving seven reactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 开放化学反应网络在有限系统尺寸下表现出随机的浓度动力学，而其宏观极限由可能呈现混沌的确定性速率方程描述。本文从理论上证明，由两时刻互信息构造的信息损失率在确定性极限下可以恢复 Kolmogorov–Sinai 熵。作者通过一个包含七个反应的三组分马尔可夫跳跃过程数值验证了这一结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开放化学反应网络在有限系统尺寸下表现为随机的浓度动力学，而其宏观极限则由能够呈现混沌的确定性速率方程控制。在这篇快报中，我们从理论上表明，由两时刻互信息构造的信息损失率，在确定性极限下可以恢复 Kolmogorov–Sinai 熵。我们通过对一个包含七个反应的三组分系统进行马尔可夫跳跃过程数值模拟，验证了这一结果。

articles.title: Correlation enhanced altermagnetism mediated by spin-lattice coupling in CrSb
articles.title_zh: CrSb 中由自旋—晶格耦合介导的关联增强型交替磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11346v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, making them promising platforms for spintronic applications. While the symmetry and multipolar origins of nonrelativistic altermagnetic spin splitting (NRASS) are well established, the role of electronic correlations and spin-lattice coupling (SLC) in controlling NRASS remain unexplored. In particular, SLC provides a direct pathway for tuning altermagnetism through lattice degrees of freedom. Here we first investigate the role of electronic correlations on altermagnetic strength in NiAs-type material CrSb using density functional theory (DFT), DFT+U, and dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). We find that increasing electronic correlations substantially enhance NRASS and drive the stabilization of an incommensurate spin-spiral (SS) state, while dynamical correlations further amplify the spin splitting through quasiparticle renormalization of the Cr-3d states. We find that the NRASS remains 12.5% larger in DFT+DMFT than in DFT. By evaluating SLC in next step, we establish its direct connection to the evolution of NRASS and identify SLC as a microscopic descriptor between electronic correlation and enhanced altermagnetism in CrSb. Investigating it in another NiAs-type compound MnTe, we show that the SLC-NRASS correlation is generic across AMs and establish SLC as a microscopic descriptor of altermagnetic strength. Our results provide a unified framework for tuning altermagnetism through the interplay between the electronic correlations and lattice degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合 DFT、DFT+U 和动力学平均场理论研究电子关联对 NiAs 型 CrSb 交替磁性强度的影响，并发现增强的电子关联会显著提高非相对论交替磁自旋劈裂。动力学关联通过 Cr-3d 态的准粒子重整化进一步放大自旋劈裂，并推动非公度自旋螺旋态稳定。进一步研究表明，自旋—晶格耦合与自旋劈裂演化直接相关，是连接电子关联和增强交替磁性的微观描述量，该关系在 MnTe 中也具有普适性。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作以CrSb为对象，结合DFT、DFT+U和DMFT研究电子关联对交替磁性自旋劈裂的增强作用，并预测关联可稳定非公度自旋螺旋态。研究进一步建立自旋-晶格耦合与非相对论交替磁性自旋劈裂演化之间的直接联系。
articles.focus_relation: 该论文高度契合团队的交替磁性、自旋-晶格耦合、磁性哈密顿量、非共线磁性及第一性原理电子结构研究。其关联效应与晶格自由度协同调控自旋劈裂的框架，也适合结合团队的机器学习哈密顿量和自旋动力学方法推广。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点跟进其自旋-晶格耦合参数提取和DMFT处理方式，并检验类似机制在其他NiAs型或二维交替磁体中的普适性。可构建含晶格畸变的自旋模型，研究温度、应变和声子激发下的自旋劈裂及磁输运响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体具有依赖动量的自旋劈裂，同时不存在净磁化，因此成为自旋电子学应用的有前景平台。尽管非相对论交替磁自旋劈裂（NRASS）的对称性和多极起源已经得到充分确立，但电子关联和自旋—晶格耦合（SLC）在调控 NRASS 中的作用仍未被探索。特别是，SLC 为通过晶格自由度调节交替磁性提供了直接途径。在本研究中，我们首先利用密度泛函理论（DFT）、DFT+U 和动力学平均场理论（DMFT）研究电子关联对 NiAs 型材料 CrSb 中交替磁性强度的作用。我们发现，增强电子关联会显著提高 NRASS，并推动非公度自旋螺旋（SS）态稳定；而动力学关联则通过 Cr-3d 态的准粒子重整化进一步放大自旋劈裂。我们发现，DFT+DMFT 中的 NRASS 比 DFT 中大 12.5%。随后，通过评估 SLC，我们确立了其与 NRASS 演化之间的直接联系，并将 SLC 确定为 CrSb 中电子关联与增强交替磁性之间的微观描述量。通过在另一种 NiAs 型化合物 MnTe 中进行研究，我们表明 SLC-NRASS 相关性在不同交替磁体中具有普适性，并确立 SLC 为交替磁性强度的微观描述量。我们的结果为通过电子关联与晶格自由度之间的相互作用调控交替磁性提供了统一框架。

articles.title: Microwave-controlled interactions and stripe formation of static-field-shielded polar molecules
articles.title_zh: 微波控制静电场屏蔽极性分子的相互作用与条纹形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study polar molecules where short-range losses are suppressed by a shielding scheme involving a static electric field and an elliptically polarized microwave field. Using perturbation theory, we derive the effective interaction potential and validate it against coupled channel calculations. We identify a parameter regime where two-body losses are strongly suppressed and the extended mean-field description of dilute molecular Bose-Einstein condensates is justified. We calculate the collective excitations and show that intriguingly, supersolidity in quasi-two-dimensional confinement emerges as a stripe phase even at small values of microwave ellipticity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一种利用静态电场和椭圆偏振微波场抑制短程损失的极性分子体系，并通过微扰理论推导有效相互作用势。该势与耦合道计算结果相符，且存在一个能够强烈抑制二体损失、适用于稀薄分子玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体扩展平均场描述的参数区域。在准二维限域中，集体激发分析显示，即使微波椭圆率较小，体系也会以条纹相的形式出现超固性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究极性分子体系，其中短程损失通过一种由静态电场和椭圆偏振微波场共同构成的屏蔽方案得到抑制。我们利用微扰理论推导有效相互作用势，并通过耦合道计算对其进行验证。我们确定了一个参数区域，在该区域中二体损失受到强烈抑制，并且可以对稀薄分子玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体采用扩展平均场描述。我们计算了集体激发，并表明在准二维限域下，即使微波椭圆率取较小值，超固性也会以条纹相的形式涌现。

articles.title: Anisotropy of Ultrafast Strain in V₂O₃ Thin Films: Out-of-Equilibrium Phase Transitions under Interfacial Clamping
articles.title_zh: V₂O₃ 薄膜超快应变的各向异性：界面钳制下的非平衡相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast photoinduced insulator-to-metal transitions in correlated materials are often mediated by lattice distortions, yet the role of interfacial lattice constraints in shaping nonequilibrium pathways remains largely unexplored. We use azimuth-resolved time-resolved X-ray diffraction to track orientation-dependent strain dynamics in granular V₂O₃ thin films on c-cut sapphire, where thermal-expansion mismatch imposes anisotropic interfacial strain. Across the thermal transition, the azimuthal profile of the (110)_H strain inverts curvature, providing direct evidence of partial clamping of the hexagonal basal-plane lattice (a_H,b_H). After photoexcitation of the antiferromagnetic insulating phase, the structural response remains clamp-limited: weakly constrained grain families reach the full basal-plane contraction characteristic of the metallic-like state, whereas strongly constrained families exhibit a strongly reduced distortion. Fluence-dependent measurements further disentangle transformed fraction from clamping-limited lattice distortion. Our results show that interfacial clamping acts as a static selector for ultrafast phase switching and provide a general route to quantify anisotropic strain dynamics in heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用方位角分辨的时间分辨 X 射线衍射，研究 c 切蓝宝石衬底上颗粒状 V₂O₃ 薄膜中取向依赖的应变动力学。热相变过程中，(110)H 应变的方位角曲线发生曲率反转，直接证明六方基面晶格受到部分钳制。光激发后，晶粒族的结构响应受钳制程度控制：约束较弱者达到金属态特征的完整基面收缩，而约束较强者的畸变显著减小，表明界面钳制能够选择性调控超快相变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 关联材料中超快光诱导绝缘体—金属相变通常由晶格畸变介导，但界面晶格约束在塑造非平衡路径中的作用仍未得到充分探索。我们利用方位角分辨的时间分辨 X 射线衍射，跟踪 c 切蓝宝石衬底上颗粒状 V₂O₃ 薄膜中取向依赖的应变动力学，其中热膨胀失配施加了各向异性的界面应变。在热相变过程中，(110)H 应变的方位角曲线发生曲率反转，为六方基面晶格（aH、bH）受到部分钳制提供了直接证据。在反铁磁绝缘相受到光激发后，结构响应仍受到钳制限制：约束较弱的晶粒族达到金属样态所具有的完整基面收缩，而约束较强的晶粒族则表现出显著减弱的畸变。依赖于激发通量的测量进一步区分了发生转变的比例与受钳制限制的晶格畸变。我们的结果表明，界面钳制是超快相切换的静态选择器，并为量化异质结构中的各向异性应变动力学提供了一条通用途径。

articles.title: Vacancy Order and Physical Properties of a Ternary Compound Fe0.68Pd0.80Te with an α-Fe1+xTe-Type Structure
articles.title_zh: 具有 α-Fe₁₊ₓTe 型结构的三元化合物 Fe₀.₆₈Pd₀.₈₀Te 的空位有序与物理性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the identification and characterization of a new compound Fe0.68Pd0.80Te with an α-Fe1+xTe prototype structure. Different from the Fe-square net and minor occupancy of interstitial Fe-sites in Fe1+xTe, Fe0.68Pd0.80Te is featured by a Pdsquare net and near 68% occupancy of the corresponding interstitial Fe-sites. Furthermore, noncontact atomic force microscopy and X-ray diffraction provide evidence for the existence of a 3*3*3 Pd-vacancy order in this layered material. A spin-glass ground state below Tg 40 K is identified via magnetic characterization. Electrical transport measurements show that Fe0.68Pd0.80Te is a semiconductor with a very small band gap below 10 meV. It has weak negative magnetoresistance and holelike charge carriers below room temperature. Our results demonstrate its potentials for further exploring various quantum phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道并表征了一种具有 α-Fe₁₊ₓTe 原型结构的新化合物 Fe₀.₆₈Pd₀.₈₀Te。该材料不同于 Fe₁₊ₓTe 中的 Fe 方格网络和少量占据的间隙 Fe 位点，具有 Pd 方格网络以及相应间隙 Fe 位点约 68% 的占据率。非接触式原子力显微镜和 X 射线衍射表明该层状材料存在 3×3×3 的 Pd 空位有序；磁性测量显示其在约 40 K 以下形成自旋玻璃基态，输运测量则表明其为小带隙半导体，并具有弱负磁阻和空穴型载流子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报道了新化合物 Fe₀.₆₈Pd₀.₈₀Te 的发现与表征，该化合物具有 α-Fe₁₊ₓTe 原型结构。不同于 Fe₁₊ₓTe 中的 Fe 方格网络以及间隙 Fe 位点的少量占据，Fe₀.₆₈Pd₀.₈₀Te 的特征是具有 Pd 方格网络，并且相应间隙 Fe 位点的占据率接近 68%。非接触式原子力显微镜和 X 射线衍射为这种层状材料中存在 3×3×3 的 Pd 空位有序提供了证据。通过磁性表征，我们确定了其在 Tg 约为 40 K 以下的自旋玻璃基态。电输运测量表明，Fe₀.₆₈Pd₀.₈₀Te 是一种带隙小于 10 meV 的半导体。它在室温以下具有弱负磁阻和空穴型载流子。我们的结果表明，该材料有望用于进一步探索各种量子现象。

articles.title: A Community-Developed Domain Ontology for Magnetic Materials
articles.title_zh: 面向磁性材料的社区开发领域本体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic materials play a crucial role in energy-related technologies, mobility, and sensing, but their complex multiscale behaviour and the coexistence of multiple unit systems pose persistent challenges for data exchange and interpretation. This paper presents a domain ontology for magnetic materials, developed within the European Union funded Magnetic Multiscale Modelling Suite (MaMMoS) project and aligned with the Elementary Multiperspective Material Ontology (EMMO). The ontology formalises intrinsic, hysteretic, and microstructural properties across multiple length scales and supports semantic interoperability between simulation tools, databases, and experimental workflows. One key feature of the ontology is its code-based and human-readable structure, enabled through the EMMOntoPy framework, which allows for direct manipulation and versioning without relying on opaque .owl or .ttl files. This facilitates collaborative development and improves transparency. The ontology supports FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) principles and is openly available for extension by the community. The aim of the MaMMoS project is to foster reproducibility, improve traceability, and promote the adoption of ontology in the magnetism domain. The ontology that has been developed already serves as the foundation for multiple software tools that handle all kinds of magnetic material data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个在欧盟资助的 MaMMoS 项目中开发、并与基础多视角材料本体 EMMO 对齐的磁性材料领域本体。该本体形式化描述跨多个长度尺度的本征性质、磁滞性质和微结构性质，支持模拟工具、数据库及实验工作流之间的语义互操作。借助 EMMOntoPy 框架，其代码化且可读的结构支持直接操作和版本管理，无需依赖不透明的 OWL 或 TTL 文件，并有助于实现 FAIR 原则和社区协作扩展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性材料在能源相关技术、交通运输和传感领域发挥着关键作用，但其复杂的多尺度行为以及多种单位制并存，持续给数据交换和解释带来挑战。本文提出一个面向磁性材料的领域本体，该本体在欧盟资助的磁性多尺度建模套件（MaMMoS）项目中开发，并与基础多视角材料本体（EMMO）保持一致。该本体对跨多个长度尺度的本征性质、磁滞性质和微结构性质进行形式化描述，并支持模拟工具、数据库和实验工作流之间的语义互操作。该本体的一个关键特征是其代码化且人类可读的结构，这一结构由 EMMOntoPy 框架实现，使用户无需依赖不透明的 .owl 或 .ttl 文件即可直接进行操作和版本管理。这种方式有利于协作开发并提高透明度。该本体支持 FAIR 原则，即可发现、可访问、可互操作和可复用原则，并向社区公开开放以便扩展。MaMMoS 项目的目标是促进磁学领域的可重复性、提高可追溯性，并推动本体的采用。已经开发完成的本体目前已成为多个软件工具的基础，这些工具能够处理各种磁性材料数据。

articles.title: Topological band structure of excitons in octochlore KTb₃F₁₀: an analog of the Luttinger Semimetal
articles.title_zh: 八氯石 KTb₃F₁₀ 中激子的拓扑能带结构：Luttinger 半金属的类比体系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the symmetry and topology of band structures in crystalline solids has been among the defining themes of a generation of condensed matter physicists, with implications across many different platforms including electronic bands, photonic crystals, phonons and magnetic excitations. In the latter systems, there is usually magnetic long-range order and time reversal symmetry breaking. Here we further enrich the possible band structures available to magnetic systems by examining dispersive crystal field excitations above a ground state that is a simple product of singlets. In these systems, there is an interplay of magnetic interactions and band topology with both crystal and time reversal symmetries. Using high-resolution neutron spectroscopy we reveal the dispersion relations of bosonic excitons in KTb₃F₁₀, an experimental realization of the octochlore lattice. We show that there are pinch point features in the scattering intensity. The dominant coupling in this system is the long-range magnetostatic dipolar interaction, whose singularity at the zone center is passed onto the scattering intensity. However, the pinch points survive when the range of the dipoles is truncated to finite shell number in the form of a three-band quadratic band touching protected by cubic symmetry. This model, which is related to the Luttinger semi-metal, provides a general long wavelength model for the emergence of pinch point scattering intensity encompassing also the true long-range dipolar model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究基态为简单单态乘积态的磁性系统中的色散晶场激发，并探讨磁相互作用、能带拓扑、晶体对称性和时间反演对称性之间的 interplay。借助高分辨率中子能谱，作者揭示了八氯石晶格 KTb₃F₁₀ 中玻色激子的色散关系及散射强度中的 pinch point 特征。研究表明，长程磁静力偶极相互作用在区中心的奇异性会传递到散射强度中；即使截断偶极相互作用的作用范围，pinch point 仍可作为受立方对称性保护的三能带二次接触存在，从而形成与 Luttinger 半金属相关的长波长模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解晶体固体中能带结构的对称性和拓扑，一直是整整一代凝聚态物理学家关注的核心主题之一，其影响涉及许多不同平台，包括电子能带、光子晶体、声子和磁激发。在后几类系统中，通常存在磁性长程有序和时间反演对称性破缺。在这里，我们通过研究基态为简单单态乘积态之上的色散晶场激发，进一步丰富磁性系统可能具有的能带结构。在这些系统中，磁相互作用以及晶体对称性和时间反演对称性共同参与决定能带性质。利用高分辨率中子能谱，我们揭示了 KTb₃F₁₀ 中玻色激子的色散关系；该材料是八氯石晶格的一种实验实现。我们表明，散射强度中存在 pinch point 特征。然而，该系统中的主导耦合是长程磁静力偶极相互作用，它在区中心的奇异性会传递到散射强度中。当偶极相互作用的范围以有限壳层数的形式截断时，pinch point 仍然保留，并表现为一种受立方对称性保护的三能带二次接触。该模型与 Luttinger 半金属有关，为 pinch point 散射强度的出现提供了一个一般性的长波长模型，并且也涵盖真正的长程偶极模型。

articles.title: Skyrmion nucleus resolves the Landauer paradox
articles.title_zh: 斯格明子成核体解决 Landauer 悖论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11551v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric switching is among the most fundamental and widely studied symmetry-breaking processes in physics. However, the Landauer paradox asserts that an ideal single-domain ferroelectric should be kinetically unswitchable, because a three-dimensional reversed nucleus would carry a prohibitive depolarization penalty, leading to unphysically large coercive field (the electric field required to switch the polarization). Here we show that this long-standing paradox is resolved by topology. In defect-free PbTiO3, large-scale molecular dynamics simulations reveal that the intrinsic critical nucleus is a three-dimensional polar skyrmion. Its continuous polarization rotation and Néel-type boundary walls self-compensate bound charge, suppressing the depolarization energy by orders of magnitude and bringing the predicted coercive field into agreement with experiment. This topological nucleus further overturns the 60-year-old Janovec-Kay-Dunn law. We derive an analytical thickness-dependent coercive-field law governed by field-induced softening of the parent ferroelectric state and controlled by a single material descriptor. This framework captures diverse experimental trends across ferroelectric families and recasts the Kay-Dunn exponent of -2/3 as an effective finite-window behavior. These results establish polar topology as an organizing principle for intrinsic switching and suggest that hidden topological transition states may broadly shape nonequilibrium phase transformations traditionally understood as Landau-type symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过大规模分子动力学模拟表明，在无缺陷 PbTiO₃ 中，铁电翻转的本征临界成核体是三维极性斯格明子。其连续的极化旋转和 Néel 型边界壁能够自补偿束缚电荷，将去极化能降低数个数量级，使预测矫顽场与实验相符。作者进一步推导出由母相铁电态的场诱导软化控制的厚度依赖矫顽场定律，解释了不同铁电材料中的实验趋势，并将 Kay–Dunn 指数 −2/3 重新解释为有限观测窗口下的有效行为。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作利用大尺度分子动力学模拟研究无缺陷PbTiO3中的铁电翻转机制，发现临界翻转核具有三维极性斯格明子结构。其连续极化旋转和Néel型边界壁能够补偿束缚电荷、降低退极化能，并据此解释实验相符的矫顽场和提出厚度依赖的解析规律。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的铁电极化翻转、畴壁动力学、拓扑磁性和分子动力学研究高度直接相关。极化斯格明子作为翻转成核机制，为研究缺陷诱导开关、尺寸效应、畴壁结构及铁电拓扑态提供了重要参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究缺陷、应变、界面、电极边界条件及有限温度对极性斯格明子成核和翻转路径的影响。建议结合有效哈密顿量或机器学习势开展更大尺度、长时间的铁电开关动力学模拟。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电翻转是物理学中最基本且研究最广泛的对称性破缺过程之一。然而，Landauer 悖论指出，理想的单畴铁电体在动力学上应当无法翻转，因为三维反转成核体会承受难以负担的去极化代价，从而导致不符合物理实际的巨大矫顽场，即翻转极化所需的电场。在这里，我们表明，这一长期存在的悖论可以通过拓扑得到解决。在无缺陷 PbTiO₃ 中，大规模分子动力学模拟揭示，本征临界成核体是一个三维极性斯格明子。其连续的极化旋转和 Néel 型边界壁能够自补偿束缚电荷，使去极化能降低数个数量级，并使预测的矫顽场与实验结果一致。这种拓扑成核体还推翻了已有 60 年历史的 Janovec–Kay–Dunn 定律。我们推导出一个随厚度变化的解析矫顽场定律，该定律由场诱导的母相铁电态软化控制，并由单一材料描述量决定。该框架能够解释不同铁电材料家族中的多种实验趋势，并将 Kay–Dunn 指数 −2/3 重新表述为有限观测窗口中的有效行为。这些结果确立了极化拓扑作为理解本征翻转的组织原则，并表明，隐藏的拓扑过渡态可能广泛影响传统上按照 Landau 型对称性破缺来理解的非平衡相变。

articles.title: Effect of Stress and Surface Roughness on Electrodeposition in All-Solid-State Batteries: A Computational Investigation
articles.title_zh: 应力与表面粗糙度对全固态电池电沉积影响的计算研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: All-solid-state batteries (ASSBs) promise high energy density and enhanced safety, but their development is hindered by instability and incompatibility at solid-solid interfaces. In Li-metal ASSBs, lithium penetration occurs despite stiff ceramic electrolytes via grain boundaries, often initiated by minor Li/SE interfacial irregularities. Here we introduce a two-dimensional continuum model with electro-chemo-mechanical coupling to investigate interfacial current distribution in Li ASSBs with surface-roughened argyrodite electrolyte under stack pressures and applied current density. Our theoretical analysis and simulation studies highlight the critical role of mechanical stress in interfacial current distribution. We find that prominent stress variations around elongated surface protrusions are the key to nonuniform Li deposition, without which Li deposition becomes uniform even on a rough surface. Moreover, our parametric study elucidates that stress effects dominate the overpotential and current distribution under low interfacial current density to exchange current density ratios, otherwise the high interfacial resistance due to surface-roughness-induced interfacial area becomes dominant. With these insights, we also discuss the potential of engineering artificial interlayers to modulate interfacial current distributions, offering guidance for improving the long-term performance and reliability of ASSBs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个二维电—化学—力学耦合连续介质模型，研究堆叠压力和外加电流密度下，表面粗糙的 argyrodite 电解质中锂金属全固态电池的界面电流分布。研究发现，细长表面凸起周围显著的应力变化是造成锂非均匀沉积的关键；若没有应力变化，即使表面粗糙，锂沉积也会趋于均匀。参数研究进一步表明，在低界面电流密度与交换电流密度比值下，应力效应主导过电位和电流分布，而在较高比值下，由粗糙度引起的界面面积变化所导致的高界面电阻成为主导因素。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全固态电池（ASSB）具有高能量密度和更高安全性的前景，但其发展受到固—固界面处不稳定性和不相容性的阻碍。在锂金属全固态电池中，尽管陶瓷电解质具有较高刚度，锂仍会沿晶界发生穿透，而这一过程通常由锂/固态电解质界面处的微小不规则结构引发。在这里，我们引入一个二维电—化学—力学耦合连续介质模型，用于研究堆叠压力和外加电流密度作用下、具有粗糙表面的 argyrodite 电解质中锂全固态电池的界面电流分布。我们的理论分析和模拟研究强调了机械应力在界面电流分布中的关键作用。我们发现，细长表面凸起周围显著的应力变化是导致锂非均匀沉积的关键；如果不存在这种应力变化，即使表面粗糙，锂沉积也会变得均匀。此外，我们的参数研究表明，当界面电流密度与交换电流密度之比较低时，应力效应主导过电位和电流分布；在其他情况下，由表面粗糙度引起的界面面积变化所导致的高界面电阻则成为主导因素。基于这些认识，我们还讨论了设计人工中间层以调节界面电流分布的潜力，为改善全固态电池的长期性能和可靠性提供指导。

articles.title: Robust Spin-1 Haldane Topology under Itinerant Doping
articles.title_zh: 巡游掺杂下稳健的自旋 1 Haldane 拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study itinerant hole doping of the spin-1 Haldane symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase in two t--J chains coupled by ferromagnetic (FM) Hund exchange. Density-matrix renormalization group calculations show that string order, a finite spin gap, and the Haldane entanglement structure coexist over a broad doping range. Combined with entanglement-entropy scaling consistent with a single gapless charge mode, these results support a metallic doped Haldane SPT with a C1S0 low-energy description. At low doping, short-range charge correlations reduce the density of spin-1/2 defect rungs, whereas at larger doping their positions become nearly uncorrelated while their spins are collectively incorporated into the correlated spin sector. The doped Haldane SPT terminates in a fully spin-polarized FM phase, which forms a reentrant pocket at high doping in the global phase diagram. Dilute-limit analyses trace the two FM boundaries to spin--charge factorization at weak Hund coupling and to rung-triplet binding with reduced pair mobility at strong Hund coupling. Our results show how mobile carriers reorganize the Haldane spin structure while preserving its characteristic signatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究两个通过铁磁 Hund 交换耦合的自旋 1 t-J 链中 Haldane 对称性保护拓扑相的巡游空穴掺杂。密度矩阵重整化群计算表明，在较宽掺杂范围内，弦序、有限自旋能隙和 Haldane 纠缠结构能够共存，并与单一无能隙电荷模相一致，支持金属掺杂 Haldane SPT 相的 C1S0 低能描述。随着掺杂增加，电荷关联会改变自旋 1/2 缺陷梯的分布及其参与自旋关联扇区的方式；最终，该相在高掺杂处终止于完全自旋极化的铁磁相，并在全局相图中形成再入区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了两个通过铁磁（FM）Hund 交换耦合的 t-J 链中自旋 1 Haldane 对称性保护拓扑（SPT）相的巡游空穴掺杂。密度矩阵重整化群计算表明，在较宽的掺杂范围内，弦序、有限自旋能隙和 Haldane 纠缠结构能够共存。结合与单一无能隙电荷模相一致的纠缠熵标度关系，这些结果支持一种具有 C1S0 低能描述的金属掺杂 Haldane SPT 相。在低掺杂下，短程电荷关联降低了自旋 1/2 缺陷梯的密度；而在较高掺杂下，这些缺陷的位置变得近乎不相关，但它们的自旋会整体并入关联自旋扇区。掺杂的 Haldane SPT 相最终终止于完全自旋极化的 FM 相，该相在全局相图的高掺杂区域形成一个再入区域。在稀释极限下的分析表明，这两个 FM 边界分别源于弱 Hund 耦合下的自旋—电荷因子化，以及强 Hund 耦合下的梯间三重态束缚和降低的成对迁移率。我们的结果展示了移动载流子如何重组 Haldane 自旋结构，同时保留其特征性标志。

articles.title: Phase-Controlled Majorana Zero Modes in Altermagnetic Topological-Insulator Josephson Junctions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11633v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We exploit facet-dependent Andreev phase shifts to control topological superconductivity with a phase bias in a three-dimensional altermagnetic topological-insulator Josephson junction. In the weak link between two conventional s-wave superconductors, the d-wave altermagnetic order produces facet-dependent momentum shifts of the surface Dirac cones. The resulting net momentum of the states involved in Andreev reflection generates additional propagation phases that differ between facets. Consequently, the facet-resolved Andreev spectra exhibit gap closings at distinct phase biases, giving rise to topological superconducting regimes that host Majorana zero modes(MZMs). We further show that tuning the phase bias controls the spatial localization of these modes. The associated topological superconducting transitions are only weakly affected by moderate variations in the chemical potential, obviating the need for fine-tuning to the Dirac point. Our results establish a platform for realizing and spatially controlling MZMs by tuning the superconducting phase bias in altermagnetic topological-insulator Josephson junctions.

articles.title: Competition between vacancy creation and filling in defect-engineering of hBN
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) has recently become the focus of intense research as a material that can host quantum emitters. It is known that such emission is related to point defects, but in order to conclusively correlate specific defects to their spectra, having control over the defect creation mechanism is required. Here, we prepare freestanding, monolayer hBN samples and irradiate them with ultra-low-energy (150 eV) Ar+ ions. The samples are characterized before and after irradiation via scanning transmission electron microscopy to assess the defect density and distribution. Contrary to what analytical potential molecular dynamics simulations have predicted, we predominantly observe boron single vacancies after ion irradiation, followed by double vacancies at half the count. Moreover, we also observe that vacancy filling with Si and C impurity atoms plays a more significant role in the created defects than previously assumed, potentially posing a problem for selective creation of quantum emitters in hBN.

articles.title: Interplay of Kekulé order, flat bands and electron-phonon coupling in graphene
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kekulé order in graphene is known to give rise to extended flat bands near the van Hove singularity (VHS) and enhanced electron-phonon coupling. However, the microscopic mechanism underlying the coexistence of these effects remains unclear. Here, it is shown that they jointly emerge as a consequence of the lattice distortion manifested through the differentiation of carbon bonds and associated electronic hoppings. In this picture, the conduction band around the M point decreases almost linearly in width with increasing Kekulé order, while the VHS and dimensionless electron-phonon coupling exhibit approximately quadratic upward responses. The resulting enhancement of the electron-phonon coupling is governed predominantly by the increasing density of states at the VHS, with the effective deformation potential remaining weakly affected by the distortion. As such, the obtained results are consistent with previous related theoretical and experimental studies, while also pointing toward a potential shallowing of the conduction band under the characteristic 1/4 filling and an increasing relevance of nonadiabatic electron-phonon effects beyond the conventional Migdal approximation. Altogether, these findings highlight the potential of controlled Kekulé ordering for engineering emergent correlated quantum phases in graphene.

articles.title: Unraveling the Kagome Antiferromagnetic 3J Model and Its Materials: An Integrated Approach
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the ground-state and finite-temperature properties of the kagome antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model with three inequivalent couplings, dubbed the 3J model, which is designed for the candidate Dirac quantum spin liquid (QSL) material YCu₃(OH)₆Br₂[Br₁₋ₓ(OH)ₓ] (see, e.g., Zeng et al., 2024). Employing large-scale density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) supplemented by neural quantum states (NQS) simulations, we identify an intermediate QSL phase between two magnetically ordered phases. We also find that this QSL is separated from the kagome spin liquid ground state at the isotropic limit. To establish a direct comparison with experiments, we compute the specific heat of the model by means of advanced exponential (XTRG) and tangent-space (tanTRG) thermal tensor-network methods. In the magnetically ordered phase, the specific heat over temperature exhibits a shoulder at a temperature that is a fraction of the coupling strength Jₕₑₓ, which disappears in the QSL phase. These universal behaviors are consistent with the experimentally observed specific heat in 3J materials for both ordered and QSL candidate samples. Our work thus connects microscopic models with experimentally measurable signatures, exemplifying an integrated approach (see Meng et al., 2026) to understanding QSL phenomena in frustrated quantum magnets, with 3J materials serving as a representative case and providing a foundation for future studies.

articles.title: Device Engineering and Performance Optimization of Cu2NiGeS4 Thin-Film Solar Cells with In2S3/MoTe2 Charge-Selective Layers: A Computational Study
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pursuit of efficient and sustainable thin-film photovoltaics increasingly demands absorber materials that combine strong optical absorption with earth-abundant and environmentally benign constituents. Cu2NiGeS4 (CNGS) has emerged as a promising quaternary chalcogenide absorber owing to its favorable optoelectronic properties and high absorption coefficient, yet its photovoltaic potential remains comparatively underexplored, particularly in conjunction with optimized charge-selective layers. Here, we introduce and comprehensively investigate an CNGS-based solar-cell architecture using SCAPS-1D, with In2S3 and MoTe2 serving as the electron and hole-transport layers respectively. The analysis of energy-band profiles, electric fields, carrier distributions, and generation-recombination characteristics reveals the mechanisms governing carrier separation and extraction across the heterojunctions. Systematic optimization of layer thickness, doping density, bulk and interface defect densities, recombination coefficients, parasitic resistances, temperature, and illumination intensity identifies the key factors limiting device performance. The optimized device is predicted to achieve a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 28.44% with a open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.984 V, short-circuit current density (JSC) of 34.39 mA/cm2, and fill factor (FF) of 84.04%, under AM1.5G illumination at 300 K. This simulated efficiency exceeds the previously reported 6.25-21.17% range for CNGS-based solar cells considered in this study. The findings establish In2S3/CNGS/MoTe2 as a promising platform for next-generation thin-film photovoltaics and provide physically grounded design guidelines for absorber optimization, interface engineering, and future experimental realization.

articles.title: Condensation temperature and magnetic phases of trapped coherently coupled Bose gases
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate condensation and finite-temperature magnetic phase transitions in a coherently (Rabi) coupled Bose gas confined in a three-dimensional harmonic trap. For the noninteracting system, we derive analytical expressions for the critical temperature and condensate fraction using a semiclassical description of the single-particle spectrum and density of states. At fixed particle number, coherent coupling enhances the critical temperature relative to the uncoupled system, and this enhancement decreases with increasing particle number N. The finite-size correction, in contrast, lowers the transition temperature, with its effect diminishing for larger N. We then incorporate repulsive interactions within the Hartree--Fock--Bogoliubov--Popov framework to investigate the finite-temperature phase diagram in the temperature--Rabi coupling plane. The system undergoes successive transitions from a ferromagnetic to a paramagnetic condensate and, at higher temperature, to a thermal gas. The transition boundaries obtained from the vanishing of the condensate fraction show excellent agreement with the analytical Hartree-Fock predictions. We find that the interactions substantially suppress the variation in the condensation temperature with an increase in the coherent coupling.

articles.title: Block entropy area based non-local fermionic mode optimization with gradient disentanglers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a systematic block entropy area based mode optimization algorithm for many-body quantum states of interacting fermions represented by matrix product states. From the gradient of a global cost function, the block entropy area, a long-ranged, non-interacting effective disentangler Hamiltonian is formed. We then simulate the time-dependent Schrödinger equation driven by the disentangler Hamiltonian by employing the time-dependent variational principle based on projector splitting, and minimize the cost function. The combination of the density matrix renormalization group with this gradient-based entanglement minimization forms an efficient low-rank iterative ground-state algorithm that also provides an optimized single-particle basis for matrix product state representation. We demonstrate the method on two-dimensional lattice models of interacting fermions and the Fe₄S₄ cluster, and show its robustness and superiority over earlier protocols using nearest-neighbor mode rotations and reorderings.

articles.title: Piezomagnetism in a model cubic noncollinear altermagnet
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11816v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets constitute a distinct class of magnetic materials that combine compensated magnetic order with spin-polarized electronic bands, hence carrying characteristics of both antiferromagnets and ferromagnets. Piezomagnetism - the linear relationship between lattice strain and a net magnetic moment - has emerged as smoking-gun evidence of altermagnetism that distinguishes it from antiferromagnetism. Here, we uncover a large piezomagnetic response in MnTe2, a cubic altermagnet with a noncollinear spin arrangement and weak spin-orbit coupling. We combine dilatometry with nuclear magnetic resonance, a bulk local probe, to observe signatures of both direct and inverse piezomagnetism consistent with symmetry considerations and first-principles calculations. The dilatometry measurements reveal a shear deformation proportional to an applied magnetic field, while magnetic resonance detects a ferromagnetic moment induced by shear strain. The respective results for the piezomagnetic coupling strength are in good agreement, and they are captured by first-principles results. These findings for simple binary MnTe2 position this material as a model altermagnet, demonstrate the utility of nuclear magnetic resonance in investigations of piezomagnetism, and open new avenues for multimodal strain and magnetic-field control in spintronic and memory applications.
articles.focus_summary: 该工作在立方非共线交替磁体MnTe2中发现较大的压磁响应，并通过膨胀测量、核磁共振、对称性分析和第一性原理计算共同验证。结果表明剪切应变能够诱导铁磁矩，反向磁场也可引起剪切形变。
articles.focus_relation: 该研究与团队的交替磁性、非共线磁结构、应变工程、磁电耦合和第一性原理计算方向直接相关。压磁效应为利用晶格自由度识别和操控交替磁性的具体可测物理量。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议跟进其磁空间群和对称性约束，分析压磁张量与自旋轨道耦合强度的关系。可在候选二维或范德华交替磁体中开展高通量压磁响应筛选，并构建应变-自旋-输运耦合模型。

articles.title: High-fidelity k·p representations of first-principles electronic band structures through covariant renormalization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The k·p method can be applied directly to first-principles energies and momentum matrix elements, but the resulting models converge slowly with the number of bands and are inexact wherever the underlying Hamiltonian is nonlocal. We show that both limitations can be largely removed by renormalizing the eigenvalue spectra of the Hermitian momentum matrices. These spectra are gauge invariant, and are identical for symmetry-related Cartesian components, hence scaling the recurring magnitudes provides a modest set of parameters that preserves degeneracies and crystal symmetry without needing to construct a symmetry-adapted basis. We choose to renormalize the models against reference eigenvalues and band velocities on rays out of a high-symmetry point. For GaP, a 15-band model can reproduce the band structure in the near-gap reference regions within a few meV. For zincblende and wurtzite AlN, similar accuracy requires 30- or 66-band models, which in the case of zincblende is traced to the strong warping in the [110] direction. The scheme readily generalizes to rocksalt PbTe, which includes spin-orbit coupling, and has L-centered valence and conduction band extrema. Further, we demonstrate, for GaP, how compact four-band Hamiltonians can be obtained by downfolding within the same renormalization scheme. Moreover, by changing the fitting regime to encompass the entire Brillouin zone, the scheme can be used to generate full-zone models that reproduce the density of states. The practical utility is illustrated with a 59-band k.p model for GaP, which can be evaluated on meshes far denser than the reference calculation, that in turn can be used both to resolve fine features in the density of states and to compute the hole conductivity at low temperature.

articles.title: High-Temperature ferromagnetism from site-selective filling in (Fe,Ni)₆₋δGeTe₂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of high-temperature ferromagnetism in the metallic van der Waals (vdW) system Fe_NGeTe₂ has brought two-dimensional (2D) magnets into technologically relevant temperature scales. Specifically at N = 5, dilution of magnetic moments by nickel substitution counterintuitively achieves a record high Curie temperature of 478~K. Unraveling the origin of this nickel-substitution-induced enhancement is complicated by the compound's structural complexity, coexistent itinerant and local magnetic contributions, and mesoscopic compositional domains. Through coordinated structural and electronic characterization, we identify that the high-T_C magnetic phase arises from a strain-stabilized Fe₆GeTe₂ nano-precipitate. Combining first-principles calculations and spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we uncover a site-specific electronic landscape in which interior iron atoms primarily host localized moments while the outer iron atoms neighboring the tellurium layers produce spin-polarized itinerant carriers that cross the vdW gap. The large energy cost associated with homogeneous nickel substitution is found to favor the spontaneous precipitation of the crystallographically and electronically ``clean'' high-T_C phase. Finally, we compare metal-rich vdW magnets with binary magnetic alloys, and discuss the unifying roles of nano-precipitates in stabilizing otherwise unattainable bulk phases. Our work provides mechanistic insights into the record-high T_C ferromagnetism in (Fe,Ni)₅₊δGeTe₂, establishing a rigorous foundation for the atomic engineering of vdW magnetic metals informed by direct electronic signatures.
articles.focus_summary: 该工作研究镍取代(Fe,Ni)6−δGeTe2中高温铁磁性的起源，发现高居里温度磁相来自应变稳定的Fe6GeTe2纳米析出物。第一性原理计算与自旋、角分辨光电子能谱表明，内层铁原子主要贡献局域磁矩，而靠近碲层的外层铁原子产生穿越范德华间隙的自旋极化巡游载流子。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的二维范德华磁体、巡游磁性、非共线磁性、磁性异质结构和自旋输运方向高度相关。位点选择性占据、应变稳定相、局域磁矩与巡游电子协同增强铁磁性，对自旋哈密顿量和磁性材料逆向设计具有借鉴价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步构建包含位点无序、应变和巡游电子效应的自旋-电子有效模型，研究其温度依赖磁性、磁阻和自旋输运性质。也可利用高通量计算和机器学习模型筛选具有类似位点选择性磁耦合机制的二维磁体。

articles.title: Low temperature thermodynamics of Sₑff=1/2 triangular lattice quantum spin liquid candidate TlYbS₂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11881v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometrically frustrated triangular-lattice antiferromagnets exhibit a delicate competition between magnetic order and quantum spin liquid (QSL) behavior, with the Yb-based delafossite family AYbX₂ providing a structurally clean platform for exploring this physics. Here, we report a comprehensive study of single-crystal TlYbS₂ using DC magnetization, AC susceptibility, electron spin resonance (ESR), and specific heat measurements extending from room temperature to the millikelvin regime. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction confirms a trigonal Rbar3m structure comprising well-separated triangular layers of Yb³⁺ ions with no detectable site disorder. At zero field, a weak thermodynamic anomaly is observed near 530 mK, which may indicate the onset of a weakly ordered state similar to that reported in KYbSe₂. Below 300 mK, the zero-field magnetic specific heat follows Cᵣₘ ₘpropto T¹.⁸, close to a quadratic temperature dependence, in contrast to the linear temperature dependence reported for the sister compound TlYbSe₂, which has been described in terms of the interplay between spinons and thermally excited gauge-flux excitations. Magnetization and ESR measurements establish pronounced easy-plane magnetic anisotropy, with g_perp/g_parallel approx 6.9. The anomaly near 530 mK exhibits a strongly anisotropic response to magnetic field. For Hperp c, it remains visible up to approximately 2 T and continuously evolves toward a field-induced ordered phase above approximately 2.5 T, followed by a sequence of field-induced phases that includes a 1/3 magnetization plateau between approximately 5 and 8 T and full polarization near 17 T. In contrast, for Hparallel c, the anomaly weakens and is suppressed near 3 T, consistent with the recently reported confinement--deconfinement transition from an ordered state to a field-induced QSL.

articles.title: Entanglement entropy in topological tensor networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10667v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We derive an entropy formula for recently proposed tensor network models which prepare diffeomorphism invariant states of topological quantum field theories with non-compact and/or continuous gauge groups. We show that our entropy formula generalizes the notion of ``topological entanglement entropy'' to incorporate the infinite number of particle-like excitations in such theories. When our networks are endowed with gauge group SL(2,R), we can interpret them as models of three-dimensional gravity with small Newton's constant and possibly non-invertible metrics.

articles.title: 3d Ising Field Theory with Magnetic Deformation: Fuzzy Sphere Meets TCSA
articles.title_zh: 具有磁性形变的三维伊辛场论：模糊球面与截断共形空间方法的结合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10670v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the magnetic deformation of the (2+1)d Ising CFT, also known as Ising Field Theory (IFT), on a spatial sphere. We use the Fuzzy Sphere (FS) Ising setup and compare it to the Truncated Conformal Space Approach (TCSA). Universal, infinite volume, IFT quantities are extracted by modeling the effects of curvature, as expected from a local effective theory on the sphere. We find evidence that IFT contains a bound-state with a small binding energy. Locality also allows us to extract the same IFT quantities from different angular momentum sectors, providing additional consistency checks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究空间球面上的二维空间加一维时间伊辛共形场论的磁性形变，即伊辛场论。作者采用模糊球面伊辛模型，并将其与截断共形空间方法进行比较。通过建模球面曲率效应，提取了普适的无限体积伊辛场论物理量，并发现该理论可能包含一个束缚能较小的束缚态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究空间球面上的二维空间加一维时间伊辛共形场论的磁性形变，该理论也称为伊辛场论（IFT）。我们采用模糊球面（FS）伊辛体系，并将其与截断共形空间方法（TCSA）进行比较。通过按照球面上的局域有效理论所预期的方式，对曲率效应进行建模，我们提取出了普适的、无限体积极限下的IFT物理量。我们发现了IFT包含一个束缚态且其束缚能很小的证据。局域性还使我们能够从不同的角动量扇区提取相同的IFT物理量，从而提供额外的一致性检验。

articles.title: Krylov Edge Spectroscopy of Symmetry-Protected Topological Phases
articles.title_zh: 受对称性保护拓扑相的克里洛夫边界谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10676v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Krylov edge spectroscopy, a many-body operator-space protocol for detecting and classifying one-dimensional symmetry-protected topological phases from local boundary dynamics. A Hermitian boundary operator generates a semi-infinite Krylov hopping chain whose boundary weight obeys an exact zero-frequency normalizability criterion. Open-periodic, boundary-bulk, and symmetry-preserving boundary-perturbation tests identify protected boundary memory, while a finite-depth leakage residual certifies when an explicitly reconstructed operator is already near zero frequency. Classification minimizes the normalized commutator over symmetry-resolved boundary operators in fixed charge sectors. For bosonic Z_N × Z_N phases, the recovered endpoint charge gives the cohomology label. The method requires neither many-body exact diagonalization, an explicit ground-state wavefunction or entanglement spectrum, nor a guessed dressed edge or string operator. For finite-range Hamiltonians, locality organizes the thermodynamic limit at fixed Krylov depth before the depth limit. We demonstrate the protocol in cluster, clock, Haldane, and trivial spin-1 chains. In the exactly solvable cluster chain, the transition between the gapped topological and trivial phases manifests as a localization-delocalization transition of the Krylov edge mode on the Krylov chain. This transition occurs precisely at the bulk gap closing, and its localization-length exponent coincides with the Ising correlation-length exponent. Through operator Krylov dynamics, our work turns local boundary evolution into a direct spectroscopy of many-body topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出克里洛夫边界谱学，一种通过局域边界动力学探测和分类一维受对称性保护拓扑相的多体算符空间方法。该方法利用边界算符生成的半无限克里洛夫跃迁链，识别受保护的边界记忆并进行对称性分类。对于玻色子 Z_N × Z_N 拓扑相，方法可以恢复对应的上同调标记，并在多种自旋链模型中得到验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了克里洛夫边界谱学，这是一种多体算符空间协议，通过局域边界动力学来探测和分类一维受对称性保护的拓扑相。一个厄米边界算符生成一条半无限的克里洛夫跃迁链，其边界权重满足一个关于零频正规化的精确判据。开放—周期、边界—体以及保持对称性的边界扰动测试能够识别受保护的边界记忆，而有限深度泄漏残差则可以在一个显式重构的算符已经接近零频时给出认证。分类过程在固定电荷扇区内的、按对称性分辨的边界算符上最小化归一化对易子。对于玻色子 Z_N × Z_N 拓扑相，所恢复的端点电荷给出了上同调标记。该方法既不需要多体精确对角化，也不需要显式的基态波函数或纠缠谱，同时不需要猜测经过修饰的边界算符或弦算符。对于有限程哈密顿量，在克里洛夫深度固定时，局域性先组织热力学极限，然后再取深度极限。我们在簇链、时钟链、海森堡—霍尔丹链以及平庸自旋-1链中演示了该协议。在可精确求解的簇链中，有能隙拓扑相与平庸相之间的转变表现为克里洛夫链上克里洛夫边界模的局域化—离域化转变。该转变恰好发生在体能隙闭合处，并且其局域化长度临界指数与伊辛关联长度指数一致。通过算符克里洛夫动力学，我们的工作将局域边界演化转化为对多体拓扑的直接谱学探测。

articles.title: A new generation of effective core potentials: Selected heavy 5d and 6p elements
articles.title_zh: 新一代有效芯势：精选重 5d 与 6p 元素
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10853v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We expand the correlation-consistent effective core potentials (ccECPs) library by developing semi-local pseudopotentials and matching basis sets by heavy-elements from 5d (Hf, Os, Hg) and 6p (Tl, Po, At, Rn) blocks. In order to accurately capture scalar relativistic effects, spin-orbit coupling, and electron-electron correlation, we implement a tiered core-valence partitioning strategy across three distinct resolutions. This includes a small 60-core (Hf, Os, Hg) that explicitly correlates subvalence shells, a large 78-core definition for the main-group elements that rigorously accounts for core polarization and relaxation effects in sparse valence environments, and an intermediate 68-core partition for Hg and Tl. This 68-core architecture represents a unique development in the ccECP library, optimizing the balance between accuracy and computational efficiency in a manner unexplored for ligther elements. Optimized against relativistic all-electron CCSD(T) references, the ccECPs deliver outstanding atomic precision, achieving a global average atomic low-lying states deviation of just 0.045 eV. This accuracy translates directly to robust molecular transferability, systematically restricting dissociation energy discrepancies to under 0.03 eV, equilibrium bond lengths to within 0.005 Å. By enforcing a regularized, finite potential at the origin for enhanced numerical stability in stochastic quantum Monte Carlo methods, this library removes a critical methodological bottleneck for predictive many-body simulations of heavy-element systems and materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文扩展了相关一致性有效芯势（ccECP）库，为 5d 区的 Hf、Os、Hg 和 6p 区的 Tl、Po、At、Rn 构建半局域赝势及匹配基组。通过分层的芯—价电子划分，同时处理标量相对论效应、自旋—轨道耦合和电子关联。相对于相对论全电子 CCSD(T) 参考结果，这些有效芯势具有很高的原子精度，并在分子体系中表现出良好的可迁移性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过为 5d 区的重元素（Hf、Os、Hg）和 6p 区的重元素（Tl、Po、At、Rn）开发半局域赝势及其匹配基组，扩展了相关一致性有效芯势（ccECP）库。为了准确捕捉标量相对论效应、自旋—轨道耦合和电子—电子关联，我们在三种不同分辨率下实施了分层的芯—价电子划分策略。这包括一种适用于 Hf、Os 和 Hg 的小型 60 芯定义，其中显式关联次价层；一种适用于主族元素的大型 78 芯定义，能够在稀疏价电子环境中严格考虑芯极化与弛豫效应；以及一种适用于 Hg 和 Tl 的中等规模 68 芯划分。该 68 芯结构是 ccECP 库中的独特发展，在精度与计算效率之间实现了优化平衡，而这一方向在较轻元素中尚未被探索。以相对论全电子 CCSD(T) 结果为优化基准，这些 ccECP 在原子层面实现了出色的精度，低激发态偏差的全球平均值仅为 0.045 eV。这种精度直接转化为稳健的分子可迁移性：解离能差异系统地限制在 0.03 eV 以内，平衡键长则控制在 0.005 Å 以内。通过在原点处施加正则化的有限势以提高随机量子蒙特卡洛方法的数值稳定性，该库消除了重元素体系预测性多体模拟中的一个关键方法学瓶颈。

articles.title: Symmetry-aware super-resolution of crystal orientation maps via invariant latent-space learning
articles.title_zh: 通过不变潜空间学习实现具有对称性意识的晶体取向图超分辨率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10898v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Crystal-orientation maps are physical fields defined only up to crystal symmetry; electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) resolves them experimentally, but acquisition-time constraints limit spatial resolution. Unlike conventional images, EBSD data lie on the quotient space SO(3)/G, where G is the crystal-symmetry group. Standard Euclidean interpolation can therefore mix symmetry-equivalent representations and blur grain boundaries. We introduce the Symmetry-Group-Aware Super-Resolution Attention Network (SG-SRAN), which incorporates crystal symmetry and boundary preservation by design. A frozen, locally isometric encoder maps equivalent orientations to a common latent representation in which Euclidean distance approximates misorientation. Super-resolution is performed in this space, with each high-resolution token restricted to a feature-consistent local support to prevent cross-boundary mixing. A dictionary-based decoder then recovers valid orientations. Across FCC and HCP benchmarks, SG-SRAN matches 15-16 million parameter backbones using only 27-49k trainable parameters, while achieving the lowest p68 errors, highest inverse-pole-figure fidelity, and zero-shot transfer to unseen alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 晶体取向图只在晶体对称性意义下定义，而电子背散射衍射的采集时间限制了其空间分辨率。本文提出对称群感知超分辨率注意力网络（SG-SRAN），在设计中同时融入晶体对称性和晶界保持机制。该方法在局部等距编码器映射的潜空间中进行超分辨率，并通过局部特征一致的支持区域避免跨晶界混合，在 FCC 和 HCP 基准上实现了高精度和对未见合金的零样本迁移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体取向图是仅在晶体对称性下定义的物理场；电子背散射衍射（EBSD）能够在实验上解析这些取向，但采集时间的限制约束了空间分辨率。与传统图像不同，EBSD 数据位于商空间 SO(3)/G 上，其中 G 是晶体对称群。因此，标准的欧几里得插值可能混合对称等价的表示，并使晶界变得模糊。我们提出了对称群感知超分辨率注意力网络（SG-SRAN），其设计内在地融入了晶体对称性和晶界保持机制。一个冻结的局部等距编码器将等价取向映射到共同的潜表示中，在该表示里，欧几里得距离近似于错取向。超分辨率过程在这一空间中执行，并将每个高分辨率标记限制在特征一致的局部支持区域内，以防止跨晶界混合。随后，基于字典的解码器恢复出有效的取向。在 FCC 和 HCP 基准数据上，SG-SRAN 仅使用 2.7 万至 4.9 万个可训练参数，就达到了拥有 1500 万至 1600 万参数的骨干网络的性能，同时取得最低的 p68 误差、最高的逆极图保真度，并能够零样本迁移到未见过的合金。

articles.title: Phases in a class of associative memories via hidden neurons
articles.title_zh: 通过隐藏神经元研究一类联想记忆中的相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10976v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Associative memory in the Hopfield network is attractor dynamics in a disordered many-body system, and higher-order and exponential extensions turn its retrieval update into softmax attention. The polynomial and exponential regimes have been analyzed by different methods, with no common architecture in which to ask what fixes the storage scale. In this paper we study the bipartite architecture of Krotov and Hopfield, which we call the class H, whose model is fixed by a Lagrangian for each layer, taking the hidden neurons as the order parameter of retrieval. At polynomial load the replica method yields the replica-symmetric phase diagrams and closed-form capacities, and the crosstalk moment is common to Ising and spherical visible neurons, so their differences come from the visible entropy. With a softmax hidden layer the load is exponential, and a copy representation maps the thermodynamics onto random-energy-model counting, with paramagnetic, condensed, and frozen phases. Heating destabilizes retrieval by quantized reassignments of attention, and typical Gaussian patterns remain metastable at every load. The regimes differ in their crosstalk statistics, central-limit at polynomial load and large-deviation at exponential load, and the class H splits retrieval into two roles, the visible Lagrangian fixing stability and the hidden one the storage scale, two axes that may also guide the design of new Lagrangians.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究 Krotov 和 Hopfield 提出的二部联想记忆架构，并将其称为 H 类模型，其中隐藏神经元充当检索序参量。通过复制表示，作者分析了多项式负载和指数负载下的相图、存储容量及交叉干扰统计。在软最大隐藏层情形下，体系表现出顺磁、凝聚和冻结相，且可通过克里洛夫动力学理解检索稳定性与存储规模由不同层的拉格朗日量分别控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Hopfield 网络中的联想记忆是无序多体系统中的吸引子动力学，而高阶扩展和指数扩展则将其检索更新转化为 softmax 注意力。多项式和指数区域一直采用不同方法进行分析，因此尚不存在一个共同架构来研究究竟是什么决定了存储规模。在本文中，我们研究 Krotov 和 Hopfield 提出的二部架构，并将其称为 H 类模型；该模型由为每一层指定的拉格朗日量决定，并将隐藏神经元作为检索的序参量。在多项式负载下，复制方法给出了复制对称相图和闭式存储容量；交叉干扰矩对于伊辛型和球型可见神经元是相同的，因此二者的差异来自可见层熵。对于 softmax 隐藏层，负载是指数级的，而一种复制表示将热力学映射为随机能量模型的计数问题，其中存在顺磁相、凝聚相和冻结相。升温会通过注意力的量子化重新分配使检索失稳，而典型的高斯模式在任意负载下仍保持亚稳态。这些区域在交叉干扰统计方面有所不同：多项式负载下呈中心极限定理型统计，指数负载下则呈大偏差型统计；H 类模型将检索分为两个角色，可见层拉格朗日量决定稳定性，隐藏层拉格朗日量决定存储规模，这两个轴也可能为新拉格朗日量的设计提供指导。

articles.title: Influence of magnetic fields on the performance of spin-orbit torque magnetic random-access memory
articles.title_zh: 磁场对自旋轨道力矩磁随机存取存储器性能的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11397v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spin-orbit torque magnetic random-access memory (SOT-MRAM) offers high speed, ultrahigh endurance, and compatibility with advanced semiconductor processes, making it a promising candidate for next-generation nonvolatile memory. However, intrinsic bias fields in magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs), originating from reference-layer stray fields and interlayer coupling, cause asymmetric critical switching currents and increased energy consumption. Existing compensation approaches usually introduce additional magnetic layers into the MTJ stack, which increases fabrication complexity and limits wafer-scale integration. Here, we propose a bias-compensation strategy without modifying the MTJ stack by engineering local stray magnetic fields through magnetic filling materials in vertical interconnect access (VIA) channels during the back-end-of-line process. Micromagnetic simulations show that the proposed magnetic filling layer can provide the required auxiliary field for deterministic switching and significantly suppress write-current asymmetry. By optimizing the MTJ position relative to the magnetic filling structure, the write-current bias ratio is reduced from 21.6% in the conventional design to 1.3%. The approach is also applicable to in-plane magnetic anisotropy SOT-MTJs, reducing the bias ratio from 19.8% to -0.2%. Scaling analysis further demonstrates that the compensation effect remains effective when the device size is reduced to 20% of the original dimension (MTJ diameter approximately 10 nm), indicating its potential for high-density SOT-MRAM integration.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋轨道力矩磁随机存取存储器具有高速、超高耐久性和先进半导体工艺兼容性，但磁隧道结中的内禀偏置场会造成临界切换电流不对称并增加能耗。本文提出一种无需修改磁隧道结堆栈的补偿策略，通过在后端工艺的垂直互连通道中引入磁性填充材料来工程化局部杂散磁场。模拟表明，该方法可显著降低写入电流偏置，并在器件缩小至约 10 nm 直径时仍保持有效。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道力矩磁随机存取存储器（SOT-MRAM）具有高速、超高耐久性以及与先进半导体工艺兼容等优点，是下一代非易失性存储器的有力候选。然而，磁隧道结（MTJ）中的内禀偏置场源自参考层杂散场和层间耦合，会导致不对称的临界切换电流并增加能耗。现有的补偿方法通常需要在 MTJ 堆栈中加入额外磁性层，这会增加制造复杂度并限制晶圆级集成。在此，我们提出一种无需修改 MTJ 堆栈的偏置补偿策略：在后端工艺过程中，利用垂直互连通道（VIA）中的磁性填充材料对局部杂散磁场进行工程设计。微磁模拟表明，所提出的磁性填充层能够提供确定性切换所需的辅助磁场，并显著抑制写入电流不对称性。通过优化 MTJ 相对于磁性填充结构的位置，写入电流偏置比可由传统设计中的 21.6% 降至 1.3%。该方法同样适用于面内磁各向异性的 SOT-MTJ，可将偏置比从 19.8% 降至 -0.2%。缩放分析进一步表明，当器件尺寸缩小至原始尺寸的 20%（MTJ 直径约为 10 nm）时，补偿效果仍然有效，显示出其用于高密度 SOT-MRAM 集成的潜力。

articles.title: Gauss Law, Monodromy Defect, Magnetic Lattice Translation, and Lattice Duality
articles.title_zh: 高斯定律、单值化缺陷、磁性晶格平移与晶格对偶性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11417v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In a Hamiltonian lattice gauge theory, the physical Hilbert space is fixed by the Gauss law, by choosing an eigenspace of the Gauss law operator which generates the gauge transformation. Choosing a non-trivial eigenspace is referred to as the modified Gauss law. In 2+1d dynamical U(1) pure gauge theory, we show that these physical Hilbert spaces are defect Hilbert spaces associated with non-topological monodromy defects for monopole operators and topological defects for U(1) 1-form symmetry, inserted along the time direction. We also construct the corresponding lattice translation operators. Under a nontrivially modified Gauss law, these translations obey a magnetic translation algebra. Finally, we discuss how the modified Gauss laws are manifested in 2+1d compact bosons, via exact duality on the lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究哈密顿晶格规范理论中非平凡高斯定律扇区的物理含义。在二维空间加一维时间的动力学 U(1) 纯规范理论中，这些物理希尔伯特空间可解释为沿时间方向插入的、与单极子算符和 U(1) 一形式对称性缺陷相关的缺陷希尔伯特空间。作者还构造了相应的晶格平移算符，发现修正高斯定律下它们满足磁性平移代数，并通过晶格对偶性讨论其在二维紧致玻色子中的表现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在哈密顿晶格规范理论中，物理希尔伯特空间由高斯定律确定，即选择由生成规范变换的高斯定律算符所定义的某个本征子空间。选择非平凡的本征子空间被称为修正高斯定律。在二维空间加一维时间的动力学 U(1) 纯规范理论中，我们证明这些物理希尔伯特空间是与缺陷希尔伯特空间相对应的空间：其中沿时间方向插入了与单极子算符相关的非拓扑单值化缺陷，以及与 U(1) 一形式对称性相关的拓扑缺陷。我们还构造了相应的晶格平移算符。在非平凡修正高斯定律下，这些平移算符满足磁性平移代数。最后，我们通过晶格上的精确对偶性讨论修正高斯定律如何在二维紧致玻色子中体现。

articles.title: Breaking Water at Graphene Defects
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯缺陷处的水解离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11602v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Water dissociation at solid surfaces underpins processes ranging from corrosion and catalysis to electrochemistry and photovoltaics. Defects often serve as reactive sites for dissociation, yet how solvation influences water dissociation at such sites remains poorly understood. Here, we use state-of-the-art machine-learned interatomic potentials to explore water dissociation at defective graphene-water interfaces. We show that solvation qualitatively changes the reaction mechanism at a graphene single vacancy (SV), opening pathways that are absent for an isolated water molecule. Whereas the gas-phase process proceeds via a single concerted channel, the solvated SV splits water through two competing pathways: a basic route forming SV-H and OH-(aq), and an acidic route forming SV-OH and H3O+(aq). These lower-barrier pathways produce distinct chemisorbed intermediates that enhance graphene-water adsorption. Accordingly, even a simple carbon vacancy gives rise to unexpectedly rich interfacial chemistry, coupling surface chemistry to interfacial charge and wettability, with implications for carbon functionalization and nanofluidic transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 固体表面的水解离对腐蚀、催化、电化学和光伏等过程具有基础作用，但溶剂化如何影响缺陷位点处的解离仍不清楚。本文利用机器学习原子间势研究缺陷石墨烯—水界面，发现溶剂化会定性改变单空位处的反应机制。溶剂化体系存在形成 SV-H 与水相 OH− 的碱性路径，以及形成 SV-OH 与水合 H3O+ 的酸性路径，这些低势垒通道揭示了丰富的界面化学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固体表面的水解离支撑着从腐蚀和催化到电化学与光伏等一系列过程。缺陷通常充当解离反应的活性位点，但人们对于溶剂化如何影响这些位点处的水解离仍缺乏充分理解。在此，我们利用最先进的机器学习原子间势，研究缺陷石墨烯—水界面上的水解离。我们表明，在石墨烯单空位（SV）处，溶剂化会定性改变反应机制，并开启孤立水分子所不存在的反应路径。气相过程沿单一协同通道进行，而溶剂化的 SV 则通过两条相互竞争的路径分解水：一条是形成 SV-H 和水相 OH− 的碱性路径，另一条是形成 SV-OH 和水合 H3O+ 的酸性路径。这些较低势垒的路径产生不同的化学吸附中间体，从而增强石墨烯—水吸附。因此，即使是简单的碳空位也会产生出乎意料的丰富界面化学，将表面化学与界面电荷和润湿性联系起来，并对碳功能化和纳米流体输运具有启示意义。

articles.title: Nonlinear dynamics and mechanical frequency combs with a Meissner-levitated micromagnet
articles.title_zh: 磁悬浮迈斯纳微磁体中的非线性动力学与机械频率梳
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11668v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nonlinearities in multimode mechanical systems can give rise to rich dynamical phenomena with great potential for sensing applications and for future quantum experiments. We demonstrate that the coupled center-of-mass and rotational motion of a Meissner-levitated micromagnet offer a promising platform for nonlinear dynamics, combining low dissipation, magnetic tunability, strong intrinsic Duffing nonlinearities, and nonlinear intermodal couplings. We use this tunability to demonstrate the generation of a mechanical frequency comb in the micromagnet dynamics, realized by parametric excitation of two translational modes followed by cascaded nonlinear frequency mixing, which produces a phononic comb with tunable spacing. At large amplitudes, nonlinear coupling to a low-frequency librational mode of the magnet leads to parametric excitation and phase locking of that mode, generating a dense spectral fine structure at subharmonics of the drive. These results establish levitated micromagnets as a platform for nonlinear multimode mechanics, with potential applications in precision sensing and quantum-limited metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了迈斯纳悬浮微磁体作为非线性多模力学平台的潜力，其质心平移和转动运动具有低耗散、磁调谐性、强本征杜芬非线性及非线性模间耦合。通过对两个平移模进行参量激发并诱导级联非线性频率混合，作者实现了间距可调的机械频率梳。在较大振幅下，低频摆动模还会发生参量激发和相位锁定，从而产生驱动频率子谐波处的致密谱精细结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多模机械系统中的非线性能够产生丰富的动力学现象，并在传感应用和未来量子实验中展现出巨大潜力。我们证明，迈斯纳悬浮微磁体的质心运动与转动运动相耦合，为研究非线性动力学提供了一个有前景的平台；该平台兼具低耗散、磁调谐性、强本征杜芬非线性以及非线性模间耦合。我们利用这种可调谐性，在微磁体动力学中实现了机械频率梳：首先对两个平移模进行参量激发，随后通过级联非线性频率混合产生间距可调的声子频率梳。在大振幅下，与磁体低频摆动模的非线性耦合会导致该模发生参量激发和相位锁定，并在驱动频率的子谐波处生成致密的谱精细结构。这些结果确立了悬浮微磁体作为非线性多模力学平台的地位，并显示出其在精密传感和量子极限计量中的潜在应用。

articles.title: Learning structural balance of graphs from quantum spectral features
articles.title_zh: 从量子谱特征中学习图的结构平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11736v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a quantum approach to spectral feature extraction from the density of states (DOS) of a problem-dependent Hamiltonian, and apply it to machine learning on signed graphs. We propose to embed a signed graph as an Ising model instance with positive and negative interactions, and use the standardized moments of the Ising DOS as features for learning. We show that these moments count signed closed walks, are switching-invariant, and are size-free by construction. As a benchmark, we target learning the frustration index, an NP-hard measure of structural balance that can be labeled exactly at moderate size. At zero field, the models can be sampled classically, allowing the quantum extraction procedure to be certified against exact ground truth. We propose DOS-QPE, a phase estimation on a purified maximally mixed probe, which samples the spectral density with orders of magnitude fewer shots than Hadamard test-based trace sampling and feeds the resulting features directly into classically trained models. On 1.4×10⁵ labeled graphs the exact DOS determines the frustration index, and five moments recover it with a mean error of 0.4, well below one sign flip. Beyond zero field, the underlying trace-estimation problem is DQC1-complete, providing access to spectral features for which no efficient classical sampling method is known. Our work opens routes towards quantum applications in social network balance analysis, spin-glass studies, correlation clustering, and protein-interaction networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种从依赖具体问题的哈密顿量态密度中提取谱特征的量子方法，并将其用于带符号图的机器学习。作者把带符号图嵌入为具有正负相互作用的伊辛模型，并使用伊辛态密度的标准化矩作为特征，这些矩能够计数带符号闭游走且对切换不变。针对结构平衡的 NP 困难挫折指数，数值实验表明精确态密度能够确定该指数，仅使用五个矩也能获得低于一次符号翻转的平均误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一种从依赖具体问题的哈密顿量态密度（DOS）中提取谱特征的量子方法，并将其应用于带符号图的机器学习。我们提出将带符号图嵌入为一个具有正、负相互作用的伊辛模型实例，并使用伊辛态密度的标准化矩作为学习特征。我们证明，这些矩能够计数带符号闭游走，具有切换不变性，并且在构造上与系统规模无关。作为基准任务，我们选择学习挫折指数，这是结构平衡的一个 NP 困难度量，在中等规模下可以精确标注。在零外场下，可以对这些模型进行经典采样，因此能够用精确基准真值验证量子特征提取过程。我们提出 DOS-QPE，即在纯化的最大混合探针上执行相位估计；与基于 Hadamard 测试的迹采样相比，该方法用少几个数量级的测量次数就能对谱密度进行采样，并将所得特征直接输入经典训练模型。在 1.4×10⁵ 个带标签图上，精确 DOS 可以确定挫折指数，而五个矩就能以 0.4 的平均误差恢复该指数，显著低于一次符号翻转。超越零外场情形后，底层的迹估计问题属于 DQC1 完备问题，从而能够获得目前尚无已知高效经典采样方法的谱特征。我们的工作为量子方法在社交网络平衡分析、自旋玻璃研究、相关聚类以及蛋白质相互作用网络中的应用开辟了路径。

articles.title: Computational framework for quantum state tomography of spin ensembles
articles.title_zh: 自旋系综量子态层析的计算框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11868v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present Tomography-NMR, an open-source Python package that reconstructs quantum density matrices from spectroscopic measurement data. The package implements a complete analysis pipeline for two-qubit quantum state tomography based on the product operator formalism: raw time-domain signals are Fourier-transformed into frequency-domain spectra, spectral peak intensities are mapped to expansion coefficients of the density matrix, and the full quantum state is reconstructed. Three integration methods are provided for different use cases: direct peak height measurement and fixed-parameter numerical integration require no theoretical reference and are suited to unknown states, achieving fidelities of approximately 98% on a benchmark set of known states, while a systematic parameter optimization against a known target state achieves reconstruction fidelities exceeding 99% for the same benchmark states. While the detailed theoretical framework for quantum state tomography is well established, the practical procedures for extracting density matrices from experimental spectra are often inadequately documented in the literature and obscured within proprietary software. This package addresses that gap by providing a fully transparent, reproducible implementation of every analysis step, from spectral preprocessing to density matrix visualization. The software has been validated on experimentally prepared two-qubit states measured via nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy of coupled ³¹P nuclei. Average reconstruction fidelities range from 0.975 to 0.995 across a benchmark set of 20 two-qubit states, including the computational basis states, Bell states, and the outputs of three fundamental quantum gates (CNOT, H, and T). Although developed for NMR, the modular architecture facilitates adaptation to other spectroscopic platforms and alternative measurement protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍开源 Python 软件包 Tomography-NMR，用于从光谱测量数据重构量子密度矩阵。该软件基于乘积算符形式，为双量子比特量子态层析提供从时域信号傅里叶变换、谱峰强度映射到密度矩阵重构的完整流程。针对实验制备的两个耦合磷-31 核量子态，软件在包括计算基态、Bell 态及多个量子门输出态的基准集上实现了约 0.975 至 0.995 的平均重构保真度，并具有向其他光谱平台扩展的模块化结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了 Tomography-NMR，这是一个开源 Python 软件包，用于从光谱测量数据重构量子密度矩阵。该软件基于乘积算符形式，实现了完整的双量子比特量子态层析分析流程：首先将原始时域信号进行傅里叶变换得到频域谱，然后将谱峰强度映射为密度矩阵展开式的系数，最后重构完整的量子态。软件提供三种适用于不同场景的积分方法：直接测量谱峰高度，以及固定参数的数值积分，这两种方法都不需要理论参考，适用于未知量子态，并在一组已知态基准数据上实现了约 98% 的保真度；另一种是针对已知目标态进行系统参数优化，在同一组基准态上实现了超过 99% 的重构保真度。尽管量子态层析的详细理论框架已经得到充分建立，但从实验谱图中提取密度矩阵的实际操作流程在文献中往往记录不足，并且隐藏在专有软件之中。该软件包通过提供从谱预处理到密度矩阵可视化的每一个分析步骤，弥补了这一缺口，并实现了完全透明且可复现的流程。该软件已经在实验制备的双量子比特量子态上得到验证，这些量子态通过耦合 ³¹P 原子的核磁共振（NMR）光谱进行测量。在包括计算基态、Bell 态以及三个基本量子门（CNOT、H 和 T）的输出态在内的 20 个双量子比特态基准集上，平均重构保真度介于 0.975 和 0.995 之间。尽管该软件最初是为 NMR 开发的，其模块化架构也便于将其适配到其他光谱平台和替代测量协议。

articles.title: Fluctuation-dissipation of the Kuramoto model on fruit-fly connectomes
articles.title_zh: 果蝇连接组上 Kuramoto 模型的涨落—耗散关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.20708v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the distance from equilibrium using the Kuramoto model via the degree of fluctuation-dissipation violation as the consequence of different levels of edge weight anisotropies. This is achieved by solving the synchronization equations on the raw, homeostatic weighted and a random inhibitory edge variant of a real full fly (FF) connectome, containing simeq 10⁵ neuron cell nodes. We investigate these systems close to their synchronization transition critical points. While the topological(graph) dimension is high: d simeq 6 the spectral dimensions of the variants, relevant in describing the synchronization behavior, are lower than the upper critical dimension: dₛ simeq 2 < d_c=5, suggesting relevant fluctuation effects and non mean-field scaling behavior. By measuring the auto-correlations and the auto-response functions for small perturbations we calculate the fluctuation-dissipation ratios (FDR) for the different variants of different anisotropy levels of the FF connectome. Numerical evidence is presented that the FDRs follow the level of anisotropy of these non-equilibrium systems in agreement with the expectations, with increasing temporal oscillations. Numerical values for the aging exponents provide confirmation for the predictions of the generalized time-translational-invariance theory. We compare the non-reciprocal connectome results with those on a symmetric ErdH os-Rényi random graph of similar size and provide estimates for the Kuramoto model aging behavior. We also present a network analysis of the FF connectome and calculate the level of hierarchy, also related to the anisotropy. Finally, we provide some partial results for the periodically forced Shinomoto-Kuramoto model describing fluctuations in the non-resting state. We provide numerical evidence that fluctuations are maximal in the resting state of the critical brain.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过涨落—耗散关系违背程度研究 Kuramoto 模型偏离平衡的程度，并考察边权各向异性对这一偏离的影响。作者在包含约 10⁵ 个神经元节点的完整果蝇连接组及其稳态化加权和随机抑制性边变体上，研究同步转变临界点附近的涨落—耗散比。数值结果表明，涨落—耗散比随非平衡系统的各向异性增强而变化，并支持广义时间平移不变性理论关于老化行为的预言；结果还显示临界静息态中的涨落最大。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用涨落—耗散关系违背的程度所体现的涨落—耗散比，研究 Kuramoto 模型偏离平衡的距离，并将其视为不同边权各向异性水平的结果。为此，我们在一个真实的完整果蝇（FF）连接组、其原始加权形式、稳态化加权形式以及随机抑制性边变体上求解同步方程；该连接组包含约 10⁵ 个神经元细胞节点。我们研究了这些系统在其同步转变临界点附近的行为。尽管拓扑（图）维数很高，约为 d ≃ 6，但这些变体的谱维数较低，约为 dₛ ≃ 2，小于上临界维数 d_c = 5；这表明涨落效应具有重要作用，并且系统可能表现出非平均场标度行为。通过测量小扰动下的自相关函数和自响应函数，我们计算了不同各向异性水平的 FF 连接组变体的涨落—耗散比（FDR）。数值证据表明，FDR 随这些非平衡系统的各向异性水平变化，并伴随增强的时间振荡，这与预期一致。老化指数的数值结果证实了广义时间平移不变性理论的预言。我们将非互易连接组的结果与规模相近的对称 Erdős–Rényi 随机图结果进行比较，并给出了 Kuramoto 模型老化行为的估计。我们还对 FF 连接组进行了网络分析，计算了与各向异性相关的层级性水平。最后，我们给出了周期驱动的 Shinomoto–Kuramoto 模型的一些部分结果，该模型描述非静息状态下的涨落。我们提供了数值证据，表明在临界大脑的静息状态中涨落达到最大。

articles.title: Max Cut graph driven quantum circuit design for geometrically frustrated planar spin systems with spin glass like energy landscapes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.12096v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Finding the ground state of geometrically frustrated spin systems is a challenging problem with broad implications. Many hard optimization problems, including NP-complete problems, can be mapped, for instance, to frustrated Ising models, where competing interactions produce rugged, spin glass like energy landscapes. The difficulty is particularly pronounced in the weak-field regime, where geometrical frustration dominates, and the spectral gap becomes exponentially small, making it hard to identify the true ground state. In this work, we consider planar frustrated lattices constructed from the triangular motif, the minimal unit of geometrical frustration. We present a graph-based approach that allows for accurate state initialization of a frustrated triangular spin lattice with up to 20 sites while avoiding barren plateaus. To optimize circuit efficiency and trainability, we employ a clustering strategy that organizes qubits into distinct groups based on the maximum cut technique, which divides the lattice into two maximally disconnected subsets. We provide evidence that this Max Cut based lattice division offers a robust framework for optimizing circuit design and effectively modeling frustrated systems at polynomial cost. All simulations are performed within the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) formalism, the current paradigm for noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices, but can be extended beyond. Our results underscore the potential of hybrid quantum classical methods in addressing complex optimization problems.

articles.title: Machine learning topological defect formation: When are the defects made?
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.20347v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological defects that form in a nonequilibrium second-order phase transition are presumably seeded by fluctuations of the order parameter in the vicinity of the critical point. Motivated by this conjecture that underlies the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM), we investigate whether machine learning (ML) can anticipate their locations from the fluctuations in the ``impulse regime'', the time interval when the evolution of the order parameter cannot keep up with the conditions imposed by the quench. Going beyond the conventional KZM focus on defect density, we show that a recurrent neural network can predict locations of topological defects from short-time dynamical data deep within the impulse regime. We thus demonstrate that defects are sown in the immediate vicinity of the critical point. The seeds of defects, fluctuations imprinted on the evolving order parameter, are exponentially small near the critical point, but become amplified by the evolution and play a dominant role in breaking symmetry. This is before the freezeout time that concludes the impulse regime, and well before the order parameter assumes its final symmetry-broken configuration. Furthermore, we find that the predictive power of the ML also exhibits power-law scaling consistent with KZM.
articles.focus_summary: 该工作研究非平衡二阶相变过程中拓扑缺陷的形成时间和位置，利用循环神经网络从淬火动力学数据中预测拓扑缺陷的位置。结果表明，缺陷种子在临界点附近的冲激区间已经形成，随后被动力学演化放大并主导最终对称性破缺。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习、相变动力学、拓扑缺陷和畴结构研究存在方法与问题层面的联系，但其重点是普适的非平衡相变模型，并非具体材料体系。其利用神经网络预测缺陷形成位置的思路可迁移到铁电畴壁、磁性斯格明子和缺陷成核研究。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可将类似时序预测方法应用于铁电或磁性材料的分子动力学轨迹，预测畴壁、涡旋和斯格明子成核位置。进一步结合物理约束或等变神经网络，有助于提升模型在不同尺寸、淬火速率和材料体系中的泛化能力。

articles.title: Octupole-driven spin torque switching of antiferromagnetic tunnel junctions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.03026v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) based on ferromagnets are canonical devices in spintronics, with wide-ranging applications in data storage, computing, and sensing. They simultaneously exhibit mechanisms for electrical detection and control of magnetic order through the tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR) and spin-transfer torque (STT) effects, respectively. It was long assumed that neither of these effects could be sizeable in all-antiferromagnetic tunnel junctions (AATJs), since they exhibit no net magnetization. Recently, however, it was shown that AATJs based on chiral antiferromagnets do exhibit TMR due to their non-relativistic momentum-dependent spin polarization and cluster magnetic octupole moment (CMO), which are manifestations of their spin-split band structure. However, the reciprocal effect, i.e., the antiferromagnetic counterpart of STT, has been assumed non-existent due to the total electric current being spin-neutral. Here, we report nanoscale AATJs exhibiting this reciprocal effect, which we term octupole-driven spin-transfer torque (OTT).
