Nonlinear wave interactions arise at the same asymptotic order as the two-way coupling and must therefore be included in the derivation. The resulting model consists of a nonlinear version of the reduced wave equation obtained in part I, coupled to a Craik-Leibovich equation governing the evolution of the background flow. The model describes the evolution of the wave field and background flow over the slow turnover frequency of the background flow, thus saving the computational burden of temporally resolving the fast wave frequency. The inviscid model exactly conserves wave action, mechanical energy and horizontal momentum, while the viscous model exactly conserves horizontal momentum. The coupling terms are cast in compact form for ease of physical interpretation and numerical implementation.

articles.title: Impact of Raman lasers beam profile inhomogeneities on a spaceborne quantum accelerometer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the study of the impact of laser beam profile inhomogeneities on the acceleration measurements of a quantum accelerometer in space. This sensor uses a low ballistic expansion source based on delta-kick collimated Bose-Einstein condensates, and an interferometer configuration based on a sequence of Raman double diffraction beamsplitters, best suited to the microgravity environment. We characterize both phase and intensity fluctuations in terms of power spectral densities and calculate their impact on the interferometer phase, averaging over all trajectories of the atoms, via numerical simulations based on randomly drawn laser profiles as well as via analytical treatments. We show that high quality optics, such as those realized for gravitational wave detectors, combined with large initial size atomic sources, will allow to reduce interferometer phase bias and fluctuations to the order of 1 mrad corresponding to accelerations in the low 10 -12 m.s -2 range.

articles.title: Designing metallo-dielectric antennas for cryogenic applications
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the design of cryogenic metallo-dielectric antennas tailored to single organic emitters, where the choice of host material imposes specific constraints on the antenna geometry. Using dibenzoterrylene (DBT) in para-dichlorobenzene (p-DCB}) as a model system, we show that photon collection efficiencies exceeding 90% can be achieved for arbitrary dipole orientations of the fluorescent molecule. The antenna design is intrinsically broadband and tolerant to emitter positioning within the structure. We further provide concrete fabrication guidelines for the full antenna architecture, and experimentally demonstrate its operating principle by recording a back-focal-plane image (BFP) of a single molecule inside a fabricated antenna.

articles.title: Coupling periodic-cell and finite-bunch dynamics for structured photocathodes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Patterning a photocathode with submicrometre features can enhance nonlinear photoemission by concentrating the optical field, but the surface geometry can also increase the transverse momentum spread of the emitted electrons. Resolving nanoscale surface fields across an injector-scale illuminated area within a full rf gun simulation is computationally demanding. To couple these scales, we developed an approach which combines a self-consistent finite flat-cathode calculation with the particle-resolved difference between matched structured and flat periodic calculations. The finite calculation determines the macroscopic bunch evolution and space-charge field. The periodic difference determines the local change caused by the surface. For a finite but relatively small test problem, comparison with a fully resolved finite-array WarpX calculation gives differences of 1.3% in rms energy spread and less than 0.1% in projected normalized emittance. We then apply the method to representative FEL photoinjector parameters with a 100 pC emitted source distributed over more than half a million periods, and track the composed bunch through an L-band rf gun and solenoid. The initial difference between the projected horizontal and vertical emittances becomes much smaller after rf acceleration and solenoid focusing. At 1.52 m downstream of the cathode, the projected emittances are nearly equal and exceed those of the matched flat-cathode reference by less than 2% in both planes. The central-slice emittances exceed the reference values by approximately 3% horizontally and 5% vertically.

articles.title: On-chip squeezed light in the audio frequency band
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Squeezed light in the audio-frequency band is a key resource for quantum metrology and quantum sensing. However, realizing stable audio-frequency squeezed light on integrated photonic platforms remains challenging due to technical noise and the difficulty of scalable phase referencing. Here, we demonstrate on-chip generation of audio-band two-mode squeezed states down to 60 Hz in a silica microcavity. To enable phase-stable operation without directly locking fragile quantum modes, we develop a coherent-comb control method in which a weak electro-optic reference comb co-propagates with the vacuum at the quantum frequency modes in an orthogonal polarization. This scheme provides quadrature measurement and long-timescale phase stability, thereby enabling covariance-matrix reconstruction. We verify the entanglement with the positive partial transposition criterion, which confirms inseparability via a minimum symplectic eigenvalue of 0.395 (<0.5). Our results establish an experimentally accessible route toward on-chip phase-stable audio-band squeezing and support the scalable framework for continuous-variable quantum information processing with integrated photonics.

articles.title: The Quantum Plumber's Problem
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11416v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent work quantified the notion of quantum counterfactual gain for an extended Elitzur-Vaidman bomb test style scenario, through a connection to the negativity of the Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability distribution. We here extend this work to identifying quantum advantage in a new scenario, which we term the ``Quantum Plumber's Problem''. In this scenario, we imagine a ``quantum plumber'', who knows that one path of an interferometer is blocked, and wants to find the optimal strategy for identifying with certainty which path this is. We discuss various strategies for a generalised path-encoded interferometer, as well as for the specific case of Hofmann's three-path interferometer, introduced in a recent analysis of the relationship between states in five measurement contexts of a three level system. We support our arguments on the relative merit of competing strategies with data collected over many simulated attempts at locating blockages. We also present results for a variant of the game in which the blockage is replaced by a non-demolition detector.

articles.title: Multi-Threshold Sampling: Signal Space, Sampling Operators, and Crossing-Time Distributions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11610v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-threshold (MT) sampling records crossing times at selected thresholds for parameter estimation and waveform reconstruction. For suitable high-speed signals, it can reduce data volume, hardware cost, and power consumption compared with high-rate uniform time-domain sampling. Applications in nuclear science include positron emission tomography, oil well logging, and photon-counting X-ray imaging. However, its theoretical foundations require further development to support performance evaluation and system design. A necessary first step is to rigorously define the signal space and sampling operators, but a general mathematical framework for this purpose is still needed. We propose a unified mathematical framework that maps the signal distribution to the distribution of recorded crossings through the sampling operators. It provides a common description of how mismatch and noise in signals and thresholds, time quantization, and selection shape the recorded data, enabling their individual and combined effects to be analyzed. For nonhomogeneous Poisson photon arrivals and deterministic MT sampling, the framework yields the exact distribution of the first recorded crossing time at a specified threshold within a given recorded-time interval. Predictions for a scintillation pulse model agree with independent Monte Carlo simulations, demonstrating the framework's predictive capability. The framework lays the groundwork for determining the fundamental performance limits of MT sampling and designing systems that approach those limits.

articles.title: Bayesian Superiority in On/Off analysis
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11683v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a detailed comparison of Bayesian criteria with three non-informative priors - flat, Jeffreys, and scale-invariant - for testing a signal against an unknown background and compare them with the classical frequentist Li-Ma approach in the On/Off problem. We perform Monte Carlo simulations for various background levels and evaluate the Li-Ma and Bayesian criteria by their Type I error rates. We then simulate a nonzero signal and compare the criteria in terms of Type II error rates. We find that the Bayesian criterion with the Jeffreys prior yields lower Type I and Type II error rates than the Li-Ma criterion. In addition, we show that the Bayesian criteria are more robust than the Li-Ma criterion when the background distribution is overdispersed relative to the Poisson distribution.

articles.title: A Geometric Reinitialization for Conservative Level-Set Methods in the Context of Capillary Flows
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.00275v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulations of immiscible two-phase flows involving surface tension (ST) require a robust high-fidelity framework. State-of-the-art multi-phase models, such as the Conservative Level-Set (CLS) approach, use Eulerian representations of the fluids and their interface, and require reinitialization methods to ensure volume conservation and accurate ST force modeling. This work proposes a new geometric reinitialization strategy for CLS formulations as an alternative to the typical PDE-based reinitialization methods. Building on the geometric reinitialization developed in context of level-set frameworks, the proposed method is an extension to the CLS approach within an open-source finite element framework that allows for fully distributed and adaptively refined, two- and three-dimensional meshes. This extension enables application of the geometric reinitialization method to large-scale three-dimensional problems with strongly deforming interfaces, including breakup. The method is quantitatively compared to two established reinitialization approaches: the PDE-based reinitialization proposed in the original CLS method and a simple projection-based approach. The assessment comprises three 3D application cases of increasing complexity: the capillary migration of a droplet, the rise of a bubble, and the Rayleigh-Plateau instability development in a capillary jet. The geometric method leads to high-quality, spatially-converged results in good agreement with benchmark and reference solutions. It robustly and accurately recovers expected interface topology-based metrics (e.g., the volume, surface area and sphericity), and relevant flow quantities. In addition, the proposed method has only two parameters and is robust across parameter choices and cases.

articles.title: Quantum Systems as Indivisible Stochastic Processes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.21192v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: According to the stochastic--quantum correspondence, a quantum system can be understood as a stochastic process unfolding in an old-fashioned configuration space based on ordinary notions of probability and `indivisible' stochastic laws, which are a non-Markovian generalization of the laws that describe a textbook stochastic process. The Hilbert spaces of quantum theory and their ingredients, including wave functions, can then be relegated to secondary roles as convenient mathematical appurtenances. In addition to providing an arguably more transparent way to understand and modify quantum theory, this indivisible-stochastic formulation may lead to new possible applications of the theory. This paper initiates a deeper investigation into the conceptual foundations and structure of the stochastic--quantum correspondence, with a particular focus on novel forms of gauge invariance, dynamical symmetries, and Hilbert-space dilations.

articles.title: A Deflationary Account of Quantum Theory and its Implications for the Complex Numbers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.01043v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Why does quantum theory need the complex numbers? With a view toward answering this question, I argue that the usual Hilbert-space formalism is a special case of the general method of Markovian embeddings. I then describe the `indivisible interpretation' of quantum theory, according to which a quantum system can be regarded as an `indivisible' stochastic process unfolding in an old-fashioned configuration space, with wave functions and other exotic Hilbert-space ingredients demoted from having an ontological status. The complex numbers end up being necessary to ensure that the Hilbert-space formalism is indeed a Markovian embedding.

articles.title: Degree-based weighted adjacency matrices: spectra, integrality, and edge deletion effects
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.08895v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study degree-based weighted adjacency matrices associated with symmetric edge-weight functions φ(dᵤ,dᵥ), with emphasis on complete multipartite graphs and spectral changes caused by edge modification. We characterize its families with three distinct eigenvalues and identifies integral matrices. For complete graphs, an exact threshold is obtained that determines whether deleting one edge increases, preserves, or decreases both the spectral radius and the weighted energy; the generalized Randić family is classified completely, thereby correcting and refining earlier published results in [Bilal and Munir, Int. J. Quantum Chem. (2024)]. We further determine the ISI spectrum under edge deletion from regular complete multipartite graphs, derive the complete weighted spectrum, energy, and inertia of crown multipartite graphs, and prove that adding an edge between two leaves of Sₙ strictly increases its ISI energy.

articles.title: When More Is Not Better: Component Anti-Synergy in a P300 Speller
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: P300 brain-computer interface (BCI) spellers can provide hands-free communication for people with severe motor impairments. Modern pipelines combine multiple individually promising components, often assuming that 'more-is-better'. We tested this assumption using a four-component full-factorial experiment varying the inclusion of Euclidean Alignment (EA), xDAWN spatial filtering, subject calibration, and language model priors on a public P300 dataset. Performance was evaluated using accuracy, repetitions, and information transfer rate (ITR) with mixed-effects models. Results show that the value of components is conditional rather than additive. Calibration was the strongest singular contributor, while EA compensated for its absence in zero-calibration settings. Adding independently useful components could also reduce performance, revealing component anti-synergy. Contrary to conventional wisdom, LM support was not universally beneficial: its effect depends strongly on the strength of the underlying EEG pipeline, while results from a larger LM showed a similar pattern. Together, these findings challenge maximal 'all-on' pipeline design and highlight the value of selecting spatial and language-support components according to the quality of available EEG evidence.

articles.title: Phase-Decoupled, Model-Calibrated Power Control for Disaggregated LLM Serving
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Datacenter GPU power is the binding constraint on LLM serving capacity, and production serving has shifted to prefill/decode (PD) disaggregation. Deploying NVIDIA's Max-Q inference profile on a disaggregated B200 system, we found its realized gain modest (+8.6% tokens/J), model-dependent, and carrying a mean end-to-end latency cost (+5.2%) that throughput-only evaluation does not surface; the profile also applies one setting to prefill and decode GPUs that operate in opposite hardware regimes. We hypothesize that the optimal power setting is a property of the deployed (model, quantization, engine, hardware) combination rather than of the GPU class, that each lane warrants its own profile, and that converting SLO headroom into energy safely requires latency-gated calibration under a runtime SLO guard rather than a fixed recipe. We present a phase-decoupled, model-calibrated controller: the prefill lane runs under an SM-clock window whose floor is a latency guarantee by construction, and the decode lane under a power cap placed by automatic calibration just above a measured throughput/latency cliff. Because a disaggregated decode lane draws flat, memory-bound power, the cap binds continuously, the reactive-overshoot weakness that led POLCA to reject capping is absent, and the GPU's own power manager retains throughput under the cap. On an 8x B200 node serving Qwen3-Coder-480B (FP8) under agentic load, our balanced mode delivers +20.4% tokens/J at +3.5% mean e2e versus +8.6% at +5.2% for Max-Q, a Pareto improvement on both axes. On Qwen3-235B-A22B (NVFP4) every operating mode meets the ITL-p99 SLO in every repetition; both vendor profiles miss it. A decode-actuator A/B shows the calibrated cap beats static clock locks, and a three-day sustained run saves 32.3% of a lane pair's electricity. Both models are MoE; a dense model recovers roughly 5x less, so we scope our claims to MoE serving.

articles.title: REVA: Reusable Evidence View Aggregation for Context-Efficient RAG Serving
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.11209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves knowledge-intensive large language model (LLM) applications by conditioning generation on retrieved documents, but longer contexts increase latency, key-value (KV) cache memory, and token cost. Post-retrieval compression can reduce this cost, yet existing compressors often operate independently for each query, rely on auxiliary models or rewriting, and introduce online overhead that can offset the benefit of shorter prompts. We revisit RAG compression from a data-mining perspective by aggregating historical query--document--model interactions into reusable evidence views. We first show that modern compressors have unstable gains over simple truncation and can add substantial inference-time latency. We then propose Reusable Evidence View Aggregation (REVA), a framework that mines the target generator's historical attention traces into a document-keyed, budget-agnostic score store. REVA maps token-level attention to readable word units, aggregates importance across repeated document accesses, and renders budget-specific plain-text views that preserve document order and the standard RAG interface. Across four representative benchmarks and modern LLMs, REVA improves generation quality by 1.0--5.8 points over existing advances, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 5.3 to 15.6, adding less than 40 ms of latency.

articles.title: Black-Box Membership Inference via Word-Level Probability Estimation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10611v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) have emerged as critical tools for auditing privacy risks in large language models (LLMs), aiming to determine whether a given text was included in a model's training corpus. However, most existing MIAs require access to per-token logits or probabilities, making them inapplicable in practice to proprietary LLMs that expose only textual continuations. To address this underexplored setting, we propose Word-level Probability MIA (WPMIA), a statistically principled MIA for strict black-box privacy auditing. WPMIA estimates word-level generation probabilities via Monte Carlo sampling with local kernel smoothing, then aggregates these estimates into a sequence-level likelihood estimator. Furthermore, WPMIA constructs the likelihood conditioned on different prefixes, thereby amplifying the distributional differences between members and non-members. We evaluate WPMIA across various open-source LLMs and find that it consistently outperforms existing black-box baselines. Importantly, we also evaluate WPMIA on modern proprietary LLMs, including GPT-5-Chat, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Claude-4.5-Haiku, achieving an average TPR@5%FPR of 42.0 across these models. These results offer a sound foundation for future research on strict black-box membership inference. Code is available at hrefhttps://github.com/niusj03/WPMIAhttps://github.com/niusj03/WPMIA.

articles.title: Composable CXL Memory as a Kubernetes-Native Shared Memory for LLM Serving
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10790v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) driver that makes composable CXL memory a schedulable cluster resource, and evaluate the resulting shared-memory tier for cross-node KV-cache reuse in LLM serving. The driver composes CXL regions on demand, materializes them as DAX devices on each participating host, and injects them into pods under a single Container Device Interface (CDI) name so that pods on different nodes access the same physical region. A shared-memory connector for vLLM/llm-d uses that region as a KV-cache tier with a slot directory embedded inside the shared medium, which eliminates the need for an external metadata service. On a two-node cluster with a 512,GiB CXL appliance and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, cross-node prefix reuse reduces TTFT by 5.5×--36.6× at an external hit rate of 95.4--99.5,%, while node-local tiers (GPU prefix caching, CPU-DRAM offload) fall back to full recompute. The sharing gap, defined as the latency ratio between cross-node and same-node reuse, is 1--4%, indicating that cross-node reuse incurs little additional latency relative to same-node reuse on our testbed. Both replicas run full engines; the study demonstrates memory disaggregation rather than prefill/decode disaggregation. We report this as a feasibility study rather than a performance evaluation.

articles.title: How Much Velocity Does Off-Ball Space Value Need? A Broadcast-Viewport Benchmark
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10801v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Velocity-aware pitch control is standard, but under a broadcast viewport half the players are off screen and on-screen velocities come from a drifting calibration. We ask at which layer of broadcast off-ball analysis velocity changes the answer. Inheriting our off-screen imputation protocol (three Metrica matches, 44 m viewport, block-bootstrap CIs), we score four velocity regimes -- none, viewport-legal observed, true-for-visible, true-for-all -- against a velocity-aware ground truth at three layers: imputation, the control surface, and team verdicts. Velocity is nearly useless for imputation (-0.2 pp against a 12--14 pp velocity-free surface MAE), first-order for the surface (-1.5 to -1.8 pp, 11--15% of that MAE), and ten times smaller for verdicts (-0.12 to -0.19 pp). The velocity that matters is the visible channel: perfect occluded-player velocity adds 2--6% of the visible gain, and no last-seen decay policy we tested exceeds that. Omitting velocity blurs the surface (per-frame |e| 2.2--2.6 pp) with small time-averaged bias (per cell <=0.4 pp), whereas imputation error is a structured bias against the defending team's deep zone (5--9 pp). At a fixed velocity window, a noise ladder of eleven jitter settings, including sigmaᵥ-matched pairs, is ordered to first order by one velocity-noise axis sigmaᵥ with break-even ~1 m/s; eleven SoccerNet-GSR clips from one match through our pipeline measure sigmaᵥ=1.65 m/s yet recover 24--36% of the benefit: 43% of the variance is frame-common, which the surface tolerates, and the residual is heavy-tailed and clustered, which Gaussian controls matched on component RMS do not reproduce (+0.03 vs. +0.36). The share of velocity-free error that velocity removes grows with viewport width (7% at 36 m, 21% at 60 m): fix imputation on tight shots, velocity on wide ones. Code and logs are released.

articles.title: DriftNet: A Dual-Head Trajectory Transformer for Detecting and Localizing Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10892v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When an indirect prompt injection succeeds against an LLM agent, the compromise is visible in the agent's own behavior: a benign prefix of tool calls, a poisoned observation, and a suffix of actions that serve the attacker. An operator needs three facts: where the attack entered, which steps it corrupted, and whether apparent poison was resisted. Existing systems return either a whole-trace verdict or a single unsafe index. We present DriftNet, a dual-head trajectory Transformer that reads a logged tool-call trajectory and answers all three questions in one forward pass: one head classifies the trajectory as compromised or not, and a second assigns every step one of four labels (benign, injection point, hijacked, failed injection). To our knowledge it is the first supervised detector to produce this joint output. A frozen sentence encoder and four identity-free world features embed each step; the trained trunk, under two million parameters and optimized with a class-weighted joint objective over both heads, needs no access to the agent's model. On the task-disjoint split of the AgentDrift benchmark (12,536 trajectories, 71,024 labeled steps), with a 20-configuration sweep bounding hyperparameter sensitivity to 0.011 F1 and the test part evaluated exactly once, DriftNet reaches trajectory-level F1 of 0.983, exact injection-point recovery on 98.7% of attacked trajectories, hijacked-span IoU of 0.979, zero flags on 218 resisted attacks, and 2.9% flags on hard negatives. A surface baseline retrained on the identical split recovers 11.1% of partial hijacks and 17.1% of delayed executions; DriftNet reaches 98.6% and 93.2% while lowering every false-alarm rate. Reading all 26 residual errors shows that most misses trace to trajectories whose labeled injection observation carries no legible instruction, and we report the benchmark's measured world-identity regularity alongside the results.

articles.title: ICT Development and Sustainable Development in Nigeria: An ARDL Assessment of Economic, Social, and Environmental Dimensions
articles.abstract: This study examines the effect of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) on sustainable development in Nigeria, focusing on its economic, social and environmental dimensions. Annual time-series data covering 1995–2024 were obtained from the World Development Indicators, United Nations Development Programme and International Telecommunication Union. Economic sustainability is proxied by GDP per capita growth, social sustainability by the Human Development Index, and environmental sustainability by carbon dioxide emissions. The study employs the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) approach to estimate the short-run and long-run relationships. The findings reveal that ICT has a positive and statistically significant effect on economic sustainability in both the short and long run. ICT also exerts a positive and significant influence on social sustainability, indicating that greater ICT penetration is associated with improvements in human development. In contrast, ICT has a negative and statistically significant effect on carbon dioxide emissions in both periods, suggesting that ICT development does not contributes to improved environmental sustainability. The findings establish that ICT has heterogeneous but consistently significant effects across the three dimensions of sustainable development in Nigeria. The study concludes that expanding digital infrastructure, strengthening digital inclusion and promoting ICT-enabled green technologies are important for aligning Nigeria’s digital transformation with sustainable development objectives.

articles.title: Financing Across the Organised Crime–Terrorism Interface: Adaptive Portfolios, Displacement, and European Criminal Policy
articles.abstract: Counter-terrorist-financing policy commonly records disrupted accounts, wallets, intermediaries, and assets. Yet, these outputs do not establish whether an organisation has lost the capacity to raise, consolidate, convert, store, move, or spend value. This article develops adaptive financial-portfolio theory through a theory-building structured integrative synthesis, anchored in a paired analysis of the Financial Action Task Force’s 2015 and 2025 global risk assessments and accompanied by three bounded organisational probes. The synthesis identifies the persistence of cash, banks, remitters, businesses, and coercive revenue alongside growing interconnection with digital platforms, mobile money, and virtual assets. The theory therefore rejects linear technological substitution and predicts function–mechanism specialisation, environment-spanning complementarity, shock-induced recomposition, governance-contingent continuity, and failure where nominally diverse channels share critical dependencies. The article does not equate terrorism with organised crime. It examines an interface at which terrorist-financing portfolios employ brokerage, illicit revenue generation, informal value transfer, legal business structures, corruption, criminal services, and enforcement adaptation also central to organised-crime scholarship. The theory is general, while the European Union provides the principal multilevel policy application and a setting in which sectoral and jurisdictional displacement can be observed. Effectiveness should be assessed through interruption duration, restoration, replacement cost, reliability, geographic reach, intelligence yield, and lawful-use harm, not channel closures alone. The propositions remain hypotheses for independent longitudinal testing.

articles.title: The Effect of CeO2 on the Electrocatalytic Oxidation Performance of Nanoporous Pd-Ag Catalyst for Methanol
articles.abstract: Al-Pd-Ag-Ce precursor alloys with different Ce contents are prepared by arc melting and melt quenching methods, and the nanoporous Pd-Ag/CeO2 catalysts are obtained by a simple dealloying treatment to investigate the electrocatalytic oxidation performance for methanol. The results show that CeO2 exists in the form of nanorods and is uniformly distributed within the nanoporous Pd-Ag alloy matrix. When the Ce content is 0.3 at% in Al-Pd-Ag-Ce precursor alloys and the dealloying time is 12 h, the obtained nanoporous Pd-Ag/CeO2 catalyst exhibits the best electrocatalytic performance. Compared with the commercial Pt/C and commercial Pd/C catalysts, its activity is about 8.9 times and 13.8 times, respectively, and stability is about 13.8 times and 39.1 times, respectively. These performance improvements are due to the synergistic effects at the interface between Pd and Ag, as well as between Pd and CeO2, the electronic effect of Ce on Pd, and the presence of oxygen vacancies on the surface of CeO2.

articles.title: The Kinetics of the ZnO Catalysed Photodegradation of Aspirin under UV Irradiation
articles.abstract: The kinetics of the photocatalytic degradation of aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) were investigated using synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO_NPs) under ultraviolet (UV) irradiation. The ZnO_NPs were synthesized via the chemical precipitation method and characterized using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier Transform Infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopy, Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), and Energy Dispersive X-ray (EDX) analysis. The average crystallite size was determined to be 32 nm calculated by using the Scherrer equation applied to the three most intense diffraction peaks. FT-IR spectra confirmed the characteristic stretching vibration of the Zn-O bond, alongside an O-H absorption band attributed to surface-adsorbed water molecules. The degradation rate of aspirin was evaluated as a function of various parameters, including catalyst dosage, substrate concentration, pH (H+ and OH− ions), and the presence of polymeric surfactants. The degradation rate constant (kobs) exhibited a positive correlation with ZnO dosage up to 50 mg. Beyond this optimum loading, the rate decreased, likely due to increased turbidity and light scattering, which reduces the penetration of UV radiation through the suspension. The degradation rate remained relatively constant in the range of 2.0 × 10− 4 mol dm− 3 to 8.0 × 10− 4 mol dm− 3, suggesting the reaction follows pseudo-first-order kinetics where the surface sites are saturated. The plot of the rate constant values versus [HClO4] yielded a bell-shaped (peaked) curve. This indicates that the degradation efficiency is highly dependent on the point of zero charge (pzc) of the ZnO and the ionization state of the aspirin molecule.

articles.title: UAS-OS: An Operating-System-Level Control Plane for Autonomous AI Governance and Real-Time Execution Abstraction
articles.abstract: As autonomous artificial intelligence systems scale into mission-critical and distributed environments, conventional operating systems treat AI workloads merely as standard processes, failing to provide adequate guarantees for intent control, behavioral governance, and physical-layer fault isolation. This paper introduces a comprehensive full-stack architecture: the Unified AI Controlling Operating System (UAS-OS) operating as an upper-layer governance control plane, powered by the Universal Operating System Architecture (QID-OS) at the lower resource and quantum orchestration layer [7]. By redefining AI agents as governed execution entities managed via Agent Control Blocks (ACBs) serving as the AI-era analogue to Process Control Blocks (PCBs), UAS-OS achieves robust intent governance and fault isolation with a measured integrated core-control overhead of just 41.308 microseconds (p99: 46.31 μs), well within real-time mission deadlines (Dtarget ≤ 100 μs). Furthermore, we integrate zero-copy virtual memory management across heterogeneous domains via hardware-backed IOMMU Direct Memory Access (DMA) and standardized bidirectional interface protocols.

articles.title: Sustainable Water Management in Construction: Application of Natural Coagulant-Treated Greywater for Interlocking Paving Stones
articles.abstract: With the rapid urbanisation, the demand for potable water has increased and sustainable alternative water sources are needed for construction. This study aimed to assess the feasibility of using greywater (GW) with four natural coagulants treatment (NCT) from Moringa oleifera (MO) seeds, Cucumis limetta (CL) seeds, Musa sapientum (MS) peels and Carica papaya (CP) seeds for the production of interlocking paving stones (IPS). The specimens of IPS were prepared in the ratio of 1:2:4 (cement:sand:stone) dust and water–cement ratio of 0.6 with dimensions of 200 × 100 × 80 mm. Greywater and NCT greywater were used as the experimental mixture while the control was potable water. The Scanning Electron Microscopy-Energy Dispersive X-Ray (SEM-EDX) Spectroscopy of IPS, compressive strength, water absorption of the IPS were determined. In addition, the physicochemical characteristics of the mixing waters such as pH, total dissolved solids, sulphate, chloride and turbidity were evaluated. The results indicated that the NCT water had an impact on the physicochemical properties of the greywater and resulted in different effects on the IPS performance. The compressive strength of CP treated greywater was 11.20 MPa, which was about 49% higher than the control (potable water) with a value of 7.53 MPa, whereas the MO treated greywater had a compressive strength of 9.70 MPa. The 28-day strengths of untreated greywater, CL-treated and MS-treated greywater were lower than the control. In addition, the CP treated greywater had a relatively low water absorption, 9.84% compared to the potable-water control (10.00%). The results showed that the NCT greywater can be used as an alternative mixing water for IPS production in general, and specifically, CP and MO-treated water. The approach promotes water savings, sustainable urban infrastructure and contributes towards Sustainable Development Goals 6 and 11.

articles.title: Design and Implementation of a Semi-Autonomous Battery-Powered Electric Vehicle Controller Using an Arduino Microcontroller
articles.abstract: The rapid proliferation of internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles has led to mounting concerns over greenhouse gas emissions, fossil fuel depletion, and urban air quality degradation. Electric vehicles (EVs) present a viable alternative, offering zero tailpipe emissions and superior energy efficiency. This paper presents the design and simulation of a semi-autonomous, battery-powered electric vehicle controller using an Arduino Uno microcontroller. The system integrates a MOSFET-based H-Bridge motor driver for bidirectional 600 W DC motor control, a pulse-width modulation (PWM) speed regulation scheme, a 24 V lead-acid battery power supply, and a 20×4 LCD user interface for real-time monitoring of driving mode, motor speed, and battery state of charge (SOC). Simulation in Proteus 8.1 verified correct forward, reverse, and regenerative braking operation. Results confirm that PWM-based control provides efficient, low-loss speed regulation and that SOC monitoring successfully protects the battery from deep discharge. The architecture is low-cost and employs components commercially available in developing markets.

articles.title: Synergetic Photocatalysis on Y2O3 doped NiZnFe2O4@rGO nanocomposite for efficient Sunset Yellow dye degradation
articles.abstract: The paper describes a synthesis of Y2O3 doped NiZnFe2O4/reduced graphene oxide (rGO) nanocomposite to be used in photo catalytics. The preparation of nanohybrid was performed by a cheap and widely used sol-gel auto combustion technique. The crystalline structure, functional groups, chemical bonds, morphology, and specific surface area of the obtained NiZnFe2O4/Y2O3/rGO were characterized using XRD, FT-IR, UV-Visible, FESEM with EDX, HRTEM, BET and XPS. Other XRD and SEM analyses revealed the purity of the phases and the crystallinity and morphology of the nano-photocatalyst. The nanocomposite from the spectral analysis performed with the UV-visible devices exhibited a band gap of 3.1eV. The studies also revealed that Y2O3 and NiZnFe2O4 particles were evenly attached onto reduced graphene oxide surface. Thus, the prepared photocatalyst could degrade Sunset Yellow dye in the visible light radiation. Operational parameters (pH, catalyst amount, initial pollutant concentration and electrolyte concentration) were varied in the experiments to understand the effect on photocatalytic performance. The findings showed that NiZnFe2O4/Y2O3/rGO had a higher photocatalytic efficiency compared to pristine rGO with a degradation efficiency of 96% of Sunset Yellow dye. The conclusion from a scavenger study was that during the presence of ultraviolet light a reaction mechanism occurred and the electron-hole pairs created by the photogeneration process were effectively separated. All these results support the idea that NiZnFe2O4/Y2O3/rGO nanohybrid has an outstanding photocatalytic ability, which can be used in advanced environmental remediation.

articles.title: Scaled-charge ion force field optimized for individual ion partial molar volumes in water
articles.abstract: We present an ion partial molar volume force field for common monovalent and divalent ionic species, including Li + , Na + , K + , Cs + , Mg 2+ , Ca 2+ , F − , Cl − , Br − , I − , OH − , and H 3 O + . When combined with the TIP4P/2005 water model, the force field enables quantitative investigations of ion-specific effects in both bulk and interfacial properties. The iPMV force field is developed based on a single guiding principle: the ion–water interaction parameters are optimized such that the experimental partial molar volume of each individual ion at infinite dilution—determined via the ultrasonic vibrational potential method—is reproduced by construction. An exception is made for the hydronium ion, for which we also provide an alternative interface-optimized model. The force field employs a charge scaling factor of 0.75 and adopts the Lorentz–Berthelot combining rules for cross-Lennard-Jones interactions, with specific modifications for divalent cations. A distinctive feature of the iPMV force field is that, despite its straightforward design, a single set of ion parameters consistently reproduces a wide range of experimental properties—from volumetric and interfacial properties to salting-out/in effects and transport coefficients. This robust performance suggests a fundamental correlation between the partial molar volumes of individual ions and the broader physical properties of aqueous electrolyte solutions.

articles.title: The energetics of force errors in machine-learned molecular dynamics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The energetic effect of a force error depends on atomic motion. We establish a directional residual-work coefficient combining directional curvature mismatch with the spatial distribution of the residual response. For conservative potentials force-matched at an anchor, it determines the leading signed work at the first crossing of a small force-error budget. At a 474-atom lithium-electrolyte interface, predictions fixed before future reference evaluations differ from measurements by less than 4.6% of predicted work across 24 prescribed endpoints. Changing only the initial velocity direction at fixed structure and initial total kinetic energy reverses the force-work ranking. At the same admitted time of 0.25 fs, one direction gives an 11.6% larger maximum force residual but 36.1% less work. The reversal recurs at a second structure. The framework connects force tolerances to reference-energy transfer, providing a physical basis for potential assessment and adaptive reference allocation.

articles.title: Two-magnon response from light scattering in altermagnets
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism is a recently established class of magnetic order that combines fully compensated moments with momentum-dependent spin splitting, yet identifying its spectroscopic fingerprints remains an open challenge. In this work, we investigate finite-momentum two-magnon excitations in a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet by calculating the two-magnon light scattering intensity in different polarization channels. Using linear spin-wave theory and further incorporating the leading 1/S quantum corrections, we demonstrate that the characteristic magnon splitting of altermagnets shifts the upper edge of the two-magnon continuum and the corresponding spectral features to higher energy at boldsymbolX=(π,0) relative to the conventional antiferromagnet, by an amount linear in the exchange anisotropy |δ J₂|, while leaving the response at the Brillouin-zone center unchanged. Although magnon-magnon interactions strongly redistribute spectral weight toward lower energies, the energy scale associated with the high-energy momentum-selective reconstruction remains robust. The interactions additionally generate a pronounced low-energy two-peak structure that has no counterpart within linear spin-wave theory. At boldsymbolK=(π/2,π/2), we show that the interacting two-magnon resonance is twofold degenerate in the conventional antiferromagnetic phase, while a finite altermagnetic exchange anisotropy lifts this degeneracy, producing two peaks whose separation is linear in |δ J₂|. The characteristic energy scales underlying both features are intrinsic to the two-magnon sector rather than to a specific scattering operator. These findings highlight the potential of finite-momentum two-magnon spectroscopy for identifying altermagnetic order in insulating magnets and motivate momentum-resolved resonant inelastic x-ray scattering studies of candidate altermagnetic materials.

articles.title: Finite-Temperature Flat-Band Ferromagnetism in the Kagome Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: Kagome Hubbard模型中的有限温度平带铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome metals exhibit a rich interplay of topology, electronic correlations, and lattice dynamics. Recent discoveries of Kagome materials with a flat band near the Fermi level have revealed a variety of correlated electronic phases. However, elucidating their microscopic origin remains challenging, as realistic descriptions require accounting for multiple orbitals and competing interactions on an equal footing. To disentangle correlation effects from material-specific details and identify the essential physics of the flat-band regime, we study the single-orbital Kagome-Hubbard model at flat-band fillings using dynamical mean-field theory. We find strong signatures of flat-band ferromagnetism, consistent with exact and mean-field ground-state results. Moreover, we uncover an unconventional quasi-ordered phase in which a partially filled spin-polarized flat band pinned at the Fermi level gives rise to persistent local spin fluctuations down to zero temperature, in striking contrast to the classical behavior expected for a conventional ferromagnet. Our results demonstrate that these anomalous fluctuations are an intrinsic consequence of the flat-band degeneracy and establish a minimal framework for understanding correlation effects in flat-band Kagome systems.
articles.abstract_zh: Kagome金属中的平带靠近费米能级时可产生丰富的关联电子相，但其微观机制仍不清楚。该研究利用动力学平均场理论考察平带填充下的单轨道Kagome-Hubbard模型，发现了与既有基态结果一致的强平带铁磁性证据。研究还揭示了一种非常规准有序相：部分填充且自旋极化的平带被钉扎于费米能级，在零温附近仍保持局域自旋涨落。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kagome金属展现出拓扑性、电子关联和晶格动力学之间丰富的相互作用。近期在费米能级附近具有平带的Kagome材料的发现，揭示了多种关联电子相。然而，阐明这些相的微观起源仍具挑战性，因为对真实材料的描述需要以同等地位考虑多个轨道和相互竞争的相互作用。为将关联效应与材料特定细节区分开来，并识别平带区域的本质物理，我们利用动力学平均场理论研究了平带填充下的单轨道Kagome-Hubbard模型。我们发现了强烈的平带铁磁性迹象，这与精确和平均场的基态结果一致。此外，我们揭示了一种非常规准有序相，其中一个部分填充、被钉扎在费米能级的自旋极化平带导致持续存在的局域自旋涨落，并一直延续至零温；这与传统铁磁体所预期的经典行为形成鲜明对比。我们的结果表明，这些反常涨落是平带简并性的内禀结果，并为理解平带Kagome体系中的关联效应建立了一个最简框架。

articles.title: Temperature-induced effective topology in many-body ultracold atomic quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 多体超冷原子量子体系中的温度诱导有效拓扑性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09463v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultracold atomic quantum systems offer an unprecedentedly powerful platform for exploring interacting symmetry-protected topological phases. Here, we show that their characteristic control over temperature provides a resource for engineering effective topological regimes with no zero-temperature counterpart. Employing finite-temperature matrix-product-state calculations, we investigate experimentally accessible Hamiltonians - the interacting bosonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger and spin-1 XXZ chains - that host a topological phase at zero temperature, as well as a fermionic dipolar ladder model whose ground state exhibits no topological order. By tracking complementary topological markers, we identify an intriguing mechanism rooted in the structure of the zero-temperature phase diagrams: in finite-size systems, excitation gaps with different magnitudes define an intermediate-temperature window where the correlations associated with the lower gap are suppressed, while those protected by the larger gap persist. This enables the emergence of effective finite-temperature regimes exhibiting topological features that are either absent or qualitatively different from those at zero temperature. Our results establish a novel route toward exploring effective topological phases in ultracold atomic quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 超冷原子体系对温度的可控性可用于构造在零温下不存在对应物的有效拓扑区域。该研究通过有限温度矩阵乘积态计算考察多个实验可实现模型，发现不同大小的激发能隙可形成一个中间温度窗口。该窗口内，小能隙所关联的关联被抑制，而大能隙保护的关联得以保留，从而产生新的有效拓扑特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超冷原子量子体系为探索相互作用的对称性保护拓扑相提供了前所未有的强大平台。本文表明，这些体系对温度所具有特征性的控制能力，可作为一种资源，用于构造没有零温对应物的有效拓扑区域。我们采用有限温度矩阵乘积态计算，研究了实验上可实现的哈密顿量，包括在零温下具有拓扑相的相互作用玻色Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链和自旋1 XXZ链，以及基态不表现拓扑有序的费米子偶极子梯模型。通过追踪互补的拓扑标志，我们识别出一种植根于零温相图结构的有趣机制：在有限尺寸体系中，具有不同量级的激发能隙定义了一个中间温度窗口，其中与较小能隙相关的关联受到抑制，而受较大能隙保护的关联则持续存在。这使得有效有限温度区域得以涌现，呈现出在零温下不存在或与零温时在性质上不同的拓扑特征。我们的结果为在超冷原子量子体系中探索有效拓扑相建立了一条新途径。

articles.title: Light-Driven Ultrafast Control of Time-Reversal Symmetry in SrTiO3
articles.title_zh: 光驱动SrTiO3中时间反演对称性的超快控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Light-driven control of material symmetry enables the engineering of phenomena forbidden in equilibrium. Although electromagnetic fields have been used to break time-reversal symmetry, its dynamic control on ultrafast timescales in nonmagnetic insulating oxides remains virtually unexplored. Here, we demonstrate simultaneous magnetic symmetry lowering and timereversal-symmetry breaking in cubic SrTiO3 driven by an off-resonant, elliptically polarized THz pulse. Second harmonic generation (SHG) polarimetry reveals emergent SHG circular dichroism inconsistent with third-order nonlinear processes under cubic m3m symmetry. The SHG polar patterns exhibit mirror-symmetry breaking, indicating a transient reduction to tetragonal 4/mm'm' magnetic symmetry. Furthermore, the SHG response scales linearly with the angular momentum of THz pulse, providing direct evidence for THz-field-induced timereversal-symmetry breaking. These results establish a direct pathway for ultrafast symmetry control in non-magnetic oxides, enabling dynamic manipulation of emergent phases on ultrafast timescales.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究展示了利用失谐椭圆偏振太赫兹脉冲，在立方SrTiO3中同时降低磁对称性并打破时间反演对称性。二次谐波产生偏振测量显示出无法由立方m3m对称性下三阶非线性过程解释的圆二色性和镜面对称性破缺。该结果为非磁性氧化物中涌现相的超快动态调控提供了直接路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光驱动的材料对称性控制能够实现平衡态下被禁止的现象。尽管电磁场已被用于打破时间反演对称性，但在非磁性绝缘氧化物中于超快时间尺度上对其进行动态控制，仍几乎未被探索。本文展示了由失谐椭圆偏振太赫兹脉冲驱动的立方SrTiO3中同时发生的磁对称性降低和时间反演对称性破缺。二次谐波产生（SHG）偏振测量揭示了新出现的SHG圆二色性，这与立方m3m对称性下的三阶非线性过程不一致。SHG偏振图样表现出镜面对称性破缺，表明体系瞬态降低至四方4/mm'm'磁对称性。此外，SHG响应随太赫兹脉冲角动量线性标度变化，为太赫兹场诱导的时间反演对称性破缺提供了直接证据。这些结果为非磁性氧化物中的超快对称性控制建立了直接途径，使得在超快时间尺度上动态操控涌现相成为可能。

articles.title: Microscopic Understanding of Thermal-magnon Transport in a Low-damping Ferrimagnetic Thin Films
articles.title_zh: 低阻尼亚铁磁薄膜中热磁振子输运的微观理解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09674v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermally generated magnons enable heat-driven spin transport in magnetic insulators, yet the microscopic mechanisms governing their propagation remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate thermal magnon transport in low-damping Li₀.₅Al₁.₀Fe₁.₅O₄/Pt nanodevices using a nonlocal spin Seebeck geometry that separates magnon transport from local thermoelectric effects. Thermal imaging establishes a detector region outside the thermal healing length, enabling intrinsic nonlocal measurements. We find that thermal magnon transport is strongly suppressed by magnetic fields far above saturation. Brillouin light scattering reveals that increasing field reduces the group velocity of backward volume magnons, providing a microscopic origin for the observed reduction in magnon spin diffusion length. We further find that thermal magnon transport decreases with increasing temperature despite an increasing magnon population. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce this behavior only when a temperature-dependent exchange stiffness is included. These results identify magnon group velocity and exchange stiffness as key parameters governing thermal magnon transport in ferrimagnetic thin films.
articles.abstract_zh: 热激发磁振子能够在磁性绝缘体中实现热驱动自旋输运，但其传播机制尚未完全明确。该研究在Li₀.₅Al₁.₀Fe₁.₅O₄/Pt纳米器件中发现，高于磁饱和所需范围的磁场会显著抑制热磁振子输运，这与后向体磁振子群速度降低有关。结果还表明，温度升高时输运减弱，只有纳入温度依赖的交换刚度后，微磁模拟才能复现这一行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热生成的磁振子能够在磁性绝缘体中实现热驱动自旋输运，但控制其传播的微观机制仍未得到充分理解。本文采用将磁振子输运与局域热电效应分离的非局域自旋塞贝克几何构型，研究了低阻尼Li₀.₅Al₁.₀Fe₁.₅O₄/Pt纳米器件中的热磁振子输运。热成像证实探测器区域位于热弛豫长度之外，从而能够进行内禀的非局域测量。我们发现，热磁振子输运会被远高于饱和场的磁场强烈抑制。布里渊光散射表明，增大磁场会降低后向体磁振子的群速度，从而为所观测到的磁振子自旋扩散长度减小提供了微观起源。我们进一步发现，尽管磁振子数目增加，热磁振子输运却随温度升高而减小。只有在纳入温度依赖的交换刚度时，微磁模拟才能复现这一行为。这些结果确定了磁振子群速度和交换刚度是控制亚铁磁薄膜中热磁振子输运的关键参数。

articles.title: Automated Generation of Commensurate Magnetic Structures based on Spin Space Groups and Graph Theory
articles.title_zh: 基于自旋空间群与图论的公度磁结构自动生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic structures with symmetry constraints are candidates for energetically favorable configurations. Enumerating these structures is essential for identifying experimental observations and provides unbiased, linearly stable, and optimally sampled reference configurations for energy fitting when extracting spin interactions. We present SpinGraph, an automated workflow generating symmetry-distinct magnetic configurations. SpinGraph is not only compatible with the more general spin space groups, but also allows precise control of the prescribed single- or multi-Q states superposition. For finite groups, we enumerate compatible subgroups directly. For spin space groups with a continuous or special spin-only part, the finite component is enumerated first and then combined with the compatible exact spin-only constraints. These actions are translated into graph constraints in real or Fourier space. The symmetry of every generated structure is re-evaluated after construction. Finally, we integrate SpinGraph with the magnetic analysis code AMATIS to perform a thorough calculation for the spin interactions of the insulating monolayer CrI3. SpinGraph complements the last part of AMATIS and realizes the fully automated workflow for the spin Hamiltonian construction, which is essential for studying phase transitions, spin textures, magnons, and spin dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出SpinGraph自动化工作流，用于生成在对称性上不同的磁构型，并支持一般自旋空间群及指定单Q或多Q态叠加的精确控制。该方法将对称性操作转换为实空间或傅里叶空间中的图约束，并在构建后重新评估每个结构的对称性。作者将其与AMATIS结合，完成了绝缘单层CrI3自旋相互作用的自动化分析。
articles.focus_summary: 论文提出 SpinGraph 自动化流程，利用自旋空间群和图论生成满足对称性约束的、无重复的磁性结构。该方法可控制单重或多重波矢态的叠加，并与磁性分析程序结合提取自旋相互作用，论文还以单层 CrI₃ 为例进行了验证。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、非共线磁性、自旋哈密顿量、对称性分析、二维范德华磁体和图神经网络方向高度直接相关。自动生成对称性完备的磁结构可显著改进交换参数拟合、磁基态搜索和机器学习磁性模型的数据集构建。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其自旋空间群枚举、连续自旋约束处理及与自旋哈密顿量拟合的接口。可进一步将该流程与主动学习、等变神经网络和高通量磁性材料筛选结合，研究自旋轨道耦合、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用及多重波矢磁序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有对称性约束的磁结构是可能在能量上更有利的构型候选。枚举这些结构对于识别实验观测至关重要，并且在提取自旋相互作用进行能量拟合时，可提供无偏、线性稳定且得到最优采样的参考构型。我们提出SpinGraph，这是一种用于生成对称性不同的磁构型的自动化工作流。SpinGraph不仅兼容更一般的自旋空间群，而且允许精确控制所指定的单Q态或多Q态叠加。对于有限群，我们直接枚举相容的子群。对于具有连续或特殊纯自旋部分的自旋空间群，首先枚举有限部分，然后将其与相容的精确纯自旋约束结合。这些操作被转换为实空间或傅里叶空间中的图约束。每个生成结构的对称性都会在构建后重新评估。最后，我们将SpinGraph与磁学分析代码AMATIS集成，对绝缘单层CrI3的自旋相互作用进行了全面计算。SpinGraph补充了AMATIS的最后一部分，实现了自旋哈密顿量构建的全自动工作流，这对于研究相变、自旋纹理、磁振子和自旋动力学至关重要。

articles.title: Anomalous Hall Response Induced by Correlated Disorder in the Breathing Kagome Lattice Mn₃Sn
articles.title_zh: 呼吸型Kagome晶格Mn3Sn中由关联无序诱导的反常霍尔响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Macroscopic transport tensors are generally constrained by the average crystallographic and magnetic symmetries of a material. In the kagome antiferromagnetic Weyl semimetals Mn₃₊δX (X=~Sn or Ge), previous studies showed that the anomalous Hall conductivity σyₓ is forbidden by the average hexsg{} structure and coplanar inverse-triangular magnetic order. Here we report that nearly stoichiometric Mn₃Sn nevertheless exhibits a finite σyₓ with large hysteresis, together with enhanced σzₓ and σyz, in the inverse-triangular phase below TN₁approx 440~K, whereas all AHE components vanish in the amplitude-modulated conical phase below TN₂approx 280~K. Total scattering and magnetic pair distribution function analysis reveal correlated orthorhombic distortions and noncoplanar Mn moments. First-principles calculations show that this coupled lattice-spin distortion activates the average symmetry forbidden σyₓ within the inverse-triangular phase. Its disappearance below TN₂ indicates that the correlated disorder must cooperate with a long-range inverse-triangular antiferromagnetic order capable of supporting Berry curvature. Our results establish correlated disorder as an active symmetry-breaking degree of freedom that enables topological transport inaccessible from the Bragg-average structure alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 在近化学计量Mn3Sn中，研究发现按平均晶体和磁对称性本应禁止的σyx反常霍尔电导却呈现有限值及明显磁滞。总散射和磁性对分布函数分析揭示了关联的正交畸变与非共面Mn磁矩，而第一性原理计算表明这种晶格-自旋耦合畸变可激活该响应。该结果说明，关联无序可作为主动的破缺对称性自由度，实现仅凭布拉格平均结构无法获得的拓扑输运。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 宏观输运张量通常受材料平均晶体学和磁学对称性的约束。在Kagome反铁磁Weyl半金属Mn₃₊δX（X约为Sn或Ge）中，先前研究表明，反常霍尔电导率σyx受到平均六方结构和共面反三角磁有序的禁止。本文报道，接近化学计量的Mn3Sn在TN1约440 K以下的反三角相中，仍表现出具有大磁滞的有限σyx，以及增强的σzx和σyz；而在TN2约280 K以下的振幅调制锥形相中，所有反常霍尔效应分量均消失。总散射和磁性对分布函数分析揭示了关联的正交畸变和非共面Mn磁矩。第一性原理计算表明，这种耦合的晶格-自旋畸变会在反三角相内激活被平均对称性禁止的σyx。其在TN2以下消失表明，关联无序必须与能够支持贝里曲率的长程反三角反铁磁有序协同作用。我们的结果确立了关联无序是一种主动的对称性破缺自由度，它能够实现仅从布拉格平均结构无法获得的拓扑输运。

articles.title: First-principles investigation of structural, mechanical, vibrational, thermal, electronic and optical properties of Na3Bi: a topological Dirac semimetal
articles.title_zh: Na3Bi结构、力学、振动、热学、电子与光学性质的第一性原理研究：一种拓扑狄拉克半金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exploring the properties of topological materials has remained an active area of research in condensed matter physics for the past few decades. Here, we present a first-principles investigation of the structural, elasto-mechanical, thermal, electronic, and optical properties of Na3Bi, one of the earliest discovered topological Dirac semimetals, using density functional theory. The hexagonal phase of Na3Bi is found to be both mechanically and dynamically stable, exhibiting moderate elastic anisotropy with a universal anisotropy index of 0.832. The compound displays a moderate machinability index of 2.386 alongside a low hardness value of 2.005, consistent with its predominantly brittle, covalently bonded character accompanied by a slight metallic contribution. Its comparatively low Debye temperature of 181.39K points to a mechanically soft lattice with loosely bound atoms. Electronic structure calculations confirm semimetallic behavior, with well-defined Dirac points pinned at the Fermi level and a Fermi surface composed of point-like pockets. Optical analysis across a wide spectral range reveals non-selective, moderate reflectivity of 40 to 45% and, in the visible region, an unusually high refractive index reaching between 2 and 4.5. Na3Bi is additionally found to be an efficient absorber of ultraviolet radiation. Together, these findings establish a comprehensive baseline for the mechanical, thermal, and optical behavior of hexagonal Na3Bi and point to its potential relevance for acoustic damping, UV-sensing, and optoelectronic applications
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于密度泛函理论，系统研究了Na3Bi六方相的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质。结果表明，Na3Bi具有机械和动力学稳定性，费米能级处存在清晰的狄拉克点，并表现出中等反射率、高可见光折射率和优良的紫外吸收能力。其性质表明，该材料在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件领域具有潜在应用价值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在过去几十年中，拓扑材料性质的探索一直是凝聚态物理学中活跃的研究领域。本文利用密度泛函理论，对Na3Bi这一最早发现的拓扑狄拉克半金属之一的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质进行了第一性原理研究。研究发现，Na3Bi的六方相在机械和动力学上均稳定，并表现出中等程度的弹性各向异性，其普适各向异性指数为0.832。该化合物的可加工性指数为2.386，属于中等水平；硬度值较低，为2.005，这与其以脆性、共价键合特征为主并伴有轻微金属性贡献的性质相一致。其相对较低的德拜温度为181.39 K，表明该材料晶格较软，原子之间的束缚较弱。电子结构计算证实其具有半金属性，在费米能级处存在定义清晰的狄拉克点，且费米面由点状口袋构成。在宽广的光谱范围内进行的光学分析表明，该材料具有40%至45%的非选择性中等反射率；在可见光区域，其折射率异常高，可达到2至4.5。研究还发现，Na3Bi能够有效吸收紫外辐射。总体而言，这些结果为六方Na3Bi的力学、热学和光学行为建立了全面基线，并指出其在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件应用中的潜在价值。

articles.title: Record-Breaking Elemental Superconductivity in Tetralayer Kagome Borophene
articles.title_zh: 四层卡戈梅硼烯中的创纪录元素超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09730v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductivity above the liquid-nitrogen temperature remains rare in two-dimensional elemental crystals, where strong covalent bonding often yields high phonon frequencies but insufficient electron-phonon coupling. Here, using first-principles calculations and fully anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory, we predict tetralayer kagome borophene (TKB) stabilized by ABAB covalent stacking, as a liquid-nitrogen-temperature elemental superconductor. With a predicted critical temperature of 102 K, TKB sets a record-high value among previously reported elemental superconductors. Unlike known high-Tc boron-based superconductors dominated by in-plane sigma-bonding states and high-frequency in-plane B-B stretching modes, TKB realizes an out-of-plane s-pz-bonding-mediated pairing mechanism, in which interlayer s-pz bonding states at the Fermi level are strongly coupled to low-frequency out-of-plane vibrations of boron atoms. These results reveal a distinct out-of-plane pairing channel in multilayer borophene and establish covalent stacking engineering as a potential route for high-Tc superconductivity in two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过第一性原理计算和完全各向异性的Migdal-Eliashberg理论，预测了由ABAB共价堆垛稳定的四层卡戈梅硼烯。该材料的预测临界温度达到102 K，创下已报道元素超导体中的最高值。其超导配对由费米能级附近的层间s-pz成键态与硼原子的低频面外振动强耦合所驱动，为二维材料实现高温超导提供了新的面外配对机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在二维元素晶体中，高于液氮温度的超导性仍然十分罕见，因为强共价键通常能够产生较高的声子频率，却无法提供足够强的电子-声子耦合。本文利用第一性原理计算和完全各向异性的Migdal-Eliashberg理论，预测了由ABAB共价堆垛稳定的四层卡戈梅硼烯，并指出其是一种工作于液氮温度范围的元素超导体。其预测临界温度为102 K，在此前报道的元素超导体中创下最高值。不同于已知的高临界温度含硼超导体主要由面内σ成键态和高频面内B-B伸缩振动主导，四层卡戈梅硼烯实现了一种由面外s-pz成键介导的配对机制，其中费米能级处的层间s-pz成键态与硼原子的低频面外振动发生强耦合。这些结果揭示了多层硼烯中一种独特的面外配对通道，并表明共价堆垛工程可能成为在二维材料中实现高临界温度超导性的途径。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作利用第一性原理计算和全各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg理论，预测四层堆垛kagome硼烯具有约102 K的高临界温度。研究指出层间s-pz成键态与低频面外振动之间的强电子-声子耦合，是其高温超导的主要来源。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的二维材料、超导、电子-声子耦合和第一性原理计算方向直接相关。其层间堆垛工程和面外振动配对机制可为二维超导材料设计及声子重整化研究提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步检验该结构的动力学和热稳定性，并研究应变、载流子掺杂、磁性或衬底效应对超导转变温度的影响。也可结合机器学习势开展大尺度有限温度结构稳定性模拟。

articles.title: Orbital-selective electronic modes induced by doping and originating from distinct spin excitations: an essential feature of orbital-selective Mott transition
articles.title_zh: 由掺杂诱导并源自不同自旋激发的轨道选择性电子模：轨道选择性莫特转变的关键特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09741v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nature of the orbital-selective Mott transition (OSMT) remains elusive. This study shows that, by doping an orbitally degenerate spin-1 antiferromagnetic insulator in the Kanamori-Hubbard model, electronic modes emerge in the band gap in an orbital-selective manner, exhibiting momentum-shifted spin-mode dispersion relations. Electronic modes originating from conventional spin excitations, including the low-energy one, appear in the doped orbital, while those from inter-orbital spin excitations appear in the undoped orbital. These emergent modes constitute an essential feature of the OSMT.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了Kanamori-Hubbard模型中轨道简并、自旋为1的反铁磁绝缘体在掺杂后的行为。结果表明，带隙中会以轨道选择性的方式出现电子模，其色散关系表现出动量平移的自旋模特征。源自常规自旋激发的电子模出现在掺杂轨道中，而源自轨道间自旋激发的电子模出现在未掺杂轨道中，这些模构成轨道选择性莫特转变的关键特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道选择性莫特转变的本质仍未得到充分阐明。本研究表明，在Kanamori-Hubbard模型中，对一个轨道简并、自旋为1的反铁磁绝缘体进行掺杂后，带隙中会出现具有轨道选择性的电子模，并呈现出动量发生偏移的自旋模色散关系。源自常规自旋激发的电子模，包括低能电子模，会出现在被掺杂的轨道中；而源自轨道间自旋激发的电子模则出现在未掺杂的轨道中。这些新出现的电子模构成了轨道选择性莫特转变的关键特征。

articles.title: Semi-Dirac States and Quantum Linear Magnetoresistance in Helimagnetic Pnictide MnP
articles.title_zh: 螺旋磁性磷族化合物MnP中的半狄拉克态与量子线性磁阻
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large linear positive magnetoresistance (LPMR) in topological and magnetic materials remains a subject of intense debate, particularly in noncollinear spin systems where spin-dependent scattering complicates charge transport. Manganese phosphide (MnP), a helimagnetic binary pnictide with multiple field-induced magnetic transitions, provides a useful platform to investigate the interplay between complex magnetism and electronic topology. Here, we present a comprehensive experimental and theoretical investigation of phase-dependent magnetotransport in high-quality MnP single crystals. Hall measurements reveal an anomalous Hall effect dominated by skew scattering at high temperatures and a finite topological Hall effect in the noncollinear fan (FAN) and low-temperature screw (SCR) phases. At low temperatures, we observe a large, non-saturating LPMR reaching nearly 800 percent at 4 K and 15 T, with a pronounced linear field dependence in the field-polarized ferromagnetic (FM2) state. First-principles calculations reveal a strongly anisotropic semi-Dirac-like band at the Y point that progressively approaches the Fermi level from the SCR to FAN and FM2 states. Our analysis indicates that the resulting small Fermi pocket can access the extreme quantum-limit regime at experimentally accessible fields, providing a microscopic framework for the observed LPMR within Abrikosov's quantum magnetoresistance theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对高质量MnP单晶中的相依赖磁输运进行了实验和理论研究。研究观察到低温下接近800%的非饱和线性正磁阻，并发现Y点附近存在强各向异性的半狄拉克型能带，该能带从螺旋相向扇形相和场极化铁磁相演化并逐渐接近费米能级。由此形成的小费米口袋可在实验可达磁场下进入极端量子极限，为观察到的线性磁阻提供了基于Abrikosov量子磁阻理论的微观解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑材料和磁性材料中的巨大线性正磁阻仍是一个受到广泛讨论的问题，尤其是在非共线自旋体系中，自旋依赖散射使电荷输运更加复杂。磷化锰（MnP）是一种具有螺旋磁性的二元磷族化合物，并存在多个由磁场诱导的磁性转变，为研究复杂磁性与电子拓扑之间的相互作用提供了有用平台。本文对高质量MnP单晶中的相依赖磁输运进行了全面的实验和理论研究。霍尔测量表明，在高温下反常霍尔效应主要由偏斜散射主导；在非共线扇形相（FAN）和低温螺旋相（SCR）中，则存在有限的拓扑霍尔效应。在低温下，研究观察到巨大且不饱和的线性正磁阻，在4 K和15 T条件下接近800%；在场极化铁磁相（FM2）中，磁阻表现出显著的线性场依赖关系。第一性原理计算揭示，在Y点存在一个强各向异性的类半狄拉克能带，该能带从SCR相向FAN相和FM2相演化时逐步接近费米能级。我们的分析表明，由此产生的小费米口袋可以在实验可达的磁场下进入极端量子极限，从而依据Abrikosov量子磁阻理论，为所观察到的线性正磁阻提供了微观框架。

articles.title: uFlowCSP: Crystal Structure Prediction using Mean flow generative models
articles.title_zh: uFlowCSP：利用平均流生成模型进行晶体结构预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal structure prediction (CSP) is fundamental to computational materials discovery. Generative models including CDVAE, DiffCSP, FlowMM, and CrystalFlow learn stable-crystal distributions directly, but diffusion and flow-matching inference requires tens to thousands of sequential network evaluations per candidate. We introduce uFlowCSP, a MeanFlow-based CSP model that learns the average, rather than instantaneous, probability-flow velocity. It generates a complete structure in one to five evaluations, delivering 5x-58x faster inference with equal or better performance. A chemistry- and symmetry-aware Transformer uses canonical atom ordering, global composition, and per-token chemistry embeddings. A coarse crystal-system token is used only during training; it provides additive gains, particularly improving space-group agreement despite being absent at inference, which remains formula-only. On MP-20 with 20 candidates per target, one step matches CrystalFlow (78.38% vs. 78.34%) with 100x fewer evaluations and about 10x lower wall-clock time. Five steps reach 83.64%, exceeding CrystalFlow (78.34% at 2,000 evaluations) and DiffCSP (77.93% at about 20,000), while using 20x fewer evaluations. uFlowCSP generates 10,000 structures in 0.39-1.31 minutes, versus 6.5 for CrystalFlow and 76.1 for DiffCSP. Under CSPBench's energy-ranked top-five structure-and-space-group criterion, five-step uFlowCSP reaches 72%/72%/65% structure, space-group, and consensus match rates. CrystalFlow reaches 78%/73%/68% at 100 steps but falls to 49%/32%/31% at five. Thus, uFlowCSP improves accuracy per network evaluation, not merely peak accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的晶体结构预测模型，通过学习平均概率流速度而非瞬时速度，将每个候选结构的生成评估次数降低至1至5次。该模型结合化学和对称性感知的Transformer，在保持或提升精度的同时实现了显著加速；在MP-20数据集上，单步推理即可匹配CrystalFlow的性能，五步推理则取得更高的结构预测准确率。结果表明，uFlowCSP提升了每次网络评估所获得的精度，而不仅仅是追求最高精度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是计算材料发现的基础。包括CDVAE、DiffCSP、FlowMM和CrystalFlow在内的生成模型能够直接学习稳定晶体的分布，但扩散模型和流匹配模型在推理时需要对每个候选结构进行数十次到数千次连续网络评估。本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的CSP模型，它学习平均概率流速度，而不是瞬时概率流速度。该模型只需进行1至5次评估即可生成完整结构，实现了5倍至58倍的推理加速，同时保持相当或更好的性能。模型采用具有化学和对称性感知能力的Transformer，并结合规范化原子排序、全局组成信息以及逐标记化学嵌入。在训练阶段，模型还使用粗粒度晶体系统标记；尽管该标记在推理时被移除、推理仍仅依赖化学式，但它能够带来额外收益，尤其可以改善空间群的一致性。在MP-20数据集上，对于每个目标生成20个候选结构时，单步推理的结构匹配率为78.38%，与CrystalFlow的78.34%相当，但网络评估次数减少了100倍，实际耗时约降低10倍。五步推理的匹配率达到83.64%，高于CrystalFlow在2,000次评估下的78.34%和DiffCSP在约20,000次评估下的77.93%，同时评估次数减少了20倍。uFlowCSP生成10,000个结构仅需0.39至1.31分钟，而CrystalFlow和DiffCSP分别需要6.5分钟和76.1分钟。在CSPBench的按能量排序的前五个结构与空间群评价标准下，五步uFlowCSP的结构、空间群和共识匹配率分别达到72%、72%和65%。CrystalFlow在100步推理下的相应结果为78%、73%和68%，但在五步推理时下降至49%、32%和31%。因此，uFlowCSP提升的是每次网络评估所对应的精度，而不仅仅是最高精度。

articles.title: Apparent Zero-Momentum Signals from Magnon--Magnon Interference in Near-Field Spin-Wave Imaging
articles.title_zh: 近场自旋波成像中由磁振子-磁振子干涉产生的表观零动量信号
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09922v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially resolved measurements of coherent waves are commonly read as direct maps of the underlying eigenmode spectrum. We show that this interpretation fails in near-field imaging of multimode spin-wave transport. Scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry of yttrium iron garnet reveals pronounced apparent low-wave-vector signals at frequencies for which no propagating spin-wave mode exists. By tuning the probe-sample distance and modeling the anisotropic near-field response, we identify their origin as coherent mixing between directly excited Damon-Eshbach waves and defect- or transducer-scattered spin waves: the measured signal acquires spatial Fourier components at the difference wave vector kₑₓc-kₛcₐₜ, which can vanish even though both constituent waves carry finite momentum. These results establish that near-field spectra of coherent excitations are interferometric field spectra rather than eigenmode maps, providing both a caution and a framework for identifying scattering processes in nanoscale magnonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在多模自旋波输运的近场成像中，空间分辨测量结果并不一定直接对应底层本征模谱。利用扫描氮-空位磁力计，研究发现某些频率下存在明显的表观低波矢信号，尽管这些频率没有传播自旋波模。该信号源于直接激发的Damon-Eshbach波与缺陷或换能器散射自旋波之间的相干混合，说明近场谱本质上是干涉场谱而非本征模图谱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对相干波进行空间分辨测量时，通常会将测量结果解读为底层本征模谱的直接映射。本文表明，在多模自旋波输运的近场成像中，这种解读并不成立。对钇铁石榴石进行扫描氮-空位磁力测量发现，在某些不存在传播自旋波模的频率处，仍然出现明显的表观低波矢信号。通过调节探针与样品之间的距离并对各向异性的近场响应进行建模，研究确定这些信号源于直接激发的Damon-Eshbach波与缺陷或换能器散射的自旋波之间的相干混合：测量信号会获得位于差分波矢k_exc-k_scat处的空间傅里叶分量，即使组成干涉的两列波都携带有限动量，该差分波矢仍可能为零。这些结果表明，相干激发的近场谱是干涉场谱，而不是本征模图谱；同时，这项工作也为识别纳米尺度磁振子器件中的散射过程提供了警示和分析框架。

articles.title: Strong Impact of Halide Ordering on Structural Phase Transitions in Mixed Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 卤素排序对混合钙钛矿结构相变的显著影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixed halide perovskites are highly versatile semiconductors with applications in photovoltaics, light-emitting diodes, and photodetectors. Understanding their thermodynamic phase behavior is central to guiding compositional design and improving device stability. Here, we train machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) on density functional theory reference data for CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y, CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y, and CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y halide perovskites, enabling large-scale hybrid Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics simulations that sample both configurational and vibrational degrees of freedom. All three binary halide systems exhibit a miscibility gap, the extent of which correlates with halide ion size mismatch. The gaps in Br-Cl and Br-I close at low temperatures, while the Cl-I gap extends above room temperature. At temperatures above the miscibility gap (200 K to 500 K), all systems show a tendency toward layered halide ordering, with halide species preferentially occupying apical or equatorial octahedral sites. In CsPbBr3yI3-3y, this ordering occurs in a device-relevant temperature regime and is linked to the structural phase transitions, shifting transition temperatures by up to 100 K relative to randomly mixed structures. We attribute the strongly non-linear composition dependence of the orthorhombic-tetragonal phase boundary observed experimentally (a linear decrease followed by a plateau) to halide ordering. Introducing Rb on the A-site weakens halide ordering and eliminates the non-linear behavior, while narrowing the miscibility gap in both the Br-I and Br-Cl systems. These results establish halide ordering as a key determinant of structural phase stability in mixed-halide perovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y和CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y卤化物钙钛矿，基于密度泛函理论数据训练机器学习原子间势，并开展同时采样构型与振动自由度的大尺度混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟。三种二元卤素体系均表现出与卤素离子尺寸失配相关的混溶间隙，并倾向于形成层状卤素排序。结果表明，卤素排序是决定混合卤素钙钛矿结构相稳定性的关键因素，并可使相变温度相对于随机混合结构改变最多100 K。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合卤素钙钛矿是用途广泛的半导体，可应用于光伏、发光二极管和光电探测器。理解其热力学相行为对于指导成分设计和提高器件稳定性至关重要。本文利用密度泛函理论参考数据，为CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y和CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y卤化物钙钛矿训练了机器学习原子间势（MLIP），从而能够开展同时采样构型自由度和振动自由度的大尺度混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟。三种二元卤素体系均表现出混溶间隙，其范围与卤素离子之间的尺寸失配相关。Br-Cl和Br-I体系中的混溶间隙在低温下闭合，而Cl-I体系的混溶间隙则延伸至室温以上。在高于混溶间隙的温度范围内，即200 K至500 K，所有体系都表现出形成层状卤素排序的倾向，其中不同卤素优先占据八面体的顶端位点或赤道位点。在CsPbBr3yI3-3y中，这种排序发生在与器件相关的温度范围内，并与结构相变相关；相对于随机混合结构，它使相变温度最多移动100 K。我们将实验观察到的正交相-四方相边界对成分的强非线性依赖，即先线性下降后出现平台，归因于卤素排序。在A位引入Rb会削弱卤素排序并消除这种非线性行为，同时缩小Br-I和Br-Cl体系中的混溶间隙。这些结果表明，卤素排序是决定混合卤素钙钛矿结构相稳定性的关键因素。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作针对混合卤化物钙钛矿，基于密度泛函理论数据训练机器学习原子间势，并结合混合蒙特卡洛分子动力学模拟构型和振动自由度。研究发现不同卤素体系存在与离子尺寸失配相关的混溶间隙，并在一定温度范围内形成层状卤素有序排列。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、钙钛矿材料、蒙特卡洛模拟、分子动力学和相变研究高度相关。其结合构型无序与晶格振动的方法可用于研究卤素迁移、离子有序、动态缺陷及器件稳定性。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步将该类机器学习势用于含缺陷、应变或界面的混合卤化物钙钛矿，并研究卤素有序与载流子输运、非辐射复合和光致相分离之间的关系。建议重点阅读其势函数训练集构建、主动学习策略及混合蒙特卡洛实现。

articles.title: SIM-GRAPH: A universal guide to symmetric interactions
articles.title_zh: SIM-GRAPH：对称相互作用的通用指南
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry plays a central role throughout physics, from Fourier analysis on discrete lattices to the classification of elementary particles in the standard model. In finite quantum systems, symmetries are often discrete, such as reflection and rotational symmetries. Here, we present the SIM-GRAPH method (Symmetric Ising Models - Graph Reduction And Projected Hamiltonians), which uses such symmetries to efficiently calculate ground-state observables of interacting quantum systems. By projecting all interactions onto a symmetric subset of the system, the method effectively reduces the number of sites, thus providing an exponential speedup over standard exact diagonalization. Furthermore, we introduce two extensions that broaden the applicability of the method and allow for a controlled trade-off between computational cost and accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出SIM-GRAPH方法，即对称伊辛模型-图约化与投影哈密顿量方法，用于高效计算相互作用量子系统的基态可观测量。该方法将所有相互作用投影到系统的对称子集上，有效减少格点数目，相比标准精确对角化可实现指数级加速。作者还提出了两种扩展，以扩大方法适用范围，并在计算成本和精度之间实现可控权衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对称性在物理学的各个领域都发挥着核心作用，从离散晶格上的傅里叶分析到标准模型中基本粒子的分类，均是如此。在有限量子系统中，对称性通常是离散的，例如反射对称性和旋转对称性。本文提出SIM-GRAPH方法，即对称伊辛模型-图约化与投影哈密顿量方法，利用这些对称性高效计算相互作用量子系统的基态可观测量。通过将所有相互作用投影到系统的一个对称子集上，该方法有效减少了格点数目，因此相较于标准精确对角化能够实现指数级加速。此外，本文还介绍了两种扩展，拓宽了该方法的适用性，并允许在计算成本与精度之间进行可控权衡。

articles.title: Non-equilibrium dissipative stabilization of s- and d-wave superconductivity
articles.title_zh: s波与d波超导性的非平衡耗散稳定化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10062v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stabilizing superconductivity beyond its equilibrium regime has been one of the quests of nonequilibrium state engineering. We report the presence of nonthermal pairing gap in BCS superconductors coupled to two thermal baths, where one of the baths can be at a temperature well above the equilibrium T_c. Superconducting state is enabled by a highly non-equilibrium steady state stabilized by weak coupling to baths that break detailed balance condition. The steady-state is well described by a generalized Gibbs ensemble parametrized with chemical potentials for associated Bogoliubov quasiparticle. A strong, non-perturbative effect is reported for both s-wave and d-wave superconductors, and its possible realization in cavity-based experiments is discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了通过非平衡态工程将超导性稳定在平衡范围之外的可能性。结果表明，与两个热浴耦合的BCS超导体中可以形成非热配对能隙，即使其中一个热浴的温度远高于平衡临界温度。弱耦合热浴打破细致平衡并稳定高度非平衡的稳态，从而维持s波和d波超导态；该稳态可由以玻戈留波夫准粒子化学势参数化的广义吉布斯系综描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过非平衡态工程将超导性稳定在其平衡范围之外，一直是非平衡态调控领域的重要目标。本文报告了与两个热浴耦合的BCS超导体中存在非热配对能隙，其中一个热浴的温度可以远高于平衡临界温度Tc。超导态由一种高度非平衡的稳态维持，该稳态通过与热浴的弱耦合得到稳定，而热浴耦合会打破细致平衡条件。该稳态可以由一个广义吉布斯系综很好地描述，其中的参数是与玻戈留波夫准粒子相对应的化学势。研究发现，对于s波和d波超导体，这种效应都具有强烈的非微扰特征，并讨论了其在基于腔的实验中的可能实现方式。

articles.title: Reconfigurable field-free spin Hall nano-oscillators enabled by crystallographic anisotropy in epitaxial Co/Pt
articles.title_zh: 由外延Co/Pt中的晶体学各向异性实现的可重构无场自旋霍尔纳米振荡器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10131v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) are nanoscale microwave sources for wireless communication, neuromorphic computing and oscillator-based Ising machines, but conventional devices require a global magnetic bias. Here we replace this bias through crystallographic anisotropy in epitaxial Co/Pt. Growth of hcp Co with its c-axis in the film plane produces an anisotropy field of about 0.36 T and enables field-free auto-oscillations above 10 GHz in nanoconstriction SHNOs. The active current polarity is selected by the remanent magnetization, providing nonvolatile reconfiguration of the oscillation state. Micro-focused Brillouin light scattering confirms that the nonlinear response is confined to the nanoconstriction region. Lithographic control of the angle between the current and anisotropy axes tunes the excitation threshold and drives two spectral branches from separated modes to a dominant single branch, consistent with mutual synchronization. These results establish epitaxial crystallographic anisotropy as a route to reconfigurable field-free spintronic oscillators and oscillator networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用外延Co/Pt中的晶体学各向异性取代传统的全局磁偏置，实现了无外场自旋霍尔纳米振荡。面内取向的六方密排Co晶体c轴产生约0.36 T的各向异性场，使纳米收缩型器件能够在10 GHz以上发生自振荡。剩磁方向决定工作电流极性，并允许非易失性重构振荡状态；电流与各向异性轴之间的夹角则可调节激发阈值并控制谱支之间的同步行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋霍尔纳米振荡器（SHNO）是用于无线通信、神经形态计算和基于振荡器的伊辛机的纳米尺度微波源，但传统器件需要全局磁偏置。本文利用外延Co/Pt中的晶体学各向异性取代这一偏置。生长c轴位于薄膜平面内的六方密排Co，可产生约0.36 T的各向异性场，并使纳米收缩型SHNO能够在无外加磁场条件下于10 GHz以上实现自振荡。工作电流的极性由剩磁方向选择，从而可以对振荡状态进行非易失性重构。微聚焦布里渊光散射测量证实，非线性响应局限于纳米收缩区域。通过光刻控制电流方向与各向异性轴之间的夹角，可以调节激发阈值，并使两个谱支从彼此分离的模式演化为由单一主导谱支构成的状态，这与相互同步相一致。这些结果表明，外延晶体学各向异性可以成为实现可重构无场自旋电子振荡器及振荡器网络的一条途径。

articles.title: Anizotropic Ising Model on 2D Kagomé Lattice as an Inhomogeneous XYZ Integrable Model
articles.title_zh: 作为非均匀XYZ可积模型的二维卡戈梅晶格各向异性伊辛模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a generalized inhomogeneous two-dimensional Ising model on the kagomé lattice with two alternating couplings Jᵢ and J'ᵢ, i=1,2,3, along the three lattice directions. The local Boltzmann weights are mapped onto a non-symmetric eight-vertex R-matrix satisfying the free-fermion condition for arbitrary values of the six couplings. We analyze the Yang--Baxter structure for the cases J'ᵢ=Jᵢ and J'ᵢ=-Jᵢ and derive the corresponding one-dimensional quantum spin chains in the anisotropic limit. The first case yields a transverse-field Ising-type Hamiltonian, while the second leads to a modified chain with a graded permutation structure and shifted partition-function zeros. For a partially anisotropic model, we also obtain the free energy and specific heat.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了二维卡戈梅晶格上的广义非均匀伊辛模型，其中沿三个晶格方向分别存在两组交替耦合。局部玻尔兹曼权重被映射为满足自由费米子条件的非对称八顶点R矩阵，并分析了两类耦合关系下的杨-巴克斯特结构。各向异性极限分别导出横场伊辛型量子自旋链和具有分次置换结构的修正自旋链，同时还获得了部分各向异性模型的自由能与比热。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了卡戈梅晶格上的广义非均匀二维伊辛模型，该模型沿三个晶格方向分别具有两组交替耦合Ji和J'i，其中i=1,2,3。局部玻尔兹曼权重被映射为一个非对称八顶点R矩阵，并且对于这六个耦合的任意取值，该矩阵都满足自由费米子条件。本文分析了J'i=Ji和J'i=-Ji两种情形下的杨-巴克斯特结构，并在各向异性极限下推导了相应的一维量子自旋链。第一种情形给出横场伊辛型哈密顿量；第二种情形则导出具有分次置换结构且配分函数零点发生平移的修正自旋链。对于部分各向异性模型，本文还得到了自由能和比热。

articles.title: Fast, Accurate, and Scalable Fermionic Neural Networks via Translation Equivariance
articles.title_zh: 通过平移等变性实现快速、精确且可扩展的费米子神经网络
