articles.title: A Novel Approach to Computing the Permanent Magnet Thickness in PMSMs
articles.title_zh: 永磁同步电机中永磁体厚度计算的新方法
articles.abstract: To address the low accuracy of empirical formulas and the time-consuming nature of finite-element (FE) parametric sweeps for permanent magnet (PM) thickness in permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs), a novel iterative approach for calculating the PM thickness is presented. The method first establishes a FE model using an initial thickness, extracts the leakage factor, reluctivity, and average air-gap flux density, and then iteratively updates the thickness using the calculation formula. A 1600 kW, 250 r/min U-shaped interior PMSM is taken as the test case for validation. The results indicate that the proposed method reduces the calculation time by about 75% compared to the FE parametric sweep method, and yields identical thickness results. Both electromagnetic performance analysis and prototype tests confirm that the proposed method enhances design efficiency without sacrificing accuracy, and is applicable to the fast calculation of PM thickness for PMSMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对经验公式精度低以及有限元参数扫描计算永磁体厚度耗时较长的问题，本文提出了一种迭代计算方法。该方法基于初始厚度建立有限元模型，提取漏磁系数、磁阻率和平均气隙磁密，并利用计算公式迭代更新永磁体厚度。以一台1600 kW、250 r/min的U形内置式永磁同步电机为例，结果表明，该方法在保持精度的同时可将计算时间缩短约75%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为解决永磁同步电机中永磁体厚度经验公式精度低以及有限元参数扫描耗时较长的问题，本文提出了一种计算永磁体厚度的新型迭代方法。该方法首先利用初始厚度建立有限元模型，提取漏磁系数、磁阻率和平均气隙磁密，然后使用计算公式对厚度进行迭代更新。本文以一台1600 kW、250 r/min的U形内置式永磁同步电机为测试对象进行验证。结果表明，与有限元参数扫描方法相比，所提出的方法可将计算时间缩短约75%，并得到相同的厚度结果。电磁性能分析和样机试验均证实，所提出的方法在不牺牲精度的情况下提高了设计效率，并适用于永磁同步电机永磁体厚度的快速计算。

articles.title: Thermo-Relational State Inference for Lithium-Ion Battery SOC Estimation under Dynamic Thermal Excitation
articles.title_zh: 动态热激励下用于锂离子电池荷电状态估计的热关系状态推断
articles.abstract: Accurate state-of-charge (SOC) estimation under dynamic thermal excitation is complicated by the time-varying relationship between terminal measurements and latent charge state. Existing data-driven estimators commonly append ambient temperature to the input vector or use it to reweight individual features, but rarely model how thermal evolution alters pairwise historical relevance. This study proposes a Thermo-Relational State Inference Network (TRSI-Net), formulating SOC estimation as thermally conditioned relational inference. Thermally Conditioned Affine Recalibration adaptively reconstructs latent electrical representations using ambient temperature, its temporal variation, and the surface-to-ambient thermal difference. A Thermal Relation Field combines relative temporal separation with pairwise thermal-state discrepancy and is embedded into Thermo-Relational Memory Attention to organize causal history. Global Relational Readout then aggregates the relation-enhanced memory for SOC regression. Evaluated on the Panasonic NCR18650PF dataset, TRSI-Net achieved an MAE of 0.47%, an RMSE of 0.56%, and an R² of 99.94%, reducing MAE and RMSE by 62.1% and 65.0%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline. Ablation results confirmed the contributions of thermal recalibration, thermo-relational modeling, relational-memory formation, and global memory aggregation. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling thermal-state-dependent historical relationships improves SOC tracking under dynamic thermal excitation.
articles.abstract_zh: 动态热激励下，端部测量量与潜在荷电状态之间的时变关系增加了SOC估计的复杂性。本文提出热关系状态推断网络TRSI-Net，将SOC估计建模为热条件关系推断，并通过热条件仿射重校准、热关系场和热关系记忆注意力组织历史信息。在Panasonic NCR18650PF数据集上，该方法取得0.47%的MAE、0.56%的RMSE和99.94%的R²，相较最强基线分别将MAE和RMSE降低62.1%和65.0%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在动态热激励下进行准确的荷电状态（SOC）估计较为复杂，这是因为端部测量量与潜在荷电状态之间的关系会随时间变化。现有的数据驱动估计器通常将环境温度附加到输入向量中，或利用环境温度对各个特征进行重新加权，但很少对热演化如何改变历史信息两两相关性进行建模。本文提出一种热关系状态推断网络（Thermo-Relational State Inference Network，TRSI-Net），将SOC估计表述为热条件关系推断问题。热条件仿射重校准模块利用环境温度、环境温度的时间变化以及表面与环境之间的温差，自适应地重构潜在电气表征。热关系场将相对时间间隔与成对热状态差异相结合，并嵌入热关系记忆注意力模块，以组织具有因果关系的历史信息。随后，全局关系读出模块对经过关系增强的记忆进行聚合，从而实现SOC回归。在Panasonic NCR18650PF数据集上的评估结果显示，TRSI-Net取得了0.47%的平均绝对误差（MAE）、0.56%的均方根误差（RMSE）和99.94%的决定系数（R²）；与最强基线相比，MAE和RMSE分别降低了62.1%和65.0%。消融实验结果证实了热重校准、热关系建模、关系记忆构建以及全局记忆聚合各部分的贡献。这些结果表明，显式建模依赖热状态的历史关系能够改善动态热激励下的SOC跟踪性能。

articles.title: Spatial configurations in rehabilitated social housing: a relational analysis of design patterns in Brazil
articles.title_zh: 改造型社会住房中的空间构型：巴西设计模式的关系分析
articles.abstract: The rehabilitation of vacant buildings in central urban areas constitutes a promising – yet still underexplored in Brazil – alternative for delivering social housing (SH) in a more sustainable and spatially integrated manner. This article aims to characterize rehabilitated buildings through design patterns, based on the theory of Christopher Alexander, which proposes solutions oriented toward enhancing architectural and urban qualities. Initially, patterns potentially applicable to this context were identified, forming a relational analytical framework: rather than being examined in isolation, they are analyzed in terms of co-occurrence, considering their combined effects and topological performance within the design structure of buildings. Subsequently, this framework is applied to a sample of ten rehabilitated buildings in Brazil, using architectural documentation and on-site visits. Data analysis was conducted through the construction of networks in VOSviewer, complemented by centrality metrics (Degree and Betweenness Centrality) to interpret their relational structure. The results indicate the presence of strongly connected design cores and patterns that perform articulating roles across different spatial scales, suggesting the existence of a recurring spatial grammar in the context of rehabilitation. Additionally, they show that the configuration of SH produced through rehabilitation tends to result from the articulation between constructive attributes, functional organization, collective spaces, and urban insertion. This analytical reading provides support for the formulation of design guidelines and the improvement of evidence-based public policies aimed at housing provision in central urban areas.
articles.abstract_zh: 在巴西，改造中心城区闲置建筑是以更可持续且空间融合的方式提供社会住房的一种有前景但仍研究不足的途径。本文基于克里斯托弗·亚历山大的模式理论，构建关系分析框架，并通过共现关系研究设计模式在10座巴西改造建筑中的组合效应和拓扑表现。结果显示，建筑中存在联系紧密的设计核心以及跨越不同空间尺度的连接模式，表明改造社会住房中可能存在反复出现的空间语法。研究可为设计导则制定和以证据为基础的中心城区住房公共政策改进提供支持。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在中心城区改造闲置建筑，是以更加可持续且空间融合的方式提供社会住房（SH）的一种有前景但在巴西仍未得到充分探索的替代方案。本文旨在基于设计模式对改造建筑进行表征。该方法以克里斯托弗·亚历山大的理论为基础，该理论提出了旨在提升建筑和城市品质的解决方案。首先，研究识别出可能适用于这一情境的模式，并建立关系分析框架：这些模式并非被孤立考察，而是根据其共现关系进行分析，同时考虑其组合效应以及在建筑设计结构中的拓扑性能。随后，研究利用建筑资料和现场考察，将该框架应用于巴西10座改造建筑样本。数据分析通过在VOSviewer中构建网络完成，并结合中心性指标（度中心性和中介中心性）解释其关系结构。结果表明，改造建筑中存在联系紧密的设计核心，以及在不同空间尺度之间发挥连接作用的模式，这提示该改造情境中可能存在一种反复出现的空间语法。此外，结果还显示，通过改造形成的社会住房空间构型，往往源于建造属性、功能组织、集体空间和城市嵌入之间的协调组合。这种分析视角可为制定设计导则以及改进旨在中心城区住房供给的循证公共政策提供支持。

articles.title: Development of a Biomimetic Agarose–Calcium Lactate Gluconate Composite Scaffold for Trabecular Bone Regeneration
articles.title_zh: 用于松质骨再生的仿生琼脂糖–乳酸葡萄糖酸钙复合支架的开发
articles.abstract: Calcium-based biomaterials have attracted significant interest due to their high biocompatibility and resemblance to natural bone architecture. They facilitate direct bone ingrowth and integration with host bone, making them highly effective for bone regeneration and osteoconductivity. According to recent research, the use of calcium-based materials in tissue engineering has advanced substantially. The aim of this study was therefore to develop a novel three-dimensional (3D) scaffold using calcium lactate gluconate (CLG) and to examine its osteogenic potential. Agarose (3%) containing CLG (3%, 5%, 10%, and 15%) scaffolds were fabricated using the freeze-drying method. The physicochemical and morphological analysis of all samples was performed using field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), energy-dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX), Elemental mapping, X-ray diffraction (XRD), Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET), and MicroCT analysis. Characterization of the composite scaffolds revealed a highly biomimetic, highly porous scaffold architecture and exhibited enhanced compressive strength and elastic modulus compared with the Agarose control sample. The in vitro experiments conducted with human pre-osteoblast cells (MG-63) revealed that the fabricated scaffolds were well compatible and supported cell adhesion and proliferation, favoring the enhanced porosity of the composite scaffolds. The in vitro haemocompatibility test indicated that the composite scaffolds had significantly lower hemolysis and a better blood clotting index than the control. CLG scaffolds also demonstrated upregulation of osteogenic differentiation markers, as assessed by quantitative real-time PCR and the Alizarin staining method, respectively. The results indicated that the CLG-functionalized scaffolds are a suitable candidate for bone tissue remodeling and potential applications in bone regeneration.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文旨在利用乳酸葡萄糖酸钙（CLG）开发新型三维骨组织工程支架，并评估其成骨潜力。研究采用冷冻干燥法制备含3%琼脂糖和不同浓度CLG（3%、5%、10%和15%）的支架，并通过多种技术分析其理化性质、形貌和孔结构。复合支架表现出高度仿生且多孔的结构，其压缩强度和弹性模量均优于琼脂糖对照组。体外实验表明，支架具有良好的细胞相容性，能够促进细胞黏附、增殖和成骨分化，并具有较低的溶血率和更好的凝血指数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钙基生物材料因其良好的生物相容性以及与天然骨结构的相似性而受到广泛关注。它们能够促进骨组织直接长入并与宿主骨整合，因此在骨再生和骨传导方面具有很高的有效性。根据近期研究，钙基材料在组织工程中的应用已经取得了长足进展。因此，本研究旨在利用乳酸葡萄糖酸钙（CLG）开发一种新型三维（3D）支架，并考察其成骨潜力。研究采用冷冻干燥法制备含有CLG（3%、5%、10%和15%）的3%琼脂糖支架。所有样品均通过场发射扫描电子显微镜（FESEM）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、能量色散X射线分析（EDX）、元素 mapping、X射线衍射（XRD）、Brunauer–Emmett–Teller（BET）分析和MicroCT分析进行理化性质和形貌表征。复合支架的表征结果显示，其具有高度仿生且高度多孔的支架结构；与琼脂糖对照样品相比，复合支架表现出增强的压缩强度和弹性模量。使用人类成骨前细胞（MG-63）开展的体外实验表明，所制备的支架具有良好的相容性，并能够支持细胞黏附和增殖，而复合支架增强的孔隙率有利于上述过程。体外血液相容性测试表明，与对照组相比，复合支架具有显著更低的溶血率和更好的血液凝固指数。通过定量实时PCR和茜素染色方法对成骨分化标志物进行评估，结果显示CLG支架还能够促进成骨分化标志物上调。研究结果表明，CLG功能化支架是骨组织重塑的适宜候选材料，并具有应用于骨再生的潜力。

articles.title: Pre-Fabrication to Post-Deployment: A Unified ML-Driven Pipeline for IC Logic Locking
articles.title_zh: 从预制造到部署后：用于集成电路逻辑加锁的统一机器学习驱动流程
articles.abstract: Every integrated circuit (IC) in the globally distributed semiconductor supply chain is a potential target for intellectual property (IP) piracy, reverse engineering, and hardware tampering. Logic locking is a widely adopted defense primitive, yet its effectiveness is constrained by three limitations: technique selection is largely manual and circuit-agnostic; static key-gate schemes are vulnerable to oracle-guided and structural attacks; and post-deployment security remains largely unaddressed. This paper presents a unified, four-stage machine learning (ML)-driven pipeline that addresses these limitations within a single automated framework spanning the complete IC protection lifecycle. A supervised Random Forest classifier extracts structural features from gate-level netlists and predicts the most appropriate technique from a portfolio of five classical locking schemes, achieving up to 97% prediction accuracy. Circuits are then secured either through fault-guided key-gate insertion or through STREAMLOCK, a lightweight stream cipher-based mechanism whose continuously evolving keystream replaces the fixed key-to-output relationship exploited by oracle-guided and structural attacks. Dynamic Partial Reconfiguration (DPR) then enables runtime key-gate updates on FPGA fabric without system interruption. Experimental evaluation across ISCAS'85 benchmarks confirms 100% functional correctness under the correct key. A three-way comparison among classical, STREAMLOCK, and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)-based locking demonstrates that STREAMLOCK achieves up to 9.3× lower Look-Up Table (LUT) utilization and up to 20.8× lower logic power than AES, while delivering cryptographically stronger protection than classical schemes. DPR integration introduces only a 5.92% increase in total power consumption and a 0.011% increase in LUT utilization. Together, these results establish a scalable and hardware-efficient IC protection pipeline.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对集成电路知识产权盗版、逆向工程和硬件篡改风险，本文提出了覆盖完整保护生命周期的四阶段机器学习驱动统一流程。该流程利用监督式随机森林分类器从门级网表中提取结构特征，并在五种经典加锁方案中预测最合适的技术，最高预测准确率达到97%；随后结合故障引导密钥门插入或STREAMLOCK机制保护电路，并通过动态部分重构实现运行时密钥更新。在ISCAS'85基准电路上的实验表明，STREAMLOCK相较AES可将查找表资源占用最多降低9.3倍、逻辑功耗最多降低20.8倍，而动态部分重构仅使总功耗增加5.92%、查找表资源占用增加0.011%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全球分布式半导体供应链中的每一块集成电路（IC）都可能成为知识产权（IP）盗版、逆向工程和硬件篡改的目标。逻辑加锁是一种广泛采用的防御原语，但其有效性受到三项限制：技术选择在很大程度上依赖人工且与电路无关；静态密钥门方案容易受到预言机引导攻击和结构攻击；部署后的安全性也基本未得到解决。本文提出一种统一的四阶段机器学习（ML）驱动流程，在单一自动化框架内覆盖完整的IC保护生命周期，以应对上述限制。监督式随机森林分类器从门级网表中提取结构特征，并从五种经典加锁方案组成的技术组合中预测最合适的方案，最高预测准确率达到97%。随后，电路通过故障引导的密钥门插入机制或STREAMLOCK进行保护。STREAMLOCK是一种轻量级流密码机制，其持续演化的密钥流取代了预言机引导攻击和结构攻击所利用的固定密钥到输出关系。之后，动态部分重构（DPR）使FPGA硬件能够在系统不中断的情况下更新运行时密钥。在ISCAS'85基准电路上的实验评估证实，使用正确密钥时功能正确率达到100%。对经典方案、STREAMLOCK和基于高级加密标准（AES）的加锁方案进行三方比较表明，与AES相比，STREAMLOCK的查找表（LUT）资源占用最多降低9.3倍，逻辑功耗最多降低20.8倍，同时能够提供比经典方案更强的密码学保护。DPR集成仅使总功耗增加5.92%，并使LUT资源占用增加0.011%。综合来看，这些结果确立了一种具有可扩展性和硬件高效性的IC保护流程。

articles.title: Rapid and non-destructive identification of micro-contaminants on eggshell surfaces based on machine vision and deep learning
articles.title_zh: 基于机器视觉与深度学习的蛋壳表面微污染物快速无损识别
articles.abstract: Aiming at the problems of missed detection and false detection caused by the small size, low contrast, and complex eggshell background texture of micro-contaminants on eggshell surfaces, a high-precision detection method based on an improved YOLOv8s model was proposed in this study. First, in the data preprocessing stage, ROI extraction and background normalization methods were used to effectively suppress conveyor belt texture and environmental noise interference, and enhance the visual saliency of contaminant regions.Second, in terms of network structure, an AIFI module was introduced to enhance the global interaction ability of high-level features, and combined with the EMA attention mechanism to adaptively recalibrate key features, thereby suppressing eggshell background noise. Meanwhile, a four-scale detection architecture integrating the P2 layer was constructed to improve the model's detection capability for micro-contaminant targets. The results show that the proposed image preprocessing method could effectively suppress complex background interference and enhance the distinguishability of contaminant regions, thereby providing more stable input for subsequent feature learning. On this basis, the improved AEP2-YOLOv8s model achieves 79.9% mAP@0.5 and 45.2% mAP@0.5:0.95 on the self-built dataset, which are 6.7 percentage points and 2.1 percentage points higher than the original YOLOv8s, respectively.This method can effectively improve the detection performance of micro-contaminants on eggshell surfaces and provides a feasible technical solution for automated egg sorting.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对蛋壳表面微污染物尺寸小、对比度低且背景纹理复杂导致的漏检和误检问题，本文提出了一种基于改进YOLOv8s模型的高精度检测方法。该方法利用感兴趣区域提取和背景归一化抑制传送带纹理及环境噪声，并引入AIFI模块、EMA注意力机制和包含P2层的四尺度检测结构，以增强特征交互、抑制背景干扰并提升微小目标检测能力。在自建数据集上，改进的AEP2-YOLOv8s模型取得79.9%的mAP@0.5和45.2%的mAP@0.5:0.95，较原始YOLOv8s分别提高6.7和2.1个百分点，为自动化鸡蛋分选提供了可行方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 针对蛋壳表面微污染物尺寸小、对比度低以及蛋壳背景纹理复杂所造成的漏检和误检问题，本研究提出了一种基于改进YOLOv8s模型的高精度检测方法。首先，在数据预处理阶段，采用感兴趣区域（ROI）提取和背景归一化方法，有效抑制传送带纹理和环境噪声干扰，并增强污染物区域的视觉显著性。其次，在网络结构方面，引入AIFI模块以增强高层特征的全局交互能力，并结合EMA注意力机制对关键特征进行自适应重校准，从而抑制蛋壳背景噪声。同时，构建了融合P2层的四尺度检测结构，以提升模型对微污染物目标的检测能力。结果表明，所提出的图像预处理方法能够有效抑制复杂背景干扰并增强污染物区域的可辨识性，从而为后续特征学习提供更加稳定的输入。在此基础上，改进的AEP2-YOLOv8s模型在自建数据集上取得了79.9%的mAP@0.5和45.2%的mAP@0.5:0.95，分别比原始YOLOv8s提高6.7个百分点和2.1个百分点。该方法能够有效提升蛋壳表面微污染物的检测性能，并为自动化鸡蛋分选提供可行的技术方案。

As quantum computers have grown more powerful, researchers have devised increasingly sophisticated ways to test whether these machines are truly harnessing quantum effects—but every method so far has run into limits.
articles.abstract_zh: 数十年来，物理学家一直通过真实实验验证量子力学的奇异预言。随着量子计算机能力不断增强，研究人员设计了越来越复杂的方法来检验这些机器是否真正利用了量子效应，但迄今为止的每种方法都遇到了局限。

articles.title: Physics-informed symbolic regression reveals a delayed oscillatory closure for particle–interface dynamics
articles.title_zh: 物理信息符号回归揭示了粒子—界面动力学中的延迟振荡闭合关系
articles.abstract: Particles settling through sharply density-stratified fluids exhibit transient dynamics that remain difficult to capture with classical buoyancy–drag models, including strong deceleration, prolonged retention near the interface, and, in some cases, apparent bouncing. Existing mechanistic models that reproduce parts of this behavior through the equation of motion rely on auxiliary artificial virtual-mass ODEs whose physical interpretation and predictive generality are limited. In this study, we demonstrate implementation of physics-informed symbolic regression (PISR) method, applied to high-resolution dataset of particle-tracking experiments across stratified interface, enabling a compact analytical closure for the delayed stratification-induced force acting on spheres crossing sharp density interfaces, replacing an virtual mass ODE and capturing complex transient dynamics. Using fully resolved position-time trajectories of spheres from water–salt and water–glycerol stratified experiments, the PISR framework is designed to select a delayed, exponentially damped oscillatory force closure that is consistent with physical mechanisms of interfacial memory, wake detachment, recoil, and viscous relaxation. The resulting force closure reproduces qualitatively and quantitatively key features of the observed sphere dynamics and improves reconstruction transient-rich cases relative to a virtual-mass-based baseline. More broadly, the study demonstrates how scientist-in-the-loop or physically-informed symbolic regression (SR) can assist physical-model discovery by combining fully resolved time series experimental data, dimensional and physical constraints, and physically interpretable analytical model selection. These results provide a practical modeling framework for sphere motion across stably-stratified density interfaces and illustrate the potential of artificial intelligence assisted SR for extracting compact, testable closures in complex fluid dynamics problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用物理信息符号回归分析分层流体中颗粒穿越尖锐密度界面的高分辨率跟踪实验数据，建立了描述延迟分层诱导力的紧凑解析闭合关系。该闭合关系表现为延迟的指数衰减振荡形式，可捕捉界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等机制，并在瞬态丰富的情形下优于基于虚质量方程的模型。研究表明，结合时间序列实验数据、量纲约束和物理约束的符号回归能够辅助复杂流体动力学中的可解释模型发现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 颗粒在具有明显密度分层的流体中沉降时，会表现出难以用经典浮力—阻力模型描述的瞬态动力学，包括强烈减速、在界面附近长时间滞留，以及某些情况下看似发生反弹的现象。现有的一些机理模型通过运动方程中的辅助人工虚质量常微分方程再现了部分行为，但这些方程的物理解释和预测普适性有限。在本研究中，我们展示了物理信息符号回归（PISR）方法的实现，并将其应用于分层界面中颗粒跟踪实验的高分辨率数据集，从而为球体穿越尖锐密度界面时所受的延迟分层诱导力建立了紧凑的解析闭合关系，取代虚质量常微分方程并捕捉复杂的瞬态动力学。研究使用了水—盐和水—甘油分层实验中球体完全解析的位置—时间轨迹。PISR框架旨在选择一种延迟的、指数阻尼振荡形式的力闭合关系，该关系与界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等物理机制相一致。所得力闭合关系定性和定量地再现了观测到的球体动力学关键特征，并且相较于基于虚质量的基线模型，改善了对瞬态特征丰富案例的重构效果。更广泛地说，本研究表明，科学家参与式或物理信息符号回归能够通过结合完全解析的时间序列实验数据、量纲与物理约束，以及具有物理可解释性的解析模型选择，辅助物理模型发现。这些结果为稳定分层密度界面中的球体运动提供了实用的建模框架，并展示了人工智能辅助符号回归从复杂流体动力学问题中提取紧凑且可检验闭合关系的潜力。

articles.title: Textured Si Wafer-Assisted Fabrication of Stretchable Platinum Nanotube Network Electrodes for Flexible Piezoelectric Devices
articles.title_zh: 纹理化硅晶圆辅助制备可拉伸铂纳米管网络电极及其在柔性压电器件中的应用
articles.abstract: Flexible and stretchable electrodes are essential components for soft electronic devices that operate under repeated mechanical deformation. However, conventional metal thin-film electrodes often suffer from crack formation and electrical failure because of the mechanical mismatch between rigid metal layers and elastomeric substrates. In this study, we present a textured Si-assisted fabrication strategy for stretchable platinum nanotube (Pt-NT) network electrodes. Electrospun polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) nanofibers on a textured Si wafer were used as sacrificial one-dimensional templates for Pt sputtering, enabling the formation of Pt-coated fibrous networks with controlled electrical continuity. Increasing the sputtering time increased the apparent Pt coating thickness and reduced the sheet resistance, indicating the development of interconnected Pt pathways. After thermal removal of the PVP template and transfer into polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS), the Pt-NT electrode exhibited a low sheet resistance of 7.55 Ω sq− 1. Under mechanical deformation, the Pt thin-film electrode showed electrical failure during bending and failed above 20% tensile strain, whereas the Pt-NT electrode maintained conductive pathways even at 100% strain. The Pt-NT electrode was further integrated with a BaTiO3-PDMS piezoelectric composite layer, producing an output current of approximately 40 nA under an applied force of 25 N at 3 Hz. These results demonstrate that textured Si-assisted Pt-NT network electrodes can serve as deformable electrode platforms for flexible piezoelectric devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出了一种纹理化硅辅助的可拉伸铂纳米管网络电极制备策略，以静电纺丝聚乙烯吡咯烷酮纳米纤维作为牺牲模板，通过溅射铂形成具有连续导电通路的纤维网络。去除模板并转移至聚二甲基硅氧烷后，电极的方块电阻为7.55欧姆/方，并可承受高达100%的拉伸应变，而传统铂薄膜在弯曲和超过20%的拉伸应变下即发生失效。该电极与钛酸钡—聚二甲基硅氧烷压电复合层集成后，在25牛顿、3赫兹外力下产生约40纳安输出电流，显示出其作为柔性压电器件可变形电极平台的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 柔性和可拉伸电极是软电子器件的重要组成部分，这些器件需要在反复机械变形下工作。然而，传统金属薄膜电极通常会因刚性金属层与弹性体基底之间的机械失配而产生裂纹并发生电学失效。在本研究中，我们提出了一种纹理化硅辅助的可拉伸铂纳米管（Pt-NT）网络电极制备策略。以纹理化硅晶圆上的静电纺丝聚乙烯吡咯烷酮（PVP）纳米纤维作为一维牺牲模板，通过溅射铂形成具有受控电连续性的铂包覆纤维网络。增加溅射时间会提高表观铂涂层厚度并降低方块电阻，表明互连铂导电通路逐渐形成。在热去除PVP模板并将其转移至聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）后，Pt-NT电极表现出7.55欧姆/方的低方块电阻。在机械变形下，铂薄膜电极在弯曲过程中出现电学失效，并在拉伸应变超过20%时失效；而Pt-NT电极即使在100%应变下仍能保持导电通路。随后，Pt-NT电极与钛酸钡（BaTiO3）—PDMS压电复合层集成，在25牛顿、3赫兹外力作用下产生约40纳安的输出电流。这些结果表明，纹理化硅辅助的Pt-NT网络电极能够作为柔性压电器件的可变形电极平台。

articles.title: Geospatial Assessment of Urban Growth Patterns and Its Impact on Land Surface Temperature
articles.title_zh: 城市增长模式的地理空间评估及其对地表温度的影响
articles.abstract: The rapid urbanization strongly influences the land surface characteristics and aggravates the environmental problems, such as Surface Urban Heat Island (SUHI) effect. The present study focuses on the effect of urban growth pattern on Land Surface Temperature (LST) and precipitation variability in Dera Ghazi Khan, Punjab, Pakistan during 25 years, 2000-2025. The study combines the use of Remote Sensing (RS), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Google Earth Engine (GEE), and statistical modeling to analyze the temporal and spatial associations of Land Use/Land Cover (LULC) alteration with the thermal environment. The multi-temporal data from Landsat missions and Sentinel-2 datasets was used to categorize the study area into four major classes of LULC namely Water Body, Built-up, Agriculture, and Barren Land. Using a Random Forest machine learning classification model, the LULC map was created for six observation years (2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020 and 2025). Spectral indices such as Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and Normalized Difference Built-up Index (NDBI) were derived to evaluate the vegetation density and urban expansion. The data for Land Surface Temperature was obtained by calculating using thermal infrared bands, and the data of precipitation was obtained from climate datasets included in Google Earth Engine. The Getis-Ord Gi statistic in ArcMap was used for spatial hotspot analysis, while Pearson correlation and linear regression analysis in Microsoft Excel were used to examine the statistical relationships. The outcomes showed significant urban growth for Dera Ghazi Khan during the study period. The extent of built-up land had grown from about 354 Sq. Km in 2000 to nearly 570 Sq. Km in 2025. The area of barren land decreased sharply and the area of Km increased. Results of the analysis showed that high built-up density and high NDBI values were correlated with high LST values. However, vegetation dominated agricultural areas and water bodies showed lower thermal signatures because of the effects of evapotranspiration and thermal inertia. There was also a variation in the average LSTs in the years 2015, with around 49°C, that was attributed to the precipitation variability, where years with higher precipitations also had better vegetation conditions and less thermal stress. The hotspot analysis revealed the spatial growth of thermal hotspots from urban core to periphery. The strong relationship between urban expansion and increase in surface temperature was further verified by statistical analysis. The results show that SUHI effect has been intensified to a great extent in an uncontrolled urbanization phenomenon and has changed the thermal environment of the region of Dera Ghazi Khan. The study offers a valuable scientific foundation for sustainable urban planning and adaptation to climate change in the fast-expanding secondary cities of arid and semi-arid areas. Geographical information systems (GIS) and statistical modeling are powerful tools for urban environmental change monitoring and evidence-based policymaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究结合遥感、地理信息系统、Google Earth Engine和统计建模，分析了2000年至2025年巴基斯坦旁遮普省德拉·加齐·汗城市增长模式与地表温度及降水变化之间的关系。结果显示，建成区面积约从354平方千米增至570平方千米，高建成区密度和高NDBI值与较高地表温度相关，而农业区和水体因蒸散和热惯性表现出较低热特征。研究认为，无序城市化显著强化了地表城市热岛效应，并可为干旱及半干旱地区快速扩张的中小城市开展可持续规划和气候变化适应提供科学依据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 快速城市化强烈影响地表特征，并加剧地表城市热岛（SUHI）效应等环境问题。本研究聚焦于2000年至2025年25年间，巴基斯坦旁遮普省德拉·加齐·汗城市增长模式对地表温度（LST）和降水变化的影响。研究结合遥感（RS）、地理信息系统（GIS）、Google Earth Engine（GEE）和统计建模，分析土地利用/土地覆被（LULC）变化与热环境在时间和空间上的关联。研究使用Landsat系列任务和Sentinel-2数据，将研究区划分为水体、建成区、农业用地和荒地四个主要LULC类别。利用随机森林机器学习分类模型，研究为六个观测年份（2000年、2005年、2010年、2015年、2020年和2025年）建立了LULC地图。研究提取了归一化植被指数（NDVI）和归一化建筑指数（NDBI）等光谱指数，以评估植被密度和城市扩张情况。地表温度数据通过热红外波段计算获得，降水数据则来自Google Earth Engine中包含的气候数据集。研究使用ArcMap中的Getis-Ord Gi统计量进行空间热点分析，并通过Microsoft Excel中的皮尔逊相关分析和线性回归分析考察统计关系。结果显示，研究期间德拉·加齐·汗经历了显著的城市增长。建成区面积从2000年的约354平方千米增长到2025年的近570平方千米。荒地面积大幅减少，而某一类土地面积增加。分析结果表明，高建成区密度和较高的NDBI值与较高的LST值相关。然而，以植被为主的农业区和水体由于蒸散作用和热惯性而呈现较低的热信号。2015年的平均LST也出现变化，约为49摄氏度，这被归因于降水变化；降水较多的年份通常具有更好的植被状况和较低的热应激。热点分析显示，热热点在空间上从城市核心区向外围扩展。统计分析进一步验证了城市扩张与地表温度升高之间的密切关系。结果表明，在无序城市化现象下，SUHI效应在很大程度上得到强化，并改变了德拉·加齐·汗地区的热环境。本研究为快速扩张的干旱和半干旱地区中小城市的可持续城市规划和气候变化适应提供了有价值的科学基础。地理信息系统（GIS）和统计建模

articles.title: Multielement Characterization and Chemometric Evaluation of Commercial Tomato Samples
articles.title_zh: 商业番茄的多元素表征与化学计量学评估
articles.abstract: Tomatoes are among the most widely consumed vegetables worldwide and represent an important dietary source of essential minerals. In this study, the concentrations of eleven chemical elements (boron, calcium, copper, iron, magnesium, manganese, sodium, phosphorus, strontium, sulfur, and zinc) were determined in 49 commercial tomato samples by inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES) following closed-block acid digestion. Element concentrations (mg kg⁻¹, fresh weight) ranged from 0.62–23.10 (B), 28.59–112.52 (Ca), 0.16–1.99 (Cu), 2.09–96.00 (Fe), 45.95–99.49 (Mg), 0.61–4.10 (Mn), 2.93–91.39 (Na), 95.48–365.41 (P), 0.02–0.76 (Sr), 70.87–199.91 (S), and 0.79–3.40 (Zn), revealing considerable variability in elemental composition among samples. Principal component analysis (PCA) of the autoscaled dataset showed that the first four principal components explained 69.09% of the total variance, revealing two major and largely independent patterns of elemental variation. The first was driven primarily by calcium, magnesium, phosphorus, zinc, manganese, and strontium, whereas the second was associated mainly with boron, sodium, iron, sulfur, and copper. Hierarchical cluster analysis (HCA) supported the PCA findings by separating both variables and samples into two principal groups while identifying several compositionally distinct samples characterized by unusually high concentrations of specific elements. Overall, the results demonstrate substantial variability in the mineral composition of commercial tomatoes and confirm the value of chemometric tools for interpreting complex multielement datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究采用电感耦合等离子体发射光谱法测定了49份商业番茄样品中11种元素的含量，发现不同样品的元素组成存在显著差异。主成分分析表明，前四个主成分解释了总方差的69.09%，并揭示了两种主要且大体独立的元素变化模式。层次聚类分析支持主成分分析结果，显示出样品和变量的两大分组，并识别出若干具有特定元素异常高含量的样品。结果表明，化学计量学工具有助于解析商业番茄复杂的多元素组成数据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 番茄是全球消费量最大的蔬菜之一，也是膳食中必需矿物质的重要来源。在本研究中，采用电感耦合等离子体发射光谱法（ICP-OES），在封闭式消解装置中进行酸消解后，测定了49份商业番茄样品中11种化学元素（硼、钙、铜、铁、镁、锰、钠、磷、锶、硫和锌）的含量。以鲜重计，元素浓度（毫克/千克）范围分别为：硼0.62至23.10、钙28.59至112.52、铜0.16至1.99、铁2.09至96.00、镁45.95至99.49、锰0.61至4.10、钠2.93至91.39、磷95.48至365.41、锶0.02至0.76、硫70.87至199.91，以及锌0.79至3.40，表明不同样品的元素组成存在显著差异。对自动缩放数据集进行主成分分析（PCA）显示，前四个主成分解释了总方差的69.09%，揭示出两种主要且大体相互独立的元素变化模式。第一种模式主要由钙、镁、磷、锌、锰和锶驱动；第二种模式则主要与硼、钠、铁、硫和铜相关。层次聚类分析（HCA）支持PCA结果，将变量和样品分别分为两个主要组，同时识别出若干组成上具有区别的样品，这些样品的某些元素浓度异常偏高。总体而言，结果表明商业番茄的矿物质组成存在显著差异，并证实化学计量学工具对于解释复杂的多元素数据集具有重要价值。

articles.title: Superfluid qubit could help scale up quantum computers
articles.abstract: Superfluid helium could offer a new way to tackle one of the biggest challenges in scaling up quantum computers, say researchers from the University of Surrey. The research team has introduced a conceptual design for a new type of qubit that could be much less vulnerable to errors.

articles.title: Dark plasma regions reveal overlooked source of reactive atomic oxygen
articles.abstract: Scientists from Tokyo Metropolitan University have found a way to make plasma more effective for its wide-ranging uses, from antimicrobial applications to surface conditioning in the semiconductor industry. They mapped the production of atomic oxygen, a key ingredient of oxygen plasma, while a high voltage was applied across oxygen gas.

articles.title: High Gain Low Elements Counts Switched Capacitor based Multi-Level Inverter
articles.abstract: The proposed switched capacitor multi-level inverter can be utilized in photovoltaic, fuel cell, and battery systems to generate low harmonic content at output voltage. This topology, with the help of two sources, 9 switches, 9 drivers, 2 capacitors, and 2 diodes, can produce 11 voltage levels at its output. The advantages include voltage boosting, self-balancing of the capacitors, and higher voltage levels relative to components compared to similar structures. Furthermore, having switches that work at the low frequency of 50 Hz is an important advantage that can reduce switching losses. Due to the usage of the "nearest level" modulation scheme, the switches work at 50 Hz, which can lead to low total losses. In the proposed configuration, DC energy sources, such as photovoltaics and batteries, will be utilized as input sources. A comparison between the proposed topology and similar schemes has been made in terms of the number of levels, the number of switches, voltage gain, the ratio of voltage gains to the number of switches, and the ratio of voltage levels to all device numbers. The simulation results and experimental prototype of the proposed circuit have been practically implemented to prove the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articles.title: Robust Broadband Dielectric Bragg Reflectors by Sensitivity-Regularized Chirp: Transfer-Matrix Proofs and Computational Uncertainty Analysis
articles.abstract: Fabrication variability limits the degree to which broadband dielectric Bragg reflectors can realize spectra predicted by nominal quarter-wave designs. This work develops a sensitivity-regularized chirp strategy for one-dimensional dielectric reflectors and analyzes it with an exact transfer-matrix model, explicit perturbation identities, and reproducible uncertainty simulations. A ten-period high/low-index stack centered at 1550 nm is parameterized by a three-coefficient Chebyshev chirp, allowing the optical thickness of each period to vary smoothly while remaining close to the quarter-wave condition. The design objective combines worst-band reflectance, spectral ripple, local thickness sensitivity, and profile smoothness. Four analytical results establish unimodularity of the lossless layer matrix, flux-consistent reflection bounds, an exact derivative formula for the multilayer product, and a first-order reflectance perturbation inequality. Over 1400–1700 nm, the optimized design increases nominal minimum reflectance from 0.9481 for a uniform stack to 0.9725 while reducing aggregate local thickness sensitivity by approximately 37%. In 1,000 Monte Carlo realizations with independent 0.5% layer-thickness errors truncated at ± 1.5%, the fifth-percentile minimum reflectance is 0.9683, compared with 0.9391 for the uniform design, and the standard deviation of minimum reflectance is reduced by approximately 75%. The results show that modest, smooth departures from quarter-wave periodicity can improve both broadband floor reflectance and manufacturing tolerance without adding materials or layers. The framework is intended as a transparent computational design method for thin-film and integrated-photonic reflector engineering.

articles.title: Anthropogenic fibers contamination in the Antarctic sea urchin Sterechinus neumayeri and the scallop Adamussium colbecki from Terra Nova Bay, Ross Sea
articles.abstract: The Ross Sea region, despite being the world's largest Marine Protected Area (RSrMPA), is increasingly subjected to anthropogenic pressure from microplastic (MP) and microfibers (MF) pollution. This study assesses MFs occurrence in two key benthic species with distinct feeding strategies sampled from Terra Nova Bay: the filter-feeding scallop Adamussium colbecki and the deposit-feeding sea urchin Sterechinus neumayeri. MFs were found in all the individuals analyzed for both species. Scallops exhibited a higher mean abundance per individual (5.6 ± 1.53 MFs) compared to sea urchins (2.6 ± 2.07 MFs). MFs were predominantly blue and black, with those found in scallops being longer than those in sea urchins, likely due to feeding behaviour as capture and fragmentation processes. Polymer characterization via FTIR microspectroscopy (µ-FTIR) identified representative fibers as cotton, which is consistent with materials used at nearby research stations and global transport patterns. Our findings confirm that MFs are pervasive in these Ross Sea benthic invertebrate species, with the amount in Antarctic sea urchins approaching that found globally in highly urbanized regions. Our study highlights how feeding strategies affect exposure pathways in Antarctic benthic invertebrates. Improving our understanding of MFs distribution and uptake in the Ross Sea will contribute to a more comprehensive evaluation of ecosystem status and resilience, supporting evidence-based management and conservation decisions within the RSrMPA.

articles.title: The difference of reaction mechanism between 2, 4-di-tert-butylphenol and 2, 6-di-tert-butylphenol in the synthesis of salicylic acid
articles.abstract: Although the Kolbe-Schmidt reaction has been studied in industrial production for more than 100 years, it is surprising that the scientific research in the theoretical stage has not attracted enough attention. Theoretical research is indispensable for the guidance and deepening of industrial production. In this paper, the carboxylation reaction characteristics of 2, 4-di-tert-butylphenol and 2, 6-di-tert-butylphenol were effectively studied at the atomic scale for the first time. The results show that the reaction of tert-butylphenol and CO2 is an exothermic reaction, and the product of 2, 4-di-tert-butylphenol O− is more exothermic and more stable in structure. However, compared with 2, 6-di-tert-butylphenol O−, the energy barrier needed to overcome in the reaction process is larger. Therefore, in order to achieve a considerable rate and conversion rate, industrial production needs to be carried out at high temperature and high pressure. This study provides a strategic direction for further understanding and optimizing the industrial application of the Kolbe-Schmitt reaction.

articles.title: A Novel Material Nano-Scale Material Derived from Garlic Shell Integrated with Red Meat Samples
articles.abstract: The study aimed to develop a novel garlic-shell-based nanofiber using electrospinning and to evaluate its effectiveness in enhancing the safety and shelf life of red meat coated with the fabricated nanofibers. The fabricated nanofibers (71.869 ± 52.830 nm) were characterized by Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, and Thermogravimetric Analysis (TGA). FTIR spectra of the fabricated nanofibers revealed a chemical structure featuring hydroxyl, aliphatic, and carbonyl groups, alongside active sulphur compounds such as allicin. The thermal mass loss of the obtained nanofibers was not significant at the cooking temperature of red meat samples. The treatment significantly suppressed the growth of pathogenic and spoilage microorganisms (p < 0.05). The nanofibers achieved a maximum log reduction of 0.885 for Escherichia coli by day 11. Salmonella typhimurium decreased by 0.66 log CFU/g in red meat samples treated with garlic-shell nanofibers compared with non-nanotreated red meat samples stored at 4°C. Besides pathogenic microorganisms, a significant suppression of Total Psychrophilic Bacteria was observed, ending at 5.10 log CFU/g compared to 6.30 log CFU/g in control samples (decline: 1.2 log CFU/g). On the other hand, the decline in Total Aerobic Mesophilic Bacteria growth was found to be 0.54 log CFU/g over an 11-day analysis period. The findings suggested that nanofibers fabricated from garlic shell, a kind of food waste, represent a promising, bio-based alternative for active food packaging, capable of enhancing the microbiological safety and extending the refrigerated shelf-life of red meat products. Thus, this novel application could play an important role in further food applications.

By combining rapid-cooling synchrotron x-ray diffraction with neutron scattering, this work shows that phase transitions in PMN-xPT are remarkably sluggish and can even be bypassed by fast cooling. At the same time, the polar nanoregions display scale-free critical correlations in both space and time over the temperature range where the giant response appears. These results suggest that slow phase-transition kinetics sustain an extended critical state, providing a new physical picture for the origin of giant relaxor responses. [Phys. Rev. articles.title: Electromagnetic radiation from baryon-rich matter in heavy-ion collisions
articles.abstract: Author(s): Xiang-Yu Wu, Charles Gale, Sangyong Jeon, Jean-François Paquet, Björn Schenke, and Chun Shen Photons and dileptons produced in high energy nuclear collisions contain undistorted information about the conditions at their point of emission, such as the local temperature, flow velocity, and chemical potential. Using state of the art modeling of the collision dynamics, which reproduce hadronic spectra, the authors find good agreement with measurements by the STAR Collaboration at the Relativistic Heavy Collider, but differ from measurements by the PHENIX Collaboration in terms of magnitude but not shape. This work shows that the multimessenger approach to heavy-ion collisions previously used at higher energy is amenable to baryon-rich environments at lower temperatures, and paves the way for more comprehensive studies of the QCD phase diagram. articles.abstract: Author(s): Maksim Ulybyshev, Savvas Zafeiropoulos, Christopher Winterowd, and Fakher Assaad Here, the authors revisit the question of the logarithmic renormalization of the Fermi velocity in graphene. Using large-scale Quantum Monte Carlo simulations of lattices with up to 2 × 10 4 interacting electrons, they directly connect experimental data with unbiased, nonperturbative calculations starting from a microscopic Hamiltonian. Their results reveal that even random-phase approximation corrections are quantitatively insufficient at realistic interaction strengths for suspended graphene, while continuum perturbation theory misses important lattice-scale effects. articles.title: Diabatic potential energy surfaces of the HF 2 system and dynamics studies of the H + F 2 reaction
articles.abstract: The diabatic potential energy surfaces (PESs) for the 1 2 A′ and 2 2 A′ states of HF 2 system were constructed using neural network method combined with symmetry-constrained function. The ab initio calculations were performed at the MRCI-F12/aug-cc-pVTZ level of theory to obtain the electronic energies. The features of the diabatic PESs are examined in detail, and the results indicate that the newly constructed diabatic PESs can reasonably describe the nonadiabatic transition processes. To clarify the nonadiabatic effect in the H + F 2 reaction, the adiabatic and nonadiabatic dynamics studies were performed using time-dependent wave packet method. The dynamical quantities, including reaction probabilities, integral cross sections and rate constants, were calculated and compared with available theoretical and experimental values. Both our nonadiabatic and adiabatic results show better agreement with experimental data than previous theoretical studies. In low collision energy range, adiabatic values are in good agreement with nonadiabatic ones. However, the difference between adiabatic and nonadiabatic values becomes more pronounced as the collision energy increases.

articles.title: HCl dissociation on Pt/Au(111) and Au/Pt(111): Contrasting barrier characters and rotational dynamics
articles.abstract: The dissociative chemisorption of HCl on Pt/Au(111) and Au/Pt(111) bimetallic surfaces is investigated by six-dimensional quantum dynamics calculations on accurate neural network potential energy surfaces. The two systems exhibit sharply contrasting barrier character, with Pt/Au(111) in a central-barrier regime (transition state H–Cl bond length of 2.92 Bohr) and Au/Pt(111) in a late-barrier regime (bond length of 3.89 Bohr). As a result, on Pt/Au(111), translational energy is more effective than vibrational excitation in promoting the reaction, and all impact sites exhibit comparable reactivity. On Au/Pt(111), by contrast, vibrational excitation is more effective than translational energy, and the top-site reactivity is three orders of magnitude lower than at the other sites. The rotational dynamics of HCl dissociation are equally distinct. Pt/Au(111) displays a monotonic angular minimum energy path with a persistent helicopter alignment preference. Au/Pt(111) exhibits a non-monotonic angular dependence induced by weak interfacial charge transfer, leading to a j -dependent inversion of alignment preference and modest rotational enhancement only at high rotational states. The opposite directions of interfacial charge transfer and surface strain in the two systems are responsible for their contrasting dynamical behavior.

articles.title: Sensitivity analysis in the face of rare events
articles.abstract: Molecular motors and other complex nonequilibrium systems are controlled by large sets of design parameters, and optimizing those parameters requires computing sensitivities—derivatives of dynamical observables with respect to the parameters. When the system’s dynamics involves rare events, both the observable and its sensitivity are difficult to estimate from direct simulation. We present a practical computational pipeline that addresses both challenges by combining importance sampling with a Markov state model (MSM). The MSM separately captures the slow, rare-event dynamics and the fast, local dynamics, and the chain rule connects those two pieces to yield an efficient sensitivity estimator. An iterative reweighting procedure based on the RiteWeight algorithm substantially reduces approximation errors from the MSM coarse-graining. We validate the approach on diffusion in the Müller–Brown potential, where the sensitivity of a transition rate to landscape parameters can be computed exactly. We then use sensitivities to optimize the directional bias of a particle-based model of a catalysis-driven molecular motor.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Silica–water model using the Vashishta force field
articles.abstract: Nanoscale interactions between silica (SiO 2 ) and water (H 2 O) significantly influence the behavior of materials such as rocks, glasses, ceramics, and cements in geological and engineered environments. Accurate simulation of these interfacial phenomena requires force fields capable of describing bond breaking and formation. Here, we present a new parameterization of a classical dissociative force field specifically for molecular dynamics simulations of the silica–water system, based on the Vashishta potential functional form for bulk water, bulk silica, and their interface. A bond-order scheme distinguishes between oxygen in silica and oxygen in water. Silica–water interaction parameters were determined using a hierarchical genetic algorithm to reproduce the orthosilicic acid structure and silanol concentration on a silica surface. The model is validated against the energetics of the interface, yielding a calculated heat of immersion of 0.48(8) J m −2 , within the range of experimental values for amorphous silica. The potential captures fundamental surface reaction pathways, such as water dissociation and the formation of isolated, geminal, and vicinal silanol groups, despite these mechanisms not being included in the training set. Applied to dynamic fracture simulation of wet silica, the force field reveals three main effects of water: reduced tensile strength, reduced toughness, and an altered failure mechanism—consistent with the molecular picture of hydrolytic weakening. This dissociative force field enables broader studies of chemo-mechanical processes, such as dissolution, friction, and hydrolytic weakening of silica in aqueous environments, under a wide range of thermodynamic conditions, while its computational efficiency allows for large-scale, long-timescale simulations.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Interfacial structure and electrochemical behavior of a ternary ionic liquid-based electrolyte with water and lithium salt: A computational analysis
articles.abstract: This study investigates the interfacial structure and behavior of a ternary electrolyte composed of the ionic liquid 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium tetrafluoroborate, water, and lithium tetrafluoroborate for different water contents and voltage drops across planar electrodes. Polarizable molecular dynamics simulations were performed using explicit graphene monolayers as electrodes, with the image charge method ensuring constant potential boundary conditions. Structural and electrochemical properties, including density profiles, orientational order, charge distribution, coordination, and differential capacitance, were analyzed to identify key factors influencing electrolyte performance. A complementary computational scheme enabled direct evaluation of charge density and atomic polarization responses at the electrodes. Results show that small water additions minimally affect ionic organization, but at higher concentrations and voltages, free water accumulates near the negative electrode, destabilizing the interface while promoting lithium migration. Although moderate water levels can enhance differential capacitance and potentially improve battery performance, concentrations above 10% reduce electrochemical stability. Finally, the analysis of the charge response at the electrodes reveals a loss of short-range correlation in the surface charge on the negatively charged electrode as both the applied voltage and water content increase. Furthermore, this loss of correlation could serve as a direct indicator of water presence in these kinds of devices.

articles.title: Lattice matching dictates the growth mode and quality of deuterium crystallization in confined spherical shells
articles.abstract: Cryogenic hydrogen isotope fuel layers with high structural integrity and atomic-scale smoothness are prerequisites for symmetric implosion and ignition in inertial confinement fusion (ICF). Using deuterium (D 2 ) as model fuel, we perform large-scale molecular dynamics simulations with a Feynman–Hibbs corrected Silvera–Goldman potential to describe nuclear quantum effects at low temperatures, systematically investigating D 2 crystallization inside spherical ablator capsules. By varying substrate lattice constant from 3.1 to 3.9 Å, we demonstrate that lattice matching dictates the transition from coherent epitaxial growth to polycrystalline formation, establishing it as the primary design principle for high-performance targets. When the substrate lattice closely matches the equilibrium hexagonal-close-packed (HCP) spacing of cryogenic D 2 (∼3.5 Å), D 2 forms coherent layer-by-layer epitaxial growth consistent with Ostwald’s stepwise nucleation theory, yielding HCP-dominated near-single crystals with minimal dislocations and ultra-smooth inner surfaces. In contrast, a large lattice mismatch destabilizes coherent growth and causes island-like growth, producing polycrystalline structures with mixed HCP/FCC phases, elevated defects, and greatly increased surface roughness. Radial stress analysis shows that interfacial stress from mismatch localizes within 2–3 molecular layers near the interface, triggering subsequent defect-mediated growth. These findings highlight substrate lattice matching in regulating confined solid growth and crystallization quality, establish it as a key principle for ablator inner-surface engineering in ICF cryogenic targets, and offer atomic guidance for growing high-quality single-crystal deuterium-tritium fuel layers with optimal smoothness.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Mixedness and entanglement witnessing analysis in two-spin-1/2 NMR systems
articles.abstract: We investigate quantum-state properties of thermal two-spin-1/2 NMR systems under external magnetic fields, with the goal of translating density-matrix-based quantum quantities into experimentally accessible NMR observables. In particular, we consider mixedness and witness-based entanglement as complementary probes of the thermal spin-state structure. Mixedness quantifies the departure of the NMR ensemble from a pure-state dominated regime and identifies field-dependent population redistribution, while the entanglement witness provides a practical test of nonclassical spin–spin entanglement without requiring full density-matrix reconstruction. Our framework links quantum-information quantities to NMR spectra, polarization observables, and spin–spin correlations, enabling the characterization of mixedness and witness-based entanglement through NMR signal analysis. We further examine the effect of noise and imperfections on the measurements. We also show how repeating the measurement improves the stability of the extracted signatures. These results provide insights for quantum-enhanced NMR, low-temperature spectroscopy, and emerging quantum sensing technologies where experimentally accessible signatures of mixedness and entanglement are needed.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Unraveling the relaxation and photodissociation pathways of electronically excited 1,3,5-triamino-2,4,6-trinitrobenzene (TATB)
articles.abstract: Femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy was employed to investigate the excited-state relaxation and photodissociation dynamics of 1,3,5-triamino-2,4,6-trinitrobenzene (TATB) in dissolved in dimethyl sulfoxide. By tracking the evolution of the S 1 manifold and ground-state recovery, we infer two distinct relaxation routes upon 370 nm excitation at the absorption peak: (1) molecules directly populated into S 1 relax back to the ground state S 0 sequentially via vibrational relaxation within S 1 and S 1 → S 0 internal conversion (∼4.4 ps) and (2) molecules populated into S 2 or higher-lying excited states first feed the S 1 manifold (∼0.26 ps) and sequentially relax to highly vibrationally excited S 0 (∼0.5 ps). The majority of these molecules cool down through vibrational relaxation, while the minority of them undergo C–NO 2 homolytic bond cleavage. Most of the resulting fragments recombine to reform ground-state TATB (∼42 ps), with only a small fraction of NO 2 escaping the solvent cage to become the primary photodissociation product. Upon 430 nm excitation at the band edge, only relaxation route (1) is observed, consistent with the nearly exclusive S 1 population. Based on these experimental observations, we propose a working model describing the excitation-wavelength-dependent dynamics of TATB, providing a useful reference for understanding analogous nitroaromatic systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Wetting interfacial diagram for equal-sized binary Lennard-Jones fluid mixtures
articles.abstract: We explore the wetting behavior along all possible three-phase lines of equal-sized Lennard–Jones fluid binary mixtures via direct coexistence molecular dynamics simulations. We build a wetting interfacial diagram in which partial, perfect, first-order, and second-order wetting transition regions are characterized, along with their corresponding wetting transition temperatures for Type II and Type III mixtures, according to the van Konynenburg and Scott classification. By analyzing the fluid molecular interactions, we reveal the driving forces behind the different wetting behaviors and discuss their dependence on the ζ and Λ energetic coordinates of the global phase diagram.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: X-ray absorption and resonant x-ray emission at the carbon edge of Li 2 CO 3
articles.abstract: While highly successful, density functional theory is known to have limitations owing to its neglect of many-body electron–electron interactions. This neglect leads to errors in the single-particle energies, leading to underestimated bandgaps and bandwidths as well as errors in band alignment at interfaces. Many-body perturbation theory, in the form of the GW self-energy correction, has been widely used to improve upon these shortcomings. Although less well studied, the same GW method is also able to predict the finite quasiparticle lifetime that is seen to cause anomalous broadening in the lowest-lying lines of valence emission spectra. Using near-edge x-ray absorption and emission, we probe the electronic structure of Li 2 CO 3 . Our measurements are compared to first-principles calculations, including GW self-energy corrections to the single-particle energies and excitonic effects from the Bethe–Salpeter equation.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Simulation study of spiral spinodal decomposition in polymer mixtures
articles.abstract: A film of a binary polymer mixture between two concentric cylindrical walls is studied numerically with the help of diffuse-interface modeling. The system starts with a homogeneous temperature above the upper critical value T c , while the inner cylinder is cooled below T c . The outer wall has a low, negligible heat conductivity. Around the inner cylinder, the system cools down and spinodal decomposition sets in. Starting from a non-radially symmetric pattern at the inner cylinder, domains of coexisting mole fractions emerge. At later times, one of the following structures forms: (a) a set of nested rings or (b) spirals growing from the inside to the outside. The spiral shape is of particular nanotechnological interest, since it allows the creation of a long continuous path from the inside to the outside. If one of the domains is electrically conductive, a flat spiral coil can be created. By crosslinking one component and removing the other, a spiral, percolating path can be formed through the solid component. The large surface area of the spiral path can be used for cooling a fluid running through it or for catalytic applications.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Structural vs dynamical estimators of the excess entropy of water across its phase diagram
articles.abstract: The excess entropy is a fundamental thermodynamic observable for understanding the properties and anomalous behavior of liquid water. Barring computationally intensive methods such as thermodynamic integration, rapid and accurate routes to the excess entropy remain somewhat elusive. Previous attempts have relied on the two-body translational entropy alone or, more rarely, on additional calculations of the two-body orientational entropy, both of which are structure-based entropy estimators. In this work, we demonstrate that the Two-Phase Thermodynamics (2PT) method, a dynamical entropy estimator based on the velocity density of states (VDOS) function, provides a robust, efficient route to estimating the excess entropy of liquid water across a wide range of state points (220 ≤ T ≤ 360 K, 0.85 ≤ ρ ≤ 1.3 g/cm 3 ). The VDOS reflects the collective dynamics of all atoms in the system, such that 2PT implicitly recovers information equivalent to the higher-order correlations neglected by S 2 , without requiring their explicit evaluation. Thus, we show that the 2PT excess entropy follows the experimental reference closely through all the state points considered, using four different empirical water models. Comparison against more rigorous transition-matrix Monte Carlo simulations, which share the force field and thus separate model error from method error, apportions the residual offset from experiment as roughly two-thirds inherent deficiencies in the force field and one-third the 2PT analysis itself.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: High-pressure variable-temperature sum-frequency vibrational spectroscopy for in situ molecular probing of gas-hydrate formation at aqueous interface
articles.abstract: Here, we describe a high-pressure, variable-temperature sum-frequency vibrational spectroscopy (SFVS) apparatus designed for in situ , surface-specific measurements of aqueous interfaces during gas-hydrate formation. The apparatus integrates an ultra-clean gas-handling system, a sealed optical chamber with controlled pressure and temperature, and a broadband SFVS spectrometer with real-time reference normalization. The chamber operates from −25 to 60 °C and from ambient pressure to 10.0 MPa, allowing interfacial spectra to be recorded while the sample is driven across the methane-hydrate phase boundary. Using the methane/D 2 O interface as a representative system, we monitor the OD-stretch response of interfacial water during cooling under 8.0 MPa CH 4 . The temperature-dependent spectral evolution reveals the emergence of hydrate-like interfacial water ordering prior to macroscopic crystallization, demonstrating the ability of the apparatus to capture early molecular signatures of hydrate formation. We further show that the same platform can be extended to buried solid/liquid interfaces using the octadecyltrichlorosilane/water interface as a model system. These measurements establish a versatile experimental platform for correlating interfacial molecular structure with gas pressure, temperature, and surface chemistry, providing a route toward mechanistic studies of gas-hydrate nucleation, growth, and inhibition under controlled thermodynamic conditions.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Ag-supported single-atom metals for CO 2 reduction: Atomistic insights into CO-binding moderation, scaling deviations, and HER suppression
articles.abstract: Electrochemical CO 2 reduction to hydrocarbons requires catalysts that activate carbon-bound intermediates while suppressing the competing hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). Here, we use density functional theory to study single-metal adatoms on Ag(211). We identify two key effects. First, depositing intrinsically strong CO-binding metals (Ni, Co, and Fe) on Ag weakens CO adsorption relative to the pure metals, moving them toward a more favorable CO-binding regime for further reduction without surface poisoning. Second, early transition metals—especially Ti—behave differently: Ti maintains moderate CO binding but stabilizes CHO much more strongly, effectively decoupling CO and CHO adsorption and deviating from linear scaling relationships. As a result, the CO → CHO activation barrier drops from 1.23 eV on Cu/Ag, taken here as an experimental benchmark for hydrocarbon production, to 0.62 eV on Ti/Ag. Single adatoms bind hydrogen weakly and suppress HER, while larger clusters restore strong H binding and increase HER activity. Our work shows that deposited-metal identity and site size independently control CO activation and HER, providing simple design rules for CO 2 reduction catalysts for hydrocarbon production.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Substitution-dependent excited-state relaxation pathways in the TADF structural isomers MA-TA and mMA-TA
articles.abstract: The photophysical properties of the para-connected MA-TA and meta-connected mMA-TA donor–acceptor thermally activated delayed fluoresence (TADF) structural isomers were investigated to clarify how substitution patterns affect excited-state relaxation dynamics in TADF molecules. Time-resolved photoluminescence measurements showed that MA-TA exhibits relatively simple emissive-state relaxation, whereas mMA-TA shows a time-dependent red shift of the emission band and biexponential photoluminescence decay. Using reference spectra obtained from steady-state absorption and fragment transient absorption measurements, femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy revealed that MA-TA undergoes rapid formation of a charge-transfer-like excited state within several picoseconds, as indicated by the decay of a broad MA-like near-infrared excited-state absorption component monitored around 850 nm and the concomitant rise of a CT-like excited-state absorption around 600 nm. In contrast, mMA-TA exhibited a spectroscopic signature of an additional intermediate excited-state species, observed as a transient absorption band around 700 nm, that was not clearly observed for MA-TA. The delayed appearance and relatively fast decay of this signal indicate that mMA-TA forms an intermediate excited-state species during early relaxation. These results demonstrate that the substitution pattern strongly influences the early excited-state relaxation pathway in these TADF molecules. The formation of an additional intermediate excited-state species in mMA-TA may provide a plausible origin for its more complex photoluminescence dynamics and lower emission efficiency. This study highlights the importance of controlling substitution-dependent intermediate excited-state formation in the molecular design of efficient TADF emitters.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Visualizing electron flow at transition states by natural reaction orbitals
articles.abstract: Transition-state analysis in quantum chemistry provides structural and energetic information but does not directly reveal how electron density is redistributed at the onset of bond reorganization. Although frontier-orbital theory is highly effective for predicting reactivity from reactant molecules, it is less suited to transition states, where bond-breaking and bond-forming processes are already underway. Here, we show that natural reaction orbital (NRO) analysis provides a response-based framework for directly visualizing electron flow at transition states. By extracting the dominant occupied-virtual mixing induced by nuclear displacement along the imaginary vibrational mode, NRO analysis reveals the electronic response that drives bond reorganization. Applications to representative pericyclic reactions show that the essential electron-density redistribution is captured by only a few dominant NRO pairs, which closely reproduces conventional curved-arrow descriptions. In a more complex system, NRO analysis automatically extracts localized, reaction-relevant orbital responses even when canonical frontier orbitals are extensively delocalized. NRO analysis thus provides a compact and chemically intuitive framework for transition-state electron-flow analysis.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: New implementation of mixed-reference spin-flip time-dependent density functional theory and application to molecules with variable diradical character and conical intersections
articles.abstract: Mixed-reference spin-flip time-dependent density functional theory (MRSF-TDDFT) improves upon the original spin-flip TDDFT (SF-TDDFT) approach by expanding the configurational space of the response states via a mixed-reference reduced density matrix, specifically, an equal mixture of the density matrices from the M S = +1 and M S = −1 components of the lowest triplet state. MRSF-TDDFT improves the description of the spin-flip target states and the respective energy differences and eliminates the problem of spin-contamination that often spoils the description of higher-lying states in SF-TDDFT. This article presents the theoretical framework and details of a new implementation of MRSF-TDDFT in the Q-Chem software package. The implementation includes calculations of energies and properties, including transition dipole moments, oscillator strengths, spin–orbit couplings, and density-matrix based analyses of the MRSF states and transitions. The capabilities of the theory are illustrated by applications to diradicals, butadiene, and a reduced retinal model, the penta-2,4-dieniminium cation, used to evaluate the performance of electronic structure methods in describing conical intersections.

articles.title: Identifying non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems unable to maintain diffusion out-of-equilibrium
articles.abstract: We develop a general method, based on the construction of a kinetic potential serving as a Lyapunov function, to establish when diffusion necessarily equilibrates in non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems under arbitrary driving by autonomous homogeneous chemostats. This equilibration of diffusion implies vanishing diffusion currents and homogeneous chemical potentials, while reactions can remain far from equilibrium. Using this method, we generalize the results of Avanzini et al. , J. Chem. Phys. 161 , 174108 (2024), by relaxing some of the underlying assumptions. Specifically, we show that diffusion equilibrates in reaction-diffusion systems whose chemical reaction network is either pseudo-detailed balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled by the stoichiometry of reactants and products, or complex balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled only by the stoichiometry of the reactants. These different constraints on the reaction fluxes are shown to originate from the distinct stoichiometric properties of the two classes of networks.

articles.title: Steering sequence generation in protein language models through Iterative Lookback Monte Carlo Sampling
articles.title_zh: 通过迭代回溯蒙特卡罗采样引导蛋白质语言模型中的序列生成
articles.abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) leverage large-scale evolutionary data to generate novel sequences, but steering generation toward desired physicochemical properties without sacrificing diversity remains a major challenge. Existing approaches often induce severe diversity loss or require computationally expensive retraining. We introduce Iterative Lookback Monte Carlo (ILMC), a training-free inference-time sampling strategy that interleaves autoregressive elongation with Metropolis–Hastings refinement to approximate sampling from a maximum-entropy target distribution balancing generative quality and steering objectives. We show theoretically that this target distribution is entropy-maximizing under fixed generative quality and steering constraints, and empirically that ILMC produces more diverse samples than standard autoregressive baselines at matched generative quality. Using simple steering potentials, ILMC improves desired molecular properties, yielding higher predicted melting temperatures than both unsteered autoregressive sampling and compute-matched rejection sampling at matched generative quality. ILMC naturally applies to classifier-guided steering, where it outperforms purely autoregressive guidance in diversity while maintaining comparable enrichment of target properties. We validate ILMC on family-specific pLMs and on the multi-family model ProGen3.
articles.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型利用大规模进化数据生成新序列，但在保持多样性的同时使生成结果趋向目标理化性质仍然具有挑战性。本文提出无需训练的迭代回溯蒙特卡罗采样方法，在自回归延伸与 Metropolis—Hastings 精化之间交替进行，以近似从兼顾生成质量和引导目标的最大熵分布中采样。理论与实验结果表明，该方法在相同生成质量下具有更高的样本多样性，并能改善目标分子性质；在分类器引导、家族特异性蛋白质语言模型和 ProGen3 上也得到验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蛋白质语言模型（pLM）利用大规模进化数据生成新型序列，但在不牺牲多样性的情况下将生成过程引导至理想的理化性质，仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法通常会导致多样性严重损失，或需要计算成本高昂的重新训练。我们提出了迭代回溯蒙特卡罗（ILMC）方法，这是一种无需训练的推理时采样策略，通过将自回归延伸与 Metropolis—Hastings 精化交替结合，近似从一种最大熵目标分布中进行采样，以平衡生成质量与引导目标。我们从理论上表明，在生成质量和引导约束固定的条件下，该目标分布能够使熵最大化；实验上表明，在生成质量相当时，与标准自回归基线相比，ILMC 可生成更多样化的样本。利用简单的引导势函数，ILMC 能够改善目标分子性质；在生成质量相当的情况下，与无引导的自回归采样和计算量匹配的拒绝采样相比，它产生了更高的预测熔点。ILMC 还可自然地应用于分类器引导；在保持目标性质富集程度相近的同时，其多样性优于纯自回归引导。我们在家族特异性 pLM 以及多家族模型 ProGen3 上验证了 ILMC。

articles.title: A mutual information-based metric for temporal expressivity and trainability estimation in quantum policy gradient pipelines
articles.title_zh: 基于互信息的量子策略梯度流程时间表达性与可训练性估计指标
articles.abstract: In recent years, various limitations of conventional supervised learning (SL) have been identified, motivating the development of reinforcement learning (RL)–and quantum RL that leverages quantum resources such as entanglement and superposition. Among the various RL methodologies, the policy gradient method is considered to have many benefits; for instance, it allows an agent to learn without explicitly knowing the crucial information of the environment such as state transition probabilities and initial state distribution. Meanwhile, from the perspective of learning, two indicators are often regarded as significant: expressivity and trainability (for gradient-based methods). While a number of attempts have been made to quantify the expressivity and trainability of Neural Network models and parameterized quantum circuits, clear efforts suitable for RL settings have so far been lacking, despite the inherent differences between conventional SL and RL. Therefore, in this study, we propose revising the notion of expressivity into a temporal expressivity suited to RL dynamics, and show that the mutual information (MI) between the action distribution and the discretized reward signal provides an upper bound for the scaled gradient norm, while yielding an information-theoretic decomposition and a residual-aware upper bound for the proposed temporal expressivity metric. Finally, under explicit concentration assumptions, we show that MI-based Temporal Expressivity and Trainability measure induces an assumption-based, one-sided prescreening criterion for initialization-time gradient fragility.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，传统监督学习的局限性推动了强化学习及量子强化学习的发展。本文针对强化学习的时间动态，将表达性重新定义为时间表达性，并证明动作分布与离散化奖励信号之间的互信息为缩放梯度范数提供上界，同时给出时间表达性指标的信息论分解和考虑残差的上界。在明确的集中性假设下，作者进一步建立了基于互信息的时间表达性与可训练性度量，并将其用于初始化阶段梯度脆弱性的一侧预筛选。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，人们发现传统监督学习（SL）存在各种局限，这推动了强化学习（RL）以及利用纠缠和叠加等量子资源的量子强化学习的发展。在多种强化学习方法中，策略梯度方法被认为具有许多优势；例如，它允许智能体在不知道环境关键先验信息的情况下进行学习，例如状态转移概率和初始状态分布。与此同时，从学习的角度来看，两个指标通常被认为十分重要：表达性以及可训练性（对于基于梯度的方法而言）。尽管已有多项工作尝试量化神经网络模型和参数化量子电路的表达性与可训练性，但针对强化学习场景的清晰研究至今仍然缺乏，尽管传统监督学习与强化学习之间存在固有差异。因此，本研究提出将表达性的概念修订为适用于强化学习动态的时间表达性，并表明动作分布与离散化奖励信号之间的互信息（MI）为缩放梯度范数提供了一个上界，同时为所提出的时间表达性指标给出一种信息论分解和一种考虑残差的上界。最后，在明确的集中性假设下，我们表明，基于互信息的时间表达性与可训练性度量能够导出一种基于假设、单侧的初始化时梯度脆弱性预筛选准则。

articles.title: The influence of quantum geometry on the phase boundary and collective excitations of electron liquids and crystals
articles.title_zh: 量子几何对电子液体与电子晶体相边界及集体激发的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments on multilayer graphene systems have reinvigorated the study of electron crystallization, now with the inclusion of quantum geometry. In this work, we apply time-dependent Hartree-Fock (TDHF) to the λ-jellium model to analyze the impact that quantum geometry has on the electronic liquid--crystal phase diagram and how it modifies the collective modes and responses of the liquid and crystal phases. In agreement with recent results utilizing neural quantum states, we find that quantum geometry favours electron crystallization, shifting the transition to higher densities. We also study the instabilities revealed by TDHF in the Fermi liquid ground state at low densities, providing insight into the fluctuations driving the crystallization transition. We further find that quantum geometry reduces the dispersion of the plasmon mode and suppresses Friedel oscillations deep in the liquid phase. Resolving the density response in terms of individual orbitals, we find that this suppression is caused by spectral weight transfer to an out-of-phase inter-orbital mode. Finally, we show that an analogous mode that emerges in the crystal phase corresponds to the breathing mode of an emergent real-space pseudospin skyrmion lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用含时 Hartree—Fock 方法研究量子几何对 λ-均匀电子气模型中电子液体—晶体相图、集体模和响应的影响。结果表明，量子几何有利于电子结晶化，使相变向更高密度移动；同时，它降低等离激元色散并抑制液体相深处的 Friedel 振荡。作者进一步将这种抑制归因于谱权重转移至反相轨道间模式，并指出晶体相中的类似模式对应于涌现实空间赝自旋斯格明子晶格的呼吸模。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期对多层石墨烯体系的实验重新激发了人们对电子结晶化的研究，并将量子几何纳入其中。在本工作中，我们应用含时 Hartree—Fock（TDHF）方法研究 λ-均匀电子气模型，分析量子几何对电子液体—晶体相图的影响，以及它如何改变液体相和晶体相中的集体模式与响应。与近期利用神经量子态得到的结果一致，我们发现量子几何有利于电子结晶化，使相变向更高密度移动。我们还研究了 TDHF 在低密度费米液体基态中揭示的不稳定性，从而深入理解驱动结晶化相变的涨落。我们进一步发现，量子几何降低了等离激元模式的色散，并在液体相深处抑制了 Friedel 振荡。通过将密度响应分解到各个轨道上，我们发现这种抑制是由谱权重转移至一个反相轨道间模式所导致的。最后，我们表明，晶体相中出现的类似模式对应于一个涌现的实空间赝自旋斯格明子晶格的呼吸模。

articles.title: Quantum oscillations of helical edge states of periodically deformed 2D topological insulator in magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中周期形变二维拓扑绝缘体螺旋边缘态的量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study edge-state transport in a two-dimensional topological insulator with a periodically deformed edge subjected to a uniform magnetic field. Zeeman coupling breaks time-reversal symmetry and enables elastic backscattering, producing oscillations of the forbidden-band widths. In the strong-field regime, the gaps can close completely at discrete field values. In the weak-field regime, we identify an important class of periodic deformations for which the dominant semiclassical scattering is controlled by complex infinity rather than by the nearest turning points. We develop a semiclassical treatment of this process and establish its agreement with perturbation theory and direct numerical calculations. The gap modulation should produce observable oscillations of the edge conductance. Unlike conventional magnetic quantum oscillations, which are periodic in inverse field, the predicted oscillations are periodic in the magnetic field itself, with a period determined by the Fermi velocity and effective g-factor
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了均匀磁场下具有周期形变边缘的二维拓扑绝缘体中的边缘态输运。塞曼耦合破坏时间反演对称性并允许弹性反向散射，从而引起禁带宽度振荡；在强场下，禁带可在离散磁场值处完全闭合。在弱场下，作者针对一类周期形变建立了半经典理论，发现主导散射由复穷远而非最近转向点控制，并通过微扰理论和数值计算加以验证，预测边缘电导将出现以磁场而非磁场倒数为周期的振荡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了均匀磁场下具有周期形变边缘的二维拓扑绝缘体中的边缘态输运。塞曼耦合破坏时间反演对称性，并使弹性反向散射成为可能，从而导致禁带宽度发生振荡。在强磁场区域，禁带可以在离散的磁场值处完全闭合。在弱磁场区域，我们确定了一类重要的周期形变，在这类形变中，主导的半经典散射由复穷远而不是最近的转向点控制。我们为这一过程建立了半经典处理方法，并证明其与微扰理论和直接数值计算相一致。禁带调制应当导致边缘电导出现可观测的振荡。不同于传统的磁性量子振荡通常以磁场倒数为周期，本文预测的振荡本身以磁场为周期，其周期由费米速度和有效 g 因子决定。

articles.title: Dual Charge-Density-Waves in Two-dimensional DyTe3 and Their Distinct Impacts on Magneto-Transport Properties
articles.title_zh: 二维 DyTe3 中的双电荷密度波及其对磁输运性质的不同影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge-density-waves (CDWs) are macroscopic quantum states defined by periodic modulations in electronic charge density coupled with lattice distortions. Despite significant research efforts, the evolution of electromagnetic transport properties in the presence of CDWs remains largely unexplored. Here, we report the effects of two orthogonal CDWs (CDW1 and CDW2) coexisting at low-temperature in DyTe3 on its electronic transport properties. Importantly, we find that while no clear magnetotransport anomaly is resolved across CDW1 transition under the present experimental conditions, the emergence of CDW2 drives a drastic enhancement in magnetoresistance and a multiband-governed nonlinear Hall response. These results demonstrate that CDW1 and CDW2 in DyTe3 are fundamentally different and impact its electronic transport in qualitatively distinct ways, establishing DyTe3 as a model system for understanding the transport consequences of multiple CDWs in quasi-two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了低温 DyTe3 中共存的两个正交电荷密度波 CDW1 和 CDW2 对电子输运性质的影响。实验发现，在当前条件下，跨越 CDW1 转变未观察到明显磁输运异常；而 CDW2 的出现会显著增强磁阻，并产生由多能带主导的非线性霍尔响应。结果表明，DyTe3 中的两个电荷密度波具有本质差异，并以定性不同的方式影响电子输运，使其成为研究准二维材料中多重电荷密度波输运后果的模型体系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电荷密度波（CDW）是由电子电荷密度的周期性调制以及与之耦合的晶格畸变所定义的宏观量子态。尽管研究工作投入巨大，但 CDW 存在时电磁输运性质的演化仍未得到充分探索。在此，我们报告了低温下共存于 DyTe3 中的两个正交 CDW（CDW1 和 CDW2）对其电子输运性质的影响。重要的是，我们发现，在当前实验条件下，跨越 CDW1 转变时没有分辨出明显的磁输运异常；而 CDW2 的出现则导致磁阻显著增强，并产生由多能带控制的非线性霍尔响应。这些结果表明，DyTe3 中的 CDW1 和 CDW2 在本质上不同，并以定性不同的方式影响其电子输运，从而确立了 DyTe3 作为理解准二维材料中多重 CDW 输运后果的模型体系。

articles.title: Composition-dependent nonlinear viscoelastic-viscoplastic behavior and constitutive framework for digitally mixed polymers spanning the glass transition
articles.title_zh: 跨越玻璃化转变的数字混合聚合物：成分依赖的非线性黏弹—黏塑行为与本构框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-material PolyJet printing produces voxel-scale digital mixtures of an elastomeric photopolymer (Agilus) and a glassy photopolymer (Vero), giving a material family whose room-temperature response ranges from elastomeric to glassy; a unified description spanning the family has remained challenging. Large-deformation uniaxial compression over nearly three orders of magnitude in strain rate reveals a nonlinear, rate-dependent load-unload response that evolves continuously with composition, from recoverable elastomeric hysteresis to glassy yield with post-yield softening, hardening, and substantial residual strain. Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) shows that each mixture has a single glass transition temperature (T_g) that shifts to higher temperature with both Vero fraction and frequency, so composition acts much as temperature or loading rate does. This time-composition equivalence motivates one constitutive structure for the whole family rather than a separate property set per mixture: an equilibrium hyperelastic network with three non-equilibrium, rate-dependent branches carrying reptational, intermolecular, and glassy resistance. Its properties are anchored at the two endpoints and interpolated by smooth composition scaling laws. The model captures the compression response of all seven calibrated compositions and predicts a withheld mixture from the scaling laws alone. Resolving the predicted stress into its branches shows the load passing from the elastomeric to the glassy mechanism, and the work from elastic storage to dissipation, as Vero content and rate rise. The glass transition that DMA maps at small strain therefore governs the large-strain deformation mechanisms. The framework gives a compact, physically based description of digitally mixed polymers and a predictive basis for designing functionally graded, architected multi-material structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 多材料 PolyJet 打印可在体素尺度上混合弹性体光聚合物 Agilus 与玻璃态光聚合物 Vero，形成室温响应从弹性体到玻璃态连续变化的材料族。近三个数量级应变速率范围内的大变形单轴压缩实验显示，材料的非线性、速率相关载荷—卸载响应随成分连续演变；动态力学分析表明，每种混合物具有单一玻璃化转变温度，且该温度随 Vero 含量和频率升高而升高。基于时间—成分等效性，作者建立了包含平衡超弹性网络及三种非平衡速率相关分支的统一本构模型，并准确描述七种标定成分及一种未参与标定的混合物，为功能梯度和多材料结构设计提供预测基础。
