articles.abstract_zh_full: 多材料 PolyJet 打印可在体素尺度上生成弹性体光聚合物 Agilus 与玻璃态光聚合物 Vero 的数字混合物，由此形成一个材料族，其室温响应范围从弹性体态延伸至玻璃态；然而，对覆盖整个材料族的统一描述一直具有挑战性。在近三个数量级的应变速率范围内进行的大变形单轴压缩显示，材料呈现非线性、速率相关的加载—卸载响应，并且该响应随成分连续变化，从可恢复的弹性体滞后演变为玻璃态屈服，并伴随屈服后软化、硬化以及显著的残余应变。动态力学分析（DMA）表明，每种混合物都具有单一的玻璃化转变温度（T_g），且该温度随 Vero 含量和频率的增加而升高，因此成分所起的作用在很大程度上类似于温度或加载速率。这样的时间—成分等效性促使我们为整个材料族采用一种统一的本构结构，而不是为每种混合物分别设定一套性质：该结构包含一个平衡超弹性网络，以及三个承载爬移、分子间作用和玻璃态阻力的非平衡速率相关分支。模型性质以两个端点为基础，并通过平滑的成分标度律进行插值。该模型能够描述全部七种经过标定的成分的压缩响应，并且仅依据标度律预测一种未参与标定的混合物。对预测应力进行分支分解表明，随着 Vero 含量和速率升高，载荷承载机制从弹性体机制转移至玻璃态机制，功的来源也从弹性储能转向耗散。因此，DMA 在小应变下描绘出的玻璃化转变，实际上控制着大应变变形机制。该框架为数字混合聚合物提供了紧凑且基于物理的描述，并为功能梯度结构和架构化多材料结构的设计提供了预测基础。

articles.title: Calculation of DFT Spin-Orbit Spillage with Quantum ESPRESSO
articles.title_zh: 利用 Quantum ESPRESSO 计算 DFT 自旋—轨道溢出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work describes the calculation of spin-orbit spillage from a crystal structure. Spin-orbit spillage provides a measure of the likelihood that a material has topological character. The spillage also provides the reference quantity for the machine-learning classifier of Choudhary et al., which predicts whether the spillage exceeds a specified threshold rather than the calculation of its numerical value directly. The complete computation workflow was applied to the insulating compound BaMg2Bi2, yielding a spillage of 2.094 compared with the published VASP spillage of 2.075, corresponding to a difference of 0.9%. The calculation is described in terms of two Quantum ESPRESSO (QE) calculations of spillage performed with and without spin-orbit coupling, the role of relativistic pseudopotentials, and the subsequent wavefunction-overlap analysis. The limitations of the same calculation procedure for semimetals are also examined.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了如何从晶体结构计算自旋—轨道溢出（spin-orbit spillage），该量可用于衡量材料具有拓扑特征的可能性，也是相关机器学习分类器所依据的参考量。作者以绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2 为例，使用 Quantum ESPRESSO 分别进行包含和不包含自旋—轨道耦合的计算，并通过波函数重叠分析得到溢出值 2.094，与已发表的 VASP 结果 2.075 相差 0.9%。文章还讨论了相对论赝势的作用以及该流程在半金属中的局限性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作描述了如何从晶体结构计算自旋—轨道溢出。自旋—轨道溢出提供了一种衡量材料具有拓扑特征可能性的指标。该溢出量还为 Choudhary 等人的机器学习分类器提供参考量；该分类器预测的是溢出是否超过指定阈值，而不是直接计算其数值。完整的计算流程应用于绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2，得到的溢出值为 2.094，而已发表的 VASP 溢出值为 2.075，两者相差 0.9%。本文从两个 Quantum ESPRESSO（QE）计算出发描述溢出的计算过程，即分别在包含和不包含自旋—轨道耦合的情况下进行计算，并讨论相对论赝势的作用以及随后进行的波函数重叠分析。文章还考察了将同一计算流程用于半金属时的局限性。

articles.title: Layer Architecture Shapes Electronic, Magnetic, and Lattice Interactions in Ruddlesden-Popper Nickelates
articles.title_zh: 层状结构塑造 Ruddlesden—Popper 镍酸盐中的电子、磁性与晶格相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates has raised a central question: how does layer architecture shape the electronic, magnetic, and lattice interactions relevant to pairing? Here, we report a detailed comparative study of the two polymorphs of La3Ni2O7--the alternating monolayer-trilayer (LNO-1313) and bilayer (LNO-2222) structures--and the related trilayer compound La4Ni3O10, using both Ni L3- and O K-edge RIXS. We find that LNO-1313 and La4Ni3O10 share strikingly similar electronic, magnetic, and lattice excitations, whereas bilayer LNO-2222 exhibits distinct features. Compared to LNO-2222, LNO-1313 and La4Ni3O10 have weaker orbital polarization, enhanced 3d8L character, a reduced out-of-plane magnetic-exchange scale, and stronger EPC. Within an effective local-moment framework, an entangled-dimer scenario provides a natural description of the spin excitations generated by strong antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling. Its advantage over conventional spin-wave theory is clearest in bilayer LNO-2222, where the interlayer coupling dominates the intralayer interactions. These findings provide critical experimental constraints for future theoretical models for the low-energy physics relevant to superconductivity in these layered nickelates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 Ni L3 边和 O K 边共振非弹性 X 射线散射，对 La3Ni2O7 的交替单层—三层结构 LNO-1313、双层结构 LNO-2222 以及相关三层化合物 La4Ni3O10 进行了比较研究。LNO-1313 与 La4Ni3O10 的电子、磁性和晶格激发高度相似，而 LNO-2222 表现出不同特征，包括更强的轨道极化、更弱的层间磁交换尺度和更弱的电子—声子耦合等差异。研究表明，纠缠二聚体图景能够自然描述强反铁磁层间耦合产生的自旋激发，尤其适用于层间耦合主导层内相互作用的双层 LNO-2222，并为超导相关低能物理模型提供实验约束。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Ruddlesden—Popper 镍酸盐中超导性的发现提出了一个核心问题：层状结构如何塑造与配对相关的电子、磁性和晶格相互作用？在此，我们利用 Ni L3 边和 O K 边共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS），对 La3Ni2O7 的两种多型体，即交替单层—三层结构（LNO-1313）和双层结构（LNO-2222），以及相关的三层化合物 La4Ni3O10 进行了详细的比较研究。我们发现，LNO-1313 与 La4Ni3O10 具有极为相似的电子、磁性和晶格激发，而双层 LNO-2222 则表现出不同的特征。与 LNO-2222 相比，LNO-1313 和 La4Ni3O10 具有更弱的轨道极化、更强的 3d8L 特征、更小的面外磁交换尺度以及更强的电子—声子耦合（EPC）。在有效局域磁矩框架下，纠缠二聚体图景能够自然描述由强反铁磁层间耦合产生的自旋激发。与传统自旋波理论相比，该图景的优势在双层 LNO-2222 中最为明显，因为在该体系中层间耦合主导层内相互作用。这些发现为未来建立描述这些层状镍酸盐中与超导性相关的低能物理理论模型提供了关键的实验约束。

articles.title: A discrete crack-tip theory for nonlinear lattice networks
articles.title_zh: 非线性晶格网络的离散裂纹尖端理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crack-tip fields govern deformation localization and failure initiation. Classical continuum fracture mechanics describes these fields through theories such as the Hutchinson-Rice-Rosengren (HRR) field for nonlinear power-law solids. However, continuum descriptions break down near cracks in soft and architected materials, where load is transmitted through discrete chains, fibers, or struts. Here, we develop a discrete crack-tip theory for lattice networks with nonlinear chains. The theory has two central components. First, at large deformation, the strain of a representative chain in layer i depends approximately linearly on the applied macroscopic strain, εᵢapprox kᵢ(λ-1), defining a layer-dependent strain-amplification factor kᵢ. Second, along topology-selected chain directions, termed discrete HRR lines, the layer-to-layer ratios of kᵢ follow a two-regime scaling law. Together, for a power-law chain force-strain relation with exponent p, the inner discrete regime predicts εᵢsim i⁻¹/p and fᵢsim i⁻¹, which differs from the classical continuum HRR prediction. The theory also explains why the intrinsic fracture energy approaches a size-independent limit as the network size increases. Photoelastic hydrogel experiments further validate our theory. These results reveal a two-regime crack-tip scaling law in nonlinear lattice networks and provide a framework for predicting chain deformation and intrinsic fracture energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究针对软材料和架构材料中连续介质断裂理论在裂纹尖端附近失效的问题，建立了适用于非线性链晶格网络的离散裂纹尖端理论。理论提出代表性链的应变放大因子及沿离散HRR线的双区域标度律，并预测内区应变与链力分别按层数的负倒数幂和负一次幂衰减。光弹性水凝胶实验验证了该理论，结果还解释了网络尺寸增大时本征断裂能趋于与尺寸无关极限的原因。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 裂纹尖端场控制着变形局部化和失效起始。经典连续介质断裂力学通过Hutchinson-Rice-Rosengren（HRR）场等理论描述非线性幂律固体中的这些场。然而，在软材料和架构材料中，载荷通过离散链、纤维或支柱传递，连续介质描述在裂纹附近会失效。在此，我们为具有非线性链的晶格网络建立了一种离散裂纹尖端理论。该理论包含两个核心部分。第一，在大变形下，第i层中代表性链的应变近似线性依赖于所施加的宏观应变，即εᵢ≈kᵢ(λ−1)，其中kᵢ定义为随层变化的应变放大因子。第二，沿着拓扑选定的链方向，即所谓的离散HRR线，kᵢ的层间比值遵循双区域标度律。对于指数为p的幂律链力—应变关系，离散内区理论预测εᵢ∼i⁻¹ᐟᵖ且fᵢ∼i⁻¹，这不同于经典连续介质HRR预测。该理论还解释了为什么随着网络尺寸增大，本征断裂能会趋近于与尺寸无关的极限。光弹性水凝胶实验进一步验证了我们的理论。这些结果揭示了非线性晶格网络中的双区域裂纹尖端标度律，并为预测链变形和本征断裂能提供了一个框架。

articles.title: Demonstration of room-temperature, magnetic-field-free, and ultralow-power spin-orbit torque logic device based on composition-uniform van der Waals magnet Fe3GaTe2
articles.title_zh: 基于成分均匀范德华磁体Fe3GaTe2的室温、无磁场超低功耗自旋轨道力矩逻辑器件演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04600v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Van der Waals magnets have received blooming interest in material science and spintronics for the advantages of low magnetization, flexible stacking, strong tunability, and dangling-bond-free interfaces. However, there has been no report of room-temperature magnetic-field-free spin logic device based on a van der Waals magnet. Here, we demonstrate a room-temperature, field-free, low-power, scalable spin-orbit torque in-memory computing logic device utilizing a van der Waals magnet Fe3GaTe2 bit with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and a Pt channel with strong spin Hall effect, high electrical conductivity, and electric asymmetries. Current pulse width-dependent switching measurement reveals a low intrinsic critical magnetic-field-free switching current of 1.8e7 A cm-2, a high thermal stability factor of 50, and the potential of an ultralow write power of 1.5 fJ per bit at 1 ns pulse width for a typical industrial-level device dimensions (40 times lower than the industrially optimized W/FeCoB device). These results suggest a great potential of van der Waals magnets in dense, ultralow-power, scalable in-memory computing technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究演示了一种基于范德华磁体Fe3GaTe2位元和具有强自旋霍尔效应的铂通道的室温、无磁场、低功耗自旋轨道力矩存内计算逻辑器件。器件具有1.8×10⁷安培/平方厘米的本征临界切换电流密度、50的热稳定因子，并显示出在1纳秒脉冲宽度下每位元1.5飞焦耳的超低写入功耗潜力。结果表明，范德华磁体有望用于高密度、超低功耗和可扩展的存内计算技术。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德华磁体因具有低磁化强度、灵活堆叠、强可调性以及无悬挂键界面等优点，在材料科学和自旋电子学领域受到广泛关注。然而，此前尚无关于基于范德华磁体的室温无磁场自旋逻辑器件的报道。在此，我们演示了一种室温、无磁场、低功耗且可扩展的自旋轨道力矩存内计算逻辑器件，该器件采用具有强垂直磁各向异性的范德华磁体Fe3GaTe2位元，以及具有强自旋霍尔效应、高电导率和电学非对称性的铂通道。依赖电流脉冲宽度的切换测量显示，该器件具有1.8×10⁷安培/平方厘米的低本征无磁场临界切换电流密度、50的高热稳定因子，并且在典型工业级器件尺寸和1纳秒脉冲宽度下，具有每位元1.5飞焦耳的超低写入功耗潜力，是经过工业优化的钨/FeCoB器件的四十分之一。这些结果表明，范德华磁体在高密度、超低功耗、可扩展的存内计算技术中具有巨大潜力。

articles.title: Light alkali metal functionalized two-dimensional C5N monolayers for enhanced hydrogen storage
articles.title_zh: 用于增强储氢性能的轻碱金属功能化二维C5N单层
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work presents a density functional theory (DFT) investigation of a two-dimensional (2D) C5N monolayer functionalized with Li, Na, and K for hydrogen storage. Pristine C5N exhibits weak H2 adsorption, while alkali-metal functionalization significantly enhances its storage capability. The C5N monolayer can stably accommodate up to six metal dopants, with binding energies stronger than the corresponding cohesive energies, indicating resistance to metal aggregation. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further confirm the thermal stability of the functionalized systems at 300 K. Charge transfer from the metal dopants to C5N enhances polarization and strengthens H2 adsorption. Each dopant can adsorb up to eight H2 molecules, yielding a maximum of 48 H2 molecules per unit cell and gravimetric storage capacities of 9.42, 8.61, and 7.93 wt% for Li-, Na-, and K-functionalized C5N, respectively. The average H2 adsorption energies of -0.16 to -0.17 eV/H2 indicate moderate interactions suitable for reversible storage. Thermodynamic analysis further demonstrates favourable H2 adsorption/desorption under practical operating conditions, while desorption-temperature, recovery-time, and volumetric analyses support the potential reversibility and storage performance of these systems. Overall, alkali-metal-functionalized C5N emerges as a promising 2D material for efficient and reversible H2 storage.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用密度泛函理论考察了Li、Na和K功能化二维C5N单层的储氢性能。碱金属功能化增强了氢分子吸附；每个掺杂原子最多可吸附8个氢分子，单位晶胞最多容纳48个氢分子，对应Li、Na和K体系分别为9.42%、8.61%和7.93%的质量储氢容量。计算表明，金属与C5N之间的电荷转移、适中的氢吸附能以及热力学稳定性使这些体系具有可逆储氢应用潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作采用密度泛函理论（DFT）研究了Li、Na和K功能化二维（2D）C5N单层的储氢性能。原始C5N表现出较弱的H2吸附能力，而碱金属功能化显著增强了其储氢能力。C5N单层能够稳定容纳最多六个金属掺杂原子，其结合能强于相应金属的内聚能，表明其能够抵抗金属团聚。第一性原理分子动力学模拟进一步证实了功能化体系在300开尔文下的热稳定性。金属掺杂原子向C5N发生电荷转移，增强了极化并强化了H2吸附。每个掺杂原子最多可吸附8个H2分子，从而每个晶胞最多容纳48个H2分子；Li、Na和K功能化C5N的质量储氢容量分别为9.42%、8.61%和7.93%。−0.16至−0.17电子伏特/H2的平均H2吸附能表明体系之间存在适度相互作用，适合可逆储氢。热力学分析进一步表明，在实际操作条件下H2的吸附和脱附具有有利条件；脱附温度、恢复时间和体积分析也支持这些体系的可逆性及其储氢性能。总体而言，碱金属功能化C5N是一种具有前景的高效、可逆储氢二维材料。

articles.title: Hydrogen Storage on Transition-Metal-Decorated Nitrogen-Modified Carbon Nanoribbons
articles.title_zh: 过渡金属修饰氮改性碳纳米带上的储氢研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently synthesized carbon nanoribbons (CNRs) were investigated for hydrogen (H2) storage using first-principles density functional theory calculations. Pristine CNRs exhibited weak H2 adsorption; therefore, the host structure was modified by substituting carbon atoms at the C-H edges with 12 nitrogen atoms, followed by Mn and Y doping to enhance H2 binding. A maximum of five metal atoms could be accommodated on the 12N-CNRs. Electronic structure analysis revealed strong orbital hybridization between the metal atoms and the CNRs, while binding energy calculations confirmed the structural stability of the doped systems. Bader charge analysis further quantified the charge transfer between the metal atoms and the host structure. The average H2 adsorption energies were calculated to be -0.40 eV/H2 for the Mn-doped system and -0.25 eV/H2 for the Y-doped system, which are within the desirable range for reversible hydrogen storage. The maximum theoretical gravimetric storage capacities at 0 K reached 7.48 wt% for the Mn-doped system and 6.55 wt% for the Y-doped system. Under practical conditions of 30 atm and 298.15 K, the storage capacity of the Y-doped system decreased to 6.04 wt%, whereas the Mn-doped system maintained its full capacity of 7.48 wt%. Thermodynamic analysis indicated that H2 adsorption is favored at low temperatures and high pressures, while desorption becomes feasible at elevated temperatures and lower pressures. These results demonstrate that Mn- and Y-doped CNRs satisfy key U.S. Department of Energy requirements for reversible H2 storage and show promise as potential hydrogen storage materials under near-ambient conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用第一性原理密度泛函理论计算了新近合成碳纳米带的储氢性能，并通过边缘碳原子被12个氮原子取代以及Mn、Y掺杂来增强氢吸附。Mn掺杂和Y掺杂体系的平均氢吸附能分别为−0.40和−0.25电子伏特/氢分子，理论质量储氢容量分别达到7.48%和6.55%。在298.15开尔文、30个大气压下，Y体系容量降至6.04%，而Mn体系保持7.48%的完整容量，显示出其在接近环境条件下可逆储氢的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究人员利用第一性原理密度泛函理论计算，研究了新近合成碳纳米带（CNR）的储氢（H2）性能。原始CNR表现出较弱的H2吸附能力；因此，通过将C—H边缘处的碳原子替换为12个氮原子对主体结构进行改性，随后进行Mn和Y掺杂以增强H2结合能力。12N-CNR最多可容纳五个金属原子。电子结构分析显示，金属原子与CNR之间存在强轨道杂化，而结合能计算证实了掺杂体系的结构稳定性。Bader电荷分析进一步量化了金属原子与主体结构之间的电荷转移。Mn掺杂体系和Y掺杂体系的平均H2吸附能分别为−0.40电子伏特/H2和−0.25电子伏特/H2，处于适合可逆储氢的理想范围内。在0开尔文下，理论最大质量储氢容量分别达到7.48%和6.55%。在30个大气压、298.15开尔文的实际条件下，Y掺杂体系的储氢容量降至6.04%，而Mn掺杂体系保持其7.48%的全部容量。热力学分析表明，H2吸附在低温和高压下更有利，而脱附在较高温度和较低压力下更易实现。这些结果表明，Mn和Y掺杂CNR满足美国能源部关于可逆储氢的关键要求，并显示出其在接近环境条件下作为潜在储氢材料的应用前景。

articles.title: Enhanced Multifractality Induced by Non-Hermitian Disorder in Quantum Percolation
articles.title_zh: 量子渗流中非厄米无序诱导的多重分形增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the interplay between geometric dilution and non-Hermitian disorder in the two-dimensional quantum site-percolation model. Non-Hermiticity is introduced through random imaginary on-site potentials, representing spatially uncorrelated gain and loss, while the hopping amplitudes remain reciprocal. By combining complex level-spacing statistics, participation entropy, and multifractal analysis, we characterize the localization properties of the eigenstates as functions of the disorder and the non-Hermiticity strength. Our finite-size scaling results show that non-Hermitian disorder shifts the quantum percolation threshold (p_q) toward larger occupation probabilities. Consequently, the fully delocalized phase is progressively suppressed and disappears at sufficiently strong disorder. This suppression is not a simple consequence of adding on-site disorder of a given strength, but is specifically enhanced by its imaginary character, as an equally strong real (Hermitian) on-site potential produces a weaker shift of p_q. Nevertheless, the intermediate region between the classical (p_c) and quantum percolation thresholds presents a genuine multifractal critical phase, while the localization-length exponent ν remains the same, relative to its Hermitian value. Altogether, our results demonstrate that random gain and loss enhance the multifractal regime while preserving the universality class of the quantum percolation transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维量子格点渗流模型中几何稀释与非厄米无序的相互作用。研究发现，随机增益和损耗会将量子渗流阈值推向更高的占据概率，逐步抑制并最终消除完全离域相，同时增强介于经典与量子渗流阈值之间的多重分形临界相。尽管如此，局域化长度指数相对于厄米情形保持不变，表明量子渗流转变的普适性类别未被改变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了二维量子格点渗流模型中几何稀释与非厄米无序之间的相互作用。通过随机虚在位势引入非厄米性，以表示空间上不相关的增益与损耗，同时保持跃迁振幅具有互易性。结合复能级间距统计、参与熵和多重分形分析，我们刻画了本征态局域化性质随无序和非厄米强度变化的特征。有限尺寸标度结果表明，非厄米无序会将量子渗流阈值 p_q 推向更大的占据概率。因此，完全离域相逐渐受到抑制，并在无序足够强时消失。这种抑制并不仅仅是加入特定强度在位无序的简单结果，而是受到其虚数性质的特定增强，因为强度相同的实数（厄米）在位势对 p_q 产生的偏移较弱。尽管如此，经典渗流阈值 p_c 与量子渗流阈值之间的中间区域仍呈现出真正的多重分形临界相，而局域化长度指数 ν 相对于其厄米情形保持不变。总之，我们的结果表明，随机增益和损耗能够增强多重分形区域，同时保持量子渗流转变的普适性类别。

articles.title: Evidence of Crystal-Field-Mediated Anisotropic Orbital Rashba Effect in Epitaxial Ru/FM Heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 外延 Ru/铁磁体异质结构中晶场介导的各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrical generation of orbital angular momentum provides a promising route to current-induced torques, yet effective control of orbital Rashba textures still remains challenging, particularly because the role of the interfacial crystal field remains largely unexplored. Here, we report experimental evidence for a crystal-field-mediated interfacial anisotropic orbital Rashba effect (AORE) in epitaxial Ru/ferromagnet heterostructures. Total orbital torque was disentangled into an isotropic bulk contribution and an in-plane anisotropic interfacial contribution. The latter was strongly suppressed by degrading the crystallinity of either constituent and by inserting a Cu spacer, highlighting the essential roles of coherent interfacial orbital hybridization and direct Ru/ferromagnet contact. These results identify interfacial crystal-field coherency as a key ingredient in manipulating orbital Rashba textures and establish a route toward engineering the symmetry and directionality of orbital torques.
articles.abstract_zh: 电学产生轨道角动量为电流诱导力矩提供了有前景的途径，但轨道 Rashba 纹理的有效调控仍然困难，尤其是界面晶场的作用尚未得到充分研究。本文在外延 Ru/铁磁体异质结构中发现了晶场介导的界面各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应的实验迹象。结果表明，相干的界面轨道杂化和直接的 Ru/铁磁体接触对于调控轨道力矩的对称性和方向性至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电学产生轨道角动量为电流诱导力矩提供了一条有前景的途径，但对轨道 Rashba 纹理进行有效调控仍然具有挑战性，特别是因为界面晶场的作用在很大程度上尚未得到研究。在此，我们报道了外延 Ru/铁磁体异质结构中存在晶场介导的界面各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应（AORE）的实验证据。我们将总轨道力矩分解为各向同性的体相贡献和面内各向异性的界面贡献。后者在任一组分的晶体质量下降以及插入 Cu 间隔层时都会受到强烈抑制，这凸显了相干界面轨道杂化和 Ru/铁磁体直接接触的关键作用。这些结果表明，界面晶场相干性是操控轨道 Rashba 纹理的关键因素，并确立了一条工程化调节轨道力矩对称性和方向性的路径。

articles.title: Mean-field theory for quantum spin chains
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋链的平均场理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mean-field theory is a widely used approximation for describing phase transitions, particularly effective above the upper critical dimension. Its origins can be traced back to the van der Waals theory of the liquid-gas transition and Weiss's molecular field theory of the paramagnetic-ferromagnetic transition. However, it was Lev D. Landau who provided a unifying and general framework applicable to a broad class of physical systems. The mean-field approach typically involves neglecting thermal fluctuations, which is a reasonable assumption in many classical contexts. However, its application to quantum phase transitions at zero temperature is less common. The aim of this short pedagogical paper is to explore and clarify the use of the mean-field approach in the less familiar domain of quantum phase transitions. We specifically consider the Ising model and the Blume-Capel model.
articles.abstract_zh: 平均场理论是描述相变的广泛使用的近似方法，在高于上临界维度时尤其有效。本文以教学性短文的形式，探讨并阐明平均场方法在较不熟悉的零温量子相变领域中的应用。研究具体考察了伊辛模型和 Blume-Capel 模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平均场理论是一种广泛用于描述相变的近似方法，在高于上临界维度时尤其有效。它的起源可以追溯到范德瓦耳斯的液-气相变理论以及 Weiss 的顺磁-铁磁相变分子场理论。然而，是 Lev D. Landau 提供了一个统一且适用于广泛物理系统的一般框架。平均场方法通常涉及忽略热涨落，这在许多经典情形下是合理的假设。然而，将其应用于零温量子相变的情况并不常见。这篇简短的教学性论文旨在探索并澄清平均场方法在量子相变这一较不熟悉领域中的使用方式。我们具体考察了伊辛模型和 Blume-Capel 模型。

articles.title: Orientation selection and superconducting properties of epitaxial Al on ferromagnetic semiconductor (In,Fe)As
articles.title_zh: 铁磁半导体（In,Fe）As 上外延 Al 的取向选择与超导性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductor/ferromagnet heterostructures provide a versatile platform for exploring spin-dependent superconducting phenomena arising from interfacial proximity effects. In this article, we investigate the structural and superconducting properties of Al thin films grown in situ by molecular beam epitaxy on strained Fe-doped ferromagnetic semiconductor (FMS) (In,Fe)As layers. X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy reveal the epitaxial growth of single-crystalline Al layers, with the growth orientation changing from (110) to (111) as the in-plane lattice constant of (In,Fe)As increases. The superconducting critical temperature of Al varies systematically with the film surface morphology and grain size. In addition, the critical magnetic field of Al exhibits an anomalous decrease below 0.5 K, possibly reflecting magnetic coupling to the underlying FMS (In,Fe)As layer. These findings provide a guideline for material design of epitaxial Al/(In,Fe)As heterostructures, which may serve as a promising platform for investigating proximity-induced superconducting and magnetic phenomena in semiconductor-based hybrid quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了应变 Fe 掺杂铁磁半导体（In,Fe）As 层上原位分子束外延生长的 Al 薄膜的结构与超导性质。实验表明，随着（In,Fe）As 面内晶格常数增大，Al 的生长取向由（110）转变为（111），而其超导临界温度随表面形貌和晶粒尺寸系统变化。Al 临界磁场在低于 0.5 K 时出现异常下降，可能反映了其与下方铁磁半导体层之间的磁耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导体/铁磁体异质结构为探索由界面邻近效应产生的自旋相关超导现象提供了多功能平台。在本文中，我们研究了通过分子束外延原位生长在应变 Fe 掺杂铁磁半导体（FMS）（In,Fe）As 层上的 Al 薄膜的结构和超导性质。X 射线衍射和透射电子显微镜表明，Al 层实现了外延生长并具有单晶结构；随着（In,Fe）As 的面内晶格常数增大，其生长取向由（110）变为（111）。Al 的超导临界温度随薄膜表面形貌和晶粒尺寸发生系统变化。此外，Al 的临界磁场在 0.5 K 以下表现出异常下降，这可能反映了其与下方铁磁半导体（In,Fe）As 层之间的磁耦合。这些发现为外延 Al/（In,Fe）As 异质结构的材料设计提供了指导，该结构有望成为研究半导体基混合量子器件中邻近效应诱导的超导和磁现象的平台。

articles.title: Field-Driven Coupled Magnon--Phonon--Electron Relaxation in Magnetite Using Steepest-Entropy-Ascent Quantum Thermodynamic Formalism
articles.title_zh: 利用最大熵增长量子热力学形式研究磁铁矿中场驱动的耦合磁振子-声子-电子弛豫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A field-driven steepest-entropy-ascent quantum thermodynamic (SEAQT) formulation is developed for longitudinal nonequilibrium relaxation in magnetite (Fe₃O₄) with coupled electron, phonon, and magnon populations. Material-specific excitation spectra define the thermodynamic state space, while one relaxation parameter for each population sets its kinetic scale. A longitudinal magnetic field shifts the dressed magnon eigenenergies while the occupation basis remains fixed; irreversible redistribution conserves instantaneous energy and electron number while allowing the magnon population to vary. The formulation yields nonequilibrium subsystem temperatures, entropy production, magnetic-work identities, and a coupled small-signal susceptibility incorporating energy-conservation feedback among all three populations; the one-pole Debye response appears only as a limiting case. Numerical results under sinusoidal driving show a transition from nearly quasistatic behavior to frequency-dependent lag, finite-amplitude departure from the linear-response ellipse, and increasing higher-harmonic content. Relaxational work per cycle increases strongly with field amplitude and frequency, while the complex susceptibility is broader and shifted relative to a Debye reference. Entropy production remains positive, and the electron, phonon, and magnon temperatures show distinct excursions followed by secular heating when positive magnetic work is retained without heat rejection. The calculated work represents longitudinal magnon quasiparticle relaxation in a homogeneous single-domain model, not the total core loss of a finite ferrite specimen.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了场驱动的最大熵增长量子热力学（SEAQT）模型，用于描述磁铁矿中电子、声子和磁振子群体耦合的纵向非平衡弛豫。模型引入材料特定的激发谱和分别表征各群体动力学尺度的弛豫参数，并在正弦驱动下揭示了从近似准静态行为到频率相关滞后的转变。结果表明，磁振子、声子和电子之间的能量守恒反馈使响应偏离单极点 Debye 形式，且在保留正磁功而无热排出的情况下会出现持续升温。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了一种场驱动的最大熵增长量子热力学（SEAQT）形式，用于描述磁铁矿（Fe₃O₄）中电子、声子和磁振子群体耦合的纵向非平衡弛豫。材料特定的激发谱定义了热力学状态空间，而每个群体各自的一个弛豫参数则确定其动力学尺度。纵向磁场会移动修饰后的磁振子本征能量，而占据基保持不变；不可逆再分配守恒瞬时能量和电子数，同时允许磁振子数发生变化。该形式给出了非平衡子系统温度、熵产生、磁功恒等式，以及包含三个群体之间能量守恒反馈的耦合小信号磁化率；单极点 Debye 响应仅在极限情况下出现。正弦驱动下的数值结果显示，系统会从近似准静态行为转变为具有频率相关滞后的行为，有限振幅会使系统偏离线性响应椭圆，并导致高次谐波成分增加。每个周期的弛豫功随场振幅和频率显著增加，而复磁化率相对于 Debye 参考响应更宽且发生偏移。当保留正磁功而不进行热排出时，熵产生保持为正，电子、声子和磁振子温度会经历不同的偏离，随后出现持续升温。计算得到的功表示均匀单畴模型中的纵向磁振子准粒子弛豫，而不是有限尺寸铁氧体样品的总磁芯损耗。

articles.title: Challenges in orbital current-driven domain wall motion in light metal/ferrimagnet heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 轻金属/亚铁磁体异质结构中轨道电流驱动畴壁运动的挑战
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in spintronics suggest that orbital Hall currents generated by charge injection in light metals can provide nonequilibrium angular momentum without relying on strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Here, we examine whether such orbital currents can drive domain wall (DW) motion in an amorphous ferrimagnetic alloy, Gd₂₅(Fe₉Co₁)₇₅ (GFC), where the rare-earth sublattice offers strong SOC for orbital-to-spin conversion. We compare three representative heterostructures: Pt/GFC as a spin Hall reference, light-metal (Mn or Ti)/GFC for direct orbital-current injection, and light-metal/Pt/GFC incorporating an ultrathin Pt layer for orbital-to-spin conversion. Whereas Pt/GFC exhibits robust and reproducible spin-orbit-torque-driven DW motion, no current-driven DW motion is detected in Mn/GFC or Ti/GFC. Second-harmonic Hall measurements nevertheless reveal finite damping-like torques in both Mn/GFC and Ti/GFC, demonstrating that angular-momentum transfer into GFC does occur but is far weaker than in Pt/GFC. Inserting a 1-nm-thick Pt conversion layer strongly enhances the damping-like torque and restores DW motion. Thickness-dependent analysis further shows that DW mobility and depinning thresholds correlate with the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and domain-wall width, highlighting weak torque conversion and insufficient interfacial stabilization of chiral DWs as key challenges for orbital-driven DW motion in light-metal/ferrimagnet heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考察轻金属注入的轨道霍尔电流能否驱动非晶亚铁磁合金 Gd₂₅(Fe₉Co₁)₇₅ 中的畴壁运动，并比较了自旋霍尔参考结构、直接轨道电流注入结构和带有超薄 Pt 转换层的结构。Mn/GFC 和 Ti/GFC 中虽检测到有限的类阻尼力矩，却未观察到电流驱动的畴壁运动；加入 1 nm Pt 转换层后，类阻尼力矩显著增强并恢复了畴壁运动。结果表明，力矩转换效率低以及手性畴壁界面稳定性不足，是轨道驱动畴壁运动面临的关键挑战。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文研究轻金属/铁磁合金异质结构中的轨道霍尔流、轨道-自旋转换和电流驱动畴壁运动，并比较了铂、锰和钛等不同结构。结果表明，轻金属直接注入的轨道流产生的阻尼型力矩较弱，加入超薄铂转换层后可显著增强力矩并恢复畴壁运动。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、自旋电子学、畴壁动力学、自旋轨道耦合和非平衡角动量输运方向直接相关。其异质结构设计和畴壁驱动机制可与自旋动力学、微磁模拟及第一性原理自旋轨道力矩计算结合。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步计算不同界面结构中的轨道霍尔电导、轨道-自旋转换效率和阻尼型力矩，并建立包含轨道自由度的自旋动力学模型。建议重点阅读其界面厚度依赖和轨道流诱导畴壁运动的实验判据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋电子学的近期进展表明，轻金属中由电荷注入产生的轨道霍尔电流能够在不依赖强自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的情况下提供非平衡角动量。在此，我们考察这种轨道电流能否驱动非晶亚铁磁合金 Gd₂₅(Fe₉Co₁)₇₅（GFC）中的畴壁（DW）运动，其中稀土子晶格提供了较强的 SOC，可用于轨道到自旋的转换。我们比较了三种代表性异质结构：作为自旋霍尔参考的 Pt/GFC、用于直接注入轨道电流的轻金属（Mn 或 Ti）/GFC，以及包含超薄 Pt 层以实现轨道到自旋转换的轻金属/Pt/GFC。Pt/GFC 表现出由自旋轨道力矩驱动的稳健且可重复的畴壁运动，而在 Mn/GFC 或 Ti/GFC 中没有检测到电流驱动的畴壁运动。尽管如此，二次谐波霍尔测量在 Mn/GFC 和 Ti/GFC 中均揭示出有限的类阻尼力矩，证明角动量确实传递到了 GFC 中，但其强度远弱于 Pt/GFC。在结构中插入 1 nm 厚的 Pt 转换层会显著增强类阻尼力矩并恢复畴壁运动。厚度依赖性分析进一步表明，畴壁迁移率和脱钉阈值与界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用及畴壁宽度相关，这凸显出较弱的力矩转换和手性畴壁界面稳定性不足是轻金属/亚铁磁体异质结构实现轨道驱动畴壁运动的关键挑战。

articles.title: On the Stability of the Polar Phase of Superfluid 3He in Nematic Aerogels
articles.title_zh: 向列气凝胶中超流氦-3 极性相的稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04821v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the stability of the solution corresponding to the polar phase of superfluid 3He in nematic aerogels with respect to perturbations induced by magnetic impurity scattering. We show that when the perturbation simultaneously breaks axial and time-reversal symmetry, the polar-distorted A phase is realized with the highest transition temperature. Within the proposed model of a p-wave scattering potential, which accounts for the effective spin-orbit interaction between the orbital angular momentum of a scattering quasiparticle and the magnetic moment texture of the scatterer, we solve the eigenvalue and eigenvector problem for the Gor'kov self-consistency equation. Finally, we discuss how our results relate to the available experimental data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究向列气凝胶中超流氦-3 极性相解在磁性杂质散射扰动下的稳定性。结果表明，当扰动同时破坏轴对称性和时间反演对称性时，极性畸变 A 相具有最高的转变温度。作者在包含散射准粒子轨道角动量与散射体磁矩纹理之间有效自旋轨道相互作用的 p 波散射势模型下，求解了 Gor'kov 自洽方程的本征值和本征矢问题，并讨论了结果与现有实验数据的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了向列气凝胶中超流氦-3 极性相所对应解在磁性杂质散射诱导扰动下的稳定性。我们表明，当扰动同时破坏轴对称性和时间反演对称性时，极性畸变 A 相得以实现，并具有最高的转变温度。在所提出的 p 波散射势模型中，我们考虑了散射准粒子的轨道角动量与散射体磁矩纹理之间的有效自旋轨道相互作用，并求解了 Gor'kov 自洽方程的本征值和本征矢问题。最后，我们讨论了这些结果与现有实验数据之间的关系。

articles.title: Multi-task deep-learning optimization of trade-off properties for superior-performance Fe-based soft magnetic alloys
articles.title_zh: 面向优异性能铁基软磁合金折中性质的多任务深度学习优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fe-based amorphous alloys are promising soft magnetic materials for developing next-generation devices with high frequency and efficiency. However, optimization of Fe-based alloys with ultra-high saturation magnetic flux density (Bₛ), ultra-low coercivity (H_c), and good glass-forming ability is a notorious problem, owing to the vast composition space and complex trade-offs of these properties. Thus, conventional design methods encounter great challenges. Here we develop a generative multi-task deep learning (GMTDL) to achieve simultaneous optimization of compositions and trade-off properties. The GMTDL can sufficiently exploit and share the knowledge of datasets across different tasks, despite the limitation and imbalance of these datasets. Therefore, it exhibits superior performance in prediction of alloys with multiple targeted properties, outperforming previous machine learning-based design strategies. Moreover, the GMTDL can also tailor compositions, providing an efficient way to regulate properties and generate desired candidates for further experimental processing. The validity and reliability of GMTDL are rigorously tested by benchmarking with Fe-based alloys reported very recently. Moreover, some new alloys with ultra-high Bₛ and ultra-low H_c are predicted. The optimal content windows of key elements and their synergistic effects are also unraveled for practical guidance. Thus, our study establishes an effective and reliable paradigm for simultaneous prediction and optimization of high-performance materials with multiple properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁基非晶合金是开发高频高效下一代器件的有前景软磁材料，但同时获得超高饱和磁感应强度、超低矫顽力和良好玻璃形成能力面临巨大的成分空间与复杂性质折中。本文开发了生成式多任务深度学习方法，以同时优化合金成分和多种折中性质，并通过共享不同任务数据集中的知识提升预测能力。该方法还能调整成分、揭示关键元素的最佳含量窗口及协同效应，并预测出具有超高饱和磁感应强度和超低矫顽力的新合金候选。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁基非晶合金是开发具有高频率和高效率的下一代器件的有前景软磁材料。然而，由于成分空间极其庞大，且这些性质之间存在复杂的折中关系，同时优化铁基合金的超高饱和磁感应强度（Bₛ）、超低矫顽力（H_c）和良好玻璃形成能力是一个长期难题。因此，传统设计方法面临巨大挑战。在此，我们开发了一种生成式多任务深度学习（GMTDL）方法，以实现对成分和折中性质的同步优化。尽管不同任务的数据集存在规模有限和分布不平衡的问题，GMTDL 仍能充分利用并共享这些数据集中的知识。因此，在预测具有多种目标性质的合金方面，其表现优于以往基于机器学习的设计策略。此外，GMTDL 还能够调整成分，为调控性质并生成供后续实验加工的目标候选材料提供高效方法。我们通过与近期报道的铁基合金进行基准比较，严格检验了 GMTDL 的有效性和可靠性。此外，我们预测出了一些具有超高 Bₛ 和超低 H_c 的新合金。我们还揭示了关键元素的最佳含量窗口及其协同效应，为实际应用提供指导。因此，本研究建立了一种有效且可靠的范式，可用于同时预测和优化具有多种性质的高性能材料。

articles.title: Excitation caging in a vertex-frustrated quasiperiodic Einstein artificial spin ice
articles.title_zh: 顶点受挫准周期 Einstein 人工自旋冰中的激发囚禁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Naturally occurring bulk quasicrystals are rare, and magnetic instances are rarer still, with chemical constraints typically permitting the synthesis of approximants rather than true quasicrystalline magnets. Here, we present an artificial spin ice based on a recently discovered Einstein lattice, the Hat tiling, which is built from the first known shape - the hat - that tiles the plane only aperiodically. The Einstein artificial spin ice has long-range structural order with no translational symmetry, and low-connectivity vertices with well-defined local ground states and excitations. Together, these properties provide a model two-dimensional quasicrystalline magnet, with magnetic correlations that we probe with magnetic force microscopy and parallel-tempered Monte Carlo simulations. We identify a two-stage partial ordering process, driven by the competition between two possible positions for magnetic excitations. This competition is resolved in the ground-state manifold, where exactly one magnetic excitation is caged on each antihat, yet the manifold remains macroscopically degenerate. This yields an unusual type of medium-range order, where the underlying quasiperiodic long-range order is randomly modulated by a strictly constrained disorder. Our findings establish the Einstein artificial spin ice as a blueprint for understanding quasicrystalline magnetism, demonstrating how quasiperiodic monotile geometries can be exploited to engineer unconventional magnetic phases with no direct equivalent in periodic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 天然存在的块体准晶体十分稀少，磁性准晶体则更为罕见，因为化学限制通常只能合成近似准晶体。本文提出一种基于帽形铺砌 Einstein 晶格的人工自旋冰，其具有长程结构有序性但没有平移对称性。磁力显微镜和并行回火蒙特卡洛模拟揭示了由磁激发位置竞争驱动的两阶段部分有序过程，并发现基态流形中每个反帽形单元恰好囚禁一个磁激发，同时仍保持宏观简并。该体系为研究准晶磁性和设计周期体系中没有直接对应物的非常规磁相提供了模型平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 天然形成的块体准晶体十分稀少，而磁性准晶体则更加罕见，因为化学限制通常只能允许合成近似晶体，而不是真正的准晶磁体。在此，我们提出一种基于最近发现的 Einstein 晶格的人工自旋冰，该晶格采用帽形铺砌构成；帽形是已知的第一个只能以非周期方式铺满平面的形状。Einstein 人工自旋冰具有长程结构有序性，却没有平移对称性，并包含具有确定局域基态和激发态的低连接度顶点。这些性质共同构成了一个理想的二维准晶磁体模型，我们利用磁力显微镜和并行回火蒙特卡洛模拟探测其中的磁关联。我们发现了一个由两种可能的磁激发位置之间的竞争驱动的两阶段部分有序过程。在基态流形中，这种竞争得到解决：每个反帽形单元上恰好囚禁一个磁激发，但该流形仍然具有宏观简并性。这产生了一种不寻常的中程有序，其中基础性的准周期长程有序被严格受约束的无序随机调制。我们的发现确立了 Einstein 人工自旋冰作为理解准晶磁性的蓝图，并展示了如何利用准周期单瓦片几何结构设计在周期体系中没有直接对应物的非常规磁相。

articles.title: Spin-Point-Group Classification of Multipoles for Nonrelativistic Collinear Magnets
articles.title_zh: 非相对论共线磁体中多极矩的自旋点群分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multipole moments provide a unified symmetry language for describing electronic degrees of freedom and their associated physical responses. Although active multipoles have been systematically classified for crystallographic and magnetic point groups, their classification in spin point groups, which naturally describe magnetic systems in the absence of spin-orbit coupling, has remained unexplored. In this work, we present a complete classification of active orbital and spin multipoles for all 32 nonmagnetic and 122 collinear spin point groups. Treating orbital and spin degrees of freedom independently, we identify the symmetry-allowed multipoles associated with nonmagnetic and collinear magnetic orderings and clarify their hierarchy through comparisons among the corresponding spin point groups. The resulting classification provides a symmetry-based database that distinguishes structural and magnetic contributions to active multipoles and directly identifies microscopic order parameters, including those responsible for d-, g-, and i-wave altermagnetism. Furthermore, by classifying response tensors within the same framework, we establish a correspondence between active multipoles and symmetry-allowed physical responses. This correspondence systematically distinguishes nonrelativistic responses that survive without spin-orbit coupling from those requiring relativistic effects, providing a unified framework for understanding and predicting spin-dependent electromagnetic and transport phenomena in magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 多极矩为描述电子自由度及其相关物理响应提供了统一的对称性语言。本文对全部 32 个非磁性自旋点群和 122 个共线自旋点群中的活性轨道多极矩与自旋多极矩进行了完整分类，并分别处理轨道与自旋自由度。该分类数据库区分了结构和磁性贡献，识别了包括 d 波、g 波和 i 波交错磁性在内的微观序参量，并建立了活性多极矩与对称性允许物理响应之间的对应关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多极矩为描述电子自由度及其相关物理响应提供了一种统一的对称性语言。尽管活性多极矩已经针对晶体学点群和磁点群得到系统分类，但在自然描述无自旋轨道耦合磁性系统的自旋点群中，其分类仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们对全部 32 个非磁性自旋点群和 122 个共线自旋点群中的活性轨道多极矩和自旋多极矩进行了完整分类。我们将轨道自由度和自旋自由度分别处理，识别了与非磁性和共线磁性有序相关的对称性允许多极矩，并通过比较相应的自旋点群阐明了它们的层级关系。所得分类提供了一个基于对称性的数据库，用于区分活性多极矩中的结构贡献和磁性贡献，并直接识别微观序参量，包括负责 d 波、g 波和 i 波交错磁性的序参量。此外，通过在同一框架内对响应张量进行分类，我们建立了活性多极矩与对称性允许物理响应之间的对应关系。这种对应关系系统地区分了无需自旋轨道耦合即可存在的非相对论响应与需要相对论效应的响应，为理解和预测磁性材料中的自旋相关电磁和输运现象提供了统一框架。

articles.title: Cascade spin dynamics of excitons localized in indirect-band-gap (In,Al)As/AlAs quantum dots with type-I band alignment
articles.title_zh: I 型能带排列间接带隙（In,Al）As/AlAs 量子点中局域激子的级联自旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the spin dynamics of excitons localized in type I (In,Al)As/AlAs quantum dots with an indirect in momentum space band structure. Polarized selective photoluminescence spectroscopy, i.e. fluorescence line narrowing, under magnetic fields up to 5 T applied in the Faraday geometry is employed. The experiment reveals a cascade spin evolution process of excitons in the indirect band-gap quantum dots: an initial short term spin dynamics associated with excited direct exciton states possessing a large oscillator strength is followed by electron relaxation into the X valley of the Brillouin zone and subsequent long term spin dynamics of indirect excitons. The two step mechanism manifests itself in the distinct features of the magnetic field dependences of photoluminescence: two component recovery of optical orientation, two component linear to circular polarization conversion and the presence of the linear polarization plane rotation. At the same time, suppression of the optical alignment shows one-component behavior governed by the spin dynamics of the indirect exciton states. Within the pseudospin formalism, we derive analytical expressions that quantitatively describe the observed dependences and yield estimates for the anisotropic exchange splitting: 210 μeV for direct excitons and 1.3 μeV for indirect excitons. Further analysis using the density matrix formalism agrees well with the pseudospin model calculations and shows that the finite optical orientation at zero magnetic field is due to comparable magnitudes of the anisotropic splitting of the indirect exciton states and the splitting of the X-valley electron states caused by the hyperfine interaction with nuclei.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有动量空间间接能带结构的 I 型（In,Al）As/AlAs 量子点中局域激子的自旋动力学，并通过磁场下的偏振选择性光致发光谱进行探测。实验揭示了级联自旋演化过程：具有较大振子强度的激发直接激子先经历短时自旋动力学，随后电子弛豫至布里渊区的 X 谷并产生间接激子的长时自旋动力学。伪自旋和密度矩阵分析定量解释了实验结果，并分别得到直接激子和间接激子的各向异性交换劈裂约为 210 μeV 和 1.3 μeV。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有动量空间间接能带结构的 I 型（In,Al）As/AlAs 量子点中局域激子的自旋动力学。实验采用偏振选择性光致发光谱，即荧光线窄化技术，并在法拉第几何下施加最高 5 T 的磁场。实验揭示了间接带隙量子点中激子的级联自旋演化过程：首先是与具有较大振子强度的激发直接激子态相关的短时自旋动力学，随后电子弛豫至布里渊区的 X 谷，并产生间接激子的长时自旋动力学。这种两步机制体现在光致发光磁场依赖性的明显特征中，包括光学取向的双组分恢复、线偏振到圆偏振转换的双组分行为以及线偏振面旋转的出现。同时，光学排列的抑制表现出单组分行为，并由间接激子态的自旋动力学控制。在赝自旋形式下，我们推导了解析表达式，定量描述了所观测的依赖关系，并得到各向异性交换劈裂的估计值：直接激子为 210 μeV，间接激子为 1.3 μeV。进一步采用密度矩阵形式进行的分析与赝自旋模型计算符合良好，并表明零磁场下仍存在有限光学取向，是由于间接激子态的各向异性劈裂与 X 谷电子态由核超精细相互作用引起的劈裂具有相近的大小。

articles.title: Nuclear quantum effects in the thermal conductivity of solid hydrogen
articles.title_zh: 固态氢热导率中的核量子效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use a combination of path integral and lattice dynamics methods to calculate the thermal conductivity of solid parahydrogen. Path integral molecular dynamics is first used to calculate a centroid potential of mean force at each temperature, on which a harmonic phonon basis is constructed using the finite displacement method. We then calculate anharmonic force constants on the centroid potential and solve the linearised phonon Boltzmann transport equation for the thermal conductivity. The resulting renormalised phonon dispersion curves, heat capacity, and thermal conductivity are all in remarkably good agreement with experimental measurements. We find that the heat transport is dominated by collective relaxon modes at low temperatures and cannot be captured by making the phonon relaxation time approximation. Indeed, quantitative agreement with the experimental thermal conductivity is only achieved when the nuclear quantum effects in the centroid potential of mean force, phonon boundary scattering, and hydrodynamic transport are all explicitly considered. This is also likely to be the case for other quantum crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合路径积分方法和晶格动力学方法，计算了固态仲氢的热导率。研究在路径积分分子动力学基础上构造温度相关的质心平均力势，并据此建立谐性声子基，再计算非谐力常数和线性化声子玻尔兹曼输运方程。结果表明，低温热输运由集体弛豫子模主导，只有同时考虑质心平均力势中的核量子效应、声子边界散射和流体动力学输运，才能定量再现实验热导率。
articles.focus_summary: 论文结合路径积分分子动力学、晶格动力学和声子玻尔兹曼输运方程，研究固态正氢中的核量子效应及热导率。结果表明，只有同时考虑核量子效应、边界散射和流体动力学输运，才能定量复现实验热导率。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的分子动力学、热输运、声子重整化、热导率和核量子效应方向相关。其将路径积分模拟得到的平均力势与非谐声子输运结合的策略，可借鉴到低温量子晶体、固态电解质和复杂材料热输运研究中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议关注其质心平均力势构造、非谐力常数计算及超越弛豫时间近似的输运分析。可进一步研究核量子效应对锂离子扩散、固态电解质热导率或氢相关材料相变的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们结合路径积分方法和晶格动力学方法，计算了固态仲氢的热导率。首先利用路径积分分子动力学在每个温度下计算质心平均力势，然后采用有限位移方法在该势上构建谐性声子基。随后，我们在质心势上计算非谐力常数，并求解线性化声子玻尔兹曼输运方程以获得热导率。所得重整化声子色散曲线、热容和热导率均与实验测量结果表现出非常好的符合。我们发现，低温下热输运由集体弛豫子模主导，不能通过采用声子弛豫时间近似来描述。事实上，只有同时显式考虑质心平均力势中的核量子效应、声子边界散射和流体动力学输运，才能在定量上与实验热导率相符。对于其他量子晶体而言，情况也很可能如此。

articles.title: Local coordination, structural softening, and polarization-switching energetics in Sc-alloyed GaN
articles.title_zh: Sc合金化GaN中的局域配位、结构软化与极化翻转能学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sc-alloyed wurtzite nitrides exhibit strongly tunable electromechanical and ferroelectric properties, yet the relationship between their lattice evolution and local bonding environment remains insufficiently established, particularly in ScₓGa₁₋ₓN. Here, we investigate the structural and local bonding evolution of ScₓGa₁₋ₓN across the dilute-to-intermediate composition range by combining X-ray diffraction, Sc K-edge X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES), extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) and first-principles calculations. Sc incorporation produces an anisotropic lattice expansion and a progressive reduction in the c/a ratio. XANES and EXAFS reveal a concurrent modification of the local environment around Sc, with the effective Sc-N coordination number increasing from 4.1(4) to 4.5(2) and the average Sc-N bond length increasing from 2.045(7) to 2.081(8)Å over x=0.06-0.26. The local response is accompanied by a reduction in the Sc K-edge pre-edge intensity, consistent with a gradual reduction of the local tetrahedral asymmetry. First-principles calculations show that these structural changes are associated with site-selective distortions around Sc and progressive flattening of the structural energy landscape. The calculated intrinsic polarization-switching barrier decreases from 24.2 to 19.0 meV/Å³ with increasing Sc content, while the calculated piezoelectric stress coefficient (e₃₃) increases from 0.82 to 1.66~C/m² and elastic constant (C₃₃) decreases from 380 to 227~GPa, resulting in an increase of piezoelectric strain coefficient (d₃₃) from 2.99 to 12.46~pC/N. These results show that Sc incorporation progressively modifies the local coordination environment and structural energetics of ScGaN while the long-range wurtzite structure remains preserved over the investigated composition range.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究结合X射线衍射、Sc K边X射线吸收谱和第一性原理计算，研究了ScₓGa₁-xN从稀释到中等组分范围内的结构与局域键合演化。Sc掺入引起各向异性晶格膨胀、c/a比下降以及Sc局域配位和键长的改变，同时使结构能量面逐渐变平，并降低本征极化翻转势垒。尽管局域结构持续变化，所研究组分范围内的长程纤锌矿结构仍保持稳定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Sc合金化的纤锌矿氮化物表现出高度可调的机电和铁电性质，但其晶格演化与局域成键环境之间的关系仍未得到充分确立，尤其是对于ScₓGa₁-xN而言。本文结合X射线衍射、Sc K边X射线吸收近边结构（XANES）、扩展X射线吸收精细结构（EXAFS）和第一性原理计算，研究了ScₓGa₁-xN在从稀释到中等组分范围内的结构与局域成键演化。Sc的引入导致各向异性晶格膨胀以及c/a比逐步降低。XANES和EXAFS显示，Sc周围的局域环境也发生了相应变化：在x=0.06-0.26范围内，有效Sc-N配位数由4.1(4)增加到4.5(2)，平均Sc-N键长由2.045(7) Å增加到2.081(8) Å。局域响应还伴随着Sc K边前峰强度降低，这与局域四面体不对称性的逐步减弱相一致。第一性原理计算表明，这些结构变化与Sc周围具有位点选择性的畸变以及结构能量面的逐步变平有关。随着Sc含量增加，计算得到的本征极化翻转势垒由24.2 meV/Å³降至19.0 meV/Å³，而计算得到的压电应力系数（e₃₃）由0.82 C/m²增加到1.66 C/m²，弹性常数（C₃₃）由380 GPa降低到227 GPa，从而使压电应变系数（d₃₃）由2.99 pC/N增加到12.46 pC/N。这些结果表明，在所研究的组分范围内，Sc掺入会逐步改变ScGaN的局域配位环境和结构能学，同时长程纤锌矿结构仍得以保持。

articles.title: Generalized Helicity-Dependent Magnetization Switching via Substrate Phonons
articles.title_zh: 通过基底声子实现广义螺旋度依赖的磁化翻转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent excitation of circularly-polarized substrate phonons can drive deterministic reversal of magnetization in an adjacent magnetic layer. However, the extent to which this substrate-mediated mechanism can be generalized across different materials remains unresolved. Here, we measure and compare the spectral dependence of helicity-dependent magnetization reversal in magnetic GdFeCo layers grown on a diverse set of diamagnetic substrates. Switching is observed for all investigated substrates, spanning six point groups and several infrared-active transverse-optical phonon symmetries. While the switching spectra broadly overlap with the Reststrahlen bands, their maxima are systematically shifted to wavelengths shorter than the corresponding transverse-optical phonon resonances. This spectral mismatch shows that substrate absorption alone does not determine the switching efficiency. Transfer-matrix calculations show that strong absorption concentrates energy deposition near the substrate interface, providing a possible source of local heating that could suppress magnetization reversal. Our results reveal the broad applicability of substrate-mediated phononic switching while showing that its efficiency is governed by the full optical response of the heterostructure rather than substrate absorption alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究比较了生长在多种抗磁基底上的GdFeCo磁性层中，螺旋度依赖磁化翻转的光谱特征。所有研究基底均观察到翻转现象，但其最大响应相对于横向光学声子共振系统性地向短波方向偏移，表明基底吸收并非决定翻转效率的唯一因素。传输矩阵计算显示，异质结构的完整光学响应以及界面附近的能量沉积共同影响声子驱动的磁化翻转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相干激发圆偏振基底声子能够驱动相邻磁性层中的磁化确定性翻转。然而，这种由基底介导的机制能在多大程度上推广到不同材料中，仍未得到解决。本文测量并比较了生长在多种抗磁基底上的磁性GdFeCo层中螺旋度依赖磁化翻转的光谱依赖性。所研究的所有基底均观察到翻转现象，这些基底涵盖六种点群以及若干红外活性横向光学声子对称性。尽管翻转光谱总体上与Reststrahlen带重叠，但其最大值相对于相应的横向光学声子共振波长系统性地向更短波长方向偏移。这种光谱失配表明，仅凭基底吸收并不能决定翻转效率。传输矩阵计算显示，强吸收会使能量沉积集中在靠近基底界面的区域，从而可能产生局域加热并抑制磁化翻转。我们的结果揭示了基底介导声子翻转具有广泛适用性，同时表明其效率由异质结构的完整光学响应决定，而不仅仅取决于基底吸收。

articles.title: Engineering Giant Thermoelectric Performance through Electrode-Coupling Geometry and Magnetic Flux in Quasiperiodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Rings
articles.title_zh: 通过电极耦合几何与磁通工程化准周期Su-Schrieffer-Heeger环中的巨型热电性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate coherent thermoelectric transport in magnetic-flux-threaded quasiperiodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) rings with engineered multi-site electrode couplings using the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism within the Landauer-Büttiker framework. We demonstrate that the electrode-coupling geometry serves as a powerful control parameter for tailoring quantum interference, thereby reshaping the transmission spectrum and thermoelectric response. In the absence of magnetic flux, the trivial dimerized phase (t₁>t₂) exhibits the highest thermoelectric efficiency, with asymmetric coupling producing a substantially larger figure of merit than the symmetric geometry. Magnetic flux further reconstructs the transmission spectrum through Aharonov-Bohm interference, driving a crossover of the optimal thermoelectric regime from the trivial to the topological dimerized phase. Under optimal flux conditions, the thermoelectric figure of merit reaches ZT approx 12 for symmetric coupling and is dramatically enhanced to ZT approx 90 for asymmetric coupling through enhanced energy filtering and suppressed electronic thermal transport. We further establish a clear correlation between the enhancement of thermoelectric efficiency and the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law. Our results demonstrate that the combined interplay of quasiperiodicity, topology, magnetic flux, and electrode-coupling geometry provides a versatile strategy for engineering high-performance coherent thermoelectric devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用非平衡格林函数和Landauer-Büttiker框架，研究了穿磁通的准周期Su-Schrieffer-Heeger环中的相干热电输运。结果表明，电极耦合几何能够调控量子干涉、重塑透射谱和热电响应；磁通则可通过Aharonov-Bohm干涉使最优热电区域从平庸二聚化相转移到拓扑二聚化相。在最佳磁通条件下，热电优值ZT在对称和非对称耦合下分别可达约12和90，并与Wiedemann-Franz定律的破缺密切相关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用 Landauer-Büttiker 框架下的非平衡格林函数形式主义，研究了具有工程化多位点电极耦合、受磁通穿透的准周期 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）环中的相干热电输运。我们表明，电极耦合几何构型是调控量子干涉的一个强有力控制参数，因而能够重塑透射谱和热电响应。在不存在磁通时，平庸二聚化相（t₁>t₂）表现出最高的热电效率，且非对称耦合产生的品质因子显著高于对称几何构型。磁通还会通过 Aharonov-Bohm 干涉进一步重构透射谱，从而推动最优热电工作区间由平庸二聚化相向拓扑二聚化相交叉转变。在最优磁通条件下，对称耦合时热电品质因子达到 ZT 约 12；通过增强能量过滤并抑制电子热输运，非对称耦合时该值被显著提高至 ZT 约 90。我们还建立了热电效率增强与 Wiedemann-Franz 定律失效之间的明确关联。我们的结果表明，准周期性、拓扑性、磁通和电极耦合几何构型的协同作用，为设计高性能相干热电器件提供了一种多用途策略。

articles.title: A locally ab initio computational framework for arbitrary incommensurate materials interfaces
articles.title_zh: 任意非公度材料界面的局域第一性原理计算框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Incommensurate materials interfaces constitute a broad and technologically important class of systems, yet their lack of shared periodicity limits predictive and computationally efficient first-principles electronic-structure methods. Here we introduce a scalable computational framework for constructing locally ab initio electronic Hamiltonians for arbitrary materials interfaces. Our approach exploits the nearsightedness of Wannier Hamiltonian matrix elements, enabling their systematic extrapolation and interpolation across interlayer registries. This strategy yields transferable Hamiltonians that retain first-principles accuracy while bypassing the need for prohibitively large commensurate supercells or Moiré approximations. We validate the framework on quasicrystalline 30deg twisted bilayer graphene, reproducing experimentally observed spectral features including mirrored Dirac cones and minigaps at avoided crossings arising from generalized interlayer scattering. We further predict quasiperiodic flat-band states in experimentally accessible doping regimes. By enabling predictive electronic-structure calculations across structurally incommensurate interfaces, this framework establishes a practical route to first-principles exploration of emergent interfacial phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种可扩展的计算框架，用于构建任意材料界面的局域第一性原理电子哈密顿量。该方法利用Wannier哈密顿量矩阵元的近视性，在不同层间配准关系之间进行系统外推和插值，从而避免构造庞大的公度超胞或采用莫尔近似。该框架在准晶30°扭转双层石墨烯中重现实验观测到的镜像狄拉克锥和避免交叉处的小能隙，并预测了可实验实现掺杂范围内的准周期平带态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非公度材料界面构成一类广泛且具有重要技术意义的体系，但由于缺乏共同的周期性，预测性强且计算高效的第一性原理电子结构方法受到限制。本文提出一种可扩展的计算框架，用于为任意材料界面构建局域从头算电子哈密顿量。我们的方法利用 Wannier 哈密顿量矩阵元的近视性，使其能够在不同层间堆垛构型之间进行系统外推和插值。这一策略产生的可迁移哈密顿量既保留第一性原理精度，又无需采用计算代价高得难以承受的巨大公度超胞或莫尔近似。我们在准晶 30 度扭转双层石墨烯上验证了该框架，再现了实验观测到的谱学特征，包括镜像狄拉克锥和由广义层间散射引起的避交叉处微能隙。我们还预言了实验可达掺杂区间中的准周期平带态。通过使预测性电子结构计算能够适用于结构非公度界面，该框架为基于第一性原理探索新兴界面现象建立了一条实用途径。

articles.title: Cross-Layer Anomalous Hall Transport driven by Néel-Vector rotating in the Altermagnet candidate V2Te2O
articles.title_zh: Altermagnet候选材料V₂Te₂O中由旋转的Néel矢量驱动的跨层反常霍尔输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05085v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In van der Waals (vdW) materials, weak interlayer coupling generally suppresses vertical dispersion, reinforcing the conventional paradigm that in-plane transport dominates over cross-layer channels. Here, using first-principles calculations and magnetic symmetry analyses, we uncover a giant, symmetry-unlocked cross-layer anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in the vdW altermagnet V2Te2O. In the magnetic ground state with Neel vector N//z, horizontal mirror symmetry protects a spin-polarized nodal chain near the Fermi level and strictly enforces zero anomalous Hall response. Tilting the Neel vector explicitly breaks this mirror protection, allowing spin-orbit coupling to gap the nodal chain and activate a sharp cross-layer Hall response. When the Neel vector is rotated into the in-plane configuration (N//x), cross-layer orbital hybridization generates intensive Berry curvature hotspots, boosting the cross-layer component of AHC σyz to approximately 255 S/cm, which exceeds in-plane component σₓy by nearly two orders of magnitude. Furthermore, varying the azimuthal angle systematically redistributes the anomalous Hall response, enabling full directional control of transverse transport. Our findings demonstrate a highly sensitive cross-layer anomalous Hall switch activated by low-barrier spin canting, offering promising avenues for directional tensor selection and low-power multi-axial vdW spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过第一性原理计算和磁对称性分析，本文在范德瓦耳斯反铁磁候选材料V₂Te₂O中发现了由Néel矢量旋转激活的巨大跨层反常霍尔电导。Néel矢量沿面外方向时，水平镜面对称性使反常霍尔响应严格为零；倾斜并旋转Néel矢量则破坏该保护，使自旋轨道耦合打开节点链能隙并产生显著的跨层霍尔响应。当Néel矢量转至面内方向时，σyz约为255 S/cm，几乎比面内分量σxy高两个数量级，从而实现横向输运方向的调控。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文通过第一性原理计算和磁对称性分析，研究范德华交替磁体候选材料 V2Te2O 中 Néel 矢量旋转引起的跨层反常霍尔输运。结果显示，旋转 Néel 矢量可破坏镜面对称性并激活强烈的跨层 Berry 曲率，使跨层霍尔电导远高于面内分量。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的交替磁性、范德华磁体、非共线磁性、自旋轨道耦合、磁性拓扑性质和量子输运方向高度直接相关。其磁对称性分析、Néel 矢量调控和跨层输运机制具有很强的借鉴价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究应变、层间滑移、电场和异质结环境对跨层反常霍尔响应的调控，并计算相应的自旋输运和非线性输运性质。建议结合 Wannier 插值和自旋哈密顿量，探索磁畴或热涨落对输运信号的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在范德华材料中，较弱的层间耦合通常会抑制垂直方向色散，从而强化面内输运主导、跨层通道较弱的传统范式。本文利用第一性原理计算和磁对称性分析，在范德华交错磁体 V2Te2O 中揭示了巨大的、由对称性解锁的跨层反常霍尔电导率。在 Néel 矢量 N//z 的磁基态中，水平镜面对称性保护费米能级附近一条自旋极化节点链，并严格强制反常霍尔响应为零。倾斜 Néel 矢量会显式破坏这种镜面对称性保护，使自旋轨道耦合能够打开节点链能隙，并激活尖锐的跨层霍尔响应。当 Néel 矢量旋转到面内构型（N//x）时，跨层轨道杂化产生强烈的 Berry 曲率热点，使反常霍尔电导率的跨层分量 σyz 增强至约 255 S/cm，比面内分量 σxy 高近两个数量级。此外，改变方位角能够系统性地重新分配反常霍尔响应，从而实现对横向输运方向的全面控制。我们的发现展示了一种可由低势垒自旋倾斜激活的高灵敏度跨层反常霍尔开关，为方向性张量选择和低功耗多轴范德华自旋电子学提供了有前景的途径。

articles.title: Symmetry-protected triplet Weyl complexes
articles.title_zh: 对称性保护的三重Weyl复合体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05120v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Nielsen-Ninomiya theorem dictates that Weyl nodes must appear in pairs of opposite chirality to preserve global charge neutrality. However, in crystals, specific crystalline symmetries can stabilize multi-Weyl nodes, circumventing this pairwise constraint and enabling compensated Weyl complexes with mixed chiral charges. The minimal configuration of this type is a triplet Weyl complex (TWC), comprising exactly three Weyl nodes. Here, we systematically investigate the symmetry conditions required to realize TWCs. By screening all 1651 magnetic space groups (MSGs) in both spinless and spinful systems, we establish that: (i) Only TWCs with charge magnitudes of 1,1,2 and 1,2,3 are permitted; (ii) the 1,1,2 configuration can be realized in 166 spinless MSGs and 70 spinful MSGs; and (iii) the 1,2,3-TWCs, which has not been reported before, can occur in 10 MSGs for both spinless and spinful cases. We explicitly demonstrate the existence of 1,2,3-TWC in a tight-binding model. Furthermore, we present the first electronic realization of 1,1,2-TWC topological semimetal state in the chiral carbon allotrope DZQH-C₃₆, in which the three Weyl nodes form a collinear configuration, leading to a characteristic ``S''-shaped surface Fermi arc pattern. Our findings uncover novel topological states featuring mixed chiral charges and provide guidance for exploring their physics in concrete material systems.
articles.abstract_zh: Nielsen-Ninomiya定理要求Weyl节点以相反手性成对出现，但特定晶体对称性能够稳定多重Weyl节点，并形成具有混合手性电荷的补偿型Weyl复合体。本文系统筛选1651个磁空间群，确定了三重Weyl复合体允许的手性电荷构型，其中包括此前未报道的1,2,3构型。研究还通过紧束缚模型和手性碳同素异形体DZQH-C₃₆展示了相应的理论与电子学实现，其共线Weyl节点可产生特征性的“S”形表面费米弧。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Nielsen-Ninomiya 定理规定，为保持全局电荷中性，Weyl 节点必须以手征性相反的成对形式出现。然而，在晶体中，特定晶体对称性可以稳定多重 Weyl 节点，从而绕开这一成对约束，并实现具有混合手征电荷的补偿 Weyl 复合体。这类构型的最小形式是三重 Weyl 复合体（TWC），其恰好由三个 Weyl 节点组成。本文系统研究了实现 TWC 所需的对称性条件。通过筛选无自旋和有自旋体系中的全部 1651 个磁空间群（MSG），我们确立了以下结论：（i）仅允许电荷量级为 1、1、2 和 1、2、3 的 TWC；（ii）1、1、2 构型可在 166 个无自旋 MSG 和 70 个有自旋 MSG 中实现；以及（iii）此前尚未报道的 1、2、3-TWC 在无自旋和有自旋两种情形下均可出现在 10 个 MSG 中。我们在一个紧束缚模型中明确展示了 1、2、3-TWC 的存在。此外，我们在手性碳同素异形体 DZQH-C36 中给出了 1、1、2-TWC 拓扑半金属态的首次电子实现，其中三个 Weyl 节点构成共线构型，导致特征性的“S”形表面费米弧图样。我们的发现揭示了具有混合手征电荷的新型拓扑态，并为在具体材料体系中探索其物理性质提供了指导。

articles.title: Semiclassical thermoelectric transport in disordered Dirac electron system Ag2Te
articles.title_zh: 无序Dirac电子系统Ag₂Te中的半经典热电输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05130v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated the thermoelectric effects of the Dirac electron system Ag2Te under magnetic field. Our anal-ysis based on the Boltzmann semiclassical model associated the disorder with the unconventional magnetic field responses such as linear magnetoresistance, linear Nernst effect, step-like Nernst effect, and sign change in Nernst effect. The analysis also revealed the impurity band near the Fermi energy. We simultaneously clari-fied the serious impact of the thermal Hall effect on the measurement of the Nernst effect, and we proposed the definitive solution. Our careful measurement and analysis will be the standard for the thermoelectric study under magnetic field.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了磁场下Dirac电子系统Ag₂Te的热电效应，并利用结合无序效应的玻尔兹曼半经典模型解释了线性磁阻、线性Nernst效应、阶梯状Nernst效应以及Nernst信号变号等异常磁场响应。分析还揭示了费米能级附近存在杂质带，并阐明了热霍尔效应对Nernst效应测量的显著影响。作者据此提出了改进相关测量的确定性方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了狄拉克电子系统 Ag2Te 在磁场下的热电效应。基于玻尔兹曼半经典模型的分析，将无序与线性磁阻、线性能斯特效应、阶跃型能斯特效应以及能斯特效应符号改变等非常规磁场响应联系起来。该分析还揭示了费米能附近的杂质带。我们同时阐明了热霍尔效应对能斯特效应测量的严重影响，并提出了明确的解决方案。我们严谨的测量与分析将成为磁场下热电研究的标准。

articles.title: Environment-assisted transport in a strongly correlated boundary-driven Fermi-Hubbard chain
articles.title_zh: 强关联边界驱动Fermi-Hubbard链中的环境辅助输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study steady-state transport in a one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard chain coupled to particle reservoirs at the boundaries and to local dephasing baths at each site, using the time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) method to solve the Lindblad master equation. In the absence of dephasing, the current exhibits two well-separated maxima as a function of the boundary driving rate, reflecting the distinct charge and spin energy scales of the strongly correlated regime. Upon introducing dephasing, we find two distinct dephasing-induced transport-enhancement regimes, in contrast to the single enhancement previously reported for spinless fermions. Analysis of the non-equilibrium steady state in the Hamiltonian eigenbasis reveals that the two regimes originate from distinct dephasing-induced redistribution processes: the first involves redistribution within the uppermost Hubbard band, while the second involves transitions between Hubbard bands. Our results demonstrate how many-body correlations shape the interplay between coherent driving, dephasing, and quantum Zeno physics in strongly correlated open systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用时间演化块解耦方法求解Lindblad主方程，研究了边界连接粒子库、各格点连接局域退相干浴的一维Fermi-Hubbard链稳态输运。在无退相干时，电流随边界驱动速率出现两个彼此分离的峰，分别反映强关联区中的电荷和自旋能标。引入退相干后出现两个不同的输运增强区间，其起源分别是最高Hubbard带内的重新分布以及Hubbard带之间的跃迁，揭示了多体关联对相干驱动、退相干和量子Zeno物理相互作用的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用时间演化块解码（TEBD）方法求解 Lindblad 主方程，研究了一维费米-哈伯德链中的稳态输运；该链在边界处与粒子库耦合，并在每个格点与局域退相干浴耦合。在没有退相干时，电流作为边界驱动率的函数呈现两个明显分离的极大值，反映出强关联区间内不同的电荷和自旋能标。引入退相干后，我们发现两个不同的退相干诱导输运增强区间，这不同于此前针对无自旋费米子报道的单一增强现象。在哈密顿量本征基中对非平衡稳态的分析表明，这两个区间源于不同的退相干诱导重分配过程：第一个涉及最高 Hubbard 带内部的重分配，第二个涉及 Hubbard 带之间的跃迁。我们的结果表明，多体关联如何塑造强关联开放系统中相干驱动、退相干与量子 Zeno 物理之间的相互作用。

articles.title: Interfacial Accommodation as a Candidate Ductility Pathway in Intermetallic-Rich Alloys
articles.title_zh: 界面协调：富金属间化合物合金中的一种潜在延性途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05147v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heterophase interfaces are increasingly recognized as active participants in plastic deformation, yet quantitative methods for comparing their strain-accommodation capacity remain limited. Here, we present an atomistic framework for quantifying interface-mediated strain accommodation using molecular dynamics simulations. Interface broadening, roughening, and migration are extracted from atomistic trajectories and combined into an Interface Accommodation Index, with a normalized counterpart accounting for differences in initial interface structure. A weighting sensitivity analysis demonstrates that the relative ranking of interfaces is robust to the specific form of the index. The framework is demonstrated for three experimentally motivated interfaces, Al/Al3Ti, Al/Al9M2, and Al9M2/Al3Ti (M = Fe, Co, Ni), under tensile, compressive, and shear loading. Bulk simulations show that Shockley partial dislocations dominate plastic deformation, with alloy chemistry governing the transition toward mixed-character dislocation networks. Tensile loading produces the greatest interface accommodation, while shear produces comparatively limited structural evolution. The Al9M2/Al3Ti interface exhibits both the highest yield resistance and the largest accommodation response, suggesting that intermetallic-intermetallic interfaces can simultaneously sustain load and redistribute strain. These simulations quantify structural accommodation rather than ductility or fracture directly; their connection to macroscopic ductility therefore requires experimental validation. The framework provides a transferable approach for comparing interface accommodation in multiphase alloys and identifies interface chemistry and crystallography as important design variables for damage-tolerant structural materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于分子动力学模拟提出了量化界面介导应变协调能力的原子尺度框架，并以界面展宽、粗化和迁移构建界面协调指数及其归一化形式。对Al/Al₃Ti、Al/Al₉M₂和Al₉M₂/Al₃Ti界面的研究表明，拉伸载荷产生最大的界面协调，而剪切引起的结构演化相对有限。Al₉M₂/Al₃Ti界面同时表现出最高的屈服抗力和最大的协调响应，说明金属间化合物-金属间化合物界面可能兼具承载和应变再分配能力，但其与宏观延性的联系仍需实验验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 异相界面日益被认为是塑性变形的活跃参与者，但用于比较其应变容纳能力的定量方法仍然有限。本文提出一个原子尺度框架，利用分子动力学模拟量化界面介导的应变容纳。我们从原子轨迹中提取界面展宽、粗化和迁移，并将其整合为界面容纳指数；同时给出一个归一化版本，以考虑初始界面结构的差异。权重敏感性分析表明，界面的相对排序对于该指数具体形式具有稳健性。该框架在三个具有实验动机的界面上进行了展示，即 Al/Al3Ti、Al/Al9M2 和 Al9M2/Al3Ti，其中 M = Fe、Co、Ni，且考察了拉伸、压缩和剪切载荷。体相模拟表明，Shockley 不全位错主导塑性变形，而合金化学成分控制向混合特征位错网络转变的过程。拉伸载荷产生最大的界面容纳，而剪切则引起相对有限的结构演化。Al9M2/Al3Ti 界面同时表现出最高的屈服抗力和最大的容纳响应，表明金属间化合物-金属间化合物界面能够同时承受载荷并重新分配应变。这些模拟量化的是结构容纳而非延性或断裂本身；因此，其与宏观延性之间的联系仍需实验验证。该框架为比较多相合金中的界面容纳提供了一种可迁移的方法，并指出界面化学成分和晶体学是设计损伤容限结构材料的重要变量。

articles.title: Glassy dynamics, crossover temperature and density scaling in fragile glass-formers
articles.title_zh: 脆性玻璃形成体中的玻璃态动力学、交叉温度与密度标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the slowing down of dynamics in a glass-forming mixture interacting via an inverse-power-law (IPL) potential using a combination of theory and large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. We measure the static pair-correlation function, configurational entropy, inherent-structure energy, and structural relaxation time. We employ a theoretical framework to calculate the structural relaxation time τα, which is found to be in very good agreement with the simulation results. The theory identifies a local structural order which defines the cooperativity of the relaxation and brings forth a fluctuation induced parameter ψ ( T ) and a crossover temperature Tₐ that characterize the density and temperature dependence of the glassy dynamics. Furthermore, we determine a crossover temperature using independent dynamical and thermodynamic criteria and compare with the theoretically predicted crossover temperature Tₐ. Relaxation dynamics is shown to obey density-temperature scaling, similar to thermodynamic properties, in terms of a variable Γ formed by an appropriate combination of density and temperature, characteristic of IPL interactions. Finally, we show that, when the excess thermodynamic and dynamic quantities obtained at different densities are plotted as functions of the reduced temperature T/Tₐ (or Tₐ/T), the data collapse onto master curves with excellent agreement between theory and simulation. These scaling relations provide a unified description of the thermodynamics and dynamics in IPL systems, enabling the prediction of relaxation behavior over a wide range of densities from data at a single state point.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合理论与大规模分子动力学模拟，研究了逆幂律势玻璃形成混合物中的动力学减缓现象，并考察了结构弛豫时间、构型熵和固有结构能等性质。理论给出的结构弛豫时间与模拟结果高度一致，并引入局域结构序、涨落诱导参数ψ(T)和交叉温度Tₐ来描述弛豫协同性及密度和温度依赖性。研究表明，动力学遵循由密度和温度组合变量Γ决定的密度-温度标度关系；以约化温度表示时，不同密度下的数据可塌缩到统一主曲线上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们结合理论和大规模分子动力学模拟，研究了通过逆幂律（IPL）势相互作用的玻璃形成混合物中动力学的迟缓过程。我们测量了静态对关联函数、构型熵、本征结构能量和结构弛豫时间。我们采用一个理论框架计算结构弛豫时间 τα，发现其与模拟结果符合得非常好。该理论识别出一种决定弛豫协同性的局域结构有序，并给出了刻画玻璃态动力学密度和温度依赖性的涨落诱导参数 ψ(T) 及交叉温度 Tₐ。此外，我们利用独立的动力学和热力学判据确定交叉温度，并与理论预言的交叉温度 Tₐ 进行比较。结果表明，与热力学性质类似，弛豫动力学也遵循密度-温度标度，即可用由密度和温度适当组合形成的变量 Γ 来描述，这是 IPL 相互作用的特征。最后，我们表明，当将不同密度下获得的过剩热力学量和动力学量绘制为约化温度 T/Tₐ（或 Tₐ/T）的函数时，数据会以理论与模拟之间的优异一致性塌缩到主曲线上。这些标度关系为 IPL 体系中的热力学和动力学提供了统一描述，使得能够利用单一状态点的数据预测宽广密度范围内的弛豫行为。

articles.title: Neural-field design of broadband Rayleigh-wave carpet cloaks under microstructure realisability constraints
articles.title_zh: 满足微结构可实现性约束的宽带Rayleigh波地毯隐身神经场设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transformation elasticity provides appropriate material distributions for elastodynamic cloaks but the required stiffness tensors generally violate the minor symmetries of Cauchy elasticity and are difficult to realise using conventional materials. Existing approaches restore these symmetries by modifying the transformed tensor, producing only an approximate cloak. In this work rather than modifying the transformed tensor we seek the best performing cloak within the class of Cauchy materials. We formulate 2D Rayleigh wave carpet cloak design as an optimisation problem governed by partial differential equations. Using a coordinate based neural-field and a differentiable finite element model solver we optimise symmetric stiffness and density fields by minimising wave field distortion. Both single frequency and broadband optimisation are considered, with the broadband model trained over multiple frequencies. Physical realisability is addressed using a database of homogenised microstructures through conditional diffusion, neural-field inverse design, and nearest-neighbour selection. FEM simulations show that the optimised Cauchy design approaches the ideal transformation-based cloak. After projection onto explicit microstructures, the homogenised representation recovers approximately 97% of the defect free reference surface-displacement magnitude, while direct FEM simulation of the fully resolved microstructured geometry recovers approximately 76%
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将二维Rayleigh波地毯隐身设计表述为由偏微分方程控制的优化问题，并利用坐标神经场和可微有限元求解器优化对称刚度场与密度场。研究同时考虑单频和宽带优化，并通过均质化微结构数据库、条件扩散模型、神经场逆向设计和近邻选择处理物理可实现性约束。有限元结果表明，优化后的Cauchy材料设计接近理想变换隐身效果；投影到显式微结构后，无缺陷参考表面位移幅值的恢复率约为97%，完全解析微结构的直接有限元模拟恢复率约为76%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 变换弹性理论为弹性动力学隐身斗篷提供了合适的材料分布，但所需的刚度张量通常违反 Cauchy 弹性的次对称性，因而难以用常规材料实现。现有方法通过修正变换后的张量来恢复这些对称性，因此只能得到近似隐身斗篷。在本工作中，我们并不修正变换后的张量，而是在 Cauchy 材料这一类别中寻求性能最佳的隐身斗篷。我们将二维瑞利波地毯式隐身斗篷设计表述为由偏微分方程控制的优化问题。借助基于坐标的神经场和可微有限元模型求解器，我们通过最小化波场畸变来优化对称刚度场和密度场。我们同时考虑单频和宽带优化，其中宽带模型在多个频率上进行训练。通过均匀化微结构数据库中的条件扩散、神经场逆向设计和最近邻选择来处理物理可实现性问题。有限元模拟表明，优化后的 Cauchy 设计接近理想的基于变换理论的隐身斗篷。在投影到显式微结构之后，均匀化表示恢复了约 97% 的无缺陷参考表面位移幅值，而对完全解析微结构几何的直接有限元模拟恢复了约 76%。

articles.title: Transparency-engineered SQUID cells for Kerr-free three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 面向无Kerr三波混频Josephson超材料的透明度工程SQUID单元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a transparency-engineered rf-SQUID cell for Kerr-free three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials. This design replaces the conventional tunnel-junction element with an effective Josephson element formed by two junctions in series, yielding a non-sinusoidal energy-phase relation that can be used as a tunable nonlinear design resource. We show that the asymmetry between the two series junctions and the applied flux bias provide independent control over the local expansion of the rf-SQUID potential, enabling operating points where the leading quartic Kerr term is suppressed while the cubic nonlinearity remains finite. We derive the corresponding Kerr-free condition, identify the resulting operating ridge in parameter space, and analyze the local stability and passive-matching constraints that bound its physically accessible portion. Our results provide a compact unit-cell design principle for three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials and suggest a route toward Kerr-suppressed Josephson traveling-wave parametric amplifiers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种采用透明度工程的射频SQUID单元，用于无Kerr三波混频Josephson超材料。该设计以两个串联结形成的有效Josephson元件取代传统隧道结，通过非正弦的能量-相位关系调控局域非线性。研究表明，串联结不对称性与外加磁通偏置可以独立控制射频SQUID势能的局部展开，从而抑制主导的四次Kerr项而保持有限的三次非线性；文中还给出了无Kerr条件、参数空间中的工作脊以及稳定性和无源匹配约束，为Kerr抑制型Josephson行波参量放大器提供了设计路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种经透明度工程设计的 rf-SQUID 单元，用于无 Kerr 效应的三波混频约瑟夫森超材料。该设计以由两个串联结形成的有效约瑟夫森元件取代传统隧穿结，从而产生非正弦能量-相位关系，并可将其用作可调谐的非线性设计资源。我们表明，两个串联结之间的不对称性和施加的磁通偏置可对 rf-SQUID 势能的局域展开进行独立控制，从而实现前导四阶 Kerr 项被抑制而三阶非线性仍保持有限的工作点。我们推导出相应的无 Kerr 条件，识别出参数空间中的相应工作脊线，并分析了限定其物理可达部分的局域稳定性和无源匹配约束。我们的结果为三波混频约瑟夫森超材料提供了紧凑的单元设计原则，并提出了一条通向 Kerr 效应受抑制的约瑟夫森行波参量放大器的路径。

articles.title: Dipolar and quadrupolar spin supersolid states in a spin-1 triangular antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 自旋-1三角反铁磁体中的偶极与四极自旋超固态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05181v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic numerical study of the spin-1 antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice in an out-of-plane magnetic field, using Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) methods. By mapping out the quantum phase diagram as a function of the single-ion anisotropy D_z and magnetic field, we identify distinct dipolar and quadrupolar spin supersolid states, characterized by spontaneous U(1) symmetry breaking with finite spin superfluid stiffness coexisting with longitudinal translational symmetry breaking. At zero field, the dipolar spin supersolid with a 'Y'-type spin configuration persists down to D_z = 0, whereas the quadrupolar spin supersolid prevails at large D_z. At intermediate fields, the phase diagram is dominated by an up-up-down phase. At high fields below saturation, a quadrupolar spin superfluid emerges in the large-D_z regime, whereas a dipolar spin supersolid with a 'V'-type spin configuration dominates at small D_z. These phases are characterized through their order parameters and spin superfluid stiffness using calculations on various system sizes. Furthermore, the dynamical spin structure factor is obtained across the phase diagram, where characteristic spectral signatures of different phases are observed, including the gapless Goldstone mode and the roton-like minima. These features are directly accessible to inelastic neutron scattering experiments. Our results provide a theoretical understanding of the interplay between frustrations, anisotropy, and Zeeman interactions in driving distinct spin supersolid phases in the spin-1 system, which are relevant to various triangular-lattice antiferromagnets such as Na₂BaNi(PO₄)₂ and K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用密度矩阵重整化群方法，系统研究了面外磁场下自旋-1三角晶格反铁磁海森堡模型的量子相图。研究发现，随单离子各向异性和磁场变化，体系可呈现偶极与四极自旋超固态，其中超流刚度与纵向平移对称性破缺共存。不同相具有可由非弹性中子散射探测的特征性动力学谱，包括无能隙Goldstone模和类旋子极小值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法，对外加垂直磁场中的三角晶格自旋-1 反铁磁 Heisenberg 模型进行了系统数值研究。通过绘制关于单离子各向异性 D_z 和磁场的量子相图，我们识别出不同的偶极和四极自旋超固态；这些状态的特征是自发 U(1) 对称性破缺，具有有限自旋超流刚度，并与纵向平移对称性破缺共存。在零磁场下，具有“Y”型自旋构型的偶极自旋超固态可一直存在至 D_z = 0，而四极自旋超固态在较大 D_z 下占主导。在中间磁场下，相图主要由上-上-下相主导。在饱和前的高磁场下，大 D_z 区域出现四极自旋超流体，而小 D_z 区域则由具有“V”型自旋构型的偶极自旋超固态占主导。通过对不同系统尺寸的计算，利用其序参量和自旋超流刚度对这些相进行了刻画。此外，我们获得了整个相图中的动力学自旋结构因子，并观察到不同相的特征谱学信号，包括无能隙 Goldstone 模和类旋子极小值。这些特征可由非弹性中子散射实验直接探测。我们的结果为理解阻挫、各向异性和 Zeeman 相互作用如何在自旋-1 体系中驱动不同自旋超固态之间的相互作用提供了理论依据，这些结果与 Na2BaNi(PO4)2 和 K2Ni(SeO3)2 等多种三角晶格反铁磁体相关。

articles.title: Ni-O hybridization as a stabilizer for s± superconductivity in La₃Ni₂O₇: a DFT+RPA study
articles.title_zh: Ni-O杂化对La₃Ni₂O₇中s±超导的稳定作用：一项DFT+RPA研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting gap symmetry of high-pressure bilayer nickelates remains under debate, with weak- and strong-coupling approaches yielding different pairing tendencies. In this work, we investigate how the weak-coupling treatment of electronic states away from the Fermi level influences magnetic fluctuations and superconductivity in La₃Ni₂O₇. We employ a full-spectrum model based on orthonormalized projections of Kohn-Sham states onto local Ni-e_g orbitals, which preserves the density-functional band structure while redistributing spectral weight over a wide energy range. Compared to a low-energy description, this approach yields enhanced interlayer spin fluctuations and a commensurate magnetic instability. Within a spin-fluctuation framework, these features favor a sign-changing s^± superconducting state, whereas low-energy models tend to stabilize d-wave pairing. Our results suggest that interlayer coupling in full-energy models may play an important role in shaping the predicted pairing symmetry of bilayer nickelates.
articles.abstract_zh: 高压双层镍酸盐的超导能隙对称性尚存争议。本文以全谱电子模型研究La₃Ni₂O₇中远离费米能级的电子态影响，发现其会增强层间自旋涨落并促成公度磁不稳定性，从而有利于符号变化的s±配对；低能模型则倾向于d波配对。结果表明，全能量模型中的层间耦合可能是决定双层镍酸盐配对对称性的关键因素。
authors: Luis G. G. V. Dias da Silva
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高压双层镍酸盐的超导能隙对称性仍存在争议，弱耦合和强耦合方法给出了不同的配对倾向。在本工作中，我们研究弱耦合处理中远离费米能级的电子态如何影响 La3Ni2O7 中的磁涨落和超导性。我们采用一种全谱模型，该模型基于将 Kohn-Sham 态正交化投影到局域 Ni-e_g 轨道上构建，在重新分配宽广能量范围内谱权重的同时保留密度泛函能带结构。与低能描述相比，该方法产生更强的层间自旋涨落和共格磁不稳定性。在自旋涨落框架下，这些特征有利于符号改变的 s± 超导态，而低能模型则倾向于稳定 d 波配对。我们的结果表明，全能量模型中的层间耦合可能在塑造双层镍酸盐的预测配对对称性方面发挥重要作用。

articles.title: Electrostatic splitting of an Edge Magnetoplasmon Resonator
articles.title_zh: 边缘磁等离激元谐振器的静电分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Edge-magnetoplasmon resonators have been proposed as a powerful tool to detect anyons by introducing a quantum point contact into an isolated quantum Hall system probed via radiofrequency radiation. In this paper, we study the effect of a quantum point contact embedded within an edge-magnetoplasmon resonator and how its polarization influences the propagating magnetoplasmonic mode. Combining dc and rf measurements, we unambiguously evidence the signature of both integer (ν = 1 and 2) and fractional quantum Hall states (ν = 4/3 and 2/3) within the radiofrequency transmission signal. Using electrostatic gating, we determine the physical parameters characterizing the electrostatic edge of an AlGaAs/GaAs based two-dimensional electron gas. We extract the dependence of the cavity perimeter with the gate voltage of the quantum point contact and fully characterize the path followed by edge magnetoplasmons in this system. Finally, we provide a geometric model in good agreement with experimental results.
articles.abstract_zh: 边缘磁等离激元谐振器结合量子点接触，可能成为通过射频探测任意子的有力工具。本文通过直流与射频测量，在射频透射信号中清晰识别出整数和分数量子霍尔态，并利用静电栅压提取AlGaAs/GaAs二维电子气边缘的物理参数。研究进一步确定了量子点接触栅压对腔体周长的影响，并建立了与实验符合良好的几何模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过在由射频辐射探测的孤立量子霍尔系统中引入量子点接触，边缘磁等离激元谐振器被提出为探测任意子的有力工具。本文研究了嵌入边缘磁等离激元谐振器内的量子点接触的影响，以及其极化如何影响传播的磁等离激元模式。结合直流和射频测量，我们在射频透射信号中明确地观测到整数（ν=1和2）及分数（ν=4/3和2/3）量子霍尔态的特征。利用静电栅控，我们确定了表征基于AlGaAs/GaAs二维电子气静电边缘的物理参数。我们提取出腔体周长对量子点接触栅极电压的依赖关系，并完整表征了边缘磁等离激元在该系统中所遵循的路径。最后，我们给出了一个与实验结果高度一致的几何模型。

articles.title: Robustness of RKKY interactions across a Weyl node-annihilation transition
articles.title_zh: 跨越外尔节点湮灭相变的RKKY相互作用稳健性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weyl semimetals (WSMs), with their unique topological properties and distinct electronic structure, exhibit intriguing properties when either time-reversal or inversion symmetries are broken. In this work, we consider the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction between magnetic impurities in time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSMs. We derive analytical expressions for the full RKKY exchange tensor in arbitrary two-band spinful lattice systems. Our approach reveals both Heisenberg, anisotropic Ising and Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya terms, which can be calculated by energy-integrating real-space Green's functions across the entire Brillouin zone, with the band edge acting as a natural energy cutoff. We apply this framework to study a two-band tight-binding model for a time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSM that interpolates between a Weyl phase with well-separated chiral nodes and a quadratic band-touching semimetal phase. Remarkably, the spatial profile, magnitude, and anisotropic tensor structure of the exchange couplings remain persistent across the node-annihilation transition. This topological robustness reveals that short- and intermediate-range RKKY interactions are mediated by the global, Brillouin-zone-integrated quantum metric of the full valence band rather than being strictly dictated by local low-energy Berry curvature monopoles. These findings demonstrate the necessity of full-band tight-binding formulations when predicting real-space magnetic interactions, providing key insights for electric-field tuning of magnetic anisotropy and constructing realistic models of heavy-fermion and Weyl-Kondo semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究时间反演对称性破缺外尔半金属中磁性杂质之间的RKKY相互作用，并推导任意二能带自旋晶格体系中完整RKKY交换张量的解析表达式。结果显示，跨越外尔节点湮灭转变后，交换耦合的空间分布、大小和各向异性张量结构依然持续存在。这表明中短程RKKY相互作用主要由整个价带的布里渊区积分量子度规介导，而非仅由低能贝里曲率单极子决定。
authors: Luis G. G. V. Dias da Silva
articles.abstract_zh_full: 外尔半金属（WSM）具有独特的拓扑性质和鲜明的电子结构；当时间反演对称性或空间反演对称性被破坏时，它们会展现出引人关注的性质。在这项工作中，我们考虑时间反演对称性破缺的外尔半金属中磁性杂质之间的Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida（RKKY）相互作用。我们推导了任意二能带含自旋晶格体系中完整RKKY交换张量的解析表达式。我们的方法揭示了海森堡项、各向异性伊辛项和Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya项；它们可通过在整个布里渊区内对实空间格林函数作能量积分来计算，而能带边缘充当自然的能量截断。我们将这一框架应用于研究一个时间反演对称性破缺外尔半金属的二能带紧束缚模型；该模型在具有充分分离手性节点的外尔相与二次能带接触半金属相之间连续插值。值得注意的是，交换耦合的空间分布、大小和各向异性张量结构在跨越节点湮灭转变时仍然保持存在。这种拓扑稳健性表明，短程和中程RKKY相互作用是由完整价带在整个布里渊区积分后的量子度规介导的，而不是严格由局域低能贝里曲率单极子决定。上述发现表明，在预测实空间磁相互作用时，完整能带紧束缚表述是必要的，并为利用电场调控磁各向异性以及构建重费米子和外尔-近藤半金属的现实模型提供了关键见解。

articles.title: Fluctuations of a Photon Bose-Einstein Condensate Coupled to a Reservoir: Describing Coherence Properties in a Free-Energy Model
articles.title_zh: 与储库耦合的光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚涨落：自由能模型中的相干性质描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photons are mutually nearly noninteracting particles, so thermalized photon ensembles are commonly obtained not from direct particle-particle-interactions but rather from contact with matter, which can constitute a reservoir for the photon gas. We develop a theory model for photons in a material-filled (e.g. liquid dye) optical microcavity, with the aim to study the fluctuation properties using a free-energy description for noninteracting photons coupled to a reservoir of material electronic excitations. To begin with, we use a single mode description for the condensate. For a small relative size of the material reservoir, corresponding to the canonical regime, condensate number fluctuations are small, and the derived free energy landscape takes the usual Mexican-hat shaped form such that spontaneous symmetry breaking occurs. In contrast, for a large relative size of the reservoir, corresponding to the grand canonical regime, fluctuations become as large as the average particle number. We show that the resulting free energy landscape acquires a bowl-shaped form, with a single minimum at the origin. Thus, a macroscopic occupation of the ground state (i.e., Bose-Einstein condensation) in the absence of spontaneous symmetry breaking is expected. We also provide a model for the treatment of a photon gas trapped in a box-shaped potential with spatially distributed coupling to a reservoir. The model predicts, for example, a statistically fluctuating pattern of islands with long-range coherence, resembling transient microcondensates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立自由能理论模型，研究与物质电子激发储库耦合的光学微腔光子凝聚体的涨落性质。小储库的正则系综条件下，凝聚数涨落较小，自由能呈墨西哥帽形并发生自发对称性破缺；大储库的巨正则条件下，涨落可与平均粒子数相当，自由能则呈原点处单极小值的碗形。该模型还预测，箱形势阱中空间分布式储库耦合的光子气体可形成具有长程相干性的统计涨落岛状图案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光子是彼此之间近乎无相互作用的粒子，因此，热化光子系综通常并非通过直接粒子-粒子相互作用获得，而是通过与物质接触获得；物质能够构成光子气体的储库。我们为充满材料的光学微腔中的光子建立了一个理论模型，例如材料可以是液体染料，旨在利用与材料电子激发储库耦合的非相互作用光子的自由能描述来研究涨落性质。首先，我们对凝聚体采用单模描述。当材料储库的相对尺寸较小时，即对应于正则系综区域，凝聚体数目涨落较小，所导出的自由能景观具有通常的墨西哥帽形状，因此会发生自发对称性破缺。相反，当储库的相对尺寸较大时，即对应于巨正则系综区域，涨落会大到与平均粒子数相当。我们表明，所得自由能景观呈现碗形，在原点只有一个极小值。因此，预期在不存在自发对称性破缺的情况下，基态的宏观占据，即玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚，仍会出现。我们还为处于箱形势阱内、并与储库空间分布式耦合的光子气体提供了一个处理模型。例如，该模型预测会出现具有长程相干性的统计涨落岛状图案，类似于瞬态微凝聚体。

articles.title: Breakdown of Anomalous Hall Scaling in Dilute Kondo System
articles.title_zh: 稀释近藤体系中反常霍尔标度关系的失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The confluence of strong electronic correlations and Berry curvature-driven transport constitutes a largely underexplored frontier in quantum materials research, particularly in systems where electronic correlations arise from flat-band physics rather than conventional f-electron states. Here, we report an intrinsic Berry curvature driven anomalous Hall transport in the dilute Kondo system Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge, a non-f-electron Heusler alloy hosting flat bands with van Hove singularity proximate to the Fermi level. The anomalous Hall response is strikingly non-monotonic, violating the Fermi-liquid scaling relation near the magnetic transition and is restored only at low temperature, coincident with the onset of Kondo coherence.
