Ab initio calculations strongly establish that the Berry curvature originates from the Kondo hybridization induced interplay of flat bands and spin-orbit coupling mediated anticrossings at the Fermi level. Our findings demonstrate that Kondo coherence of flat bands bears a profound impact on Berry curvature associated ferroic responses, mandating a rigorous theoretical understanding of anomalous transport in the regime where reciprocal space topology and strong correlations are intrinsically intertwined.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了稀释近藤体系Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge中的本征贝里曲率驱动反常霍尔输运。该非f电子Heusler合金的平带和近费米能级范霍夫奇点使反常霍尔响应呈显著非单调行为，在磁相变附近违反费米液体标度关系；低温近藤相干出现后，该关系才恢复。第一性原理计算表明，贝里曲率源于近藤杂化诱导的平带与自旋轨道耦合反交叉共同作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强电子关联与贝里曲率驱动输运的汇合，是量子材料研究中一个在很大程度上尚未探索的前沿，尤其是在电子关联源于平带物理而非传统f电子态的体系中。在这里，我们报告了稀释近藤体系Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge中的本征贝里曲率驱动反常霍尔输运；该体系是一种非f电子Heusler合金，具有平带及位于费米能级附近的范霍夫奇点。反常霍尔响应呈现显著的非单调性，在磁相变附近违反费米液体标度关系，并且仅在低温下、与近藤相干开始出现相一致时才恢复该关系。第一性原理计算有力地证明，贝里曲率起源于近藤杂化诱导的平带与由自旋轨道耦合介导的费米能级反交叉之间的相互作用。我们的发现表明，平带的近藤相干会深刻影响与贝里曲率相关的铁性响应，因此要求对倒空间拓扑与强关联本征交织区域中的反常输运进行严格的理论理解。

articles.title: How dipolar interactions structure molecular droplets
articles.title_zh: 偶极相互作用如何塑造分子液滴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how dipolar interactions between microwave-shielded polar molecules structure the self-bound droplets formed under variation of the interaction strength. We identify the transition from droplets to crystals as a finite-size first order transition. With droplet-ring states and transitional supersolid states we predict additional structure in the crystal and droplet phases, respectively. To describe this strongly correlated regime, and in particular the reconfiguration of quantum ground states, we design a variational Monte Carlo framework based on neural quantum states. It is especially suitable to describe ground states and almost degenerate states with very different configurations. Moreover, one can easily determine the superfluid fraction. Our results reveal the sequence of finite-size structures through which dipolar interactions reorganize molecular droplets into crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究微波屏蔽极性分子间的偶极相互作用如何随作用强度改变自束缚液滴的结构。研究将液滴到晶体的转变识别为有限尺寸一级相变，并预测了液滴环态和过渡超固态等附加结构。作者提出基于神经量子态的变分蒙特卡洛框架，以描述这一强关联区域中构型显著不同且近简并的量子基态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了微波屏蔽极性分子之间的偶极相互作用如何在相互作用强度变化时塑造形成的自束缚液滴。我们将从液滴到晶体的转变识别为有限尺寸一级相变。借助液滴环态和过渡超固态，我们分别在晶体相和液滴相中预测了附加结构。为了描述这一强关联区域，特别是量子基态的重构，我们设计了一个基于神经量子态的变分蒙特卡洛框架。该框架尤其适合描述构型差异很大、且几乎简并的基态。除此之外，还可以方便地确定超流分数。我们的结果揭示了偶极相互作用将分子液滴重组为晶体时所经历的一系列有限尺寸结构。

articles.title: Remote epitaxy beyond polarity
articles.title_zh: 超越极性的远程外延
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Remote epitaxy through a monolayer two-dimensional material-covered substrate establishes a crystallographic registry across the van der Waals (vdW) surface that enables the epitaxial growth, lift-off and transfer of single-crystalline films. A central belief in remote epitaxy is that the substrate facilitating the phenomenon must be a material with strong ionicity, as the interatomic electrostatic potential fluctuation in covalent and metallic materials is substantially attenuated by two-dimensional materials. Here, we show remote epitaxy is possible when the substrate is a metallic or covalently bonded material and experimentally demonstrate non-polar remote homo- and heteroepitaxy across a wide range of material systems, including both metals and semiconductors. The achieved non-polar remote interactions are designed and engineered by harnessing substrate conductivity and vicinal surface step-edge density. These findings indicate that remote epitaxy is universal and applicable to ionic, metallic, and covalent materials, expanding its capabilities and stimulating a plethora of new fundamental scientific questions about the mechanism of remote epitaxy.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维单层材料覆盖衬底上的远程外延可跨越范德华表面维持晶体学配准，实现单晶薄膜生长、剥离与转移。本文表明，金属或共价键合衬底同样能够实现远程外延，并在多类金属和半导体体系中实验展示了非极性远程同质和异质外延。结果指出，可通过衬底导电性和微斜表面台阶边缘密度设计非极性远程相互作用，从而拓展远程外延的材料适用范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过单层二维材料覆盖的衬底进行远程外延，可在范德华（vdW）表面两侧建立晶体学配准关系，从而实现单晶薄膜的外延生长、剥离和转移。远程外延领域的一个核心观点是，促成这一现象的衬底必须是具有强离子性的材料，因为共价材料和金属材料中的原子间静电势涨落会被二维材料显著衰减。在这里，我们表明，当衬底为金属或共价键合材料时也可以实现远程外延，并且在包括金属和半导体在内的广泛材料体系中，实验展示了非极性远程同质外延和异质外延。通过利用衬底导电性和微斜表面台阶边缘密度，我们对所实现的非极性远程相互作用进行了设计和工程化调控。这些发现表明，远程外延具有普适性，可适用于离子性、金属和共价材料，从而扩展其能力，并激发有关远程外延机制的大量新的基础科学问题。

articles.title: Customized spin spirals in ferromagnetic thin films
articles.title_zh: 铁磁薄膜中的可定制自旋螺旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The advancement of spintronic nanoscale devices hinges on the ability to flexibly engineer magnetic spin structures in thin-film stacks with precision and control. Meeting this demand remains a challenge for stable non-collinear spin configurations and, more specifically, vertical spin spirals in thin films. Innovative methods are required for their fabrication, stabilization and control. Here, we use oblique-incidence deposition to design and stabilize vertical spin spirals at room temperature and without an external field in magnetic thin films. We induce two crossed uniaxial magnetic anisotropies at the thin film boundaries. These anisotropies are tunable in direction and strength, thus providing control over the angular range and depth profile of the resulting spin spiral. The combination of polarized neutron reflectometry and nuclear resonant scattering enables precise and direct determination of the depth-dependent spin configurations. Our results establish a single-film design approach, in which the surface anisotropies independently serve as controllable design parameters for tailoring the vertical spin-spiral profile. Potential applications include nanoscale energy-storage devices, magnetic sensors, and ferromagnetic-resonance filters, advancing all-spin-based device engineering in general.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用斜入射沉积，在室温且无外加磁场条件下设计并稳定了磁性薄膜中的垂直自旋螺旋。薄膜两个边界处引入的交叉单轴磁各向异性可在方向和强度上调节，进而控制自旋螺旋的角度范围与深度分布。偏振中子反射和核共振散射直接确定了深度依赖自旋构型，为自旋电子器件中的可编程自旋结构设计提供了单薄膜方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋电子学纳米尺度器件的发展取决于能否以精确且可控的方式，在薄膜堆叠结构中灵活设计磁性自旋结构。对于稳定的非共线自旋构型，特别是薄膜中的垂直自旋螺旋，满足这一需求仍是一项挑战。其制备、稳定和调控需要创新方法。在这里，我们利用斜入射沉积，在磁性薄膜中设计并稳定了室温、无外加磁场下的垂直自旋螺旋。我们在薄膜边界处诱导出两种交叉的单轴磁各向异性。这些各向异性的方向和强度均可调，从而能够控制所得自旋螺旋的角度范围和深度分布。偏振中子反射与核共振散射相结合，可精确且直接地确定深度依赖的自旋构型。我们的结果建立了一种单薄膜设计方法，其中表面各向异性可独立地作为可控设计参数，用于定制垂直自旋螺旋的分布。潜在应用包括纳米尺度储能器件、磁传感器和铁磁共振滤波器，并总体上推动全自旋器件工程的发展。

articles.title: Variable Charge State, Magnetic Excitations, and Kondo Effect of Sm/g/Ir(111)
articles.title_zh: Sm/石墨烯/Ir(111)体系的可变电荷态、磁激发与近藤效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy we investigate the charge state, magnetic excitations, and Kondo features of individual Sm adatoms on graphene/Ir(111). Depending on the number and distance of their neighbors, Sm atoms can be in two discrete charge states. At certain distances, a reversible transition between these two states is induced by the electric field of the STM tip leading to concentric charge rings in the images. Only atoms in one of the two charge states exhibit magnetic excitations in dI/dV spectra. Two such excitations are located at 35~meV and 54~meV and related to transitions from the J = 1/2 ground state doublet to the first crystal field split J = 3/2 multiplet. Together with the intra-atomic exchange excitations at higher energy, these observations indicate that Sm transfers one 6s electron to the substrate while it retains its gas-phase 4f filling. New for lanthanide adatoms, we observe a Kondo resonance. The Zeeman splitting of the Kondo peak reveals that Sm retains its large gas-phase g-factor. Comparison of dI/dV spectra to cotunneling theory yields the crystal field acting on the 4f shell and, consequently, on the J = 3/2 quadruplet, confirms Sm⁺ as the ground state, and identifies Sm²⁺ as being energetically close, thereby rationalizing our observation of variable charge states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用低温扫描隧道显微镜研究石墨烯/Ir(111)上单个Sm吸附原子的电荷态、磁激发和近藤特征。Sm原子会依赖邻近原子的数量与距离呈现两种离散电荷态，STM针尖电场可在特定距离诱发可逆转换；其中一种电荷态显示35和54 meV的磁激发。研究还首次在镧系吸附原子中观测到近藤共振，并结合共隧穿理论确定Sm⁺为基态、Sm²⁺能量接近。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用低温扫描隧道显微镜研究了石墨烯/Ir(111)上单个Sm吸附原子的电荷态、磁激发和近藤特征。取决于其邻近原子的数量和距离，Sm原子可以处于两种离散电荷态。在某些距离处，STM针尖的电场可诱导这两种状态之间发生可逆转换，从而在图像中形成同心电荷环。两种电荷态中只有一种原子在dI/dV谱中表现出磁激发。两个此类激发位于35 meV和54 meV，并与从J=1/2基态双重态到第一个晶体场分裂J=3/2多重态的跃迁有关。连同位于更高能量的原子内交换激发，这些观测表明Sm向衬底转移了一个6s电子，同时保留其气相4f电子占据。我们首次在镧系吸附原子中观测到近藤共振。近藤峰的塞曼分裂揭示Sm保留了其较大的气相g因子。将dI/dV谱与共隧穿理论比较，可得到作用于4f壳层、并因而作用于J=3/2四重态的晶体场；该比较确认Sm⁺为基态，并确定Sm²⁺在能量上与其接近，从而解释了我们对可变电荷态的观测。

articles.title: Data-Driven Discovery of Composition-Dependent Constitutive Models for Hyperelasticity and Viscoelasticity of Digital Materials
articles.title_zh: 数字材料超弹性与黏弹性的成分依赖本构模型数据驱动发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04541v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Digital materials fabricated by multi-material 3D printing are designed as controlled mixtures of stiff and compliant constituents, yielding effective responses that span more than an order of magnitude in apparent stiffness and exhibit strongly nonlinear, composition-dependent, and rate-dependent dissipative behavior. Classical finite-strain viscoelastic models represent such behavior with closed-form strain energy functions for equilibrium and non-equilibrium stresses as well as evolution of internal variables, which may limit flexibility when a single constitutive model is expected to generalize across materials and loading rates. Here, we present a data-driven multi-material constitutive modeling framework that generalizes a formulation by Bergström and Boyce. The proposed framework retains the structure of the classical model, namely multiplicative kinematics, invariant-based strain-energy functions, and a scalar dissipative evolution law directed along the normalized nonequilibrium deviatoric stress. For the equilibrium branch, the data-driven discovery framework either directly predicts closed-form model parameters as functions of composition or automatically constructs a polyconvex strain-energy function using neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs). The nonequilibrium branch kinetics are learned similarly, either by directly identifying closed-form parameters across compositions or by using appropriately constrained artificial neural networks. Using multi-rate uniaxial compression data across multiple material compositions, we show that the proposed formulation captures rate-dependent stiffness and hysteresis across compositions while preserving thermodynamic consistency.
articles.abstract_zh: 多材料3D打印数字材料由刚性和柔顺组分的可控混合构成，具有强非线性、成分依赖和速率依赖的耗散行为。本文提出保持经典Bergström-Boyce模型结构的数据驱动多材料本构建模框架，可直接学习随成分变化的闭式参数，或借助神经常微分方程与受约束神经网络学习平衡和非平衡响应。多成分、多加载速率单轴压缩数据表明，该方法能在保证热力学一致性的同时刻画速率相关刚度和滞回。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过多材料3D打印制造的数字材料被设计为刚性与柔顺组分的可控混合物，其有效响应中的表观刚度可跨越一个以上数量级，并表现出强烈的非线性、成分依赖和速率依赖耗散行为。经典有限应变黏弹性模型使用平衡应力和非平衡应力的闭式应变能函数以及内部变量的演化规律来表征此类行为；当期望单一本构模型能够跨材料和加载速率泛化时，这可能限制模型的灵活性。在这里，我们提出了一个数据驱动的多材料本构建模框架，以推广Bergström和Boyce提出的一种表述。所提出的框架保留了经典模型的结构，即乘法运动学、基于不变量的应变能函数，以及沿归一化非平衡偏应力方向的标量耗散演化律。对于平衡分支，数据驱动发现框架可以直接预测作为成分函数的闭式模型参数，或者利用神经常微分方程（NODE）自动构建多凸应变能函数。非平衡分支的动力学也以类似方式学习，即直接识别跨成分的闭式参数，或者采用适当约束的人工神经网络。利用跨越多种材料成分的多速率单轴压缩数据，我们表明，所提出的表述能够在保持热力学一致性的同时，捕捉不同成分下的速率依赖刚度和滞回。

articles.title: Band Gaps and Localization of Surface Waves at Hyperbolic Material and Topological Insulator Interfaces
articles.title_zh: 双曲材料与拓扑绝缘体界面处表面波的带隙和局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04587v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop analytical criteria for surface electromagnetic waves at interfaces between hyperbolic materials and topological insulators. The analysis identifies propagation conditions, field penetration depths, and spectral band gaps. In the lossless model, the band edge is governed primarily by dielectric contrast, while the bulk topological coupling produces only a small shift and a weak correction to the dispersion. For structures combining hexagonal boron nitride with bismuth selenide, a thin topological insulator film on a dielectric substrate with low permittivity can substantially broaden the accessible propagation window. We also analyze a dissipative titanium and silicon hyperbolic effective medium interfaced with bismuth selenide. To make the complex branch structure visible, this lossy calculation uses an intentionally enhanced interface response and is therefore illustrative rather than a quantitative prediction for a conventional topological insulator. In the lossy case, a root of the dispersion relation represents a physical guided mode only when the fields decay away from the interface, attenuate consistently along the propagation direction, have finite penetration depths, and exhibit a consistent energy flow profile. Apparent gaps and jumps can occur when the complex quantities controlling transverse decay approach square root branch cuts. These results provide design guidelines for controlling dispersion, confinement, band gaps, and propagation loss in mid-infrared photonic structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立双曲材料与拓扑绝缘体界面表面电磁波的解析判据，分析其传播条件、场穿透深度和谱带隙。无损模型中，带边主要由介电对比决定，体拓扑耦合仅引起微小色散修正；低介电常数衬底上的薄拓扑绝缘体膜可显著扩大六方氮化硼与硒化铋结构的可传播窗口。针对有损体系，作者强调只有满足横向衰减、沿传播方向一致衰减、有限穿透深度及一致能流等条件的色散根才代表物理导模。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了双曲材料与拓扑绝缘体界面处表面电磁波的解析判据。该分析确定了传播条件、场穿透深度和谱带隙。在无损模型中，带边主要由介电对比控制，而体拓扑耦合仅导致微小的位移和对色散关系的弱修正。对于由六方氮化硼和硒化铋构成的结构，位于低介电常数衬底上的薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜能够显著拓宽可达的传播窗口。我们还分析了与硒化铋相接的、有耗钛和硅双曲有效介质。为了使复杂的支结构可见，这一有耗计算采用了有意增强的界面响应，因此它是说明性的，而不是对常规拓扑绝缘体的定量预测。在有耗情形下，色散关系的一个根只有在满足下列条件时才代表物理导模：场远离界面衰减、沿传播方向以一致方式衰减、具有有限穿透深度，并呈现一致的能流分布。当控制横向衰减的复数量接近平方根分支切线时，可能出现表观带隙和跳变。这些结果为控制中红外光子结构中的色散、约束、带隙和传播损耗提供了设计准则。

articles.title: Voltage-embedded equivariant machine learning potential for open system simulations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04696v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modeling electrochemical interfaces under operational non-equilibrium conditions is vital for energy technologies but remains bottlenecked by the expensive cost of ab initio methods. Current machine learning potentials, largely designed for closed systems under homogeneous electric fields, are limited in open quantum transport applications. To overcome this, we present an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network that embeds voltage bias for open-system simulations. Our approach decouples the system energy and forces into zero-bias and bias-dependent contributions, assigning distinct vector encodings to electrode and scattering-region atoms to capture non-equilibrium conditions. Trained on limited discrete bias data, the model achieves high predictive accuracy and robust extrapolation transferability. When applied to a lithium/water interface, our model successfully captures the field-induced dynamic reorientation of water molecules and reproduces asymmetric electrochemical behavior at different electrodes.
articles.focus_summary: 论文提出一种嵌入电压偏置的E(3)等变图神经网络势，用于开放体系和非平衡量子输运模拟。该方法将能量与力分解为零偏压和偏压相关贡献，并在锂/水界面中再现了电场诱导的水分子重排及电极间非对称电化学行为。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的等变神经网络、机器学习势、开放体系模拟、锂电池和界面电荷转移方向高度直接相关。电压条件编码、有限偏压数据训练及开放边界体系建模思路可借鉴到电化学界面、固态电解质和非平衡载流子输运研究中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其偏压依赖能量与力的分解方式、数据集构造和外推验证，并评估其对长程库仑相互作用的处理。可进一步将该框架拓展到锂离子电池电极/电解质界面、离子迁移和电压驱动反应动力学。

articles.title: Quantum control and the topological properties of the magnon photo-transport in two-dimensional collinear ferromagnet
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.06852v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we investigate light-induced magnon spin photocurrent (MSPC) and magnon energy photocurrent (MEPC) via the Aharonov-Casher (AC) effect. We treat the influence of the electric field through the AC effect as a perturbative term. Subsequently, we derived explicit expressions for MSPC and MEPC in a two-dimensional, collinear ferromagnetic system. Our theoretical framework is applied to both Hexagonal and Kagome two-dimensional ferromagnetic lattices. We demonstrate that MSPC and MEPC can be modulated by tuning the optical frequency and the material's relaxation time. Furthermore, in the low-frequency and infinite-relaxation-time limit, longitudinal MS(E)PC correlates with the topological properties of the magnon system.

articles.title: Gapped topological spin-orbital liquid on the honeycomb lattice
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝晶格上的有能隙拓扑自旋—轨道液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.06549v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We perform large-scale density matrix renormalization group simulations of the SU(4) Heisenberg model on the honeycomb lattice to address the long-standing question of its ground state in an unbiased and quantitatively controlled manner. We find reliable numerical evidence that the ground state is a gapped spin-orbital liquid, presumably with a Z₄ topological order, characterized by a finite topological entanglement entropy close to ln(4), the absence of both SU(4) and lattice symmetry breaking, and a variationally optimized ground-state energy well below the previously proposed π-flux variational state. By exploiting full SU(4) symmetry and keeping up to 12,800 SU(4) multiplets, corresponding to more than one million U(1) states, we achieve unprecedented accuracy for two-dimensional SU(4) quantum magnets. Finite-size scaling of energies and entanglement entropies supports a robust gapped phase in the two-dimensional limit, while a gapless critical state on narrow cylinders is identified as a proximate remnant of a Dirac spin-orbital liquid. Our results find the SU(4) honeycomb Heisenberg model a realization of a gapped topological spin-orbital liquid and provide convincing numerical evidence for topological order in a highly symmetric two-dimensional quantum magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用大规模密度矩阵重整化群模拟研究蜂窝晶格 SU(4) 海森堡模型的基态。结果为一种有能隙自旋—轨道液体提供了可靠数值证据，该相可能具有 Z₄ 拓扑序，并且不表现 SU(4) 或晶格对称性破缺。有限尺寸标度和高精度计算支持二维极限中的稳健有能隙相，同时窄圆柱上的无能隙临界态被解释为邻近 Dirac 自旋—轨道液体的残余。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对蜂窝晶格上的 SU(4) 海森堡模型进行了大规模密度矩阵重整化群模拟，以无偏且定量可控的方式解决其基态这一长期存在的问题。我们发现了可靠的数值证据，表明基态是一种有能隙自旋—轨道液体，推测具有 Z₄ 拓扑序，其特征是有限的拓扑纠缠熵接近 ln(4)，不存在 SU(4) 和晶格对称性破缺，并且经变分优化的基态能量显著低于先前提出的 π-通量变分态。通过利用完整的 SU(4) 对称性并保留多达 12,800 个 SU(4) 多重态（对应于超过一百万个 U(1) 态），我们在二维 SU(4) 量子磁体方面实现了前所未有的精度。能量和纠缠熵的有限尺寸标度支持二维极限中稳健的有能隙相，而窄圆柱上的无能隙临界态被识别为 Dirac 自旋—轨道液体的邻近残余。我们的结果表明 SU(4) 蜂窝海森堡模型实现了一种有能隙拓扑自旋—轨道液体，并为高度对称二维量子磁体中的拓扑序提供了令人信服的数值证据。

articles.title: Energy Eigenstates of Electrons, Magnons and Phonons in Fe₃O₄ (magnetite), MnFe₂O₄ (jacobsite), and mixed Mn-Zn ferrites
articles.title_zh: Fe₃O₄（磁铁矿）、MnFe₂O₄（雅各布石）及混合 Mn-Zn 铁氧体中电子、磁振子和声子的能量本征态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.16374v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report first-principles calculations of the electronic structure, magnon excitations, and phonons in magnetite (Fe₃O₄), jacobsite (MnFe₂O₄), and mixed manganese-zinc ferrites (Mnₓ,Zn₁₋ₓ)Fe₂O₄ for representative compositions (0le x le 1) and A/B-site cation arrangements. Electronic structures are computed using density functional theory (DFT) augmented by rotationally invariant DFT+U+J, with on-site Hubbard and Hund's parameters, U and J, respectively, determined self-consistently by spin-polarized linear-response perturbations of the chosen correlated subspaces (including, where applied, the ligand 2p subspace). A classical Heisenberg spin Hamiltonian is parameterized by mapping DFT+U+J total energies for multiple collinear spin configurations onto nearest-neighbor exchange couplings, which are then used to obtain magnon dispersions and magnon densities of states within linear spin-wave theory. Phonon spectra and densities of states are obtained from finite-displacement force constants and dynamical matrices computed on the same DFT+U+J-relaxed structures. Overall, the workflow provides a consistent, composition- and configuration-aware route to electronic, vibrational, and magnetic excitation spectra across the Mn/Zn ferrite space.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了磁铁矿、雅各布石以及不同成分和 A/B 位阳离子排布的 Mn-Zn 混合铁氧体的第一性原理计算。研究结合自洽确定参数的 DFT+U+J、海森堡自旋模型映射、线性自旋波理论和有限位移声子计算，得到电子结构、磁振子和声子谱。该流程为 Mn/Zn 铁氧体体系提供了考虑成分和构型的一致激发谱计算路线。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文对磁铁矿、锰铁氧体及锰锌混合铁氧体开展 DFT+U+J 计算，获得电子结构、声子谱和磁振子激发，并将总能映射到经典海森堡自旋哈密顿量。研究建立了成分、阳离子排布、磁交换和晶格振动之间的一致性计算流程。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、第一性原理计算、自旋哈密顿量、磁振子、声子、交换相互作用和自旋-晶格耦合方向高度相关。其自洽确定 U、J 并结合自旋波理论的工作流可直接参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步纳入非共线磁性、反对称交换、双二次交换和显式自旋-晶格耦合，研究温度、缺陷及阳离子无序对磁相变的影响。也可用机器学习势或自旋-晶格动力学模拟复杂组分铁氧体的有限温度行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了磁铁矿（Fe₃O₄）、雅各布石（MnFe₂O₄）以及代表性组成（0≤x≤1）和 A/B 位阳离子排布的混合锰锌铁氧体（Mnₓ,Zn₁₋ₓ）Fe₂O₄中电子结构、磁振子激发和声子的第一性原理计算。电子结构采用密度泛函理论（DFT）并辅以旋转不变的 DFT+U+J 计算，其中在位 Hubbard 参数 U 和 Hund 参数 J 分别通过对所选关联子空间（包括在适用情况下的配体 2p 子空间）进行自旋极化线性响应微扰来自洽确定。通过将多个共线自旋构型的 DFT+U+J 总能量映射到最近邻交换耦合，参数化一个经典海森堡自旋哈密顿量，随后在线性自旋波理论中用这些交换耦合获得磁振子色散和磁振子态密度。声子谱和态密度由有限位移力常数以及在相同 DFT+U+J 弛豫结构上计算的动力学矩阵获得。总体而言，该工作流程为整个 Mn/Zn 铁氧体空间中的电子、振动和磁激发谱提供了一条一致的、考虑成分和构型的路线。

articles.title: Learning Hamiltonians for solid-state quantum simulators
articles.title_zh: 面向固态量子模拟器的哈密顿量学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02889v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a generalizable framework for identifying effective Hamiltonians directly from experimental data in solid-state quantum systems. Our unsupervised autoencoder-based approach incorporates the governing physics (here, the S-matrix formalism) directly into the decoder, enabling physically meaningful Hamiltonian inference without labeled Hamiltonian parameters. Through numerical experiments on a triple quantum dot chain, we demonstrate automated characterization of programmable solid-state simulators from transport measurements. The model accurately infers Hamiltonian parameters and generalizes beyond the training domain, while exhibiting finite capacity as the parameter space becomes increasingly broad or diverse. We further demonstrate robustness to noisy measurements and show that the model can be successfully trained on transport data generated outside the Hamiltonian family assumed by the physics decoder, while still identifying meaningful effective parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种可推广框架，用于直接从固态量子系统实验数据中识别有效哈密顿量。该无监督自编码器方法将 S 矩阵形式主义等物理约束嵌入解码器，无需带标签的哈密顿量参数即可进行有物理意义的推断。三重量子点链数值实验表明，该模型可从输运测量中自动表征可编程固态模拟器，并具有噪声鲁棒性和一定域外泛化能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种可推广框架，用于直接从固态量子系统的实验数据中识别有效哈密顿量。我们的基于无监督自编码器的方法将支配物理（此处为 S 矩阵形式主义）直接纳入解码器，从而在没有带标签哈密顿量参数的情况下实现具有物理意义的哈密顿量推断。通过在三重量子点链上的数值实验，我们展示了如何从输运测量中自动表征可编程固态模拟器。该模型能够准确推断哈密顿量参数，并泛化到训练域之外，同时在参数空间变得越来越宽或越来越多样时表现出有限容量。我们进一步展示了其对噪声测量的鲁棒性，并表明即使输运数据是在物理解码器所假设的哈密顿量族之外生成的，该模型仍可成功训练，同时仍能识别有意义的有效参数。

articles.title: Crossover to Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev criticality in an infinite-range quantum Heisenberg spin glass
articles.title_zh: 无限程量子海森堡自旋玻璃中向 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 临界性的交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.11263v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A central question in frustrated quantum magnets is how quantum fluctuations destabilize spin-glass order and promote quantum spin-liquid behavior. We study the equilibrium dynamics of an infinite-range quantum Heisenberg model with random couplings, in which local magnetic moments arise from N_f flavors of spinful fermions. We employ an expansion in N_f, which controls the strength of quantum fluctuations, and self-consistently include 1/N_f corrections to the Luttinger-Ward functional. In the large-N_f limit, where quantum fluctuations are weak, the high- and low-temperature phases are respectively paramagnetic and spin glass ordered, with a transition temperature independent of N_f. For small numbers of fermionic flavors, however, quantum fluctuations substantially suppress the ordering temperature. We show that this behavior reflects the proximity of the system to a Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) regime, realizing quantum spin-liquid dynamics over a broad range of finite frequencies, where both fermionic and spin spectral densities display critical behavior over a broad range of finite frequencies, with the latter exhibiting the scale-invariant form χ''(ω)simsgn(ω). At the lowest energies and temperatures, spin glass dynamics ultimately take over, producing a universal sub-Ohmic dynamical spin susceptibility χ''(ω)simsgn(ω)sqrt|ω|. Our results highlight a direct connection between the suppression of spin-glass order and the emergence of SYK criticality in a frustrated quantum magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究随机耦合无限程量子海森堡模型中的平衡动力学，关注量子涨落如何抑制自旋玻璃有序并促进量子自旋液体行为。作者采用 N_f 展开并自洽纳入 Luttinger-Ward 泛函的 1/N_f 修正，发现小费米子味数下有序温度被显著压低。该行为源于系统接近 SYK 区域，在有限频率范围内出现临界自旋液体动力学，而最低能量和温度下最终由自旋玻璃动力学主导。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受挫量子磁体中的一个核心问题是量子涨落如何破坏自旋玻璃有序并促进量子自旋液体行为。我们研究具有随机耦合的无限程量子海森堡模型的平衡动力学，其中局域磁矩来自 N_f 种自旋费米子。我们采用 N_f 展开来控制量子涨落强度，并自洽地纳入 Luttinger-Ward 泛函的 1/N_f 修正。在量子涨落较弱的大 N_f 极限中，高温相和低温相分别为顺磁相和自旋玻璃有序相，其转变温度与 N_f 无关。然而，对于较小数量的费米子味，量子涨落会显著抑制有序温度。我们表明，这种行为反映了系统接近 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）区域，在宽广的有限频率范围内实现量子自旋液体动力学，其中费米子和自旋谱密度都在宽广的有限频率范围内表现出临界行为，后者呈现尺度不变形式 χ''(ω)∼sgn(ω)。在最低能量和温度下，自旋玻璃动力学最终占据主导，产生普适的亚欧姆动力学自旋磁化率 χ''(ω)∼sgn(ω)√|ω|。我们的结果突出了自旋玻璃有序的抑制与受挫量子磁体中 SYK 临界性涌现之间的直接联系。

articles.title: Field-angle dependence of magnetoresistance in UTe2
articles.title_zh: UTe₂ 中磁阻的磁场角度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.17235v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically study angle-resolved magnetoresistance under rotated magnetic field in the normal state of a spin-triplet superconductor UTe₂. The Wannier model derived from a GGA+U calculation shows quasi-two-dimensional Fermi surfaces with warping in the k_z direction, consistent with quantum oscillation measurements in the high magnetic field regime. Solving the semiclassical Boltzmann equation, we show that the Fermi surface geometry gives rise to oscillations in the magnetoresistance when the field is tilted from the c axis toward the a or b axis. By assuming a band-dependent relaxation time, the calculated angle-resolved magnetoresistance is in good agreement with the recent transport experiment. This is direct evidence for the warped Fermi surface revealed by ordinary intraband transport. It suggests that the hole band with long relaxation time dominates electron transport. The field angle dependence of the Hall resistivity is calculated for further experimental verification.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究了自旋三重态超导体 UTe₂ 正常态中旋转磁场下的角分辨磁阻。由 GGA+U 得到的 Wannier 模型给出沿 k_z 方向翘曲的准二维费米面，与高场量子振荡实验一致。通过求解半经典 Boltzmann 方程，作者说明费米面几何导致磁阻随磁场倾角振荡，并指出长弛豫时间空穴带主导电子输运。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究自旋三重态超导体 UTe₂ 正常态中旋转磁场下的角分辨磁阻。由 GGA+U 计算导出的 Wannier 模型显示出在 k_z 方向具有翘曲的准二维费米面，这与高磁场区域的量子振荡测量一致。通过求解半经典 Boltzmann 方程，我们表明，当磁场从 c 轴向 a 轴或 b 轴倾斜时，费米面几何会引起磁阻振荡。通过假设能带依赖的弛豫时间，计算得到的角分辨磁阻与近期输运实验高度一致。这是普通带内输运揭示翘曲费米面的直接证据。它表明具有长弛豫时间的空穴带主导电子输运。我们还计算了霍尔电阻率的磁场角度依赖性，以供进一步实验验证。

articles.title: Energy landscape of the kagome antiferromagnet: Characterization of multiple energy scales
articles.title_zh: kagome 反铁磁体的能量景观：多重能量尺度的表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.18902v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the energy landscape of the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet within its coplanar ground-state manifold. Although coplanar states are degenerate at harmonic order, transitions between them require collective weathervane-loop rotations whose barriers grow strongly with loop size. To characterize this structure, we construct disconnectivity graphs using two complementary approaches: exact enumeration and minimax-barrier calculations for small lattices, and a statistical construction for large lattices based on random walks through configuration space, with loop length used as a proxy for barrier height. The exact landscape reveals a dominant low-barrier scale associated with elementary six-spin loops and a broader higher-barrier sector from longer rearrangements. For large systems, the statistical analysis exposes a hierarchy of barrier scales, including a pronounced six-spin-loop peak and an intermediate scale-free regime of loop lengths. This hierarchy provides a natural basis for multiple dynamical time scales: six-spin loops govern the fastest local relaxation, while slower collective dynamics arise from activation of longer loops. These results show that the coplanar manifold is dynamically rugged, with its low-energy dynamics governed by a hierarchy of loop-mediated barriers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体在其共面基态流形内的能量景观。虽然共面态在谐波阶简并，但它们之间的转变需要集体风向标环旋转，且势垒随环尺寸显著增大。通过精确枚举、minimax 势垒计算和大体系统计构造，研究揭示了由六自旋环和更长环重排共同形成的分级势垒结构及多重动力学时间尺度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体在其共面基态流形内的能量景观。尽管共面态在谐波阶是简并的，但它们之间的转变需要集体的风向标环旋转，其势垒随环大小强烈增长。为表征这一结构，我们使用两种互补方法构建断连图：对于小晶格，采用精确枚举和 minimax 势垒计算；对于大晶格，则基于构型空间随机游走进行统计构造，并以环长度作为势垒高度的代理。精确能量景观揭示了与基本六自旋环相关的主导低势垒尺度，以及来自更长重排的更宽高势垒区。对于大体系，统计分析显示出势垒尺度的层级结构，包括显著的六自旋环峰和中间的无标度环长区域。这种层级结构为多重动力学时间尺度提供了自然基础：六自旋环支配最快的局域弛豫，而更慢的集体动力学来自更长环的激活。这些结果表明，共面流形在动力学上是崎岖的，其低能动力学由环介导势垒的层级结构支配。

articles.title: GEWUM: General Exploration Workflow for the Utopia of Materials: A Unified Platform for Automated Structure Generation, Selection, and Validation
articles.title_zh: GEWUM：材料乌托邦通用探索工作流——用于自动结构生成、筛选与验证的统一平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.21401v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The fragmented landscape of existing computational tools often hinders the seamless integration of large-scale structure prediction with rigorous stability validation. To address this, we present GEWUM (General Exploration Workflow for the Utopia of Materials), an open-source platform that integrates the Selective Random Structure Search (SRSS) strategy with universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (uMLIPs) to automate and accelerate materials discovery. With native support for SLURM-based HPC clusters, GEWUM unifies the entire workflow from structure generation and diversity-preserving selection to thermodynamic/dynamic stability assessments and property calculations. The platform further incorporates built-in visualization tools, including Sankey diagrams for space-group evolution, violin plots for energy distributions, and t-SNE/UMAP embeddings for structural diversity, enabling intuitive interpretation of screening results. We demonstrate GEWUM through three case studies: low-energy polymorph prediction in Al-Sc-N, identification of a P-62c phase of U3Si5, and high-pressure structure prediction of ThH10 at 150 GPa. Benchmark tests confirm reasonable agreement in thermophysical property predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出开源平台 GEWUM，用于整合大规模结构预测与严格稳定性验证。该平台结合选择性随机结构搜索与通用机器学习原子间势，支持从结构生成、保多样性筛选到稳定性评估和性质计算的自动化流程。作者通过 Al-Sc-N、U₃Si₅ 和高压 ThH₁₀ 三个案例展示其应用，并报告热物性预测基准测试具有合理一致性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现有计算工具的碎片化格局常常阻碍大规模结构预测与严格稳定性验证的无缝整合。为解决这一问题，我们提出 GEWUM（General Exploration Workflow for the Utopia of Materials），这是一个开源平台，将选择性随机结构搜索（SRSS）策略与通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）相结合，以自动化并加速材料发现。GEWUM 原生支持基于 SLURM 的高性能计算集群，将从结构生成和保持多样性的筛选，到热力学/动力学稳定性评估和性质计算的整个工作流程统一起来。该平台还集成了内置可视化工具，包括用于空间群演化的 Sankey 图、用于能量分布的小提琴图，以及用于结构多样性的 t-SNE/UMAP 嵌入，从而能够直观解释筛选结果。我们通过三个案例研究展示 GEWUM：Al-Sc-N 中低能多晶型预测、U3Si5 的 P-62c 相识别，以及 150 GPa 下 ThH10 的高压结构预测。基准测试证实其热物理性质预测具有合理一致性。

articles.title: Thermodynamics and dynamics of non-compact prismatic dislocation loops simulated using a machine-learning model
articles.title_zh: 利用机器学习模型模拟非紧致棱柱位错环的热力学与动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.10630v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We explore how the thermodynamic properties and dynamics of a self-interstitial prismatic dislocation loop are affected by microscopic-scale variations in its geometric configuration, an aspect that rarely received attention in literature. We develop a machine-learning (ML) model to predict the formation energy of an arbitrary geometrically complex configuration of a self-interstitial atom dislocation loop. Trained on atomistic simulation data, the ML model achieves high predictive accuracy across a broad range of configurations, with a typical error in the 1% range. From the ML model, we evaluate the density of configurational microstates as a function of loop's formation energy and derive analytical expressions valid in tractable limiting cases. Using statistical mechanics, we derive the configurational free energy, the average energy, and the thermodynamic entropy of a dislocation loop as a function of temperature. We also simulate the dynamics of self-climb of dislocation loops with various geometries and evaluate their diffusion coefficients and effective activation energy for diffusion. Analysis shows that there is a single universal parameter describing the morphological irregularity of the loop configuration in its ground state. This parameter determines the thermodynamic properties of a loop as well as its dynamics, and simulations illustrate how the properties and mobility of a configurationally complex loop vary as functions of the irregularity parameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究自间隙棱柱位错环的微观几何构型变化如何影响其热力学性质和动力学。作者构建机器学习模型预测任意复杂几何位错环的形成能，并以统计力学推导自由能、平均能量和熵。模拟表明，一个描述基态形貌不规则性的普适参数可决定位错环的热力学性质与迁移动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们探究自间隙棱柱位错环的热力学性质和动力学如何受到其几何构型中微观尺度变化的影响，而这一方面在文献中很少受到关注。我们开发了一个机器学习（ML）模型，用于预测任意几何复杂构型的自间隙原子位错环形成能。该 ML 模型在原子模拟数据上训练，在广泛构型范围内达到较高预测精度，典型误差在 1% 量级。基于该 ML 模型，我们评估位错环构型微观态密度作为形成能的函数，并推导在可处理极限情形下有效的解析表达式。利用统计力学，我们推导位错环的构型自由能、平均能量和热力学熵随温度的函数关系。我们还模拟了具有不同几何形状的位错环自攀移动态，并评估其扩散系数和扩散有效活化能。分析表明，存在一个单一普适参数，用来描述环构型在基态中的形貌不规则性。该参数决定位错环的热力学性质及其动力学，模拟展示了构型复杂环的性质和迁移率如何随不规则性参数变化。

articles.title: Shapiro steps of superfluid Fermi gases in a ring trap across the BCS--BEC crossover
articles.title_zh: BCS–BEC 跨越中环形陷阱内超流费米气体的 Shapiro 台阶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.17940v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the transport properties of a superfluid Fermi gas confined in a ring trap with a moving potential barrier across the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) to Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) crossover. Employing time-dependent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) equations, we simulate the dynamics of a Josephson junction biased by both DC and AC currents. Over a wide range of interaction strengths, the barrier-velocity dependence of the chemical potential difference exhibits low-order plateau structures, consistent with Shapiro steps, with fitted levels close to integer multiples of hbarω/2 within the phase-coherent regime. This factor of 1/2 reflects our convention of defining the chemical potential per single fermion in the BdG framework. Microscopic analysis reveals that these fundamental steps originate from synchronized phase slips mediated by periodic soliton generation at the barrier. Our findings clarify the role of interaction regimes in the nonequilibrium phase dynamics of ring-trapped fermionic superfluids and provide microscopic insights relevant to future studies of atomtronic systems with nontrivial topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究受移动势垒作用的环形陷阱超流费米气体在 BCS 到 BEC 跨越中的输运性质。通过含时 Bogoliubov–de Gennes 方程模拟同时受直流和交流电流偏置的 Josephson 结，作者在宽相互作用范围内发现符合 Shapiro 台阶的低阶平台结构。微观分析表明这些基本台阶源于势垒处周期孤子生成所介导的同步相滑移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究在 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer（BCS）到 Bose-Einstein 凝聚（BEC）跨越中，受限于环形陷阱并具有移动势垒的超流费米气体的输运性质。采用含时 Bogoliubov--de Gennes（BdG）方程，我们模拟了同时受到直流和交流电流偏置的 Josephson 结动力学。在宽广的相互作用强度范围内，化学势差对势垒速度的依赖表现出低阶平台结构，与 Shapiro 台阶一致；在相干相位区域内，拟合能级接近 ℏω/2 的整数倍。这个 1/2 因子反映了我们在 BdG 框架中将化学势定义为每个单个费米子的约定。微观分析表明，这些基本台阶源于势垒处周期性孤子生成所介导的同步相滑移。我们的发现阐明了相互作用区域在环形陷阱费米超流体非平衡相位动力学中的作用，并提供了与未来研究具有非平凡拓扑的原子电子学系统相关的微观见解。

articles.title: A Metadynamics-Based Framework for Free Energy Surface Mapping of Multiparticle Diffusion in Crystals
articles.title_zh: 一种用于晶体中多粒子扩散自由能面映射的基于元动力学的框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.23360v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose two metadynamics (MetaD)-based methodologies for efficiently mapping free energy surfaces (FESs) of multiple interacting carriers diffusing in crystalline solids. Our approaches circumvent the challenges of high-dimensional collective variables (CVs) by employing replica state exchange MetaD and parallel bias MetaD, both of which decompose the high-dimensional CVs into multiple lower-dimensional ones. As a benchmark, we investigate two-dimensional lithium (Li) diffusion in LixTiS2 across a wide range of Li concentrations. The Li jump frequencies estimated from the obtained FESs exhibit concentration- and temperature-dependent trends consistent with previous kinetic Monte Carlo simulations and nuclear magnetic resonance measurements. Our approaches provide a promising framework for capturing the slow dynamics of diffusive carriers that are typically inaccessible to conventional molecular dynamics simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出两种基于元动力学的方法，用于高效映射晶体固体中多个相互作用扩散载流子的自由能面。方法通过副本态交换元动力学和平行偏置元动力学，将高维集体变量分解为多个低维变量。以 LixTiS2 中二维锂扩散为基准，所得自由能面估计的跳跃频率与既有动力学 Monte Carlo 和核磁共振结果趋势一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出两种基于元动力学（MetaD）的方法，用于高效映射晶体固体中多个相互作用载流子扩散的自由能面（FESs）。我们的方法通过采用副本态交换 MetaD 和平行偏置 MetaD 来绕开高维集体变量（CVs）的挑战，这两者都将高维 CV 分解为多个低维 CV。作为基准，我们研究了 LixTiS2 中跨宽广 Li 浓度范围的二维锂（Li）扩散。由所得 FES 估计的 Li 跳跃频率表现出与先前动力学 Monte Carlo 模拟和核磁共振测量一致的浓度与温度依赖趋势。我们的方法为捕捉扩散载流子的慢动力学提供了有前景的框架，而这类慢动力学通常是常规分子动力学模拟难以达到的。

articles.title: Group theory of Raman effect in magnetic materials
articles.title_zh: 磁性材料中拉曼效应的群论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09339v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Despite the wealth of experimental observations on Raman scattering in magnetic materials, the underlying selection rules have remained largely unexplored. In this work, we use Onsager reciprocity relation, other than the conventional corepresentation method, to deal with the mathematical structures of Raman tensors in magnetic groups. Using this approach, we generate Raman tensor tables for all magnetic point groups, and present a comprehensive understanding of the Raman selection rules in magnetic materials with direct product representations method. Our theoretical and numerical results match previous experiments well, and resolve a recent puzzle in the Raman spectroscopy of CrSBr. Moreover, we identify a common but overlooked phenomenon: the magneto-Raman vector can be orthogonal to the magnetic moment direction. Our method and associated Raman tensor tables will be helpful for the Raman studies in both experimental and theoretical domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对磁性材料拉曼散射选择定则尚未充分阐明的问题，提出使用 Onsager 互易关系处理磁群中拉曼张量的数学结构。作者生成了所有磁点群的拉曼张量表，并用直积表示方法系统理解选择定则。理论和数值结果与既有实验吻合，解释了 CrSBr 拉曼光谱中的近期疑难，并指出磁拉曼矢量可与磁矩方向正交这一常被忽视的现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管磁性材料中的拉曼散射已有大量实验观测，其 underlying 选择定则仍在很大程度上未被探索。在这项工作中，我们使用 Onsager 互易关系，而不是传统的共表示方法，来处理磁群中拉曼张量的数学结构。利用这种方法，我们生成了所有磁点群的拉曼张量表，并采用直积表示方法对磁性材料中的拉曼选择定则给出全面理解。我们的理论和数值结果与先前实验高度吻合，并解决了近期 CrSBr 拉曼光谱中的一个疑难。此外，我们识别出一种常见但被忽视的现象：磁拉曼矢量可以与磁矩方向正交。我们的方法及相关拉曼张量表将有助于实验和理论领域的拉曼研究。

articles.title: Bilinear Flexo-Antiferrodistortive Coupling in Ferroelastics: Polar Twins, Antiphase Boundaries and Fingerprints of Alterelectricity
articles.title_zh: 铁弹体中的双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合：极性孪晶、反相边界与交变电性的指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.29456v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using the Landau-Ginsburg-Devonshire approach we show that the linear gradient-type coupling between the electric polarization vector and antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter pseudovector, that has the form of Lifshitz invariant and named "bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling", can emerge in all antiferrodistortive ferroelastics, since it is symmetry-allowed. Using the four sublattices model we reveal that the bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling can induce the sublattice-sensitive polarization at the twin walls and antiphase boundaries in antiferrodistortive ferroelastics without any ferroelectric or antiferroelectric ordering. Since the induced polarization is perpendicular to the antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter and counter-directed in neighboring sublattices with checkerboard-type direction of antiferrodistortive long-range order parameter, such structure of polarization may correspond to the alterelectric-type quadrupolar electric order. However, physical manifestations of the bilinear flexo-antiferrodistortive coupling are invisible in most nanostructured antiferrodistortive ferroelectrics and antiferroelectrics due to the domination of piezoelectric and/or omnipresent linear flexoelectric couplings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用 Landau-Ginsburg-Devonshire 方法说明，电极化矢量与反铁畸变长程有序参数赝矢量之间的线性梯度型耦合在所有反铁畸变铁弹体中均可由对称性允许。四子晶格模型表明，该耦合可在无铁电或反铁电有序的反铁畸变铁弹体孪晶壁和反相边界处诱导对子晶格敏感的极化。作者进一步指出，这种极化结构可能对应交变电型四极电有序，但在许多纳米结构反铁畸变铁电体和反铁电体中其表现会被更强耦合掩盖。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用 Landau-Ginsburg-Devonshire 方法，我们表明电极化矢量与反铁畸变长程有序参数赝矢量之间的线性梯度型耦合具有 Lifshitz 不变量的形式，并被称为“双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合”，它可以出现在所有反铁畸变铁弹体中，因为它由对称性所允许。利用四子晶格模型，我们揭示双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合能够在没有任何铁电或反铁电有序的反铁畸变铁弹体中，在孪晶壁和反相边界处诱导对子晶格敏感的极化。由于诱导极化垂直于反铁畸变长程有序参数，并且在具有棋盘型反铁畸变长程有序参数方向的相邻子晶格中反向，这种极化结构可能对应于交变电型四极电有序。然而，在大多数纳米结构反铁畸变铁电体和反铁电体中，由于压电耦合和/或无处不在的线性挠曲电耦合占主导，双线性挠曲—反铁畸变耦合的物理表现不可见。

articles.title: The Statistical physics of unsaturated soil water: kinetic theory and non commutative pore water dynamics
articles.title_zh: 未饱和土壤水的统计物理：动力学理论与非交换孔隙水动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09416v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a statistical-mechanical theory of water in unsaturated soil whose outcome is a continuum field equation for the pore-occupancy g(r,x,t), the fraction of pores of radius r that are water-filled at position x and time t. The theory is built across three scales: microscopic inter-pore transfers set by Hagen-Poiseuille rates and a driving potential (the difference of pore-class chemical potentials, taken in capillary-gravitational form but open to adsorptive, osmotic, or thermal refinement); a mesoscale master equation relaxing the occupancy toward the equilibrium step g_eq=H(r*-r); and, on contracting the averaging volume to a point, the continuum balance dₜ g + div F = C[g] - E - T, of which everything else is a limit, a moment, or a boundary resolution. The kinetic equation is an Onsager gradient flow descending the Gibbs free energy, with an H-theorem for the isothermal unforced system and mass conservation as its zeroth moment. A single dimensionless group, the pore-resolved Damkohler number Da(r,x), organizes the behavior and unifies phenomenologies long modelled separately. A Chapman-Enskog reduction identifies Richards' equation as the quasi-static (Da->0) limit, with matric potential and hydraulic conductivity K emerging only there and K vanishing below the percolation threshold; capillary-bundle and critical-path models are its diagonal and spectral limits. Hysteresis is the holonomy of a forcing bundle, a geometric phase rather than per-pore bistability, with a falsifiable loop-area law H ~ I². Preferential flow is what the same equation does where Da>1, so the Richards/preferential-flow dichotomy becomes a continuous Da-controlled crossover. Out of the quasi-static limit g(r) is the irreducible state variable. All inputs are geometric properties of the pore network, measurable from micro-CT and calibrated against no macroscopic data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了未饱和土壤中水分的统计力学理论，并推导出描述不同半径孔隙含水占比的连续场方程。该理论涵盖孔隙间微观转移、介观主方程和连续介质守恒方程，并由孔隙尺度达姆科勒数统一组织不同流动行为。研究表明，理查兹方程是达姆科勒数趋于零时的准静态极限，而滞后与优先流可分别理解为强迫过程的几何相位和高达姆科勒数区域中的连续动力学现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了一种未饱和土壤中水分的统计力学理论，其结果是一个关于孔隙占据函数 g(r,x,t) 的连续场方程，其中 g(r,x,t) 表示位置 x 和时间 t 处半径为 r 的孔隙中被水充满的孔隙比例。该理论跨越三个尺度构建：微观尺度上的孔隙间转移由 Hagen-Poiseuille 速率和驱动势决定，其中驱动势是孔隙类别化学势之差，采用毛细力-重力形式，同时也可进一步纳入吸附、渗透或热效应；介观尺度上的主方程使占据率向平衡阶跃函数 g_eq=H(r*-r) 松弛；当平均体积收缩为一点时，则得到连续介质平衡方程 dₜ g + div F = C[g] - E - T，其他所有结果都可视为该方程的极限、矩或边界解析。该动力学方程是沿吉布斯自由能下降的 Onsager 梯度流；对于等温、无外力系统，它满足 H 定理，并且其零阶矩体现质量守恒。单一的无量纲群，即孔隙分辨的达姆科勒数 Da(r,x)，组织了系统的行为，并统一了过去分别建模的多种现象。Chapman-Enskog 约化表明，理查兹方程是准静态极限（Da->0），只有在这一极限下基质势和水力传导率 K 才会出现，并且当低于渗流阈值时 K 消失；毛细管束模型和临界路径模型分别是它的对角极限和谱极限。滞后是强迫丛的整体 holonomy，是一种几何相位，而不是逐孔隙的双稳态，并满足可证伪的环路面积定律 H ~ I²。优先流是同一个方程在 Da>1 区域中的表现，因此理查兹流与优先流之间的二分可转化为由 Da 控制的连续交叉。离开准静态极限后，g(r) 是不可约的状态变量。所有输入都来自孔隙网络的几何性质，可通过微型 CT 测量，并依据无宏观数据进行标定。

articles.title: Fragmented ETH and Ensemble Inequivalence
articles.title_zh: 碎片化本征态热化假说与系综不等价
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15350v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate thermalization in finite quantum systems with strong long-range interactions. Nearly conserved quantities inherited from the fully connected limit organize the Hilbert space into weakly coupled sectors and split the many-body spectrum into energy bands. Despite the resulting breakdown of global ergodicity, quantum chaos develops within individual energy bands, enabling the definition of microcanonical ensembles within the bands. This supports a band-resolved formulation of thermalization, which we term fragmented eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (fETH). Unlike conventional ETH, finite-size scaling in fETH obeys a symmetry-imposed selection rule that restricts which system sizes can be compared. This band-resolved description has consequences for equilibrium statistical mechanics. While microcanonical ensembles remain confined to a single band, canonical ensembles mix different bands. This mismatch explains ensemble inequivalence without invoking equilibrium phase transitions. Our results apply broadly to Hamiltonians near a fully permutation-symmetric limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有强长程相互作用的有限量子系统中的热化现象。由完全连接极限遗留下来的近似守恒量将希尔伯特空间划分为弱耦合扇区，并将多体谱分裂为能带；尽管整体遍历性破缺，单个能带内部仍会出现量子混沌。作者据此提出能带分辨的碎片化本征态热化假说，并说明微正则系综局限于单一能带而正则系综混合不同能带，从而无需平衡相变即可解释系综不等价。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究具有强长程相互作用的有限量子系统中的热化现象。从完全连接极限继承而来的近似守恒量将希尔伯特空间组织成弱耦合扇区，并将多体能谱分裂为能带。尽管由此导致整体遍历性的破缺，量子混沌仍会在单个能带内部发展，从而能够定义能带内部的微正则系综。这支持一种能带分辨的热化表述，我们称之为碎片化本征态热化假说（fETH）。不同于传统的 ETH，fETH 中的有限尺寸标度遵循由对称性强制施加的选择规则，该规则限制了哪些系统尺寸可以进行比较。这种能带分辨的描述对平衡统计力学具有影响。微正则系综仍局限于单一能带，而正则系综会混合不同能带。这种不匹配无需引入平衡相变即可解释系综不等价。我们的结果广泛适用于接近完全置换对称极限的哈密顿量。

articles.title: Magnetised Bounds for Conformal Field Theories
articles.title_zh: 共形场论的磁化界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.13592v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Aspects of parity-preserving, charge-conjugation-invariant, three-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs) with a global U(1) symmetry in the presence of a background magnetic field are investigated. A local effective action is constructed to four-derivative order, based on an assumption that the magnetic field drives the theory into a gapped phase. This action is evaluated in a variety of backgrounds, and is used to obtain one- and two-point functions of the conserved current and stress-energy tensor. Dispersive arguments are developed and shown to impose powerful constraints on the Wilson coefficients of the effective action, leading to universal predictions for the CFT response at large magnetic field and the scaling dimensions of background monopole operators. These general results are further examined through explicit calculations in the free complex scalar, free Dirac fermion, and a holographic Einstein-Hilbert-Maxwell model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有全局 U(1) 对称性的三维宇称保持、荷共轭不变共形场论在背景磁场中的性质。在假设磁场将理论驱动至有能隙相的基础上，作者构造了四阶导数阶的局域有效作用量，并利用色散关系约束其 Wilson 系数。由此得到强磁场下共形场论响应和背景单极子算符标度维数的普适预言，并通过自由复标量、自由 Dirac 费米子和全息 Einstein-Hilbert-Maxwell 模型进行检验。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了在背景磁场存在时，具有全局 U(1) 对称性的、保持宇称且满足荷共轭不变性的三维共形场论（CFT）的若干性质。在假设磁场将理论驱动进入有能隙相的基础上，作者构造了包含至四阶导数的局域有效作用量。该作用量在多种背景下进行了计算，并被用于获得守恒流以及应力-能量张量的一点函数和两点函数。研究发展了色散关系论证，并表明这些论证能够对有效作用量中的 Wilson 系数施加强有力的约束，从而给出强磁场下 CFT 响应以及背景单极子算符标度维数的普适预言。作者进一步通过自由复标量、自由 Dirac 费米子以及全息 Einstein-Hilbert-Maxwell 模型中的显式计算，对这些一般性结果进行了考察。

articles.title: Quantum-optical reset with classical memory
articles.title_zh: 具有经典记忆的量子光学重置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.02980v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Dynamic quantum circuits generate states that depend on the measurement results obtained during circuit execution. To date such a quantum computing model has mainly been implemented with qubit-based superconducting hardware utilizing reset operations and classical logic. Here we develop a model of optical reset by using time-bin self-looped interferometers demonstrated in recent experiments. Synchronizing the optical reset with a simple classical device storing history of measurement results allows one to decrease uncertainty of future measurements, which suggests new possibilities for constructing dynamical circuits on optical platforms. Information flow with significant multi-time correlations and memory depth is identified through distinct information-theoretic measures. We discuss potential applications of the proposed reset model, including the realization of boson sampling and experimental tests of the quantum-mechanical formulation of Landauer's principle.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于时间箱自循环干涉仪的光学重置模型，并将其与存储测量结果历史的简单经典装置同步。该机制能够降低未来测量结果的不确定性，为光学平台上的动态量子电路提供可能性。研究还利用多种信息论测度识别出具有显著多时间关联和记忆深度的信息流，并讨论其在玻色子采样和兰道尔原理实验检验中的潜在应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动态量子电路生成的量子态取决于电路执行过程中获得的测量结果。迄今为止，这种量子计算模型主要通过采用重置操作和经典逻辑的基于量子比特的超导硬件实现。在此，我们利用近期实验中展示的时间箱自循环干涉仪，发展了一种光学重置模型。将光学重置与一个存储测量结果历史的简单经典装置同步，可以降低未来测量结果的不确定性，这为在光学平台上构建动态电路提供了新的可能性。通过不同的信息论测度，我们识别出了具有显著多时间关联和记忆深度的信息流。我们讨论了所提出重置模型的潜在应用，包括实现玻色子采样以及对兰道尔原理量子力学表述开展实验检验。

articles.title: Rydberg states with a liquid core
articles.title_zh: 具有液态核心的里德伯态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.18169v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop a self-consistent approach that provides an explicit potential for a Rydberg electron whose ionic core consists of a polarizable medium, typically realized with superfluid droplets. The electron's motion remains separable in spherical coordinates, but the radial force exerted by the droplet breaks degeneracy of the angular momentum states non-perturbatively. The ensuing electron spectrum reveals intriguing properties dependent on droplet size and electron excitation. Deviations of the polarizable medium from the continuous spherical distribution can be taken into account as a perturbation of this redefined Rydberg dynamics. We discuss specific but paradigmatic examples for superfluid helium and also propose a way to probe droplet properties including its possible crystallized fraction through stimulated transitions of the Rydberg electron.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一种自洽方法，为离子核心由可极化介质构成的里德伯电子给出显式势能，典型体系为超流液滴。液滴施加的径向力会以非微扰方式打破角动量态简并，形成依赖液滴尺寸和电子激发程度的特殊能谱。作者还讨论了超流氦中的典型实例，并提出通过里德伯电子的受激跃迁探测液滴性质，包括其中可能存在的晶化组分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发展了一种自洽方法，为这样一种里德伯电子提供显式势能：其离子核心由可极化介质构成，通常可通过超流液滴实现。电子运动在球坐标中仍然可以分离，但液滴施加的径向力会以非微扰方式打破角动量态的简并。由此产生的电子能谱呈现出依赖液滴尺寸和电子激发程度的引人注目的性质。可将可极化介质偏离连续球对称分布的影响作为重新定义的里德伯动力学上的微扰加以考虑。我们讨论了超流氦中的具体但具有范式意义的实例，并提出一种通过里德伯电子的受激跃迁探测液滴性质的方法，其中包括探测其可能存在的晶化组分。

articles.title: Weak-Coupling Limit of the Lattice Nonlinear Schrödinger Integral Equation
articles.title_zh: 晶格非线性薛定谔积分方程的弱耦合极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09522v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the ground-state integral equation of the quantum lattice nonlinear Schrödinger model, equivalently the isotropic Heisenberg XXX chain at spin s = -1, whose solution is the root density on a Fermi interval. In the weak-coupling limit the equation is doubly singular: the driving term and the kernel collapse onto delta functions, and the solution separates into three regions on three scales, an inner peak, the bulk of the Fermi sea, and a boundary layer at the band edge. We treat the singular structure probabilistically. We identify both the kernel and the driving term as the Cauchy density, in such a way that the root density corresponds to the Green kernel of a Cauchy random walk killed on leaving the Fermi sea. Consequently, the three regions are then the potential kernel, the interval exit law, and the ascending-ladder renewal function of that walk. This construction determines the logarithmic growth of the central density and the digamma form of the inner profile, whose Fourier-space solution is the Bose--Einstein distribution. In the bulk, the density approaches the Green function of the half-Laplacian, while the Wiener--Hopf factorisation fixes the edge behaviour and identifies a candidate scale for non-perturbative corrections. The analysis also yields closed asymptotic expressions for the total density and the ground-state energy. Nyström solutions over a broad range of Fermi rapidities confirm the three-region asymptotic description.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究量子晶格非线性薛定谔模型基态积分方程的解，该模型等价于自旋 s=-1 的各向同性 Heisenberg XXX 链，其解为费米区间上的根密度。弱耦合极限下，驱动项和核同时奇异地收缩为 δ 函数，根密度在内峰、费米海主体和带边界层三个尺度上分离。作者借助概率论将这些区域分别解释为被杀死的 Cauchy 随机游走的势核、区间逃逸律和上升阶梯更新函数，并得到中心密度、边缘行为、总密度和基态能量的渐近结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究量子晶格非线性薛定谔模型的基态积分方程，该模型等价于自旋 s=-1 的各向同性 Heisenberg XXX 链，其解是费米区间上的根密度。在弱耦合极限下，该方程具有双重奇异性：驱动项和核都收缩为 δ 函数，而解则在三个尺度上分为三个区域，即内峰、费米海主体以及带边缘的边界层。我们以概率论方式处理这种奇异结构。我们识别出核和驱动项都是 Cauchy 密度，因此根密度对应于一个离开费米海时被杀死的 Cauchy 随机游走的 Green 核。于是，这三个区域分别对应于该随机游走的势核、区间逃逸律和上升阶梯更新函数。该构造确定了中心密度的对数增长和内区剖面的 digamma 形式，而其傅里叶空间解则是 Bose-Einstein 分布。在主体区域，密度趋近于半拉普拉斯算子的 Green 函数；Wiener-Hopf 因子分解确定了边缘行为，并指出了非微扰修正的一个候选尺度。该分析还给出了总密度和基态能量的闭式渐近表达式。在广泛的费米快度范围内得到的 Nyström 数值解证实了这一区域分三段的渐近描述。

articles.title: Discrete classical electromagnetism
articles.title_zh: 离散经典电磁学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electric charges that make up charge distributions and currents in classical electromagnetism (EM) are point charge electrons with a fixed finite charge. This means that a truly continuous charge distribution or current cannot be formed because that would require infinitesimal charges. If the number of electrons in any distribution is very large, the distributions can be approximately continuous, and can be used in many applications, but the discrete character of the distributions has a major effect on other physical effects. We consider two of those effects in this paper. Does a point charge have infinite self-energy, and does a moving current loop have an electric dipole moment?
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，经典电磁学中的电荷分布和电流由具有固定有限电荷的点电荷电子组成，因此严格连续的电荷分布或电流在物理上并不存在。虽然大量电子可产生近似连续的分布，但其离散性仍会影响某些物理效应。文章重点考察点电荷是否具有无限自能，以及运动电流环是否具有电偶极矩。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 构成经典电磁学（EM）中电荷分布和电流的电荷，是带有固定有限电荷的点状电子。这意味着真正连续的电荷分布或电流无法形成，因为那将要求存在无穷小电荷。当任意分布中的电子数非常大时，这些分布可以近似视为连续分布，并可用于许多应用，但分布的离散特征仍会对其他物理效应产生重大影响。本文考察其中两个效应：点电荷是否具有无限自能，以及运动中的电流环是否具有电偶极矩。

articles.title: Design optimization, commissioning, and uncertainty analysis of the quadrupole resonator system at Jefferson Lab for SRF material characterization
articles.title_zh: 杰斐逊实验室用于超导射频材料表征的四极谐振器系统：设计优化、调试与不确定度分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A quadrupole resonator (QPR) provides a sample-based platform for characterizing materials for superconducting radio-frequency (SRF) applications under controlled field, frequency, and temperature conditions. This paper presents the design optimization, commissioning, and validation of the Jefferson Lab QPR system, including a quantitative assessment of measurement uncertainty. The resonator geometry was re-optimized from the CERN version-II design to improve quadrupole-mode separation and enable four usable modes at 400, 806, 1221, and 1640 MHz. The measurement system combines self-excited-loop RF operation, cable-loss-corrected power calibration, decay-based external-Q calibration, and RF-DC thermal-substitution calorimetry to determine the peak surface magnetic field Bpk and sample surface resistance Rs. Commissioning measurements on bulk Nb and Nb3Sn-Ta-Cu samples validated the system response over a broad range of frequency, temperature, and RF field. The extracted superconducting energy-gap parameters are consistent with the reported values for Nb and Nb3Sn, as well as with those obtained from single-cell cavity measurements. The commissioned system operates from 1.8 K to near the superconducting transition temperature of the sample, with accessible Bpk values from approximately 5 mT to a sample- and temperature-dependent heater-power-budget limit; a maximum field of 60 mT was demonstrated for bulk Nb at 400 MHz and 4 K. The combined relative standard uncertainties are 8.3% for Bpk and below 18% for Rs when r = PDC2/PDC1 is less than 0.9. The worst-case Bpk resolution at the 95% confidence level is approximately 1.35 mT, while the Rs resolution is below 1 nOhm at 10 mT and 2 K. These results establish the JLab QPR as a calibrated, multi-frequency platform with quantified measurement uncertainty for SRF material characterization.
articles.abstract_zh: 四极谐振器（QPR）能够在受控的场强、频率和温度条件下，以样品为基础表征超导射频材料。本文介绍杰斐逊实验室 QPR 系统的设计优化、调试和验证，并定量评估测量不确定度；重新优化的谐振器可实现 400、806、1221 和 1640 MHz 的四个可用模式。利用射频自激环路、校正电缆损耗的功率标定、基于衰减的外部 Q 值标定以及射频-直流热替代量热法，系统测定了峰值表面磁场和样品表面电阻，并通过 Nb 与 Nb3Sn-Ta-Cu 样品验证了系统性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 四极谐振器（QPR）提供了一个基于样品的平台，可在受控的场强、频率和温度条件下表征用于超导射频（SRF）应用的材料。本文介绍了杰斐逊实验室 QPR 系统的设计优化、调试和验证，包括对测量不确定度的定量评估。该谐振器的几何结构在 CERN version-II 设计基础上进行了重新优化，以改善四极模式分离，并实现 400、806、1221 和 1640 MHz 四个可用模式。测量系统结合了自激环路射频运行、经过电缆损耗修正的功率标定、基于衰减的外部 Q 值标定以及射频-直流热替代量热法，以确定峰值表面磁场 Bpk 和样品表面电阻 Rs。对块体 Nb 以及 Nb3Sn-Ta-Cu 样品的调试测量，在广泛的频率、温度和射频场范围内验证了系统响应。提取出的超导能隙参数与 Nb 和 Nb3Sn 的已报道数值一致，也与单腔测量获得的结果一致。完成调试的系统可在 1.8 K 至接近样品超导转变温度的范围内运行；可获得的 Bpk 约为 5 mT 至受样品和温度影响的加热器功率预算上限。在 400 MHz、4 K 条件下，块体 Nb 实现了 60 mT 的最大场强。当 r = PDC2/PDC1 小于 0.9 时，Bpk 的合成相对标准不确定度为 8.3%，Rs 的合成相对标准不确定度低于 18%。在 95% 置信水平下，Bpk 的最坏情况下分辨率约为 1.35 mT；在 10 mT、2 K 条件下，Rs 的分辨率低于 1 nOhm。这些结果表明，JLab QPR 已成为一个经过标定、具有多频率能力并且测量不确定度得到量化的 SRF 材料表征平台。

articles.title: HELIX: a hybrid envelope-multiparticle linac code with differentiable space-charge optimization
articles.title_zh: HELIX：具有可微空间电荷优化的混合包络-多粒子直线加速器代码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: HELIX (Hybrid Envelope-multiparticle LInac eXplorer) is a Python hadron-linac framework developed at Fermilab for the PIP-II superconducting H- linac. It combines exact-gradient matching through a self-consistent nonlinear particle-in-cell (PIC) space-charge solve with the lattice-card workflow used for machine design. One TraceWin-format lattice drives an rms-envelope solver with 3-D linearized space charge, a multiparticle tracker with a 3-D FFT PIC solve, and linear matrix analysis over one data model, and the constraint cards that steer six classical matching algorithms also steer a differentiable seventh, which re-expresses a fixed-energy subset of the tracking-plus-PIC map as a single PyTorch graph and returns reverse-mode Jacobians exact to floating-point precision at a cost set by the number of constraints rather than of knobs. On a six-quadrupole manufactured verification problem the exact-Jacobian run reaches a tolerance-normalized residual of 3.2×10⁻¹⁰, some 200 times below the finite-difference endpoint at the same forward-equivalent budget; the Jacobian cost is flat in the knob count, with the crossover between ten and twelve knobs and reverse mode 1.45 times faster at sixteen. Verification is hierarchical, from analytic envelope references through 10⁻⁹-10⁻¹³ cross-implementation PIC parity to TraceWin benchmarks on the PIP-II low-energy, medium-energy and accelerating lines: with space charge on, the rms moments along the MEBT and half-wave-resonator line agree within 0.7%, and over the 186-m linac the energy agrees within 0.03% and transmission within the combined statistical uncertainty. HELIX also provides machine-learned field-map surrogates, Pareto exploration, error Monte Carlo with orbit correction, failure compensation, and RFQ transport, with NumPy, C++/OpenMP, CUDA and Metal backends.
articles.abstract_zh: HELIX 是费米实验室为 PIP-II 超导 H- 直线加速器开发的 Python 强子直线加速器框架，将自洽非线性粒子-网格（PIC）空间电荷求解与机器设计中的晶格卡工作流结合起来。一个 TraceWin 格式晶格可驱动均方根包络求解器、多粒子跟踪器和线性矩阵分析，并支持基于 PyTorch 的可微优化。验证表明，精确雅可比方法显著优于有限差分方法；与 TraceWin 基准相比，HELIX 在含空间电荷的条件下对包络、能量和传输率均实现了较高一致性，同时提供场图代理模型、帕累托探索、误差蒙特卡洛、轨道校正、故障补偿和 RFQ 输运等功能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: HELIX（Hybrid Envelope-multiparticle LInac eXplorer，混合包络-多粒子直线加速器探索器）是费米实验室为 PIP-II 超导 H- 直线加速器开发的 Python 强子直线加速器框架。它将通过自洽非线性粒子-网格（PIC）空间电荷求解实现的精确梯度匹配，与机器设计中使用的晶格卡工作流结合起来。一个 TraceWin 格式的晶格通过同一数据模型驱动均方根包络求解器、采用三维线性化空间电荷的多粒子跟踪器以及线性矩阵分析；用于控制六种经典匹配算法的约束卡也控制第七种可微算法。该算法将固定能量子集上的“跟踪加 PIC”映射重新表达为单个 PyTorch 计算图，并以浮点精度返回反向模式雅可比矩阵，其计算成本由约束数量而非旋钮数量决定。在一个由六个四极磁铁构成的制造验证问题上，精确雅可比运行达到 3.2×10⁻¹⁰ 的容差归一化残差，比相同正向等效预算下有限差分方法的终点残差低约 200 倍；雅可比计算成本不随旋钮数量增加，在 10 到 12 个旋钮之间出现交叉点，并且在 16 个旋钮时反向模式速度是其 1.45 倍。验证工作具有层级结构，从解析包络参考，到 10⁻⁹-10⁻¹³ 精度的跨实现 PIC 一致性，再到 PIP-II 低能、中能和加速段上的 TraceWin 基准测试：在开启空间电荷时，MEBT 和半波谐振器束线中的均方根矩一致性达到 0.7% 以内；在全长 186 m 的直线加速器上，能量一致性达到 0.03% 以内，传输率则处于合并统计不确定度之内。HELIX 还提供机器学习场图代理模型、帕累托探索、带轨道校正的误差蒙特卡洛、故障补偿以及 RFQ 输运功能，并支持 NumPy、C++/OpenMP、CUDA 和 Metal 后端。

articles.title: Learning Memory-Dependent Neural Network Correlation Potentials for Accurate Electron Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 学习具有记忆依赖性的神经网络关联势以实现精确电子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-dependent density functional theory, though exact in theory, is in practice applied in an adiabatic approximation using exchange-correlation functionals with only local temporal dependence. Simultaneously, the exact correlation potential formally depends on, among other quantities, the time-history of electron densities. Here we develop a framework to learn neural network models of correlation functionals that feature explicit memory-dependence. Our framework includes two different approaches, both linked through their use of adjoint-based optimization. One approach decouples the learning of the functional from inversion to find ground truth values of the correlation potential. The other approach learns the functional directly without requiring inversion. We apply these methods to modeling the electron dynamics of two-electron systems in two spatial dimensions. In both cases, our methods yield correlation functionals with low test set propagation error, outperforming standard local density and generalized gradient approximation functionals by one to two orders of magnitude. Overall, our framework points at one strategy to move beyond the adiabatic approximation and develop memory-dependent correlation functionals that yield accurate propagation for excited state and/or non-equilibrium dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管含时密度泛函理论在理论上是精确的，实际应用通常采用绝热近似，使交换-关联泛函仅具有局部时间依赖性。本文建立了学习显式记忆依赖关联泛函的神经网络框架，并提出两种均基于伴随优化的方法：一种将泛函学习与求取基准关联势的反演过程解耦，另一种直接学习泛函而无需反演。对二维双电子体系的测试表明，这些方法具有较低的传播误差，相比标准局域密度和广义梯度近似泛函提高一至两个数量级。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文开发具有显式时间记忆效应的神经网络关联势，用于改进时间依赖密度泛函理论中的电子动力学模拟。研究在二维双电子模型上表明，记忆依赖的神经网络泛函可显著降低传播误差，并优于常规局域或梯度近似。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习电子结构、机器学习 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量、非绝热分子动力学和激发态动力学方向相关，但目前主要针对模型体系，尚未直接面向复杂材料。其时间非局域建模思想可用于提高载流子弛豫、非辐射复合和电荷转移动力学的精度。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可将记忆依赖关联势推广到半导体缺陷、卤化物钙钛矿和二维材料，并用 GW-BSE 或高精度时间依赖计算生成训练数据。需要重点验证模型的时间稳定性、守恒性质以及跨材料和跨激发条件的泛化能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 含时密度泛函理论虽然在理论上是精确的，但在实践中通常采用绝热近似，并使用仅具有局部时间依赖性的交换-关联泛函。与此同时，精确的关联势在形式上还依赖于电子密度的时间历史等多个量。在此，我们建立了一个用于学习具有显式记忆依赖性的关联泛函神经网络模型的框架。我们的框架包含两种不同的方法，二者都通过使用基于伴随变量的优化而相互关联。其中一种方法将泛函学习与反演过程解耦，以求得关联势的真实值。另一种方法无需反演，直接学习泛函。我们将这些方法应用于二维空间中的双电子体系电子动力学建模。在这两种情况下，所得到的关联泛函都具有较低的测试集传播误差，相比标准的局域密度近似和广义梯度近似泛函，性能提高了一个至两个数量级。总体而言，我们的框架展示了一种超越绝热近似的路径，有望发展出具有记忆依赖性的关联泛函，从而为激发态和/或非平衡动力学提供精确传播。

articles.title: Assessing the effect of error field penetration during plasma current ramp-up in the DIII-D tokamak
articles.title_zh: 评估等离子体电流爬升期间误差场穿透对 DIII-D 托卡马克的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work provides evidence that established error field penetration threshold scalings remain applicable during plasma current ramp-up. In dedicated DIII-D experiments with imposed n=1 perturbations during extended Iₚ ramps, an apparent empirical threshold is found between 2 and 3~kA of applied 3D coil current, above which MHD modes are seeded. The imposed perturbation couples to the rational surfaces present during the ramp, seeding near the q=4 surface and penetrating as an m/n=3/1 mode by the end of the perturbation phase. To interpret these observations, multi-machine penetration threshold scalings are combined with equilibrium-based overlap metrics from the GPEC code, including the in-situ error fields of the device. This modeling reproduces the observed onset in the amplitude scan and classifies mode seeding across a database of 12 ramp-up discharges spanning a range of plasma currents and densities. Across this database, the seeding appears to be controlled primarily by the applied 3D coil current rather than by the plasma current or its ramp rate. Accounting for the in-situ error fields is found to be important for reliable prediction. These results are consistent with the robustness of scaling-based penetration metrics when coupled to detailed 3D field modeling under transient ramp-up conditions, and suggest the importance of accounting for in-situ error fields when assessing additional externally induced perturbations. This work is motivated by future tokamaks in which transient, non-axisymmetric error fields can arise during startup, for example from runaway electron mitigation coils.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为既有的误差场穿透阈值标度关系在等离子体电流爬升期间仍然适用提供了证据。在 DIII-D 实验中，施加 n=1 扰动时发现，外加三维线圈电流约为 2 至 3 kA 之间存在经验阈值，超过该阈值会激发磁流体动力学模。结合 GPEC 平衡重叠度量和装置原位误差场的多装置穿透标度模型，研究重现了模态起始，并表明模态播种主要受外加三维线圈电流控制，而非等离子体电流或其爬升速率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项工作提供了证据，表明既有的误差场穿透阈值标度关系在等离子体电流爬升期间仍然适用。在 DIII-D 开展的专门实验中，研究人员在延长的 Iₚ 爬升过程中施加 n=1 扰动，发现施加的三维线圈电流在 2 至 3 kA 之间存在一个表观经验阈值，超过该阈值后会播种磁流体动力学（MHD）模。施加的扰动与爬升期间存在的有理面耦合，在 q=4 面附近播种，并在扰动阶段结束时以 m/n=3/1 模式穿透。为解释这些观测结果，研究将多装置穿透阈值标度关系与基于平衡的重叠度量相结合；这些度量来自 GPEC 代码，并包括装置的原位误差场。该建模重现了幅度扫描中观测到的起始现象，并对涵盖一系列等离子体电流和密度的 12 次爬升放电数据库中的模态播种进行了分类。在该数据库中，模态播种似乎主要由施加的三维线圈电流控制，而不是由等离子体电流或其爬升速率控制。研究发现，考虑原位误差场对于实现可靠预测十分重要。这些结果表明，当基于标度的穿透度量与瞬态爬升条件下的详细三维场建模相结合时，它们具有稳健性；同时也说明，在评估额外外部诱导扰动时，考虑原位误差场十分重要。这项工作受到未来托卡马克的需求驱动，在这些装置中，启动期间可能出现瞬态的非轴对称误差场，例如由失控电子缓解线圈产生的误差场。

articles.title: Impact of extremely high temperature on future photovoltaic power potential over East Asia
articles.title_zh: 极高温度对东亚未来光伏发电潜力的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As global warming intensifies, the frequency and intensity of extremely high temperatures are expected to increase. This will impact the production of photovoltaics (PVs), which are increasingly adopted as an effective alternative to replace fossil fuel-based energy sources and reduce CO2 emissions. Furthermore, extremely high temperature days account for a considerable proportion of days with high PV power potential (PVpot). Therefore, this study investigates changes in PVpot on future extremely high temperature days over East Asia, a region with high greenhouse gas emissions and vulnerability to extreme climatic events. The East Asia-averaged PVpot for extremely high temperature days was estimated to decrease across all scenarios and future periods. The East Asia-averaged PVpot for extremely high temperature days was predicted to decrease more substantially toward the late 21st century, with a larger magnitude of decrease expected under the high-carbon emissions scenario compared to the low-carbon emissions scenario. By the mid-and late 21st century, PVpot for extremely high temperature days was projected to decrease in PV hotspot areas, particularly in the regions of northern China and southern Mongolia, by up to -7.2 %. The signs of PVpot projections vary across sub-regions under summer mean conditions, while on extremely high temperature days, PVpot is consistently expected to decrease in all regions. This suggests that extremely high temperatures further intensify the decrease in PVpot. Moreover, under extremely high-temperature conditions, near-surface air temperature has been identified as the primary driver of projected decreases in PVpot among the climate variables considered; its influence is expected to intensify over time, thereby accelerating PVpot decreases under the high-carbon emissions scenario.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着全球变暖加剧，极高温度的发生频率和强度预计将增加，这将影响光伏发电潜力。本文研究了东亚未来极高温日上的光伏发电潜力变化，该地区温室气体排放量高且易受极端气候事件影响。结果表明，在所有情景和未来时期，东亚平均极高温日光伏发电潜力均将下降，且在高碳排放情景和 21 世纪后期下降更明显。极高温条件下，近地面气温是导致光伏潜力下降的主要气候因素，其影响会随时间增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着全球变暖加剧，极高温度的发生频率和强度预计将增加。这将影响光伏发电（PV）的生产，而光伏发电正日益被采用为替代化石燃料能源并减少 CO2 排放的有效方式。此外，极高温日占据了光伏发电潜力（PVpot）较高日数中的相当比例。因此，本研究考察了东亚未来极高温日上的 PVpot 变化；东亚是一个温室气体排放量高且易受极端气候事件影响的区域。在所有情景和未来时期，东亚平均极高温日 PVpot 均预计下降。与 21 世纪中期相比，东亚平均极高温日 PVpot 预计在 21 世纪后期下降得更加显著；与低碳排放情景相比，高碳排放情景下的下降幅度也预计更大。在 21 世纪中期和后期，PVpot 热点区域，尤其是中国北部和蒙古南部的极高温日 PVpot 预计将下降，降幅最高可达 -7.2%。在夏季平均条件下，不同子区域的 PVpot 预测变化方向并不一致；然而，在极高温日，所有区域的 PVpot 都预计下降。这表明，极高温会进一步加剧 PVpot 的下降。此外，在极高温条件下，近地面气温被确定为所考虑气候变量中导致 PVpot 预测下降的主要因素；预计其影响会随时间增强，从而在高碳排放情景下加速 PVpot 的下降。

articles.title: Activated carbon-assisted anionic dye decomposition using a dual-liquid post-double dielectric barrier discharge plasma reactor
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04734v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-thermal Plasma (NTP) technology, including the Dielectric Barrier Discharge (DBD) reactor, has emerged as an effective advanced oxidation process (AOP) for treating persistent organic pollutants in industrial wastewater. Based on this objective, a dual-liquid dielectric-barrier-discharge plasma reactor was built and used to degrade a ternary anionic dye mixture comprising Reactive Red 120, Congo Red, and Methyl Orange in its post-discharge configuration. The adjustable length of the outer liquid electrode (grounded) provides flexibility in controlling the discharge length and cooling, thereby achieving higher degradation efficiency and greater reactor stability. The conducting-liquid high-voltage electrode (a dielectric tube filled with a conductive solution) helps mitigate metal corrosion and oxidation caused by reactive species in the discharge zone. A detailed study of the degradation of ternary anionic dye mixtures (simulated dye wastewater samples) in the presence of activated carbon (AC) was performed to explore the potential applications of post-discharge treatment. The activated carbon (granules) enhances the degradation rate of ternary anionic dye mixtures in basic solutions rather than in acidic or neutral solutions. A comparative study of the degradation reaction kinetics of the ternary anionic dye mixtures in acidic and basic solutions was conducted after analyzing UV-Vis absorption spectra. The role of other parameters, such as solution pH, the mass and size of AC particles, dye concentrations, and AC reuse, was investigated in relation to degradation efficiency. The degradation mechanism was elucidated by the formation of strong oxidizer (hydroxyl radicals) on the surface of activated carbon during post-discharge treatment. However, in acidic or neutral anionic dye solutions, the degradation mechanism was dominated by ozone.

articles.title: BEAM3R: Beam's-eye-view architecture with Mamba-3 for implicit dose reconstruction
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To enable accurate and rapid photon control point and proton beamlet dose calculation in the DoseRAD2026 challenge, we present BEAM3R, a dose estimation framework operating in beam's-eye-view (BEV). Our core innovation combines a Mamba-3 state-space depth-sequence core with physics-based transport conditioning to model long-range depth transport without expensive 3D convolutions. BEAM3R shares a 2D CNN encoder-decoder architecture for photon and proton dose tasks, processing per-plane BEV slices. Proton beamlets are conditioned on water equivalent thickness and remaining range, encoding the parameters determining Bragg peak position. Photon models use a bidirectional Mamba-3 core to capture dose contributions from materials downstream of the calculation point, while the proton model uses a forward core with learned energy-prefix tokens and a Bragg-peak refinement module. To reduce interpolation artifacts and support high spatial resolution, we introduce axial grid alignment of BEV lattices with CT slices and an implicit super-resolution representation via sub-pixel phase packing, evaluated by a differentiable Triton-accelerated resampler that reconstructs packed cubic B-spline coefficients directly in CT space. For MRI-based tasks, synthetic CTs (sCT) are generated by a patch-based conditional GAN with a SwinUNETR backbone. On the preliminary DoseRAD2026 test set, CT-to-photon and CT-to-proton models achieved 1%/1 mm local gamma pass rates of 96.8% and 96.0%, with stratified plan-level MAEs of 0.0041 and 0.0079. Substituting sCT reduced gamma pass rates to 89.7% for photon and 75.4% proton plan level doses, with stratified plan-level MAEs of 0.0093 and 0.0336. Standardised runtimes were 23.4 s and 18.4 s for CT-to-photon and CT-to-proton prediction, increasing to 39.7 s and 42.8 s for the corresponding MRI-based pipelines.

articles.title: Dead-zone-free free-induction-decay alkali-metal atomic magnetometer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04847v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The detection dead zone is an important systematic limitation in scalar atomic magnetometers, constraining their practical utility. In this work, we demonstrate a sensitive dead zone free scalar magnetometer by integrating previously established techniques into a FID magnetometer based on Bell Bloom optical pumping. The dead zone is eliminated by inserting a reflecting mirror within a multipass cavity assisted atomic cell, which folds the optical beam into orthogonal paths. Our analysis reveals that interregion cross talk is essential for interpreting the resulted experimental signals. The sensor exhibits oscillation signal amplitude variations within a factor of three across all orientations in three dimensional space, and a field sensitivity better than 80 fT/Hz⁽¹/²⁾ over the full space. We further characterize the heading error in the geomagnetic field range, where experimental results agree with theoretical predictions within 0.7 nT. Additionally, the sensor can operate in a closed loop mode by feeding back the real time frequency extracted from the FID signal to modulate the pump beam, we characterize the magnetic field slew rate of the sensor. This work paves the way towards a sensitive vector FID magnetometer.

articles.title: Frugal Effective Models for Nanophotonic Scattering: Optimizing Global Polarizability Matrices for Metasurface Design
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate nano-photonics simulations of large scale devices like optical metasurfaces require high accuracy reduced models for the device constituents. We present an automated framework for the optimization of Global Polarizability Matrix (GPM) models, which represent a complex scatterer as a small set of non-local effective dipoles. Our goal is to find the most frugal model that reproduces a particle's scattering response within a user-defined accuracy. The method iteratively removes redundant dipoles while re-adapting the positions of the remaining ones via gradient based optimization, stopping at the smallest model that still meets the target. Automatic differentiation, combined with an untrained neural network that reparametrizes the dipole positions, helps to place the dipoles at physically intuitive locations. We demonstrate the versatility of this approach across diverse geometries, from two dimensional ridges over simple spheres to complex three-dimensional particles, achieving compression factors of typically two orders of magnitude compared to full-wave simulations, for target accuracies in the order of few percent. We finally demonstrate how accurate, frugal effective models enable large-scale meta-deflector optimization without periodic approximations. This robust recipe for constructing frugal effective models paves the way for the rapid simulation of large-scale photonic assemblies, required for example for metasurface design.

articles.title: From the Light Quantum to the Photon: The Evolution of a Physical Concept
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04985v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work examines the physical and conceptual evolution of the light quantum from Planck's blackbody theory to the theoretical and experimental developments that led to the quantization of the electromagnetic field. The present study shows that the decisive transition occurred in Einstein's quantum theory of radiation (1916-1917). Absorption, stimulated emission, and spontaneous emission were formulated as elementary probabilistic mechanisms whose statistical balance alone reproduces the blackbody spectrum. In particular, spontaneous emission requires the emission of a light quantum, thereby implicitly proving its physical necessity before its theoretical status was clarified. At the same time, the already existing term photon began to acquire a stable usage following Lewis's 1926 proposal and became increasingly associated with Einstein's light quantum. By the mid-1920s, the central problem had shifted from whether light quanta were physically required to how radiation could be incorporated into the emerging quantum-mechanical formalism. This transition marks a key stage, illustrating how initial debates about the existence of light quanta gave way to their integration into a comprehensive theoretical structure. The resulting asymmetry between the novel quantum description of matter and the still-classical description of radiation, called into question by the phenomenon of spontaneous emission, identifies the physical problem that led to the quantization of the electromagnetic field.

articles.title: Fisher-information retention under local driving in non-Hermitian feed-forward chains
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When local drive hardware is installed before a sensing task is revealed, directional non-Hermitian buildup creates a tradeoff between targeted preparation and spatial coverage. We quantify this tradeoff for stable linear scatterers with proper complex Gaussian output statistics. For parameters encoded in the internal generator, and at fixed coherent internal resource, the drive hardware enters the optimized mean-response Fisher information only through the projector onto the internally reachable subspace, while the preparation Gramian sets the source cost. In an on-resonance feed-forward chain, nested Green-function columns decompose into disjoint port intervals, and the site-local retention factors in each interval sum exactly to unity. Directionality concentrates this unit downstream, so the worst-site retention decays exponentially when one port serves many sites; for m equal intervals, a single probe shared by all tasks has a worst-site retention lower by a further factor m than task-specific reoptimization. Joint source-power and internal-resource constraints connect this fixed-resource law to source-limited preparation. A noisy RLC/VCCS model illustrates the retention law with stored electromagnetic energy, covariance Fisher information, and component disorder. The resulting bounds turn directional buildup into a port-layout criterion: source savings for a selected task are accompanied by a spatial coverage cost for tasks unknown at the hardware-design stage.

articles.title: Fabrication-Aware Design of a Hybrid Metasurface-Bragg Mirror for Low-Noise Precision Optics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-reflectivity coatings for precision interferometry must simultaneously minimize optical losses and thermally driven displacement noise. Dielectric Bragg mirrors provide robust high reflectance but rely on thick multilayer coatings, whereas metasurface mirrors provide high reflectance and low noise but are sensitive to fabrication-induced deviations. A fabrication-aware hybrid mirror concept is introduced that combines a resonant single-layer metasurface, an etch-stop layer, an antiresonant spacer, and a reduced Bragg reflector. Fabrication effects, including geometric tolerances and line-edge roughness, are explicitly considered in the optical design. Full-wave electromagnetic simulations are combined with a truncated-Gaussian Monte Carlo analysis to determine the performance distribution under the assumed fabrication conditions. The ideal metasurface design exceeds 99.999% reflectance. After roughness-aware reoptimization, the modeled non-reflected power remains below 2.88·10⁻⁴ at 95% fabrication yield. For the cryogenic ETpathfinder gravitational-wave testbed, three Bragg layer pairs reduce the non-reflected power of the complete stack to approximately 6.4,ppm. The estimated thermal displacement-noise amplitude spectral density is 8.4·10⁻²¹,mathrmm,Hz⁻¹/² at 100,Hz. The architecture connects fabrication robustness, optical performance, and thermal-noise reduction within a single design framework.

articles.title: Unveiling wing turbulence dynamics through explainable deep learning
