articles.abstract: Growing trends in sustainable production of energy in industries have fuelled the need for sustainable alternatives for the conventional sources of energy in industries. The current study investigates the use of briquette fuel made from agricultural and industrial waste material as an alternate fuel for the production of steam in industrial boilers through experimental analysis, thermodynamic simulation using Python and Machine Learning (ML) techniques. It was found that the tested biomass briquette fuel possesses good characteristics such as low moisture content (8–12%) and increased calorific value (3500–4800 kcal kg⁻¹). The economic analysis results showed a saving of Rs. 7,333 per day and Rs. 26.76 lakhs annually when biomass briquettes were used in place of firewood. Based on the Python program code developed, the maximum furnace temperature was estimated to be 1678 K, average furnace temperature was estimated to be 1320 K, rate of steam generation at 2120 kg h⁻¹, boiler efficiency at 81.6%, carbon dioxide emissions at 512 kg h⁻¹ and NOx at 182 ppm. The performance of the machine learning algorithms such as XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost was outstanding, where XGBoost yielded the highest accuracy level (R² = 0.98). From SHAP analysis, it was clear that furnace temperature and fuel feed rate were key parameters for controlling boiler efficiency.

articles.title: Occurrence and characterization of microplastics in tilapia (oreochromis niloticus) from Deduru Oya reservoir in Sri Lanka
articles.abstract: Microplastics (MPs) contamination in freshwater ecosystems has become a global environmental concern due to its widespread occurrence and potential impacts on aquatic organisms and food safety. However, information on MP ingestion by freshwater fish in Sri Lankan reservoirs remains limited. This study evaluated the characteristics, abundance, polymer composition, and potential biological implications of MPs in Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) collected from the Deduru Oya Reservoir, Sri Lanka. Gastrointestinal tract samples were digested using 10% KOH, and suspected MPs were identified by microscopic examination and polymer characterization using ATR-FTIR spectroscopy. MPs were detected in 82.9% of examined fish, with an average abundance of 3.11 ± 3.13 particles per individual. Fibers were the dominant particle type, followed by fragments and films. Polyethylene (53.7%) was the most abundant polymer, followed by polyvinyl chloride (12.2%), polyacrylate (9.75%), polystyrene (7.31%), nylon (2.43%), and polyurethane (2.43%). The predominance of polyethylene suggests that buoyant polymers are more readily available for ingestion by tilapia within the reservoir ecosystem. The calculated Polymer Hazard Index (PHI) of approximately 1.48 x 105 indicated a very high hazard level, suggesting that the identified MP polymers may pose substantial environmental and ecological risks. These findings provide important data on freshwater MP contamination in Sri Lanka and highlight the need for continued monitoring of MP pollution in reservoir fisheries used for human consumption and support future monitoring and management strategies.

articles.title: Physics-Informed Dual-View YOLO Framework for Tennis Ball Trajectory Prediction
articles.abstract: The flight behavior of spinning tennis balls constitutes a nonlinear aerodynamic system governed by the coupling among translational motion, rotational dynamics, gravity, and aerodynamic forces. Conventional trajectory prediction methods often rely on simplified projectile assumptions and therefore fail to accurately reconstruct spin-induced nonlinear trajectory evolution under realistic high-speed sports conditions. To address this limitation, this study proposes a physics-informed tennis trajectory reconstruction framework integrating synchronized dual-view motion acquisition, YOLO-based object localization, three-dimensional kinematic reconstruction, and Magnus-effect-informed aerodynamic simulation. Side-view and top-view observations are utilized to estimate key motion parameters, including initial velocity, elevation angle, and lateral motion angle, which are subsequently incorporated into a nonlinear aerodynamic trajectory model considering gravity, drag, and spin-induced lift forces. Experiments were conducted using 40 tennis strokes collected under daytime and nighttime conditions on a red clay court with physically measured landing-point references. The results demonstrate that incorporating Magnus-effect coupling substantially improves longitudinal trajectory reconstruction accuracy. Specifically, the Z-axis mean absolute error decreased from 2.49 m to 1.08 m, while the overall RMSE decreased from 2.82 m to 1.52 m compared with the non-Magnus model. Spatial deviation analysis further revealed reduced systematic prediction bias and improved trajectory stability under varying illumination conditions. The proposed framework establishes a coupled visual–physical paradigm for nonlinear sports trajectory reconstruction by integrating deep learning–based motion acquisition with physics-informed aerodynamic modeling. The study contributes toward physically consistent landing-point prediction, intelligent sports analytics, and high-fidelity trajectory simulation in high-speed sports environments.

articles.title: Coordination or Synchronization? Social Interaction, Participation Thresholds, and Liquidity in a Heterogeneous-Agent Asset Market
articles.abstract: This paper develops an agent-based computational asset market to study when social interaction improves coordination and when it instead produces synchronized instability. Agents differ continuously in their reliance on fundamental-value and trend signals, face heterogeneous participation thresholds and order capacities, and observe a fixed local peer network before submitting bounded orders to a market maker with finite depth. The model is deliberately parsimonious so that the interaction mechanism can be isolated. A Monte Carlo design spans seven peer-interaction intensities, five levels of market depth, and repeated random seeds, with additional population-size robustness tests. The results reveal a pronounced nonlinear transition. At the baseline market depth, increasing the interaction parameter from 0.5 to 1.5 raises return volatility by about 72%, while increasing it to 2.5 raises volatility by roughly sixfold and mispricing by more than elevenfold. The mechanism is a joint expansion of market participation and directional synchronization. Greater market depth lowers the absolute magnitude of the resulting instability, but does not remove the interaction-driven transition. The findings show that peer information is not intrinsically stabilizing: its effect depends on whether local coordination remains dispersed or becomes synchronized enough to overwhelm market-making capacity. JEL classification: C63; D83; G12; G14

articles.title: Molecularly Bridged Gradient Interphases via Hyperbranched-Polyamide- Functionalized Porous CNT Networks in Glass-Fiber/Epoxy Composites
articles.abstract: The interfacial properties of fiber-reinforced composites (FRCs) critically govern their mechanical response and service reliability. However, the intrinsic modulus mismatch between fibers and resin matrices generates steep stress gradients within the interphase, restricting the simultaneous improvement of load-bearing capability and damage tolerance. Herein, a porous carbon nanotube (pCNT) network was constructed on glass fibers and subsequently functionalized with an amino-terminated hyperbranched polyamide (HBP) through EDC/NHS-mediated amination, yielding HBP-functionalized pCNT-coated glass fibers (GF-pCNT-H). HBP was covalently anchored within the carboxylated CNT network, while its flexible branches and remaining reactive groups extended toward the epoxy phase and promoted molecular interpenetration and chain entanglement during curing. HBP therefore acted as a flexible molecular bridge between the rigid CNT scaffold and the compliant epoxy matrix, transforming a nanofiller interlayer governed mainly by physical interactions into a chemically coupled and mechanically continuous gradient interphase. This architecture combined CNT-enabled rigid support, pore anchoring, and mechanical interlocking with HBP-mediated stress relaxation and molecular-level energy dissipation, thereby smoothing the modulus transition across the fiber/matrix interphase. HBP grafting increased the surface roughness by 42.2% relative to GF-pCNT, while the modulus-transition zone broadened from 0.787 to 2.763 µm. Compared with unmodified fibers, GF-pCNT-H exhibited increases of 66.1%, 97.1%, and 73.6% in single-fiber tensile strength, interfacial shear strength, and transverse tensile strength, respectively. Molecular dynamics simulations further revealed enlarged interfacial component overlap, stronger molecular interactions, and delayed tensile failure. This work provides a scalable molecular-bridging strategy for designing high-performance gradient interphases in FRCs.

articles.title: Combining the field line slippage rate with persistent homology: an application to magnetic topology in the magnetosphere
articles.abstract: We present a novel framework for analyzing magnetic topology by combining the field-line slippage rate with persistent homology. The slippage rate provides a local, physically motivated scalar field sensitive to gradients in field-line connectivity, while persistent homology enables the automated extraction of dominant topological features. This approach is particularly efficient for the analysis of large datasets of complex magnetic field configurations. Applied to magnetospheric configurations from two empirical models, the method identifies distinct magnetotail regimes associated with magnetic cusps, X-lines and flux ropes. We show that the location of strong near-Earth slippage rate regions, in both models, is primarily governed by magnetic pressure balance, demonstrating that this combined methodology provides a robust, scalable framework for diagnosing and systematically characterizing complex magnetic structures in large datasets.

articles.title: Physicochemical Characterization of Optimized Pyrolysis-Derived Orange Peel Activated Carbon Modified with a DBU-Based Ionic Liquid
articles.title_zh: 经优化热解制备并用DBU基离子液体改性的橙皮活性炭的物理化学表征
articles.abstract: Activated carbon (AC) derived from biomass has attracted increasing attention as sustainable materials for gas separation applications. In this study, AC was produced from orange peel waste through pyrolysis and subsequently modified with the protic ionic liquid (PIL) 1,8-diazabicyclo[5.4.0]undec-7-enium acetate ([DBUH][Ac]). The effects of pyrolysis temperature, residence time, biomass loading, and particle size on biochar production were optimized via Box–Behnken (BB) and Central Composite Design (CCD) models. The optimum pyrolysis conditions produced biochar yields of 47.18 wt.% and 46.75 wt.% for the BB and CCD models, respectively, together with enhanced carbon content (89.06 wt.%) after chemical activation. The synthesized ILs and resulting AC were characterized by density measurements, Karl Fischer titration, pH analysis, FT-IR, NMR, TGA, BET, XRD, Raman spectroscopy, and SEM. The [DBUH][Ac]-modified AC exhibited the improved physicochemical properties, like high thermal stability, well-developed porous structure, high crystallinity, and extensive surface area (687.18 m2 g− 1). These characteristics indicate that [DBU][Ac] ILs impregnation enhances the structural properties of orange peel-derived AC compared with conventional activation methods. The comprehensive characterization presented in this work provides a foundation for future studies of this material as a potential novel bioadsorbent for biogas purification, particularly for CO2 and H2S removal.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究以橙皮废弃物为原料，通过热解制备活性炭，并采用质子型离子液体[DBUH][Ac]进行改性。作者利用Box-Behnken和中心复合设计优化热解条件，并通过多种表征手段评估材料结构与性质。结果表明，离子液体浸渍可提高橙皮基活性炭的热稳定性、孔结构、结晶性和比表面积，为其用于沼气净化中CO2和H2S去除提供基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生物质衍生活性炭因可作为气体分离应用中的可持续材料而受到越来越多关注。本研究通过热解橙皮废弃物制备活性炭，并随后用质子型离子液体1,8-二氮杂双环[5.4.0]十一碳-7-烯鎓乙酸盐（[DBUH][Ac]）进行改性。通过Box-Behnken（BB）和中心复合设计（CCD）模型，优化了热解温度、停留时间、生物质装填量和粒径对生物炭生产的影响。最佳热解条件分别使BB和CCD模型获得47.18 wt.%和46.75 wt.%的生物炭产率，并在化学活化后实现了提高的碳含量（89.06 wt.%）。采用密度测量、卡尔费休滴定、pH分析、傅里叶变换红外光谱、核磁共振、热重分析、BET、X射线衍射、拉曼光谱和扫描电子显微镜对合成的离子液体及所得活性炭进行了表征。[DBUH][Ac]改性活性炭表现出改善的物理化学性质，如高热稳定性、发育良好的多孔结构、高结晶性以及较大的比表面积（687.18 m2 g−1）。这些特征表明，与传统活化方法相比，[DBU][Ac]离子液体浸渍增强了橙皮衍生活性炭的结构性质。本文所呈现的全面表征为未来研究该材料作为潜在新型生物吸附剂用于沼气净化，特别是用于CO2和H2S去除，奠定了基础。

articles.title: Observation of intrinsic transverse thermoelectricity in anisotropic semimetals
articles.title_zh: 各向异性半金属中本征横向热电效应的观测
articles.abstract: Localized hotspots arising from non-uniform energy dissipation fundamentally limit the performance of nanoscale electronic devices. Thermoelectric (TE) cooling provides a direct means to mitigate this challenge by coupling charge and heat transport. Conventional TE theory, however, typically assumes the Seebeck response as scalar, such that heat flow remains collinear with electrical current and cooling is restricted to the transport direction. Here, we observe a pronounced transverse TE response without external magnetic fields and demonstrate absolute cooling at room temperature in the anisotropic van der Waals semimetals Td-WTe2 and TaIrTe4. Control measurements on isotropic Bi2Te3 devices show that the effect originates from the intrinsic in-plane anisotropy of the Seebeck tensor. By exploiting this tensorial response in asymmetric monolithic TE legs, we achieve local TE cooling that surpasses Joule heating (ΔT_TE-cold≥ΔT_J) in the region of maximal dissipation, driving the hotspot lattice temperature below ambient, with maximum net cooling values of approximately -60 mK in WTe2 and -100 mK in TaIrTe4. These results establish anisotropic thermoelectricity as a zero-field route to directional heat-flow control in solids and suggest a general strategy for site-specific cooling in on-chip devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在无外磁场条件下，于各向异性范德华半金属Td-WTe2和TaIrTe4中观测到显著横向热电响应，并实现室温绝对冷却。对各向同性Bi2Te3器件的对照测量表明，该效应源于塞贝克张量的本征面内各向异性。结果证明各向异性热电性可用于固体中零场定向热流控制，并为片上器件热点定点冷却提供策略。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由非均匀能量耗散产生的局域热点从根本上限制了纳米尺度电子器件的性能。热电冷却通过耦合电荷和热输运，为缓解这一挑战提供了直接手段。然而，传统热电理论通常假定塞贝克响应为标量，使热流与电流保持共线，冷却也被限制在输运方向上。在这里，我们在没有外部磁场的情况下观测到显著的横向热电响应，并在各向异性范德华半金属Td-WTe2和TaIrTe4中证明了室温下的绝对冷却。对各向同性Bi2Te3器件的对照测量表明，该效应源于塞贝克张量的本征面内各向异性。通过在非对称单片热电支腿中利用这种张量响应，我们在最大耗散区域实现了超过焦耳热的局域热电冷却（ΔT_TE-cold≥ΔT_J），使热点晶格温度低于环境温度，在WTe2和TaIrTe4中分别获得约-60 mK和-100 mK的最大净冷却值。这些结果确立了各向异性热电性作为固体中零场定向热流控制途径的地位，并提出了一种用于片上器件特定位点冷却的通用策略。

articles.title: SDF-Guided 3D Reconstruction of Irregular GPR Responses to Interlayer Voids beneath Airport Runways
articles.title_zh: SDF引导的机场跑道下层间空洞不规则GPR响应三维重建
articles.abstract: Interlayer voiding beneath rigid airport runways produces irregular ground-penetrating radar (GPR) responses, while sparse and anisotropic cross-channel sampling makes continuous three-dimensional representation difficult and causes staircase artifacts in direct mask stacking. This study develops an SDF-guided 3D reconstruction workflow for irregular GPR response regions. Eight hundred B-scan images were divided into training, validation and test subsets (640/80/80), with 600 CutMix images added only to training. YOLO11-seg extracted response masks, signed distance fields (SDF) were interpolated between adjacent channels to generate transitional masks, and Marching Cubes extracted the equivalent electromagnetic anomaly body in approximate runway coordinates. On the internal test subset, YOLO11-seg achieved an mIoU of 85.01%, an mPA of 92.46% and a foreground Dice coefficient of 0.84. Inserting three intermediate SDF slices reduced the computational cross-channel interval from 48 to 12 mm and visibly mitigated staircase artifacts. An illustrative FDTD and one field case demonstrated end-to-end workflow execution and approximate coordinate embedding. The reconstructed body represents a continuous GPR-response morphology rather than validated physical void geometry and can support anomaly visualization and candidate-zone planning.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究针对刚性机场跑道下层间空洞引起的不规则探地雷达响应，提出一种SDF引导的三维重建流程。该方法结合YOLO11-seg掩膜提取、相邻通道间符号距离场插值和Marching Cubes表面提取，以生成近似跑道坐标中的连续电磁异常体。测试结果显示分割精度较高，插入中间SDF切片可减轻阶梯伪影，但重建体表示的是连续GPR响应形态而非经验证的真实空洞几何。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 刚性机场跑道下方的层间空洞会产生不规则的探地雷达（GPR）响应，而稀疏且各向异性的跨通道采样使连续三维表示变得困难，并在直接掩膜堆叠中造成阶梯伪影。本研究开发了一种用于不规则GPR响应区域的SDF引导三维重建流程。将800幅B扫描图像划分为训练、验证和测试子集（640/80/80），并仅向训练集中加入600幅CutMix图像。YOLO11-seg提取响应掩膜，符号距离场（SDF）在相邻通道之间插值以生成过渡掩膜，Marching Cubes则在近似跑道坐标中提取等效电磁异常体。在内部测试子集上，YOLO11-seg取得了85.01%的mIoU、92.46%的mPA和0.84的前景Dice系数。插入三个中间SDF切片将计算跨通道间隔从48 mm降低到12 mm，并明显减轻了阶梯伪影。一个示意性的FDTD案例和一个现场案例展示了端到端流程执行和近似坐标嵌入。重建体表示的是连续的GPR响应形态，而不是经验证的物理空洞几何，可支持异常可视化和候选区域规划。

articles.title: Exact quantum spin liquids with topological order on maple-leaf and trellis lattices
articles.title_zh: 枫叶晶格与栅架晶格上具有拓扑序的精确量子自旋液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct spin models with bond-dependent anisotropic interactions on the penta-coordinated maple-leaf and trellis lattices, which yield exact Z₂ quantum spin liquids akin to the Kitaev honeycomb model. We characterize the resulting ground states by their flux sectors, Chern numbers, and topological excitations. Using replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we find that the gauge fluxes are ordered at sufficiently low temperatures such that every unit triangle has ± π/2-flux, where the sign is uniform across the system, and every unit hexagon (square) has 0-flux (π-flux) within the parameter space of interest. We map out the topological phase diagram for each model, which reveals parameter regimes hosting Z₂ and Ising topological orders, and we derive an analytical expression for the mass term of the Majorana fermions, the vanishing of which indicates a transition between these phases. We further establish the correspondence between individual vortices (i.e., flux excitations) and two species of anyons in the dimer limit, overcoming the obstacle faced by degenerate perturbation theory in treating odd-length elementary plaquettes. Interestingly, we find that two dimer limits of the maple-leaf model with distinct assignments of anyon species can be smoothly connected to each other in the vortex-free sector, but they are separated by fermion-gap-closing transitions in certain two-vortex sectors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在五配位枫叶晶格和栅架晶格上构造具有键依赖各向异性相互作用的自旋模型，得到类似Kitaev蜂窝模型的精确Z2量子自旋液体。作者通过通量扇区、陈数和拓扑激发刻画基态，并利用复本交换量子蒙特卡罗确定低温通量有序行为。研究绘制了拓扑相图，识别Z2和Ising拓扑序区域，并分析涡旋与任意子种类的对应关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在五配位的枫叶晶格和栅架晶格上构造了具有键依赖各向异性相互作用的自旋模型，它们产生类似Kitaev蜂窝模型的精确Z2量子自旋液体。我们通过其通量扇区、陈数和拓扑激发来表征所得基态。利用复本交换量子蒙特卡罗模拟，我们发现，在足够低温下规范通量发生有序化，使得每个单位三角形具有±π/2通量，其符号在整个体系中一致，并且在所关注的参数空间内，每个单位六边形（正方形）具有0通量（π通量）。我们为每个模型绘制了拓扑相图，揭示了具有Z2和Ising拓扑序的参数区域，并推导了Majorana费米子质量项的解析表达式，其消失表明这些相之间发生转变。我们进一步建立了单个涡旋（即通量激发）与二聚体极限中两类任意子之间的对应关系，克服了简并微扰理论在处理奇数长度基本斑块时面临的障碍。有趣的是，我们发现枫叶晶格模型中具有不同任意子种类指派的两个二聚体极限可以在无涡旋扇区中平滑连接，但它们在某些双涡旋扇区中被费米子能隙闭合转变所分隔。

articles.title: Fukui-Kawakami chains: spectrum and hidden mathfrakgl(1|1)-symmetry
articles.title_zh: Fukui-Kawakami链：谱与隐藏的mathfrakgl(1|1)对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fukui and Kawakami showed that the trigonometric Haldane--Shastry (HS) spin chain can be deformed by introducing twisted boundary conditions. In this work we revisit the resulting twisted HS chains, which we call Fukui--Kawakami (FK) chains. We analyse their spectra in dependence of the twist parameter, utilising a direct connection with the (untwisted) HS chain. This allows us to explain why part of the spectrum can be described by Fukui and Kawakami's twisted Bethe equations, and can be constructed from Yangian highest weight states. These states can be labelled by combinatorial data called `motifs', as in the HS chain, which cover some of the (deformed) descendants. We furthermore show that there are other descendants which do not follow from these Bethe equations, but whose energy can be described as a sum of two single-particle energies, suggesting additional hidden symmetries. We then focus on the special case of antiperiodic boundary conditions, and show that this chain coincides with the `minimally polarised' long-range model recently introduced by Basu-Mallick, Finkel, and González-López. Remarkably, this connection implies that the antiperiodic chain has a hidden mathfrakgl(1|1)-symmetry, which we use to relate the HS motifs to their `supersymmetric' mathfrakgl(1|1) counterparts.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新考察由Fukui和Kawakami通过扭曲边界条件得到的三角Haldane-Shastry自旋链变形，并称之为Fukui-Kawakami链。作者利用其与未扭曲HS链的直接联系，分析能谱随扭曲参数的变化，并解释部分谱为何可由扭曲Bethe方程和Yangian最高权态描述。研究还发现反周期边界条件下该链与近期提出的“最小极化”长程模型一致，从而具有隐藏的mathfrakgl(1|1)对称性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Fukui和Kawakami表明，可以通过引入扭曲边界条件来变形三角Haldane-Shastry（HS）自旋链。在这项工作中，我们重新考察所得的扭曲HS链，并将其称为Fukui-Kawakami（FK）链。我们利用其与（未扭曲）HS链的直接联系，分析它们的谱对扭曲参数的依赖性。这使我们能够解释为什么谱的一部分可以由Fukui和Kawakami的扭曲Bethe方程描述，并可由Yangian最高权态构造。这些态可以像HS链中一样由称为“motifs”的组合数据标记，并覆盖一些（变形的）后裔态。我们进一步表明，还存在其他并非来自这些Bethe方程的后裔态，但其能量可以描述为两个单粒子能量之和，这暗示存在额外的隐藏对称性。随后我们聚焦于反周期边界条件这一特殊情形，并表明该链与Basu-Mallick、Finkel和González-López近期引入的“最小极化”长程模型一致。值得注意的是，这一联系意味着反周期链具有隐藏的mathfrakgl(1|1)对称性，我们利用该对称性将HS motifs与其“超对称”mathfrakgl(1|1)对应物联系起来。

articles.title: Speed-quality tradeoff in a physical model of molecular sorting
articles.title_zh: 分子分选物理模型中的速度-质量权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04380v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Eukaryotic cells rely on membrane-mediated processes to compartmentalize biomolecules, counteracting diffusion-driven homogenization. These processes involve the selective sorting and packing of molecules into lipid vesicles, which are then dispatched to appropriate intracellular destinations. Previous works introduced an abstract statistical physics framework for studying this molecular distillation process, where the membrane was treated as static and the focus was on molecular aggregation and extraction. Here, we extend this framework to explicitly incorporate dynamic membrane behavior, including bending, curvature generation, and changes in membrane size due to vesicle fusion and fission events. Sorting domains drive membrane curvature, leading to vesicle formation, detachment, and a molecular distillation process that alters membrane size. Using mesoscopic modeling and numerical tools, we investigate the resulting interplay between membrane mechanics and molecular sorting. We determine a well-defined parameter region where vesicle fission and efficient molecular sorting occur, controlled by membrane rigidity, spontaneous curvature, and pressure difference across the membrane. We further identify a trade-off between speed and quality of molecular distillation: parameters that accelerate vesicle formation tend to reduce the quality of distillation, and vice versa. We propose maximization of the rate of negative entropy production as a natural criterion to optimally balance these competing effects. In this context, optimal parameters emerge naturally from the coupled dynamics of molecular aggregation and membrane mechanics, suggesting a possible strategy for cellular sorting systems to strike an efficient balance between rapid vesicle formation and high sorting quality.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究扩展了分子蒸馏的统计物理框架，将膜弯曲、曲率生成以及囊泡融合和裂变引起的膜尺寸变化纳入模型。作者通过介观建模和数值工具分析膜力学与分子分选之间的耦合，并确定了囊泡裂变与高效分选发生的参数区域。结果揭示了分子蒸馏速度与质量之间的权衡，并提出以负熵产生速率最大化作为平衡两者的自然准则。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 真核细胞依赖膜介导过程来区室化生物分子，从而抵消扩散驱动的均质化。这些过程涉及将分子选择性分选并包装进脂质囊泡，随后将其派送到适当的细胞内目的地。以往工作引入了一个用于研究这一分子蒸馏过程的抽象统计物理框架，其中膜被视为静态，重点放在分子聚集和提取上。在这里，我们扩展这一框架，以显式纳入动态膜行为，包括弯曲、曲率生成，以及由囊泡融合和裂变事件引起的膜尺寸变化。分选结构域驱动膜曲率，导致囊泡形成、脱离以及改变膜尺寸的分子蒸馏过程。利用介观建模和数值工具，我们研究了膜力学与分子分选之间由此产生的相互作用。我们确定了一个明确的参数区域，在其中会发生囊泡裂变和高效分子分选，该区域由膜刚性、自发曲率以及跨膜压力差控制。我们进一步识别出分子蒸馏速度与质量之间的权衡：加速囊泡形成的参数往往会降低蒸馏质量，反之亦然。我们提出，将负熵产生速率最大化作为自然准则，以最优地平衡这些相互竞争的效应。在这一背景下，最优参数自然地从分子聚集与膜力学的耦合动力学中涌现出来，这提示细胞分选系统可能采用某种策略，在快速囊泡形成与高分选质量之间实现有效平衡。

articles.title: Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
articles.title_zh: 利用可变块稀疏矩阵库加速原子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04397v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern atomistic simulations increasingly employ localized orbitals to represent quantum operators, yielding sparse block matrices whose block shapes vary with chemical species and basis choice. Conventional scalar sparse formats store the entries of each block individually, obscuring this local structure and limiting the use of efficient block algorithms. We present VBCSR, a distributed sparse matrix library that preserves variable-size atomic blocks and accelerates the core linear algebra of large-scale atomistic simulations. A unified interface automatically maps scalar, uniform-basis, and multispecies operators to compressed sparse row (CSR), block sparse row (BSR), or variable-block compressed sparse row (VBCSR). Our advanced acceleration method groups blocks of equal shape and dispatches them to optimized dense kernels. In the reported benchmarks, VBCSR outperforms the tested Python-accessible reference implementations for several block-sparse benchmarks. We further demonstrate VBCSR in an InP nanoparticle application containing more than (10⁶) atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出VBCSR，一种保留可变尺寸原子块结构的分布式稀疏矩阵库，用于加速大规模原子模拟中的核心线性代数计算。该库可将标量、统一基组和多物种算符自动映射到CSR、BSR或VBCSR格式，并通过按相同块形状分组调用优化稠密核实现加速。基准测试显示VBCSR在多个块稀疏任务中优于测试的Python可访问参考实现，并被展示于超过10⁶个原子的InP纳米颗粒应用中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代原子模拟越来越多地采用局域轨道来表示量子算符，从而产生稀疏块矩阵，其块形状随化学物种和基组选择而变化。传统标量稀疏格式逐项存储每个块的元素，掩盖了这种局域结构，并限制了高效块算法的使用。我们提出VBCSR，这是一种分布式稀疏矩阵库，能够保留可变尺寸原子块，并加速大规模原子模拟的核心线性代数。一种统一接口会自动将标量、统一基组和多物种算符映射到压缩稀疏行（CSR）、块稀疏行（BSR）或可变块压缩稀疏行（VBCSR）。我们的高级加速方法将相同形状的块分组，并将其分派给优化的稠密核。在所报告的基准测试中，VBCSR在若干块稀疏基准中优于所测试的可通过Python访问的参考实现。我们进一步在一个包含超过（10⁶）个原子的InP纳米颗粒应用中展示了VBCSR。

articles.title: Triboelectrification of a dense metal-organic framework for resilient mechanical energy harvesters
articles.title_zh: 用于韧性机械能量收集器的致密金属有机框架摩擦起电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) incorporating metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) have largely been designed around porous architectures, based on the assumption that high internal surface area is the primary driver for triboelectric enhancement. Herein, we demonstrate that a dense, nominally nonporous MOF called ZIF-zni can instead function as an effective high-loading filler within a tribopositive polyurethane (PU) matrix, offering a design strategy for harnessing interfacial electromechanical effects. A 20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU composite delivers an output voltage of 470+/-15 V and a peak power density of 1.31+/-0.03 W m-2 against polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS). The device exhibits stable performance over ~94,000 cycles under a contact force of ~100 N, and it remains operational under higher impact beyond 500 N. This concept enables the demonstration of a proof-of-concept triboelectric floor tile. Combined experimental and theoretical studies indicate that the performance enhancement arises from favourable interfacial polarization, reduced dielectric screening, and surface accessible ZIF-zni rich domains, rather than porosity alone. These features are accompanied by reduced work of adhesion and modified surface roughness, hence improving contact electrification. These findings establish dense MOFs as an effective triboelectric filler and identify interfacial electronic structure and polarization as key design parameters for engineering mechanical energy harvesters and self-powered sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，致密、名义上非多孔的MOF材料ZIF-zni可作为摩擦正性聚氨酯基体中的高负载填料，用于提升摩擦纳米发电机性能。20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU复合材料在与PDMS接触时实现高输出电压和功率密度，并在长循环和高冲击条件下保持工作。实验与理论结果表明，性能提升主要来自有利的界面极化、较低介电屏蔽和表面可接近的ZIF-zni富集区域，而非仅由孔隙率决定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 掺入金属有机框架（MOF）的摩擦纳米发电机（TENG）很大程度上围绕多孔结构进行设计，其依据是假定高内部表面积是摩擦电增强的主要驱动因素。在本文中，我们证明一种称为ZIF-zni的致密、名义上非多孔MOF反而可以在摩擦正性聚氨酯（PU）基体中作为有效的高负载填料发挥作用，为利用界面机电效应提供了一种设计策略。20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU复合材料在与聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）接触时输出电压为470+/-15 V，峰值功率密度为1.31+/-0.03 W m-2。该器件在约100 N接触力下经过约94,000次循环仍表现出稳定性能，并且在超过500 N的更高冲击下仍能工作。这一概念使得验证性摩擦电地砖得以展示。结合实验和理论研究表明，性能提升源于有利的界面极化、降低的介电屏蔽以及表面可接近的ZIF-zni富集区域，而不是仅仅源于孔隙率。这些特征伴随着黏附功降低和表面粗糙度改变，从而改善了接触起电。这些发现确立了致密MOF作为有效摩擦电填料的地位，并将界面电子结构和极化确定为工程化机械能量收集器和自供能传感器的关键设计参数。

articles.title: From Single-Chain Dynamics to Structure Formation: Dynamic Self-Consistent Field Theory and Molecular Dynamics of (Co)polymer Melts across Entanglement Regimes
articles.title_zh: 从单链动力学到结构形成：缠结区域内（共）聚合物熔体的动态自洽场理论与分子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dynamic self-consistent field theory (DSCFT) provides an efficient continuum framework for studying structure formation in inhomogeneous polymer systems, but its predictive accuracy depends on the choice of the nonlocal mobilities. Here, we construct mobility functions for moderately and strongly entangled homopolymer and diblock copolymer systems from the relaxation dynamics of single-chain structure factors, based on molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the Kremer-Grest model and analytical reptation theory. Single- chain mobilities are combined such that the resulting DSCFT accounts for the dependence of fluxes on local chain densities. The theory is then applied to the spinodal decomposition of symmetric homopolymer blends and diblock copolymer melts following a quench into the (micro)phase-separation regime. Predictions of DSCFT are systematically compared with MD simulations. Mobility functions derived from single-chain dynamics are found to reproduce the kinetics of structure formation more accurately than conventional Debye-type mobilities. We additionally investigate the influence of adding stochastic currents (noise) that are correlated according to the fluctuation-dissipation relation. At low noise levels, they enable the generation of equilibrium initial states and facilitate defect annealing. At high noise levels, however, nonolinear effects lead to discrepancies between DSCFT and MD simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于Kremer-Grest模型的分子动力学模拟和解析爬行理论，从单链结构因子的弛豫动力学构建中等与强缠结均聚物和二嵌段共聚物体系的迁移率函数。作者将该动态自洽场理论应用于淬火后均聚物共混物和二嵌段共聚物熔体的相分离结构形成，并与MD模拟系统比较。结果显示，源自单链动力学的迁移率比传统Debye型迁移率更准确，同时噪声在低强度下有益于初态生成和缺陷退火，高强度下会引起偏差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动态自洽场理论（DSCFT）为研究非均匀聚合物体系中的结构形成提供了一种高效的连续介质框架，但其预测准确性取决于非局域迁移率的选择。在这里，我们基于Kremer-Grest模型的分子动力学（MD）模拟和解析爬行理论，从单链结构因子的弛豫动力学出发，为中等缠结和强缠结的均聚物及二嵌段共聚物体系构建迁移率函数。单链迁移率被组合起来，使所得DSCFT能够考虑通量对局部链密度的依赖。随后，该理论被应用于对称均聚物共混物和二嵌段共聚物熔体在淬火进入（微）相分离区域后的旋节线分解。DSCFT的预测与MD模拟进行了系统比较。研究发现，由单链动力学推导出的迁移率函数比传统Debye型迁移率更准确地再现结构形成动力学。我们还研究了加入随机流（噪声）的影响，这些随机流按照涨落-耗散关系相关。在低噪声水平下，它们能够生成平衡初始态并促进缺陷退火。然而，在高噪声水平下，非线性效应会导致DSCFT与MD模拟之间出现差异。

articles.title: Structural tuning of reduced exciton mass in layered HOIP compounds: Causation vs. correlation
articles.title_zh: 层状HOIP化合物中约化激子质量的结构调控：因果关系与相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04558v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reduced exciton mass (μ) was recently reported to correlate strongly with a framework distortion in a series of nine single-layer (2D) metal-halide perovskite (HOIP) compounds. Specifically, μ was observed to increase in tandem with an alternating PbI4 octahedral tilt about an in-plane axis. In this work, we use group representation theory to decompose the observed framework distortions into displacive symmetry modes of a common high-symmetry parent framework. We find that all nine distorted frameworks involve linear combinations of the same six symmetry modes, which have been reported to contribute to the framework distortions of a wide range of HOIP compounds. We show that these modes have highly correlated impacts on the band structure. To differentiate causation from correlation, we vary the amplitude of each mode independently and use density-functional theory to determine the resulting electronic band structures, from which μ is extracted. We find that bond-transverse displacements of the equatorial halide atoms increase μ, while bond-transverse displacements of the apical halide atoms decrease it. Bond-axis displacements appear to have little or no effect on μ. Our results demonstrate three new structure-property relationships, revealing a promising new avenue for exciton engineering in layered perovskite materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对九种单层金属卤化物钙钛矿中约化激子质量与框架畸变的强相关性，利用群表示理论将畸变分解为共同高对称母框架的位移对称模式。作者发现这些框架均由相同六种对称模式的线性组合构成，且这些模式对能带结构影响高度相关。通过独立调节各模式振幅并进行密度泛函理论计算，研究区分了因果关系与相关性，并提出新的结构-性质关系用于层状钙钛矿激子工程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近有报道指出，在一系列九种单层（2D）金属卤化物钙钛矿（HOIP）化合物中，约化激子质量（μ）与一种框架畸变强相关。具体而言，观察到μ随着围绕面内轴的交替PbI4八面体倾斜而增加。在这项工作中，我们使用群表示理论，将观测到的框架畸变分解为共同高对称母框架的位移对称模式。我们发现，所有九种畸变框架都涉及相同六种对称模式的线性组合，而这些模式据报道会贡献于范围广泛的HOIP化合物的框架畸变。我们表明，这些模式对能带结构的影响高度相关。为了区分因果关系与相关性，我们独立改变每种模式的振幅，并使用密度泛函理论确定由此产生的电子能带结构，再从中提取μ。我们发现，赤道卤素原子的键横向位移会增加μ，而顶端卤素原子的键横向位移会降低μ。键轴位移似乎对μ几乎没有或完全没有影响。我们的结果展示了三种新的结构-性质关系，揭示了层状钙钛矿材料中激子工程的一条有前景的新途径。

articles.title: Initialization-free ultralow-power programmable spin-orbit torque logic devices enabled by chirally asymmetric switching
articles.title_zh: 由手性非对称翻转实现的免初始化超低功耗可编程自旋轨道矩逻辑器件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04594v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin logic is of great interest for the development of high-performance, non-Von Neumann artificial intelligence chips. Of particular advantage is the programmable spin-orbit torque logic that can achieve the complete set of the 16 Boolean logic operations within a single device in an initialization-free, low-power, and scalable manner, which is, however, a challenge despite remarkable efforts over more than two decades. Here, utilizing chirally asymmetric switching, we demonstrate an initialization-free, low-power, programmable spin-orbit torque logic device that is capable of the complete set of 16 Boolean logic operations within a single device with only three inputs and ultralow power of < 1 fJ/bit. We also propose the first initialization-free, all-electrical spin-based cascading computing devices, including a half adder, a three-level full adder, a two-level full adder, and a Transfer/NOT selector. These compact and scalable computing devices are enabled by the chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque switching of a Ta/FeCoB bilayer with a significant perpendicular Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction field. These results pave an intriguing way for the development of next-generation high-performance large-scale in-memory computing chips based on chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque switching.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用手性非对称翻转，展示了一种免初始化、低功耗、可编程自旋轨道矩逻辑器件。该器件仅用三个输入即可在单个器件内实现完整16种布尔逻辑运算，功耗低于1 fJ/bit。作者还提出了首批免初始化全电自旋级联计算器件，展示其在下一代大规模存内计算芯片中的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋逻辑对于开发高性能、非冯诺依曼人工智能芯片具有重要意义。尤其具有优势的是可编程自旋轨道矩逻辑，它能够以免初始化、低功耗且可扩展的方式在单个器件内实现完整的16种布尔逻辑运算；然而，尽管二十多年来付出了显著努力，这仍然是一个挑战。在这里，利用手性非对称翻转，我们展示了一种免初始化、低功耗、可编程自旋轨道矩逻辑器件，该器件仅凭三个输入即可在单个器件内完成全部16种布尔逻辑运算，并具有< 1 fJ/bit的超低功耗。我们还提出了首批免初始化、全电自旋级联计算器件，包括半加器、三级全加器、二级全加器以及Transfer/NOT选择器。这些紧凑且可扩展的计算器件由Ta/FeCoB双层中的手性非对称自旋轨道矩翻转实现，该双层具有显著的垂直Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用场。这些结果为基于手性非对称自旋轨道矩翻转开发下一代高性能大规模存内计算芯片铺平了一条引人关注的道路。

articles.title: 4 MV/cm (010) β-Ga₂O₃ Heterojunction Diodes Realized by Low-Damage e-Beam NiOₓ Interlayers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the utilization of a low-damage e-beam NiOₓ deposition process to realize field-plated heterojunction diodes (FP-HJDs) on (010) β-Ga₂O₃ films with high critical breakdown field strengths beyond 4 MV/cm and power figure of merits (PFOM) of >1 GW/cm². Diodes were fabricated on a 2.67 × 10¹⁶ cm⁻³ intentionally doped 6.2 μm thick epitaxial layer grown by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) on a conductive Sn-doped β-Ga₂O₃ (010) substrate using TMGa, O₂, Ar carrier gas, and SiH₄ as the silicon dopant source. The mesa etched FP-HJD devices utilized a thin 7 nm e-beam NiOₓ interlayer before the sputtered NiOₓ layers to eliminate the effects of sputter-induced ion damage on the (010) epilayers. Current-Voltage measurements resulted in a forward current density of 700 A/cm² at 4 V, HJD ideality factor of 1.29, a Vbᵢ of 2 V, rectification ratio of 10¹¹, and a differential specific on resistance (Rₒₙ,ₛₚ) value of 2.36 mΩ × cm². Breakdown of the (010) FP-HJDs was 1.64 kV, leading to a parallel plane electric field at breakdown (E||,ₘₐₓ) of 4.02 MV/cm and a PFOM of 1.14 GW/cm², which is a state-of-the-art result for diodes on MOCVD-grown (010) drift layers.

articles.title: Interlayer Exciton Condensate Stiffness Is Non-Monotonic in Quantum Metric
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying the origin of the superfluid stiffness of electron-electron and electron-hole pair condensates is an important issue in flat-band physics. Here, we study the stiffness of bilayer exciton condensates using exact diagonalization and realistic Coulomb interactions across a wide variety of flat Chern band systems, including Landau levels, mixed Landau levels, and moiré bands. We find that stiffness is non-monotonic in the trace of the quantum metric and that it develops peaks when the band wavefunctions are engineered to be similar to those of Landau levels. The stiffness predicted by mean-field theory agrees quantitatively with exact diagonalization in these optimal cases, but systematically overestimates it otherwise. Flat bands with identical quantum geometry tensors can exhibit substantial differences in stiffness. The stiffness of condensates formed between moiré flat bands, which typically have strong variations in Berry curvature and quantum metric across their Brillouin zones, tends to be larger when the bands have non-zero Chern numbers and can be larger than that of Landau levels. Our results reveal a behavior that is richer than that suggested by simple geometric bounds and provide new guiding principles for the design of robust flat-band condensates with large superfluid stiffness.

articles.title: Spin-Charge Subordination in the Infinite-U SU(N) Hubbard Chain
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We obtain the exact full counting statistics of charge and flavor transport in the one-dimensional infinite-U SU(N) Hubbard model. The no-passing constraint freezes the ordered flavor sequence while the particle coordinates evolve as free spinless fermions. Consequently, charge transfer is governed by a free-fermion determinant, whereas flavor transfer is exactly subordinated to the number of particles crossing the observation cut. For an arbitrary traceless Cartan generator this yields an exact relation between the charge and flavor cumulants. The complete asymptotic flavor distribution is a universal non-Gaussian M-Wright law. Together, these results establish spin--charge subordination as a kinematic mechanism for anomalously slow internal-state transport in one-dimensional impenetrable quantum gases.

articles.title: The elasticity of semiflexible polymers with reversible spontaneous curvature in two dimensions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many semiflexible filaments exhibit structural asymmetries that lead to a curved ground state (curvature in the absence of thermal fluctuations, external forces, or torques). This property is known as spontaneous curvature. Many semiflexible polymers can reversibly develop spontaneous curvature through internal conformational transitions or through transient interactions with their molecular environment. In this article, we show that such reversible spontaneous curvature, even in the absence of transitions in the value of the bending stiffness, provides a minimal mechanism for ensemble-dependent elasticity. We formulate an analytically tractable two-state modified wormlike-chain model in two dimensions, in which an uncurved state (without spontaneous curvature) competes with a curved state (possessing spontaneous curvature). The transition is controlled by an activation energy. Within the weak-bending approximation, we obtain the Gibbs and Helmholtz partition functions for a stretched filament with reversible constant (uniform along the backbone) or sinusoidal spontaneous curvature and for a grafted bistable filament driven either by an end torque or a bending force. Stretching or bending induces a crossover from spontaneous-curvature-dominated to entropic elasticity. We show how the elastic response differs in the two ensembles (Gibbs vs Helmholtz). In addition, we consider the case where the curved state is also characterized by a higher value of the bending stiffness. In that case, a reentrant transition is possible as we stretch the bistable filament.

articles.title: Liquid-liquid phase separation precedes crystallization in supercooled water-glycerol solutions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the structural evolution of supercooled water-glycerol solutions is important for cryopreservation, yet distinguishing liquid-state transformations from ice crystallization remains challenging. Here, we investigate a deeply supercooled water-glycerol solution by X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) in ultra-small-angle X-ray scattering (USAXS) geometry, combined with wide-angle X-ray scattering (WAXS). This combination simultaneously captures the structural and dynamical evolution of the supercooled liquid upon quenching to cryogenic temperatures (172 K). We observe discontinuous changes in the liquid structure on molecular length scales and formation of microscale domains. The dynamics slow down during this stage and exhibit hyper-diffusive, ballistic-like relaxation. This transformation precedes ice crystallization, which we identify from the emergence of ice Bragg peaks in WAXS, allowing the two processes to be temporally separated. Phase-field (Cahn-Hilliard) simulations qualitatively reproduce the experimental observations and show that a spinodal-decomposition scenario is consistent with the measured scattering evolution. These findings are consistent with a liquid-liquid phase separation scenario preceding ice crystallization and provide a route to disentangle the two processes in supercooled aqueous systems.

articles.title: Nonreciprocal plasmonic response of drift-biased two-dimensional metals
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a nonlocal electrodynamic framework for drift-biased two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) with Dirac (linear) and parabolic (quadratic) dispersions, deriving closed-form drift-dependent conductivity tensors from the Boltzmann transport equation. We obtain the plasmon dispersion and near-field emission of a point dipole, revealing nonreciprocal propagation in both systems. At equal drift parameter, the parabolic 2DEG exhibits stronger nonreciprocity than the Dirac system, although we find that a larger drift parameter does not by itself produce stronger nonreciprocity: the response is set by the interplay of drift and plasmon nonlocality. As such, the combination of strong nonlocality and experimentally accessible drift velocities of semiconductor 2DEGs identifies parabolic systems as a promising platform for tunable, nonreciprocal plasmonics.

articles.title: ANT:UI: An interactive 3D tool for preparing ANT.Gaussian molecular junction geometries
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: ANT.UI is a Python graphical interface that automates the construction of molecular-junction geometries for NEGF-DFT quantum transport calculations. Through a real-time 3D viewer, users interactively position electrodes and molecules and generate complete, ready-to-run input files for Gaussian and ANT.Gaussian without manual scripting. Dedicated Pull, Grid, and Rotation assistants further automate electrode-pulling sequences, surface scans, and step-wise rotation studies, with optional geometry-optimisation chaining across each sequence. By replacing a process that previously demanded days of custom scripting with a point-and-click workflow, ANT.UI accelerates research in theoretical molecular electronics and lowers the barrier to entry for new users. The software also exports all constructed geometries in standard XYZ format, allowing direct reuse in molecular dynamics codes or third-party visualization tools without manual reformatting.

articles.title: Influence of dislocation density on the tribological response in oxides: case study on SrTiO3
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most ceramics suffer from brittle surface damage and cracking when small particles slide across the surface under low load. Microscratching tests are a useful technique to mimic this loading scenario while retaining the material's deformation history; however, the impact of pre-seeded dislocations, which can significantly facilitate plastic deformation, has not been explored in ceramics. Here, the influence of mechanically seeded dislocations on the microscratching response of oxides is investigated using a model perovskite, SrTiO3. First, various dislocation densities over four orders of magnitude are introduced via room-temperature cyclic Brinell indenter scratching. Subsequently, load-ramped microscratching tests are performed within the pristine and dislocation-seeded regions using a nominally 30 μm spherical diamond tip. On the reference pristine surface, we observe a clear transition from elastic to elasto-plastic deformation, followed by median/radial cracking at higher loads. In contrast, pre-seeded dislocations, accompanied by residual compressive stresses, suppress elastic deformation and lead to median/radial crack shortening and subsequent transition to a partial cone crack. The subsurface cracks are characterized by 3D Nano-CT. The changes in crack geometry, with and without dislocations, were described using the Lawn-Evans-Marshall and Lawn-Wiederhorn-Roberts models. These findings provide direct evidence of dislocation-regulated near-surface damage tolerance, with general applicability to other plastically deformable oxides.

articles.title: Anharmonic Lattice Dynamics and Anisotropic Electron-Phonon Coupling in Quasi-1-Dimensional Charge Density Wave Ta2NiSe7
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The microscopic origin of charge density wave formation in quasi one dimensional Ta2NiSe7 remains actively debated, particularly regarding the relative contributions of Fermi surface nesting, electron phonon coupling, and lattice instabilities. Here, we combine temperature and orientation dependent polarized Raman spectroscopy with first principles calculations to uncover the anisotropic electronic and lattice interactions governing the CDW state in Ta2NiSe7. Heat capacity and electrical transport measurements identify an incommensurate CDW transition at 61 K. Raman spectroscopy reveals pronounced in plane anisotropy, with e ph coupling strength along intrachain b axis exceeding five times that along interchain c axis, whereas lattice anharmonicity is enhanced by threefold along c axis. First principles calculations identify Ta2 Se octahedral vibrations and Ta Se electronic states near the Fermi level as dominant channels mediating the anisotropic e ph interaction. Exceptionally strong and directional e ph coupling along b axis establishes lattice driven electronic instability as the primary mechanism underlying CDW modulation and highlights the dominance of intrachain interactions in strongly coupled Ta2NiSe7. Despite this strong coupling, the CDW remains incommensurate, indicating that lattice anharmonicity provides an additional degree of freedom. Enhanced anharmonicity along c axis suggests that anisotropic phonon phonon interactions reshape the free energy landscape and contribute to stabilizing incommensurate phase. These findings reveal a cooperative interplay between anisotropic e ph coupling and lattice anharmonicity in governing CDW formation in low dimensional quantum materials.
articles.focus_summary: 论文结合偏振拉曼光谱、输运和热容测量以及第一性原理计算，研究准一维 Ta2NiSe7 中电荷密度波形成的微观机制。结果表明，沿链方向的电子-声子耦合显著强于层间方向，Ta-Se 八面体振动和费米能级附近电子态是主要耦合通道，支持晶格驱动的电子不稳定性机制。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的第一性原理计算、电子-声子耦合、晶格动力学、磁性和电荷密度波材料研究直接相关。其对各向异性电子-声子耦合和非谐晶格效应的分析，可为研究低维材料中的结构相变、输运和声子重整化提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步结合非谐声子、有限温度分子动力学和 Wannier 插值，定量研究电子-声子耦合对电荷密度波转变温度及输运性质的影响。也可探索应变、层间堆垛或缺陷对 Ta2NiSe7 电荷密度波和各向异性耦合的调控。

articles.title: Dynamical Reduction of Two Series Josephson Junctions to a Synthetic High-Transparency Josephson Element
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two conventional Josephson junctions connected in series can reproduce, in the static limit in which the currents through the capacitive and resistive channels are negligible, the current-phase relation of a single effective weak link with tunable transparency. Therefore, the two-junction series can be treated as a single synthetic high-transparency element. Here, we investigate to what extent this mapping remains valid under finite-frequency drive and retaining the junctions' resistive and capacitive terms. The full resistively and capacitively shunted junction equations are compared with an effective synthetic element with tunable transparency that retains the synthetic tunable-transparency current-phase relation together with effective capacitive and dissipative terms, thus reducing the two second order degree of freedom system to a single second order degree of freedom. The resulting single-element dynamics is compared with the complete two-junction system under ac excitation. The agreement is quantified through a normalized root-mean-square error between the full and effective voltage waveforms. A broad low-error region is found at low drive frequency, while pronounced deviations emerge as the drive frequency approaches the relevant plasma-frequency scale and at larger drive amplitudes. The results provide a quantitative dynamical criterion for using the reduced single-element description of a synthetic high-transparency Josephson element in superconducting circuits.

articles.title: Diffusion under competing bulk and surface stopping mechanisms
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate reflected diffusion in a bounded domain subject to two independent, competing stopping mechanisms: an exponentially distributed bulk lifetime of rate p and a surface reaction triggered when the boundary local time exceeds an independent exponential threshold of rate q. Denoting by T the stopping time and by L the acquired boundary local time at stopping, we derive their marginal distributions, joint Laplace transform, and complete hierarchy of mixed moments. These statistics are determined by the splitting probability φ that surface reaction occurs before bulk decay. In particular, we establish the identity pexpectT+qexpectL=1 and show that the cumulative risk pT+qL is exponentially distributed with unit rate. We further obtain equivalent representations of φ in terms of the Robin-Laplacian and the generalized Steklov spectra. Explicit results for a three-dimensional ball reveal how competing rates p,q control φ and the (T,L) statistics. Monte Carlo simulations test the universal cumulative-risk law.

articles.title: Molecular interfacial rheology: Lipid membrane shear viscosity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a method to extract the shear viscosity of a lipid membrane from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. The method characterizes the rheology of general interfacial systems embedded in three-dimensional media; we term it molecular interfacial rheology. In our simulations the planar bilayer and surrounding water are confined between solid, parallel walls. Following Onsager's regression hypothesis, membrane and water fluctuations are assumed to relax according to the coupled continuum-mechanical equations governing the confined system---which predict that the membrane transverse velocity autocorrelation function (TVACF) decays exponentially, at a rate set by the membrane and water viscosities. The measured TVACF, however, exhibits damped oscillations followed by a slowly decaying tail. We reconcile these behaviors using the Mori--Zwanzig formalism, and extract the wavevector-dependent membrane viscosity from the time-integral of the TVACF. Results from theory and simulations agree over a decade of wavevectors, and extrapolating to long wavelengths yields shear viscosities ranging from 0.064 to 0.18 pN*us/nm across two representative single-component, fluid-phase bilayers. Our results are corroborated by nonequilibrium simulations where a spatially varying in-plane body force is applied to lipid molecules, thus validating the framework of molecular interfacial rheology.

articles.title: Non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes: Exceptional points, Anomalous relaxation, Pseudo-equilibrium and Boundary refrigeration
articles.title_zh: 非互易相互作用的奥恩斯坦–乌伦贝克过程：例外点、异常弛豫、伪平衡与边界制冷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05391v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-reciprocal interactions are ubiquitous in active, biological, and disordered systems, generically driving them out of equilibrium. Here, we introduce a hierarchy of non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (NROU) models governed by a tunable non-reciprocity parameter g. At a special point g=g^*, the drift matrix becomes non-diagonalizable, realizing exceptional points (EP's) of different orders, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors simultaneously coalesce. The hierarchy encompasses non-reciprocally coupled dimers, their disordered counterparts, and a many-body chain exactly mapping onto the paradigmatic Hatano-Nelson model in the arena of non-Hermitian quantum systems. For the disordered model, we show that the distribution of the EP location g^* across disorder realizations develops a universal edge singularity precisely at the clean-system EP, and is manifestly non-self-averaging. Across all models, we find that at the EP, the usual exponential relaxation of the autocorrelation and covariance functions is dressed by a polynomial-in-time prefactor whose degree is set by the order of the EP and whose detailed structure encodes the spatial architecture of the chain. At complete asymmetry, the many-body chain exhibits ``pseudo-equilibrium'': its steady-state distribution factorizes into equilibrium-like single-particle measures despite a nonzero steady-state current. Moreover, the N-particle interacting system decomposes into N/2 independent complex OU processes. Finally, using the Harada-Sasa relation, we obtain a closed-form expression for the total steady-state heat dissipation and uncover a boundary refrigeration effect, in which the boundary particles switch from acting as a hot to a cold reservoir as the non-reciprocity is tuned.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了由可调非互易参数控制的非互易耦合奥恩斯坦–乌伦贝克模型层级，并研究例外点处的动力学与稳态性质。研究发现，例外点会使相关函数出现由例外点阶数决定的多项式修正，并在完全非对称时产生具有非零稳态电流的伪平衡。作者还推导了稳态热耗散，并揭示了边界粒子随非互易性调节由热源转变为冷源的边界制冷效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非互易相互作用普遍存在于活性系统、生物系统和无序系统中，并通常会使系统偏离平衡态。本文引入了一组由可调非互易参数 g 控制的非互易相互作用奥恩斯坦–乌伦贝克模型层级。在特殊点 g=g^* 处，漂移矩阵变得不可对角化，从而实现不同阶数的例外点，在这些点上本征值和本征矢同时合并。该模型层级包括非互易耦合的二聚体、其无序对应模型，以及一个能够精确映射到非厄米量子系统领域中典型 Hatano–Nelson 模型的多体链。对于无序模型，作者证明了不同无序实现中例外点位置 g^* 的分布会在无序洁净系统的例外点处形成普适的边缘奇异性，并且表现出明显的非自平均性。在所有模型中，作者发现例外点处自相关函数和协方差函数通常具有的指数弛豫会被时间的多项式前因子修饰，该前因子的次数由例外点的阶数决定，而其具体结构则编码了链的空间构型。在完全非对称情况下，多体链表现出伪平衡：尽管存在非零稳态电流，其稳态分布仍可分解为类似平衡态的单粒子测度的乘积。此外，含 N 个粒子的相互作用系统可分解为 N/2 个相互独立的复数奥恩斯坦–乌伦贝克过程。最后，作者利用 Harada–Sasa 关系得到了总稳态热耗散的闭式表达式，并发现了一种边界制冷效应：随着非互易性的调节，边界粒子会从充当热库转变为充当冷库。

articles.title: From Electronic Structure to Environmental Remediation: Adsorption of Ionized Glyphosate on COOH-Modified Carbon Nanotube
articles.title_zh: 从电子结构到环境修复：羧基修饰碳纳米管上离子化草甘膦的吸附
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Glyphosate is a widely used herbicide whose persistence and toxicity in aquatic and terrestrial environments demand efficient removal strategies. Here we employ GFN2 xTB calculations with implicit ALPB aqueous solvation and automated docking to investigate the adsorption of all five pH dependent ionized forms of glyphosate (G1-G5) on (10,0) single walled carbon nanotubes covalently functionalized with carboxyl groups at 0-25% coverage. Adsorption energies reveal a clear charge dependent trend: the dianionic (G4) and trianionic (G5) species exhibit the most negative binding energies over the entire functionalization range, while the protonated and neutral forms (G1, G2) bind weakly, approaching reversible adsorption at high COOH contents. The deprotonated form G5 strengthens from -2.17 eV on pristine CNT to about -5.7 eV at 10% and 25% functionalization, with a local minimum near 15-20% COOH due to steric and electrostatic crowding of adjacent groups. Decomposition of the solvation free energy shows dominant electrostatic stabilization complemented by increasingly favorable hydrogen bond contributions as carboxyl density grows. All complexes display very small HOMO-LUMO gaps (0.02-0.22 eV), indicating high electronic sensitivity to adsorption and functionalization. Overall, CNT+COOH systems can operate in both strong capture and regenerable regimes depending on glyphosate ionization state, offering a tunable platform for pH responsive remediation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用 GFN2-xTB 计算、隐式 ALPB 水溶剂模型和自动化对接方法，研究了草甘膦五种 pH 依赖离子形态在羧基功能化单壁碳纳米管上的吸附。结果表明，二价和三价阴离子形态具有最强吸附，而质子化和中性形态结合较弱；羧基覆盖度会通过静电作用、氢键以及空间拥挤共同调节吸附强度。该体系可根据草甘膦的电离状态，在强捕获与可再生吸附之间实现调控，为 pH 响应型环境修复提供平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 草甘膦是一种广泛使用的除草剂，其在水环境和陆地环境中的持久性与毒性要求人们发展高效的去除策略。本文采用具有隐式 ALPB 水溶剂模型的 GFN2-xTB 计算和自动化对接方法，研究了草甘膦 全部五种随 pH 变化的离子化形态（G1–G5）在共价引入羧基、覆盖度为 0–25% 的（10,0）型单壁碳纳米管上的吸附。吸附能显示出清晰的电荷依赖趋势：二价阴离子物种 G4 和三价阴离子物种 G5 在整个功能化范围内都表现出最负的结合能，而质子化形态和中性形态 G1、G2 的结合较弱，在较高 COOH 含量下接近可逆吸附。去质子化形态 G5 的吸附强度从未修饰碳纳米管上的 −2.17 eV 增强到 10% 和 25% 功能化时约 −5.7 eV，但由于相邻基团之间的空间位阻和静电拥挤，在 15–20% COOH 覆盖度附近出现局部最小值。对溶剂化自由能的分解表明，静电稳定化起主导作用；随着羧基密度增加，越来越有利的氢键贡献也得到增强。所有复合物都具有非常小的 HOMO–LUMO 能隙（0.02–0.22 eV），表明其电子性质对吸附和功能化具有高度敏感性。总体而言，CNT+COOH 体系可根据草甘膦的电离状态，在强捕获模式和可再生模式之间运行，从而为 pH 响应型环境修复提供了可调平台。

articles.title: Three-Electrode TiO2 + rGO Cells: Classical Controls and Interpretation within a Quantum-Discord Framework
articles.title_zh: 三电极 TiO2 + rGO 电池：量子失谐框架下的经典控制与解释
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04252v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In three-electrode electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), the impedance/capacitance response of the working electrode (WE) is measured relative to the reference electrode (RE), whereas the current required by potentiostatic control flows between the WE and the counter electrode (CE). Under classical three-electrode operation, the measured WE-RE response should therefore be independent of the properties of the electrode used as the CE, provided that conventional electrochemical and instrumental artifacts are negligible. Here, we test this expectation in cells containing nanostructured electrodes TiO2 + rGO and examine the results within a framework motivated by quantum discord to describe effective interelectrode correlations. We used dummy-cell measurements, a two-electrode bar-bar control, comparisons between Pt and bar CEs, a dummy circuit introduced into the CE branch, and CE ensemble comparisons to distinguish additive circuit behavior from CE-dependent behavior specific to the three-electrode configuration. In these experiments, the measured three-electrode capacitance response depends on CE, an effect that is not reproduced by the dummy-circuit controls examined. These findings identify a macroscopic CE-dependent capacitance response that departs from the tested classical expectation and is compatible with an effective interelectrode-correlation framework motivated by quantum discord, although the capacitance evidence alone does not constitute a direct measurement of quantum discord.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考察了三电极电化学阻抗谱中工作电极响应是否会依赖对电极性质，并在 TiO2+rGO 纳米结构电极中进行了多种对照实验。实验显示，测得的三电极电容响应确实随对电极变化，而所测试的虚拟电路对照未能重现这一效应。作者认为，这一宏观对电极依赖现象与受量子失谐启发的有效电极间关联框架相容，但强调电容证据本身不能直接证明量子失谐的存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在三电极电化学阻抗谱中，工作电极相对于参比电极的阻抗或电容响应会被测量，而恒电位控制所需的电流则在工作电极与对电极之间流动。因此，在经典三电极工作条件下，只要传统的电化学伪象和仪器伪象可以忽略，测得的工作电极–参比电极响应应当独立于作为对电极的电极性质。本文在含有 TiO2+rGO 纳米结构电极的电池中检验了这一预期，并在受量子失谐启发的框架下考察有效电极间关联。作者采用了虚拟电池测量、双电极棒–棒对照、铂对电极与棒状对电极的比较、在对电极支路中引入虚拟电路，以及对不同对电极组合进行比较，以区分加性电路行为与三电极构型中特有的对电极依赖行为。在这些实验中，测得的三电极电容响应依赖于对电极，而所考察的虚拟电路对照并未重现这一效应。这些结果表明存在一种宏观的、依赖对电极的电容响应，偏离了所检验的经典预期，并且与受量子失谐启发的有效电极间关联框架相容；不过，仅凭电容证据并不能构成对量子失谐的直接测量。

articles.title: Strong-Drive Floquet Engineering of Interacting Qudits: From Finite-Duration Controls to Emergent Symmetry
articles.title_zh: 相互作用量子位的强驱动 Floquet 工程：从有限持续时间控制到涌现对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04309v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Floquet driving uses periodic controls to tailor the behavior of quantum systems, with applications in quantum analogue simulation, sensing, and the protection of quantum information. Most approaches are designed using idealized, instantaneous pulses, even though experiments necessarily use pulses with finite duration and shape. This mismatch becomes especially challenging for interacting d-level systems, or qudits, because the number of possible controls grows rapidly with the number of levels. We develop a strong-drive Floquet theory that incorporates experimentally realizable pulse waveforms directly into the design of the effective interactions. The pulse duration, amplitude, and shape therefore become useful control parameters rather than sources of error. We show that systems with more than two levels offer capabilities unavailable in qubit systems: finite-duration driving can create new interactions that are absent from the original system and can substantially change its symmetries. We demonstrate these capabilities for interacting three-level systems. A single pulse transforms a diagonal interaction into a quantum spin-1 model dominated by nematic interactions, while pulse protocols motivated by trapped ultracold polar molecules produce models with enlarged SU(2)× U(1) and SU(3) symmetries. Numerical tests of both short-time evolution and many-body dynamics confirm the accuracy of the resulting description. Our results provide a scalable analytical framework for designing finite-duration controls in interacting qudit platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了包含实验可实现脉冲波形的强驱动 Floquet 理论，将脉冲持续时间、振幅和形状作为有效相互作用的控制参数。研究表明，三能级及更高维量子位能够通过有限持续时间驱动产生原系统不存在的新相互作用，并显著改变系统对称性。针对相互作用三能级系统的数值结果显示，该方法可生成以向列相互作用为主导的自旋 1 模型，以及具有扩展 SU(2)×U(1) 和 SU(3) 对称性的模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Floquet 驱动利用周期性控制来调节量子系统的行为，并可应用于量子模拟、传感和量子信息保护。大多数方法都是基于理想化的瞬时脉冲设计的，然而实验中必然使用具有有限持续时间和具体形状的脉冲。对于相互作用的 d 级系统，即量子位而言，这种不匹配尤其具有挑战性，因为随着能级数增加，可能的控制数量会迅速增长。本文发展了一种强驱动 Floquet 理论，将实验上可实现的脉冲波形直接纳入有效相互作用的设计之中。因此，脉冲持续时间、振幅和形状不再只是误差来源，而成为有用的控制参数。作者表明，具有多于两个能级的系统能够实现量子位系统所不具备的能力：有限持续时间驱动可以产生原系统中不存在的新相互作用，并能够显著改变其对称性。作者以相互作用的三能级系统为例展示了这些能力。单个脉冲可以将一个对角相互作用转化为由向列相互作用主导的量子自旋 1 模型，而受受限超冷极性分子启发的脉冲方案则能够产生具有扩展 SU(2)×U(1) 和 SU(3) 对称性的模型。对短时间演化和多体动力学的数值检验均证实了所得描述的准确性。本文结果为在相互作用量子位平台中设计有限持续时间控制提供了一种可扩展的解析框架。

articles.title: Two-phase Temperature Reconstruction in Ice-Water Systems
articles.title_zh: 冰–水系统中的两相温度重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04479v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: What controls heat transport when liquid water interacts with ice? Answering this question is essential for understanding water bodies undergoing phase change. Yet experimental progress remains limited by the lack of a minimally invasive methodology for simultaneously resolving temperature fields in coupled liquid water and non-isothermal ice systems. Here, we introduce a physics-based data-assimilation method for reconstructing temperature fields in buoyancy-driven flows interacting with non-isothermal ice. Particle tracking velocimetry provides the liquid velocity field, while thermal and kinematic boundary conditions constrain the inverse problem. The method couples advection--diffusion in liquid water with conduction in ice to reconstruct simultaneous mean temperature fields and quantify heat transport across the water--ice interface, while remaining minimally invasive and compatible with free-surface systems. We demonstrate the method in laboratory experiments in which the temperature range across the liquid water in contact with ice drives cabbeling-induced convection. This framework enables investigation of coupled thermo-fluid dynamics in cryospheric aquatic systems, including heat exchange at the ice-water interface and liquid-phase energetics, with broader applications to phase-change processes in food and energy industries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于物理的数据同化方法，用于重建浮力驱动流动与非等温冰相互作用时的液体和冰中的温度场。该方法结合粒子跟踪测速、液体中的平流–扩散方程、冰中的热传导方程以及热学和运动学边界条件，可同时重建平均温度场并量化冰–水界面的热输运。实验表明，该方法能够解析由 cabbeling 效应驱动的对流，为研究冰冻圈水体中的耦合热流体动力学和相变过程提供了微创工具。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当液态水与冰发生相互作用时，什么因素控制热输运？回答这一问题对于理解经历相变的水体至关重要。然而，由于缺乏一种能够同时解析耦合液态水和非等温冰中温度场的微创方法，实验研究进展仍然受到限制。本文提出了一种基于物理的数据同化方法，用于重建与非等温冰相互作用的浮力驱动流中的温度场。粒子跟踪测速提供液体速度场，而热学和运动学边界条件则约束逆问题。该方法将液态水中的平流–扩散过程与冰中的热传导过程耦合起来，从而重建同时存在的平均温度场，并量化水–冰界面上的热输运；与此同时，该方法仍保持微创性，并适用于自由表面系统。作者在实验室实验中展示了该方法，实验中与冰接触的液态水内部存在一定温度范围，并由此驱动 cabbeling 引起的对流。该框架能够研究冰冻圈水生系统中的耦合热流体动力学，包括冰–水界面的热交换和液相能量学，并可进一步应用于食品和能源工业中的相变过程。

articles.title: Low electrical conductivity of dry CaSiO3 perovskite under lower mantle conditions
articles.title_zh: 下地幔条件下干燥 CaSiO3 钙钛矿的低电导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04499v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electrical conductivity (EC) provides important constraints on the composition and volatile distribution of Earth's deep mantle, yet the EC of davemaoite (CaSiO3 perovskite), a major lower-mantle phase, remains poorly constrained. We measured the EC of nominally dry CaSiO3 perovskite at pressures up to 89 GPa and temperatures up to 2200 K using impedance spectroscopy in a laser-heated diamond anvil cell. Conductivity increases with temperature but decreases systematically with pressure and it is substantially lower than previously reported, yet broadly consistent with recent theoretical predictions for oxygen-vacancy-mediated ionic transport. A distinct change in the temperature dependence coincides with the tetragonal-to-cubic phase boundary, revealing a modest enhancement of ionic transport across the structural transition. Along a normal lower-mantle geotherm, dry davemaoite is comparable in conductivity to bridgmanite near the top of the lower mantle but becomes progressively less conductive with depth. Under cold-slab conditions, dry davemaoite is substantially less conductive than dry subducted MORB and cannot account for the observed high-conductivity anomalies. Dry davemaoite therefore contributes little to bulk lower-mantle conductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用激光加热金刚石压砧中的阻抗谱，测量了名义无水 CaSiO3 钙钛矿在高压高温条件下的电导率。电导率随温度升高而增加、随压力升高而系统性降低，且显著低于此前报道的结果，但总体上与氧空位介导离子输运的最新理论预测一致。研究还发现，四方相到立方相的结构转变会带来离子输运的适度增强；干燥钙钛矿对下地幔整体电导率的贡献有限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电导率能够为地球深部地幔的组成和挥发性物质分布提供重要约束，但作为下地幔主要矿物相的 davemaoite，即 CaSiO3 钙钛矿，其电导率仍缺乏充分约束。本文利用激光加热金刚石压砧中的阻抗谱，测量了名义无水 CaSiO3 钙钛矿在最高 89 GPa 压力和最高 2200 K 温度下的电导率。电导率随温度升高而增加，但随压力升高而系统性降低，并且显著低于此前报道的结果；不过，它总体上与近期关于氧空位介导离子输运的理论预测一致。温度依赖性的一个明显变化与四方相到立方相的相边界相吻合，表明结构转变会使离子输运得到适度增强。在正常下地幔地温梯度下，干燥 davemaoite 在下地幔顶部附近的电导率与 bridgmanite 相当，但随着深度增加，其电导率逐渐降低。在冷俯冲板片条件下，干燥 davemaoite 的电导率显著低于干燥的俯冲 MORB，因而无法解释观测到的高电导率异常。因此，干燥 davemaoite 对下地幔整体电导率的贡献很小。

articles.title: Operando imaging of intercalation memory in MXenes
articles.title_zh: MXene 中嵌入记忆的工作状态成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04977v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ion intercalation enables reversible control of charge, structure and function in layered solids. Yet layered materials contain nanosheets with different thicknesses and stacking, whose intercalation pathways are averaged out in ensemble measurements. This becomes critical under Angstrom-scale confinement, where ion transport couples to solvent reorganization and host deformation, leaving the origins of kinetics, reversibility and activation unresolved. Here we combine operando interferometric scattering and interference reflection microscopy to resolve proton-driven dynamics in individual single- and multilayer Ti3C2Tx MXene flakes and show that even a few stacked layers introduce a significant kinetic barrier. Cycling then separates nanosheets into three persistent behaviors: reversible monolayers, restacked multilayers with incomplete recovery and delayed deintercalation, and coherently stacked multilayers that self-stabilize through reversible folding. Operando synchrotron X-ray diffraction shows this memory at electrode scale, where the interlayer structure converges towards a reproducible state. Our findings reveal cycling-induced structural memory that governs subsequent intercalation in layered MXenes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合工作状态干涉散射显微镜和干涉反射显微镜，解析了单层与多层 Ti3C2Tx MXene 薄片中的质子驱动嵌入动力学。结果显示，即使只有少数堆叠层也会引入显著动力学障碍，循环过程会使纳米片形成三种持久行为：可逆单层、恢复不完全且脱嵌延迟的重新堆叠多层，以及通过可逆折叠自稳定的相干堆叠多层。同步辐射 X 射线衍射进一步表明，这种结构记忆会在电极尺度上使层间结构趋向可重复状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离子嵌入能够可逆地调控层状固体中的电荷、结构和功能。然而，层状材料包含厚度和堆叠方式各不相同的纳米片，其嵌入路径会在系综测量中被平均掉。在埃尺度限域条件下，这一问题尤其关键，因为离子输运会与溶剂重组和主体材料变形耦合，使动力学、可逆性及其激活机制的起源难以确定。本文结合工作状态干涉散射显微镜和干涉反射显微镜，解析了单层和多层 Ti3C2Tx MXene 薄片中的质子驱动动力学，并表明即使只有少数堆叠层也会引入显著的动力学障碍。经过循环后，纳米片分化出三种持久行为：可逆单层、恢复不完全并且脱嵌延迟的重新堆叠多层，以及通过可逆折叠实现自稳定的相干堆叠多层。工作状态同步辐射 X 射线衍射在电极尺度上显示出这种记忆效应，在该尺度下层间结构会趋向一个可重复的状态。本文结果揭示了由循环诱导的结构记忆，而这种记忆会控制层状 MXene 后续的离子嵌入过程。

articles.title: What Photocurrent Versus Effective Voltage Tells Us About Charge Generation in Organic Solar Cells
articles.title_zh: 光电流与有效电压的关系揭示了有机太阳能电池中的电荷产生问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05170v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The photocurrent of an organic solar cell is routinely plotted against an effective voltage and used to extract an exciton dissociation probability, and through it a free-charge generation efficiency. The photocurrent measures neither. Using a drift-diffusion model in which free-charge generation is field independent and losses occur only by bimolecular recombination, we show that the apparent dissociation probability returned by this procedure lies well below unity even for complete dissociation. Across wide variations of carrier mobility and recombination strength it is a single-valued function of the fill factor and coincides with the short-circuit charge collection efficiency, reporting neither the generation yield nor anything about collection beyond what the fill factor already shows. Even for ideal transport the normalised photocurrent saturates below unity at an intensity-independent first-order limit set by recombination of photogenerated carriers with injected equilibrium charge. Applied to four organic solar cells whose generation efficiencies are known independently, the apparent dissociation probabilities track the short-circuit collection efficiency rather than the generation yield. We therefore suggest this construction not be used, particularly in the high-efficiency non-fullerene acceptor systems that are now state of the art.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，通常将有机太阳能电池的光电流与有效电压关联起来并据此提取激子解离概率，实际上并不能直接测量激子解离或自由电荷产生效率。漂移–扩散模型表明，即使完全解离，该方法得到的表观解离概率也可明显低于 1，并且主要是填充因子和短路电荷收集效率的函数。对多个有机太阳能电池的分析进一步显示，表观解离概率跟踪的是短路收集效率而非电荷产生率，因此不应将该构造用于判断高效非富勒烯受体体系中的电荷产生效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有机太阳能电池的光电流通常被绘制为有效电压的函数，并用于提取激子解离概率，进而得到自由电荷产生效率。光电流实际上既不测量其中的激子解离概率，也不测量自由电荷产生效率。本文采用一个漂移–扩散模型，在该模型中自由电荷产生与电场无关，损失仅通过双分子复合发生；作者表明，即使实现完全解离，该方法所得到的表观解离概率仍会远低于 1。在载流子迁移率和复合强度大范围变化时，该表观解离概率是填充因子的单值函数，并且与短路电荷收集效率相一致；它既不反映电荷产生率，也不提供超出填充因子本身信息的电荷收集信息。即使输运是理想的，归一化光电流也会在低于 1 的位置饱和，其与光强无关的一阶极限由光生载流子与注入的平衡电荷之间的复合决定。作者将该方法应用于四种独立测得电荷产生效率的有机太阳能电池，发现表观解离概率跟踪的是短路收集效率，而不是电荷产生率。因此，作者建议不要使用这种构造，尤其是在当前处于技术前沿的高效率非富勒烯受体体系中。

articles.title: Thermoelectric properties of metal-semiconductor percolation composites
articles.title_zh: 金属–半导体渗流复合材料的热电性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05273v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We analyze thermoelectric response of composite materials comprising homogeneous semiconductor hosts with randomly distributed metallic inclusions. We demonstrate that the properties of such materials are strongly affected by the percolation transition (with background conductivity). We show that in vicinity of percolation threshold, the power factor and the thermoelectric figure of merit strongly depend on both the concentration and arrangement of inclusions. Finally, we identify promising regimes for enhancing the power factor in realistic composites.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了由均匀半导体基体和随机分布金属夹杂物组成的复合材料的热电响应。研究表明，渗流转变及背景电导会显著影响材料性质；在渗流阈值附近，功率因数和热电优值强烈依赖夹杂物的浓度与空间排列。作者进一步确定了有望在实际复合材料中提升功率因数的参数区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文分析了由均匀半导体基体和随机分布的金属夹杂物组成的复合材料的热电响应。作者证明，这类材料的性质会受到渗流转变以及背景电导的强烈影响。研究显示，在渗流阈值附近，功率因数和热电优值都强烈依赖于夹杂物的浓度和排列方式。最后，作者确定了在实际复合材料中增强功率因数的有希望区域。

articles.title: A photonic source with half-a-GHz single-photon flux
articles.title_zh: 具有半吉赫兹单光子通量的光子源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05387v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Advanced optical quantum technologies demands high quality quantum light generation at very high rates. Here, we report on a deterministic single-photon source that simultaneously combines high excitation rates with high system efficiency to reach over 500 MHz of in-fibre single-photon flux. The source delivers optical power of over 100 pW, as is measured with an off-the-shelf powermeter, enabling a simple and direct way of determining the single-photon source fiber efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种确定性单光子源，同时实现了高激发速率和高系统效率。该光源在光纤中产生超过 500 MHz 的单光子通量，并输出超过 100 pW 的光功率。研究还表明，使用商用功率计即可简便、直接地测定单光子源的光纤效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 先进的光学量子技术需要以非常高的速率产生高质量的量子光。本文报道了一种确定性单光子源，它同时结合了高激发速率和高系统效率，从而实现了超过 500 MHz 的光纤单光子通量。该光源提供超过 100 pW 的光功率，这使得利用现成的商用功率计即可简单而直接地确定单光子源的光纤效率。

articles.title: Tunable Anomalous Diffusion in Subrecoil-Laser-Cooled Atoms
articles.title_zh: 亚反冲激光冷却原子中的可调异常扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.15027v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Laser cooling of atomic motion enables advances in quantum information and precision metrology. However, the spatial spreading of subrecoil-laser-cooled atoms---crucial for understanding cooling mechanisms and atomic confinement---remains largely unexplored. Here, we analyze anomalous diffusion in subrecoil-laser-cooled atoms, where a velocity-dependent fluorescence rate R(v) propto |v|α governs transport properties. By tuning α, we uncover transitions between normal, subdiffusive, and superdiffusive regimes. Notably, at α = 3/2, diffusion is minimized, leading to optimal atomic confinement. We further identify a conceptual link between subrecoil laser cooling and the Pomeau-Manneville map from nonlinear dynamics, revealing that anomalous diffusion can generically exhibit a nontrivial minimum in spatial spreading---even across seemingly unrelated physical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了亚反冲激光冷却原子的空间扩散，并以速度依赖的荧光率 R(v)∝|v|^α 描述输运性质。通过调节 α，系统可在正常扩散、次扩散和超扩散之间转变；其中 α=3/2 时扩散最弱，对应最佳原子限域。研究还揭示了亚反冲激光冷却与非线性动力学中的 Pomeau–Manneville 映射之间的概念联系，说明异常扩散中可能普遍存在空间扩展的非平凡最小值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子运动的激光冷却推动了量子信息和精密计量的发展。然而，亚反冲激光冷却原子的空间扩展对于理解冷却机制和原子限域至关重要，却仍未得到充分研究。本文分析了亚反冲激光冷却原子中的异常扩散，其中速度依赖的荧光率 R(v)∝|v|^α 控制着输运性质。通过调节 α，作者发现系统可以在正常扩散、次扩散和超扩散区域之间发生转变。值得注意的是，在 α=3/2 时，扩散达到最小值，从而实现最佳原子限域。作者进一步确定了亚反冲激光冷却与非线性动力学中的 Pomeau–Manneville 映射之间的概念联系，揭示出异常扩散一般可能表现出空间扩展的非平凡最小值，即使是在看似彼此无关的物理系统之间也是如此。

articles.title: Fingerprinting superconductors by disentangling Andreev and quasiparticle currents across tunable tunnel junctions
articles.title_zh: 通过可调隧穿结区分安德烈夫电流与准粒子电流来识别超导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.20798v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tunneling Andreev reflection (TAR) spectroscopy offers a powerful new approach to fingerprint superconducting pairing symmetry at the atomic scale. By leveraging the exponential sensitivity of excess tunneling decay rate to Andreev reflection, TAR robustly distinguishes between s-wave, d-wave, and more complex order parameters, overcoming limitations of traditional conductance-based techniques. Here, using atomistic superconducting transport simulations, we show that the additivity of excess decay rate enables clear separation of Andreev and quasiparticle currents. In particular, we reveal how their competition as well as higher-order scattering processes shape both the decay rate spectra and their dependence on the coupling strength. We show that this phenomenology stems from the fact that Andreev reflection dominates mid-gap conductance for s-wave superconductors, it is suppressed for the d-wave, and it coexists with quasiparticle tunneling in sign-changing symmetries if the expectation value for the superconducting gap remains finite. These distinct spectral fingerprints pave the way for atomically resolved identification of unconventional superconducting states.
articles.abstract_zh: 隧穿安德烈夫反射谱学利用过量隧穿衰减率对安德烈夫反射的指数敏感性，可在原子尺度上区分超导配对对称性。本文通过原子级超导输运模拟表明，过量衰减率具有可加性，因此能够分离安德烈夫电流与准粒子电流。不同配对对称性在带隙中间区域的安德烈夫反射及其与准粒子隧穿的竞争关系不同，由此形成可用于识别非常规超导态的谱学指纹。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 隧穿安德烈夫反射谱学提供了一种在原子尺度上识别超导配对对称性的有力新方法。该方法利用过量隧穿衰减率对安德烈夫反射的指数敏感性，能够稳健地区分 s 波、d 波以及更复杂的序参量，并克服传统基于电导的技术所存在的局限。本文利用原子级超导输运模拟表明，过量衰减率的可加性能够清晰地区分安德烈夫电流和准粒子电流。特别是，作者揭示了二者之间的竞争以及高阶散射过程如何共同塑造衰减率谱及其对耦合强度的依赖。作者表明，这种现象源于以下事实：对于 s 波超导体，安德烈夫反射主导带隙中间区域的电导；对于 d 波超导体，安德烈夫反射受到抑制；而对于变号对称性，如果超导能隙的期望值保持有限，安德烈夫反射就会与准粒子隧穿共存。这些不同的谱学指纹为在原子分辨率下识别非常规超导态提供了途径。

articles.title: Predictive first-principles simulations for co-designing next-generation energy-efficient AI systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.08995v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In modern generative-AI workloads, matrix-vector/matrix-matrix multiplications (emphMatMul) dominate the compute and energy cost. Achieving dramatic reductions in energy per token therefore requires a novel, specialized hardware that is co-designed across materials, devices, interconnects, circuits, and architectures rather than optimized at any single layer in isolation. In this emphPerspectives article, we argue that emphpredictive (first-principles, fitting-parameter-free) device and interconnect simulations can close the loop between nanoscale physics and workload-level metrics, enabling the identification of device/interconnect operating regimes that plausibly support emphorders-of-magnitude improvements in energy efficiency of AI accelerators.

articles.title: Information-Geometric Signatures from Nonextensivity in the 1-D Blume-Capel Model
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.17483v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the thermodynamic geometry of the one-dimensional Blume--Capel model within the Tsallis nonextensive framework to understand how generalized statistics modify correlation structure and pseudo-critical behaviour. Using the transfer matrix method, we construct the Tsallis entropy based thermodynamic metric as its negative Hessian on the parameter space (β, J), with the crystal-field anisotropy D as a control parameter, and compute the associated scalar curvature R(T) as a measure of correlations. Although no true phase transition occurs in one dimension, R(T) exhibits finite peaks signaling pseudo-critical crossovers. We analyze both D < J and D > J regimes and show that deviations from the Boltzmann--Gibbs limit (q=1) systematically deform the curvature profile: for q>1 the peak shifts and correlations persist beyond the crossover, whereas for q<1 the peak is weakened or suppressed. Our results demonstrate that the Tsallis parameter q geometrically reshapes the entropy surface, providing a clear information-geometric interpretation of nonextensive effects in spin-1 systems.

articles.title: Hubbard vs. Emery model: spectra, transport and relevance for cuprates
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.08085v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding the transport properties of cuprate superconductors is one of the central challenges in the physics of strongly correlated electrons. The most common approach is to define and solve a low-energy lattice model, but it is still unclear what the minimal model is to capture all relevant mechanisms and provide quantitative predictions.
