Material effects on the emerging annihilation products were estimated by Monte Carlo (Geant4) calculations, while annihilation artefacts on the complex surface of a microchannel plate are cancelled out in this approach. This method minimises largely systematic uncertainties, leading to a final error of roughly 10% for the reconstruction of absolute antiproton numbers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用安装在真空腔周围的商用CMOS数字相机，通过反质子在微通道板表面湮灭产生的电离粒子来测定入射keV反质子数量。结果表明，CMOS像素探测器可近乎100%探测多数最小电离粒子，并因薄耗尽层而对背景伽马不敏感。通过簇重建、固角标定和Geant4材料效应估计，该方法可在高密度径迹环境中以约10%的最终误差重建绝对反质子数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.04078v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：GBAR实验在AD/ELENA上产生反氢，需要很好地了解入射keV反质子的数量，而这可能存在困难。我们使用了一台安装在实验真空腔周围的商用CMOS数字相机，通过束流成像所用微通道板探测器表面湮灭过程中产生的电离粒子来确定反质子数量。我们表明，考虑到周围材料预算后，逸出的带电粒子多重性与静止核子上单个反质子湮灭的预期相符。这些粒子中的大多数处于最小电离状态，但几乎能以100%的效率被CMOS像素探测器探测到；同时，由于耗尽层很薄，该器件对背景伽马射线不敏感。得益于高颗粒度和小像素尺寸，可在高密度径迹环境中以较大动态范围和良好分辨率重建数百万次反质子湮灭。通过对非垂直径迹的簇长度研究，估计了耗尽区厚度和有效探测面积。簇长度还可用于监测径迹角度。反质子数量通过CMOS传感器中重建簇的数量确定，方法是利用相对于GBAR装置最上游位置已知束流强度校准测量的覆盖固角。逸出湮灭产物的材料效应通过蒙特卡洛（Geant4）计算估计，而微通道板复杂表面上的湮灭伪影在该方法中被抵消。该方法在很大程度上最小化了系统不确定性，使绝对反质子数量重建的最终误差约为10%。

articles.title: An interpretation-independent formulation of the measurement problem
articles.title_zh: 测量问题的一种解释无关表述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03409v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we do not try to solve the measurement problem, but rather to properly formulate it. One of the reasons why it still lacks a precise, agreed definition is that the problem may take very different aspects depending on the interpretation of quantum mechanics embraced. Inspired by the methodology of theory-independent results like Bell's theorem, we propose to identify the common root of the puzzle in an interpretation-independent way i.e. as a property of the empirical statistics only, before deriving its philosophical consequences. The key observation is that quantum matter can not be described by a Kolmogorovian probabilistic theory. Arguing that the Kolmogorov axioms of probability theory are the postulates of epistemic uncertainty leads us to reformulate the measurement problem as the impossibility to build an ontology independent of epistemology for quantum matter. Said differently, there exists no God's-eye view on quantum systems. Although it is meaningless to solve the measurement problem as defined in this way, insofar as it is a feature of the universe's statistics, such a formulation may on the other hand bring side benefits. In particular, we argue that it allows to: (i) shed a new light on the variety of interpretations; (ii) propose a fundamental reason why quantum mechanics and general relativity are so incompatible, not relying on purely mathematical or technical arguments; (iii) guide the quest for quantum gravity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文并不试图解决量子测量问题，而是提出一种不依赖具体量子诠释的表述方式。作者主张从经验统计性质出发，指出量子物质无法由柯尔莫哥洛夫概率理论描述，并将测量问题重述为无法为量子物质建立独立于认识论的本体论。该表述被认为有助于理解不同诠释、量子力学与广义相对论的不相容性，以及量子引力研究方向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03409v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在本文中，我们并不试图解决测量问题，而是试图恰当地表述它。该问题至今仍缺乏精确定义和共识定义的原因之一，是它可能因所采纳的量子力学诠释不同而呈现出非常不同的面貌。受贝尔定理等理论无关结果的方法论启发，我们提出先以解释无关的方式，即作为经验统计本身的一种性质，识别这一难题的共同根源，然后再推导其哲学后果。关键观察是，量子物质不能由柯尔莫哥洛夫概率理论描述。我们认为，概率论的柯尔莫哥洛夫公理是认识论不确定性的公设，这使我们能够将测量问题重新表述为：不可能为量子物质构建一种独立于认识论的本体论。换言之，对于量子系统不存在上帝视角。尽管按照这种方式定义的测量问题作为宇宙统计性质之一并无解决意义，但这种表述另一方面可能带来附带益处。特别是，我们认为它能够：（i）为各种诠释提供新的理解；（ii）提出一个根本性理由来解释为什么量子力学和广义相对论如此不相容，而不依赖纯数学或技术性论证；（iii）指导量子引力的探索。

articles.title: Quantum Quasi-Monte Carlo: a window for pre-asymptotic quantum advantage
articles.title_zh: 量子拟蒙特卡罗：前渐近量子优势的窗口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03625v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Numerical integration with Monte Carlo methods is a central computational task in many scientific and industrial applications, including financial derivative pricing and risk management. Classical Monte Carlo algorithms are computationally demanding: achieving an accuracy ϵ typically requires a number of function evaluations scaling as O(1/ϵ²). Quantum-accelerated Monte Carlo methods based on quantum amplitude estimation can in principle quadratically improve this dependence. However, quasi-Monte Carlo methods have not been explored in the quantum context. In this work, we introduce a quantum quasi-Monte Carlo algorithm that combines low-discrepancy nets with quantum amplitude estimation. The proposed method prepares the quasi-random point set coherently in superposition. The method does not yield an asymptotic improvement over classical quasi-Monte Carlo, since the total error separates into a discretization error, determined by the finite net, and a quantum estimation error. Instead, we explore a pre-asymptotic advantage window: for a target accuracy that would classically require 2^q low discrepancy points, one can prepare a higher-resolution net of size 2^Q, with Q>q, in superposition and reach the same accuracy using significantly fewer function queries. This window can be controlled by tuning the circuit resolution and amplitude-estimation parameters, making the approach relevant for practical regimes where the number of queries is finite rather than asymptotically large.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种量子拟蒙特卡罗算法，将低差异点集与量子振幅估计相结合，用于数值积分。作者指出，该方法并不在渐近意义上优于经典拟蒙特卡罗，因为总误差可分为有限点集导致的离散化误差和量子估计误差。其潜在价值在于前渐近区间：通过在叠加态中制备更高分辨率的低差异点集，可在有限查询次数的实际场景中减少函数查询量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03625v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：使用蒙特卡罗方法进行数值积分是许多科学和工业应用中的核心计算任务，包括金融衍生品定价和风险管理。经典蒙特卡罗算法计算成本很高：达到精度ϵ通常需要函数评估次数按O(1/ϵ²)缩放。基于量子振幅估计的量子加速蒙特卡罗方法原则上可以将这种依赖关系二次改进。然而，拟蒙特卡罗方法尚未在量子语境下得到探索。在本工作中，我们提出一种量子拟蒙特卡罗算法，将低差异网与量子振幅估计相结合。该方法以相干方式在叠加态中制备准随机点集。该方法并未相对于经典拟蒙特卡罗产生渐近改进，因为总误差可分解为由有限网决定的离散化误差和量子估计误差。相反，我们探索了一个前渐近优势窗口：对于一个经典上需要2^q个低差异点才能达到的目标精度，可以在叠加态中制备规模为2^Q且Q>q的更高分辨率网，并用显著更少的函数查询达到相同精度。通过调节电路分辨率和振幅估计参数，可以控制这一窗口，使该方法适用于查询次数有限而非渐近无限大的实际情形。

articles.title: Detection of hydrocarbons in Titan using high-resolution cross-correlation spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 利用高分辨率互相关光谱探测土卫六中的碳氢化合物
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03975v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-resolution cross-correlation spectroscopy (HRCCS) is a powerful technique for detecting molecules whose individual spectral lines are too weak to be identified directly, but its sensitivity is limited by the availability and quality of high-resolution opacity data. Many molecules of atmospheric and astrobiological interest lack complete line lists, restricting traditional template-based searches. In this work, we use Titan as a controlled testbed to develop and validate a new cross-section-based methodology for HRCCS template construction. We analyse K-band CRIRES+ observations of Titan (1.99 - 2.48 μm), and compute cross-correlation functions using both line-by-line and cross-section-based templates. Our analysis recovers known hydrocarbons such as methane (CH4) and acetylene (C2H2), and yields the first HRCCS detection of ethane (C2H6) with a significance of SNRpeak = 5.17 ± 0.07. The ethane detection was made possible exclusively through cross-section-based templates, as no high-resolution line list currently exists for this molecule. These results demonstrate that cross-section-based template construction is a practical and powerful strategy for extending HRCCS to molecules that currently lack reliable line lists, and establish Titan as a benchmark for calibrating molecular detection techniques that can be applied to both solar system and exoplanet atmospheres. Future applications of this approach to other ground-based high-resolution spectrographs, as well as to JWST's highest-resolution modes and next-generation facilities such as the ELT, could significantly expand the inventory of molecules detectable in planetary atmospheres.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以土卫六为受控测试平台，发展并验证一种基于截面的高分辨率互相关光谱模板构建方法。作者分析了土卫六K波段CRIRES+观测数据，恢复了甲烷和乙炔等已知碳氢化合物，并首次以HRCCS方式探测到乙烷。结果表明，基于截面的模板可扩展HRCCS对缺乏可靠高分辨率线表分子的探测能力，并可用于太阳系和系外行星大气研究。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03975v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：高分辨率互相关光谱（HRCCS）是一种强大的技术，可用于探测那些单条谱线太弱而无法直接识别的分子，但其灵敏度受到高分辨率不透明度数据的可获得性和质量限制。许多具有大气和天体生物学意义的分子缺乏完整线表，从而限制了传统的基于模板的搜索。在本工作中，我们以土卫六作为受控测试平台，发展并验证一种新的基于截面的HRCCS模板构建方法。我们分析了土卫六的K波段CRIRES+观测数据（1.99—2.48微米），并使用逐线模板和基于截面的模板计算互相关函数。我们的分析恢复了甲烷（CH4）和乙炔（C2H2）等已知碳氢化合物，并首次实现了乙烷（C2H6）的HRCCS探测，其显著性为SNRpeak = 5.17 ± 0.07。乙烷探测完全依赖基于截面的模板才得以实现，因为目前该分子不存在高分辨率线表。这些结果表明，基于截面的模板构建是将HRCCS扩展到目前缺乏可靠线表分子的实用而有力的策略，并确立土卫六作为校准分子探测技术的基准，该技术可应用于太阳系和系外行星大气。未来将该方法应用于其他地基高分辨率光谱仪，以及JWST最高分辨率模式和ELT等下一代设施，可能会显著扩展可在行星大气中探测到的分子清单。

articles.title: Quantum-Enhanced Phase Estimation with Photon-Added Even and Odd Coherent States in an SU(1,1) Interferometer
articles.title_zh: SU(1,1)干涉仪中使用加光子偶相干态与奇相干态的量子增强相位估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04064v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate phase estimation in an SU(1,1) interferometer employing m-photon-added even and odd coherent states as nonclassical input resources. The phase sensitivity is evaluated through intensity detection and the error propagation method, while the ultimate precision limit is determined from the quantum Cramér-Rao bound with the quantum Fisher information serving as the relevant metrological quantity. Our results demonstrate that photon addition significantly enhances the phase sensitivity, increases the quantum Fisher information, and reduces the quantum Cramér-Rao bound, leading to a clear improvement over the corresponding even and odd coherent states. Furthermore, the achievable sensitivity exceeds the standard quantum limit and gradually approaches the Heisenberg scaling with increasing photon-addition number. We also find that the m-photon-added even coherent states exhibit a modest advantage over their odd counterparts. As m increases, however, this distinction becomes progressively weaker, suggesting that photon addition diminishes the role of the initial parity of the coherent state in determining the interferometric performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察在SU(1,1)干涉仪中以m光子添加偶、奇相干态作为非经典输入资源的相位估计性能。作者通过强度探测和误差传播评估相位灵敏度，并以量子费舍尔信息和量子克拉美—罗界确定最终精度极限。结果显示，光子添加可显著提升相位灵敏度并降低精度下界，使灵敏度超过标准量子极限并逐渐接近海森堡标度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.04064v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们研究了在SU(1,1)干涉仪中采用m光子添加偶相干态和奇相干态作为非经典输入资源的相位估计。相位灵敏度通过强度探测和误差传播方法进行评估，而最终精度极限则由量子克拉美—罗界确定，其中量子费舍尔信息作为相关的计量学量。我们的结果表明，光子添加显著增强了相位灵敏度，提高了量子费舍尔信息，并降低了量子克拉美—罗界，从而相对于相应的偶相干态和奇相干态带来明确改进。此外，可实现的灵敏度超过标准量子极限，并随着光子添加数的增加逐渐接近海森堡标度。我们还发现，m光子添加偶相干态相对于其奇相干态对应物表现出适度优势。然而，随着m增加，这种差异逐渐减弱，表明光子添加削弱了初始相干态宇称在决定干涉性能中的作用。

articles.title: Spurious quantum correlations
articles.title_zh: 伪量子关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04157v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In his seminal paper, Bell [Physics Physique Fizika 1, 195 (1964)] considers the correlations that result from space-like separated measurements on a pair of entangled particles. He uses relativity theory to motivate the Bell causal structure, then shows the existence of quantum correlations that cannot be explained classically within this causal structure. Classical explanations of such quantum correlations are possible in alternative causal structures, for instance, those that allow superluminal causal influences, but, as shown in [New Journal of Physics 17 033002 (2015)], all such alternative explanations require fine tuning (causation without correlation). Here we discuss the existence of spurious quantum correlations --- correlations that look quantum in one causal structure, but have a natural classical explanation in another. More precisely, there are causal structures that admit non-classical quantum correlations, but for which the same correlations have a classical explanation in another causal structure without fine tuning. The realisation in the other causal structure can also be achieved without breaking any natural constraints on the causal structure that follow from relativity theory. However, similarly to non-classical quantum correlations in the Bell causal structure, we find other causal structures with non-classical quantum correlations that do not have a classical causal explanation in any alternative causal structure without fine tuning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文讨论某些在一个因果结构中看似量子的关联，可能在另一个因果结构中具有自然的经典解释且无需精细调节。作者将其称为伪量子关联，并指出有些因果结构允许非经典量子关联，但相同关联可在其他满足相对论自然约束的因果结构中经典实现。不过，与贝尔因果结构中的非经典量子关联类似，仍存在无法在任何替代因果结构中无精细调节地获得经典因果解释的情形。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.04157v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在其开创性论文中，Bell [Physics Physique Fizika 1, 195 (1964)] 考虑了一对纠缠粒子在类空间隔测量所产生的关联。他利用相对论来引出贝尔因果结构，随后证明存在无法在该因果结构内以经典方式解释的量子关联。此类量子关联的经典解释在其他因果结构中是可能的，例如允许超光速因果影响的因果结构；但正如 [New Journal of Physics 17 033002 (2015)] 所示，所有这类替代解释都需要精细调节（即有因果作用而无关联）。本文讨论伪量子关联的存在——这些关联在一种因果结构中看起来是量子的，但在另一种因果结构中却具有自然的经典解释。更确切地说，存在一些因果结构允许非经典量子关联，但相同关联在另一种因果结构中可以在无需精细调节的情况下获得经典解释。在另一种因果结构中的实现也可以在不违反相对论所导出的任何自然因果结构约束的情况下完成。然而，类似于贝尔因果结构中的非经典量子关联，我们发现还有其他因果结构具有非经典量子关联，而这些关联无法在任何替代因果结构中在无需精细调节的情况下获得经典因果解释。

articles.title: Solving the Nonlinear Vlasov Equation on a Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 在量子计算机上求解非线性 Vlasov 方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.19310v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The practical applicability of a recent Carleman-linearization-based quantum algorithm for solving ordinary differential equations (ODEs) with quadratic nonlinearities is investigated for the nonlinear electrostatic Vlasov equation with Krook-type collision operators. The equation is discretized on a (1+1)-dimensional phase-space grid and mapped onto the input of the quantum algorithm. Upper bounds for the query and gate complexities are derived in the limit of large grid sizes and found to be polynomially larger than the time complexity of the corresponding classical algorithms, primarily due to the dimension, sparsity, and norm of the Carleman-linearized evolution matrix. The convergence criteria are shown to impose severe restrictions on physically relevant plasma applications, requiring dissipation levels far exceeding those provided by the Krook operator.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评估了一种基于 Carleman 线性化的量子算法用于求解非线性 Vlasov 方程的实际可行性。结果表明，该方法在网格尺寸较大时的查询与门复杂度高于对应经典算法，且收敛条件对物理上相关的等离子体应用限制较严。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究一种近期提出的、基于 Carleman 线性化的量子算法，用于求解带 Krook 型碰撞算子的非线性静电 Vlasov 方程的实际适用性。该方程在一个（1+1）维相空间网格上离散化，并映射为量子算法的输入。我们在大网格尺寸极限下推导了查询复杂度和门复杂度的上界，发现由于 Carleman 线性化演化矩阵的维数、稀疏性和范数等因素，其复杂度在多项式意义上大于相应经典算法的时间复杂度。结果还表明，算法的收敛条件对物理上有意义的等离子体应用施加了严格限制，所需耗散水平远高于 Krook 算子所能提供的水平。

articles.title: A linear rotor trapped and coupled to the vibrational modes of an ion crystal
articles.title_zh: 被俘获并耦合到离子晶体振动模中的线性转子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.00590v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: When molecular ions are trapped together with atomic ions in a Paul trap, their dipole moment couples the molecular rotation to the joint vibrational motion of the particles in the trap. To leverage this coupling for quantum control, a rotational transition in the molecule should be resonant with one of the ion crystal vibrational modes. Focusing on the example of singly charged thorium fluoride molecular ions, cotrapped with two ytterbium ions, we determine the conditions for resonant dipole-phonon coupling, fully accounting for the molecular hyperfine structure. We identify several choices for resonant coupling and discuss its detection using sideband-resolved laser spectroscopy and measurements of decoherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究分子离子在保罗阱中与原子离子共同俘获时，分子转动与晶体振动之间的偶极耦合条件。以钍氟分子离子与镱离子共同俘获为例，作者给出了若干可实现共振偶极-声子耦合的方案，并讨论了其探测方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当分子离子与原子离子共同俘获于保罗阱中时，它们的偶极矩会将分子转动与阱中粒子的联合振动运动耦合起来。为了利用这种耦合实现量子控制，分子中的某一转动跃迁应与离子晶体的某一振动模共振。以单电荷钍氟分子离子与两个镱离子共同俘获为例，我们在充分考虑分子超精细结构的基础上，确定了实现共振偶极-声子耦合的条件。我们识别出若干可用于共振耦合的选择，并讨论了利用边带分辨激光光谱以及退相干测量对其进行探测的方法。

articles.title: Analysis of the action of conventional trapped-ion entangling gates in qudit space
articles.title_zh: 在 qudit 空间中分析传统俘获离子纠缠门的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.21886v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Qudits, or multi-level quantum information carriers, present a promising path for scaling quantum computers. However, their use introduces increased complexity in quantum logic, necessitating careful control of relative phases between different qudit levels. In trapped-ion systems, entangling operations accumulate phases on specific levels that are no longer global, unlike in qubit architectures. Furthermore, the structure of multi-level gates becomes increasingly intricate with higher-dimensional Hilbert spaces. This work explores the theory of these additional local and nonlocal phases, accumulated in Mø lmer--Sø rensen and Light-shift gates. We propose methods to actively compensate for these phases, enhance gate robustness against parameter fluctuations, and simplify native gates for more efficient circuit decomposition. Our results pave the way toward the practical and scalable implementation of qudit-based quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究俘获离子体系中传统纠缠门在多能级量子比特体系中的相位累积与门结构问题。作者提出了补偿局域与非局域相位的方法，并旨在提升门对参数波动的鲁棒性，为 qudit 量子处理器的实现提供支持。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Qudit，即多能级量子信息载体，为量子计算机规模化提供了一条很有前景的路径。然而，它们的使用也带来了更高的逻辑复杂性，需要仔细控制不同 qudit 能级之间的相对相位。在俘获离子系统中，纠缠操作会在特定能级上累积相位，而这些相位不再像在量子比特体系中那样只是全局相位。此外，随着希尔伯特空间维度的升高，多能级门的结构也变得越来越复杂。本文研究了在 Mølmer--Sørensen 门和光移门中累积的这些额外局域相位与非局域相位的理论。我们提出了主动补偿这些相位、增强门对参数波动的鲁棒性以及简化原生门以实现更高效电路分解的方法。我们的结果为基于 qudit 的量子处理器走向实用化和可扩展实现铺平了道路。

articles.title: Selective Hypergraph Refinement for Frozen Graph Clustering
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing graph-clustering methods typically improve clustering performance by optimizing model parameters and node representations. Effective means of further improving the clustering results of an already trained and frozen model, however, remain limited. We study post-processing for frozen graph clustering. After checkpoint fixation, the procedure uses no labels and updates neither model parameters, node representations, nor the original graph structure. Instead, it exploits an attribute hypergraph to supplement higher-order relations that ordinary graphs cannot readily express, thereby refining existing cluster assignments. Because global hypergraph refinement can yield both performance gains and erroneous updates, we propose Selective Hypergraph Refinement (SHR). The method generates candidate residual directions from the hypergraph and evaluates their reliability using graph structure, node attributes, and matched-null evidence. It updates only nodes with sufficient support and otherwise retains their original assignments. Further analysis shows that whether a node changes cluster is jointly governed by its native assignment gap and the directional strength of the refinement. In a controlled common-suite evaluation, 13 of 15 backbone-dataset cells had a positive mean macro gain, one produced exact no-action, and one was negative. The cell-equal macro gain was 0.066 pp (95% bootstrap CI, [0.030, 0.107] pp), while only 0.209% of hard assignments changed on average. A broader 15-combination native-interface evaluation yielded a macro gain of 0.137 pp at a mean change ratio of 0.375%. These results indicate that frozen clustering outputs retain a limited but measurable refinement space after training. The effect is heterogeneous across backbone-dataset pairs, and broader coverage also increases exposure to negative transfer.

articles.title: Mind the Gap: Robustness Risks in PII Detection Systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection is a foundational component of data protection infrastructure where missed entities constitute direct privacy and security risks. Although modern PII systems report strong performance on standard benchmarks, we show that these evaluations mask substantial robustness failures under realistic distribution shifts encountered in deployment. Rather than comparing state-of-the-art accuracy, we study how different PII detection paradigms fail under noisy, unstructured, and informal inputs. We construct a stress test benchmark spanning seven categories of natural distribution shift and evaluate representative systems from three widely deployed architectural families: encoder-based NER (SpaCy), rule-based hybrid detection (Presidio), and generative LLM extraction (Qwen2.5-3B). All three exhibit significant degradation on out-of-distribution inputs, but with distinct and complementary failure modes. Encoder models primarily fail on unseen surface forms and boundary detection, rule-based systems fail on non-standard formats, and LLMs exhibit entity-type confusion and generation instability. These results show that aggregate benchmark scores obscure deployment-critical weaknesses and that no single architecture is uniformly reliable across PII categories. Motivated by these findings, we propose a hybrid detection pipeline with a QA-driven feedback loop for iterative risk mitigation, and release our benchmark to support OOD-aware evaluation of PII systems.

articles.title: Legibility is Not Interpretability: Comparing Judged and Actual Importance in Chain-Of-Thought Reasoning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04194v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reasoning traces from chain-of-thought models appear to offer a legible window into how a model arrives at its answer. A growing body of work treats them as such, using LLM judges to diagnose errors, evaluate faithfulness, and provide step-level supervision via process reward models and generative critics. These practices rely on the text of a reasoning step carrying information about its functional role. But does the text actually encode information about which reasoning steps matter? We operationalize the importance of a reasoning step as its advantage: the change in expected reward, e.g., producing the correct final answer, from including that step, estimated via Monte Carlo rollouts. Basing ground truth on these estimates, we evaluate whether LLM judges can identify high-advantage steps and find that sufficiently capable LLMs can outperform a prevalence baseline but fall well short of a noise ceiling. Fine-tuning a model as a step-level critic yields strong improvement for incorrect responses but remains distant from ceiling for correct responses, suggesting that step importance is only partially recoverable from the text of the reasoning trace. Our findings contribute to a growing body of chain-of-thought faithfulness work that cautions against treating the legibility of reasoning traces as interpretability, especially with implications for process reward modeling.

articles.title: Q-Edge: Symmetry-Reduced Quantum Simulation of Structured Extreme Dependence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03706v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-dimensional simulation of multivariate extremes is fundamentally limited by the combinatorial complexity of dependence, often more than by the scarcity of extreme observations. We show that symmetry admits a lossless orbit-space representation that preserves structured extreme dependence while replacing an exponentially large dependence space with a compact set of symmetry classes. Based on this principle, we develop Q-Edge (Quantum Extreme Dependence Engine), a symmetry-reduced quantum framework that operates directly in orbit space, enabling scalable simulation and digital twins of structured extreme systems. By transferring symmetry into the data representation rather than the quantum circuit, Q-Edge allows unconstrained quantum generative models to exploit dramatically reduced state spaces. For a 30-dimensional problem, approximately 1.6 million angular states collapse to 256 orbit states, reducing the required quantum representation from about 21 qubits to 8. Our results establish a general computational principle for scalable quantum simulation of structured extreme dependence.

articles.title: Beyond "Made with AI": Visualizing Provenance Density to Mitigate the Transparency Penalty
articles.title_zh: 超越“由 AI 制作”：可视化溯源密度以缓解透明度惩罚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03460v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As generative AI makes polished prose cheap to produce, users can no longer rely on fluency as a proxy for truth. We call this failure mode the Fluency Trap: users trust fluent hallucinations while also discounting accurate content once it is disclosed as AI-generated. Binary ``Made with AI'' labels respond with authorship disclosure, but they do not show what supports a claim. We propose Provenance Density, an evidence-visualization interface that shows the density of verified claims in a text. In a user study with 81 participants, an idealized Provenance Density interface produced a large discernment gap between truth and fabrication (+4.15 points, d=1.82), whereas participants given no signal showed no detectable discrimination. A technical audit with 200 samples shows that retrieval density alone is insufficient; unexpectedly, the Consistency Veto carries most of the discriminative signal on dynamic queries. As AI-generated content becomes indistinguishable from human writing, effective transparency must move from authorship disclosure toward evidence visualization.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着生成式 AI 使流畅文本的生产成本大幅降低，用户已难以将文笔流畅视为真实可靠的指标。本文提出“溯源密度”这一证据可视化界面，用于展示文本中经验证主张的密度。用户研究显示，该界面显著提高了用户区分真实与虚构内容的能力；技术审计则表明，仅靠检索密度不足以判别，动态查询中一致性否决机制贡献了主要判别信号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03460v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：随着生成式 AI 使精致流畅的文字变得廉价易得，用户不再能够依赖流畅性作为真实性的替代指标。我们将这种失效模式称为“流畅性陷阱”：用户会信任流畅的幻觉内容，同时也会在内容被披露为 AI 生成后低估其中准确内容的价值。二元的“由 AI 制作”标签以作者身份披露作为回应，但它们并不展示某项主张由什么证据支撑。我们提出“溯源密度”，这是一种证据可视化界面，用于显示文本中经验证主张的密度。在一项包含 81 名参与者的用户研究中，理想化的溯源密度界面在真实内容与虚构内容之间产生了很大的辨别差距（+4.15 分，d=1.82），而没有获得任何信号的参与者未显示出可检测的区分能力。一项包含 200 个样本的技术审计表明，仅有检索密度是不够的；出人意料的是，在动态查询中，一致性否决承载了大部分判别信号。随着 AI 生成内容变得与人类写作难以区分，有效的透明度必须从作者身份披露转向证据可视化。

articles.title: Speak for Me: Giving LLMs the Situational Awareness to Participate in a Meeting
articles.title_zh: 替我发言：赋予大语言模型参与会议的情境感知能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In online meeting delegation, LLM agents fail to recognize when to speak. With no structured way to track stances, coverage, and floor, they miss the moments where they should contribute. Prompt-only delegates stay silent on 51.4% of the absent participant's talking opportunities on the AMI corpus. We present CAPA (Collaborative Agent Predictive Architecture), an architecture for online meeting delegation. A Perceiver updates the meeting state from each observed turn. A Predictor forecasts how the conversation will continue. A Controller decides whether to speak and which proposition to surface. A Generator phrases the chosen contribution in the participant's style. Two judges score the forecast and the action against the next observed turn. A Recalibrator updates the meeting state from those verdicts for future decisions. To evaluate online delegation, we introduce an episode-level protocol that scores whether, when, and what a delegate contributes around the participant's actual idea units. The protocol's schema-constrained LLM judges align with human annotations at Cohen's kappa = 0.71. On 137 AMI meetings, CAPA reduces the silence rate from 51.4% to 2.5%, doubles credited recovery (26.1 --> 52.2), and keeps hallucination at 0.6%. The failure mode shifts from omission to selection, with each residual near-miss attributable to a specific module of the architecture. Mechanism ablations identify the meeting state as the lever that closes the recognition gap, where raw-context scaling alone does not.
articles.abstract_zh: 在线会议代理场景中，LLM 代理常因缺乏对立场、议题覆盖和发言权的结构化追踪而不知道何时应发言。本文提出 CAPA 架构，通过感知会议状态、预测对话走向、控制发言时机与内容，并根据评判结果重新校准状态来实现会议代理。实验显示，CAPA 在 AMI 会议语料上显著降低沉默率、提高有效补救，同时保持较低幻觉率，关键机制来自对会议状态的建模。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03923v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：在在线会议委托中，LLM 代理无法识别何时应该发言。由于没有结构化方式来跟踪立场、覆盖范围和发言权，它们会错过本应贡献意见的时刻。仅依赖提示词的代理在 AMI 语料库中会在缺席参与者 51.4% 的发言机会中保持沉默。我们提出 CAPA（协作式代理预测架构），这是一种用于在线会议委托的架构。感知器从每一个观察到的发言轮次更新会议状态。预测器预测对话将如何继续。控制器决定是否发言以及提出哪一项命题。生成器以该参与者的风格表述所选贡献。两个评判器根据下一轮实际观察到的发言对预测和行动进行评分。重新校准器依据这些评判结果更新会议状态，以供未来决策使用。为评估在线委托，我们引入了一种 episode 级协议，用于围绕参与者的实际思想单元评估代理是否、何时以及贡献了什么。该协议中受模式约束的 LLM 评判器与人工标注的一致性达到 Cohen's kappa = 0.71。在 137 场 AMI 会议上，CAPA 将沉默率从 51.4% 降至 2.5%，使获得认可的补救量翻倍（26.1 -> 52.2），并将幻觉率保持在 0.6%。失败模式从遗漏转向选择，剩余的每一次接近但未命中的情况都可归因于架构中的某个具体模块。机制消融实验表明，会议状态是弥合识别差距的关键杠杆，而仅扩大原始上下文并不能做到这一点。

articles.title: Interface-Induced Trajectory Censoring
articles.title_zh: 界面诱导的轨迹审查
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent evaluations report a tool-call rate read off the serving stack. That number can be zero while the model is emitting well-formed calls: the interface censors the trajectory before anything downstream sees it. On BFCL v4's own data, executor and scorer, holding weights, cases, decoding and seeds fixed and changing only the serving adapter, the same model scores 0.00 or 0.96 / 0.19. A 2x2 over chat template and parser locates the effect exactly: both main effects are exactly zero and all of it sits in the interaction -- no component is defective, and repairing one side of the contract buys precisely nothing. On tau-bench's 115 interactive retail tasks the same swap moves server-parsed calls from 0 to 636 and tasks reaching any tool execution from 0 to 103. Our probe reproduces the funnel across a 21x scale range of Qwen2.5-Coder: the server parses 0/100 at every size while well-formed emitted calls rise to 80/100 at 32B (~72 after calibration against an adjudicated gold standard). Under a matched envelope, across a comparable scale span, the silent fraction stays at 0-2, a prediction committed to the repository before the run. Llama-3.1-8B's 23% rate of calling the task function itself as a tool falls to 0 under one strict:true flag. The mismatch reaches inside the training loop, and its consequence is scale-dependent: in verl's AgentLoop at 7B, 45 of 115 generations carry a complete call; 0 are accepted, 0 execute, 0 return an observation. At 1.5B the same zero is over-determined, so we report the two scales separately. At evaluation time, repairing the adapter restores the mechanism but not a significant outcome gain: parsing 0->84, rescues 0->9, pass rate 53->62 (n.s.). We release a 98-line preflight check that catches every silent failure here. The observed tool-call rate is not a property of the model alone; it is a property of the model-interface stack that measures it.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，工具调用率并非仅由模型决定，而会受到服务接口栈的强烈影响。即使模型输出了格式良好的工具调用，接口也可能在下游组件看到之前将其“审查”掉。作者在 BFCL v4、tau-bench 和训练循环中展示了适配器、聊天模板与解析器契约不匹配造成的零调用或零执行现象，并发布了一个预检工具以捕捉这类静默失败。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03966v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：智能体评估报告的工具调用率通常是从服务栈中读出的。这个数字可以为零，即便模型正在发出格式良好的调用：界面会在任何下游组件看到它之前审查掉该轨迹。在 BFCL v4 自有的数据、执行器和评分器上，在保持权重、案例、解码和随机种子固定、仅改变服务适配器的情况下，同一个模型的得分可以是 0.00，也可以是 0.96 / 0.19。围绕聊天模板和解析器构造的 2x2 实验精确定位了该效应：两个主效应都正好为零，全部效应都位于二者的交互中——没有任何一个组件本身是有缺陷的，只修复契约的一侧完全没有收益。在 tau-bench 的 115 个交互式零售任务上，同样的替换使服务器解析到的调用从 0 增至 636，并使达到任意工具执行的任务数从 0 增至 103。我们的探针在 Qwen2.5-Coder 跨 21 倍规模范围内复现了这一漏斗：服务器在每个尺寸上都解析出 0/100，而格式良好的已发出调用在 32B 时上升到 80/100（经与裁定的黄金标准校准后约为 72）。在匹配的包络下，跨越相近的规模跨度，静默比例保持在 0-2，这是运行前提交到代码库中的预测。Llama-3.1-8B 将任务函数本身作为工具调用的比例为 23%，在一个 strict:true 标志下这一比例降为 0。这种不匹配延伸到训练循环内部，其后果具有尺度依赖性：在 verl 的 AgentLoop 中，7B 模型的 115 次生成里有 45 次携带完整调用；0 次被接受，0 次执行，0 次返回观察结果。在 1.5B 上，同样的零结果是过度决定的，因此我们分别报告这两个尺度。在评估时，修复适配器恢复了机制，但没有带来显著的结果收益：解析数 0->84，挽救数 0->9，通过率 53->62（不显著）。我们发布了一个 98 行的预检检查程序，可捕捉此处的每一种静默失败。观察到的工具调用率并不是模型单独的属性；它是测量该调用率的模型-界面栈的属性。

articles.title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation through Human-AI Interaction
articles.title_zh: 通过人机交互实现高效测试时适应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents are trained on population-scale data to encode broad capabilities spanning those of many practitioners. Yet the artifacts they produce rarely meet the personal bar professionals need to stake their reputation on. On realistic, open-ended tasks where success criteria are heterogeneous and insufficiently documented, individual expertise lives precisely in the elevation and departure from the average. In practice, iterative human-agent interaction surfaces criteria that users cannot fully specify up front, yet apply repeatedly across tasks. We argue this cross-session interaction data is a rich, underused signal for closing the gap to individual expertise. In this work, we propose test-time adaptation through human-agent interaction (TAHI), which integrates these signals into agent context and weights, and crystallizes each user's training and evaluation criteria via an evolving rubric module. We adapt agents to 30 individuals in two high-utility domains, writing and visual creation, on a total of 600 tasks. Our agents improve solo task success by 4.5-20.9% within only tens of tasks. Meanwhile, our evolving rubric module serves as a scalable annotation tool, creating evaluation rubrics that catch 16.0-22.3% more failures than those from LMs or humans alone. While agents are adapted towards individuals, we show these personalized agents also produce improvements in success of up to 8.8% that generalize across users.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文关注 AI 代理如何通过跨会话的人机交互数据适应个人专业标准。作者提出 TAHI 方法，将用户交互信号整合到代理上下文和权重中，并通过演化式评价量规模块沉淀个体训练与评估标准。在写作和视觉创作两个领域的实验表明，该方法能在少量任务内提升个人任务成功率，并生成更能发现失败的评价量规。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.04141v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：AI 代理在群体规模数据上训练，以编码涵盖许多从业者能力的广泛能力。然而，它们生成的作品很少达到专业人士愿意以自身声誉为其背书的个人标准。在现实的开放式任务中，成功标准是异质的且记录不足，而个体专业能力恰恰存在于对平均水平的提升以及对平均水平的偏离之中。在实践中，迭代式人类-代理交互会显露出用户无法在一开始完全明确说明、却会在多个任务中反复应用的标准。我们认为，这种跨会话交互数据是一种丰富但未被充分利用的信号，可用于弥合代理与个体专业能力之间的差距。在这项工作中，我们提出通过人类-代理交互进行测试时适应（TAHI），它将这些信号整合进代理的上下文和权重，并通过一个不断演化的量规模块使每位用户的训练与评价标准结晶化。我们在写作和视觉创作两个高效用领域中，使代理适应 30 名个体用户，共涉及 600 个任务。我们的代理在仅几十个任务内使单独任务成功率提高了 4.5-20.9%。同时，我们的演化式量规模块可作为可扩展的标注工具，创建出的评价量规比单独来自语言模型或人类的量规多捕捉 16.0-22.3% 的失败。尽管代理是朝个体用户适应的，我们还表明，这些个性化代理也能产生最高 8.8% 的成功率提升，并且这种提升可跨用户泛化。

articles.title: Air-Ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation via Shared Bird's-Eye Maps
articles.title_zh: 通过共享鸟瞰地图实现空地协同视觉语言导航
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03483v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Air-ground collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) pairs an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with a global bird's-eye view and an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) with a local first-person view, yet the setting remains largely unexplored: existing training-free methods solve single-agent tasks but offer no collaboration mechanism, and a recent CARLA-Air evaluation found no stable cooperative behavior across five state-of-the-art VLA models; naive semantic communication or bidirectional coupling even degrades performance. We establish AGC-VLN (Air-Ground Collaborative VLN), the first training-free baseline for air-ground collaborative VLN. The key insight is that training-free methods decompose navigation into VLM-based semantic reasoning and deterministic geometric execution, exposing a collaboration interface: the UAV's global view, over which it renders the UGV's reported pose and the VLM-anchored target as CAR/GOAL markers with distance labels, yielding a shared bird's-eye map. From this map, the UGV acquires global spatial context its first-person view cannot provide, plans a road-following path with a frozen VLM, and executes it under closed-loop control; in parallel, the UAV runs 3D-SPF, a spatial-search upgrade of SPF that localizes the target in the downward view and flies toward it. On 100 closed-loop episodes in CARLA-Air's Town10HD scene, AGC-VLN reaches a 77.0% joint success rate, a collaboration gain of +27.0% over the weaker individual agent (the UAV, 50.0%), and exceeds the strongest published single-agent baseline (Travel UAV, 53.0%) by 24.0 points, stemming from the complementarity of the UAV's global view and the UGV's road-following execution. Project page: https://github.com/ZSN2024/AGC-VLN.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 AGC-VLN，面向无人机与无人地面车协同的视觉语言导航，是一种无需训练的基线方法。方法利用无人机全局鸟瞰视角构建共享地图，并将其与地面车的局部第一人称视角和道路跟随执行结合。CARLA-Air 实验显示，该方法取得较高联合成功率，体现出空中全局观察与地面道路执行之间的互补性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.03483v1 公告类型：交叉稿 摘要：空地协同视觉语言导航（VLN）将具备全局鸟瞰视角的无人机（UAV）与具备局部第一人称视角的无人地面车（UGV）配对，但这一设定仍很少被探索：现有无需训练的方法可以解决单智能体任务，却没有提供协作机制，而近期的 CARLA-Air 评估发现，五种最先进的 VLA 模型都没有表现出稳定的协同行为；朴素的语义通信或双向耦合甚至会降低性能。我们建立了 AGC-VLN（空地协同 VLN），这是首个用于空地协同 VLN 的无需训练基线。关键洞见在于，无需训练的方法将导航分解为基于 VLM 的语义推理和确定性的几何执行，从而暴露出一个协作接口：无人机的全局视角，在该视角上渲染无人地面车报告的位姿以及由 VLM 锚定的目标，并以 CAR/GOAL 标记和距离标签显示，由此形成共享鸟瞰地图。借助这张地图，无人地面车获得其第一人称视角无法提供的全局空间上下文，使用冻结的 VLM 规划一条沿道路行驶的路径，并在闭环控制下执行；与此同时，无人机运行 3D-SPF，这是 SPF 的空间搜索升级版，用于在向下视角中定位目标并向其飞行。在 CARLA-Air 的 Town10HD 场景中进行的 100 个闭环 episode 上，AGC-VLN 达到 77.0% 的联合成功率，相较较弱的单个智能体（无人机，50.0%）带来 +27.0% 的协作增益，并比已发表的最强单智能体基线（Travel UAV，53.0%）高出 24.0 个百分点，这源于无人机全局视角与无人地面车道路跟随执行之间的互补性。项目页面见原文。

articles.title: A Blind Trust, the Bloody Thrust: When Attacker-Controlled Hook Updates Steer AI Agent Harnesses towards Malicious Behaviors
articles.title_zh: 盲目信任，血腥突袭：攻击者控制的钩子更新如何将人工智能代理框架引向恶意行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03884v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern AI agent harnesses expose lifecycle hooks that bind shell commands to runtime events such as session start, tool calls, and file edits. These commands run with host privileges yet ship as lifecycle-hook configuration and may fire at times the LLM never observes. We identify the lifecycle-hook update path, which harnesses trust blindly, as a new attack surface. Under a supply-chain threat model in which an attacker controls only plugin metadata and lifecycle-hook configuration, a benign versioned plugin can be trojanized by an update that silently binds attacker-chosen commands to benign events, yielding malicious host-side behavior such as privilege escalation. We propose HookPry, an open-source and fully automated attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability across heterogeneous AI agent harnesses. HookPry realizes ten attack objectives; across 25 combinations of harnesses and backends in 1,000 end-to-end runs, it compromises all seven evaluated harnesses, with per-harness success rates reaching 92.5%. Representative defenses remain insufficient: Microsoft Defender has 0% recall, and the union of three static defenses misses 47.5% of malicious artifacts.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代人工智能代理框架提供生命周期钩子，可将 shell 命令绑定到会话启动、工具调用和文件编辑等运行时事件。这些命令以主机权限运行，而生命周期钩子配置的更新路径却被框架盲目信任，从而形成新的攻击面。作者提出自动化攻击框架 HookPry，并通过大规模实验表明，所评估的七种代理框架均可被攻陷，现有防御措施也存在明显漏检。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代人工智能代理框架公开了生命周期钩子，可将 shell 命令绑定到会话启动、工具调用和文件编辑等运行时事件。这些命令以主机权限运行，但作为生命周期钩子配置的一部分发布，并且可能在大语言模型从未观察到的时间触发。我们识别出生命周期钩子更新路径这一新的攻击面，而各类框架会盲目信任该路径。在攻击者仅控制插件元数据和生命周期钩子配置的供应链威胁模型下，一个原本无害的版本化插件可以通过一次更新被植入木马；该更新会悄悄地将攻击者选择的命令绑定到无害事件上，从而产生包括权限提升在内的恶意主机侧行为。我们提出 HookPry，这是一个开源且完全自动化的攻击框架，能够系统性地利用不同人工智能代理框架中的这一漏洞。HookPry 可实现十种攻击目标；在涵盖多种框架与后端的 25 种组合、共 1,000 次端到端运行中，它攻陷了评估的全部七种框架，单个框架的成功率最高达到 92.5%。现有具有代表性的防御措施仍然不足：Microsoft Defender 的召回率为 0%，三个静态防御措施的并集仍漏检 47.5% 的恶意制品。

articles.title: PatchBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Vulnerability Patching
articles.title_zh: PatchBench：评估人工智能代理的漏洞修补能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04075v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI agents have recently demonstrated strong performance in automated vulnerability patching. However, existing evaluations often validate a patch only by testing whether the provided Proof-of-Concept (PoC) input still triggers a crash. This leaves two key threats to validity: agents may reproduce memorized historical developer patches, or they may generate surface-level fixes that only suppress the reported crash. We study these concerns for C/C++ vulnerability patching. We introduce a patch similarity metric to detect memorized patches. On average, 25% of the agent patches exhibit substantial similarity to historical developer patches, indicating that patch memorization is a real threat to the validity of vulnerability patching evaluations. Meanwhile, agents also frequently exploit benchmark structures to pass patch validation by patching on the crash stack trace to suppress the crash, rather than localizing and fixing the root cause of the vulnerabilities. To handle these issues, we propose PatchBench, a new benchmark for evaluating AI agents on realistic vulnerability patching tasks. PatchBench selects vulnerabilities whose ground-truth fixes lie outside the crash stack and uses vulnerability transplant and code mutations to migrate historical vulnerabilities into new repository contexts, reducing the risks of surface-level fixes and patch memorization. We develop new patch validation methods that thoroughly evaluate both security and semantic correctness of agent patches. Across 11 state-of-the-art agents, including the top three AIxCC agents, the original PoC-only validation inflates the patching task solve rate of agents by 1.83× on average. Our results reveal key limitations of current patching agents and point to future research directions for more reliable vulnerability repair.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有漏洞修补评估通常只检验给定概念验证输入是否仍会触发崩溃，因此可能高估代理的真实修补能力。作者发现，平均 25% 的代理补丁与历史开发者补丁具有较高相似性，且代理经常通过抑制崩溃而非修复根因来通过验证。为此，作者提出 PatchBench，通过漏洞移植、代码变异及同时评估安全性和语义正确性的验证方法，降低补丁记忆和表层修复带来的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，人工智能代理在自动化漏洞修补方面展现出较强性能。然而，现有评估通常只通过测试所提供的概念验证（PoC）输入是否仍会触发崩溃来验证补丁。这会带来两个关键的有效性威胁：代理可能复现记忆中的历史开发者补丁，或者生成仅仅抑制所报告崩溃的表层修复。我们针对 C/C++ 漏洞修补研究了这些问题。我们提出了一种补丁相似性度量，用于检测被记忆的补丁。平均而言，25% 的代理补丁与历史开发者补丁表现出较高相似性，表明补丁记忆确实对漏洞修补评估的有效性构成威胁。同时，代理还经常利用基准测试结构，通过针对崩溃堆栈跟踪进行修补来抑制崩溃，从而通过补丁验证，而不是定位并修复漏洞的根本原因。为处理这些问题，我们提出 PatchBench，这是一个用于评估人工智能代理执行真实漏洞修补任务的新基准。PatchBench 选取真实修复位于崩溃堆栈之外的漏洞，并利用漏洞移植和代码变异，将历史漏洞迁移到新的代码仓库环境中，从而降低表层修复和补丁记忆的风险。我们开发了新的补丁验证方法，全面评估代理补丁的安全性和语义正确性。在包括排名前三的 AIxCC 代理在内的 11 种最先进代理中，原先仅依赖 PoC 的验证方法平均将代理解决修补任务的比率夸大了 1.83 倍。我们的结果揭示了当前漏洞修补代理的关键局限，并为更可靠的漏洞修复指明了未来研究方向。

articles.title: Elucidating the interactions of an unmodified natural clay with cationic and anionic dyes: Toward sustainable remediation
articles.title_zh: 未改性天然黏土与阳离子和阴离子染料相互作用的阐明：迈向可持续修复
articles.abstract: Various environmental remediation methods have been employed to address dye contamination in water. Among these, adsorption stands out as a particularly advantageous process due to its simplicity, cost-effectiveness, high efficiency, and environmental friendliness. Clay-based adsorbents, in particular, have attracted considerable interest because of their unique physicochemical properties. Previous research has demonstrated the efficacy of Cuban natural palygorskite (PAL) in removing both cationic and anionic dyes, specifically methylene blue (MB) and Congo red (CR), respectively. Building on these findings, this study provides a detailed analysis of the characterization of the resulting PAL-CR and PAL-MB composites to elucidate the interactions governing clay/dye affinity. The composites were analyzed using attenuated total reflection infrared spectroscopy (ATR-FTIR) and thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), complemented by preliminary desorption studies in distilled water. The results indicate that the efficient adsorption of MB monomers parallel to the PAL surface is likely governed by electrostatic and hydrophobic interactions. Instead, the anionic CR adsorption onto PAL is dominated by hydrogen bonding, electrostatic interactions, and attractive supramolecular interactions due to the conformational flexibility of the dye. Desorption tests further confirmed the strong clay/dye interactions, indicating that the adsorption process is largely irreversible for both systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 吸附因操作简单、成本低、效率高且环境友好，成为处理水体染料污染的有利方法，黏土基吸附剂也因此受到关注。本研究对去除亚甲基蓝和刚果红后的古巴天然凹凸棒石复合材料进行 ATR-FTIR、热重分析及初步解吸研究，以阐明黏土与染料的作用机制。结果表明，亚甲基蓝主要通过静电和疏水作用吸附，而刚果红则主要受氢键、静电及超分子吸引作用控制；两种体系的吸附均基本不可逆。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们已经采用多种环境修复方法来处理水体中的染料污染。其中，吸附因其简单、经济、高效且环境友好，成为一种尤其有利的过程。黏土基吸附剂具有独特的物理化学性质，因此引起了特别广泛的兴趣。先前研究已经证明，古巴天然凹凸棒石（PAL）能够有效去除阳离子染料亚甲基蓝（MB）和阴离子染料刚果红（CR）。在这些发现的基础上，本研究对所得 PAL-CR 和 PAL-MB 复合材料进行了详细分析，以阐明控制黏土/染料亲和性的相互作用。研究采用衰减全反射傅里叶变换红外光谱（ATR-FTIR）和热重分析（TGA）对复合材料进行分析，并辅以在蒸馏水中的初步解吸研究。结果表明，MB 单体平行于 PAL 表面的高效吸附，可能由静电作用和疏水作用共同控制。相比之下，CR 阴离子在 PAL 上的吸附主要由氢键、静电作用以及由染料构象柔性产生的吸引性超分子相互作用控制。解吸试验进一步证实了强烈的黏土/染料相互作用，表明这两种体系中的吸附过程在很大程度上是不可逆的。

articles.title: Post-glacial carbon stocks in two restricted Patagonian fjord basins (52°S) using acoustic profiles and sediment cores
articles.title_zh: 利用声学剖面和沉积物岩心估算两个受限巴塔哥尼亚峡湾盆地的冰后期碳储量（52°S）
articles.abstract: Fjord sediment carbon is commonly quantified from burial rates or surficial stocks in individual cores; full-column basin-scale estimates that resolve sediment geometry remain scarce. In this study, post-glacial sediment carbon stocks are estimated for two restricted basins of the southern Patagonian fjord system, Bahía Caribe (BC, 0.87 km²) and Bahía Trampa (BT, 0.15 km²), by combining parametric sub-bottom profiling with core geochemistry. The seafloor surface and basal acoustic horizon were modelled by sequential Gaussian simulation, generating 1000 sediment-thickness realisations. Depocentre profiles of volumetric total organic carbon (TOC) and total inorganic carbon (TIC) density were integrated over the simulated thickness fields; densities below the core base were held at the lowermost measured interval. Full-column basin stocks are 6.51 × 10⁴ t TOC and 3.80 × 10⁴ t TIC in BC, and 1.34 × 10⁴ t TOC and 0.46 × 10⁴ t TIC in BT, giving basin-mean areal densities of 119 kg C m⁻² and 122 kg C m⁻². Inorganic carbon accounts for 37% of the basin inventory in BC and 25% in BT, attributed to biogenic carbonate accumulation in catchments without carbonate bedrock. At the depocentres, full-column inventories exceed upper-10-cm surficial stocks by approximately two orders of magnitude. On an areal basis, basin-mean TOC densities are comparable in magnitude to regional peatland soil-carbon densities, and TIC forms a substantial but distinct component of the sediment carbon inventory.
articles.abstract_zh: 峡湾沉积物碳储量通常依据埋藏速率或单个岩心表层储量进行量化，而能够解析沉积物几何结构的全柱状盆地尺度估算仍较少见。本研究结合参数化亚底层剖面测量与岩心地球化学分析，估算巴塔哥尼亚南部峡湾系统两个受限盆地的冰后期沉积物碳储量。结果显示，有机碳和无机碳均构成重要储量，且全柱状储量显著高于表层 10 厘米储量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 峡湾沉积物碳储量通常根据埋藏速率或单个岩心中的表层储量进行量化；能够解析沉积物几何结构的全柱状盆地尺度估算仍然十分少见。本研究通过结合参数化亚底层剖面测量与岩心地球化学分析，估算了巴塔哥尼亚南部峡湾系统两个受限盆地，即 Bahía Caribe（BC，0.87 km²）和 Bahía Trampa（BT，0.15 km²）的冰后期沉积物碳储量。研究采用序贯高斯模拟对海底表面和底部声学界面进行建模，生成了 1,000 个沉积物厚度实现值。研究将沉积中心剖面中的体积总有机碳（TOC）和总无机碳（TIC）密度整合到模拟厚度场中；对于岩心底部以下的区域，则将密度设定为最低实测层段的数值。BC 的全柱状盆地储量为 6.51 × 10⁴ 吨 TOC 和 3.80 × 10⁴ 吨 TIC，BT 的全柱状盆地储量为 1.34 × 10⁴ 吨 TOC 和 0.46 × 10⁴ 吨 TIC，对应的盆地平均面密度分别为 119 kg C m⁻² 和 122 kg C m⁻²。无机碳分别占 BC 和 BT 盆地总储量的 37% 和 25%，这被归因于没有碳酸盐基岩的集水区中发生的生物成因碳酸盐累积。在沉积中心，全柱状储量约为表层 10 厘米储量的两个数量级以上。按面积计算，盆地平均 TOC 密度与区域泥炭地土壤碳密度处于相近量级，而 TIC 则构成沉积物碳储量中一个重要但性质不同的组成部分。

articles.title: Competitive reaction pathways in oxidative dehydrogenation of propane over monolayer V2O5/TiO2 catalysts: Experiment and theoretical insights
articles.title_zh: 单层 V₂O₅/TiO₂ 催化剂上丙烷氧化脱氢中的竞争反应路径：实验与理论分析
articles.abstract: Oxidative dehydrogenation of propane to propylene over a monolayer vanadia-titania catalyst was studied in situ using Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIRS). It was found that two types of active species capable of activating C–H bonds exist on the catalyst surface: vanadyl oxygen species (V = O) and hydroxyl groups (V–OH). The adsorption of propane onto vanadyl oxygen activates a C–H bond, subsequently initiating the transfer of a proton from the methylene group to another vanadyl oxygen, which leads to the formation of a new hydroxyl group and an isopropyl group. Alternatively, propane can adsorb onto a surface hydroxyl group to form a hydrogen-bonded complex. This surface complex is unstable and can decompose via the cleavage of a C–H bond in a methyl group, transferring the proton to the nearest vanadyl oxygen to form a new hydroxyl group and hydrogen-bonded n-propyl group. These findings indicate that the dehydrogenation of propane over the monolayer V2O5/TiO2 catalyst can proceed via at least two distinct reaction pathways, initiated either by the adsorption of propane onto vanadyl oxygen species or onto the surface hydroxyl groups. The energy profiles for these pathways were calculated using the density functional theory (DFT). The DFT calculations demonstrated that the pathway initiated by the formation of a hydrogen-bonded complex between surface hydroxyl groups and propane is more thermodynamically favorable than the pathway starting with the adsorption of propane onto vanadyl oxygen species. In both pathways, two C–H bonds are cleaved and two protons are transferred to the vanadyl oxygen species to form new hydroxyl groups and propylene.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用原位傅里叶变换红外光谱研究了单层钒氧化物-二氧化钛催化剂上的丙烷氧化脱氢反应，并发现两类能够活化 C–H 键的活性物种，即钒氧物种和羟基。丙烷可分别吸附于钒氧或表面羟基上，从而沿两条不同路径发生脱氢。密度泛函理论计算表明，以表面羟基与丙烷形成氢键复合物为起点的路径在热力学上更有利；两条路径最终均断裂两个 C–H 键并生成丙烯。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIRS）原位研究了单层钒氧化物-二氧化钛催化剂上丙烷氧化脱氢生成丙烯的反应。研究发现，催化剂表面存在两类能够活化 C–H 键的活性物种：钒氧基氧物种（V=O）和羟基（V–OH）。丙烷吸附到钒氧基氧上后，会活化一个 C–H 键，随后亚甲基上的质子转移到另一个钒氧基氧上，形成新的羟基和异丙基。另一种情况下，丙烷可以吸附到表面羟基上，形成氢键复合物。该表面复合物不稳定，可以通过断裂甲基上的 C–H 键发生分解，将质子转移到最近的钒氧基氧上，形成新的羟基和通过氢键结合的正丙基。这些发现表明，单层 V₂O₅/TiO₂ 催化剂上的丙烷脱氢至少可以通过两条不同的反应路径进行，其起始步骤分别是丙烷吸附到钒氧物种上，或吸附到表面羟基上。我们利用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算了这些路径的能量分布。DFT 计算表明，以表面羟基与丙烷形成氢键复合物为起点的路径，在热力学上比从丙烷吸附到钒氧基氧物种开始的路径更有利。在两条路径中，均有两个 C–H 键断裂，并有两个质子转移到钒氧基氧物种上，从而形成新的羟基和丙烯。

articles.title: MnO₂ catalyzed hydrothermal regeneration of spent LiFePO₄ cathode materials for sustainable lithium-ion battery recycling
articles.title_zh: MnO₂ 催化废旧 LiFePO₄ 正极材料的水热再生：面向可持续锂离子电池回收
articles.abstract: Large-scale retirement of LiFePO₄ (LFP) batteries from electric vehicle and energy storage industries poses severe resource waste and environmental risks, while conventional LFP recycling technologies are limited by high energy consumption, secondary pollution and insufficient lattice repair. Herein, a recyclable MnO₂-catalyzed hydrothermal strategy is proposed for high-value regeneration of degraded LFP cathodes. Integrated hydrothermal treatment with Li₃PO₄@MnO₂ composite lithium source and glucose reductant and subsequent annealing achieve synchronous Li⁺ compensation and Fe³⁺ reduction, realizing thorough lattice defect remediation. Structural and electrochemical characterizations systematically verify the material reconstruction and MnO₂ catalytic mechanism. Under optimal conditions, the regenerated LFP exhibits a well-reconstructed crystal structure with a Li/Fe molar ratio of 0.98, close to pristine commercial LFP. It delivers a discharge capacity of 142.3 mAh·g⁻¹ at 0.2 C, excellent cycling stability over 200 cycles at 1 C, and a low charge-transfer resistance of 87.35 Ω, superior to catalyst-free samples. Mechanistically, MnO₂ acts as an electron mediator to lower reaction barriers and build a dual catalysis–lithium replenishment system for complete LFP lattice reconstruction. This low-cost, eco-friendly approach provides a feasible route for high-value recycling of spent LFP cathodes and promotes the sustainable development of power battery industries.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对退役 LiFePO₄ 电池造成的资源浪费和环境风险，本研究提出了一种可循环使用的 MnO₂ 催化水热再生策略。通过 Li₃PO₄@MnO₂ 复合锂源、葡萄糖还原剂及后续退火，实现 Li⁺ 补偿与 Fe³⁺ 还原同步进行，从而修复晶格缺陷。在最佳条件下，再生材料具有接近商业原始 LiFePO₄ 的晶体结构和锂铁比，并表现出较高放电容量、良好循环稳定性及较低电荷转移电阻。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电动汽车和储能行业中 LiFePO₄（LFP）电池的大规模退役造成了严重的资源浪费和环境风险，而传统 LFP 回收技术受到能耗高、二次污染以及晶格修复不充分等问题的限制。在此，我们提出一种可循环使用的 MnO₂ 催化水热策略，用于高价值再生性能退化的 LFP 正极。将采用 Li₃PO₄@MnO₂ 复合锂源和葡萄糖还原剂的水热处理与后续退火相结合，可实现 Li⁺ 补偿和 Fe³⁺ 还原同步进行，从而彻底修复晶格缺陷。结构和电化学表征系统地验证了材料重构过程及 MnO₂ 的催化机制。在最佳条件下，再生 LFP 展现出重构良好的晶体结构，其 Li/Fe 摩尔比为 0.98，接近商业原始 LFP。该材料在 0.2 C 下的放电容量达到 142.3 mAh·g⁻¹，在 1 C 下循环 200 次仍具有优异的循环稳定性，电荷转移电阻低至 87.35 Ω，性能优于不使用催化剂的样品。从机理上看，MnO₂ 充当电子介体，降低反应能垒，并构建催化与补锂协同的双重体系，实现 LFP 晶格的完整重构。这种低成本、环境友好的方法为废旧 LFP 正极的高价值回收提供了可行路径，并推动动力电池产业的可持续发展。

articles.title: Geometry-controlled effects of circular and semi-circular laser textures on the tribological behavior of G13Cr14Co12Mo5Ni2 bearing steel
articles.title_zh: 圆形与半圆形激光纹理的几何控制效应对 G13Cr14Co12Mo5Ni2 轴承钢摩擦学行为的影响
articles.abstract: This study investigates the influence of texture geometry on the tribological performance of G13Cr14Co12Mo5Ni2 bearing steel by comparing circular and semi-circular laser textures with nearly identical projected areas and depths. The textures were fabricated using ultraviolet femtosecond laser processing, and their tribological behaviors were evaluated through ball-on-disk tests under dry sliding and PAO6 lubrication conditions. Surface morphology, wear characteristics and elemental distributions were analyzed by three-dimensional profilometry and SEM–EDS, while a thin-film lubrication model was developed to clarify the geometric effect on local pressure generation. Under PAO6 lubrication at 30 N, the semi-circular texture achieved the lowest friction coefficient 0.11–0.13 and specific mass wear rate 2.98 × 10⁻⁷ g·N⁻¹·m⁻¹. Compared with the circular texture, the semi-circular geometry exhibited improved debris accommodation, reduced ploughing damage and enhanced texture-edge integrity. Numerical analysis revealed that the asymmetric geometry generated stronger local positive-pressure responses, promoting lubricant redistribution and load support. These findings demonstrate that texture asymmetry provides an effective strategy for improving lubricated tribological performance by integrating lubricant retention, debris management and pressure regulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在投影面积和深度近似相同的条件下，比较圆形与半圆形激光纹理对 G13Cr14Co12Mo5Ni2 轴承钢摩擦学性能的影响。研究采用紫外飞秒激光制备纹理，并在干滑动和 PAO6 润滑条件下进行球-盘试验。结果表明，在 PAO6 润滑和 30 N 载荷下，半圆形纹理具有更低的摩擦系数和比质量磨损率，其非对称几何形状有利于碎屑容纳、减轻犁削损伤并增强润滑剂再分配和承载能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究通过比较投影面积和深度近乎相同的圆形与半圆形激光纹理，研究纹理几何形状对 G13Cr14Co12Mo5Ni2 轴承钢摩擦学性能的影响。纹理采用紫外飞秒激光加工制备，其摩擦学行为通过干滑动和 PAO6 润滑条件下的球-盘试验进行评估。研究利用三维轮廓测量和扫描电子显微镜-能量色散 X 射线谱（SEM–EDS）分析表面形貌、磨损特征和元素分布，同时建立薄膜润滑模型，以阐明几何形状对局部压力产生的影响。在 PAO6 润滑、30 N 载荷下，半圆形纹理实现了最低的摩擦系数 0.11–0.13 和比质量磨损率 2.98 × 10⁻⁷ g·N⁻¹·m⁻¹。与圆形纹理相比，半圆形几何形状表现出更好的碎屑容纳能力、更小的犁削损伤以及更高的纹理边缘完整性。数值分析表明，非对称几何形状产生了更强的局部正压力响应，促进了润滑剂再分配和载荷支撑。这些发现表明，纹理非对称性可通过整合润滑剂保持、碎屑管理和压力调节，有效改善润滑条件下的摩擦学性能。

articles.title: Machine learning interatomic potentials for solid-state precipitation
articles.title_zh: 用于固态析出的机器学习原子间势
articles.abstract: Author(s): Lorenzo Piersante and Anirudh Raju Natarajan Machine-learning interatomic potentials now model complex alloys with near a b i n i t i o precision, but two challenges persist. Researchers must generate training data tailored to the physical process of interest, and they need validation metrics that go beyond simple statistical errors. Here the authors introduce a crystal-symmetry-based enumeration scheme for structural phase transformations in multicomponent alloys and a semi-grand-canonical Kendall-τ that quantifies thermodynamic accuracy across composition. These tools yield a general-purpose Mg-Nd potential. Simulations reveal a subtle interplay between chemical ordering and structural rearrangement and elucidate the continuous hcp-to-bcc transition underlying precipitation in this alloy. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 093802] Published Fri Sep 04, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势能够以接近第一性原理的精度模拟复杂合金，但训练数据设计和超越简单统计误差的验证指标仍是挑战。作者提出基于晶体对称性的多组分合金结构相变枚举方法，以及用于量化跨成分热力学准确性的半巨正则 Kendall-τ 指标。基于这些工具构建的通用镁-钕势函数揭示了化学有序与结构重排之间的相互作用，并阐明了该合金析出过程中连续的六方密排结构到体心立方结构转变。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文发展面向固态析出过程的机器学习原子间势，提出基于晶体对称性的结构相变枚举训练数据生成方案，并用半大正则 Kendall-τ 指标评估热力学排序精度。作者构建了 Mg-Nd 合金势函数，揭示了析出过程中化学有序与结构重排及连续 hcp-bcc 转变的耦合。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们工作的机器学习势、主动学习、高通量结构采样、相变和材料模拟高度相关。其面向具体物理过程构造训练集和用热力学排序验证势函数的思路，可直接借鉴到铁电相变、离子扩散或复杂磁性材料模拟。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点关注其结构枚举和热力学验证指标，而不只看常规能量/力误差。可尝试将类似策略用于 HfO2 铁电相稳定性、卤化物钙钛矿相变或电池材料析相过程的机器学习势开发。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势如今能够以接近第一性原理的精度模拟复杂合金，但仍存在两个挑战。研究人员必须生成针对目标物理过程的训练数据，同时还需要超越简单统计误差的验证指标。在本文中，作者提出了一种基于晶体对称性的多组分合金结构相变枚举方案，以及一种半巨正则 Kendall-τ 指标，用于量化跨成分范围的热力学准确性。这些工具产生了一个通用的 Mg-Nd 势函数。模拟揭示了化学有序与结构重排之间微妙的相互作用，并阐明了该合金析出过程中连续的六方密排结构到体心立方结构的转变。

articles.title: Experimental Evidence for Coronal Mass Ejection Suppression in Strong Stellar Magnetic Fields
articles.title_zh: 强恒星磁场中日冕物质抛射受抑制的实验证据
articles.abstract: Author(s): S. N. Chen, K. Burdonov, W. Yao, J. D. Alvarado-Gómez, C. Argiroffi, J. Béard, S. Bolanõs, R. Bonito, A. Ciardi, I. Cohen, O. Cohen, J. J. Drake, S. Orlando, and J. Fuchs Using high-power lasers to drive highly magnetized plasmas, researchers have probed the stellar processes that control coronal mass ejections. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 105201] Published Fri Sep 04, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕利用高功率激光驱动强磁化等离子体，探究控制恒星日冕物质抛射的物理过程展开。研究重点是强恒星磁场是否会抑制日冕物质抛射，具体实验结果和定量结论需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究人员利用高功率激光驱动强磁化等离子体，探究了控制恒星日冕物质抛射的恒星过程。该摘要未提供更详细的实验方法、具体数据或定量结论，相关详情需查阅原文。

articles.title: Giant Thermopower Changes Related to the Resistivity Maximum and Colossal Magnetoresistance in EuCd₂P₂
articles.title_zh: EuCd₂P₂ 中与电阻率极大值和巨磁阻相关的巨大热电势变化

articles.title: Hyperfine-resolved variational nuclear motion spectra of homonuclear diatomic molecules
articles.title_zh: 同核双原子分子超精细分辨的变分核运动光谱
articles.abstract: The diatomic variational nuclear-motion program duo is extended to calculate hyperfine-resolved spectra of homonuclear diatomic molecules. The hyperfine interactions considered include five nuclear magnetic dipole terms and one nuclear electric quadrupole term. Nuclear-exchange symmetry is explicitly incorporated, and the final hyperfine-resolved parity-adapted Hamiltonian is constructed in a complete angular-momentum basis. After diagonalization of this Hamiltonian, hyperfine-resolved line lists can be generated using transition electric dipole and quadrupole moment curves. To validate the implementation, we apply the extended program to H 2 and D 2 , as well as 14 N 2 and 14 N2+, and compare the calculated results with those from previous experimental and theoretical work and from the perturbative program pgopher ; good agreement is obtained in all cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将双原子变分核运动程序 duo 扩展到可计算同核双原子分子的超精细分辨光谱。研究纳入核交换对称性与超精细相互作用，并用 H2、D2、14N2 和 14N2+ 等体系验证了该方法，与既有实验和理论结果符合良好。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文将双原子变分核运动程序 duo 扩展到用于计算同核双原子分子的超精细分辨光谱。所考虑的超精细相互作用包括五项核磁偶极项和一项核电四极项。核交换对称性被显式纳入，最终在完整角动量基组中构造出经过宇称适配的超精细哈密顿量。对该哈密顿量进行对角化后，可结合跃迁电偶极矩和电四极矩曲线生成超精细分辨的谱线表。为验证该实现，作者将扩展后的程序应用于 H2 和 D2，以及 14N2 和 14N2+，并将计算结果与先前的实验和理论工作以及微扰程序 PGOPHER 的结果进行比较；各项结果均取得良好一致。

articles.title: Interaction-energy statistics from structural correlations
articles.title_zh: 基于结构相关性的相互作用能统计
articles.abstract: We introduce a unified statistical framework for quantifying system–environment coupling by treating the interaction energy VSE as a stochastic variable. Using our proposed reference-particle decomposition, we derive exact, closed-form expressions for the mean and variance of VSE in terms of the single-particle density and correlation functions up to fourth order. These expressions are valid throughout all coupling regimes, from strongly coupled finite systems to the weak-coupling thermodynamic limit. They connect interaction-energy statistics directly to equilibrium structural information and provide a systematic route for evaluating coupling across open system–environment boundaries. We further show how the moment framework enters free energy constructions, including the Hamiltonian of mean force and the quasichemical-theory outer-shell contribution. When the relevant interaction-energy distribution is approximately Gaussian, the first two moments determine the corresponding second-cumulant free energy estimate. To validate our framework, we performed explicit Monte Carlo simulations of a Lennard-Jones system across a range of system sizes, generating reference distributions of the system–environment interaction energy VSE. We also performed independent empty-cavity Monte Carlo calculations to validate the quasichemical outer-shell specialization. We then applied our derived analytical formulas to predict these distributions and found excellent agreement in both the weak- and strong-coupling regimes. The results demonstrate that interaction-energy distributions and the associated thermodynamic contributions can be reconstructed from microscopic structural correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个统一的统计框架，将系统-环境耦合视为相互作用能的随机变量，并可由结构相关函数重建其均值与方差。该框架可用于自由能构造及多种耦合情形下的统计分析，且经蒙特卡洛模拟验证与数值结果一致良好。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一个统一的统计框架，通过将系统—环境相互作用能 V_SE 视为随机变量来量化系统与环境之间的耦合。借助我们提出的参考粒子分解方法，可从单粒子密度以及最高到四阶的相关函数中推导出 V_SE 均值与方差的精确闭式表达式。这些表达式适用于所有耦合强度范围，从强耦合的有限体系到弱耦合的热力学极限均适用。它们将相互作用能统计量与平衡结构信息直接联系起来，并为跨越开放系统—环境边界评估耦合提供了系统途径。我们进一步表明，这一矩框架可进入自由能构造中，包括平均力哈密顿量以及准化学理论的外层贡献。当相关的相互作用能分布近似为高斯分布时，前两个矩即可确定相应的二阶累积自由能估计。为验证该框架，我们对 Lennard-Jones 体系在一系列系统尺寸下进行了显式蒙特卡洛模拟，生成了系统—环境相互作用能 V_SE 的参考分布。我们还进行了独立的空腔蒙特卡洛计算，以验证准化学理论中的外层专门化形式。随后，我们将推导出的解析公式用于预测这些分布，并在弱耦合和强耦合两种情形下都获得了极好的一致性。结果表明，相互作用能分布及其相关热力学贡献可以由微观结构相关性重建。

articles.title: Lithium solvation and interfacial structure in a ternary carbonate electrolyte at electrified graphite interface: Constant charge vs constant potential molecular dynamics
articles.title_zh: 三元碳酸酯电解质在带电石墨界面中的锂溶剂化与界面结构：定电荷与定电势分子动力学比较
articles.abstract: Multicomponent carbonate electrolytes are central to next generation electrochemical energy storage devices, and the choice of electrode model strongly shapes their predicted interfacial behavior. This study compares the constant charge method (CCM) and constant potential method (CPM) for modeling electrified interfaces in such electrolytes. Molecular dynamic simulations are performed for 1 M LiPF 6 in an ethylene carbonate:dimethyl carbonate:ethyl methyl carbonate ternary carbonate electrolyte sandwiched between two graphite electrodes. Results show that CCM and CPM give nearly identical interfacial structures at low and moderate polarization, with clear deviations emerging at ±1.35 V, equivalent to a 2.70 V cell voltage. This method-dependent response originates mainly from Li + behavior at the negative electrode, where CCM promotes partial desolvation and contact-like adsorption, whereas CPM preserves solvent separated adsorption through dynamic charge redistribution and stronger interfacial solvent ordering. Meanwhile, PF6− distributions remain comparatively insensitive to electrode treatment. This study defines the polarization regime where CCM is sufficient and establishes when CPM is required to capture coupled Li + /solvent/electrode interactions in carbonate solvent-based energy storage electrolytes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了恒电荷方法与恒电势方法在描述多组分碳酸酯电解质电化界面时的差异。结果表明，在低到中等极化下两者几乎一致，而在较高极化下，锂离子、溶剂化结构与电极处理方式之间的耦合差异开始显著显现。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.focus_summary: 该论文用分子动力学比较恒电荷和恒电势两种电极模型对三元碳酸酯电解液/石墨界面的描述。结果表明低到中等极化下两者界面结构接近，高极化下锂离子在负极附近的溶剂化和吸附行为出现明显差异。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们工作中的锂电池材料、固液界面、分子动力学和界面电荷行为方向中等相关。其恒电势界面建模对研究固态电解质、电极界面和离子迁移具有方法参考价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可重点阅读其恒电势分子动力学实现和界面锂离子溶剂化分析方法。后续可考虑将类似电极边界条件用于固态电解质/电极界面或机器学习势加速的电化学界面模拟。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多组分碳酸酯电解质是下一代电化学储能器件的核心组成，而电极模型的选择会显著影响其预测的界面行为。本研究比较了恒电荷方法（CCM）与恒电势方法（CPM）在此类电解质电化界面建模中的表现。作者对 1 M LiPF6 在乙烯碳酸酯：二甲基碳酸酯：乙基甲基碳酸酯三元碳酸酯电解质中的分子动力学进行了模拟，该电解质被置于两片石墨电极之间。结果表明，在低到中等极化条件下，CCM 和 CPM 给出的界面结构几乎相同；但当电势达到 ±1.35 V（对应 2.70 V 电池电压）时，二者开始出现明显差异。该方法依赖性响应主要源于负极侧的 Li+ 行为：CCM 会促进部分去溶剂化并形成类接触吸附，而 CPM 由于动态电荷重分布和更强的界面溶剂有序化，则保持溶剂分隔吸附。与此同时，PF6− 的分布对电极处理方式相对不敏感。该研究界定了 CCM 足够适用的极化范围，并明确了何时需要 CPM 才能捕捉碳酸酯溶剂型储能电解质中 Li+/溶剂/电极的耦合相互作用。

articles.title: Field-driven peptide transport across the inner mitochondrial membrane via a transient membrane pore
articles.title_zh: 通过瞬态膜孔实现电场驱动的肽跨内线粒体膜转运
articles.abstract: Cell-penetrating peptides translocate across a membrane via different mechanisms. In this work, we employ coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations to study the effect of an external electric field, which mimics the transmembrane potential, on the stability of a mitochondrial membrane and the translocation of peptide(s) across it. In the absence of peptides, we observed that the membrane undulates under the applied field and develops a curvature promoted by the presence of cardiolipin, which further leads to the formation of a transient pore caused by the merging of the phospholipids from the upper leaflet into the lower leaflet. We also studied the translocation of two different mitomembrane-targeting peptides at various electric field intensities in which the integrity of the membrane was preserved. Under the applied field, we observed that the cationic residues of each peptide bound to the phosphate headgroups of lipids, gradually moving toward the membrane region where a transient pore forms at a critical field strength, followed by the translocation across the mitomembrane via this transient pore. Comparing systems containing single peptides with those containing ten peptides of each type, we found that the transport of multiple peptides across the mitomembrane requires lower field magnitudes, no more than two peptides translocate at a time, and the translocation time, once in the pore, is marginally higher for multiple peptides compared to a single peptide. Overall, the findings from this work enhance our understanding of the effect of the transmembrane potential on the transport of mitomembrane-targeting peptides.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用粗粒化分子动力学模拟研究外加电场对线粒体膜稳定性以及肽跨膜转运的影响。结果显示，电场可诱导膜弯曲并形成瞬态孔道，肽可借助该孔道完成跨膜转运，揭示了膜电位对线粒体靶向肽运输的作用。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 细胞穿膜肽可以通过不同机制跨越膜结构。在本研究中，我们采用粗粒化分子动力学模拟，研究外加电场（模拟跨膜电位）对线粒体膜稳定性以及肽跨膜转运的影响。在没有肽的情况下，我们观察到膜在所加电场下会起伏，并在心磷脂存在时形成弯曲；这种弯曲进一步导致瞬态孔的形成，其原因是上层脂单层的磷脂并入下层脂单层。我们还研究了两种不同的线粒体膜靶向肽在不同电场强度下的跨膜转运，此时膜的完整性得以保持。在所加电场下，我们观察到每条肽中的阳离子残基会与脂质磷酸头基结合，并逐渐向膜区域移动；在达到临界电场强度时，瞬态孔形成，随后肽通过该瞬态孔跨越线粒体膜。比较单肽体系与包含每种肽各十条的体系，我们发现，多肽跨越线粒体膜所需的电场强度更低；在任一时刻跨越的肽不超过两条；且一旦进入孔道，多肽体系中的转运时间略高于单肽体系。总体而言，本工作加深了我们对跨膜电位影响线粒体膜靶向肽运输机制的理解。

articles.title: Predicting solubility of molecular liquids using first principles and adaptive force matching
articles.title_zh: 利用第一性原理与自适应力匹配预测分子液体的溶解度
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of solubility is crucial in various fields, including pharmaceuticals, environmental chemistry, and materials science. In this study, we demonstrate the application of Adaptive Force Matching (AFM) to predict the solubility of molecular liquids in water. By developing high-quality force fields using AFM, we accurately compute the free energy of vaporization and hydration, which are essential components for predicting solubility. Our results show that AFM models can reliably predict the solvation free energy of selected small molecules, exhibiting a deviation of <1.3 kJ/mol from experimental references for cyclohexene, isopentane, and n-butanol. Although a slightly larger error is observed for n-octanol, which was developed by borrowing AFM parameters from other molecules, the deviation remains comparable to commonly accepted chemical accuracy. This study highlights the potential of AFM as a powerful tool for predicting solubility, enabling the design and development of new materials and molecules with tailored properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了自适应力匹配方法在预测水中分子液体溶解度方面的应用。通过构建高质量力场并计算汽化与水合自由能，作者对若干小分子的溶剂化自由能获得了与实验较为一致的结果，说明该方法具有较强的预测能力。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确预测溶解度在制药、环境化学和材料科学等多个领域都至关重要。本研究展示了自适应力匹配（AFM）在预测水中分子液体溶解度方面的应用。通过开发高质量力场，作者精确计算了汽化自由能和水合自由能，而这两者是预测溶解度所必需的组成部分。结果表明，AFM 模型能够可靠预测所选小分子的溶剂化自由能；对于环己烯、异戊烷和正丁醇，与实验参考值相比偏差小于 1.3 kJ/mol。对于正辛醇，由于其力场参数借用了其他分子的 AFM 参数，因此误差略大，但偏差仍与通常接受的化学精度相当。该研究强调了 AFM 作为溶解度预测强大工具的潜力，可用于设计和开发具有定制性质的新材料与新分子。

articles.title: Investigating causality between principal components in protein dynamics
articles.title_zh: 蛋白质动力学中主成分之间因果关系的研究
articles.abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is widely used to characterize collective protein motions from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. While PCA identifies the dominant modes of structural fluctuation, it does not reveal whether different principal components (PCs) causally influence each other. Here, we investigate this question using a recently introduced causal-discovery framework [V. D. Tatto et al. , Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. U. S. A. 121 , e2317256121 (2024)], which allows us to infer putative causal asymmetries between high-dimensional time series. We apply this approach to long-timescale MD trajectories of two proteins. By analyzing relationships among PCs, we construct directed networks describing how PCs influence one another across time scales. These directional relationships, whose existence is a necessary condition for the presence of a causal link, are not captured by conventional covariance-based analyses and provide information that is complementary to PCA and time-lagged independent component analysis. Our results suggest that our causal inference approach can uncover previously hidden aspects of the dynamical organization of protein motions and offer a new perspective on this very popular class of collective variables.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用因果发现框架研究分子动力学轨迹中不同主成分之间是否存在因果影响。结果表明，主成分之间可形成有方向性的影响网络，这些关系可补充传统 PCA 与时间滞后独立成分分析，为理解蛋白质集体运动提供新视角。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 主成分分析（PCA）被广泛用于从分子动力学（MD）模拟中表征蛋白质的集体运动。尽管 PCA 可以识别结构涨落的主导模态，但它并不能揭示不同主成分（PC）之间是否存在因果影响。本文利用一种最近提出的因果发现框架 [V. D. Tatto 等，Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. U. S. A. 121, e2317256121 (2024)] 来研究这一问题，该框架能够从高维时间序列中推断潜在的因果不对称性。作者将该方法应用于两种蛋白质的长时间尺度 MD 轨迹，并通过分析各主成分之间的关系，构建出描述主成分如何随时间相互影响的有向网络。这些方向性关系的存在是因果联系成立的必要条件，而传统基于协方差的分析无法捕捉这些关系；它们为 PCA 和时间滞后独立成分分析提供了互补信息。结果表明，该因果推断方法能够揭示蛋白质运动动力学组织中先前被隐藏的方面，并为这一非常常用的集体变量类别提供新的视角。

articles.title: Trapped light generates nanoscale magnetization
articles.title_zh: 被俘获的光产生纳米尺度磁化
articles.abstract: Using an engineered metasurface that traps light, Cornell researchers have demonstrated a new way to generate strong static magnetic fields without using external magnets or magnetic materials—an approach that could advance spintronics, quantum and photonic computing, and data storage.
articles.abstract_zh: 康奈尔大学研究人员利用能够俘获光的工程化超表面，展示了一种无需外部磁体或磁性材料即可产生强静态磁场的新方法。该方法有望推动自旋电子学、量子计算、光子计算和数据存储的发展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 康奈尔大学研究人员利用一种能够俘获光的工程化超表面，展示了一种无需使用外部磁体或磁性材料即可产生强静态磁场的新方法；这一方法有望推动自旋电子学、量子计算、光子计算以及数据存储的发展。

articles.title: Making superconductors thinner can change how they accommodate magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 使超导体变薄会改变其容纳磁场的方式
articles.abstract: What happens when a superconductor becomes so thin that electrons can no longer behave as if they were moving through an ordinary three-dimensional piece of metal? This question has been at the center of my recent work on quantum confinement in metallic films. Over the past few years, I have been developing this line of theory with my colleague Giovanni Ummarino at Politecnico di Torino. Our initial goal was to understand something rather concrete: Why does shrinking the thickness of a superconducting film change the temperature at which superconductivity appears?
articles.abstract_zh: 当超导体变得足够薄，以至于电子不再能够表现得像是在普通三维金属中运动时，会发生什么？这一问题是作者近期研究金属薄膜中量子限域效应的核心。相关理论工作旨在理解超导薄膜厚度减小为何会改变超导出现的温度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当超导体变得如此之薄，以至于电子不再能够表现得像是在一块普通的三维金属中运动时，会发生什么？这个问题一直是我近期研究金属薄膜中量子限域问题的核心。过去几年里，我一直与都灵理工大学的同事 Giovanni Ummarino 一起发展这一理论研究方向。我们最初的目标是理解一个相当具体的问题：为什么减小超导薄膜的厚度会改变超导性出现的温度？

articles.title: PACMAN AI framework for controlling fusion systems safely makes key decisions in milliseconds
articles.title_zh: 用于安全控制聚变系统的 PACMAN 人工智能框架能在毫秒内作出关键决策
articles.abstract: Inside some fusion energy systems, particles hotter than the core of the sun can become unruly in a few thousandths of a second, far faster than any human operator can react. A new software framework developed by researchers at the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (PPPL) and Princeton University hands those split-second decisions to artificial intelligence (AI), while keeping the machine safe and humans firmly in charge of the goals.
articles.abstract_zh: 在一些聚变能源系统中，温度高于太阳核心的粒子可能在几千分之一秒内变得难以控制，远快于人类操作员的反应速度。美国能源部普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室和普林斯顿大学的研究人员开发了一种新的软件框架，将这些瞬时决策交给人工智能，同时确保设备安全并让人类牢牢掌握目标设定权。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在一些聚变能源系统内部，温度高于太阳核心的粒子可能在几千分之一秒内变得难以控制，其速度远快于任何人类操作员能够作出反应的速度。美国能源部（DOE）普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室（PPPL）和普林斯顿大学的研究人员开发了一种新的软件框架，将这些瞬间决策交给人工智能（AI），同时确保设备安全，并让人类始终牢牢掌握目标。

articles.title: Campaign-resolved evidence for adaptive critical-heat-flux surrogates under experimental shift
articles.title_zh: 实验变化下自适应临界热通量替代模型的按实验批次解析证据
articles.abstract: Critical heat flux (CHF) is a limiting heat-transfer condition in water-cooled systems. Prediction has progressed from empirical correlations and lookup tables to mechanistic models, physics-informed machine learning, and uncertainty-aware hybrids. These advances improve predictive capability, but a separate question remains: whether knowledge learned from experiments remains reliable when an entire experimental campaign, with its own test section, instrumentation, surface history, and operating trajectory, is absent from model development. This study treats the campaign as the common unit of generalization, uncertainty calibration, evidence valuation, and sparse adaptation. Using 24,579 water-CHF measurements from 60 uniformly heated vertical round-tube campaigns, physics-anchored and direct machine-learning models are tested under exhaustive whole-campaign separation. The same campaign structure is then examined through conformal uncertainty, directed source-to-target transfer, coalition data value, and regularized Bayesian updating from a few revealed measurements. An independent hierarchical response-field analysis tests whether campaign-level residual structure persists under a different estimator, while a one-dimensional energy balance is used only as a conservation check. The analysis shows that whole-campaign prediction is harder than record-level prediction, and historical sampling concentration explains only part of that difference. Cross-campaign evidence is not exchangeable: usefulness depends on thermohydraulic support, can reverse with transfer direction, and yields coalition rankings that depend on the transport rule. Record-level uncertainty calibration does not provide uniform protection across campaigns. By contrast, a small number of new measurements can recover part of the unresolved campaign-specific state, although the acquisition policy does not statistically outperform simple random sampling. The work, therefore, reframes CHF machine learning as an experimental evidence transport problem. The resulting framework is an offline, campaign-initialized adaptive surrogate for deciding when historical evidence is transferable, when uncertainty should be widened, and when limited new measurements can support prediction updates; it does not claim to identify mechanisms, achieve multiphase simulation fidelity, or attain operational digital twin status.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究将实验批次视为水冷系统临界热通量预测中的泛化、校准不确定性、证据评估和稀疏适应的共同基本单位，并对 60 个实验批次的 24,579 条测量数据进行了整批次留出分析。结果表明，跨批次证据并非可交换，其有效性取决于热工水力支持关系，记录级不确定性校准也无法为所有批次提供一致保护。少量新测量能够恢复部分批次特有状态，但其获取策略在统计上并未优于简单随机采样；因此，研究将 CHF 机器学习重新界定为实验性证据迁移问题，并提出一种离线、以实验批次初始化的自适应替代模型框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 临界热通量（CHF）是水冷系统中的一种传热极限状态。其预测方法已经从经验关联式和查表法发展到机理模型、物理信息机器学习以及具备不确定性感知能力的混合模型。这些进展提升了预测能力，但仍有一个不同的问题需要回答：当整个实验批次及其特有的试验段、仪器设备、表面历史和运行轨迹被排除在模型开发之外时，从实验中学习到的知识是否仍然可靠。本研究将实验批次视为泛化、不确定性校准、证据价值评估以及稀疏适应的共同基本单位。研究使用来自 60 个均匀加热垂直圆管实验批次的 24,579 条水-CHF 测量数据，在穷举式整批次分离条件下测试了物理锚定模型和直接机器学习模型。随后，研究通过保形不确定性、定向源域到目标域迁移、联盟数据价值以及基于少量已揭示测量值的正则化贝叶斯更新，考察了相同的实验批次结构。一个独立的层次响应场分析采用不同的估计器，检验批次层面的残差结构是否仍然存在；同时，一维能量平衡仅被用作守恒性检查。分析表明，整批次预测比记录级预测更困难，而历史采样集中程度只能解释这种差异的一部分。跨实验批次证据并非可交换：其有用性取决于热工水力支持关系，可能随迁移方向改变，且联盟排序取决于所采用的传输规则。记录级不确定性校准无法为不同实验批次提供统一的保护。相比之下，少量新测量能够恢复部分尚未解析的批次特有状态，尽管其数据获取策略在统计上并未优于简单随机采样。因此，本研究将 CHF 机器学习重新界定为一个实验性证据迁移问题。由此形成的框架是一种离线、以实验批次初始化的自适应替代模型，可用于判断历史证据何时具有可迁移性、何时应扩大不确定性范围，以及何时有限的新测量能够支持预测更新；该框架并不声称能够识别机理、达到多相流模拟的保真度，或实现运行级数字孪生。

articles.title: CTDG-IDS: Continuous-time Dynamic Graph Representation Learning for Network Intrusion Detection
articles.title_zh: CTDG-IDS：用于网络入侵检测的连续时间动态图表示学习
articles.abstract: To detect network threats in communication networks, network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) have achieved good results in identifying different attack behaviors. However, machine learning (ML)-based and deep learning (DL)-based techniques ignore the inherent topology in the network. In the actual communication process, once an interaction event occurs between entities, a topological relationship will be formed, and attackers cannot bypass the formation of this topological relationship. Graph representation learning (GRL)-based methods learn useful representations from network topology but ignore the time-varying characteristics of network flows. However, network communication combines dynamically changing network topology and temporal interactions between entities. Ignoring these information will fail to cope with complex and changeable attack behaviors. To address this problem, we propose a Continuous-time Dynamic Graph (CTDG)-based Representation Learning framework for Network Intrusion Detection, called CTDG-IDS, which considers the nature of network communication. The proposed framework converts network flows into a continuous-time dynamic graph. Then we adopt a memory updating mechanism to maintain the historical state of nodes. Furthermore,we construct a hypergraph to strength the memory state of nodes. Finally, a dynamic graph attention variant (GATv2) aggregation scheme is designed to extract the global spatiotemporal evolution information. The experimental results on the UNSW-NB15 and CIC-IDS2017 datasets demonstrate that our proposed method can effectively detect various attacks, particularly those closely related to spatiotemporal behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有基于机器学习和深度学习的网络入侵检测方法往往忽略网络固有的拓扑结构，而图表示学习方法又通常忽略网络流量随时间变化的特征。为此，本文提出 CTDG-IDS，将网络流转换为连续时间动态图，并通过记忆更新机制维护节点历史状态，再利用超图增强节点记忆状态。实验结果表明，在 UNSW-NB15 和 CIC-IDS2017 数据集上，该方法能够有效检测多种攻击，尤其适用于具有明显时空行为特征的攻击。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为了检测通信网络中的网络威胁，网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）在识别不同攻击行为方面已经取得了良好效果。然而，基于机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）的技术忽略了网络固有的拓扑结构。在实际通信过程中，一旦实体之间发生交互事件，就会形成拓扑关系，而攻击者无法绕过这种拓扑关系的形成。基于图表示学习（GRL）的方法能够从网络拓扑中学习有用的表示，但忽略了网络流量随时间变化的特征。然而，网络通信同时包含动态变化的网络拓扑以及实体之间的时间交互。忽略这些信息将无法应对复杂多变的攻击行为。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于连续时间动态图（CTDG）的网络入侵检测表示学习框架，称为 CTDG-IDS，该框架考虑了网络通信的本质特征。所提出的框架将网络流转换为连续时间动态图。随后，我们采用记忆更新机制来维护节点的历史状态。此外，我们构建了一个超图，以增强节点的记忆状态。最后，我们设计了一种动态图库注意力变体（GATv2）聚合方案，用于提取全局时空演化信息。在 UNSW-NB15 和 CIC-IDS2017 数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够有效检测多种攻击，尤其是那些与时空行为密切相关的攻击。

articles.title: Neural-Network Error Mitigation for Quantum Teleportation and Superdense Coding
articles.title_zh: 用于量子隐形传态和超密编码的神经网络误差缓解
articles.abstract: Quantum teleportation and superdense coding are foundational protocols of quantum communication, but both degrade under channel imperfections. This paper examines whether a small neural network, acting purely as a classical post-processing layer, can mitigate such imperfections when it is given only the information a real receiver could collect. Both protocols are implemented exactly using tensor operations on complex qubit amplitudes, reproducing ideal noiseless behaviour. Realistic imperfections are then introduced and learned mitigation is evaluated under finite-shot conditions, so that the network observes a finite number of discrete measurement outcomes rather than exact probabilities, and is never supplied the noise parameters. The results identify a clear boundary on when learning helps. For superdense coding through a biased Pauli channel followed by asymmetric readout error, a learned decoder exceeds a majority-vote baseline in the low-shot regime, by roughly five percentage points at five shots, with both methods converging toward perfect accuracy as shots grow. For teleportation through a systematic gate miscalibration, the network learns to invert the miscalibration and raises mean state fidelity from about 0.93 to 0.99, with the gain increasing as additional shots reduce tomographic noise. A control experiment replacing the systematic miscalibration with a fully random per-qubit rotation yields no benefit, the expected outcome when noise carries no recurring structure. The findings indicate that lightweight learned post-processing is worthwhile specifically in the low-shot, structured-noise regime, and offers nothing when noise is structureless.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一个仅作为经典后处理层的小型神经网络，能否利用真实接收者可获得的信息来缓解量子隐形传态和超密编码中的信道缺陷。结果显示，在低测量次数和具有结构的噪声条件下，学习型后处理能够改善性能：对于带偏置泡利信道和非对称读出误差的超密编码，其准确率在五次测量时比多数投票基线高约五个百分点；对于系统性门校准误差下的隐形传态，平均态保真度可由约 0.93 提升至 0.99。面对每个量子比特均随机变化、缺乏重复结构的噪声时，该方法没有带来收益。
