Cyclopentadiene (c-C5H6) is a five-membered cyclic hydrocarbon recently detected in TMC-1 and some other interstellar molecular clouds. While accurate spectroscopic data were available, collisional rate coefficients for its rotational transitions were missing so far, introducing a potential limitation in the interpretation of the observations. This study aims to provide a comprehensive set of state-to-state thermal rate coefficients for the rotational excitation of c-C5H6 due to collisions with helium, crucial for non-local thermodynamic equilibrium (non-LTE) radiative transfer modelling in astrophysical environments, and to examine how far the molecule is from thermalisation under the physical conditions of cold molecular clouds. The research employed accurate quantum scattering calculations using the close-coupling (CC) and coupled states (CS) methods, based on a highly-correlated three-dimensional potential energy surface for the [c-C5H6 + He] collisional complex. Calculations were performed for a wide range of rotational states (from j = 0 to j ≤ 25) and kinetic temperatures (from 10 to 50 K). We calculated a complete set of thermal rate coefficients for both ortho- and para-C5H6. Radiative transfer simulations demonstrated that most rotational levels of cyclopentadiene are fully thermalized under typical cold cloud conditions and exhibit minor non-LTE effects. Nevertheless, this study is the first to utilise accurate state-to-state rate coefficients for radiative transfer simulation of a large, five-membered cyclic species detected in space. This allows to draw some general conclusions and paves the way for future studies of complex astromolecules that will enable a more precise interpretation of upcoming detections.

articles.title: Dual Theory of MHD Turbulence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.12682v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an exact analytic solution for decaying incompressible magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence. Our solution reveals a dual formulation in terms of two interacting Euler ensembles--one for hydrodynamic and another for magnetic circulation. This replaces empirical scaling laws with an infinite set of power terms with calculable decay exponents, some of which appear as complex-conjugate pairs related to the Riemann zeta function. A key result of our analysis is the explicit dependence of the solution on the Prandtl number (Pr = ν/η), leading to a phase transition at Pr = 1. In the Pr<1 regime, turbulence is dominated by hydrodynamic fluctuations, while for Pr>1, two distinct solutions emerge: a metastable one in which magnetic fluctuations grow with Pr and a stable one where they remain balanced with hydrodynamic fluctuations. We compare our theoretical predictions with recent direct numerical simulations (DNS) and discuss their implications for astrophysical plasmas, fusion devices, and laboratory MHD experiments. Our results provide a rigorous mathematical framework for understanding MHD turbulence and its dependence on fundamental parameters, offering a new perspective on turbulence in highly conducting fluids.

articles.title: Brillouin Spectroscopy Reveals Mechanical Properties Beyond Hydration
articles.title_zh: 布里渊光谱揭示超越水合程度的力学性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.08150v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Brillouin light scattering is a noncontact technique for probing the micromechanical properties of cells and tissues through the GHz-frequency longitudinal modulus. Interpreting Brillouin spectra in hydrated biological materials remains challenging because the Brillouin shift is influenced not only by water content but also by polymer network mechanics, relaxation processes, and viscous dissipation. Here, we investigated two model hydrogels with distinct network chemistry, together with a binary solvent mixture, to disentangle these contributions. Time- and space-resolved measurements of a hydrating hydrogel further show that Brillouin microscopy captures local mechanical changes that bulk rheometry only partially resolves. Experiments on ethanol-water mixtures further demonstrate that the Brillouin shift does not vary monotonically with hydration but instead reflects changes in the mixture's mechanical properties. In addition, by comparing longitudinal, bulk, and shear viscosities, we identify bulk viscous dissipation as an important contributor to the Brillouin response. Together, these results show that hydration modulates Brillouin spectra but does not fully determine them. Our findings provide a mechanical framework for interpreting Brillouin measurements in hydrated and biomolecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 布里渊光散射可通过GHz频率的纵向模量无接触地探测细胞和组织的微观力学性质，但在含水生物材料中的光谱解释受到多种因素共同影响。本文通过研究具有不同网络化学性质的水凝胶和乙醇-水二元溶剂，区分水含量、聚合物网络力学、弛豫过程及黏性耗散的作用。结果表明，水合会调节布里渊光谱，但不能完全决定其变化，体积黏性耗散也是重要因素。
authors: Maria de los Angeles De la Cruz Garcia
articles.abstract_zh_full: 布里渊光散射是一种非接触技术，可通过GHz频率的纵向模量探测细胞和组织的微观力学性质。在含水生物材料中解释布里渊光谱仍然具有挑战性，因为布里渊频移不仅受到含水量影响，还受到聚合物网络力学、弛豫过程和黏性耗散的影响。在本研究中，我们研究了两种网络化学性质不同的模型水凝胶以及一种二元溶剂混合物，以解耦这些因素的作用。对水合过程中的水凝胶进行时间和空间分辨测量进一步表明，布里渊显微镜能够捕捉局部力学变化，而整体流变测量只能部分解析这些变化。对乙醇-水混合物的实验进一步表明，布里渊频移不会随水合程度单调变化，而是反映混合物力学性质的变化。此外，通过比较纵向黏度、体积黏度和剪切黏度，我们确定体积黏性耗散是布里渊响应的重要贡献因素。总之，这些结果表明，水合会调节布里渊光谱，但并不能完全决定光谱特征。我们的研究结果为解释水合体系和生物分子体系中的布里渊测量提供了一个力学框架。

articles.title: Strong Collective Chiroptical Response from Electric-Dipole Interactions in Atomic Systems
articles.title_zh: 原子系统中由电偶极相互作用产生的强集体手性光学响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15231v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiroptical responses in atomic systems are usually weak, as they arise from the interference between electric- and much weaker magnetic-dipole transitions. We show that atoms arranged in chiral geometries can instead exhibit a strong collective chiroptical response mediated entirely by electric-dipole interactions. Using a coupled-dipole framework, we identify a regime of pronounced chiroptical response emerging at subwavelength interatomic separations, which can be tuned by the probe frequency. This enhancement is directly linked to the formation of subradiant collective modes. Our results establish a fundamental connection between geometric chirality and collective light-matter interactions, opening new pathways for engineering and exploiting chiral optical responses in atomic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子系统中的手性光学响应通常较弱，因为它依赖于电偶极跃迁与弱得多的磁偶极跃迁之间的干涉。本文表明，排列成手性几何结构的原子可以完全通过电偶极相互作用产生强烈的集体手性光学响应。该增强效应出现在亚波长原子间距下，并与亚辐射集体模的形成直接相关，为设计原子系统中的手性光学响应提供了新途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子系统中的手性光学响应通常较弱，因为它们源于电偶极跃迁与弱得多的磁偶极跃迁之间的干涉。我们表明，排列成手性几何结构的原子可以产生完全由电偶极相互作用介导的强集体手性光学响应。利用耦合偶极子框架，我们确定了一种在亚波长原子间距下出现显著手性光学响应的区域，并且该响应可以通过探测光频率进行调谐。这种增强效应与亚辐射集体模的形成直接相关。我们的结果建立了几何手性与集体光-物质相互作用之间的基本联系，为工程化设计和利用原子系统中的手性光学响应开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Quantum-classical solvation hydrodynamics: a Hamiltonian modeling framework
articles.title_zh: 量子-经典溶剂化流体动力学：一种哈密顿建模框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.05658v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a mixed quantum-classical hydrodynamic framework to model short-time inertial effects in the non-adiabatic evolution of a quantum solute coupled to a classical polar solvent. Drawing upon the work of Burghardt and Bagchi [Chem. Phys. 329 (2006), 343], we employ the Hamiltonian approach to incorporate consistent backreaction and preserve quantum decoherence beyond standard Ehrenfest dynamics. The solvent is treated as an ideal polar fluid and the quantum solute state is coupled to both the position and molecular orientation coordinates of the liquid. This approach retains essential solute-solvent correlations while reducing the computational complexity of previous approaches. We further incorporate dissipative terms to capture both inertial effects and polarization relaxation. After establishing the general setting for non-local dielectric continua, the Marcus local approximation is integrated into the model thereby extending traditional solvation theory to account for collective fluid sloshing on fast timescales.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种混合量子-经典流体动力学框架，用于描述量子溶质与经典极性溶剂在非绝热演化中的短时惯性效应。该方法采用哈密顿方法处理一致的反作用，并在标准 Ehrenfest 动力学之外保留量子退相干，同时将溶剂视为理想极性流体。模型还纳入耗散项和 Marcus 局域近似，从而描述快速时间尺度上的集体流体晃荡及极化弛豫。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种混合量子-经典流体动力学框架，用于模拟量子溶质与经典极性溶剂耦合体系在非绝热演化中的短时惯性效应。受 Burghardt 和 Bagchi 相关工作的启发，我们采用哈密顿方法纳入一致的反作用，并在标准 Ehrenfest 动力学之外保留量子退相干。溶剂被视为理想极性流体，而量子溶质态同时与液体的位置坐标和分子取向坐标耦合。该方法保留了基本的溶质-溶剂关联，同时降低了以往方法的计算复杂度。我们进一步加入耗散项，以捕捉惯性效应和极化弛豫。在为非局域介电连续介质建立一般框架之后，我们将 Marcus 局域近似纳入模型，从而扩展传统溶剂化理论，使其能够描述快速时间尺度上的集体流体晃荡。

articles.title: Bulk-to-Wall Observability in Rarefied Hypersonic Flow over Triangular Protrusions: Full-Range Moment Limits and Incident Half-Range Sufficiency
articles.title_zh: 稀薄高超声速三角凸起流动中的体域到壁面可观测性：全范围矩极限与入射半范围充分性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25752v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid kinetic--continuum solvers, moment methods, and machine-learned wall closures share one implicit assumption that a small set of macroscopic fields near a surface carries enough information to determine the pressure and shear exerted on that surface. Wall traction in a rarefied gas, however, is a half-space velocity integral, whereas density, velocity, temperature, stress, and heat flux are full-range moments that mix molecules moving toward the wall with molecules leaving it. This study measures where the assumption holds and where it fails for rarefied hypersonic flow over backward-facing, forward-facing and symmetric triangular protrusions. Geometry-consistent coordinate-conditioned surrogates first establish field and surface interpolation on a 57-condition direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) database. The observability test then compares nested full-range states of increasing content, the primitive variables S₀, the momentum-flux state S₁=S₀+Pᵢⱼ, and the heat-flux augmentation S₂=S₁+qᵢ, with the incident half-range state SHR constructed from pre-collision molecular velocities. In equal-capacity blind interpolation from Kn=0.1 and 0.8 to Kn=0.2 and 0.4, Pᵢⱼ improves wall-pressure recovery by 31% relative to primitives yet does not beat a parameter baseline, and no finite state improves transferable signed shear. A constructive example supplies the reason: two positive distributions share every full-range moment through total degree three while their incident half-range shear has opposite sign, so the failure is information loss rather than model capacity.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合动理学-连续介质求解器、矩方法和机器学习壁面闭合模型都隐含假设：壁面附近少量宏观场足以确定壁面压力和剪切力。然而，稀薄气体中的壁面牵引力是半空间速度积分，而密度、速度、温度、应力和热流等全范围矩会混合朝向壁面的分子与离开壁面的分子。本文基于三角凸起上的 DSMC 数据库检验这一假设，发现增加应力矩可改善压力恢复，但有限全范围状态仍无法可靠迁移地预测有符号剪切力，根本原因是信息丢失而非模型容量不足。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合动理学-连续介质求解器、矩方法以及机器学习壁面闭合模型都共享一个隐含假设，即壁面附近少量宏观场包含足够信息，可以确定壁面所承受的压力和剪切力。然而，稀薄气体中的壁面牵引力是一个半空间速度积分，而密度、速度、温度、应力和热流等全范围矩会将朝向壁面的分子与离开壁面的分子混合在一起。本研究考察了在后向、前向和对称三角凸起上的稀薄高超声速流动中，这一假设在哪些情况下成立以及在哪些情况下失效。首先，研究利用包含57种条件的直接模拟蒙特卡罗数据库，构建了与几何相一致的、以坐标为条件的代理模型，以完成场变量和表面量的插值。随后，可观测性测试比较了内容逐步增加的嵌套全范围状态，包括原始变量S₀、动量通量状态S₁=S₀+Pᵢⱼ，以及加入热流后的状态S₂=S₁+qᵢ；同时，由碰撞前分子速度构造入射半范围状态S_HR。在从Kn=0.1和0.8向Kn=0.2和0.4进行等容量盲插值时，与原始变量相比，Pᵢⱼ使壁面压力恢复性能提高了31%，但仍未超过参数基线，而且没有任何有限状态能够改善可迁移的有符号剪切力预测。一个构造性例子说明了原因：两个正分布在总次数不超过三阶的所有全范围矩上完全相同，但它们的入射半范围剪切力符号相反，因此失败源于信息丢失，而不是模型容量不足。

articles.title: Quantum matrix arithmetics with Hamiltonian evolution
articles.title_zh: 基于哈密顿演化的量子矩阵运算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.06316v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The efficient implementation of matrix arithmetic operations underpins the speedups of many quantum algorithms. We develop a suite of methods to perform matrix arithmetics -- with the result encoded in the off-diagonal blocks of a Hamiltonian -- using Hamiltonian evolutions of input operators. We show how to maintain this Hamiltonian block encoding, so that matrix operations can be composed one after another, and the entire quantum computation takes ≤ 2 ancilla qubits. We achieve this for matrix multiplication, matrix addition, matrix inversion, Hermitian conjugation, fractional scaling, integer scaling, complex phase scaling, as well as singular value transformation for both odd and even polynomials. We also present an overlap estimation algorithm to extract classical properties of Hamiltonian block encoded operators, analogous to the well known Hadamard test, at no extra cost of qubit. Our Hamiltonian matrix multiplication uses the Lie group commutator product formula and its higher-order generalizations due to Childs and Wiebe. Our Hamiltonian singular value transformation employs a dominated polynomial approximation, where the approximation holds within the domain of interest, while the constructed polynomial is upper bounded by the target function over the entire unit interval. We describe a circuit for simulating a class of sum-of-squares Hamiltonians, attaining a commutator scaling in step count, while leveraging the power of matrix arithmetics to reduce the cost of each simulation step. In particular, we apply this to the doubly factorized tensor hypercontracted Hamiltonians from recent studies of quantum chemistry, obtaining further improvements for initial states with a fixed number of particles. We achieve this with 1 ancilla qubit.
articles.abstract_zh: 高效实现矩阵运算是许多量子算法获得加速的基础。本文提出一套利用输入算子的哈密顿演化执行矩阵运算的方法，并将结果编码在哈密顿量的非对角块中，支持矩阵乘法、加法、求逆、共轭转置、缩放及奇异值变换等操作，且连续组合时最多只需两个辅助量子比特。作者还给出重叠估计、平方和哈密顿量模拟及量子化学应用，部分情形下仅需一个辅助量子比特。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 矩阵运算的高效实现是许多量子算法获得加速的基础。我们发展了一套方法，利用输入算子的哈密顿演化执行矩阵运算，并将结果编码在哈密顿量的非对角块中。我们展示了如何维持这种哈密顿量块编码，使矩阵运算能够一个接一个地组合，且整个量子计算最多只需2个辅助量子比特。对于矩阵乘法、矩阵加法、矩阵求逆、厄米共轭、分数缩放、整数缩放、复相位缩放，以及奇次和偶次多项式的奇异值变换，我们均实现了这一目标。我们还提出一种重叠估计算法，用于提取哈密顿量块编码算子的经典性质，其作用类似于广为人知的 Hadamard 测试，但不需要额外的量子比特。我们的哈密顿量矩阵乘法采用 Lie 群交换子乘积公式及其由 Childs 和 Wiebe 提出的高阶推广。我们的哈密顿量奇异值变换采用受支配的多项式逼近：该逼近在目标区域内成立，同时所构造的多项式在整个单位区间上均由目标函数上界控制。我们描述了一种模拟一类平方和哈密顿量的电路，该电路在步数上实现交换子标度，同时利用矩阵运算的能力降低每个模拟步骤的成本。具体而言，我们将其应用于近期研究中的双重因子化张量超收缩哈密顿量，并进一步降低了固定粒子数初态的成本。在这种情况下，我们只需1个辅助量子比特。

articles.title: ReNFT: Repairing Mode Collapse in Reward Post-Training via Internal Probability-Mass Recalibration
articles.title_zh: ReNFT：通过内部概率质量重新校准修复奖励后训练中的模式坍缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reward post-training of diffusion generators inevitably concentrates probability mass on a few reward-favored modes, a mode collapse that erases within-prompt diversity. Existing methods for mitigating collapse rely on external signals or interfaces, augmenting the reward with perceptual objectives, adjusting reference regularization, or modifying the text encoder, but none repairs an adapter that has already collapsed while preserving the acquired reward. We observe that online post-training primarily reallocates probability mass over capabilities inherited from pretraining rather than learning new visual content. Collapse is therefore suppression, not deletion, and can be reversed from within the generator. We propose ReNFT, which repairs a high-reward, low-diversity adapter through internal probability-mass recalibration. Unconditional probes first prioritize "anti-hub" prompts where the prompt-independent bias is easiest to expose. Two policy-dominated mixed routes then generate matched counterfactual proposals from the same prompt and initial noise, one probing the frozen base direction for suppressed alternatives and the other exposing the post-trained unconditional tendency. Reward ranking with an adaptive flipping guard assigns pull and push roles, and a joint-and-paired NFT update realizes the repair. On PickScore and GenEval, ReNFT retains 98.9% and 99.0% of NFT's reward while improving DreamSim-Div by 58.8% and 55.0%, respectively, offering a complementary alternative to external interventions.
articles.abstract_zh: 扩散生成器的奖励后训练会将概率质量集中到少数高奖励模式，导致提示内多样性丧失。本文认为，在线后训练主要是在预训练继承的能力之间重新分配概率质量，因此模式坍缩是抑制而非删除，可以从生成器内部修复。作者提出 ReNFT，利用无条件探测、匹配反事实提议、奖励排序和联合配对 NFT 更新恢复被抑制的模式，在保持约99%奖励的同时显著提升生成多样性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 扩散生成器的奖励后训练不可避免地会将概率质量集中到少数受奖励偏好的模式上，这种模式坍缩会抹去同一提示下的多样性。现有的缓解方法依赖外部信号或接口，例如加入感知目标、调整参考正则化，或修改文本编码器，但没有一种方法能够在保持已获得奖励的同时修复一个已经发生坍缩的适配器。我们观察到，在线后训练主要是在预训练所继承的能力之间重新分配概率质量，而不是学习新的视觉内容。因此，模式坍缩是抑制而非删除，可以从生成器内部将其逆转。我们提出 ReNFT，通过内部概率质量重新校准来修复高奖励、低多样性的适配器。无条件探测首先优先选择“反枢纽”提示，在这些提示下，与提示无关的偏置最容易暴露。随后，两个由策略主导的混合路径从相同提示和初始噪声出发，生成匹配的反事实提议：其中一条探测被冻结的基础模型方向，以寻找受到抑制的替代方案；另一条揭示后训练模型的无条件倾向。基于奖励的排序与自适应翻转保护机制分配拉取和推动角色，联合且成对的 NFT 更新则实现修复。在 PickScore 和 GenEval 上，ReNFT 分别保留了 NFT 奖励的98.9%和99.0%，同时使 DreamSim-Div 分别提升58.8%和55.0%，因此可作为外部干预的互补替代方案。

articles.title: Foundation models for electricity price forecasting and battery arbitrage: Can they replace market-specific forecasting models?
articles.title_zh: 电价预测与电池套利的基础模型：它们能取代市场特定的预测模型吗？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models promise accurate forecasts with little or no task-specific training, but whether they can replace models designed specifically for electricity price forecasting remains unclear. We compare nine variants from five foundation model families, evaluated in zero-shot mode, with two state-of-the-art electricity price forecasting benchmarks in Germany, Poland, and Spain over 2021-2025. Their performance is assessed in terms of point and probabilistic forecasting accuracy, as well as economic value in battery energy storage arbitrage. Only the TabPFN models consistently and significantly outperform the benchmarks across all three markets and all statistical measures. However, this statistical dominance does not translate directly into economic dominance: TabPFN performs best under unlimited bids and riskier quantile-based strategies, whereas the Distributional Deep Neural Network benchmark is more profitable when risk tolerance is lower. Thus, foundation models cannot universally replace market-specific models, and their value depends on both model architecture and the decision problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 基础模型有望以很少或无需任务特定训练实现准确预测，但其能否取代专门设计的电价预测模型尚不明确。本文在德国、波兰和西班牙2021至2025年的数据上，以零样本方式比较五个基础模型家族的九个变体和两个先进基准模型，并同时评估统计预测性能与电池储能套利的经济价值。结果显示，TabPFN在统计指标上稳定占优，但在经济决策中并不普遍占优，基础模型的价值取决于模型架构和风险偏好。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基础模型承诺能够以很少或无需任务特定训练实现准确预测，但它们能否取代专门为电价预测设计的模型仍然不明确。我们在德国、波兰和西班牙三个市场中，使用2021年至2025年的数据，以零样本方式评估来自五个基础模型家族的九个变体，并将其与两个最先进的电价预测基准模型进行比较。我们从点预测和概率预测准确性，以及电池储能套利中的经济价值等方面评估模型性能。只有 TabPFN 模型在三个市场和所有统计指标上都持续且显著地优于基准模型。然而，这种统计优势并不会直接转化为经济优势：在无限竞价和风险更高的分位数策略下，TabPFN 表现最佳；而当风险容忍度较低时，分布式深度神经网络基准模型的盈利能力更高。因此，基础模型无法普遍取代市场特定模型，其价值同时取决于模型架构和决策问题。

articles.title: Safin-1: Safety from Within through Memory-Native State Evolution
articles.title_zh: Safin-1：通过记忆原生状态演化实现内生安全
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00092v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon complex tasks require foundation models to accumulate information, maintain internal states, and adapt over extended interactions. Safety should be an intrinsic property of the model itself, rather than a behavioral constraint relying solely on external safeguards or post-hoc alignment such as supervised fine-tuning. This motivates Safety from Within, where safety-relevant capabilities are represented and invoked through the model's native computation. We present Safin-1, a family of foundation models realizing this principle through memory routing and state evolution. Safin-1 is built on Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History (MARCH), a network architecture that maintains structured memory states and selectively retrieves relevant historical information through content-conditioned routing. It supports test-time adaptation of persistent capability states without repeatedly modifying the backbone, enabling controlled specialization over a shared foundation. We investigate this interface on downstream safety tasks through a Safety State, demonstrating effective state-based adaptation with substantial safety improvements. More broadly, the routed-state interface unifies contextual memory and persistent capability adaptation within the model's native computation, reframing memory from a passive record of prior context into an active substrate for maintaining and evolving model behavior. Evaluations across general capabilities, long-context understanding, retrieval, and efficiency further validate Safin-1. These findings provide a path toward safety as a state-native and adaptively maintainable capability. This work is only an initial architectural exploration of Safety from Within, and substantial further work is needed to realize this broader vision.
articles.abstract_zh: 长期复杂任务要求基础模型持续积累信息、维护内部状态并适应长时间交互，本文主张安全性应成为模型自身的内在属性。作者提出 Safin-1，通过跨上下文历史的记忆锚点路由维护结构化记忆状态，并选择性检索相关历史信息。该架构支持测试时对持久能力状态进行适应，在安全任务上实现显著改进，并将上下文记忆与持久能力适配统一为模型原生计算的一部分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长期复杂任务要求基础模型积累信息、维护内部状态，并在长时间交互过程中进行适应。安全性应当是模型自身的内在属性，而不应仅仅依赖外部防护措施或监督微调等事后对齐所施加的行为约束。这促成了“内生安全”理念，即通过模型的原生计算来表示和调用与安全相关的能力。我们提出 Safin-1，一系列通过记忆路由和状态演化实现这一理念的基础模型。Safin-1 建立在跨上下文历史的记忆锚点路由（MARCH）架构之上，该架构维护结构化记忆状态，并通过内容条件路由选择性地检索相关历史信息。该架构支持对持久能力状态进行测试时适配，而无需反复修改主干网络，从而能够在共享基础模型上实现受控的专业化。我们在下游安全任务中通过安全状态研究这一接口，展示了基于状态的有效适配以及显著的安全性提升。更广泛地说，这种路由状态接口将上下文记忆与持久能力适配统一在模型的原生计算之中，将记忆重新定义为维护和演化模型行为的主动载体，而不只是对既有上下文的被动记录。在通用能力、长上下文理解、检索和效率方面的评估进一步验证了 Safin-1。上述发现为将安全性构建为一种状态原生且能够自适应维护的能力提供了路径。本文只是对“内生安全”这一理念进行的初步架构探索，要实现这一更宏大的愿景仍需开展大量后续工作。

articles.title: A hybrid quantum-classical neural network for learning to route
articles.title_zh: 用于学习路由的混合量子-经典神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work studies hybrid quantum-classical neural networks for learning routing heuristics. Specifically, this paper asks whether small quantum neural networks can replace parameter-heavy modules inside a competitive attention-based routing model while maintaining solution quality. For the capacitated vehicle routing problem, encoder feed-forward replacement emerges as the most promising design: it reduces the number of model parameters by 56.6% while keeping the hybrid model close to the classical neural baseline at small and medium instance sizes, although the gap grows for larger instances. This work also compares to classical routing algorithms, which remain highly competitive and often superior on the fixed Euclidean test sets. Our results therefore do not indicate quantum advantage or solver dominance, but identify encoder feed-forward replacement as a viable hybrid-module compression strategy for neural combinatorial optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究利用混合量子-经典神经网络学习组合优化中的路由启发式方法，重点考察小型量子神经网络能否替代注意力路由模型中参数量较大的模块。对于容量约束车辆路径问题，替换编码器前馈模块最有前景：模型参数量减少56.6%，在小规模和中等规模实例上仍接近经典基线。经典路由算法在固定欧氏测试集上仍具有竞争力，因此研究未显示量子优势或求解器支配性，而是表明该替换可作为神经组合优化中的混合模块压缩策略。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究考察利用混合量子-经典神经网络学习路由启发式方法。具体而言，本文探讨小型量子神经网络能否在保持解质量的同时，替代具有竞争力的基于注意力的路由模型中的参数密集型模块。对于容量约束车辆路径问题，替换编码器前馈模块是最有前景的设计：它使模型参数量减少56.6%，同时在小规模和中等规模实例上使混合模型保持接近经典神经网络基线的性能，不过在更大规模实例上性能差距会扩大。本文还将这些方法与经典路由算法进行比较，后者在固定的欧氏测试集上仍然具有很强的竞争力，并且通常表现更优。因此，我们的结果并不表明存在量子优势或求解器支配性，而是确定了编码器前馈模块替换方案可作为神经组合优化中的一种可行混合模块压缩策略。

articles.title: LatentPress: Context Compression Beyond Text and Vision
articles.title_zh: LatentPress：超越文本与视觉的上下文压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01507v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compressed context is usually carried as human-readable text or as rendered images that must be decoded, even when its consumer is a language model. We introduce LatentPress, which writes conversational histories and long documents into a third representation: continuous memory tokens that a frozen decoder reads directly through its input-embedding interface, with no text reconstruction at inference. A small reader-matched writer compresses 4-16× while training only an adapter (4.2M-26.2M parameters, sim!0.1% of the decoder). On LongMemEval, LatentPress reaches 0.504 accuracy at 7.70× compression versus 0.490 for uncompressed evidence, outperforming text summaries (0.184) and OCR-based compression (0.426 to 0.312). On LongBench-QA, in-domain writers match or exceed raw-context reading at 4-8× compression, while 16× trails raw. Writing takes 43ms per conversation, roughly an order of magnitude faster than text summarization or OCR reconstruction, and reading is 5-9× faster than raw context or cached OCR. We validate the interface under two transfer settings, zero-shot from UltraChat to LongMemEval memory QA and from LongMemEval-derived QA to unseen LongBench document domains, establishing direct soft tokens as a practical machine-facing context interface beyond text and vision. The implementation of the experiments could be found at: https://github.com/xuyd16ai/context_softtoken_compress .
articles.abstract_zh: 压缩后的上下文通常以可读文本或需解码的图像形式保存，即使其使用者是语言模型。本文提出 LatentPress，将对话历史和长文档写入连续记忆令牌，由冻结解码器通过输入嵌入接口直接读取，无需在推理时重建文本。该方法可实现4至16倍压缩，在长上下文记忆问答和文档问答中保持或超过原始上下文性能，并显著降低写入和读取成本。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 压缩后的上下文通常以人类可读的文本或必须解码的渲染图像形式承载，即使其使用者是语言模型。我们提出 LatentPress，将对话历史和长文档写入第三种表示形式：连续记忆令牌；冻结的解码器通过其输入嵌入接口直接读取这些令牌，无需在推理时重建文本。一个与读取器匹配的小型写入器可以实现4至16倍压缩，同时训练的仅是一个适配器，其参数量为420万至2620万，仅约占解码器参数量的0.1%。在 LongMemEval 上，LatentPress 在7.70倍压缩下达到0.504的准确率，而未压缩证据的准确率为0.490；它优于文本摘要的0.184和基于 OCR 的压缩结果（0.426至0.312）。在 LongBench-QA 上，域内写入器在4至8倍压缩下达到与读取原始上下文相当或更高的性能，而在16倍压缩下性能低于原始上下文。写入每段对话耗时43毫秒，大约比文本摘要或 OCR 重建快一个数量级；读取速度则比原始上下文或缓存的 OCR 快5至9倍。我们在两种迁移设置下验证了该接口：一是从 UltraChat 零样本迁移到 LongMemEval 记忆问答，二是从基于 LongMemEval 的问答迁移到未见过的 LongBench 文档领域。结果表明，直接使用软令牌是一种实用的、超越文本和视觉的面向机器的上下文接口。

articles.title: Gradient-Update Mismatch: Rethinking Conflict-Free Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 梯度更新失配：重新思考物理信息神经网络的无冲突训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01558v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) requires jointly optimizing physics residual and initial/boundary condition loss terms, which often induce conflicting gradients. Gradient surgery methods mitigate this issue by constructing directions from loss-specific gradients to reduce conflict before optimizer transformation. However, even when the constructed direction is conflict-free, this property may not be preserved after optimizer transformation. Let aₜ denote the direction constructed by gradient surgery, uₜ the optimizer proposal, and Cₜ the conflict-free cone induced by the loss-specific gradients. We show that modern optimizers can transform aₜ through mechanisms such as historical state, adaptive scaling, preconditioning, or decoupled weight decay, so aₜ in Cₜ does not generally imply uₜ in Cₜ. We refer to this optimizer-induced discrepancy in conflict-freeness between aₜ and uₜ as Gradient-Update Mismatch (GUM). Accordingly, we propose Gradient-Update Alignment (GUA), which projects uₜ onto Cₜ to obtain the aligned update pₜ and applies pₜ to the parameters. When the optimizer maintains internal state, GUA further adjusts this state toward targets reconstructed from the applied update. We conduct extensive experiments and find that GUM is widespread across momentum, adaptive, and curvature-based optimizers, with conflict rates reaching up to 86.3%. Across all PINN settings, GUA achieves conflict-free applied updates and consistently improves various gradient surgery methods, reducing the relative L₂ error by up to 98.2% in individual settings. Data and code are available at https://github.com/JingXiao10/GUA.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络需要联合优化物理残差损失与初始/边界条件损失，而这些损失往往产生相互冲突的梯度。本文指出，梯度手术构造的无冲突方向在经过现代优化器的历史状态、自适应缩放、预条件或权重衰减变换后，可能重新产生冲突，并将这种差异称为梯度更新失配。作者提出梯度更新对齐方法，将优化器提议投影到无冲突锥中，并在含内部状态时同步调整优化器状态，从而在实验中实现无冲突更新并显著降低误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 训练物理信息神经网络（PINN）需要联合优化物理残差损失和初始/边界条件损失，而这些损失项经常会产生相互冲突的梯度。梯度手术方法通过从特定损失的梯度构造方向，在优化器变换之前减少冲突，从而缓解这一问题。然而，即使构造出的方向不存在冲突，这一性质也未必能在经过优化器变换后保持。设aₜ表示由梯度手术构造的方向，uₜ表示优化器提议的更新，Cₜ表示由特定损失梯度诱导的无冲突锥。我们表明，现代优化器可以通过历史状态、自适应缩放、预条件或解耦权重衰减等机制变换aₜ，因此aₜ属于Cₜ并不一般意味着uₜ也属于Cₜ。我们将aₜ与uₜ之间这种由优化器诱导的无冲突性差异称为梯度更新失配（GUM）。据此，我们提出梯度更新对齐（GUA），将uₜ投影到Cₜ上以获得对齐更新pₜ，并将pₜ应用于模型参数。当优化器维护内部状态时，GUA还会根据已应用的更新重建目标状态，并进一步将内部状态调整至这些目标。我们开展了广泛实验，发现 GUM 在动量、自适应和基于曲率的优化器中普遍存在，冲突率最高可达86.3%。在所有 PINN 设置中，GUA 都能实现无冲突的实际更新，并持续改进多种梯度手术方法，在部分设置中将相对L₂误差最多降低98.2%。

articles.title: I-CARE: Analysis of interference-related phenomena in a controllable, diverse and representative unlearning setting for text-to-image models
articles.title_zh: I-CARE：在可控、多样且具代表性的文本到图像模型遗忘设置中分析干扰相关现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00003v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine unlearning studies the removal of knowledge from an AI model, making the system forget a concept it previously learned. Despite rapid progress in generative machine unlearning, the unintended degradation of semantically related concepts that should have been retained (henceforth, interference) remains poorly characterized and inconsistently evaluated. This paper introduces I-CARE, a methodology that formalizes interference as a first-class object of study in generative unlearning. Rather than proposing a new benchmark or unlearning algorithm, I-CARE provides formal definitions for tasks, metrics, and templates for reporting results, enabling the systematic and reproducible study of interference across unlearning settings. While our methodology is designed to remain valid as models and unlearning algorithms evolve, decoupling long-term scientific insight from transient empirical results, we present a feasibility demonstration with state-of-the-art algorithms and frequently used datasets. The results demonstrate that I-CARE enables meaningful analysis of interference patterns across multiple unlearning settings, establishing the practical applicability of the framework. The software implementation of the methodology is provided in an open-source framework, together with a web-based graphical interface that enables exploration of the outcomes of this study without requiring direct interaction with the codebase or specialized data analysis tools.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器遗忘旨在移除人工智能模型已经学到的知识，但生成式模型遗忘过程中与应保留的语义相关概念发生的非预期退化，即干扰，仍缺乏系统刻画和一致评估。本文提出 I-CARE，将干扰形式化为生成式遗忘中的一等研究对象，并提供任务定义、指标和结果报告模板，而不提出新的基准或遗忘算法。基于可复现的方法论、可行性实验和开源工具，I-CARE 支持在多种遗忘设置中系统分析干扰模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器遗忘研究旨在从人工智能模型中移除知识，使系统忘记此前学到的某个概念。尽管生成式机器遗忘发展迅速，但本应保留的语义相关概念遭受非预期退化的问题（下文称为干扰）仍缺乏充分刻画，其评估方式也不一致。本文提出 I-CARE，这是一种将干扰形式化为生成式遗忘中一等研究对象的方法论。I-CARE 不提出新的基准或遗忘算法，而是提供任务和指标的形式化定义，以及结果报告模板，从而支持在不同遗忘设置中系统且可复现地研究干扰。尽管该方法论的设计目标是随着模型和遗忘算法的发展继续有效，将长期科学认识与短期经验结果相分离，我们仍使用最先进的算法和常用数据集开展了可行性演示。结果表明，I-CARE 能够在多种遗忘设置中对干扰模式进行有意义的分析，确立了该框架的实际适用性。该方法论的软件实现以开源框架形式提供，并配备基于网页的图形界面，使用户无需直接操作代码库或使用专门的数据分析工具即可探索本研究的结果。

articles.title: When Prediction Error Is Not Enough: Evaluating Nuisance-Function Prediction for Causal Estimation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Prediction error is widely used to evaluate nuisance-function estimators in causal inference, but its relationship with causal estimator performance may differ across performance measures. We studied this question in a partially linear model using Monte Carlo simulations. We compared ordinary least squares (OLS), generalized additive models (GAMs), XGBoost, and Double Machine Learning with XGBoost (DML-XGBoost), evaluating nuisance-function prediction error, bias, RMSE, and 95% confidence interval coverage. We also examined a simple joint-error measure based on the absolute cross-product of estimation errors from the exposure and outcome nuisance functions. Across the simulated settings, XGBoost had the lowest RMSE among the non-oracle methods, while DML-XGBoost generally provided better confidence interval coverage. Prediction error did not consistently track causal bias across methods and settings, and the method with the best point-estimation performance did not necessarily have the best confidence interval coverage. The joint-error measure was only weakly associated with causal bias and did not provide a useful standalone measure of causal performance. These results suggest that prediction error is useful for assessing nuisance-function estimation, but it should not be treated as a direct measure of the quality of the resulting causal estimator.

articles.title: Exact Global MCMC with Denoising Diffusion
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00279v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work shows that diffusion models learned with standard denoising loss can provide effective global MCMC proposals for complex high-dimensional target densities. The method is motivated by the observation that sequentially applying a forward and reverse diffusion process defines a Markov chain with a target stationary distribution for an ideal denoiser trained on samples of the target distribution. This observation can be made exact for any denoiser by applying a Metropolis-Hastings step whose acceptance ratio includes the density of the forward and reverse paths of a discrete time SDE approximation. We therefore propose to train denoising diffusion models on locally convergent MALA samples to learn global MCMC proposals. We call the composition of the global denoiser-based path sampler and a local MALA sampler Denoising Diffusion Monte Carlo (DDMC). Experiments show that DDMC can provide global proposals with high acceptance across a variety of complex target densities. Our results offer preliminary evidence that the established scaling behavior of standard diffusion training transfers directly to exact sampling from high-dimensional unnormalized densities.

articles.title: Latent-Space No-Arbitrage Geometry of Generative Models for Implied Volatility Surfaces
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00332v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative models for implied volatility surfaces must produce outputs that satisfy static no-arbitrage constraints. We study these constraints in latent space. For a fixed generator, we assign each latent code a scalar margin determined by the no-arbitrage conditions of the generated surface. The codes with nonnegative margin form the admissible latent set. We establish conditions under which strictly admissible codes remain admissible under small perturbations and the boundary of the admissible set is characterized by zero margin. For regular boundary components, we formulate a level-set equation whose local dynamics are directed toward the zero-margin set. The analysis treats the generator as a map from latent variables to surfaces and is therefore not restricted to a particular architecture. It applies to variational autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and other generative models with a deterministic realization map. Numerical tests recover known boundaries in analytic examples. Experiments with a variational autoencoder trained on Heston surfaces show that similar reconstruction errors can correspond to different admissible regions and that the latent prior may be concentrated inside such a region. The computed boundary can also be used to modify latent codes that generate violating surfaces.

articles.title: Towards unsupervised representation learning for quantum data: quantum models with inference and generation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00372v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: With quantum sensors, simulators and networks emerging, a future of quantum technology may produce quantum states as data---that is, coherently rather than as classical measurement records---thus motivating the study of suitable quantum generalisations of modern machine learning, including the automated, unsupervised extraction of useful representations. Two ingredients are central to the latter: inference, mapping observations to latent representations, and generation, mapping latent states back to synthetic data. Both are related to each other and to joint distributions for training models by the chain-rule of classical probability theory. The fact that quantum states however lack such universal, standard factorisation property thus poses a challenge. Here we develop a conceptual and mathematical framework for unsupervised representation learning from quantum data. Models are joint quantum states over visible and latent systems; state-over-time maps provide a notion of factorisation into a marginal state and inference (generation) channel; models with inference (generation) are ambiguous states---states for which such factorisation obtains---subject to a further consistency condition on extended inference maps as data extension. These stipulations are restrictive: we show that non-trivial models must feature non-linear such maps to the extended space. For three representative state-over-time maps, we completely characterise the ambiguous states, uncovering a hierarchy tied to the positive-partial-transpose (PPT) criterion from entanglement theory. Notably, the Leifer-Spekkens construction supports inference and generation exactly for model classes of PPT states, thus allowing genuinely quantum visible-latent correlations. We also formulate quantum counterparts of exact and approximate inference training, explore weaker notions of data extension and sketch a future research programme.

articles.title: Capability-Gated Language Models: Security Composes, Utility Does Not
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00445v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deployed language model safeguards (safety fine-tuning, filtering, unlearning) vary by principal only outside the model weights: filters are reconfigured, tiers are multiplied, and artefacts are reissued; inside one set of weights every request meets the same model configuration. This motivates us to define capability-gated deployment: per-principal access control inside one set of weights, whose configurations form a lattice - meets accumulate a principal's restrictions and joins pool a coalition's reach. We instantiate it by sparse rank gating over an existing nested-factorisation mechanism, guide profile search with one-pass attribution, and read every result once from a pre-registered held-out split. Security composes: provably at meets under a monotone-elicitation assumption we falsify pointwise. In two lineages the median held-out meet deepens suppression; the one effect surviving correction strengthens it. Utility does not: individually harmless profiles can compose to retention and fluency damage, and no compositional bound exists.

articles.title: Real-Time Neuromorphic Spectrum Intelligence Simulator
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00585v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present the Real-Time Neuromorphic Spectrum Intelligence Simulator (RT-NuSIS), a modular framework to study spiking neural network (SNN) and memristor-inspired agents for dynamic spectrum access under constrained energy budgets and adversarial conditions. RT-NuSIS couples leaky integrate-and-fire neuronal dynamics, memristive synaptic models, physics-informed energy-harvesting models (triboelectric and RF), and adversary models including jamming and Byzantine behavior. We formalize the simulator mathematically, prove boundedness, present a mean-field adversary threshold, analyze per-step complexity, and provide a reproducible benchmark harness for energy-per-inference, latency, and robustness metrics. The codebase is modular, deterministic by seed, and designed for large-scale event-driven simulations.

articles.title: Sharp Mixed Spectral Barron Regularity of Coulombic Many-Electron Wave Functions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00872v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish sharp mixed spectral Barron regularity for eigenfunctions of molecular Coulomb Hamiltonians. The mixed norm is a Fourier L¹ norm with one isotropic weight and coordinate-product weights, and therefore detects regularity invisible to the isotropic Barron scale. For a nonempty set I of electron indices on which the wave function is antisymmetric, we derive an explicit admissible region for the isotropic order s and the coordinate orders α,β. This region is optimal as a uniform statement over the class of clamped-nuclei Coulomb Hamiltonians. For fixed-spin components with two occupied spin blocks, it reduces to s+α+β<1; in the fully spin-polarized class it reduces to s+α<1. In particular, if mathcal I_σ denotes the family of occupied same-spin blocks determined by σ, then every fixed-spin spatial component ψ_σ satisfies, for every 0≤α<1, [ left(sumIᵢₙₘₐₜₕcₐₗ I_σprodᵢᵢₙ Ilangleξᵢrangle^αright)widehatψ_σin L¹(R³N). ] For a fully spin-polarized state, mathcal I_σ=1,ldots,N.

articles.title: Persistent Entropy as a Detector of Phase Transitions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.09058v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Persistent entropy is a scalar summary of persistence barcodes widely used to detect regime changes, yet there is no account of when a structural change in a barcode must produce a detectable change in entropy. We establish a model-agnostic theorem supplying such conditions. Treating persistence diagrams as random objects indexed by a control parameter, we identify a dispersion-condensation mechanism in the normalized persistence weights and derive an explicit lower bound on the entropy difference between the two regimes, valid with high probability at finite sample size and insensitive to the absolute scale of bar lifetimes. We also give a procedure for verifying the hypotheses on empirical barcodes. Applied to convolutional networks, the criterion shows that the circular organization of learned filters reported by Gabrielsson and Carlsson emerges through a sharp topological phase transition, and locates its onset: within a few hundred iterations on MNIST, but an order of magnitude later on CIFAR-10. The same criterion detects the Kuramoto synchronization and Vicsek order-disorder transitions.

articles.title: AL-SPCE - Reliability analysis for nondeterministic models using stochastic polynomial chaos expansions and active learning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.04553v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reliability analysis traditionally relies on deterministic simulators, where identical inputs yield identical outputs. However, many real-world systems exhibit stochastic behavior, producing non-repeatable outcomes even under identical conditions. Stochastic simulators account for this behavior by representing the response as a random variable, whose intrinsic variability must be considered in reliability analysis. While Monte Carlo simulation can address this problem, its computational cost is often prohibitive. Stochastic emulators have therefore been introduced as surrogate models capable of reproducing the random simulator response at reduced cost. Recent studies have shown their potential for reliability analysis, but accurate estimates may still require relatively large training sets, which can be impractical for expensive models. In this work, we propose an active learning framework to further reduce the computational effort. Focusing on stochastic polynomial chaos expansions (SPCE), we introduce a learning function that identifies regions relevant to reliability estimation where the emulator exhibits high predictive uncertainty. We further exploit the asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator to quantify local prediction uncertainty. The resulting methodology, termed active learning stochastic polynomial chaos expansions (AL-SPCE), is validated on three types of problems. In all cases, AL-SPCE significantly improves computational efficiency compared with previous surrogate-based approaches and direct Monte Carlo simulation, while maintaining accurate reliability estimates.

articles.title: Towards a Belief-Based World Model for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00455v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are being used as policies for autonomous decision-making and planning in many domains. Despite their strong reasoning capabilities, LLMs struggle with long-horizon tasks, especially under partial observability. World models are a promising way to enhance policy performance, both during training and inference. During inference, agents currently use world models to simulate the consequences of candidate actions before committing to an action, which can improve decision-making. However, we argue that simulation alone is an incomplete interface for decision-making under partial observability: simulation doesn't adequately capture uncertainty about the current state, which agents may need for accurate decision-making. We address this limitation with Belief-Based World Models (BB-WMs), which model and maintain a belief that LLMs can query to access information on what is known and uncertain about the current state. Before developing methods to learn accurate BB-WMs, we first ask a more fundamental question: does exposing a world model's belief directly to an LLM policy improve decision-making? Our results show that giving LLM agents access to world model beliefs improves task performance under partial observability, while remaining complementary to existing simulation-based world models. Code is released at https://github.com/skumar-ml/belief-world-models.

articles.title: ChatDev 2.0: A No-Code Multi-Agent Platform for Developing Everything
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, yet their development forces a tradeoff: code frameworks are expressive but engineering-intensive, while no-code builders simplify authoring but constrain agent interactions to author-defined workflows. We present ChatDev 2.0: DevAll (hereafter DevAll), a no-code platform for building, executing, and inspecting heterogeneous MAS that delivers both high expressiveness and ease of use. In terms of expressiveness, DevAll pairs a declarative executable graph abstraction with a cycle-aware execution engine, so that heterogeneous agents and dynamic and cyclic interactions can be represented and executed within a single framework. For ease of use, an integrated visual interface lets users author, run, monitor, and inspect MAS, including human-in-the-loop steps, entirely without writing code. Experiments demonstrate that DevAll reproduces state-of-the-art MAS across three representative tasks at competitive performance and without task-specific orchestration code, highlighting its effectiveness as a general-purpose platform for LLM-based MAS. DevAll is available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev.

articles.title: Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction (NeuSOGA): From Observations to Symbolic Mathematical Representations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence is the transformation of observations into explicit symbolic representations suitable for abstraction, interpretation, and reasoning. While modern AI systems achieve remarkable perceptual capabilities through large-scale statistical learning, the resulting knowledge is typically encoded within latent parameters that are difficult to inspect or manipulate analytically. Inspired by Neuro-Symbolic AI and theories of human abstraction, this paper investigates the formation of symbolic mathematical representations from geometric observations. We propose NeuSOGA (Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction), a framework that progressively transforms observations into topological abstractions, geometric abstractions, and ultimately symbolic mathematical representations. The architecture combines topology-guided structural discovery using Euclidean Distance Transforms, foundation-model perception using Segment Anything, adaptive multi-scale geometric abstraction, and symbolic synthesis through Implicit Area Splines. The resulting representation is an analytical implicit model supporting arbitrary-order smoothness, additive composition, and closed-form evaluation. Unlike neural latent encodings, the generated representation remains interpretable, editable, and mathematically explicit. Experiments on ModelNet40 point clouds, arbitrary-view projections, and segmented optical observations demonstrate that NeuSOGA transforms diverse observations into compact symbolic representations while preserving essential geometric and topological structure across sensing modalities and viewing directions. NeuSOGA provides an interpretable and explainable pathway from observation to symbol and establishes

articles.title: RePro: Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting for Reliable Evaluation of LLM Mathematical Problem Solving
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00062v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Data contamination undermines the reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on mathematical problem solving. While rewriting-based evaluation mitigates memorization, existing methods lack guarantees of problem validity and answer correctness. We propose Proof-Verified Benchmark Rewriting (RePro), the first framework to integrate Lean-oriented neural automated theorem provers (ATPs) into benchmark rewriting, which rewrites problems and regenerates answers with correctness ensured by Lean-verified proofs. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH show that RePro's retained rewritten instances achieve 100% well-definedness, feasibility, and answer correctness, while existing methods still produce invalid or incorrect instances. Moreover, several models exhibit accuracy drops on proof-verified rewritten benchmarks, suggesting that their performance is sensitive to surface-level and structural variations and may partly reflect memorization effects. Our source code and data are available at https://github.com/AI4Engi/RePro.

articles.title: Detecting Hidden Behaviors in LLMs via Activation-matched Finetuning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00351v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models can hide hidden behaviors that activate only under narrow conditions, such as backdoor triggers, sleeper-agent deployment cues, sandbagging, or topic-conditioned censorship. Such behaviors are difficult to detect without prior knowledge what to look for. We present activation-matched finetuning, an unsupervised detection method that assumes no knowledge of the trigger or the target behavior. Given a suspect model and a publicly available anchor, we finetune the anchor to reproduce the suspect's activations on a small benign corpus, and score each evaluation prompt by the residual between the two models. Since no benign corpus covers the sparse trigger region, the reference learns the benign computation but not the hidden behavior. Therefore, trigger prompts -- and, crucially, their semantic neighbors -- incur a large residual that signal the presence of unusual behavior to the defender. Testing our method across third-party models and custom models, activation-matched finetuning surfaces hidden behavior reliably. Furthermore, we empirically consider a natural defense-aware attack and showcase that it fails to suppress our detection method without sacrificing the behavior itself.

articles.title: (V)LMs generalize beyond surface co-occurrence: Evidence from cross-modal number agreement
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00443v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language models learn about grammatical number primarily from co-occurrence, and show frequency effects as a result---sometimes taken to indicate that they do not learn abstract ``rules'', and are instead dependent on specific lexical items. Testing generalization with text stimuli alone cannot settle this debate, since distributional cues (is/are, this/these) easily give number away. We instead use cross-modal generalization as a tool to investigate abstractions in LMs that can also accept visual inputs (VLMs), restricting the evidence that diagnoses number to an extra-linguistic modality. We teach VLMs pairs of new nouns by adding new embeddings and only updating them during learning, comparing conditions where number is diagnosed by visual cues alone against ones where it is disambiguated by text. Across behavior, representational dynamics, and causal mechanisms, we find non-trivial evidence for cross-modal generalization across both exposure conditions, and that linguistic vs. extra-linguistic cue conditions are treated in similar ways in the internal mechanisms of the model. This suggests that statistical learners like VLMs can generalize beyond surface-level co-occurrence and show genuine abstraction-compatible behavior.

articles.title: Runtime-Independent Persistent Agents: Preserving Identity, Memory, and Code Across Models, Harnesses, and Servers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00546v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agent systems are commonly described by the model and harness that currently produce their behavior. That boundary is useful for one execution but underspecifies a long-lived agent that may change models, orchestration harnesses, interaction sessions, and host servers while retaining one identity, memory, and executable code lineage. We present a runtime-independent architecture for persistent agents. A continuity-bearing substrate Pₜ=(Iₜ,Mₜ,Bₜ) contains an architectural identity representation, private durable memory, and a versioned software body. A replaceable deployment binding comprises an execution substrate Eₜ=(Rₜ,Hₜ,Dₜ), which supplies a reasoner, harness, and host, and a set of interaction surfaces Sₜ, such as chat, API, or user interface bindings. A deployed execution is Aₜ=Pₜtriangleright(Eₜ,Sₜ); changing either replaceable layer is migration, not agent creation, when an authorized protocol preserves attributable lineage and transfers continuation authority within a governed deployment boundary. We define six continuity invariants and a quiesce--checkpoint--validate--bind--rehydrate--resume protocol. Enoch realizes the design as a reusable body plus private installed identity, memory, workflow state, and continuation authority, with infrastructure dependencies behind versioned provider contracts. A clean-room run of the frozen public commit passes 833 core tests and 92 provider and library tests executed separately from the core suite; deployments have exercised reasoner-version, interaction-surface, and host-machine substitutions while retaining continuity-bearing state. This evidence supports mechanical substitutability and authorized system continuity, not behavioral invariance or exhaustive pairwise evaluation. The downstream measurement question is whether an authorized continuation still recalls, composes, and enacts its identity.

articles.title: Thermally Adaptive Interfacial Polymer Network Enables Space-Compatible Perovskite Solar Cells
articles.abstract: Metal halide perovskite solar cells (PSCs) are promising candidates for next-generation terrestrial and space photovoltaics owing to their high power-to-weight ratio, solution processability and intrinsic radiation tolerance. Yet their practical deployment, particularly in low-Earth-orbit (LEO) environments, is hindered by rapid temperature fluctuations and intense ultraviolet (UV) irradiation. These coupled thermomechanical stresses accelerate buried-interfacial degradation by promoting stress accumulation, defect generation and inefficient charge extraction at the interface between self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) and the perovskite absorber. Here we report an adaptive buried interface enabled by the glass transition of a thermoresponsive poly(2-hydroxyethyl methacrylate) (P2HM) interlayer inserted between the SAMs and the perovskite. The polymer undergoes in-situ structural adaptation near its glass-transition temperature (Tg = 87.4°C), transforming into a compliant viscoelastic reticulated network that strengthens interfacial adhesion, bridges voids arising from incomplete SAM coverage and dynamically coordinates with undercoordinated Pb2+ sites. This adaptive interface not only passivates existing defects but also suppresses the continual generation of stress-induced interfacial defects during operation. The resulting PSCs achieve a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 27.25% (certificated 27.19%) while retaining 90% of their initial efficiency after 540 rapid thermal cycles (32°C min-1 ramp rate) between -60°C and +100°C and 93.4% after 316 h of intensified UV irradiation under 80 mW cm-2. Our findings establish thermally adaptive buried interfaces as a general strategy for mitigating mechanically driven interfacial degradation, providing a design principle for durable perovskite photovoltaics operating under extreme terrestrial and space environments.
articles.focus_summary: 论文提出了用于空间钙钛矿太阳能电池埋藏界面的热响应聚合物网络。该界面层能够在温度变化下调节机械柔顺性、填补自组装单分子层缺陷，并与欠配位Pb2+位点配位，从而缓解界面退化并改善电荷提取。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的卤化物钙钛矿、界面电荷转移、缺陷钝化和太阳能电池研究相关，但论文主要属于器件和实验界面工程，计算方法关联相对有限。其界面缺陷、动态配位和热机械适应机制可作为第一性原理及分子动力学研究的对象。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可通过第一性原理计算比较聚合物官能团与Pb缺陷位点的结合能、缺陷形成能和界面电荷转移，并用分子动力学研究温度循环下的结构稳定性。进一步可结合非绝热动力学分析聚合物界面对载流子复合和提取过程的影响。

articles.title: A retrievable cation-linked alginate ion-matrix for closed-loop agricultural water management
articles.abstract: Persistent contaminant residues in the water-food nexus threaten ecosystems and human health by disrupting plant hormone signaling and inducing epigenetic changes in humans. Tracking these hazards is difficult because conventional systems separate analyte isolation, sensing, and recovery into multiple steps. Here we report a retrievable cation-linked alginate ion-matrix that integrates contaminant absorption, Raman sensing, and magnetic recovery for closed-loop agricultural water management. We create a matrix that broadly absorbs chemically diverse toxicants, including those with low metal affinity, via hydrogel partitioning and nanoparticle interactions. Using this platform, we accomplish to isolate eight toxic analytes from water, including weakly interacting ones, and detect them via localized densification that amplifies label-free surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS), yielding a 15-fold signal increase and up to a 10⁹-fold reduction in detection limits. During arugula cultivation, the platform simultaneously monitors water quality, reduces plant uptake of toxicants by 50%, and preserves chlorophyll integrity for up to 14 days until magnetic retrieval is completed. Our findings provide a scalable strategy for autonomous, on-site agricultural water management to safeguard global food security.

articles.title: Well-Posedness Diagnostics and Staged Numerical Solution of MHD Buoyant Flow over a Bi-Axially Stretching Surface with Cattaneo--Christov Thermal Relaxation
articles.abstract: Similarity-reduced magnetohydrodynamic buoyant flow over a bi-axially stretching surface governed by the Cattaneo--Christov hyperbolic heat flux model is solved via a feed-forward cascade decomposition. Supercritical thermal relaxation causes the leading coefficient of the transformed energy equation to vanish at an interior collocation point, inducing a regular singular point and numerical breakdown. A closed-form admissibility criterion, derived analytically from the reduced system, identifies the parameter subspace in which the boundary-value problem remains non-degenerate. The feed-forward structure of the momentum, thermal, and free-stream subsystems is exploited to eliminate inter-subsystem stiffness and reduce the global problem to three sequentially solved, well-posed stages. Primary solutions are obtained via residual-controlled adaptive collocation. Independent verification employs a Chebyshev pseudospectral discretization of the momentum subsystem, with both schemes in agreement to double-precision tolerance and the spectral solver exhibiting exponential convergence. Parametric analysis shows that elevated Hartmann number and Prandtl number progressively contract the admissible relaxation domain, imposing increasingly stringent constraints on physically realizable thermal relaxation times. The derived admissibility bounds provide rigorous parameter selection criteria for non-Fourier boundary-layer computations.

articles.title: A conserved structural organization of the human public TCRβ repertoire persists throughout exceptional longevity
articles.abstract: The human public T-cell receptor (TCR) repertoire provides a shared immunological framework across individuals, yet whether it possesses a conserved higher-order structural organization and how this organization is affected by lifelong immune ageing remain unknown. Here, we constructed a structural atlas of the human public TCRβ repertoire from 1.33 million unique public CDR3β sequences derived from healthy Adults (80 years). The atlas comprised 64 reproducible Structural Sequence Modules (SSMs) representing sequence-coherent neighborhoods supported by quantitative model selection and independent topological validation. Projection of individual repertoires onto this common framework demonstrated complete preservation of all SSMs across both cohorts. Although 18 modules exhibited significant differences in unweighted occupancy, the global module hierarchy remained highly conserved, indicating that exceptional longevity is associated primarily with quantitative redistribution among pre-existing structural compartments rather than loss or replacement of repertoire organization. Rarefaction analysis demonstrated that unequal cohort size strongly influenced public-clonotype discovery but had minimal impact on the direction and magnitude of module-level occupancy differences, whereas frequency-weighted analysis indicated that remodeling was not primarily driven by expansion of highly abundant public clonotypes. Susceptibility to remodeling was associated mainly with module size and within-module CDR3β length variability. Module publicness was highly conserved across age groups and associated with coordinated sequence, germline and network properties, while TRBJ usage was substantially more strongly associated with SSM identity than TRBV usage. Finally, curated antigen annotations were non-randomly distributed across SSMs, demonstrating module-level functional biases, although structural proximity did not generally predict similarity in antigen-recognition profiles. Together, these findings identify higher-order structural organization as a robust property of the human public TCRβ repertoire. Exceptional longevity preserves this organization while selectively remodeling the occupancy of pre-existing Structural Sequence Modules, distinguishing age-associated quantitative redistribution from cohort-size effects and clonal expansion. The structural atlas therefore provides a reproducible framework for investigating the organization and remodeling of adaptive immune repertoires across ageing and immune-mediated conditions.

articles.title: Direct valorization of real acid mine drainage into MgAlFe-LDHs: structural evolution, sulfate fixation, and anionic pollutant removal
articles.abstract: Acid mine drainage (AMD) is a sulfate-rich acidic wastewater containing multiple dissolved metal ions, and conventional neutralization usually produces low-value sludge while rarely coupling treatment with resource recovery. In this study, real AMD was directly converted into MgAlFe layered double hydroxides (MgAlFe-LDHs) through a foreign-anion-free MgO/NaOH co-regulation route, in which pH and M2+/M3+ ratio were simultaneously adjusted without introducing additional anionic species from external metal salts. The effects of synthesis pH and M2+/M3+ ratio on LDH formation were investigated, and the recovered solids were characterized by XRD, FTIR, SEM-EDS, XPS, and DFT calculations to evaluate structural evolution and sulfate fixation. The results showed that LDH formation was highly dependent on synthesis conditions, and the sample prepared at pH 9.5 with an M2+/M3+ ratio of 2.5 exhibited the most favorable layered structure and crystallinity. Under this condition, dissolved metal ions and sulfate in AMD were synchronously removed and fixed during material formation, with the sulfate removal ratio reaching approximately 28.17%. DFT calculations further showed that the LDH model with an M2+/M3+ ratio of 2.5 had the lowest formation energy, while sulfate fixation at specific interlayer sites was thermodynamically feasible. The recovered AMD-derived MgAlFe-LDHs also showed subsequent removal potential toward methyl orange (MO) and Cr(VI), with maximum adsorption capacities of 49.78 and 14.19 mg·g− 1, respectively. These findings demonstrate a treatment-coupled route for converting real sulfate-rich AMD into functional LDH materials, linking mine-water treatment, sulfate fixation, resource recovery, and subsequent pollutant removal.

articles.title: Hollow Bowl‑Like MXene/FeNi3 Heterostructures for Electromagnetic Wave Absorption and Photo‑Thermo‑Electric Conversion
articles.abstract: Driven by rapid advancement of modern electronic and wireless technologies, multifunctional electromagnetic wave absorption (EMA) materials are urgently demanded in radar camouflage, 5G/6G communications and energy utilization. However, traditional EMA absorbers face a critical challenge in reconciling the inherent trade-off between high-efficiency absorption and multifunctional integration. Inspired by bioinspired architecture, we construct a hollow bowl-like MXene/FeNi3 heterostructure that enables precise modulation of interfacial charge distribution and band alignment, while simultaneously triggering synergistic effects among interfacial charge transport, oxygen vacancy defects and magnetic interactions. Benefiting from these merits, the optimized MXene/FeNi3 achieves extraordinarily EMA performance with a minimum reflection loss (RLₘiₙ) of − 77.90 dB, an effective absorption bandwidth (EAB) of 6.31 GHz, and a Radar Cross section value of − 45.36 dB m2. Furthermore, MXene/FeNi3 exhibits outstanding photo-thermo-electric conversion performance, maintaining a stable surface temperature of 56.7°C for over 6 hours, along with a superior open-circuit voltage of 225.8 mV and short-circuit current of 38.9 mA under 1 sun illumination. More importantly, this architecture design strategy is readily extendable to other magnetic systems such as Co, CoFe, CoNi, and FeCoNi, establishing a versatile platform for the development of next-generation multifunctional integrated EMA materials.

articles.title: Hot tearing behavior and underlying mechanisms of Mg-xCu-2xGd alloys with varying total Cu and Gd content
articles.abstract: As novel high strength-ductility cast magnesium alloys, LPSO (long-period stacking order) strengthened Mg-Cu-Gd alloys still require further evaluation of their hot tearing resistance. In this work, four Mg-Cux-Gd2x (x = 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 at%) alloys with a fixed Cu/Gd ratio of 0.5 were designed to systematically investigate the effect of total Cu and Gd content on their hot tearing susceptibility (HTS). The hot tearing and solidification behaviors of the alloys were evaluated using a T‑shaped mold casting system and a dual‑thermocouple thermal analysis apparatus, respectively. Combined with microstructural characterization, the mechanisms of hot tearing initiation, propagation, and healing were revealed. The results indicate that with increasing total Cu and Gd contents, the HTS of the alloys decreases significantly. The Kou0.6 index, calculated based on the temperature range corresponding to the solid fraction interval of 0.6–0.99, accurately reflects the cracking severity at the hot spot, with values of 886, 791, 659, and 114, respectively. A decrease in dendrite coherency temperature shortens the interdendritic feeding stage, improves the permeability of feeding channels, and reduces the probability of microcavity formation and the initial stress accumulation rate. The increase in LPSO phase content enhances the crack healing capacity of the alloys, as evidenced by the coarsening and increased number of healing patterns near the hot spot. After solidification, the LPSO phase drawn into the cracks forms coherent interfaces with the α‑Mg matrix on both sides, significantly improving the interfacial strength and effectively preventing crack re‑initiation. Meanwhile, the increased latent heat of solidification softens the dendritic skeleton, delays stress accumulation at the final stage of solidification, and improves the fluidity of the eutectic liquid. This study provides experimental evidence and theoretical guidance for expanding the selection of high strength-ductility magnesium alloys and for avoiding composition ranges with high HTS.

articles.title: NaCl-Assisted Synthesis of Co/CoS2 Heterostructures Encapsulated within N, S Co-doped Carbon Nanotubes as Electrocatalysts for Anion Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells and Rechargeable Liquid-State/flexible Zn-air Batteries
articles.abstract: The development of durable and cost-effective non-precious metal electrocatalysts for both the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) is crucial for the practical application of rechargeable Zn-air batteries (ZABs). Herein, we report a highly efficient and electrochemically stable bifunctional electrocatalyst consisting of N, S dual-doped carbon nanotubes (NSCNTs) grown on a porous dodecahedral carbon framework, which encapsulates the Co/CoS2 heterostructures. The porous architecture, engineered via NaCl-assisted templating combined with Zn evaporation, provides abundant access to active sites and promotes electrolyte penetration and mass transport. Meanwhile, the in-situ grown NSCNTs construct a three-dimensional conductive network that facilitates electron transport and stabilizes the embedded Co-based nanoparticles against aggregation. Furthermore, the N,S dual-heteroatom doping and Co/CoS2 heterointerface engineering introduce structural defects and modulating the surface electronic configuration of the catalyst, thereby optimizing the adsorption energetics of reaction intermediates. Benefiting from these integrated structural and electronic advantages, the Co/CoS2/NSCNT electrocatalyst delivers competitive bifunctional activity, exhibiting an overpotential of 334 mV at 10 mA cm− 2 for OER and a half-wave potential of 0.874 V for ORR. This enhanced ORR activity leads to the high-power density of 199.15 mW cm− 2, when Co/CoS2/NSCNT is assembled into the anion-exchange membrane fuel cell (AEMFC) cathode. When applied to liquid-state and flexible ZABs, the devices achieve peak power densities of 163.57 mW cm− 2 and 95.19 mW cm− 2, respectively, surpassing those of benchmark Pt/C- and RuO2-based ZABs. Moreover, both devices demonstrate robust cycling stability over 100 and 25 hours, respectively. These results underscore the effectiveness of synergistically integrating hierarchical porosity, conductive carbon networks, and heterointerface engineering in designing efficient and stable bifunctional electrocatalysts for next-generation flexible and wearable energy devices.

articles.title: An Intelligent Algorithm for Path Planning and Feed Rate Prediction in Shot Peening Forming of Complex Integral Panels
articles.abstract: Shot peen forming process planning for integral panel primarily involves path planning and parameter prediction.The shot peening path of integral panels determines the spatial distribution of shot impacts, while process parameters govern the deformation magnitude at each impact position. Together, these two factors control the shot coverage rate and outer surface accuracy of the component. Within the computational framework for progressive shot peening process parameters, this paper proposes an intelligent algorithm for path planning and process parameter prediction in shot peening forming of complex integral panels. First, the structural characteristics and shot peening forming parameters of complex integral panels are analyzed. Since the spanwise curvature radius of wing integral panels is relatively large, they can be approximated as single-curvature surfaces. A shot peening path calculation method based on extreme curvature tracking and an equal-strength region merging algorithm via feed rate consolidation are established. Subsequently, in accordance with the structural features of integral stiffened panels, test specimens including flat plate, I-shaped stringer and T-shaed stringer specimens are fabricated for shot peening forming experiments. The forming laws of flat plates and stiffened structures are compared and analyzed. The results verify that tests on flat plate specimens can provide fundamental data for the shot peening parameter design of stringer-reinforced integral panel. Further, specimens with a length of 200 mm and a width of 50 mm are prepared, featuring four different base plate thicknesses and two rib thicknesses (6 mm and 8 mm). Shot peening tests are conducted under 11 different feed rates to acquire prediction data for feed rate. Three feed rate prediction models for shot peening forming are established respectively using regression analysis, BP artificial neural network and linear interpolation. Comparative analysis reveals that the linear interpolation method delivers higher prediction accuracy and stability. The proposed methods are adopted to calculate the feed rate at each discrete point along the shot peening path of a practical part. The obtained data is used to compile NC programs and conduct shot peening forming. The results of component forming tests show that the outer surface deviation of the finished workpiece meets the precision requirements.

articles.title: Sustainable Bamboo-Activated Carbon/MXene/Carbonyl Iron Hybrid Fillers in Silicone Rubber: Toward Lightweight and Flexible Microwave Absorbers
articles.abstract: A quaternary flexible microwave-absorbing composite based on bamboo-derived activated carbon (AC), carbonyl iron (CI), Ti₃C₂Tₓ MXene, and room-temperature vulcanizing silicone rubber (SR) was synthesized and characterized across the X-band (8.2–12.4 GHz). Three formulations M1 (AC 2.5 wt%, CI 22.5 wt%, MXene 5 wt%), M2 (AC 5 wt%, CI 20 wt%, MXene 5 wt%), and M3 (AC 7.5 wt%, CI 17.5 wt%, MXene 5 wt%) were fabricated and evaluated. X-ray diffraction confirmed phase purity: MXene showed a (002) peak at 2θ = 7.88° (d₀₀₂ = 11.21 Å, Lc = 9.95 nm) with complete absence of the MAX-phase (104) reflection, verifying full etching; carbonyl iron exhibited the BCC α-Fe (110) peak at 44.73° (Dk = 28.6–30.4 nm); and bamboo AC displayed a turbostratic (002) hump at 24.77° (d₀₀₂ = 3.591 Å, Lc = 0.93 nm) with co-existing α-quartz at 26.64°. FTIR confirmed interfacial bonding among all four phases. In Raman Spectra presence of D and G band confirms the formation of AC. Electromagnetic parameters extracted via the Nicolson–Ross–Weir algorithm from VNA measurements revealed that natural ferromagnetic resonance of CI near 10 GHz dominates energy dissipation (tanδₘ ≈ 0.133), with secondary dielectric contributions from AC and MXene improving impedance matching. M3 delivered the best performance: reflection loss minimum of − 23 dB at 10.8 GHz, effective absorption bandwidth of 3.15 GHz, and peak absorbance of 0.93 at 11.2 GHz. M2 achieved the highest attenuation constant of 49 Np/m at 9.9 GHz. The biomass-derived AC imparts sustainability while simultaneously moderating composite permittivity, making this quaternary system a viable candidate for lightweight EMI shielding and radar-absorbing applications.

articles.title: Integrated photonic multigrid solver for partial differential equations
articles.abstract: Solving partial differential equations underpins quantitative modelling across physics, engineering and the natural sciences, but high-accuracy simulations increasingly push conventional high-performance computers to their limits. Many of these problems reduce to large, sparse linear systems whose solution is limited not only by arithmetic cost, but also by the sequential and communication-bound nature of established digital algorithms. Current trends in general-purpose digital hardware are not well aligned with these properties, resulting in the utilization of only a small fraction of the peak performance. Specialised photonic processors offer ultralow-latency matrix-vector operations, yet analog noise has so far prevented optical solvers from reaching the accuracies required for demanding scientific simulations. Here, we show the synergy between multigrid methods and low-latency photonic matrix-vector multipliers. We develop a mixed-precision photonic multigrid framework that offloads the computationally demanding smoothing algorithm to the optical domain. Within this framework, we construct integrated photonic multigrid solvers based on a photonic crossbar array. The solvers converge with residual norms below 10−10 for Poisson and Schrödinger problems and reduce high-precision digital operations by 60% and 80%, respectively. Extending the approach with an adaptive multigrid scheme for lattice quantum chromodynamics, we find reductions of up to 97% for ill-conditioned systems with small quark masses, potentially improving computational speed and efficiency by more than an order of magnitude. Using the strengths of high-precision digital and low-latency photonic computing, the integrated photonic multigrid solvers present an exciting trajectory to increase computational power in the post–Moore's law era.

Bruun The polaron, a single impurity embedded in a quantum many-body environment, conceptually bridges few- and many-body physics. This review discusses two pristine experimental platforms in which polarons have recently been realized: ultracold atomic gases and atomically thin transition-metal dichalcogenides.
