articles.title: Quantum AIO-ChameleonGAN for Behaviour-Aware Quantum–Classical Intrusion Detection of Adaptive Cyber Threats
articles.title_zh: 面向自适应网络威胁的行为感知量子-经典入侵检测：Quantum AIO-ChameleonGAN
articles.abstract: Stealthy, polymorphic, and behaviourally adaptive cyber attacks challenge intrusion detection systems that rely predominantly on statistical feature representations. This study proposes Quantum AIO-ChameleonGAN, a hybrid quantum--classical intrusion detection framework that extends CM-GAN through contextual behavioural modelling and variational quantum feature transformation. The proposed Angle of Incidence Optimization (AIO) strategy constructs an observation-specific benign reference from locally neighbouring benign traffic and represents directional deviation as a contextual behavioural descriptor. An eight-qubit Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) provides a complementary trainable feature transformation that is fused with the classical features and AIO descriptor for adversarial learning. Experiments on the CIC-UNSW-NB15 benchmark dataset employed a stratified 70:15:15 training--validation--test split, with preprocessing and augmentation restricted to the training partition and model selection performed using the validation partition. On the independent test partition, Quantum AIO-ChameleonGAN achieved 99.85% accuracy, 99.79% precision, 99.84% recall and anomaly detection rate (ADR), 99.81% F₁₋ₛcore, an MCC of 0.996, an AUROC of 0.9973, and an FNR of 0.16%. Relative to CM-GAN, the proposed framework improved accuracy and F₁₋ₛcore by 0.07 and 0.09 percentage points, respectively, while reducing the FNR from 0.24% to 0.16%, corresponding to a 33.3% relative reduction. Component-wise ablation showed complementary contributions from AIO and the VQC, with AIO providing the larger individual improvement and their combined representation achieving the strongest overall performance. Neighbourhood-sensitivity, ten-run paired statistical analysis, five-fold cross-validation, and adversarial perturbation experiments further supported the stability and robustness of the proposed framework under the evaluated conditions. Because the VQC was evaluated using state-vector simulation, the reported findings demonstrate a representational benefit of the hybrid formulation rather than quantum computational advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 隐蔽性、多态性及行为自适应网络攻击，对主要依赖统计特征表示的入侵检测系统构成挑战。本文提出混合量子-经典框架 Quantum AIO-ChameleonGAN，通过入射角优化策略刻画上下文行为偏离，并以八量子比特变分量子线路提供可训练的补充特征变换。在 CIC-UNSW-NB15 测试集上，该方法取得 99.85%的准确率和 0.16%的漏报率；消融、交叉验证及对抗扰动实验支持其在所评估条件下的稳定性与鲁棒性。由于变分量子线路基于态矢量模拟，结果表明的是混合表示带来的收益，而非量子计算优势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 隐蔽性、多态性和行为自适应的网络攻击，对主要依赖统计特征表示的入侵检测系统构成挑战。本文提出 Quantum AIO-ChameleonGAN，这是一种混合量子-经典入侵检测框架，它通过上下文行为建模和变分量子特征变换扩展了 CM-GAN。所提出的入射角优化（AIO）策略利用局部相邻的良性流量构建特定于观测样本的良性参考，并将方向偏差表示为一种上下文行为描述符。一个八量子比特变分量子线路（VQC）提供补充性的可训练特征变换，并与经典特征及 AIO 描述符融合，以进行对抗学习。在 CIC-UNSW-NB15 基准数据集上的实验采用分层的 70:15:15 训练-验证-测试划分，预处理和数据增强均限制在训练分区内，模型选择则使用验证分区完成。在独立测试分区上，Quantum AIO-ChameleonGAN 达到 99.85%的准确率、99.79%的精确率、99.84%的召回率和异常检测率（ADR）、99.81%的 F1 分数、0.996 的 MCC、0.9973 的 AUROC，以及 0.16%的假阴性率（FNR）。相对于 CM-GAN，所提框架的准确率和 F1 分数分别提高了 0.07 和 0.09 个百分点，同时将 FNR 从 0.24%降至 0.16%，相当于相对降低 33.3%。按组件进行的消融实验表明，AIO 和 VQC 具有互补贡献，其中 AIO 提供了更大的单独改进，而二者的组合表示实现了最强的总体性能。邻域敏感性分析、十次运行的配对统计分析、五折交叉验证和对抗扰动实验，进一步支持了所提框架在已评估条件下的稳定性和鲁棒性。由于 VQC 使用态矢量模拟进行评估，所报告的发现表明的是混合表述的表示优势，而不是量子计算优势。

articles.title: Benchmarking unsupervised protein mutational effect predictors: practical guidelines for protein engineering and reduced accuracy at beneficial residues
articles.title_zh: 无监督蛋白质突变效应预测器的基准测试：面向蛋白质工程的实用指南及其在有益残基上的准确率下降
articles.abstract: Computational protein mutational effect prediction is becoming a powerful tool for protein engineering. Despite active methodological development, existing benchmarks have largely concentrated on amino acid substitution prediction across entire proteins, while more practical metrics such as accuracy specific to protein structure contexts have received considerably less attention. Here, we benchmarked 3 mainstream methods: protein language model, molecular simulation, and structure-based machine-learning prediction, using large scale deep mutational scanning datasets. Beyond prediction accuracy of amino acid substitution, we benchmarked prediction accuracy of residue position that enhances function by mutation, accuracy by tertiary and secondary structure contexts as well as amino acid’s physicochemical properties. The result shows the applicability of computational prediction methods for selecting position to introduce mutation. We also provide guidelines for ProteinMPNN and LigandMPNN, showing that model and input structure should be selected depending on the target functional property. In addition, we identified consistent weaknesses across methods, including reduced accuracy for surface and binding interface residues, helix and loop structures, involving changes in charge or polar residues. Moreover, we demonstrate that all tested computational approaches show decreased accuracy on residues whose mutations enhance function, suggesting their limited predictive performance for gain-of-function mutations. Together, our benchmark presented practical guidelines for unsupervised protein mutational effect prediction methods for protein engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 计算蛋白质突变效应预测正成为蛋白质工程的重要工具，但现有基准测试较少关注结构情境下的实用性能。本文使用大规模深度突变扫描数据，对蛋白质语言模型、分子模拟和基于结构的机器学习方法进行比较，并提出 ProteinMPNN 和 LigandMPNN 的使用建议。结果显示，各方法对表面、结合界面、螺旋和环区，以及涉及电荷或极性残基变化的预测存在一致弱点；对增强功能突变的预测准确率也普遍降低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计算蛋白质突变效应预测正成为蛋白质工程的强大工具。尽管方法学发展活跃，现有基准测试大多集中于整个蛋白质范围内的氨基酸替换预测，而对于更实用的指标，例如特定蛋白质结构情境下的准确率，则受到的关注明显较少。本文利用大规模深度突变扫描数据集，对三种主流方法进行了基准测试：蛋白质语言模型、分子模拟和基于结构的机器学习预测。除氨基酸替换预测准确率外，我们还对能够通过突变增强功能的残基位置预测准确率、按三级和二级结构情境划分的准确率，以及按氨基酸理化性质划分的准确率进行了基准测试。结果表明，计算预测方法可用于选择引入突变的位置。我们还为 ProteinMPNN 和 LigandMPNN 提供了指导原则，指出应根据目标功能性质选择模型和输入结构。此外，我们识别出不同方法间一致存在的弱点，包括对表面残基和结合界面残基、螺旋和环结构，以及涉及电荷或极性残基变化时的准确率下降。我们进一步表明，所有测试的计算方法在突变可增强功能的残基上均表现出准确率下降，这提示它们对功能获得性突变的预测性能有限。总体而言，我们的基准测试为蛋白质工程中的无监督蛋白质突变效应预测方法提供了实用指南。

articles.title: Nanoscale Defect Modulation in Zn 1-x Ni x Fe 2 O 4 Spinel Nanoparticles: Hydrodynamic Agglomeration, Mesoporosity, and Coupled Magnetic and Electrochemical Responses
articles.title_zh: Zn1-xNixFe2O4 尖晶石纳米颗粒中的纳米尺度缺陷调控：水动力团聚、中孔性及磁性与电化学耦合响应
articles.abstract: Spinel ferrites (Zn1−xNixFe2O4) exhibit adjustable magnetic and electrical properties, which are influenced by the distribution of cations between the tetrahedral and octahedral sites. XRD confirmed cubic spinel structure formation with systematic lattice contraction from 8.485 Å (x = 0.00) to 8.451 Å (x = 0.02), followed by a pronounced anomaly at x = 0.03 (a = 8.522 Å) and relaxation at x = 0.04 (8.462 Å). The x = 0.03 composition exhibited the minimum crystallite size (19.7 nm) and maximum microstrain (0.0058), consistent with the heightened defect density and cation redistribution. FTIR showed characteristic spinel bands (ν1 = 547–550 cm− 1, ν2 = 451–460 cm− 1) and Kt > Ko (2.19–2.22×105 vs. 1.49–1.55×105 dyne/cm), alongside minor signatures of adsorbed water/CO2 and trace amounts of PVA residues. The EIS Nyquist spectra displayed a single depressed semicircle dominated by grain boundaries; the fitted Rgb peaked at 11119.0 Ω at x = 0.03 with non-Debye behavior (θ = 36.75°–44.73°, n up to 0.592), indicating maximal boundary scattering and suppressed Fe2+/Fe3+ hopping. Despite nanoscale primary sizes, DLS revealed severe aqueous agglomeration (Z-average 3006–4539.9 nm; PDI 0.907–1.270), maximized at x = 0.03 (4539.9 nm; diffusion minimum 1.084×10− 9 cm2/s), consistent with FE-SEM observations of porous spherical agglomerates formed via PVA combustion and gas evolution. Electrochemically, CV at 10 mV s− 1 showed a shift from an anodic peak (123.3 mV, 1.548 µA for x = 0.00) to cathodic-dominated redox (− 146.9 to − 338.6 mV) upon Ni substitution; specific capacitance dropped at x = 0.01, then increased to 6.47 and 6.24 mF g− 1 at x = 0.02 and 0.03 before declining to 3.14 mFg− 1 at x = 0.04, attributed to defect-rich mesoporosity and enlarged electroactive interface. VSM indicated soft ferrimagnetic/near-superparamagnetic behavior (Mr/Ms = 0.0033–0.0529) with a critical x = 0.03 hardening: Ms sharply decreased to 23.087×10− 3 emu g− 1, while Hc rose to 150.0 Oe and K to 1.732 erg g− 1, implicating dead-layer spin canting and defect/grain-boundary pinning. Overall, a narrow compositional threshold near x = 0.03 maximizes the defect density and grain-boundary networks, simultaneously enhancing the coercivity and optimizing faradaic charge storage, establishing low-concentration Ni doping as an effective strategy to co-tune the magnetic functionality and electrochemical energy-storage performance in Zn-ferrite nanomaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究低浓度 Ni 掺杂对 Zn1-xNixFe2O4 尖晶石纳米颗粒结构缺陷、团聚行为、磁性和电化学性质的影响。x=0.03 的组分表现出最小晶粒尺寸、最大微应变、最高晶界电阻及最严重的水相团聚，反映出增强的缺陷密度和阳离子重新分布。该临界组分同时提升矫顽力并优化法拉第储电性能，表明低浓度 Ni 掺杂可协同调控锌铁氧体纳米材料的磁功能与储能表现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尖晶石铁氧体（Zn1−xNixFe2O4）具有可调的磁性和电学性质，这些性质受阳离子在四面体位与八面体位之间分布的影响。XRD 证实形成了立方尖晶石结构，其晶格从 8.485 Å（x=0.00）系统性收缩至 8.451 Å（x=0.02），随后在 x=0.03 时出现显著异常（a=8.522 Å），并在 x=0.04 时恢复至 8.462 Å。x=0.03 的组分具有最小的晶粒尺寸（19.7 nm）和最大的微应变（0.0058），这与升高的缺陷密度和阳离子重新分布相一致。FTIR 显示出特征性的尖晶石谱带（ν1=547–550 cm−1，ν2=451–460 cm−1）以及 Kt>Ko（2.19–2.22×10⁵ 对 1.49–1.55×10⁵ dyne/cm），同时还显示出吸附水/CO2 和痕量 PVA 残留物的次要信号。EIS Nyquist 谱显示出一个由晶界主导的单一压低半圆；拟合得到的 Rgb 在 x=0.03 时达到 11119.0 Ω 的峰值，并呈现非德拜行为（θ=36.75°–44.73°，n 最高为 0.592），表明晶界散射最大且 Fe2+/Fe3+ 跳跃受到抑制。尽管初级粒径处于纳米尺度，DLS 显示其在水中的团聚十分严重（Z 平均粒径为 3006–4539.9 nm；PDI 为 0.907–1.270），并在 x=0.03 时达到最大值（4539.9 nm；扩散系数最低为 1.084×10−9 cm2/s），这与 FE-SEM 所观察到的多孔球状团聚体相一致；这些团聚体由 PVA 燃烧和气体逸出形成。电化学方面，在 10 mV s−1 下的 CV 表明，随着 Ni 掺杂，响应从阳极峰（x=0.00 时为 123.3 mV、1.548 µA）转变为阴极主导的氧化还原过程（−146.9 至 −338.6 mV）；比电容在 x=0.01 时下降，随后在 x=0.02 和 0.03 时升至 6.47 和 6.24 mF g−1，最终在 x=0.04 时降至 3.14 mF g−1，这归因于富缺陷中孔结构和扩大的电化学活性界面。VSM 表明材料具有软亚铁磁性/近超顺磁性行为（Mr/Ms=0.0033–0.0529），并且在临界组分 x=0.03 出现硬化：Ms 急剧降至 23.087×10−3 emu g−1，而 Hc 升至 150.0 Oe、K 升至 1.732 erg g−1，这表明存在死层自旋倾斜以及缺陷/晶界钉扎。总体而言，x=0.03 附近的窄组分阈值可使缺陷密度和晶界网络最大化，同时提高矫顽力并优化法拉第电荷存储，确立了低浓度 Ni 掺杂作为协同调控锌铁氧体纳米材料磁功能和电化学储能性能的有效策略。

articles.title: From Research Hubs to Innovation Partners: The Hi-Acts Platform Model for Co-Creation and Societal Impact
articles.title_zh: 从研究枢纽到创新伙伴：面向协同创造与社会影响的 Hi-Acts 平台模型
articles.abstract: Fundamental research accelerators generate technologies, expertise and experimental capabilities with significant potential for innovation and societal impact. However, particle accelerators remain difficult for many external partners to access because their capabilities are distributed across specialised facilities and are often communicated in technical rather than application-oriented terms. This paper presents the Helmholtz Innovation Platform for Accelerator-Based Technologies and Solutions (Hi-Acts), which reframes accelerator facilities from providers of one-way technology transfer to capability hubs supporting industrial co-creation. Hi-Acts coordinates capabilities across five German accelerator centres while preserving their autonomy. The platform aligns complementary expertise, connects industrial challenges with accelerator capabilities through a single access point and application-oriented use cases, and enables collaboration through targeted early-stage support. Two example cases, a coordinated radiation testing service for the space sector and an integrated operando battery testing workflow, illustrate how this approach broadens industrial access, creates new collaborative services, and accelerates the translation of research capabilities into societal benefit. The Hi-Acts model provides a practical, transferable platform principle that can be adapted by other accelerator facilities to strengthen innovation and societal impact by coordinating existing capabilities around real-world challenges while preserving their primary research mission.
articles.abstract_zh: 基础研究加速器拥有可转化为创新和社会影响的技术、专长与实验能力，但外部合作方通常难以有效获取这些分散且高度专业化的资源。本文介绍 Hi-Acts 平台，该平台协调德国五个加速器中心的能力，通过单一入口、应用导向案例和早期支持，推动产业挑战与加速器能力对接。辐射测试和原位电池测试案例表明，该模式可扩大产业可及性、形成新的协作服务，并在不损害基础研究使命的前提下促进成果转化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基础研究加速器能够产生技术、专业知识和实验能力，并具有显著的创新与社会影响潜力。然而，粒子加速器对于许多外部合作伙伴而言仍然难以获取，因为其能力分布在专业化设施之中，并且通常以技术语言而非应用导向的语言进行传达。本文介绍了亥姆霍兹加速器技术与解决方案创新平台（Hi-Acts），该平台将加速器设施从单向技术转移的提供者重新定位为支持产业协同创造的能力枢纽。Hi-Acts 在保留五个德国加速器中心自主权的同时，对其能力进行协调。该平台整合互补专长，通过单一接入点和应用导向的用例，将产业挑战与加速器能力相连接，并通过有针对性的早期阶段支持促成合作。两个示例案例，即面向航天领域的协调化辐射测试服务和一体化原位电池测试工作流程，说明了该方法如何扩大产业获取渠道、创建新的协作服务，并加速将研究能力转化为社会效益。Hi-Acts 模型提供了一项实用且可迁移的平台原则，其他加速器设施可据此调整其做法，在围绕现实世界挑战协调现有能力的同时保留其主要研究使命，从而强化创新和社会影响。

articles.title: A Three-Head Hamiltonian-consistent neural network for nonadiabatic time-dependent density functional theory dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于非绝热含时密度泛函理论动力学的三头哈密顿一致性神经网络
articles.abstract: The exact exchange-correlation potential in time-dependent density functional theory is a causal functional of the full density history, a dependence that widely used adiabatic approximations discard. We ask whether this history dependence can be approximated by a learnable finite-dimensional memory state while retaining a Hamiltonian-consistent description of the Kohn–Sham phase-space dynamics. To this end, we propose a Three-Head neural architecture consisting of a Hamiltonian dynamics head that induces a symplectic vector field from a parameterized scalar energy, a direct vector field head that supplies a flexible correction pathway, and a memory XC potential head that reconstructs from density history through a recurrent memory module with cross-window carry. We evaluate the model on two physically distinct benchmarks. On the one-dimensional two-electron electron–hydrogen scattering model, it attains the lowest density reconstruction error among all baselines over the full propagation window, by the largest margin during the pre-collision approach phase, and is the only model that recovers the peak-and-step structure of in the subsequent strongly nonadiabatic scattering window. On a one-dimensional helium Rabi oscillation model under strong-field driving, it reduces the correlation-potential reconstruction error by roughly an order of magnitude relative to all adiabatic baselines at every driven phase of both the Rabi and optical cycles, including the adiabatically exact ground-state limit, which shows that the residual error along the adiabatic axis is controlled by the missing density history rather than by the accuracy of the time-local map. Ablation studies show that structured dynamics and memory-based potential learning are mutually supportive rather than separable.
articles.abstract_zh: 含时密度泛函理论中的精确交换-相关势依赖于完整的密度历史，而常用绝热近似忽略了这种记忆效应。作者提出由哈密顿动力学头、直接矢量场头和记忆交换-相关势头组成的三头神经网络，在电子-氢散射与强场驱动氦原子拉比振荡两个基准中均优于绝热基线模型。消融研究表明，结构化动力学描述与基于记忆的势学习相互促进，二者不可简单割裂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 含时密度泛函理论中的精确交换-相关势是完整密度历史的因果泛函，而被广泛采用的绝热近似忽略了这种依赖性。我们提出问题：在保留 Kohn-Sham 相空间动力学的哈密顿一致性描述的同时，这种历史依赖性能否由可学习的有限维记忆状态来近似。为此，我们提出了一种三头神经架构：哈密顿动力学头由参数化标量能量诱导辛矢量场；直接矢量场头提供灵活的校正通路；记忆交换-相关势头则通过带有跨窗口传递的循环记忆模块，从密度历史中重建势。我们在两个物理上不同的基准问题上评估该模型。对于一维双电子电子-氢散射模型，在整个传播时间窗内，该模型在所有基线中取得最低的密度重建误差；在碰撞前的接近阶段，其优势最为显著；并且它是唯一能够在随后强烈非绝热的散射时间窗中恢复峰值-阶跃结构的模型。对于强场驱动下的一维氦原子拉比振荡模型，在拉比周期和光学周期的各个受驱动相位中，包括绝热上精确的基态极限，该模型相对于所有绝热基线都将关联势重建误差降低了约一个数量级；这表明，沿绝热轴的残余误差受缺失的密度历史控制，而非受时间局域映射精度控制。消融研究表明，结构化动力学与基于记忆的势学习是相互支持的，而非彼此可分离的。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出三头神经网络，用可学习的记忆状态近似含时密度泛函理论中交换-关联势的历史依赖，并同时保持Kohn-Sham相空间动力学的哈密顿量一致性。模型在一维电子-氢散射等强非绝热基准中显著降低了密度重构误差，并能恢复绝热近似难以描述的非绝热结构。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的非绝热分子动力学、机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量、电子结构机器学习和激发态载流子动力学方向高度相关。其将物理约束哈密顿量学习与长时记忆建模结合的思路，可借鉴到材料中的非绝热电子-声子动力学。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其哈密顿量一致性约束、记忆模块和长时间传播稳定性的实现细节。可进一步测试该框架在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体或缺陷辅助载流子复合中的可迁移性。

articles.title: Emergent hydrodynamic response and dynamical backreaction: Magnon bound-state propagation in a Bose-Hubbard fluid
articles.title_zh: 涌现流体动力学响应与动力学反作用：玻色-哈伯德流体中的磁振子束缚态传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28719v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the nonequilibrium response of a one-dimensional Bose-Hubbard medium to a two-magnon bound state propagating along an attractive XXZ chain. A Holstein-type displacement coupling makes the magnon density act both as a local chemical-potential perturbation and as a source of bosons. We derive a long-wavelength hydrodynamic description of the density and phase fluctuations and test it against matrix-product-state simulations of the full coupled dynamics. The theory predicts a comoving near-field deformation together with retarded density waves confined to a sound cone. In the Mott regime, the deformation remains localized around the moving pair. In the compressible regime, two counterpropagating fronts detach and approach the semiclassical sound velocity, recovered from the equilibrium density with no fitted parameters. The coupling also induces a dynamical backreaction that slows the bound state and broadens its magnon-density profile. The comparison delimits where hydrodynamics stays quantitative once the probe reacts back on the medium.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了沿吸引性 XXZ 链传播的双磁振子束缚态对一维玻色-哈伯德介质产生的非平衡响应，并建立长波长流体动力学描述与矩阵乘积态模拟进行比较。在莫特绝缘区，形变局域在运动磁振子对附近；在可压缩区，两个反向传播的前沿脱离并趋近于由平衡密度无拟合参数确定的半经典声速。耦合还会通过动力学反作用减慢束缚态并拓宽其磁振子密度分布，从而界定探针反过来影响介质时流体动力学保持定量有效的范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一维玻色-哈伯德介质对沿吸引性 XXZ 链传播的双磁振子束缚态的非平衡响应。Holstein 型位移耦合使磁振子密度既充当局域化学势微扰，也充当玻色子的源。我们推导了密度和相位涨落的长波长流体动力学描述，并将其与完整耦合动力学的矩阵乘积态模拟进行检验比较。该理论预测存在随束缚态共同运动的近场形变，以及被限制在声锥内的迟滞密度波。在莫特区，该形变保持局域于运动磁振子对周围。在可压缩区，两个反向传播的前沿会脱离出来，并趋近于半经典声速；该声速由平衡密度恢复得到，不含任何拟合参数。该耦合还会诱导一种动力学反作用，使束缚态减速并拓宽其磁振子密度分布。这一比较界定了当探针对介质产生反作用时，流体动力学在哪些范围内仍能保持定量准确。

articles.title: Fractal Confinement and Magnetic Self-sabotage of Current Flow: Electrons Near the Metal-insulator Crossover in a 2D δ-layer
articles.title_zh: 分形限域与电流的磁性自我阻断：二维 δ 掺杂层中接近金属-绝缘体交叉的电子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study low-T transport and itinerant magnetism in 2D δ-doped semiconductors. Large-scale Hartree-Fock calculations with random hoppings and repulsion U₀ reveal two transport regimes near a critical density. The conductivity σ(T) initially increases as T drops below U₀ / 10. However, at T sim U₀/100, a tiny density of magnetic moments forms, driving an insulating downturn. Fractal wavefunctions locally amplify magnetic interactions, initially concentrating currents into branched filaments, but ultimately choking them off via dynamic SU(2) symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究二维 δ 掺杂半导体在低温下的输运与巡游磁性，并通过含随机跃迁和排斥相互作用的大尺度 Hartree-Fock 计算发现临界密度附近存在两种输运阶段。电导率在温度降至 U₀/10 以下时先升高，但在约 U₀/100 时，极少量磁矩的形成会引发绝缘性下降。分形波函数先将电流集中到分叉丝状通道中，同时放大局域磁相互作用；最终，动态 SU(2) 对称性破缺会阻断这些通道。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了二维 δ 掺杂半导体中的低温输运和巡游磁性。具有随机跃迁和排斥相互作用 U₀ 的大尺度 Hartree-Fock 计算揭示了临界密度附近的两种输运状态。随着温度降至 U₀/10 以下，电导率 σ(T) 起初升高。然而，在温度约为 U₀/100 时，极低密度的磁矩形成，并驱动体系出现向绝缘态转变的下降趋势。分形波函数会在局域上增强磁相互作用，最初使电流集中于分叉的丝状通道中，但最终会通过动态 SU(2) 对称性破缺将这些电流通道阻断。

articles.title: Floquet engineering of competing antiferromagnetism and d-wave superconductivity on the square lattice
articles.title_zh: 方格晶格上反铁磁性与 d 波超导性的 Floquet 工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28750v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a driven Lieb--Hubbard quantum simulator whose prethermal dynamics realize a square-lattice spin-1/2 fermion model with independently tunable repulsive on-site and attractive bond interactions. Periodically modulating the charge-transfer offset between the site (d) and bond (p) orbitals of the Lieb lattice brings a p-orbital doublon energetically close to a pair in the d manifold while keeping all p-orbital singlons off resonance, thereby creating a synthetic ``negative-U'' center on a Lieb-lattice bond site. Two controlled eliminations then generate a compact bond attraction in the reduced d-only model on the square lattice, despite the microscopic repulsion in the p orbital. The resulting interaction J is tunable independently of the Hubbard repulsion U_d on the d orbitals, while interference between photon-assisted paths provides access to an intermediate-coupling regime in which J and U_d are both comparable to the effective hopping. At half filling, a mean-field calculation in this regime finds adjacent antiferromagnetic and d-wave superconducting phases, as well as narrow coexistence regions, suggesting close competition between these orders. We discuss the branch-preparation, prethermal, and higher-band conditions required to translate the formal construction into an optical-lattice protocol. More broadly, our work identifies a structural similarity between Floquet systems and electron-phonon problems that may guide the design of novel quantum-simulation protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种受驱动的 Lieb-Hubbard 量子模拟器，可在预热动力学中实现具有独立可调排斥现场相互作用和吸引键相互作用的方格晶格自旋-1/2费子模型。通过周期性调制 Lieb 晶格中位点 d 轨道与键 p 轨道之间的电荷转移偏移，可在 d 轨道上产生有效的“负 U”键中心，并独立调节键吸引 J 与 Hubbard 排斥 U_d。在半填充条件下，平均场计算显示相邻的反铁磁相和 d 波超导相及狭窄的共存区域，表明两种序之间存在强烈竞争。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种受驱动的 Lieb-Hubbard 量子模拟器，其预热动力学可以实现方格晶格上的自旋-1/2费子模型，其中排斥性的现场相互作用与吸引性的键相互作用能够独立调节。周期性调制 Lieb 晶格中位点（d）轨道与键（p）轨道之间的电荷转移偏移，使一个 p 轨道双占据态在能量上接近 d 轨道组态中的一对粒子，同时使所有 p 轨道单占据态保持远离共振，从而在 Lieb 晶格的键位点上产生合成的“负 U”中心。随后进行两次受控消元，即使 p 轨道在微观层面具有排斥相互作用，也能在约化后的仅含 d 轨道的方格晶格模型中产生紧致的键吸引。由此得到的相互作用 J 可以独立于 d 轨道上的 Hubbard 排斥 U_d 进行调节，而光子辅助跃迁路径之间的干涉则使系统能够进入中等耦合区域，在该区域中 J、U_d 与有效跃迁均具有可比大小。在半填充条件下，该区域内的平均场计算发现了相邻的反铁磁相和 d 波超导相，以及狭窄的共存区域，这表明这两种序之间存在紧密竞争。我们讨论了将这一形式构造转化为光学晶格实验方案所需满足的分支制备、预热以及高能带条件。更广泛地说，我们的工作揭示了 Floquet 系统与电子-声子问题之间的结构相似性，这可能有助于指导新型量子模拟方案的设计。

articles.title: Domain walls with alternating magnetic order in a model with dipolar coupling
articles.title_zh: 具有交替磁序的偶极耦合模型中的畴壁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A model for a one-dimensional chain of elongated nano-scale magnetic islands with dipole interactions is analyzed here for the properties of its static domain walls with site-by-site alternating order. The anisotropic magnetic islands on a nonmagnetic substrate have their longer axes oriented transverse (y-direction) to the chain direction (x-direction), in a transverse applied magnetic field. The islands' magnetic dipoles vecμₙ are represented as macrospins of fixed length μ. The nearest-neighbor (NN) dipole interactions drive transverse alternating order, allowing for doubly-degenerate, uniform, static, y-alternating states, where the dipoles alternately point transverse to the chain direction, as in vecμₙ = ±(-1)ⁿ μ haty. Assuming only NN interactions, the domain walls connecting these two alternating states are found with numerical relaxation simulations and analyzed in a two-sublattice continuum theory. As the uniaxial anisotropy constant K₁ descends from larger values until it closely approaches the NN dipolar coupling constant D, the domain wall width grows indefinitely, and the large-x continuum solutions closely approach the lattice numerical solutions. The applied field produces a very slight canting of the dipoles towards the field, maximum in the center of the domain wall. The dipoles on the two sublattices are found to rotate in em opposite senses as one scans along the lattice, resulting in a large longitudinal magnetic moment of the domain wall. A much smaller transverse magnetic moment has a topological contribution that depends on whether the chain length is odd or even.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有偶极相互作用的一维细长纳米级磁岛链中，具有逐格交替磁序的静态畴壁。最近邻偶极相互作用产生横向交替序，并形成两个简并的均匀静态交替态。数值弛豫模拟和双亚晶格连续理论表明，当单轴各向异性常数接近最近邻偶极耦合常数时，畴壁宽度无限增大；外场还会导致畴壁中心附近的轻微倾斜，并产生较大的纵向磁矩。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文分析了由偶极相互作用构成的一维细长纳米尺度磁岛链中，具有逐格交替磁序的静态畴壁性质。这些各向异性磁岛位于非磁性衬底上，其长轴沿横向（y 方向）排列，而链方向为 x 方向；系统还处于横向外加磁场中。磁岛的磁偶极矩 vecμₙ 用长度固定为 μ 的宏自旋表示。最近邻（NN）偶极相互作用驱动横向交替序，从而允许存在两个简并的、均匀的静态 y 向交替态，其中偶极矩交替指向垂直于链方向的方向，例如 vecμₙ = ±(-1)ⁿ μ haty。在只考虑最近邻相互作用的假设下，我们通过数值弛豫模拟找到连接这两个交替态的畴壁，并在双亚晶格连续理论中对其进行分析。当单轴各向异性常数 K₁ 从较大值下降并接近最近邻偶极耦合常数 D 时，畴壁宽度无限增大，并且大 x 区域的连续解逐渐接近晶格数值解。外加磁场会使偶极矩略微向磁场方向倾斜，而这种倾斜在畴壁中心处最大。研究发现，沿晶格扫描时，两个亚晶格上的偶极矩沿相反方向旋转，从而使畴壁产生较大的纵向磁矩。一个小得多的横向磁矩具有拓扑贡献，其大小取决于链长是奇数还是偶数。

articles.title: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy of graphene nanogaps
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯纳米间隙的电化学阻抗谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphene nanogaps represent an emerging platform for nanoscale electrochemical and sensing devices, with potential applications in next-generation biomolecular sequencing. However, their interfacial behavior in aqueous environments remains poorly characterized, particularly with respect to frequency-dependent impedance and charge transport mechanisms at the graphene edge. We fabricate graphene nanogaps by controlled electrical breakdown in an inert atmosphere and study their electrochemical response. Upon exposure to ambient conditions, a surface contamination layer supports electrochemical activity within an adsorbed ultrathin conductive film between the graphene edges. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy reveals distinct frequency-dependent responses consistent with a Warburg element associated with diffusion in this confined interfacial film. The impedance evolves systematically with liquid pH, reflecting changes in electrochemical reaction-diffusion processes at the graphene edges. A quantitative equivalent-circuit model captures these effects and enables extraction of an effective nanogap length scale from impedance spectra, providing information complementary to that obtained from tunneling measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文制备了石墨烯纳米间隙，并研究其在水环境中的电化学响应。结果表明，环境暴露形成的表面污染层在石墨烯边缘之间的吸附超薄导电膜中支持电化学活性；阻抗谱显示出与受限界面膜中扩散相关的 Warburg 元件。阻抗随液体 pH 系统变化，定量等效电路模型则可提取有效纳米间隙长度尺度，为隧穿测量提供补充信息。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 石墨烯纳米间隙代表了纳米尺度电化学和传感器件的新兴平台，并可能应用于下一代生物分子测序。然而，人们对于其在水环境中的界面行为仍缺乏充分认识，尤其是对频率依赖的阻抗以及石墨烯边缘处电荷传输机制的了解。我们在惰性气氛中通过受控电击穿制备石墨烯纳米间隙，并研究其电化学响应。在暴露于环境条件后，表面污染层使石墨烯边缘之间吸附的超薄导电膜具有电化学活性。电化学阻抗谱显示出明显的频率依赖响应，这与受限界面膜中扩散所对应的 Warburg 元件相一致。阻抗随液体 pH 系统性变化，反映出石墨烯边缘处电化学反应-扩散过程的改变。定量等效电路模型能够描述这些效应，并可从阻抗谱中提取有效的纳米间隙长度尺度，从而提供隧穿测量之外的补充信息。

articles.title: Direct Evidence of Unconventional Superconductivity in Doped Kagome system RV₃Sb₅
articles.title_zh: 掺杂 Kagome 体系 RV₃Sb₅ 中非常规超导性的直接证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting pairing symmetry of kagome metals remains a central unresolved question largely because phase-sensitive experiments capable of distinguishing between different possible order parameters have been difficult to implement. The spatial and energetic characteristics of impurity bound states measured by spectroscopic-imaging scanning tunneling microscopy encode information on the superconducting order parameter. Here, we use impurity-bound state spectroscopy to investigate optimally doped RbV₃Sb₅ where the charge-density wave instability is fully suppressed. We find that the superconducting state is fully gapped and exhibits two distinct energy scales, consistent with a multiband order parameter. Atomic-scale spectroscopy around nonmagnetic defects reveals pronounced particle-hole asymmetric bound states. Comparison with theoretical calculations demonstrates that these bound states are incompatible with conventional s-wave and sign-changing s± pairing. Our calculations also show that the data are fully consistent with a chiral order parameter. Our results establish impurity-bound-state spectroscopy as a powerful phase-sensitive probe of superconductivity in kagome materials and provide strong evidence that optimally doped RbV₃Sb₅ realizes a fully gapped chiral superconducting state.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用杂质束缚态谱研究电荷密度波不稳定性已完全抑制的最佳掺杂 RbV₃Sb₅。该超导态具有完全能隙和两个不同能标，符合多带序参量特征；非磁性缺陷周围还出现显著的粒子-空穴不对称束缚态。理论比较表明，这些束缚态不兼容常规 s 波和变号 s± 配对，但与手性序参量完全一致，为 RbV₃Sb₅ 实现完全能隙手性超导态提供了有力证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kagome 金属的超导配对对称性仍是一个核心未决问题，主要原因在于能够区分不同可能序参量的相敏感实验一直难以实现。通过谱成像扫描隧道显微镜测量的杂质束缚态的空间和能量特征，可以编码有关超导序参量的信息。在这里，我们利用杂质束缚态谱研究最佳掺杂的 RbV₃Sb₅，其中电荷密度波不稳定性已被完全抑制。我们发现，该超导态具有完全能隙，并表现出两个不同的能量尺度，这与多带序参量相一致。在非磁性缺陷周围进行的原子尺度谱测量揭示了显著的粒子-空穴不对称束缚态。与理论计算的比较表明，这些束缚态与常规 s 波配对和变号 s± 配对均不相容。我们的计算还显示，实验数据与手性序参量完全一致。我们的结果确立了杂质束缚态谱作为 Kagome 材料中超导性的有力相敏感探针，并为最佳掺杂 RbV₃Sb₅ 实现完全能隙手性超导态提供了强有力的证据。

articles.title: Superconductivity and Magnetism in Bi-Ni System: From Bulk to Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: Bi-Ni 体系中的超导性与磁性：从块体到异质结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity with ingredients of magnetism such as time reversal breaking, triplet pairing and proximity effects has been a long time pursued topic in physics and material science as a new source of innovative phenomena and effects to drive further scientific advances and technologies. The Bi-Ni system has emerged as a convenient candidate for the investigation of such phenomenology. Strictly speaking, the term Bi-Ni system refers to two different schemes, first to the NiBi₃ intermetallic compound, a 4 K superconductor in which a complex magnetism seems to govern electrical properties in the normal phase, but without implication in the superconducting properties. The second Bi-Ni system is not quite a material but a heterostructure formed by a bilayer of Bi and Ni. Here the superconducting phase has to steal the spotlight by showing strong evidence of time-reversal breaking and triplet pairing featuring a complex unconventional state. The ease of preparing the samples, compared to other candidates for such unconventionality, usually Uranium-based compounds, has accelerated the research in this system. Here, we went through a detailed review of the main results about the electronic properties of these two systems as well as a discussion of the main open questions to be solved in order to reach the complete understanding in this topic.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述 Bi-Ni 体系中的电子性质与超导磁性。该体系包括约 4 K 超导的金属间化合物 NiBi₃，以及由 Bi/Ni 双层形成的异质结构；前者正常态电性质似乎受复杂磁性控制，但磁性未影响超导性质，后者则显示出时间反演对称性破缺和三重态配对的强有力证据。作者还讨论了理解这一体系仍需解决的主要开放问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 含有磁性因素的非常规超导性，例如时间反演对称性破缺、三重态配对和邻近效应，长期以来一直是物理学和材料科学追求的研究主题，因为它可能产生推动科学进步与技术发展的新型现象和效应。Bi-Ni 体系已经成为研究这类现象的便利候选体系。严格来说，Bi-Ni 体系这一术语指代两种不同的体系：第一种是金属间化合物 NiBi₃，它是一种临界温度为 4 K 的超导体，其正常相中的电学性质似乎由复杂磁性主导，但这种磁性并未影响超导性质。第二种 Bi-Ni 体系并非严格意义上的材料，而是由 Bi 和 Ni 双层形成的异质结构。在该体系中，超导相成为研究重点，因为它显示出时间反演对称性破缺和三重态配对的强有力证据，并呈现复杂的非常规状态。与其他非常规超导候选材料，尤其是通常以铀为基础的化合物相比，该体系样品制备较为容易，这加速了对这一体系的研究。在本文中，我们详细回顾了这两个体系电子性质方面的主要结果，并讨论了为彻底理解这一主题仍需解决的主要开放问题。
articles.focus_summary: 论文综述或讨论了Bi-Ni体系从块体NiBi3到Bi/Ni异质结构中的超导与磁性现象，重点涉及时间反演对称性破缺、三重态配对及近邻效应。其核心结论是Bi/Ni双层结构可作为研究非常规超导和磁性耦合的相对易制备平台。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的超导、磁性材料及量子功能材料方向相关，但摘要显示其重点偏向实验体系与现象梳理。可关注其中磁性界面对超导配对、时间反演对称性破缺和自旋轨道耦合的影响。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步阅读其关于Bi/Ni界面微观机制的理论部分，并评估能否用第一性原理、Wannier模型和BdG或有效哈密顿量研究界面交换与自旋轨道耦合。

articles.title: Phase stability, charge ordering, and charge-liquid formation in the Falicov-Kimball model on triangular and kagome lattices
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格和 Kagome 晶格上 Falicov-Kimball 模型中的相稳定性、电荷有序与电荷液体形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28898v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic investigation of the stability of the phase diagram of the spinless Falicov-Kimball model on two-dimensional non-bipartite lattices, the triangular and kagome lattices, using Markov-chain Monte Carlo simulations. Three filling or chemical potential conditions are examined: fixed chemical potentials (μ_f = μ_c = U/2), "generalized" half-filling (barn_f = 1/3, barn_c = 2/3), and conventional half-filling (barn_f = barn_c = 1/2). For each condition, the effects of a perturbatively small next-nearest-neighbor hopping are studied. On the triangular lattice, Anderson insulator, Mott insulator, and charge-density wave (CDW) phases are found in all cases, with the CDW driven by Coulomb-interaction-mediated nesting. Evidence for a charge-liquid regime is found in the region between the weakly correlated regime and the CDW, characterized by competing charge-ordering wavevectors and the absence of universal scaling behavior, whose extent shrinks progressively from the grand-canonical to the conventional half-filling condition. On the kagome lattice, the CDW phase is completely absent; instead, an insulating ground state, plausibly of the Mott type, is found, with signatures of a possible quantum phase transition at zero temperature. Our results establish the crucial role of lattice geometry and particle-hole symmetry breaking in shaping the phase diagram of correlated electron systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛模拟，系统研究二维非二分晶格上无自旋 Falicov-Kimball 模型相图的稳定性，并考察三角晶格和 Kagome 晶格。三角晶格上出现 Anderson 绝缘体、Mott 绝缘体和电荷密度波相，弱关联区与电荷密度波之间还存在由竞争性电荷有序波矢和缺乏普适标度行为表征的电荷液体区域。Kagome 晶格上电荷密度波相完全缺失，取而代之的是可能属于 Mott 类型的绝缘基态，结果凸显了晶格几何和粒子-空穴对称性破缺对关联电子相图的关键作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛模拟，系统研究二维非二分晶格，即三角晶格和 Kagome 晶格上无自旋 Falicov-Kimball 模型相图的稳定性。我们考察了三种填充或化学势条件：固定化学势（μ_f = μ_c = U/2）、“广义”半填充（平均 n_f = 1/3，平均 n_c = 2/3）以及通常的半填充（平均 n_f = 平均 n_c = 1/2）。对于每一种条件，我们研究了微扰性很小的次近邻跃迁所产生的影响。在三角晶格上，所有情况下都发现了 Anderson 绝缘体、Mott 绝缘体和电荷密度波（CDW）相，其中 CDW 由库仑相互作用介导的嵌套驱动。在弱关联区域与 CDW 之间的区域发现了电荷液体状态的证据，其特征是相互竞争的电荷有序波矢以及不存在普适标度行为；从巨正则条件到通常的半填充条件，该区域的范围逐渐缩小。在 Kagome 晶格上，CDW 相完全不存在；相反，发现了一种绝缘基态，其性质很可能属于 Mott 类型，并且呈现出可能在零温下发生量子相变的特征。我们的结果确立了晶格几何和粒子-空穴对称性破缺在塑造关联电子体系相图中的关键作用。

articles.title: Energy landscape and dissipation of sliding magnetic rotor arrays
articles.title_zh: 滑动磁转子阵列的能量景观与耗散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetically coupled damped rotational degrees of freedom can give rise to tribological loss when excited by a relative sliding motion, linking friction to the dynamics of magnetic moments. We analytically investigate such magnetic friction by studying a recently introduced simplified model for a rigid magnetic rotor array sliding over a commensurate magnetic substrate. Here, the array rotors can rotate about an axis perpendicular to the sliding direction and are damped by microscopic shaft friction, while the substrate magnets have a fixed in-plane orientation. The simplified model reduces the collective rotor dynamics of this setup to a set of coupled nonlinear differential equations, which can be studied by the corresponding energy landscape in the quasi-static regime. We find that the parameter plane spanned by layer separation and time can be divided into distinct chambers, in which the structure of the energy landscape remains invariant. Using these chambers, we identify the layer separation intervals corresponding to different dynamical states and recover the emergence of a regime where the moment alignment alternates globally while exhibiting peak dissipation. Additionally, we derive the leading nontrivial orders of the collective magnetic friction in the regimes of small and large gaps between the array and the substrate. For the alternating regime, we find that friction can be computed by tracking energy jumps from unstable to stable critical points at the chamber boundaries. These results provide an analytical foundation for the observed dynamics and dissipation in sliding rotor arrays. Because the simplified model is scale-free, our conclusions transfer across a broad range of microscopic and macroscopic length scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文解析研究了刚性磁转子阵列在具有公度性的磁性衬底上相对滑动时产生的磁摩擦。模型将转子阵列的集体动力学化为一组受轴摩擦阻尼的耦合非线性微分方程，并在准静态条件下通过能量景观分析其动力学。研究确定了由层间距和时间划分的不同能量景观区域，推导了小间隙和大间隙下磁摩擦的主导非平凡阶，并说明了交替状态下如何通过临界点间的能量跃迁计算摩擦。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受相对滑动运动激发的磁耦合阻尼转动自由度能够产生摩擦学损耗，从而将摩擦与磁矩动力学联系起来。我们通过研究一个近期提出的刚性磁转子阵列在具有公度性的磁性衬底上滑动的简化模型，解析考察了这种磁摩擦。在该模型中，阵列转子可以绕垂直于滑动方向的轴旋转，并受到微观轴摩擦的阻尼，而衬底磁体则具有固定的面内取向。这个简化模型将该体系的集体转子动力学化为一组相互耦合的非线性微分方程，并可在准静态条件下通过相应的能量景观进行研究。我们发现，由层间距和时间张成的参数平面可以划分为不同区域，在每个区域内，能量景观的结构保持不变。利用这些区域，我们确定了对应于不同动力学状态的层间距区间，并重新得到一种状态的出现：磁矩的整体排列发生交替，同时耗散达到峰值。此外，我们推导了阵列与衬底之间间隙较小和较大时集体磁摩擦的主导非平凡阶。对于交替状态，我们发现可以在区域边界处追踪从不稳定临界点到稳定临界点的能量跃迁，从而计算摩擦。由于该简化模型具有尺度无关性，我们的结论能够推广到广泛的微观和宏观长度尺度。

articles.title: Chiral Tubular Magnonic Crystals with Periodic Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya Interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有周期性 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的手性管状磁子晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a chiral tubular magnonic crystal formed by a ferromagnetic nanotube with a periodically modulated interfacial Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI). Using a plane-wave formalism adapted to the cylindrical geometry, we calculate the spin-wave band structure including exchange, nonlocal dipolar coupling, and interfacial DMI. We show that the tubular geometry qualitatively modifies the role of periodic DMI compared with planar chiral magnonic crystals. Besides producing the usual nonreciprocal frequency shift, curvature converts part of the interfacial DMI into an effective anisotropy-like internal field. This creates a sign-dependent frequency landscape along the tube, so that DMI-covered regions can act either as potential wells or barriers for the lowest-frequency modes. As a result, flat and weakly dispersive bands appear in both Damon--Eshbach-like and backward-volume-like configurations, with the latter having no direct counterpart in planar systems. Our results identify periodically engineered DMI in nanotubes as a route for controlling nonreciprocal spin waves, localized modes, and flat magnonic bands in curved architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种由界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用周期调制的铁磁纳米管构成的手性管状磁子晶体，并利用适用于柱面几何的平面波形式计算其自旋波能带。曲率会将部分界面 DMI 转化为类似有效各向异性的内部场，使覆盖 DMI 的区域对低频模式表现为势阱或势垒。该效应在 Damon-Eshbach 类和后向体积类构型中均产生平坦且弱色散的能带，其中后向体积类能带在平面体系中没有直接对应物。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种手性管状磁子晶体，它由具有周期性调制界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用（DMI）的铁磁纳米管构成。我们使用适用于柱面几何的平面波形式，计算了包含交换作用、非局域偶极耦合和界面 DMI 在内的自旋波能带结构。我们表明，与平面手性磁子晶体相比，管状几何会定性改变周期性 DMI 的作用。除了产生通常的非互易频率偏移之外，曲率还会将部分界面 DMI 转化为类似有效各向异性内部场的贡献。这会沿纳米管形成依赖符号的频率景观，使覆盖 DMI 的区域能够对最低频率模式充当势阱或势垒。因此，在 Damon-Eshbach 类和后向体积类构型中都出现了平坦且色散较弱的能带，而后者在平面体系中没有直接对应物。我们的结果表明，在纳米管中周期性设计 DMI，为控制弯曲结构中的非互易自旋波、局域模式和平坦磁子能带提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Giant staggered Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya vectors emerged in synthetic antiferromagnets with spatially alternating stress
articles.title_zh: 具有空间交替应力的合成反铁磁体中出现的巨大交错 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 矢量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction is a source of chiral magnetic physics, and it manifests microstructural symmetry which could link to exotic magnetic and electronic properties such as altermagnetism. For a new paradigm in magnetism and spintronics, it is crucial to have control on the DM interaction as well as ordering of the DM vectors which characterize the DM interaction. Here, we report on a strong interlayer DM interaction emerged in Co/Ru magnetic superlattices whose structural symmetry is unambiguously broken by alternating mechanical strains developed using the peculiar technique of our stress mechanism. Moreover, theoretical analyses reveal that our magnetic superlattices host a staggered order of the DM vectors. Our results indicate that the spatially varying strains with our breakthrough technique are quite effective in breaking the symmetry of the system and prove that it can control the DM interaction strength as well as the DM vector order.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中的强层间 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用，该体系通过交替机械应变明确破坏结构对称性。理论分析表明，这些磁性超晶格具有交错排列的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 矢量。结果说明，空间变化的应力能够有效破坏体系对称性，并同时调控 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的强度及其矢量有序方式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用是手性磁学现象的来源之一，它体现了微观结构对称性，并可能与交替磁性等奇异磁性和电子性质相联系。对于磁学和自旋电子学的新范式而言，实现对 DM 相互作用以及刻画该相互作用的 DM 矢量排列的控制至关重要。在这里，我们报道了 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中的强层间 DM 相互作用；该超晶格通过采用我们应力机制中的特殊技术形成交替机械应变，从而明确破坏了结构对称性。此外，理论分析表明，我们的磁性超晶格具有 DM 矢量的交错有序。我们的结果表明，利用这种突破性的技术产生空间变化的应力，对于破坏体系对称性非常有效，并证明该方法能够同时控制 DM 相互作用的强度以及 DM 矢量的有序方式。
articles.focus_summary: 论文在具有空间交替应力的Co/Ru人工反铁磁超晶格中观察到强层间Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，并通过理论分析揭示DM矢量的交错有序。结果表明，应变诱导的结构对称性破缺能够同时调控DM相互作用强度和其矢量排布。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、磁性超晶格、应变工程、交替磁性和自旋电子学方向高度直接相关。该工作尤其契合通过对称性分析和自旋哈密顿量设计可控手性磁相的研究路线。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可跟进交错DM矢量对非互易自旋波、斯格明子稳定性及交替磁性输运的影响，并以第一性原理提取交换参数后结合自旋动力学模拟验证。

articles.title: Coherent phononic frequency combs in ferroelectric CMOS oxides
articles.title_zh: 铁电 CMOS 氧化物中的相干声子频率梳
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern electronic systems require tens of clock and carrier frequencies, each synthesized by a dedicated phase-locked loop from a shared reference, imposing routing, power and synchronization burdens that grow with every domain. Optical frequency combs solved this problem in photonics, whereas electronics has lacked an equivalent source in its native radiofrequency domain. Here we report broadband phononic frequency combs in ferroelectric hafnia-zirconia nanoelectromechanical resonators built from complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) oxides. Lithographically defined detuning of a 2:1 internal resonance selects the generation mechanism: two-tone-seeded wave mixing yields more than 170 lines distributed over two octaves, with mutual coherence verified for representative pump and generated lines, whereas an autonomous Hopf route yields hierarchical combs of more than 200 lines through torus and period-doubling dynamics, in agreement with slow-flow bifurcation theory. Geometric scaling extends comb generation across 0.44 GHz to 2.1 GHz. Heterodyne measurements, analyzed using the modified Allan deviation (MDEV), establish a two-timescale law. The mechanism governs short-term stability: seeded combs inherit the white-phase-noise scaling of their pumps, whereas autonomous combs acquire the phase diffusion of a free-running oscillator, with the one-second MDEV increasing from 1e-11 to 1e-8. The material governs long-term stability: in air and without active thermal control, the temperature-compensated stack suppresses the random-walk drift that dominates uncompensated resonators. These results establish mechanism- and material-level design rules for operating a single resonator as chip-scale frequency infrastructure, from multi-clock generation to radiofrequency parallel processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在由 CMOS 氧化物制成的铁电铪锆氧化物纳米机电谐振器中实现了宽带声子频率梳。通过对 2:1 内部共振进行光刻调谐，可选择不同的梳状谱产生机制：双音种子波混合产生跨越两个倍频程的 170 多条谱线，而自主 Hopf 路径通过环面和倍周期化动力学产生 200 多条分层频率梳。研究还揭示了由机制决定短期稳定性、由材料决定长期稳定性的设计规律，可将单个谐振器用于芯片级频率基础设施。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代电子系统需要数十个时钟频率和载波频率，每个频率都由共享参考源驱动的专用锁相环合成，因此随着频率域数量增加，布线、功耗和同步负担也会增加。光学频率梳已经解决了光子学中的这一问题，而电子学在其原生射频域中一直缺少等效的频率源。在这里，我们报道了由互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）氧化物制成的铁电铪锆氧化物纳米机电谐振器中的宽带声子频率梳。对 2:1 内部共振进行光刻定义的失谐可以选择频率梳的产生机制：双音种子波混合产生分布于两个倍频程以上的 170 多条谱线，并通过对具有代表性的泵浦谱线和生成谱线进行测量验证了它们之间的相互相干性；另一方面，自主 Hopf 路径通过环面动力学和倍周期化动力学产生包含 200 多条谱线的分层频率梳，这与慢流分岔理论相一致。几何尺度调节可将频率梳产生范围扩展到 0.44 GHz 至 2.1 GHz。利用异频测量并通过修正 Allan 偏差（MDEV）进行分析，我们建立了一个双时间尺度规律。产生机制决定短期稳定性：种子频率梳继承其泵浦源的白相位噪声标度，而自主频率梳则获得自由运行振荡器的相位扩散特征，其 1 秒 MDEV 从 10⁻¹¹ 增加到 10⁻⁸。材料决定长期稳定性：在空气中且不进行主动温度控制时，温度补偿结构抑制了无补偿谐振器中占主导地位的随机游走漂移。这些结果确立了机制层面和材料层面的设计规律，使单个谐振器能够作为芯片级频率基础设施，用于多时钟生成以及射频并行处理。

articles.title: Electronic state of vortices at twin boundaries in a nematic superconductor
articles.title_zh: 向列超导体孪晶边界处涡旋的电子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local electronic states of vortices in an s ± d wave nematic superconductor are studied both in the absence and presence of twin boundaries. The Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory for a tight-binding model is used with its nematicity represented by the anisotropy in the transfer integrals and attractive interactions between the nearest-neighbor sites. We evaluate s and d wave components of the pair potentials and the local density of states, and analyze the effects of nematicity on the vortex core structures with/without twin boundaries. We find that a single vortex trapped at the twin boundary is composed of a bound pair of fractional vortices accompanied by weakly-induced s ± id wave components, despite that such s ± id wave components do not appear in a zero magnetic field. The calculated spatial structures of the local electronic states are compared with the vortex image measured by STM experiments in an iron-based superconductor FeSe.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于紧束缚模型的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 理论，研究了 s±d 波向列超导体中有无孪晶边界时涡旋的局域电子态。结果表明，束缚在孪晶边界上的单个涡旋由一对分数涡旋组成，并伴随弱诱导的 s±id 波分量，尽管这些分量在零磁场下不会出现。计算得到的局域电子态空间结构还与铁基超导体 FeSe 中扫描隧道显微镜测得的涡旋图像进行了比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了 s ± d 波向列超导体中涡旋的局域电子态，考察了不存在和存在孪晶边界两种情况。我们采用紧束缚模型的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 理论，其中向列性由跃迁积分的各向异性以及最近邻格点之间的吸引相互作用表示。我们计算了 s 波和 d 波配对势的分量以及局域态密度，并分析了有无孪晶边界时向列性对涡旋核结构的影响。我们发现，束缚在孪晶边界上的单个涡旋由一对分数涡旋组成，并伴随弱诱导的 s ± id 波分量，尽管这种 s ± id 波分量在零磁场下并不会出现。我们将计算得到的局域电子态空间结构与铁基超导体 FeSe 中扫描隧道显微镜实验测量的涡旋图像进行了比较。

articles.title: Orbital occupation selects structural dimensionality in binary transition-metal oxides
articles.title_zh: 轨道占据选择二元过渡金属氧化物的结构维度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbital-lattice coupling in transition-metal oxides is usually discussed within a given bonding framework, where orbital occupation is intertwined with local coordination, strain, or symmetry breaking. Here, we show that orbital occupation can also select the bonding framework itself, thereby determining structural dimensionality. Using first-principles calculations, we identify CrO as a prototype in which the single active 3d,e_g electron of high-spin Cr²⁺ gives rise to two competing orbital-structure states. The dₓ^₂₋y^₂ occupation favors a three-dimensionally connected covalent phase, whereas the dz^₂ occupation stabilizes a weakly coupled layered phase. Constrained-occupation calculations show that increasing the dz^₂ filling continuously contracts the in-plane lattice while expanding the structure along the layer normal. The two phases exhibit distinct magnetic ground states and ferroelastic responses. Moreover, the layered phase is robust against exchange-correlation functional and on-site (U) variations, remains dynamically stable down to the monolayer limit, and has a low exfoliation energy of 46 meV/Angstrom². Extending the analysis across related 3d binary oxides reveals a filling-dependence relation between accessible orbital filling and the preference for 2D or 3D connected bonding motifs, providing a microscopic basis for exploring low-dimensional oxide materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，轨道占据不仅与局域配位、应变和对称性破缺相互耦合，还能够选择材料本身的成键框架，从而决定结构维度。以 CrO 为原型，第一性原理计算显示，高自旋 Cr²⁺ 的单个活性 3d、e_g 电子中，dₓ²₋y² 占据倾向于形成三维连通共价相，而 d_z² 占据则稳定弱耦合层状相。相关层状相对计算方法和 U 参数具有稳健性，可稳定至单层极限，并具有较低剥离能；对相关二元氧化物的分析进一步揭示了轨道填充与二维或三维成键偏好之间的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡金属氧化物中的轨道-晶格耦合通常是在给定成键框架内讨论的，在这种框架中，轨道占据与局域配位、应变或对称性破缺相互交织。在这里，我们表明，轨道占据还能够选择成键框架本身，进而决定结构维度。通过第一性原理计算，我们确定了 CrO 这一原型体系，其中高自旋 Cr²⁺ 的单个活性 3d、e_g 电子产生了两种相互竞争的轨道-结构状态。dₓ²₋y² 轨道占据有利于形成三维连通的共价相，而 d_z² 轨道占据则稳定弱耦合的层状相。受限占据计算表明，随着 d_z² 轨道填充增加，面内晶格会连续收缩，而结构沿层法线方向发生膨胀。这两个相具有不同的磁性基态和铁弹性响应。此外，层状相对交换-关联泛函和现场 U 参数的变化具有稳健性，在降至单层极限时仍保持动力学稳定，并具有 46 meV/Å² 的低剥离能。将分析扩展到相关的 3d 二元氧化物后，我们揭示了可实现的轨道填充与二维或三维连通成键构型偏好之间的填充依赖关系，从而为探索低维氧化物材料提供了微观基础。

articles.title: Can a Spin Liquid State Persist as the Ground State in the Presence of Competing Interactions and Disorder?
articles.title_zh: 在竞争相互作用与无序存在时，自旋液体态能否作为基态持续存在？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28998v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this report, we have shown that, in an otherwise geometrically frustrated lattice, the underlying interactions compete to stabilize different magnetic phases. In conjunction with fluctuations, these interactions may lead to the formation of unusual ordered phases, providing a pathway for understanding the fluctuation-driven order-by-disorder phenomenon. This competition is further modified by the presence of inherent structural disorder in a frustrated two-dimensional lattice. Furthermore, due to the local nature of the additional structural disorder, the majority of the samples evolve toward glassy dynamics, which can not only mimic spin-liquid-like behavior but also make it difficult to identify genuine spin-liquid candidates experimentally.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究几何受挫晶格中竞争相互作用、涨落与结构无序对磁性基态的共同影响。竞争相互作用可能稳定不同磁相，并在涨落作用下形成异常有序相，从而为理解涨落驱动的无序致有序现象提供途径。局域结构无序还会使多数样品演化出玻璃态动力学，这种行为不仅可能模拟自旋液体特征，也增加了实验识别真正自旋液体候选体系的难度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在一个原本具有几何受挫的晶格中，我们展示了底层相互作用彼此竞争，以稳定不同的磁性相。与涨落共同作用时，这些相互作用可能导致异常有序相的形成，为理解由涨落驱动的无序致有序现象提供了一条途径。在受挫二维晶格中，固有结构无序的存在会进一步改变这种竞争。此外，由于额外结构无序具有局域性，大多数样品会演化出玻璃态动力学；这种动力学不仅能够模拟类似自旋液体的行为，也会使实验上识别真正的自旋液体候选体系变得困难。

articles.title: Fractional Impurity Entropy from Potential Scattering in a Free Electron Gas
articles.title_zh: 自由电子气中由势散射产生的分数杂质熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional changes in entropy are often associated with strong electron correlations or non-Abelian anyons in topological systems. We show that neither condition is necessary -- a system of free electrons on a ring scattering off a repulsive point-like impurity undergoes a k_Blnsqrt 2 entropy change as the impurity strength is increased. This effect arises from a shift of allowed single-particle momenta from integer quantization to half-integer quantization, induced by the impurity. We show that this fractional entropy change is universal across a broad class of single-particle dispersions, demonstrating that such signatures can arise without strong correlations or topological order.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数熵变通常与强电子关联或拓扑系统中的非阿贝尔任意子联系在一起。本文表明，这两种条件都不是必需的：环上的自由电子与排斥性点状杂质发生散射时，随着杂质强度增加，系统会产生大小为k_B ln√2的熵变。该效应源于杂质使允许的单粒子动量从整数定量化转变为半整数定量化，并且对广泛的单粒子色散关系具有普适性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数熵变通常与强电子关联或拓扑系统中的非阿贝尔任意子联系在一起。我们表明，这两个条件都不是必要的——环上的自由电子在排斥性点状杂质上发生散射时，随着杂质强度增加，会经历大小为k_B ln√2的熵变。该效应源于杂质诱导的允许单粒子动量变化，即动量定量化方式由整数定量化变为半整数定量化。我们表明，这种分数熵变对于广泛的一类单粒子色散关系都是普适的，说明即使不存在强关联或拓扑序，也可能产生此类特征信号。

articles.title: Probing spin order via magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions
articles.title_zh: 通过量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁振子传输探测自旋序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional material platforms now host a remarkable array of exotic correlated phases, from unconventional superconductivity to fractional Chern insulators. Probing magnetic order in these systems is essential for understanding their underlying physics, yet dilute spin densities render conventional magnetic probes ineffective. Spin waves, or magnons, in quantum Hall ferromagnets (QHFM) have proven effective for probing the magnetic order in various symmetry-broken quantum Hall (QH) phases in graphene systems, but previous works have been limited to homojunction configurations within a single material. Here, we demonstrate magnon transmission across a monolayer-bilayer graphene quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunction - the first magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions, using one material as a magnon source to probe magnetic order in a distinct material. Generating magnons in monolayer graphene (MLG) at ν = 1, we detect their transmission through bilayer graphene (BLG) via nonlocal voltage measurements, revealing spin order in BLG symmetry-broken quantum Hall states. The transmission exhibits hallmark magnon signatures: a sharp onset at the Zeeman energy and systematic variation with Landau level filling, including suppression at ν = 4 and 8 where spin polarization vanishes. Our findings establish heterojunction magnon transmission as a powerful, modular probe of magnetic order, opening new avenues for investigating exotic quantum states across the rapidly expanding family of two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维材料平台如今包含从非常规超导性到分数陈绝缘体在内的多种奇异关联相，但稀疏自旋密度使传统磁性探测手段难以奏效。本文实现了单层石墨烯与双层石墨烯量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁振子传输，并利用单层石墨烯作为磁振子源探测双层石墨烯中的磁序。非局域电压测量显示，磁振子传输具有塞曼能量处的尖锐起始以及随朗道能级填充变化的系统特征，并在自旋极化消失的ν=4和8处受到抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维材料平台如今承载着一系列引人注目的奇异关联相，从非常规超导性到分数陈绝缘体。探测这些体系中的磁序对于理解其底层物理至关重要，但稀疏的自旋密度使传统磁性探测手段难以发挥作用。量子霍尔铁磁体中的自旋波，即磁振子，已被证明能够有效探测石墨烯体系中各种对称性破缺量子霍尔相的磁序，但以往研究仅限于单一材料内部的同质结构型。在这里，我们展示了单层石墨烯—双层石墨烯量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁振子传输，这是首次实现跨量子霍尔铁磁异质结的磁振子传输，并使用一种材料作为磁振子源来探测另一种不同材料中的磁序。我们在填充因子ν=1的单层石墨烯中产生磁振子，并通过非局域电压测量探测其穿过双层石墨烯的传输，从而揭示双层石墨烯对称性破缺量子霍尔态中的自旋序。该传输表现出磁振子的标志性特征：在塞曼能量处出现尖锐起始，并随朗道能级填充发生系统性变化；在自旋极化消失的ν=4和8处，传输受到抑制。我们的研究确立了异质结磁振子传输作为探测磁序的一种强大而模块化的手段，为研究不断扩展的二维材料家族中的奇异量子态开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Enhanced Diffusion from Twist-Angle Disorder
articles.title_zh: 扭转角无序导致的扩散增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29062v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the effect of twist-angle disorder on the single-particle properties of twisted bilayer systems. These materials are a natural playground for studying how tiny, uncontrolled spatial variations may become unusually consequential; a local change in the twist geometry can give rise to spatially-correlated alterations of the parent Hamiltonian, which in turn affect the coarse-grained properties of the substrate such as transport and ordering tendencies. In analogy to electrodynamics, where the magnetic field is given by the curl of the vector potential, we model the twist angle as the curl of the relative displacement between the two bilayers. We find that geometric scattering constraints imposed here by the twist structure substantially suppress momentum relaxation relative to mean-rate-matched white noise. We quantify these effects and show that the problem can be mapped onto a non-linear sigma model (NLSM).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考察扭转角无序对扭转双层体系单粒子性质的影响。局部扭转几何的微小变化会引起母体哈密顿量的空间关联改变，进而影响输运和有序倾向等粗粒化性质。作者将扭转角建模为两层相对位移的旋度，发现扭转结构施加的几何散射约束相较于平均散射率匹配的白噪声会显著抑制动量弛豫，并将该问题映射到非线性σ模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考察扭转角无序对扭转双层体系单粒子性质的影响。这些材料为研究微小且无法完全控制的空间变化如何产生异常重要的后果提供了天然平台；扭转几何的局部变化可能导致母体哈密顿量发生具有空间关联的改变，进而影响基底的粗粒化性质，例如输运和有序倾向。类比于电动力学中磁场由矢势的旋度给出，我们将扭转角建模为两层双层体系相对位移的旋度。我们发现，这里由扭转结构施加的几何散射约束，相较于平均散射率匹配的白噪声，会大幅抑制动量弛豫。我们量化了这些影响，并表明该问题可以映射为一个非线性σ模型。

articles.title: Real-space manifestation of ferroic multipoles in altermagnetic MnF₂
articles.title_zh: 交替磁性MnF₂中铁性多极矩的实空间表现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are unconventional spin split magnets arising from the zero spin-orbit coupled limit. They host a magnetic multipolar order parameter yet direct real-space observation of these multipoles has remained elusive. Here we use polarized-neutron diffraction to reconstruct the three-dimensional magnetization density of the prototypical altermagnet MnF₂. By exploiting symmetry-selective magnetic reflections, we separate the dominant spherical Mn²⁺ contribution from the much weaker anisotropic Mn magnetization and the covalent spin polarization of the fluorine ligands. The reconstructed spin density reveals a finite fluorine ion moment together with an anisotropic Mn magnetization consistent with the symmetry-allowed altermagnetic rank-5 magnetic multipole O₅₂(magnetic triacontadipole). These results provide direct real-space evidence of ferroic multipolar order in an altermagnet and establish polarized-neutron diffraction as a powerful probe of hidden magnetic multipoles in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁体是源于零自旋轨道耦合极限的非常规自旋分裂磁体，具有磁多极序参量，但其多极矩此前一直难以在实空间直接观测。本文利用偏振中子衍射重建原型交替磁体MnF₂的三维磁化密度，并分离出主导的球对称Mn²⁺贡献、较弱的各向异性Mn磁化以及氟配体的共价自旋极化。重建的自旋密度揭示了有限的氟离子磁矩和符合对称性要求的五阶磁多极矩O₅₂，为交替磁体中的铁性多极序提供了直接实空间证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体是源于零自旋轨道耦合极限的非常规自旋分裂磁体。它们具有磁多极序参量，但对这些多极矩的直接实空间观测一直难以实现。在这里，我们利用偏振中子衍射重建了原型交替磁体MnF₂的三维磁化密度。通过利用具有对称性选择性的磁反射，我们将占主导地位的球对称Mn²⁺贡献，与较弱的各向异性Mn磁化以及氟配体的共价自旋极化分离开来。重建的自旋密度揭示出有限的氟离子磁矩，以及与对称性允许的交替磁性五阶磁多极矩O₅₂，即磁三十六面体偶极矩相一致的各向异性Mn磁化。这些结果为交替磁体中的铁性多极序提供了直接的实空间证据，并确立了偏振中子衍射作为探测量子材料中隐藏磁多极矩的有力手段。

articles.title: Doping-driven evolution of pairing symmetry in pressurized La₃Ni₂O₇
articles.title_zh: 加压La₃Ni₂O₇中由掺杂驱动的配对对称性演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29091v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the superconducting pairing symmetry and its doping evolution in pressurized La₃Ni₂O₇. For the undoped compound, the most favorable pairing state is found to be s±-wave, characterized by sign reversal of the gap functions between the Fermi pockets. A detailed analysis of the pairing interactions reveals that this unconventional state originates from repulsive interactions mediated by the magnetic odd modes of the bilayer nickelate. Upon hole doping, the γ Fermi pocket expands, which amplifies the intrapocket repulsions on this pocket. These repulsions, driven by the magnetic even modes, gradually dominates the pairing interactions and ultimately drive a transition in pairing symmetry from s±-wave to dₓy-wave in the heavily hole-doped regime. In stark contrast, the s±-wave pairing persists under electron doping, even deep into the heavily electron-doped regime where a Lifshitz transition occurs. This finding suggests that the γ Fermi pocket is not essential for the emergence of superconductivity in bilayer nickelates. In fact, the s±-wave pairing becomes more robust in the absence of the γ pocket, as spin fluctuations are strongly enhanced by the favorable nesting between the α and β pockets --- a condition guaranteed by Luttinger's theorem and the Fermi surface topology. We believe that exploring the doping evolution of superconducting pairing will open a new realm for testing the pairing mechanism in pressurized La₃Ni₂O₇.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究加压La₃Ni₂O₇中的超导配对对称性及其掺杂演化。未掺杂体系最有利的配对态为s±波，其来源是双层镍酸盐磁性奇模介导的排斥相互作用。空穴掺杂扩大γ费米口袋并增强其口袋内排斥，最终在重空穴掺杂区域驱动配对对称性由s±波转变为dxy波；相比之下，电子掺杂下s±波即使在发生莱夫希茨转变后仍能保持，并且在γ口袋消失时因α与β口袋之间的有利嵌套而更加稳健。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了加压La₃Ni₂O₇中的超导配对对称性及其掺杂演化。对于未掺杂化合物，最有利的配对态被发现是s±波，其特征是不同费米口袋之间的能隙函数发生变号。对配对相互作用的详细分析表明，这种非常规态源于双层镍酸盐的磁性奇模所介导的排斥相互作用。在空穴掺杂下，γ费米口袋扩大，从而增强了该口袋内的口袋内排斥。这些由磁性偶模驱动的排斥相互作用逐渐在配对相互作用中占据主导地位，并最终在重空穴掺杂区域驱动配对对称性由s±波转变为dxy波。与此形成鲜明对比的是，在电子掺杂下，即使深入到发生莱夫希茨转变的重电子掺杂区域，s±波配对仍然存在。这一发现表明，γ费米口袋并不是双层镍酸盐产生超导性的必要条件。事实上，在γ口袋不存在时，s±波配对会变得更加稳健，因为α与β口袋之间有利的嵌套会显著增强自旋涨落，而这种条件由Luttinger定理和费米面拓扑共同保证。我们认为，探索超导配对随掺杂的演化，将为检验加压La₃Ni₂O₇中的配对机制开辟新的领域。

articles.title: A route to the thermodynamics of colloid-polymer mixtures from structural information
articles.title_zh: 从结构信息出发获得胶体—聚合物混合物热力学的一条途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Liquid-state theory provides a fundamental connection between microscopic structure and macroscopic thermodynamic behaviour. Here, we develop a framework for predicting thermodynamics and phase behaviour directly from structural correlations, using either radial distribution functions or static structure factors as input. The approach constructs a free-energy functional from structural information obtained at a single thermodynamic state point, without requiring explicit knowledge of the underlying interaction potentials. This circumvents a central difficulty in modelling complex fluids, for which effective interactions are often unknown or rely on approximations. We demonstrate the framework for a range of model fluids, including colloidal and colloid--polymer systems, with predictions in good agreement with molecular simulation data. The results show that structural information at a single state point can provide sufficient information to predict the broader thermodynamic response of a system. This establishes a route toward inferring phase behaviour directly from experimentally measured structure, even when the microscopic interactions are not known a priori.
articles.abstract_zh: 液态理论建立了微观结构与宏观热力学行为之间的基本联系。本文提出一种直接利用结构关联预测热力学性质和相行为的框架，以径向分布函数或静态结构因子作为输入，并从单一热力学状态点的结构信息构造自由能泛函。该方法无需明确知道底层相互作用势，因而适用于有效相互作用未知或依赖近似的复杂流体；在多种模型流体、胶体和胶体—聚合物体系中，其预测与分子模拟结果吻合良好。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 液态理论提供了微观结构与宏观热力学行为之间的基本联系。在这里，我们发展了一种直接从结构关联预测热力学性质和相行为的框架，其中可以使用径向分布函数或静态结构因子作为输入。该方法利用从单一热力学状态点获得的结构信息构造自由能泛函，而不需要明确知道底层相互作用势。这绕过了复杂流体建模中的一个核心困难，因为对于复杂流体，有效相互作用往往未知或依赖于近似。我们针对一系列模型流体，包括胶体体系和胶体—聚合物体系，展示了这一框架的应用，其预测结果与分子模拟数据符合良好。结果表明，单一状态点的结构信息可以提供足够的信息，用于预测体系更广泛的热力学响应。这为直接从实验测得的结构推断相行为提供了一条途径，即使微观相互作用事先并不明确。

articles.title: Evolving charge order in the CDW state of AV₃Sb₅ metals
articles.title_zh: AV₃Sb₅金属电荷密度波态中不断演化的电荷序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AV₃Sb₅ kagome metals are characterized by intertwined electronic and structural orders, which motivated extensive studies in recent years. Yet the details of the electronic state preceding the superconducting phase remain poorly understood. Here we extend our previous investigation [Phys. Rev. Research 7, L032046 (2025)] of RbV₃Sb₅ using avoided level crossing (ALC) muon-spin spectroscopy to the A = Cs and K systems. Consistent with our previous study, we identify a second transition whose origin cannot be attributed solely to an internal magnetic field, indicating the involvement of an additional electronic mechanism that subtly modifies the charge distribution within the V plane. In particular, the ALC results point towards an additional charge modulation taking place within the charge density wave (CDW) phase and occurring at T*
articles.abstract_zh: AV₃Sb₅笼目金属具有交织的电子序与结构序，但其进入超导相之前的电子态仍缺乏清晰认识。本文将此前对RbV₃Sb₅的避免能级交叉缪子自旋谱研究扩展到A=Cs和K的体系。研究发现存在第二个转变，其起源不能仅归因于内部磁场，避免能级交叉结果指向电荷密度波相内一种额外的电荷调制，该调制发生在温度T*处并细微改变钒平面内的电荷分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: AV₃Sb₅笼目金属以交织的电子序和结构序为特征，这推动了近年来的大量研究。然而，在超导相之前出现的电子态的细节仍然缺乏充分理解。在这里，我们利用避免能级交叉（ALC）缪子自旋谱，将此前对RbV₃Sb₅的研究[Phys. Rev. Research 7, L032046 (2025)]扩展到A=Cs和K的体系。与我们此前的研究一致，我们识别出第二个转变，其起源不能仅仅归因于内部磁场，这表明还涉及一种额外的电子机制，该机制会细微地改变钒平面内的电荷分布。特别是，ALC结果指向在电荷密度波（CDW）相内发生的额外电荷调制，并且该调制发生在T*处。

articles.title: Topological pair density waves in kagome superconductors
articles.title_zh: 笼目超导体中的拓扑配对密度波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pair density wave (PDW) is an unconventional superconducting state exhibiting periodic pairing modulations due to pairing with finite momentum Q. In two dimensions, multiple Q components of the PDW can have a non-trivial relative phase, breaking time-reversal symmetry and resulting in a topological electronic structure. Here we review progress on exploring such topological PDWs (TPDWs) and discuss their potential realization in kagome superconductors. We first introduce the concept of a TPDW starting from the Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state and examine the challenges toward its realization. We then discuss the possibility of a TPDW in the kagome lattice, which intertwines with chiral superconductivity and loop currents, thus connecting to models describing the quantum anomalous Hall effect. Furthermore, we review the experimental signatures of a TPDW in AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, Rb, K) superconductors and highlight related quantum effects, including switchable chiral pairing modulations, Bogoliubov Fermi states, the superconducting diode effect, and the anomalous thermal Hall effect. Finally, we project the future research opportunities of this correlated topological quantum phase and discuss its broad implications for finite-momentum pairing, topological matter, and chiral superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 配对密度波是具有非常规超导性的状态，其配对以有限动量Q发生，从而导致周期性配对调制。在二维体系中，配对密度波的多个Q分量可以具有非平凡相对相位，破缺时间反演对称性并形成拓扑电子结构。本文回顾拓扑配对密度波的研究进展及其在笼目超导体中的潜在实现，讨论其与手性超导和环流的交织，以及在AV₃Sb₅中的实验信号，包括可切换的手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应和反常热霍尔效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 配对密度波（PDW）是一种非常规超导态，其特征是由于以有限动量Q进行配对而产生周期性配对调制。在二维体系中，PDW的多个Q分量可以具有非平凡的相对相位，从而破缺时间反演对称性并形成拓扑电子结构。在这里，我们回顾对这类拓扑配对密度波（TPDW）的探索进展，并讨论其在笼目超导体中的潜在实现。我们首先从Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov（FFLO）态出发介绍TPDW的概念，并考察其实现所面临的挑战。随后，我们讨论笼目晶格中出现TPDW的可能性；这种状态与手性超导和环流交织在一起，从而与描述量子反常霍尔效应的模型相联系。此外，我们回顾AV₃Sb₅（A=Cs、Rb、K）超导体中TPDW的实验特征，并强调相关量子效应，包括可切换的手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应以及反常热霍尔效应。最后，我们展望这一关联拓扑量子相未来的研究机会，并讨论其对有限动量配对、拓扑物质和手性超导研究的广泛意义。

articles.title: Quantitative Disentanglement of Terahertz Spin and Orbital Pumping in 3d Ferromagnetic Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 3d铁磁异质结构中太赫兹自旋泵浦与轨道泵浦的定量解耦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin and orbital pumping - the injection of spin and orbital angular momentum from a driven ferromagnet into an adjacent nonmagnetic layer - are fundamental processes underlying angular-momentum generation and transport in magnetic heterostructures. Femtosecond optical excitation extends these phenomena into the ultrafast regime, where spintronic terahertz emission spectroscopy (STES) detects picosecond angular-momentum currents in a contact-free manner through spin-to-charge and orbital-to-charge conversion. Microscopic theory predicts that orbital-pumping efficiency increases from Fe to Ni across the 3d series, yet whether these predictions hold under ultrafast excitation remains unclear. A central challenge is that spin and orbital currents are generated simultaneously and contribute additively to the same terahertz emission, preventing their quantitative separation. Here, we overcome this limitation by combining STES with wedge-sample thickness control in heterostructures whose nonmagnetic layers (Ta, W, and Nb) have spin Hall and orbital Hall angles of opposite signs. The two angular-momentum channels therefore exhibit distinct emission polarities and thickness dependences, enabling their quantitative decomposition. Systematic measurements on Fe, Co, and Ni heterostructures reveal that the orbital-pumping contribution increases progressively toward Ni, reaching several tens of percent of the spin-current contribution - far exceeding theoretical predictions. Even Fe generates a non-negligible orbital current that becomes essential in the thin-nonmagnetic-layer regime. The extracted orbital diffusion lengths are consistently shorter than spin diffusion lengths and increase with decreasing spin-orbit coupling strength of the nonmagnetic layer. These results establish a quantitative framework for ultrafast spin and orbital pumping in magnetic heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋泵浦和轨道泵浦是由受驱动铁磁体向邻近非磁层注入自旋角动量和轨道角动量的基本过程。本文将自旋电子学太赫兹发射谱与楔形样品厚度控制相结合，并利用具有相反自旋霍尔角和轨道霍尔角的Ta、W和Nb非磁层，实现同时产生的自旋流与轨道流在太赫兹发射中的定量分离。对Fe、Co和Ni异质结构的测量表明，轨道泵浦贡献向Ni方向逐渐增强，可达到自旋流贡献的数十个百分点，并且轨道扩散长度始终短于自旋扩散长度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋泵浦和轨道泵浦，即从受驱动的铁磁体向相邻非磁层注入自旋角动量和轨道角动量，是磁性异质结构中角动量产生与输运的基本过程。飞秒光激发将这些现象扩展到超快区域，在该区域，自旋电子学太赫兹发射谱（STES）通过自旋到电荷和轨道到电荷的转换，以非接触方式探测皮秒尺度的角动量流。微观理论预言，沿3d系列从Fe到Ni，轨道泵浦效率会提高，但这些预言是否适用于超快激发仍不清楚。一个核心挑战在于，自旋流和轨道流会同时产生，并以相加方式贡献于同一个太赫兹发射信号，因而无法定量分离。在这里，我们将STES与异质结构中的楔形样品厚度控制相结合，这些异质结构的非磁层为Ta、W和Nb，并且它们的自旋霍尔角和轨道霍尔角符号相反。因此，两种角动量通道表现出不同的发射极性和厚度依赖性，从而能够对它们进行定量分解。对Fe、Co和Ni异质结构的系统测量表明，轨道泵浦贡献朝向Ni逐步增加，达到自旋流贡献的数十个百分点，远高于理论预言。即使Fe也会产生不可忽略的轨道流，而在非磁层较薄的情形下，该轨道流变得至关重要。提取出的轨道扩散长度始终短于自旋扩散长度，并且随着非磁层自旋轨道耦合强度减弱而增加。这些结果为磁性异质结构中的超快自旋泵浦和轨道泵浦建立了定量框架。

articles.title: Single-pulse strain-induced precessional dynamics of magnetization in Co-doped iron garnet
articles.title_zh: 单脉冲应变诱导的钴掺杂铁石榴石磁化进动动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29245v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast control of magnetization through lattice excitation provides a route to manipulating magnetic order on short timescales, yet the role of transient strain in driving magnetization dynamics remains poorly understood. Here, single-shot pump-probe magneto-optical microscopy is used to resolve the structural and magnetic responses of cobalt-doped yttrium iron garnet to individual 5-ps mid-infrared pulses. The excitation generates a localized strain field together with an outward-propagating elastic wave. Concurrently, the magnetic contrast decreases following excitation and subsequently reverses on a timescale of approximately 1.5-2 ns before recovering to its initial state. The structural and magnetic responses exhibit closely correlated wavelength and pulse-energy dependences, indicating a common excitation pathway. Micromagnetic simulations incorporating transient strain reproduce the precessional reorientation of the magnetization within individual domains while largely preserving the labyrinthine domain morphology. These results identify transient lattice deformation as the link between single-pulse mid-infrared excitation and reversible precessional magnetization dynamics in Co-doped yttrium iron garnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过晶格激发实现磁化强度的超快控制，为在短时间尺度操纵磁序提供了途径，但瞬态应变在驱动磁化动力学中的作用仍未得到充分理解。本文利用单次泵浦—探测磁光显微镜，解析钴掺杂钇铁石榴石在单个5皮秒中红外脉冲作用下的结构和磁响应。激发产生局域应变场及向外传播的弹性波，磁对比度随后降低并在约1.5至2纳秒后反转，最终恢复初始状态；包含瞬态应变的微磁模拟再现了磁化在单个畴内的进动重取向，同时基本保持迷宫状畴形貌。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过晶格激发实现磁化强度的超快控制，为在短时间尺度操纵磁序提供了一条途径，但瞬态应变在驱动磁化动力学中的作用仍然缺乏充分理解。在这里，我们使用单次泵浦—探测磁光显微镜，解析了钴掺杂钇铁石榴石在单个5皮秒中红外脉冲作用下的结构和磁响应。激发产生了局域应变场以及向外传播的弹性波。与此同时，磁对比度在激发后降低，并随后在大约1.5至2纳秒的时间尺度上发生反转，之后恢复到初始状态。结构响应和磁响应在波长依赖性与脉冲能量依赖性方面表现出密切相关，表明二者具有共同的激发途径。包含瞬态应变的微磁模拟再现了单个磁畴内磁化的进动重取向，同时基本保持了迷宫状磁畴形貌。这些结果表明，瞬态晶格形变是连接单脉冲中红外激发与Co掺杂钇铁石榴石中可逆进动磁化动力学的纽带。

articles.title: Crystal electric field excitations and an effective-spin-1/2 ground doublet in the hyperkagome magnet Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂
articles.title_zh: 超笼目磁体Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂中的晶场激发与有效自旋1/2基态双重态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29276v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use inelastic neutron scattering (INS) to determine the crystal electric field (CEF) excitations of Yb³⁺ in the rare-earth hyperkagome magnet Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂. Three nearly dispersionless magnetic excitations are observed near 58, 68, and 74~meV, corresponding to transitions from the ground-state Kramers doublet to the three excited doublets of the J=7/2 multiplet. A Stevens-operator analysis constrained by the local 222 (D₂) symmetry reproduces the excitation energies and spectral weights and yields an Ising-type ground-state g tensor. The first excited doublet lies approximately 58~meV above the ground state, establishing a well-isolated effective Jₑff=1/2 degree of freedom over the low-temperature regime relevant to collective magnetism. Notably, the directly measured CEF spectrum substantially revises the level scheme previously inferred from bulk measurements, while preserving the essential low-energy pseudospin description. Two independent fitting protocols give consistent excitation energies, ground-doublet wave functions, and g tensors, despite the nonuniqueness of the individual CEF parameters. The resulting single-ion model also reproduces the characteristic susceptibility, magnetization, and field evolution of the Schottky anomaly in specific heat. These results establish the microscopic single-ion basis needed to construct an effective exchange Hamiltonian and to interpret future measurements of low-energy collective excitations in Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用非弹性中子散射确定稀土超笼目磁体Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂中Yb³⁺的晶场激发。实验观察到约58、68和74 meV处的三个近乎无色散磁激发，对应于J=7/2多重态基态克拉默斯双重态到三个激发双重态的跃迁。受局域222（D₂）对称性约束的Stevens算符分析再现了激发能量和谱重，并给出伊辛型基态g张量；首个激发双重态位于基态之上约58 meV，确立了低温集体磁性相关温区内良好隔离的有效Jeff=1/2自由度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用非弹性中子散射（INS）确定了稀土超笼目磁体Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂中Yb³⁺的晶体电场（CEF）激发。我们在约58、68和74 meV处观察到三个近乎无色散的磁激发，它们对应于从基态克拉默斯双重态到J=7/2多重态中三个激发双重态的跃迁。受局域222（D₂）对称性约束的Stevens算符分析再现了激发能量和谱权重，并得到了一个伊辛型基态g张量。第一个激发双重态位于基态之上约58 meV，从而确立了在与集体磁性相关的低温区域内良好隔离的有效Jeff=1/2自由度。值得注意的是，直接测得的晶场谱显著修正了此前由体性质测量推断出的能级方案，同时保留了基本的低能赝自旋描述。两种相互独立的拟合方法给出了相互一致的激发能量、基态双重态波函数和g张量，尽管单个晶场参数并不唯一。所得单离子模型还再现了磁化率、磁化强度以及比热中Schottky反常随外场演化的特征。这些结果确立了构建有效交换哈密顿量所需的微观单离子基础，并为解释未来对Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂低能集体激发的测量提供了依据。

articles.title: Experimental observation of decoupled spin subsystems in decorated square kagomé lattice magnets of the nabokoite family
articles.title_zh: 纳博科石家族修饰方形戈 kagome 晶格磁体中解耦自旋子系统的实验观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The square kagomé lattice (SKL) offers a model platform for investigating geometric frustration in 2D systems. Nabokoite-family compounds nabokAX (A=Na, K, Cs, Rb and X=Cl, Br) extend this physics to a 3D network, where 2D SKL layers are decorated by interlayer spins. Using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR), we demonstrate a dramatic splitting of this complex exchange network into two virtually decoupled spin subsystems: absolute calibration of the electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) absorption reveals that only a fraction of all copper spins in nabokoites is EPR-active and this fraction of the spins orders at the Néel point. Comparison of the EPR absorption and static susceptibility indicates that contribution of the EPR-silent spin subsystem to total magnetic susceptibility decreases on cooling. This direct observation of coexisting magnetic order and possible spin-liquid dynamics within a single compound challenges conventional models of unified exchange networks in decorated frustrated lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 方形 kagome 晶格为研究二维体系中的几何阻挫提供了模型平台，纳博科石家族化合物则将其扩展到由层间自旋修饰的三维网络。电子顺磁共振测量表明，复杂的交换网络可分裂为两个近乎解耦的自旋子系统，只有部分铜自旋具有电子顺磁共振活性并在 Néel 温度发生有序化。结果显示，材料中可能同时存在磁有序与自旋液体动力学，这对传统的统一交换网络模型提出了挑战。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 方形 kagome 晶格（SKL）为研究二维体系中的几何阻挫提供了模型平台。纳博科石家族化合物 nabokAX（A = Na、K、Cs、Rb，X = Cl、Br）将这一物理问题扩展到了三维网络，其中二维 SKL 层由层间自旋加以修饰。利用电子顺磁共振（EPR），我们证明这一复杂的交换网络会显著分裂成两个近乎解耦的自旋子系统：对电子顺磁共振（EPR）吸收进行绝对标定后发现，纳博科石中的全部铜自旋只有一部分具有 EPR 活性，并且这部分自旋在 Néel 温度处发生有序化。比较 EPR 吸收与静态磁化率表明，随着降温，EPR 沉默自旋子系统对总磁化率的贡献会减小。在单一化合物中直接观测到磁有序与可能的自旋液体动力学共存，这对修饰型受挫晶格中统一交换网络的传统模型提出了挑战。

articles.title: Heavy-Hole--Light-Hole Mixing and Spin--Photon Coupling in Germanium Flopping-Mode Qubits
articles.title_zh: 锗翻转模式量子比特中的重空穴—轻空穴混合与自旋—光子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29325v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intrinsic spin--orbit interaction in germanium provides electrically active flopping-mode qubits without requiring magnetic-field gradients to generate spin--charge hybridization. We study double quantum dots (DQDs) with a multiband Luttinger--Kohn framework that retains heavy-hole (HH) and light-hole (LH) states on equal footing. Modeling vertical confinement with a finite confinement potential along the growth direction brings selected subbands into a regime of appreciable HH--LH mixing. This admixture activates electric-dipole spin-coupling through LH--LH and LH--HH transitions, complementing the conventional HH--HH pseudospin-flip resonance. For the parameter sets considered, these additional channels can produce larger spin--photon figures of merit than the HH--HH transition. HH--LH mixing thus supplies a tunable ingredient for qubit--cavity coupling in germanium hole-spin qubits and extends the operating regimes available to circuit-QED architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 锗中的本征自旋—轨道相互作用使翻转模式量子比特能够通过电学方式操控，而无需磁场梯度来产生自旋—电荷杂化。基于保留重空穴和轻空穴态的多带 Luttinger–Kohn 模型，研究发现适度的重空穴—轻空穴混合可激活多种电偶极自旋耦合通道。对于所研究的参数，这些附加通道的自旋—光子耦合性能可能优于传统的重空穴—重空穴跃迁，从而拓展锗空穴自旋量子比特在电路量子电动力学架构中的工作范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锗中的本征自旋—轨道相互作用提供了无需磁场梯度产生自旋—电荷杂化、即可实现电学活跃翻转模式量子比特的途径。我们采用保留重空穴（HH）态和轻空穴（LH）态并使二者处于同等地位的多带 Luttinger–Kohn 框架，研究了双量子点（DQD）。通过在生长方向上采用有限限制势对垂直限制进行建模，可以使选定的子带进入具有显著 HH–LH 混合的区域。这种混合通过 LH–LH 和 LH–HH 跃迁激活了电偶极自旋耦合，并补充了传统的 HH–HH 赝自旋翻转共振。对于所考虑的参数组，这些附加通道能够产生比 HH–HH 跃迁更高的自旋—光子性能指标。因此，HH–LH 混合为锗空穴自旋量子比特中的量子比特—腔耦合提供了一个可调控因素，并拓展了电路量子电动力学架构可采用的工作区域。

articles.title: Collinear and noncollinear antiferromagnetic ordering in a highly frustrated decorated square kagomé lattice antiferromagnets of the nabokoite family
articles.title_zh: 纳博科石家族高度受挫修饰方形 kagome 晶格反铁磁体中的共线与非共线反铁磁有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nabokoite family compounds ACu₇(TeO₄)(SO4)₅X (A=Na, K, Rb, Cs; X=Cl, Br) host frustrated 2D square kagom'e lattice layers decorated by additional inter-layer magnetic ions. We study magnetic order in nabokoites with multi-frequency electron spin resonance spectroscopy and thermodynamic measurement (specific heat, magnetization and dielectric permittivity). Our study reveals that the choice of the low-temperature ground state is qualitatively different in light-alkali-ion (K, Na) and heavy-alkali-ion (Rb, Cs) compounds. Heavy-alkali-ion nabokoites order in conventional collinear antiferromagnetic pattern with easy-axis anisotropy. The parameters of the ordered antiferromagnetic state are very close for all heavy-alkali-ion subfamily. Light-alkali-ion members of nabokoite family demonstrate much more complicated route to the ordered state: firstly, a ferroelectric transition at 25-90K lifts the frustration and thus pre-cooks the low-temperature ordering; secondly, an unusual noncollinear magnetic order develops via two-step phase transition with first transition temperature Tc₁simeq 5-6K and the second transition at Tc₂simeq 3-4K. Noncollinear order is evidenced by observation of characteristic non-Larmor antiferromagnetic resonance mode. Spin dynamics of light-alkali-ion nabokoites is characterized by three zero-field magnon gaps and two spin-reorientation fields, the values of magnon gaps and critical fields are quite different for different compounds. The finite-size cluster modeling of pyramidal structural block of nabokoite structure combined suggests that the critical closeness of the nabokoite exchange coupling parameters to the border-line between the different quantum ground state of pyramidal building block of nabokoite structure could be the clue to the choice of qualitatively different ordered state in light- and heavy-alkali-ion nabokoites.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳博科石家族化合物含有由层间磁性离子修饰的受挫二维方形 kagome 晶格层。多频电子自旋共振和热力学测量显示，轻碱金属成员（K、Na）与重碱金属成员（Rb、Cs）的低温基态具有本质差异：前者经历铁电转变，并通过两步相变形成非共线磁有序；后者形成具有易轴各向异性的常规共线反铁磁有序。有限尺寸团簇模型表明，交换耦合参数接近不同量子基态的分界线，可能是造成两类化合物不同有序态的关键。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纳博科石家族化合物 ACu₇(TeO₄)(SO₄)₅X（A = Na、K、Rb、Cs；X = Cl、Br）包含受挫的二维方形 kagome 晶格层，并由额外的层间磁性离子加以修饰。我们采用多频电子自旋共振谱学以及热力学测量（比热、磁化强度和介电常数）研究了纳博科石中的磁有序。我们的研究表明，轻碱金属离子化合物（K、Na）与重碱金属离子化合物（Rb、Cs）的低温基态选择在性质上明显不同。重碱金属离子纳博科石形成具有易轴各向异性的常规共线反铁磁结构。重碱金属离子亚族中所有化合物的反铁磁有序态参数都非常接近。纳博科石家族中的轻碱金属离子成员则表现出更为复杂的有序化过程：首先，在 25–90 K 发生铁电转变，解除阻挫并为低温有序化预先创造条件；随后，通过两步相变形成异常的非共线磁有序，其中第一次转变的温度 Tc₁ 约为 5–6 K，第二次转变发生在 Tc₂ 约为 3–4 K。观察到具有特征性的非拉莫尔反铁磁共振模式，证明了非共线有序的存在。轻碱金属离子纳博科石的自旋动力学具有三个零场磁振子能隙和两个自旋重取向场；不同化合物的磁振子能隙值和临界场值存在相当大的差异。对纳博科石结构中金字塔形结构单元进行有限尺寸团簇建模后发现，纳博科石交换耦合参数临界性地接近该金字塔形结构单元不同量子基态之间的分界线，这可能是解释轻、重碱金属离子纳博科石为何选择性质不同的有序态的关键。

articles.title: Strain-Driven Electronic and Catalytic Modulation of g-C3N4/GeS van der Waals heterostructure for Photocatalytic Water Splitting
articles.title_zh: 应变驱动的 g-C₃N₄/GeS 范德华异质结构电子与催化调控：用于光催化水分解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting offers a viable pathway for sustainable hydrogen production. In this study, first-principles density functional theory calculations were performed to explore the strain-dependent photocatalytic behaviour of a two-dimensional g-C3N4/GeS heterostructure. The heterostructure shows type-II band alignment with an indirect band gap of 2.17 eV, smaller than those of the individual g-C3N4 (2.81 eV) and GeS (3.31 eV) monolayers. Biaxial tensile strain up to 3% effectively modulates the band gap and band edge positions, allowing suitable alignment with water redox potentials. The calculated Gibbs free energy for the hydrogen evolution reaction (ΔGHER) is 0.2 eV for the pristine heterostructure and approaches near-thermoneutral values (-/+ 0.1 eV) under +1% and +2% strain. Meanwhile, the OER overpotential decreases from 2.17 V to 0.97 V with increasing strain. AIMD simulations and optical absorption in the visible region confirm the thermodynamic stability and promising photocatalytic potential of the heterostructure for hydrogen generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用第一性原理密度泛函理论计算，探讨了二维 g-C₃N₄/GeS 异质结构中应变依赖的光催化行为。该异质结构具有 II 型能带排列和 2.17 eV 的间接带隙，双轴拉伸应变可调节带隙及带边位置，使其更适合水氧化还原反应。计算表明，应变能够改善析氢反应自由能并显著降低析氧反应过电位；AIMD 模拟和可见光吸收结果进一步支持其稳定性及光催化制氢潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光催化水分解为可持续制氢提供了一条可行途径。在本研究中，我们采用第一性原理密度泛函理论计算，探究二维 g-C₃N₄/GeS 异质结构中依赖应变的光催化行为。该异质结构表现出 II 型能带排列，并具有 2.17 eV 的间接带隙，小于独立 g-C₃N₄（2.81 eV）和 GeS（3.31 eV）单层的带隙。最高达 3% 的双轴拉伸应变能够有效调节带隙和带边位置，使其与水的氧化还原电势实现适宜匹配。计算得到，未施加应变的异质结构析氢反应自由能（ΔG_HER）为 0.2 eV；在 +1% 和 +2% 应变下，该数值接近热中性值（约 ±0.1 eV）。与此同时，随着应变增加，析氧反应过电位从 2.17 V 降低至 0.97 V。AIMD 模拟以及可见光区域的光学吸收结果证实，该异质结构具有热力学稳定性和用于制氢的良好光催化潜力。

articles.title: Elastic properties of amorphous LiTaCl₆ solid-state electrolyte
articles.title_zh: 非晶态 LiTaCl₆ 固态电解质的弹性性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amorphous solid-state electrolytes are attractive candidates for safe, high-energy-density all-solid-state batteries, yet their mechanical properties remain poorly understood from a computational perspective. Here, we investigate the elastic behavior of the recently discovered amorphous superionic Li-ion conductor LiTaCl₆ using density-functional-theory (DFT)-based methods, including unrelaxed static, relaxed static, and strain fluctuations from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations in the isobaric--isothermal (NPT) ensemble with DFT-trained machine-learning force fields (MLFFs). While the unrelaxed static method predicts a Young's modulus an order of magnitude higher than the experiment, the relaxed static method---commonly applied to crystalline electrolytes---still overestimates the modulus by more than 170%. In contrast, the MD approach using MLFFs yields a Young's modulus of 2.84 ± 0.26 GPa, which quantitatively agrees with the experimental value of 2.91 ± 0.32 GPa.
