Using the MLFF-MD approach, we further predict bulk modulus (4.44 GPa), shear modulus (1.02 GPa), and Poisson's ratio (0.39) for amorphous LiTaCl₆ and conclude that elastically it behaves like a soft polymer or gel. These results demonstrate that amorphous superionic materials possess some unique elastic properties and that, among the methods examined, only the MLFF-MD approach yields quantitative agreement with experiment, highlighting the necessity of a dynamical treatment to simulate their elastic response, consistent with recent findings for crystalline superionic conductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究采用基于密度泛函理论的方法，结合静态计算和利用机器学习力场进行分子动力学模拟，考察了非晶态超离子导体 LiTaCl₆ 的弹性行为。未弛豫和弛豫静态方法都显著高估了杨氏模量，而 NPT 系综中的 MLFF-MD 方法得到的结果与实验定量一致。研究预测 LiTaCl₆ 具有较低的体积模量和剪切模量，整体弹性行为类似软聚合物或凝胶，并表明模拟非晶超离子材料的弹性响应必须考虑动力学效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非晶态固态电解质是安全、高能量密度全固态电池颇具吸引力的候选材料，但从计算角度看，人们对其力学性质仍缺乏充分认识。在此，我们利用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的方法研究了近期发现的非晶态锂离子超离子导体 LiTaCl₆ 的弹性行为，所采用的方法包括未弛豫静态计算、弛豫静态计算，以及在等压等温（NPT）系综中借助由 DFT 训练的机器学习力场（MLFF）进行分子动力学（MD）模拟并计算应变涨落。未弛豫静态方法预测的杨氏模量比实验值高出一个数量级，而通常应用于晶态电解质的弛豫静态方法仍将该模量高估了 170% 以上。相比之下，利用 MLFF 的 MD 方法得到的杨氏模量为 2.84 ± 0.26 GPa，与实验值 2.91 ± 0.32 GPa 定量一致。进一步利用 MLFF-MD 方法，我们预测了非晶态 LiTaCl₆ 的体积模量（4.44 GPa）、剪切模量（1.02 GPa）和泊松比（0.39），并得出其弹性行为类似软聚合物或凝胶的结论。这些结果表明，非晶态超离子材料具有一些独特的弹性性质；在所考察的方法中，只有 MLFF-MD 方法能够与实验实现定量一致，从而凸显出模拟其弹性响应时采用动力学处理的必要性，这与近期关于晶态超离子导体的研究发现相一致。
articles.focus_summary: 论文以非晶LiTaCl6固态电解质为对象，比较静态弹性计算与基于DFT训练机器学习力场的NPT分子动力学方法。结果显示，机器学习力场分子动力学得到的杨氏模量与实验高度一致，而常规静态方法明显高估弹性模量，并进一步预测了体积模量、剪切模量和泊松比。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的固态电解质、锂离子电池、第一性原理分子动力学、机器学习势和非晶材料模拟方向高度直接相关。该工作突出显示了MLFF-MD在有限温度非晶离子导体力学性质预测中的必要性和可靠性。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步研究LiTaCl6的离子扩散、温度依赖黏弹性、局域结构演化及应力对离子电导的影响，并检验机器学习势在成分变化和非平衡加载条件下的迁移能力。

articles.title: PINN-Phase: A physics-informed neural network for curvature-driven multiphase-field evolution
articles.title_zh: PINN-Phase：一种用于曲率驱动多相场演化的物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase-field simulation of polycrystalline microstructures becomes costly when many related cases must be evolved over long times. We introduce PINN-Phase, a physics-informed neural time integrator that advances the full multiphase field from its initial condition and enforces phase bounds and unit sum at every step; on the reported explicit multiphase-field benchmarks, post-initial-condition reference states serve only for evaluation. Without case-specific tuning, a single trained 25-grain model meets all predefined criteria in seven of eight unseen microstructures fixed before evaluation and in both stress cases, with 0.94-3.71% terminal grain-label disagreement across the ten cases. Each 12,000-step rollout takes about 5.2 min on a single GPU and reaches nearly three times the temporal horizon represented during training. A pre-registered 64-grain model reaches 6.09% disagreement, retaining all 21 reference survivors plus one additional grain; a post-evaluation continuation with a doubled training horizon and 25 additional epochs reaches 3.97% and the exact survivor set. In three dimensions, one trained 16-grain 96³ model recovers the exact terminal active set and all three extinction identities in six of six unseen microstructures, five of which meet the complete predefined qualification. These results demonstrate structurally admissible long-horizon prediction and prospective initial-condition transfer within fixed benchmark families.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 PINN-Phase，这是一种物理信息神经时间积分器，可从初始条件推进完整多相场，并在每一步保持相场有界和总和为一。在无需针对具体案例调参的情况下，单个训练模型在多个未见微结构和应力情形中实现了较低的终态晶粒标签不一致率，并可推进至近三倍于训练时长的时间范围。三维测试还表明，该方法能够准确恢复终态活跃晶粒集合及晶粒消失身份，显示出长时程预测和初始条件迁移能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当需要在较长时间内演化许多相关案例时，多晶微结构的相场模拟会变得十分昂贵。我们提出 PINN-Phase，这是一种物理信息神经时间积分器，能够从初始条件推进完整的多相场，并在每一步都强制满足相界限和总和为一的约束；在本文报告的显式多相场基准测试中，初始条件之后的参考状态仅用于评估。在不进行针对具体案例调参的情况下，一个经过训练的 25 晶粒模型在评估前预先固定的八个未见微结构中的七个以及两个应力案例中满足全部预定义标准，在十个案例中的终态晶粒标签不一致率为 0.94%–3.71%。每次 12,000 步的推进在单个 GPU 上约需 5.2 分钟，并且能够达到几乎三倍于训练阶段所覆盖的时间范围。一个预注册的 64 晶粒模型达到 6.09% 的不一致率，保留了全部 21 个参考存活晶粒，并额外保留了一个晶粒；在评估后继续训练、将训练时长加倍并增加 25 个训练周期后，不一致率降至 3.97%，且恢复了完全相同的存活晶粒集合。在三维情况下，一个经过训练的 16 晶粒 96³ 模型在六个未见微结构中的全部六个案例中恢复了精确的终态活跃晶粒集合和三个晶粒消失身份，其中五个案例满足完整的预定义资格标准。这些结果表明，在固定的基准测试族中，该方法能够进行结构上满足约束的长时程预测，并能够将模型迁移到新的初始条件。

articles.title: Vibrational Origin of the Barocaloric Effect in the Spin-Crossover Complex Fe(pap-5NO2)2: A Combined DFT and Mean-Field Study
articles.title_zh: Fe(pap-5NO₂)₂ 自旋交叉配合物中压卡效应的振动起源：DFT 与平均场联合研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29447v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite the barocaloric performance recently reported for the spin-crossover complex Fe(pap-5NO2)2, the microscopic origin of its pressure-induced entropy change remains poorly understood. In particular, the relative contributions of vibrational, configurational, and spin degrees of freedom to the barocaloric response have not yet been quantitatively established. Here, we develop a theoretical framework that combines density functional theory (DFT) calculations with an effective mean field Hamiltonian to investigate the barocaloric effect in this spin-crossover complex. Vibrational frequencies of the low-spin (S = 0) and high-spin (S = 2) states obtained from first-principles calculations are incorporated into a thermodynamic model that explicitly accounts for configurational, spin, and lattice entropy contributions. By establishing a correspondence between the vibrational spectra of both spin states through displacement-vector overlap analysis, we identify low and mid frequency metal-ligand vibrations as the primary microscopic origin of the vibrational entropy change. The proposed model quantitatively reproduces the experimentally reported barocaloric entropy change for a pressure variation of 2 kbar, corresponding to a maximum reversible entropy change of approximately 70 J kg-1 K-1, and predicts a spin-crossover temperature of T₁/2 = 313 K under ambient pressure, in excellent agreement with the experimental value of 308 K. Analysis of the entropy components reveals that lattice entropy associated with molecular vibrations accounts for approximately 84% of the total barocaloric response, whereas configurational and spin contributions are comparatively small.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合密度泛函理论计算与有效平均场哈密顿量，研究了 Fe(pap-5NO₂)₂ 自旋交叉配合物中压力诱导熵变的微观起源。通过比较低自旋和高自旋态的振动谱，研究确定低频和中频金属—配体振动是振动熵变的主要来源。模型能够定量重现实验压卡熵变，并预测环境压力下自旋交叉温度约为 313 K；其中分子振动相关的晶格熵约占总压卡响应的 84%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管近期已经报道了自旋交叉配合物 Fe(pap-5NO₂)₂ 的压卡性能，但其压力诱导熵变的微观起源仍缺乏充分理解。特别是，振动、构型和自旋自由度对压卡响应的相对贡献尚未得到定量确定。在此，我们建立了一个结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与有效平均场哈密顿量的理论框架，用于研究该自旋交叉配合物中的压卡效应。我们将通过第一性原理计算获得的低自旋（S = 0）和高自旋（S = 2）态振动频率纳入热力学模型，并在模型中明确计入构型熵、自旋熵和晶格熵的贡献。通过位移矢量重叠分析建立两种自旋态振动谱之间的对应关系后，我们确定低频和中频金属—配体振动是振动熵变的主要微观来源。所提出的模型能够定量重现实验报道的压卡熵变：在 2 kbar 的压力变化下，最大可逆熵变约为 70 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹；模型还预测环境压力下的自旋交叉温度 T₁/₂ = 313 K，与实验值 308 K 高度吻合。熵分量分析表明，与分子振动相关的晶格熵约占总压卡响应的 84%，而构型和自旋贡献相对较小。

articles.title: Extreme Polarization of the Optical Gap and High-Energy Exciton Landscape in CrSBr
articles.title_zh: CrSBr 中光学带隙的极端偏振特性与高能激子图景
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29566v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We reveal a strongly anisotropic excitonic landscape in monolayer and bulk-like CrSBr using optical absorption spectroscopy and GW-Bethe-Salpeter equation ab initio calculations. The direct absorptive determination of the lowest bright optical onsets i.e. X₀^a and X₀^b excitons for the two in-plane polarization eigenaxes yield an in-plane optical gap anisotropy of 470 ± 15 meV. This is the highest observed value for any material in the near-infrared-to-visible spectral region to the best of our knowledge. Energetically above, we identify multiple strongly polarized excitons spanning 1.25 eV to 3.1 eV selectively aligned along the two orthogonal axes. A resonance X⁻, located 24 meV below the X₀^b progressively transfers oscillator strength to X_b⁰, a behavior consistent with a coupled trion (Fermi-polarion)/exciton pair. Our experiments also provide polarization-resolved broadband dielectric functions of CrSBr. These results establish CrSBr as a strongly polarization-selective excitonic system and highlight its potential for polarization-selective optoelectronics enabled with its large optical-gap anisotropy.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用光学吸收光谱和 GW-贝特—萨尔彼特方程第一性原理计算，揭示了单层及类块体 CrSBr 中高度各向异性的激子图景。沿两个面内偏振本征轴测得的最低明亮激子光学起始能量显示出 470 ± 15 meV 的带隙各向异性，这是近红外至可见光区域中已知材料的最高观测值。研究还发现了分布于 1.25–3.1 eV 的多个强偏振激子，以及可能由耦合三重激子与激子对引起的振子强度转移，表明 CrSBr 适用于偏振选择性光电子学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们结合光学吸收光谱和 GW-贝特—萨尔彼特方程的第一性原理计算，揭示了单层和类块体 CrSBr 中高度各向异性的激子图景。沿两个面内偏振本征轴对最低明亮光学起始态，即 X₀ᵃ 和 X₀ᵇ 激子，进行直接吸收测定，得到 470 ± 15 meV 的面内光学带隙各向异性。据我们所知，这是近红外至可见光光谱区域中任何材料已观测到的最高值。在更高能量处，我们识别出多个强偏振激子，其能量分布在 1.25 eV 至 3.1 eV，并分别选择性地沿两个正交轴取向。位于 X₀ᵇ 下方 24 meV 处的共振态 X⁻ 会逐渐将振子强度转移给 X_b⁰，这一行为与耦合三重激子（费米极化子）/激子对相一致。我们的实验还获得了 CrSBr 的偏振分辨宽带介电函数。这些结果确立了 CrSBr 作为一种具有强偏振选择性的激子体系，并凸显了其凭借巨大光学带隙各向异性实现偏振选择性光电子学的潜力。

articles.title: From Freezing to Terminal Packing: A Puzzle and a Paradox
articles.title_zh: 从冻结到终端堆积：一个谜题与悖论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A density-functional theory developed for equilibrium freezing also produces a high-density endpoint close to terminal packing. We revisit the nonlinear Ramakrishnan--Yussouff bifurcation framework and distinguish the first crystalline fold, thermodynamic coexistence, and terminal marginality. At the terminal point, the grand-potential curvature vanishes along the principal finite-wavevector density mode, exactly when the nonlinear self-consistency equation loses stiffness. The construction gives exact close packing for one-dimensional hard rods, a terminal hard-disk packing fraction near 0.8407, and a hard-sphere value near 0.629, close to random close packing. These results identify a finite-wavevector thermodynamic marginality of a metastable liquid continuation, rather than equilibrium freezing or mechanical jamming, and expose a persistent puzzle: why should liquid-state correlations encode the approach to terminal disordered packing across different physical dimensions and systems?
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视一种由平衡冻结理论发展而来的密度泛函理论，并区分了首次晶体折叠、热力学共存和终端临界性。终端点对应于有限波矢密度主模方向上的巨正则势曲率消失，也是非线性自洽方程失去刚性的时刻。该理论分别给出一维硬棒的精确紧密堆积结果，以及接近随机紧密堆积的二维硬盘和三维硬球终端堆积率，提示亚稳液体延拓存在有限波矢热力学临界性，但也留下了液体态关联为何能反映不同维度和体系中无序终端堆积趋近过程的难题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一种为平衡冻结发展起来的密度泛函理论同样能够产生一个接近终端堆积的高密度端点。我们重新考察非线性 Ramakrishnan–Yussouff 分岔框架，并区分首次晶体折叠、热力学共存和终端临界性。在终端点处，巨正则势沿主导的有限波矢密度模的曲率消失，而这恰好发生在非线性自洽方程失去刚性之时。对于一维硬棒，该构造给出了精确的紧密堆积结果；对于硬盘，其终端堆积率约为 0.8407；对于硬球，该数值约为 0.629，接近随机紧密堆积。这些结果表明，这是一种亚稳液体延拓的有限波矢热力学临界性，而不是平衡冻结或机械堵塞，并揭示出一个持续存在的谜题：为什么在不同物理维度和不同体系中，液体态关联都应当编码无序终端堆积的趋近过程？

articles.title: Magnetic Field-Tunable Repulsive Exciton-Exciton Interaction in the van der Waals Antiferromagnet NiPS₃
articles.title_zh: 范德华反铁磁体 NiPS₃ 中可由磁场调控的排斥性激子—激子相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29701v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two ultra-narrow absorption peaks around 1.5 eV, which are widely believed to originate from a transition from a spin-orbital entangled triplet to a singlet state, in the two-dimensional van der Waals crystal NiPS₃, have attracted considerable attention because of their pronounced spin-dependent character. An interesting question is whether ultrahigh magnetic fields modify an interaction-driven hybridization between those two peaks. In this work we perform systematic magneto-optical measurements of NiPS₃ in pulsed magnetic fields of up to 178 T and observe a pronounced mutual repulsion between the two sharp exciton peaks accompanied by a redistribution of oscillator strength, while the band edge shows no detectable field-induced shift within our experimental resolution. We construct a minimal two-level interaction model and compare it semi-quantitatively with the experimental data. Our results reveal a magnetic-field-tunable exciton-exciton coupling as the dominant high-field response of NiPS₃, and clarify this material as a new experimental platform for exploring strongly correlated exciton physics in magnetic van der Waals insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维范德华晶体 NiPS₃ 在约 1.5 eV 处具有两个超窄吸收峰，通常认为它们源自自旋—轨道纠缠三重态到单重态的跃迁。通过最高 178 T 的脉冲磁场磁光测量，研究观察到两个尖锐激子峰之间显著的相互排斥及伴随的振子强度重分配，而带边在实验分辨率内没有可检测的场致位移。最小二能级相互作用模型表明，高磁场响应主要由可调控的激子—激子耦合主导，使 NiPS₃ 成为研究磁性范德华绝缘体中强关联激子物理的平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维范德华晶体 NiPS₃ 中约 1.5 eV 附近的两个超窄吸收峰受到广泛关注，人们普遍认为它们源自自旋—轨道纠缠三重态到单重态的跃迁，这是因为这些峰表现出显著的自旋依赖特性。一个有趣的问题是，超高磁场是否会改变这两个峰之间由相互作用驱动的杂化。在本工作中，我们在最高达 178 T 的脉冲磁场中对 NiPS₃ 进行了系统的磁光测量，观察到两个尖锐激子峰之间显著的相互排斥，并伴随振子强度的重新分配；与此同时，在我们的实验分辨率范围内，带边没有出现可检测的磁场诱导位移。我们构建了一个最小二能级相互作用模型，并将其与实验数据进行了半定量比较。我们的结果揭示出，可由磁场调控的激子—激子耦合是 NiPS₃ 在高磁场下响应的主导因素，同时表明该材料是探索磁性范德华绝缘体中强关联激子物理的新实验平台。

articles.title: Phase Diagram and Critical Behaviour of the Two-Dimensional Potts Model with Long-Range Quenched Disorder
articles.title_zh: 具有长程淬火无序的二维 Potts 模型的相图与临界行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the phase diagram and critical properties of the q = 3 and q = 8 Potts models with spatially correlated disorder governed by a power-law decay with exponent a. Building on the phase diagram proposed by Chippari et al. [3], where a transition from finite-disorder to infinite-disorder fixed points was identified as a function of a, we refine this picture by using wrapping probabilities of Fortuin-Kasteleyn clusters. Furthermore, using magnetic observables, we clarify the physical origin of the double-peak structure in the magnetic susceptibility and establish the validity of the hyper-scaling relation across all investigated regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有空间相关无序的 q = 3 和 q = 8 Potts 模型的相图与临界性质，其中无序关联按指数 a 的幂律衰减。在 Chippari 等人提出的相图基础上，研究利用 Fortuin–Kasteleyn 团簇的绕包概率进一步刻画了有限无序固定点与无限无序固定点之间的转变。通过磁性观测量，作者还澄清了磁化率双峰结构的物理来源，并验证了超标度关系在所有研究区域内均成立。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了 q = 3 和 q = 8 的 Potts 模型的相图与临界性质，其中空间相关无序由指数 a 控制，并按照幂律衰减。我们以 Chippari 等人提出的相图为基础，利用 Fortuin–Kasteleyn 团簇的绕包概率对该图景进行了细化；在此前的相图中，人们根据 a 的变化确定了从有限无序固定点到无限无序固定点的转变。此外，通过磁性观测量，我们澄清了磁化率中双峰结构的物理起源，并确立了超标度关系在所有所研究区域内的有效性。

articles.title: High-Field Terahertz Spin Resonance in Cr₂O₃ above the Spin-Flop Transition
articles.title_zh: 自旋翻转相变以上 Cr₂O₃ 中的高场太赫兹自旋共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report single-shot terahertz time-domain spectroscopy of Cr₂O₃ in pulsed magnetic fields up to 30 T. Well above the spin-flop field, in the 20-30 T range, the resonance frequency exhibits a nearly linear field dependence with a slope of ~22 GHz/T, smaller than the 28 GHz/T reported from low-field measurements. This reduction is insensitive to temperature and to a 15deg field tilt, suggesting an intrinsic high-field property.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究报告了在最高 30 T 脉冲磁场下对 Cr₂O₃ 进行的单次太赫兹时域光谱测量。在远高于自旋翻转场的 20–30 T 区间，共振频率随磁场近似线性变化，斜率约为 22 GHz/T，低于低场测量报道的 28 GHz/T。该斜率降低对温度和 15° 的磁场倾角均不敏感，表明这是 Cr₂O₃ 的内禀高场性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了在最高达 30 T 的脉冲磁场下对 Cr₂O₃ 进行的单次太赫兹时域光谱测量。在远高于自旋翻转场的 20–30 T 范围内，共振频率随磁场呈近似线性依赖，其斜率约为 22 GHz/T，小于低场测量中报道的 28 GHz/T。该斜率的降低与温度以及 15° 的磁场倾角无关，这表明它是高场下的内禀性质。

articles.title: Harnessing the skyrmion Hall effect for low-power skyrmion transport in a tubular synthetic antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 利用斯格明子霍尔效应实现管状合成反铁磁体中的低功耗斯格明子输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29724v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that optimal control can turn the skyrmion Hall effect from a source of typically unwanted transverse motion into a mechanism for reducing Ohmic losses in skyrmion transport. We consider a pair of antiferromagnetically coupled skyrmions confined to a tubular geometry, where their relative transverse displacement becomes a periodic internal coordinate. The skyrmion Hall effect drives this coordinate, while finite interlayer coupling makes the resulting relation between applied current and longitudinal velocity nonlinear, allowing different current protocols to produce the same prescribed average velocity. We determine which of these protocols minimizes Joule heating. Depending on the interlayer coupling and spin-transfer-torque parameters, the optimal current is either constant, with the skyrmion pair maintaining a fixed relative position, or time dependent, with the pair undergoing periodic relative motion around the tube. In either case, the additional internal degree of freedom created by the skyrmion Hall effect and interlayer coupling enables skyrmion transport at a lower power than in the uncoupled limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究表明，最优控制能够将通常导致非期望横向运动的斯格明子霍尔效应转化为降低斯格明子输运欧姆损耗的机制。作者考察了受限于管状几何结构中的一对反铁磁耦合斯格明子，其相对横向位移构成周期性内部坐标。依据层间耦合与自旋转移力矩参数，最优电流可以是保持固定相对位置的恒定电流，也可以是驱动斯格明子对绕管作周期性相对运动的时变电流。该内部自由度使输运功耗低于无耦合极限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，最优控制能够将通常是不受欢迎横向运动来源的斯格明子霍尔效应，转化为降低斯格明子输运中欧姆损耗的机制。我们研究了一对受限于管状几何结构中的反铁磁耦合斯格明子，其中它们的相对横向位移成为一个周期性的内部坐标。斯格明子霍尔效应驱动该坐标，而有限的层间耦合使施加电流与纵向速度之间的关系变为非线性，从而允许不同的电流方案产生相同的给定平均速度。我们确定了这些方案中哪一种可使焦耳热最小。取决于层间耦合和自旋转移力矩参数，最优电流要么是恒定的，此时斯格明子对保持固定的相对位置；要么是随时间变化的，此时该对斯格明子绕管进行周期性的相对运动。在任一种情形下，由斯格明子霍尔效应和层间耦合所产生的额外内部自由度，都使斯格明子能够以低于无耦合极限的功率实现输运。

articles.title: Emergent Pair Density Wave and Incoherent Metallic State in a Strongly Correlated Doped System
articles.title_zh: 强关联掺杂体系中涌现的配对密度波与非相干金属态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the dynamical emergence of a state driven by the interplay between antiferromagnetism (AFM) and singlet d-wave superconductivity (SC) within a slave-rotor mean-field framework. By decomposing the electron into charge and spin degrees of freedom, the formalism captures strong-correlation effects beyond conventional mean-field approaches. A PDW order is found to emerge dynamically in the coexistence region of AFM and SC. The AFM-SC coexistence region is significantly modified with correlation, leading to a systematic shift of the tetra-critical point. The doping and temperature evolution of the AFM, SC, and PDW order parameters, together with the rotor condensate amplitude φ, which characterizes charge coherence, shows a crossover from a coherent to an incoherent metal with the suppression of coherent quasi-particle spectral weight. Moreover, in the AFM + (φ ≠ 0) region, coherent quasi-particle bands coexist with incoherent Hubbard-like excitations, whereas only incoherent spectral features survive in the AFM + (φ = 0) regime. The SC phase exhibits nodal quasi-particles consistent with d-wave pairing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用从转子平均场框架，考察反铁磁性与单态 d 波超导之间相互作用所驱动的动力学态。反铁磁与超导共存区内可动力学地产生配对密度波序，且强关联会显著重塑该共存区域并移动四临界点。随掺杂和温度变化，体系可由相干金属交叉到非相干金属；不同区域中相干准粒子带、Hubbard 类非相干激发及 d 波节点准粒子表现出不同特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在从转子平均场框架内研究了由反铁磁性（AFM）与单态 d 波超导性（SC）相互作用所驱动的态的动力学涌现。通过将电子分解为电荷和自旋自由度，该形式体系能够捕捉超越常规平均场方法的强关联效应。在 AFM 与 SC 的共存区域中发现配对密度波（PDW）序可以动力学地产生。关联效应显著改变了 AFM-SC 共存区域，从而导致四临界点发生系统性移动。AFM、SC 和 PDW 序参量以及表征电荷相干性的转子凝聚振幅 φ 随掺杂和温度的演化表明，随着相干准粒子谱权重受到抑制，体系从相干金属交叉到非相干金属。此外，在 AFM +（φ ≠ 0）区域，相干准粒子能带与非相干的 Hubbard 类激发共存；而在 AFM +（φ = 0）区域，只有非相干谱特征得以保留。SC 相呈现出与 d 波配对一致的节点准粒子。

articles.title: Localized orbitals and tunnel couplings from general confinement potentials in gate-defined quantum-dot arrays
articles.title_zh: 从一般限域势中获得栅极定义量子点阵列的局域轨道与隧穿耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient simulation of dense gate-defined multi-quantum-dot arrays requires accurate and scalable modeling methods, compatible with asymmetries and imperfections of realistic voltage-controlled confinement potentials. We present a numerical localization procedure that rotates the eigenbasis of a general one-particle effective orbital Hamiltonian into s-, p-, d-, ldots-shells of localized orbital wavefunctions associated with individual quantum dots. The pairwise tunnel couplings between such states are computed directly as matrix elements of the Hamiltonian. We demonstrate this procedure on a 2D triangular Si-MOS triple-quantum-dot array by obtaining the voltage dependencies of the tunnel couplings and their distributions in the presence of disorder. We discuss the implications of this evaluation method on the many-body calculations, and relate it to the experimental tunnel coupling measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 高密度栅极定义多量子点阵列的模拟需要能够处理真实电压限域势不对称性与缺陷的精确、可扩展方法。本文提出数值局域化程序，将一般单粒子有效轨道哈密顿量的本征基旋转为与各量子点对应的局域 s、p、d 等壳层轨道。作者以二维三角形 Si-MOS 三量子点阵列为例，获得隧穿耦合的电压依赖性和无序条件下的分布，并讨论其对多体计算和实验测量的意义。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对高密度栅极定义多量子点阵列进行高效模拟，需要准确且可扩展的建模方法，并且这些方法应能兼容现实中电压控制限域势的不对称性和不完美性。我们提出一种数值局域化过程，将一般单粒子有效轨道哈密顿量的本征基旋转为局域轨道波函数的 s、p、d 等壳层，这些波函数与各个量子点相关联。这类态之间的两两隧穿耦合可直接作为哈密顿量矩阵元计算得到。我们在一个二维三角形 Si-MOS 三量子点阵列上演示了该过程，获得了隧穿耦合对电压的依赖关系及其在存在无序时的分布。我们讨论了这种评估方法对多体计算的影响，并将其与实验中的隧穿耦合测量联系起来。

articles.title: Magnetic contacts on freestanding superconducting LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃ micromembranes
articles.title_zh: 悬空超导 LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃ 微膜上的磁性接触
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) at the LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃ (LAO-STO) interface is a promising platform for superconducting spintronics, however, integrating ferromagnetic contacts with the superconducting 2DEG remains challenging. Here, we realize superconducting LAO-STO micromembrane devices contacted by ferromagnetic nickel contacts through a side-contact geometry. Low-temperature transport measurements demonstrate that superconductivity is preserved in the presence of the ferromagnetic contacts. We show that the superconducting state is strongly influenced by the magnetic history of the nickel contacts, which generates a tunable effective magnetic field in the 2DEG. Through an effective field model, the magnetization of the contacts can be inferred from the maximum superconducting response. Our results establish ferromagnetically contacted LAO-STO as a platform for future investigations of spin injection into oxide superconductors and provide a route towards superconducting spintronic devices based on complex oxide interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃ 界面的超导二维电子气是超导自旋电子学的潜在平台，但与铁磁接触的集成仍具挑战。本文通过侧接触几何结构，以铁磁镍接触制备了超导 LAO-STO 微膜器件，并证实低温下超导性得以保持。镍接触的磁历史可产生可调有效磁场并显著影响超导态，为氧化物超导体中的自旋注入和超导自旋电子器件研究提供了路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃（LAO-STO）界面处的超导二维电子气（2DEG）是超导自旋电子学的一个很有前景的平台，然而，将铁磁接触与该超导二维电子气集成仍然颇具挑战性。在这里，我们实现了通过侧接触几何结构与铁磁镍接触相连接的超导 LAO-STO 微膜器件。低温输运测量表明，在铁磁接触存在的情况下超导性得以保持。我们表明，超导态受到镍接触磁历史的强烈影响，后者在二维电子气中产生一个可调谐的有效磁场。通过一个有效场模型，可以从最大超导响应推断接触的磁化强度。我们的结果将具有铁磁接触的 LAO-STO 确立为未来研究向氧化物超导体中自旋注入的平台，并为基于复杂氧化物界面的超导自旋电子器件提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Valley-Enabled Intrinsic Dresselhaus Spin-Orbit Coupling in Silicon
articles.title_zh: 硅中由谷自由度实现的内禀 Dresselhaus 自旋轨道耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29785v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a symmetry-based theory of spin-orbit-valley coupling in silicon that reveals an intrinsic source of Dresselhaus spin-orbit coupling independent of interfaces or external electric fields. Treating the valley degree of freedom as a symmetry-carrying quantum degree of freedom, we show that the Dresselhaus interaction is necessarily valley off-diagonal and that a bulk contribution proportional to the valley Pauli matrix τ₁ is symmetry allowed. Tight-binding calculations yield a bulk coupling more than an order of magnitude larger than typical interface-induced spin-orbit coupling; achieving the same energy scale through the interface-induced mechanism would require electric fields roughly 50 times larger than typical fields. We further derive the symmetry-allowed spin-valley couplings generated by magnetic-field gradients and show how they account for the valley-dependent Zeeman splitting observed in micromagnet experiments. A slight tilt of the background magnetic field out of the plane produces an additional isotropic contribution linear in B_z, providing an experimentally accessible signature of the corresponding coupling constant. Finally, we predict a spin-independent micromagnet-induced valley splitting in the τ₃ channel, which is distinct from the τ₁,₂ channels generated by alloy disorder and therefore remains robust against disorder-induced cancellation. These results establish valley symmetry as a fundamental ingredient in the spin-orbit physics of silicon and provide new mechanisms for controlling and probing spin and valley degrees of freedom in silicon quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立基于对称性的硅中自旋-轨道-谷耦合理论，揭示了一种不依赖界面或外加电场的内禀 Dresselhaus 自旋轨道耦合来源。该理论表明 Dresselhaus 相互作用必然在谷空间中为非对角形式，且允许与谷泡利矩阵 τ₁ 成正比的体材料贡献；紧束缚计算显示其强度显著超过典型界面诱导耦合。研究还推导了磁场梯度诱导的自旋-谷耦合，解释了微磁体实验中的谷依赖塞曼分裂，并预测一种对无序消除具有鲁棒性的微磁体诱导谷分裂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发展了一种基于对称性的硅中自旋-轨道-谷耦合理论，揭示了一种独立于界面或外加电场的 Dresselhaus 自旋轨道耦合内禀来源。通过将谷自由度视为携带对称性的量子自由度，我们表明 Dresselhaus 相互作用必然在谷空间中是非对角的，并且对称性允许存在一个与谷泡利矩阵 τ₁ 成正比的体材料贡献。紧束缚计算得到的体耦合比典型的界面诱导自旋轨道耦合大一个数量级以上；若通过界面诱导机制实现相同能量尺度，则需要约为典型电场 50 倍的电场。我们还推导了由磁场梯度产生的、对称性允许的自旋-谷耦合，并表明它们如何解释微磁体实验中观察到的谷依赖塞曼分裂。背景磁场稍微偏离面内方向会产生一个与 B_z 线性相关的额外各向同性贡献，为相应耦合常数提供了一种实验上可获得的特征信号。最后，我们预测了 τ₃ 通道中一种与自旋无关的微磁体诱导谷分裂；它不同于由合金无序产生的 τ₁、τ₂ 通道，因此对无序诱导的相消保持鲁棒。这些结果确立了谷对称性作为硅自旋轨道物理的基本要素，并为在硅量子器件中控制和探测自旋与谷自由度提供了新机制。

articles.title: Thermal Hall Signatures of Distinct Schwinger-Boson Flux Sectors on the Honeycomb Lattice
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝晶格上不同 Schwinger 玻色子通量扇区的热霍尔特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermal transport offers a bulk probe of charge-neutral excitations in frustrated magnets. It remains challenging, however, to determine whether such transport can distinguish different parton mean-field structures of the same spin system. This question is particularly relevant on the honeycomb lattice, where distinct 0-flux, π-flux, and chiral π/2-flux sectors have been proposed. In this paper, we compare self-consistent saddle-point solutions in these three sectors for a frustrated J₁-J₂ Heisenberg model with a next-nearest-neighbor Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and a perpendicular magnetic field. Using finite-temperature Schwinger-boson mean-field theory and the Kubo formula for bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes systems, we evaluate the intrinsic spinon thermal Hall conductivity. At a common parameter point where all three branches remain gapped, the 0-flux response is positive and the π-flux response is negative for D>0 and h>0 under the sign conventions used in this paper, whereas the π/2-flux response changes sign with increasing temperature. We further show that a projective symmetry combining a sixfold rotation with time reversal forces the zero-field response of a fixed chiral π/2-flux domain to vanish. Within the mean-field regime examined in this paper, the sign and temperature dependence of κₓy/T therefore provide a flux-sensitive transport signature.
articles.abstract_zh: 热输运可作为探测受挫磁体中电中性激发的体相手段，但其能否区分同一自旋体系的不同部分子平均场结构尚不明确。本文比较了含次近邻 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和垂直磁场的受挫 J₁-J₂ 海森堡模型中 0 通量、π 通量及手征 π/2 通量扇区的自洽解。结果显示，不同扇区的自旋子热霍尔电导率符号及其温度依赖不同，因此 κₓy/T 可作为对通量敏感的输运标志。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热输运为受挫磁体中的电中性激发提供了一种体相探针。然而，确定此类输运能否区分同一自旋系统的不同部分子平均场结构仍然具有挑战性。这个问题在蜂窝晶格上尤其相关，因为人们已提出了不同的 0 通量、π 通量和手征 π/2 通量扇区。本文比较了具有次近邻 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和垂直磁场的受挫 J₁-J₂ 海森堡模型中这三个扇区的自洽鞍点解。我们利用有限温度 Schwinger 玻色子平均场理论，以及针对玻色 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 系统的 Kubo 公式，计算了内禀自旋子热霍尔电导率。在一个三个分支均保持有能隙的共同参数点上，按照本文采用的符号约定，当 D > 0 且 h > 0 时，0 通量响应为正，π 通量响应为负，而 π/2 通量响应会随温度升高而改变符号。我们进一步表明，将六重旋转与时间反演相结合的投影对称性，迫使固定手征 π/2 通量畴的零场响应为零。因此，在本文考察的平均场范围内，κₓy/T 的符号及温度依赖性提供了一种对通量敏感的输运特征。

articles.title: Floquet Topological Spin-Valley-Layertronics on a Layered Dice Lattice
articles.title_zh: 层状骰子晶格中的 Floquet 拓扑自旋-谷-层电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of long-sought dice flat band in layered YCl electride has opened up rich possibilities of correlation and topological physics in dice lattice systems [Nature Communications 17, 2213 (2026), arXiv:2509.05958]. Here, we reveal a plethora of distinctive correlated topological phases in a generic layered dice lattice system at band filling of ν =4 under on-site Hubbard interactions: (i) the system is an intrinsic sublattice anti-ferromagnetic (AFM) quantum spin-valley Hall insulator; (ii) a circularly polarized light (CPL) drives the AFM spin-valley insulator into a Floquet odd-parity f-wave altermagnet(AM) insulator; (iii) a vertical displacement field turns the Floquet f-wave AM insulator into a spin-valley-layer-polarized Chern insulator, with the sign of spin, valley and Chern number all controlled by the direction of the displacement field. Our results not only establish the layered dice lattice as a versatile platform for electrically switchable magnetic and topological phases, but also provide an all-electrical scheme for integrated spin-valley-layertronics for non-volatile information storage and processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 层状 YCl 电化物中骰子平带的发现，为骰子晶格体系的关联与拓扑物理开辟了新方向。本文发现，在填充数 ν = 4 和在位 Hubbard 相互作用下，通用层状骰子晶格可呈现本征亚晶格反铁磁量子自旋-谷霍尔绝缘体、圆偏振光驱动的 Floquet 奇宇称 f 波交错磁体绝缘体，以及位移场驱动的自旋-谷-层极化陈绝缘体。位移场方向可控制自旋、谷和陈数的符号，表明该体系可用于电学开关的磁性和拓扑相及非易失信息处理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期在层状 YCl 电化物中发现长期寻求的骰子平带，为骰子晶格系统中的关联和拓扑物理开辟了丰富的可能性［Nature Communications 17, 2213 (2026), arXiv:2509.05958］。在此，我们揭示了一个通用层状骰子晶格系统在带填充 ν = 4 且存在在位 Hubbard 相互作用时大量独特的关联拓扑相：（i）该系统是一个本征的亚晶格反铁磁（AFM）量子自旋-谷霍尔绝缘体；（ii）圆偏振光（CPL）将该 AFM 自旋-谷绝缘体驱动为 Floquet 奇宇称 f 波交错磁体（AM）绝缘体；（iii）垂直位移场将 Floquet f 波 AM 绝缘体转变为自旋-谷-层极化陈绝缘体，其中自旋、谷和陈数的符号都由位移场方向控制。我们的结果不仅将层状骰子晶格确立为一个可用于电学切换磁性和拓扑相的多功能平台，而且还为面向非易失信息存储和处理的集成自旋-谷-层电子学提供了一种全电学方案。

articles.title: Superheating Field of Extreme Type-II Superconductors Calculated from the Eliashberg Theory
articles.title_zh: 基于 Eliashberg 理论计算极端第二类超导体的过热场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29842v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We calculate the superheating field Hₛ of a type-II superconductor with a large Ginzburg-Landau parameter from the isotropic Eliashberg theory. It is shown that the temperature dependencies of Hₛ(T) can be obtained from a thermodynamic approach for different scattering parameters p=hbar/2πτ_Nk_BT_c in a wide range of the nonmagnetic impurity scattering times τ_N ranging from the clean (pll 1) to the dirty (pgg 1) limits. Specific calculations were done for Nb and Nb₃Sn using their electron-phonon spectral functions extracted from tunneling measurements. We show that the ratio Hₛ(T,p)/H_c(T) calculated from the Eliashberg theory exceeds that of the weak coupling BCS model, where H_c is the thermodynamic magnetic field. We also show that, even though nonmagnetic impurities are pairbreakers in the current-carrying state, Hₛ(0,p) for Nb₃Sn at T=0 has a maximum at papprox 0.2 at which the ratio Hₛ/H_c is about 6% higher than that in the BCS clean limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于各向同性 Eliashberg 理论，计算了具有大 Ginzburg-Landau 参数的第二类超导体的过热场。作者针对从洁净到脏极限的广泛非磁杂质散射区间，给出了过热场的温度依赖，并以 Nb 和 Nb₃Sn 为例进行具体计算。结果表明，Eliashberg 理论预言的 Hₛ/Hc 高于弱耦合 BCS 模型；对于 Nb₃Sn，零温过热场在特定散射参数附近达到最大值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用各向同性 Eliashberg 理论计算了具有大 Ginzburg-Landau 参数的第二类超导体的过热场 Hₛ。结果表明，对于不同的散射参数 p = hbar/2πτ_Nk_BT_c，在从洁净极限（p 远小于 1）到脏极限（p 远大于 1）的广泛非磁杂质散射时间 τ_N 范围内，可通过热力学方法获得 Hₛ(T) 的温度依赖关系。我们利用从隧穿测量中提取的电子-声子谱函数，对 Nb 和 Nb₃Sn 进行了具体计算。我们表明，由 Eliashberg 理论计算的比值 Hₛ(T,p)/H_c(T) 超过弱耦合 BCS 模型的相应比值，其中 H_c 是热力学临界磁场。我们还表明，尽管非磁性杂质在载流态中会破坏配对，但在 T = 0 时，Nb₃Sn 的 Hₛ(0,p) 在 p 约为 0.2 处具有最大值，此时 Hₛ/H_c 比 BCS 洁净极限中的该比值高约 6%。

articles.title: Chiral cellulose fibril organization in a plant cell wall as liquid crystal confined in a cylindrical boundary
articles.title_zh: 作为受圆柱边界限域液晶的植物细胞壁中手性纤维素原纤维组织
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The order of cellulose microfibrils in xylem cell walls is identified using polarized optical microscopy. The line, helix, ring, crossed helix, and twisted helix organizations in a cylindrical shell are the equilibrium states of balanced elastic deformation and surface anchoring. A computational model of the five organizations is established to simulate their birefringent-colored profiles. These five textures present unique optical textures, which are clearly recognized in the cross sections of Eucalyptus grandis. The libriform fiber cell for support has a twisted helical cell wall. The vessel cell for high-speed water uptake consists of a helical layer covered by a layer of vortex array. The ray cell for radial transportation is crossed helical. The microfibril angles versus the radius of the cell wall were measured utilizing the distribution of birefringence colors. In fiber cell walls, the MFA is significantly correlated with the curvature, bending, and surface anchoring, respectively. In vessel cell walls, the vortex array includes focal conic domains of chiral order and topological defects of nematic order, suggesting that the phase transition of cellulose fibrils leads to pattern formation. Liquid crystal phases and patterns in the cell walls reveal how the cell wall thickens and how cells differentiate. Out of the frustration of long, stiff, twisting fibrils packed in slender tubes, trees generate the helical channel networks, transforming the brittle lamina into an elastic, tear-resistant, self-healing tissue.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究借助偏振光学显微镜识别木质部细胞壁中纤维素微原纤维的排列，并将圆柱壳中的直线、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋和扭转螺旋组织解释为弹性能与表面锚定平衡下的平衡态。计算模型模拟了五类组织的双折射颜色分布，并可在桉树横截面中清晰辨识相应纹理。结果揭示不同细胞类型的细胞壁结构、微原纤维角及拓扑缺陷，并指出纤维素原纤维的液晶相与图案有助于解释细胞壁增厚、细胞分化及木材韧性来源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用偏振光学显微镜识别木质部细胞壁中纤维素微原纤维的有序排列。圆柱壳中的直线、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋和扭转螺旋组织，是弹性形变与表面锚定相平衡时的平衡态。建立了这五种组织的计算模型，用以模拟它们的双折射颜色分布。上述五种织构呈现独特的光学纹理，并可在巨桉的横截面中被清晰识别。起支撑作用的木纤维细胞具有扭转螺旋细胞壁。用于高速吸水的导管细胞由一个螺旋层及其覆盖的涡旋阵列层组成。用于径向输送的射线细胞呈交叉螺旋结构。利用双折射颜色的分布测量了细胞壁微原纤维角随半径的变化。在纤维细胞壁中，微原纤维角分别与曲率、弯曲和表面锚定显著相关。在导管细胞壁中，涡旋阵列包含手性有序的焦锥畴和向列有序的拓扑缺陷，表明纤维素原纤维的相变会导致图案形成。细胞壁中的液晶相和图案揭示了细胞壁如何增厚以及细胞如何分化。由于长而坚硬、具有扭转特性的原纤维被紧密堆积在细长管中所产生的受挫，树木形成了螺旋通道网络，将脆性的薄层转化为富有弹性、抗撕裂且能够自修复的组织。

articles.title: Spin-textured orbitals in altermagnetic artificial atoms
articles.title_zh: 交错磁性人工原子中的自旋纹理轨道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial atoms provide a versatile platform for engineering atomic-like orbitals, yet spin generally remains a passive degree of freedom in their orbital structure. Here, we introduce the concept of altermagnetic artificial atoms formed by confining electrons with momentum-dependent spin splitting. We show that altermagnetism reconstructs conventional confined orbitals into spin-textured orbitals, with spatially distinct distributions of opposite spin components. The resulting confined spectrum retains a twofold degeneracy protected by the combined C₄zT symmetry. These spin textures persist in higher-energy states, where additional radial structures combine with the characteristic angular spin pattern. Furthermore, strain resolves the degenerate orbital pairs into spin-polarized states, and continuously tunes their energy splitting. Our results establish altermagnetic artificial atoms as a route to engineering spin-dependent orbital structures in quantum-confined systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工原子可用于构造类原子轨道，但自旋通常并未参与轨道结构的主动塑造。本文提出交错磁性人工原子概念：动量依赖自旋劈裂可将常规受限轨道重构为自旋纹理轨道，使相反自旋分量在空间上分离。组合 C₄zT 对称性保护其二重简并；应变可将简并轨道对分解为自旋极化态，并连续调节能量劈裂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工原子为构造类原子轨道提供了一个多功能平台，然而在其轨道结构中，自旋通常仍然是一个被动自由度。在这里，我们提出交错磁性人工原子的概念，其形成方式是利用动量依赖的自旋劈裂来限域电子。我们表明，交错磁性会将常规受限轨道重构为自旋纹理轨道，其中相反自旋分量具有空间上不同的分布。所得受限能谱保留由组合 C₄zT 对称性保护的二重简并。这些自旋纹理在更高能态中仍然存在，其中额外的径向结构与特征性的角向自旋图样相结合。此外，应变可将简并轨道对分解为自旋极化态，并连续调节其能量劈裂。我们的结果确立了交错磁性人工原子作为在量子限域系统中构造自旋依赖轨道结构的一条途径。

articles.title: Birefringent-colored optical profiling of wood presenting the 3D cellulose microfibril architecture
articles.title_zh: 利用双折射颜色光学剖析呈现三维纤维素微原纤维结构的木材
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wood slices under a polarized optical microscope show a spectrum of interference colors, such as cyan, blue, magenta, yellow, and bluish gray because of the birefringent cellulose in the microfibrils. An optical model is established to simulate the birefringent-colored micrograph of wood. Five typical cell wall architectures, line, helix, ring, crossed helix, and twisted helix, are considered. With a retardation wave plate to distinguish fibrils of different orientations, each structure displays its unique birefringent-colored texture, presenting its underlying 3D structure with the vivid colors. Cross sections of the trunk and twig of Eucalyptus grandis presented birefringent-colored profiles. Three identification methods were compared: visible fibril trends, birefringent-colored optical textures, and the simulated look-up library. The three methods gave consistent results, proving that the birefringent-color tags are efficient and accurate. Electron and atomic force microscopy are unable to resolve cellulose microfibrils embedded in the lignin and hemicellulose matrix. Polarized optical microscopy overcomes this by selectively detecting birefringent cellulose, enabling accurate identification of complex helical structures. This method enables statistical and spatial analysis of complex biomaterial compositions. Capable of profiling dozens of cells simultaneously, this high-throughput optical method provides a potentially fully automated analysis framework for plant science, biomechanics, and bioinspired cellulose materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 偏振光学显微镜下，木材切片因微原纤维中双折射纤维素而呈现多种干涉色。本文建立光学模型，模拟直线、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋和扭转螺旋五类细胞壁结构的双折射彩色显微图像，并利用相位延迟片区分不同取向的原纤维。巨桉样品中，肉眼可见的纤维趋势、双折射颜色纹理和模拟检索库三种识别方法给出一致结果，显示该方法能高通量、准确地解析复杂三维纤维素结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 偏振光学显微镜下的木材切片会呈现青色、蓝色、品红色、黄色和蓝灰色等干涉色谱，这是由于微原纤维中的纤维素具有双折射性。建立了一个光学模型，用于模拟木材的双折射彩色显微图像。研究考虑了五种典型细胞壁结构，即直线、螺旋、环状、交叉螺旋和扭转螺旋。借助用于区分不同取向原纤维的相位延迟片，每种结构都会显示其独特的双折射彩色纹理，以鲜明色彩呈现其内在的三维结构。巨桉树干和枝条的横截面呈现出双折射颜色分布。比较了三种识别方法：可见的原纤维走向、双折射彩色光学纹理以及模拟查找库。这三种方法给出一致结果，证明双折射颜色标签高效且准确。电子显微镜和原子力显微镜无法分辨嵌入木质素和半纤维素基质中的纤维素微原纤维。偏振光学显微镜通过选择性探测双折射纤维素克服了这一问题，从而能够准确识别复杂的螺旋结构。该方法能够对复杂生物材料组分进行统计和空间分析。这种高通量光学方法能够同时剖析数十个细胞，为植物科学、生物力学和仿生纤维素材料提供了一个可能实现全自动化的分析框架。

articles.title: Chiral superconductors and competing states across a Lifshitz transition in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱面体五层石墨烯中跨越利夫希茨转变的手性超导与竞争态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene hosts a distinctive low-energy electronic structure in which strong Coulomb interactions and nontrivial quantum geometry intertwine to generate exotic quantum states. Recent experiments reported signatures of chiral superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene within the spin- and valley-polarized regime. Here we map the normal-state fermiology surrounding chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene. Quantum oscillation measurements reveal an electrically controlled Lifshitz transition between a simply-connected circular quarter-metal Fermi surface and an annular quarter-metal Fermi surface. The Lifshitz boundary itself shifts with perpendicular magnetic field, consistent with the strongly momentum-dependent orbital magnetic moment of the low-energy band. Approaching the transition from either side, the electron effective mass becomes strongly enhanced, implying the formation of a nearly dispersionless band bottom and a strongly reduced kinetic-energy scale. This singular electronic structure produces a regime of exceptionally strong instability in which chiral superconductivity competes with Wigner crystalline phases and reentrant quantum Hall states. In particular, two superconducting regions with signatures of orbital time-reversal-symmetry breaking lie on opposite sides of the Lifshitz boundary and have comparable transition temperatures, yet the annular-side state is suppressed by a substantially smaller perpendicular magnetic field. Our calculation finds comparable chiral pairing tendencies on the two parent Fermi surfaces while producing a much lower orbital-Zeeman pair-breaking scale and an additional finite-momentum pairing tendency for the annular state. These results identify Fermi-surface topology as a key control parameter for chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱面体多层石墨烯中的强库仑相互作用与非平庸量子几何可产生丰富的量子态。该研究利用量子振荡描绘菱面体五层石墨烯中手性超导附近的费米面，发现电场可调控圆形与环形四分之一金属费米面之间的利夫希茨转变。转变附近有效质量显著增强，手性超导与维格纳晶体相、重入量子霍尔态发生竞争；环形费米面一侧的超导对垂直磁场更敏感。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 菱面体多层石墨烯具有独特的低能电子结构，其中强库仑相互作用与非平庸量子几何相互交织，从而产生奇异量子态。近期实验已在自旋和谷极化区域的电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯中报告了手性超导的迹象。本文描绘了菱面体五层石墨烯中围绕手性超导的正常态费米面学图景。量子振荡测量揭示了一种可由电场控制的利夫希茨转变，发生于单连通圆形四分之一金属费米面与环形四分之一金属费米面之间。利夫希茨边界本身会随垂直磁场移动，这与低能能带强烈依赖动量的轨道磁矩相一致。从转变两侧接近该转变时，电子有效质量均显著增强，表明形成了近乎无色散的带底以及大幅降低的动能尺度。这种奇异电子结构产生了一个异常强的不稳定性区域，其中手性超导与维格纳晶体相及重入量子霍尔态竞争。特别地，具有轨道时间反演对称性破缺迹象的两个超导区域位于利夫希茨边界两侧，且具有相近的转变温度，但环形一侧的态会被显著更小的垂直磁场压制。我们的计算发现，两种母体费米面上存在可比的手性配对趋势，同时环形态具有低得多的轨道塞曼破对尺度以及额外的有限动量配对趋势。这些结果表明，费米面拓扑是菱面体石墨烯中手性超导的关键控制参数。

articles.title: Cesium Clustering and Fluoroberyllate Network Disruption in FLiBe: A Total Scattering and Molecular Dynamics Study
articles.title_zh: FLiBe中铯团簇化与氟铍酸盐网络破坏：总散射与分子动力学研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29898v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Several next-generation fission reactor designs employ molten salts such as FLiBe (2LiF-BeF₂), with some concepts using fuel dissolved directly in the salt. During operation, fission products such as cesium will accumulate in the salt mixture, potentially leading to an evolution of the thermophysical properties underpinned by the atomic structure. To understand the structural perturbations in FLiBe with 5 mol% CsF, we conducted X-ray and neutron diffraction measurements, refined empirical potential structure refinement (EPSR) models against the experimental data, and compared the resulting structure with neural network molecular dynamics (NNMD) simulations. Comparisons of the EPSR and NNMD structures distinguishes features constrained by the scattering data from those that remain model dependent. The new Cs-bearing correlations account for the changes in the total structure factor and pair-distribution function, while the FLiBe correlations remain minimally altered. We find that Cs slightly disrupts the intermediate-range fluoroberyllate network, increasing the fraction of free fluorine ions, while the local coordination remains largely unchanged. The Cs ions within FLiBe cluster extensively, with BeF₄²⁻ tetrahedra bridging neighboring cesium environments. In contrast to the minor structural perturbations in the liquid, the addition of 5 mol% CsF suppressed the formation of the crystalline Li2BeF4 phase at room temperature, with the phase appearing only above 180C upon heating. These experimentally constrained structural features provide a benchmark for atomistic models used to predict the behavior and properties of fission-product-containing FLiBe.
articles.abstract_zh: 多种下一代裂变反应堆设计使用FLiBe熔盐，而裂变产物铯的累积可能改变其结构与热物性。该研究结合X射线和中子衍射、经验势结构精修及神经网络分子动力学，考察含5 mol% CsF的FLiBe。结果表明，铯会轻微扰动中程氟铍酸盐网络并显著团簇化，同时抑制室温下晶态Li2BeF4相的形成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多种下一代裂变反应堆设计采用FLiBe（2LiF-BeF2）等熔盐，其中一些方案将燃料直接溶解于盐中。运行期间，铯等裂变产物会在盐混合物中累积，可能导致由原子结构所支撑的热物性发生演化。为理解含5 mol% CsF的FLiBe中的结构扰动，我们进行了X射线和中子衍射测量，利用实验数据精修经验势结构精修（EPSR）模型，并将所得结构与神经网络分子动力学（NNMD）模拟进行了比较。EPSR与NNMD结构之间的比较区分了受散射数据约束的特征和仍依赖于模型的特征。新的含Cs关联解释了总结构因子和对分布函数的变化，而FLiBe关联则基本未发生改变。我们发现，Cs轻微破坏了中程氟铍酸盐网络，增加了游离氟离子的比例，而局域配位基本保持不变。FLiBe中的Cs离子发生了广泛团簇化，BeF4²⁻四面体桥接相邻的铯局域环境。与液体中较小的结构扰动相反，加入5 mol% CsF抑制了室温下晶态Li2BeF4相的形成；该相仅在加热至180摄氏度以上时出现。这些受实验约束的结构特征为用于预测含裂变产物FLiBe行为和性质的原子尺度模型提供了基准。

articles.title: Symmetry-Enforced Topological Structures in Quantum Phase Diagrams
articles.title_zh: 量子相图中由对称性强制的拓扑结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the topological structure of the quantum phase diagram of gapped systems by identifying the noncontractibility of loops, so-called S¹-families, within the gapped phase diagram in which many-body Hamiltonians can have nontrivial ground-state degeneracy. We manifest the role of symmetries in such S¹-family classifications by the exotic symmetry interplay: (i) nontrivial mixed anomalies, (ii) semi-direct product relation between the spontaneously broken and the unbroken symmetries, and (iii) symmetry with noninvertible operators. We find that such structures lead to the novel S¹-family classifications inaccessible by earlier classifications based on ``independent'' symmetries. Furthermore, we construct lattice realizations of these S¹-families and explicitly demonstrate their novel algebraic structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过识别有能隙相图中不可收缩的闭环，即S¹族，探讨有能隙体系量子相图的拓扑结构。作者指出，混合反常、破缺与未破缺对称性之间的半直积关系以及含非可逆算符的对称性，可导致既有独立对称性分类所无法获得的新型S¹族分类。研究还构造了相应的晶格实现并展示其新的代数结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过识别有能隙相图中环路，即所谓S¹族的不可收缩性，研究有能隙体系量子相图的拓扑结构；在该相图中，多体哈密顿量可以具有非平凡的基态简并。我们通过特殊的对称性相互作用揭示了对称性在此类S¹族分类中的作用：（i）非平凡混合反常；（ii）自发破缺对称性与未破缺对称性之间的半直积关系；以及（iii）具有非可逆算符的对称性。我们发现，这些结构导致了早先基于“独立”对称性的分类无法获得的新型S¹族分类。此外，我们构造了这些S¹族的晶格实现，并明确展示了其新颖的代数结构。

articles.title: Van Hove singularities at the L-face of the lutetium nitride phonon dispersion
articles.title_zh: 氮化镥声子色散L面处的范霍夫奇点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.29994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the structural and vibrational properties of the prototypical 4f-filled nonmagnetic member LuN of the lanthanide nitrides, LnN, with elastic and inelastic neutron scattering data at 4~K. We find a peak in the generalized density of states which, through input from a DFT+U computation, we ascribe to a van Hove singularity on the fourfold-degenerate L-face of the Brillouin zone. This work advances the understanding of phonon dynamics in LnN beyond the Γ-point.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用4 K下的弹性与非弹性中子散射，考察了镧系氮化物中4f壳层填满、非磁性的代表性成员LuN的结构和振动性质。广义态密度中的峰经DFT+U计算辅助，被归因于布里渊区四重简并L面上的范霍夫奇点。该工作推动了对LnN声子动力学的理解从Γ点扩展至更广泛的动量空间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用4 K下的弹性和非弹性中子散射数据，报告了镧系氮化物LnN中原型性的4f壳层填满非磁性成员LuN的结构和振动性质。我们在广义态密度中发现一个峰，并借助DFT+U计算将其归因于布里渊区四重简并L面上的一个范霍夫奇点。这项工作将对LnN中声子动力学的理解推进到了Γ点之外。

articles.title: Chemical Perspectives on Cuprate Superconductivity: Hole-Protected Spin Dimers as d Wave Cooper Pairs
articles.title_zh: 铜酸盐超导的化学视角：空穴保护的自旋二聚体作为d波库珀对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The observation that the coherence lengths in cuprate superconductors are extremely small motivated us to search for its real-space structure by examining the consequence of hole-doping in CuO4 units in cuprates. We analyzed aggregates of hole-doped CuO4 units that phase-separate from hole-doped CuO2 layers in terms of their segregation-pressure indices defined in this work. Our search suggests that each d-wave Cooper pair is an antiferromagnetically coupled spin dimer protected in an antiferromagnetic hole dimer (AHD), and that the antiferromagnetic chains of AHDs provide channels through which such spin dimers can move collectively without perturbation. Based on these suggestions and their implications, we examined the causes for several seemingly puzzling observations on cuprate superconductors to find that they are naturally explained by the suggestions.
articles.abstract_zh: 铜酸盐超导体极短的相干长度促使作者从实空间角度研究空穴掺杂CuO4单元的后果。研究提出，每个d波库珀对可能是受反铁磁空穴二聚体保护的反铁磁耦合自旋二聚体，且空穴二聚体的反铁磁链可为其集体运动提供通道。作者进一步认为，该图景能够自然解释若干看似令人困惑的铜酸盐超导实验现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铜酸盐超导体中相干长度极其短这一观察结果，促使我们通过考察铜酸盐中CuO4单元空穴掺杂的后果，寻找其在实空间中的结构。我们依据本文定义的偏析压力指数，分析了从空穴掺杂CuO2层中发生相分离的空穴掺杂CuO4单元聚集体。我们的探索表明，每一个d波库珀对都是一个受反铁磁空穴二聚体（AHD）保护的反铁磁耦合自旋二聚体，并且AHD的反铁磁链提供了通道，使此类自旋二聚体能够在不受扰动的情况下集体运动。基于这些推测及其含义，我们考察了铜酸盐超导体中若干看似令人困惑的观测结果的成因，发现这些结果可由上述推测自然解释。

articles.title: Twist-Tunable Paramagnetic Superconductivity in d-wave Altermagnet/Superconductor Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: d波交替磁体/超导体异质结构中的扭转可调顺磁超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between twist-angle engineering and unconventional magnetism provides a powerful new route to control quantum phenomena. We theoretically investigate a heterostructure comprising a d-wave superconductor proximitized by a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet. We reveal that the momentum-space mismatch between the superconducting gap nodes and the altermagnetic spin-splitting nodes generates a robust, twist-tunable odd-frequency spin-triplet pairing. Consequently, the macroscopic electromagnetic response of the system can be tuned from a conventional diamagnetic Meissner state to an anomalous paramagnetic Meissner effect driven entirely by the interfacial twist angle. For a dₓ^₂₋y^₂ altermagnet, the paramagnetic response is maximized at perfect alignment (φ=0) and completely suppressed at a maximal twist of φ=π/4, while a dₓy altermagnet exhibits the exact complementary behavior. Our results establish twisted altermagnetic heterostructures as a versatile platform for engineering odd-frequency pairing and macroscopic superconducting phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论研究考察由d波超导体与二维d波交替磁体构成的异质结构。超导能隙节点与交替磁自旋劈裂节点之间的动量空间失配会产生稳健、可由扭转角调控的奇频自旋三重态配对，使系统的迈斯纳响应可由抗磁态转变为顺磁态。对于不同对称性的交替磁体，顺磁响应对扭转角呈互补依赖。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 扭转角工程与非常规磁性之间的相互作用，为控制量子现象提供了一条强有力的新途径。我们从理论上研究了一种异质结构，其中d波超导体与二维d波交替磁体通过近邻效应耦合。我们揭示，超导能隙节点与交替磁自旋劈裂节点之间的动量空间失配，会产生稳健且可由扭转角调控的奇频自旋三重态配对。因此，系统的宏观电磁响应可完全通过界面扭转角，从常规抗磁迈斯纳态调节为异常顺磁迈斯纳效应。对于dₓ²-y²交替磁体，顺磁响应在完全对齐时（φ=0）最大，并在最大扭转角φ=π/4时被完全抑制；而d_xy交替磁体则表现出完全互补的行为。我们的结果确立了扭转交替磁异质结构作为设计奇频配对和宏观超导相的多用途平台。

articles.title: Chemical potentials from structure factors: II. Charged multi-component mixtures
articles.title_zh: 由结构因子求化学势：II. 带电多组分混合物
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The chemical potentials of charged multi-component mixtures are central to electrolyte thermo- dynamics, but remain difficult to compute from atomistic simulations. The S0 method enables computing chemical potentials of mixtures from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. Here we extend the S0 method to charged mixtures by combining the composition-space framework developed in Part I: Neutral Multi-component Mixtures with a Coulombic treatment of the small- wavenumber limits of static structure factors. This approach separates thermodynamically relevant neutral composition fluctuations from forbidden macroscopic charge fluctuations, and further ac- counts for charge-neutrality constraints. We use the method to compute the chemical potentials of multiple-halide aqueous salt solutions, elucidating the ion-specific thermodynamic effects. We also calculate the mixing free energies of molten salt mixtures, demonstrating the importance of correctly describing long-wavelength electrostatic correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 带电多组分混合物的化学势是电解质热力学的核心量，但难以从原子尺度模拟中计算。该研究将S0方法扩展至带电体系，通过处理静态结构因子的小波数极限，分离热力学相关的中性组成涨落与不允许的宏观电荷涨落，并纳入电中性约束。该方法被用于计算多卤化物水溶液的化学势及熔盐混合物的混合自由能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 带电多组分混合物的化学势是电解质热力学的核心，但仍然难以由原子尺度模拟计算。S0方法能够从平衡分子动力学模拟中计算混合物的化学势。本文通过将第一部分“中性多组分混合物”中建立的组成空间框架，与对静态结构因子小波数极限的库仑处理相结合，将S0方法扩展到带电混合物。这一方法将热力学相关的中性组成涨落与不允许的宏观电荷涨落分离开来，并进一步考虑电中性约束。我们使用该方法计算了多卤化物水溶液的化学势，阐明了离子特异性的热力学效应。我们还计算了熔盐混合物的混合自由能，展示了正确描述长波长静电关联的重要性。

articles.title: Libron-phonon coupling and hydrogen-bond dynamics in the vacancy-ordered perovskite (NH4)2SnCl6: a temperature- and pressure-dependent Raman study
articles.title_zh: 有序空位钙钛矿(NH4)2SnCl6中的转动振子-声子耦合与氢键动力学：温度和压力依赖拉曼研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vacancy-ordered perovskites R2MX6 combine a rigid inorganic framework with a molecular A-site cation, but how the cation dynamics couples to the lattice phonons under external perturbation remains largely unexplored. The librational motion of NH4+ in (NH4)2SnCl6 is strictly Raman-silent by symmetry, which is why it has been probed almost exclusively by neutron scattering, NMR and NQR. We show that it is nevertheless accessible to Raman spectroscopy, through the renormalization it imposes on the allowed [SnCl6]2- modes. Combining single-crystal X-ray diffraction with Raman scattering between 10 and 300 K and up to 10.1 GPa, we find that the average cubic structure varies smoothly with no anomaly, while below ~100 K the [SnCl6]2- modes acquire a libron-phonon renormalization (E_eff ~ 4.7 meV) and a symmetry-selective line asymmetry, and the N-H stretch passes through a minimum near 120 K (E_eff ~ 9.3 meV); both track the classical-to-quantum crossover of the ammonium rotor. The two effective energies lie below the bare librational transition of 13.4 meV measured by neutrons, as expected for a self-energy scale. The ammonium linewidths, by contrast, are governed by pure dephasing rather than by anharmonic decay and carry no crossover signature. Under pressure the octahedral modes stiffen smoothly, whereas the cavity responds twice: the translational F2g mode of NH4+ gains Raman intensity above 1.3 GPa, and the N-H stretch inverts its pressure slope near 1.7 GPa, with no change of space group and full recovery on decompression. The rigid octahedral framework is thus essentially decoupled from a dynamically active NH4+ subsystem that carries the response to both perturbations, offering a route to tune cation-phonon coupling independently of the octahedral network.
articles.abstract_zh: 有序空位钙钛矿R2MX6兼具刚性无机骨架和分子A位阳离子，但阳离子动力学与晶格声子在外部扰动下的耦合仍缺乏研究。该工作表明，尽管NH4+的受阻转动在对称性上为拉曼禁戒，其对[SnCl6]2-允许模的重整化使其可被拉曼光谱间接探测。温度和压力实验揭示，动态活跃的NH4+子系统主导外部响应，而刚性八面体骨架基本与其解耦。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有序空位钙钛矿R2MX6兼具刚性无机骨架和分子A位阳离子，但在外部扰动下阳离子动力学如何与晶格声子耦合仍基本未得到探索。(NH4)2SnCl6中NH4+的受阻转动运动因对称性而严格为拉曼禁戒，这也是其几乎仅通过中子散射、核磁共振和核四极共振进行探测的原因。我们表明，尽管如此，仍可通过拉曼光谱观测到该运动，途径是其对允许的[SnCl6]2-振动模式施加的重整化。通过结合单晶X射线衍射与10至300 K、最高10.1 GPa下的拉曼散射，我们发现平均立方结构平滑变化而没有异常；而在约100 K以下，[SnCl6]2-模式获得转动振子-声子重整化（有效能量E_eff约为4.7 meV）及选择对称性的谱线不对称性，N-H伸缩振动则在约120 K附近经历最小值（有效能量E_eff约为9.3 meV）；两者都追踪了铵根转子的经典至量子交叉。两个有效能量均低于由中子测得的13.4 meV裸受阻转动跃迁能量，这符合其作为自能尺度的预期。相比之下，铵根谱线宽度由纯退相干而非非谐衰减支配，并不带有交叉特征。在压力下，八面体模式平滑硬化，而空腔表现出两次响应：NH4+的平移F2g模式在1.3 GPa以上获得拉曼强度，N-H伸缩振动则在约1.7 GPa处反转其压力斜率，期间没有空间群改变，并且在卸压后完全恢复。因此，刚性八面体骨架与一个动力学活跃的NH4+子系统基本解耦，后者承载了对两种扰动的响应，并提供了一条独立于八面体网络调控阳离子-声子耦合的途径。

articles.title: Superconductivity of Tellurium Polyhydride with Tc above 90K
articles.title_zh: 临界温度超过90 K的碲多氢化物超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report experimental diacovery of superconductivity (SC) in tellurium (Te) polyhydride. The compound was synthesized at high pressure and high temperature conditions using a diamond anvil cell combined with a laser heating system. Subsequent in situ transport measurements at high pressures, performed as a function of temperature and applied magnetic field, revealed a superconducting transition with a critical temperature Tc about 91 K at 263 GPa. The superconducting phase is assigned to TeH4 with characterized face shared TeH12 cage forming quasi molecular H2 units based on synchrotron x-ray diffraction experiments. Analysis of the SC behavior at magnetic fields yielded a Ginzburg Landau (GL) coherence length of approximately 47 angstroms. Tellurium polyhydride thus becomes another chalcogen polyhydride superconductor in addition to the landmark discovery of the first polyhydride high Tc SC SH3.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报告了碲多氢化物的实验超导发现。样品在金刚石对顶砧和激光加热条件下合成，并在263 GPa下观察到约91 K的超导转变。研究将超导相归属为TeH4，并依据磁场行为估算其Ginzburg-Landau相干长度约为47埃。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了碲（Te）多氢化物中超导性（SC）的实验发现。该化合物采用金刚石对顶砧结合激光加热系统，在高压高温条件下合成。随后在高压下开展的原位输运测量，作为温度和外加磁场的函数，揭示了在263 GPa下临界温度Tc约为91 K的超导转变。基于同步辐射X射线衍射实验，该超导相被归属为TeH4，其特征为面共享的TeH12笼结构形成准分子H2单元。对磁场下超导行为的分析给出了约47埃的金兹堡-朗道（GL）相干长度。因此，碲多氢化物成为继首个多氢化物高Tc超导体SH3这一里程碑式发现之后的又一种硫族多氢化物超导体。

articles.title: Universal tuning of Förster resonance energy transfer in gate-programmable conductor-dielectric-conductor heterostructures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a quantum-electrodynamical theory for universal tuning of spontaneous emission and Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) in a material-agnostic conductor-dielectric-conductor heterostructure. The platform consists of a dielectric spacer of thickness W bounded by two gate-tunable two-dimensional conductors. The only microscopic input from the surrounding materials is the transverse-magnetic and transverse-electric reflection amplitudes rTM/TE(q_ρ,ω) of the two sheets. Starting from the QED photon propagator, we derive the retarded Maxwell dyadic, the vacuum/Hadamard field propagator, and the time-ordered Feynman propagator in the same geometry. The spontaneous-emission rate is controlled by the local vacuum spectral density, while FRET is controlled by the nonlocal retarded/advanced product obGₜₑₓₜ R(bx_D,bx_A;ω_D)Im,balpha_A(ω_D)obGₜₑₓₜ A(bx_A,bx_D;ω_D). In the transparent limit rTM→ 0, the near-field FRET rate recovers the bulk x_ρ⁻⁶ law. In the Dirichlet/PEC branch rTM→ -1, the gapless transverse mode is removed and the donor-acceptor coupling acquires a Bessel-K envelope, giving an exponentially screened FRET rate ΓD→ Aproptoexp(-2π x_ρ/W) at large lateral separation. In the opposite Neumann/PMC-like branch rTM→ 1⁻, a nearly gapless transverse mode survives and produces a wide quasi-two-dimensional logarithmic propagator, enhancing the nonlocal electromagnetic coupling over a gate-programmable range xρ,*sim W/(1-rTM). For graphene-Er implementations, the same retarded Green tensor also separates dissipative on-shell Er-to-graphene decay, governed by its absorptive part, from dispersive virtual-plasmon-mediated Er-Er coupling, governed by its reactive part; a plasmonic band gap can suppress the former while retaining the latter.

articles.title: Switchable Magnetoelectric Transport in Graphene via a Van der Waals Multiferroic
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric and magnetic control of transport properties at atomic interfaces is central to the development of next generation electronics and spintronics. Van der Waals multiferroics materials that simultaneously host dielectric and magnetic orders down to the monolayer limit offer a promising platform for such interfacial control, yet the realization of electronic functionalities that exploit the unique attributes of van der Waals multiferroics has largely remained elusive. Here, we realize a van der Waals heterostructure comprising graphene and the multiferroic CuCrP2S6, enabling gate-switchable magnetoelectric transport in graphene, mediated by the multiferroic layer. The charge-neutrality resistance peak of graphene exhibits pronounced hysteresis arising from polarization flip in the multiferroic state. Application of an in-plane magnetic field shifts this peak in a polarization-dependent manner, revealing magnetic-field-induced polarization modulation a direct signature of the magnetoelectric effect. Furthermore, cooling the device under an applied electric field enables domain control of the multiferroic order, allowing reversible switching of the interfacial magnetoelectric transport. These results provide the first demonstration of interfacial magnetoelectric transport in a vdW heterostructure, and establish a pathway for engineering two-dimensional van der Waals interfaces for functional device applications.
articles.focus_summary: 论文构建了石墨烯与范德华多铁体CuCrP2S6的异质结构，实现了可由栅压切换的磁电输运响应。石墨烯电中性点电阻峰的滞后反映多铁层极化翻转，面内磁场导致与极化状态相关的峰位移动，表明存在磁电耦合和可逆畴调控。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的二维范德华多铁性、滑移铁电、磁性材料、界面电荷输运和自旋电子学方向高度相关。该工作提供了利用二维多铁层调控导电层输运的器件实例。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可跟进CuCrP2S6/石墨烯界面的极化电荷转移、磁交换近邻效应和畴壁输运，并结合第一性原理与量子输运计算分析磁电响应来源。

articles.title: Singlet-doublet transitions and Josephson currents in a superconducting ring with a quantum dot
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the ground state properties of a superconducting ring embedded with a quantum dot (QD) by using a variational wave-function approach. A theoretical formulation for the treatment of the finite-U Anderson impurity coupled with a superconducting ring are presented. We demonstrate singlet-doublet transitions of the ground state for this system with the QD in the mixed valence regime. It is shown that the supercurrent in the superconductor ring shows oscillations with the external enclosed magnetic flux and exhibits abrupt jumps at the singlet-doublet phase transition points.

articles.title: Scalar Spin Chirality from Dissipative Pumping and Lamb Shift Precession
articles.title_zh: 耗散泵浦与兰姆位移进动产生的标量自旋手征性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circulating currents in triangular triple quantum dots reverse repeatedly with bias even at zero magnetic flux and for a real Hamiltonian, a phenomenon whose origin has remained unclear. We show that dissipative tunneling prepares an orbital pseudospin, while virtual charge fluctuations generate a noncollinear Lamb field that rotates it toward the chiral direction. Bias changes their relative orientation and thereby reverses the current. This reservoir-induced orbital Hanle effect converts a nonchiral orbital polarization into scalar spin chirality, which an exact ground-multiplet identity links to the circulating current. Hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations show that the low-bias reversal survives beyond the second-order weak-coupling description, while the quadratic growth of chirality after a sudden voltage switch identifies precession. More broadly, time-reversal-odd responses can emerge in open quantum systems from the interplay between dissipative state preparation and coherent precession.
articles.abstract_zh: 三角三量子点中的环流即使在零磁通和实哈密顿量条件下，也会随偏压反复反向。研究表明，耗散隧穿制备轨道赝自旋，虚电荷涨落产生非共线兰姆场并使其向手征方向旋转；两者相对取向随偏压改变，从而导致电流反向。层级运动方程计算进一步验证了低偏压反向现象，并指出开放量子系统中的耗散态制备与相干进动可共同产生时间反演奇响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三角三量子点中的环流会随偏压反复反向，即使在零磁通和实哈密顿量条件下也是如此，而这一现象的起源此前一直不明确。我们表明，耗散隧穿制备了一种轨道赝自旋，而虚电荷涨落产生非共线的兰姆场，使该赝自旋朝向手征方向旋转。偏压改变这两者的相对取向，进而使电流反向。这种由库诱导的轨道汉勒效应将非手征的轨道极化转换为标量自旋手征性，而一个精确的基态多重态恒等式将后者与环流联系起来。层级运动方程计算显示，低偏压反向在超出二阶弱耦合描述后仍然存在；而突然切换电压后手征性的二次增长则表明存在进动。更广泛地说，开放量子系统中的时间反演奇响应能够源于耗散态制备与相干进动之间的相互作用。

articles.title: Pseudospin Dynamics of Charge Order
articles.title_zh: 电荷有序的赝自旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge order is conventionally viewed as a static modulation of the electronic density, despite growing experimental capabilities to probe and manipulate its nonequilibrium evolution. In contrast to spin-ordered systems, a microscopic framework for charge-order dynamics and its control under external driving remains largely underdeveloped. Here, starting from an extended Hubbard model, we derive an effective pseudospin model in which the charge-ordered state maps onto staggered pseudospin order. The resulting charge-order dynamics is governed by Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert-like equations for the pseudospins, closely analogous to those of a bipartite antiferromagnet. We show that an external electric field directly controls the staggered pseudospin order and, above a threshold field, drives coherent reversal of the charge-order polarity by destabilizing collective pseudospin excitations. Our results establish the charge pseudospin as a microscopic dynamical degree of freedom for coherent switching and control of charge order, providing a charge-sector analogue of the well-established framework for spin-order dynamics in spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 电荷有序通常被视为静态电子密度调制，其非平衡动力学及外场调控的微观理论仍不完善。该研究从扩展 Hubbard 模型出发，将电荷有序映射为交错赝自旋序，并导出类似双亚晶格反铁磁体的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 型动力学方程。外加电场可直接调控该序参量，并在超过阈值后通过失稳集体赝自旋激发实现电荷有序极性的相干翻转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管实验上探测和操控电荷有序非平衡演化的能力不断提高，电荷有序通常仍被视为电子密度的静态调制。与自旋有序体系相比，关于电荷有序动力学及其在外部驱动下调控的微观框架仍很不完善。这里，我们从一个扩展 Hubbard 模型出发，导出了一个有效赝自旋模型，其中电荷有序态映射为交错赝自旋有序。由此产生的电荷有序动力学由赝自旋的类 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程控制，与双亚晶格反铁磁体的动力学密切类似。我们表明，外加电场能够直接控制交错赝自旋序，并且在超过阈值场强后，通过使集体赝自旋激发失稳而驱动电荷有序极性的相干翻转。我们的结果确立了电荷赝自旋作为相干切换和控制电荷有序的微观动力学自由度，为自旋电子学中已充分建立的自旋有序动力学框架提供了电荷部门的对应物。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作从扩展Hubbard模型推导有效赝自旋模型，将电荷有序态映射为交错赝自旋序。所得动力学方程类似双亚晶格反铁磁体的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程，并预测外加电场可通过集体赝自旋激发实现电荷序极性的相干翻转。
articles.focus_relation: 该研究与团队的有效哈密顿量、自旋哈密顿量、自旋动力学、磁电耦合和电场驱动序参量翻转密切相关。虽然对象是电荷序而非传统磁序，但其赝自旋映射为研究电荷-自旋-晶格耦合及非平衡调控提供了可借鉴模型。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议核查有效模型参数与真实材料可观测量之间的对应关系，并关注阻尼和外场阈值的微观来源。可探索将该赝自旋动力学与第一性原理参数化、声子耦合或电荷密度波材料相结合。

articles.title: Coupling of two individual magnon resonators via a superconducting microwave resonator operating in the strong coupling regime
articles.title_zh: 通过强耦合超导微波谐振器耦合两个独立磁振子谐振器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate coherent coupling of ferromagnetic resonance in two individual permalloy stripes via a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator. The two stripes are placed on top of the resonator with an angle of 50cⁱrc between their respective long axes. This alignment enables us to separately tune their ferromagnetic resonance frequency by exploiting their shape anisotropy by simply rotating the external bias magnetic field in the sample plane. Both individual ferromagnets exhibit strong coupling with the microwave resonator. This method avoids the use of local individual bias coils and facilitates the integration of similar experiments into planar device infrastructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究演示了利用超导共面波导谐振器，实现两条独立坡莫合金条带的铁磁共振之间的相干耦合。两条带的长轴夹角为50度，可通过在样品平面内旋转外加偏置磁场，借助形状各向异性分别调谐其共振频率。两个铁磁体均与微波谐振器处于强耦合状态，该方案无需局域独立偏置线圈，便于集成至平面器件结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们演示了通过超导共面波导谐振器，实现两条独立坡莫合金条带中铁磁共振之间的相干耦合。两条条带放置在谐振器上方，其各自长轴之间的夹角为50度。这种对准方式使我们能够仅通过在样品平面内旋转外加偏置磁场，并利用其形状各向异性，分别调谐它们的铁磁共振频率。两个独立铁磁体都与微波谐振器表现出强耦合。该方法避免使用局域的独立偏置线圈，并有利于将类似实验集成到平面器件基础设施中。

articles.title: Viscoelastic interfacial structures in undersaturated calcium solutions under nanoconfinement
articles.title_zh: 纳米限域下未饱和钙溶液中的黏弹性界面结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Calcium mineralisation underpins processes ranging from biomineralisation to scalable carbon storage, yet the earliest stages of nucleation remain unresolved. Here we investigate calcium-containing solutions under nanoscopic confinement while remaining undersaturated with respect to bulk calcium carbonate precipitation. Using sensitive surface force measurements, we identify a long-range non-DLVO repulsive interaction specific to calcium solutions, which we attribute to hydrated ion networks at mineral interfaces. These interfacial networks exhibit viscoelastic behaviour distinct from the bulk solution, persist across a broad pH range, and can be disrupted by competing ions with strong surface affinity. Our findings provide experimental evidence that stable hydrated ion networks can emerge at mineral interfaces under undersaturated conditions, supporting the possibility that interfaces and confinement stabilise intermediate ion assemblies prior to nucleation. These results bridge classical and nonclassical descriptions of mineral nucleation and highlight the central role of interfaces and confinement in directing crystallisation pathways.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙矿化的早期成核过程尚未完全阐明。研究利用高灵敏度表面力测量发现：在相对于体相碳酸钙沉淀仍未饱和的纳米限域钙溶液中，存在钙溶液特有的长程非 DLVO 排斥作用，归因于矿物界面的水合离子网络。该网络具有不同于体相溶液的黏弹性，可在宽 pH 范围内存在，并可被强表面亲和性竞争离子破坏。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钙矿化支撑着从生物矿化到可规模化碳储存的诸多过程，但成核最早期阶段仍未得到解析。这里，我们研究了纳米尺度限域下的含钙溶液，同时保持其相对于体相碳酸钙沉淀处于未饱和状态。利用灵敏的表面力测量，我们识别出一种钙溶液特有的长程非 DLVO 排斥相互作用，并将其归因于矿物界面处的水合离子网络。这些界面网络表现出不同于体相溶液的黏弹性行为，在宽广的 pH 范围内持续存在，并可被对表面具有强亲和力的竞争离子破坏。我们的发现提供了实验证据，表明在未饱和条件下，稳定的水合离子网络能够在矿物界面出现，支持界面和限域可在成核前稳定中间离子组装体的可能性。这些结果连接了矿物成核的经典与非经典描述，并突出了界面和限域在引导结晶路径中的核心作用。

articles.title: Dynamics of a nanoscale ferromagnetic vortex
articles.title_zh: 纳米尺度铁磁涡旋的动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a ferromagnetic vortex stabilized by the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (iDMI) and investigate its properties through theoretical analysis and micromagnetic simulations. Our results demonstrate that this vortex can remain stable even in nanoscale ferromagnetic disks with radii below 5,nm---far smaller than those of conventional nanodot vortices having about 1,mum radius. We analytically solve the nonlinear equation of motion describing the anharmonic vortex oscillation, and identify the critical frequency that determines the stability of the driven oscillation of the vortex. This nanoscale vortex exhibits conventional properties of microscale vortices, including gyrotropic oscillation and resonance frequency shift under an out-of-plane magnetic field. It also exhibits unconventional behaviors, such as a strongly anharmonic potential, nonlinear oscillations, and a Duffing-oscillator-like response under the external AC bias.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出了一种由界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用稳定的铁磁涡旋，并结合理论分析与微磁模拟考察其性质。该涡旋在半径小于5 nm的铁磁圆盘中仍可稳定存在，尺寸远小于传统纳米点涡旋。研究还解析了其非谐振荡动力学，确定了受驱振荡稳定性的临界频率，并揭示其具有强非谐势、非线性振荡和类似 Duffing 振子的响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种由界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用（iDMI）稳定的铁磁涡旋，并通过理论分析和微磁模拟研究其性质。我们的结果表明，这种涡旋即使在半径小于5 nm的纳米尺度铁磁圆盘中也能保持稳定，远小于半径约为1微米的传统纳米点涡旋。我们解析求解了描述非谐涡旋振荡的非线性运动方程，并确定了决定涡旋受驱振荡稳定性的临界频率。该纳米尺度涡旋表现出微米尺度涡旋的常规性质，包括回旋振荡以及面外磁场下的共振频率移动。它还表现出非常规行为，例如强非谐势、非线性振荡，以及在外加交流偏置下类似 Duffing 振子的响应。

articles.title: Chemically Resolved Topological Coordinates Link Structural Dynamics and Configurational Thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 化学分辨拓扑坐标连接结构动力学与构型热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic coordinates specify a structure, but they do not reveal how chemical connectivity across several length scales relates to atomic motion and configurational energy ordering. We formulate chemically directed persistent homology at four resolutions---complete networks, individual sites, spatial fields, and substitutional arrangements---while retaining the chemical identity and length scale of each connectivity feature. In ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectories of δ- and γ-CsPbI₃ at five temperatures spanning 500--700 K, the corner-sharing γ network has a lower Pb--I restoring stiffness and permits larger iodide excursions, yet iodide positional correlations decay 2.27 times more slowly and Pb-network topology retains memory 1.63 times longer than in the edge-sharing δ phase. Local softness and loss of network memory are therefore distinct. At individual sites, rare γ-phase Pb environments with a δ-like Cs-cage connectivity precede 0.17 mathringA greater Pb displacement over the subsequent 0.5 ps. The same Pb-network coordinate resolves disruption of corner-sharing connectivity across a 2560-atom δ|γ boundary. In substituted CsPbI₃, compact dopant arrangements undergo greater cooperative host relaxation and lie lower in density-functional-theory (DFT) energy than dispersed arrangements of the same composition. SchNet and Allegro model families with comparable energy errors encode opposite ordering along this coordinate, and 61 of 247 supplied models with errors below 1 meV atom⁻¹ on separate test structures reverse the DFT relation. Because relative configurational energies set Boltzmann populations, chemical network topology links structure to physical response and tests whether learned energy models preserve DFT configurational ordering even when their average errors are small.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子坐标能够描述结构，却难以揭示多尺度化学连通性与原子运动及构型能量排序的关系。研究提出四种分辨率下的化学定向持续同调方法，并将其应用于 CsPbI₃ 的从头算分子动力学、相界面和掺杂构型分析。结果显示，化学网络拓扑既可预测局部结构动力学，也可检验机器学习能量模型是否保留 DFT 所给出的构型相对能量排序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子坐标规定了一种结构，但并未揭示跨越多个长度尺度的化学连通性如何与原子运动和构型能量排序相关。我们在四种分辨率下构建了化学定向持续同调：完整网络、单个位点、空间场以及取代构型，同时保留每个连通性特征的化学身份和长度尺度。在覆盖500至700 K五个温度的δ相和γ相 CsPbI₃ 从头算分子动力学轨迹中，角共享的γ相网络具有更低的 Pb-I 回复刚度，并允许更大的碘离子位移；然而，与边共享的δ相相比，碘离子的位置相关性衰减慢2.27倍，Pb网络拓扑保留记忆的时间长1.63倍。因此，局域软化与网络记忆丧失是不同的概念。在单个位点层面，具有δ相类 Cs 笼连通性的罕见γ相 Pb环境，会在随后0.5 ps内先于大0.17埃的 Pb 位移出现。同一 Pb 网络坐标还解析了一个2560原子δ|γ边界处角共享连通性的破坏。在掺杂的 CsPbI₃ 中，紧凑的掺杂原子排列经历更强的协同宿主晶格弛豫，并且相较于相同组分的分散排列具有更低的密度泛函理论（DFT）能量。具有相当能量误差的 SchNet 和 Allegro 模型家族沿该坐标编码出相反的排序；在247个所提供模型中，61个模型虽然在独立测试结构上的误差低于每原子1 meV，却颠倒了 DFT 关系。由于相对构型能量决定玻尔兹曼布居，化学网络拓扑将结构与物理响应连接起来，并检验学习型能量模型即使在平均误差很小时，是否仍保留 DFT 的构型排序。

articles.title: Moiré-induced lattice reconstruction at buried atomic interfaces
articles.title_zh: 莫尔诱导的埋藏原子界面晶格重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic reconstruction at twisted two-dimensional interfaces governs many of their emergent optical, electronic, and mechanical properties, including sliding ferroelectricity. Despite recent progress in understanding lattice reconstruction in suspended twisted bilayers, structural changes at van der Waals heterointerfaces between multilayer crystals remain largely unexplored. Here we use multi-slice electron ptychography to non-invasively recover the three-dimensional atomic structure at marginally twisted rhombohedral interfaces between thick transition-metal dichalcogenide crystals. With a position precision of ~3 pm and a depth resolution ~1 nm, we resolve the twist-induced lattice reconstruction field per layer, and the resulting dislocation network at the buried interface. Despite the bulk nature, we observe markedly strong in-plane interfacial reconstruction due to suppression of the out-of-plane bending by outer layers, exceeding predictions from our three-dimensional modelling. Furthermore, we extract the strain tensor evolution during the decay of the reconstruction into the bulk, providing a structural foundation for understanding multi-layer moiré systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 扭转二维界面的原子重构决定其多种新兴光学、电子与力学性质，但厚多层晶体间范德华异质界面的结构变化仍少有研究。该工作采用多切片电子叠层衍射成像，非侵入式恢复了厚过渡金属二硫族化物晶体间微小扭转菱方界面的三维原子结构。研究分辨出逐层重构场和埋藏界面的位错网络，并发现因外层抑制面外弯曲而产生显著强于三维模型预测的面内界面重构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 扭转二维界面处的原子重构控制着其许多新兴的光学、电子和力学性质，其中包括滑移铁电性。尽管近期在理解悬空扭转双层中的晶格重构方面取得了进展，多层晶体之间范德华异质界面处的结构变化仍在很大程度上未被探索。这里，我们利用多切片电子叠层衍射成像，以非侵入方式恢复了厚过渡金属二硫族化物晶体之间轻微扭转菱方界面的三维原子结构。凭借约3 pm的位置精度和约1 nm的深度分辨率，我们分辨了逐层的扭转诱导晶格重构场，以及埋藏界面处由此形成的位错网络。尽管体系具有体相性质，我们仍观察到显著强烈的面内界面重构，这是由于外层抑制了面外弯曲，其强度超过了我们的三维建模预测。此外，我们提取了重构向体相衰减过程中的应变张量演化，为理解多层莫尔体系提供了结构基础。
articles.focus_summary: 论文利用多切片电子叠层成像重建厚层过渡金属硫族化物中弱扭转菱方界面的三维原子结构，解析了界面位错网络和逐层衰减的重构应变场。结果显示，外层对面外弯曲的抑制会增强埋藏界面的面内重构，其强度超过已有三维模型预测。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的莫尔材料、二维范德华体系、层间耦合、应变工程及滑移铁电性直接相关。该实验结构信息可为研究扭转界面中的极化、电子结构和畴结构提供可靠输入。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议关注重构场与局域堆垛、滑移铁电势能面及界面电荷分布的对应关系，并用机器学习势或第一性原理计算建立可扩展的原子尺度模型。

articles.title: Heterogeneous ferroelectricity and conductivity of oxidized BaTiO₃ crystals: the role of nanoscale phase segregation in the surface region
articles.title_zh: 氧化 BaTiO₃ 晶体的非均匀铁电性与导电性：表面区域纳米尺度相偏析的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the effect of thermal oxidation on BaTiO₃ single crystals. Our results reveal that, even at moderate temperatures of up to 1000 degC, complex segregation mechanisms occur involving the movement of Ba-rich compounds to the upper surface, where they form inhomogeneously distributed BaO nanocrystals. As a result, deeper regions of the surface layer become depleted in Ba and become TiO₂-rich. A sandwich-like structure evolves in the surface layer, exhibiting a measurable electromotive force and self-polarization. This, in turn, screens the polarization and diminishes the global ferroelectric response. The conductivity is also strongly influenced by the irreversible segregation effects in the surface region. An as-received crystal can be transformed into a metallic state, while oxidation induces semiconducting properties and prevents a return to the metallic state upon subsequent reduction. Nanoscale analysis demonstrates that the conductivity is channeled to filaments forming along dislocations, whose local chemical composition changes upon reduction and oxidation even at moderate temperatures due to preferential Ba and O pipe diffusion thus determining the electric behavior of the whole sample.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究考察热氧化对 BaTiO₃ 单晶的影响，发现即使温度不超过1000摄氏度，也会发生复杂偏析：富钡化合物迁移至上表面并形成分布不均的 BaO 纳米晶，而更深的表层区域则贫钡、富 TiO₂。表层由此形成具有电动势和自极化的夹层结构，屏蔽极化并削弱整体铁电响应。不可逆偏析还显著改变导电性，并使导电通道集中于沿位错形成、成分受还原和氧化影响的细丝。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了热氧化对 BaTiO₃ 单晶的影响。结果表明，即使在不超过1000摄氏度的中等温度下，也会发生复杂的偏析机制，涉及富钡化合物向上表面迁移，并在那里形成非均匀分布的 BaO 纳米晶。结果，表层中更深的区域会耗尽 Ba 并变得富含 TiO₂。表面层中演化出一种夹层状结构，表现出可测量的电动势和自极化。这反过来会屏蔽极化并减弱整体铁电响应。导电性也受到表面区域不可逆偏析效应的强烈影响。原始接收的晶体可转变为金属态，而氧化会诱导半导体性质，并阻止其在后续还原时返回金属态。纳米尺度分析表明，导电性被限制在沿位错形成的细丝中；由于 Ba 和 O 的优先管道扩散，即使在中等温度下，这些细丝的局部化学成分也会随还原和氧化而改变，从而决定整个样品的电学行为。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作研究热氧化对BaTiO3单晶表面结构、电学输运和铁电响应的影响。氧化诱导Ba富集相向表面迁移并形成BaO纳米晶，同时近表层转变为TiO2富集区，形成具有自极化和电动势的夹层结构，进而屏蔽极化并显著改变导电性；位错处的成分变化导致丝状导电通道。
articles.focus_relation: 该研究与团队的铁电体、缺陷物理、畴壁与缺陷诱导极化翻转、氧化物功能材料方向高度相关。其表面相分离、位错导电和氧空位相关化学重构问题，可与第一性原理缺陷计算及机器学习分子动力学直接衔接。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可建立BaTiO3表面、位错和Ba/O非化学计量缺陷的第一性原理模型，计算局域极化、形成能和输运势垒。进一步可结合机器学习势模拟氧化还原过程中的元素偏析及导电细丝演化。

articles.title: Machine learning reveals common features of unconventional superconductors with high transition temperatures
articles.title_zh: 机器学习揭示高临界温度非常规超导体的共同特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30588v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductors with high critical temperatures that emerges beyond the phonon-mediated regime are usually considered unconventional in nature, yet unlike conventional superconductors, no broadly applicable predictive theory currently guides their discovery. Here, we use interpretable machine learning to uncover a common materials-space signature of high-Tc unconventional superconductors and develop a data-driven strategy for materials discovery. We construct a unified feature representation for each material by integrating compositional statistics, structural information, and latent representations from trained property-prediction models, followed by structure-aware filtering of an experimentally established superconducting dataset. Without using transition-temperature information, unsupervised analysis shows that cuprate and iron-based superconductors occupy a common region of materials space, characterized primarily by large electronegativity deviation and intermediate mean valence-electron number. A supervised Tc model independently identifies the same descriptors as dominant features, providing complementary evidence for their relevance. Using this empirical materials-space prior together with the Tc model, we prioritize candidate materials, recover recently discovered nickelate superconductors, and identify chemically distinct candidates for future investigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 声子介导机制之外的高临界温度超导体通常被视为非常规超导体，但其发现尚缺乏普适预测理论。研究采用可解释机器学习整合成分、结构与性质预测模型的潜在表征，在不使用转变温度信息的条件下发现铜氧化物和铁基超导体位于共同材料空间区域。该区域主要具有较大的电负性偏差与中等平均价电子数，并被监督式 Tc 模型独立支持，可用于筛选候选材料。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超出声子介导机制的高临界温度超导体通常被认为本质上属于非常规超导体；然而，与常规超导体不同，目前尚无广泛适用的预测理论指导其发现。这里，我们使用可解释机器学习揭示高 Tc 非常规超导体的一种共同材料空间特征，并开发了一种数据驱动的材料发现策略。我们通过整合成分统计、结构信息以及训练后的性质预测模型的潜在表征，为每种材料构建统一特征表示，随后对实验确立的超导数据集进行结构感知筛选。在不使用转变温度信息的情况下，无监督分析显示，铜氧化物和铁基超导体占据材料空间中的共同区域，该区域主要以较大的电负性偏差和中等的平均价电子数为特征。一个监督式 Tc 模型独立地识别出相同描述符为主导特征，为其相关性提供了互补证据。利用这一经验材料空间先验与 Tc 模型，我们对候选材料进行优先排序，找回了近期发现的镍酸盐超导体，并识别出有待未来研究的化学上不同的候选材料。

articles.title: Quadratic pair-breaking absorption edge from Anderson localization in a superconducting wire
articles.title_zh: 超导线中安德森局域化导致的二次破对吸收边
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that Anderson localization fundamentally reshapes dissipative superconducting electrodynamics, replacing the linear Mattis--Bardeen pair-breaking onset with a parametrically weaker quadratic Mott edge while leaving the quasiparticle spectrum unchanged. We derive this behavior for a weakly disordered single-channel wire with a spatially uniform s-wave pair potential using a Nambu-space extension of the Berezinskii diagram technique that resums elastic impurity scattering to all orders. Conservation of the Bogoliubov branch collapses the Nambu diagram hierarchy onto an exactly solvable localization problem. The localization length remains equal to its normal-state value, whereas the localization time diverges at the gap edge. The new absorption edge results from the product of the superconducting pair-creation coherence factor and the Mott-suppressed current matrix elements between localized orbitals, which generates the characteristic double logarithm. Localization also reduces the Hebel--Slichter coherence peak. The resulting theory provides an all-orders benchmark for microwave and spin-relaxation experiments on localized superconducting nanowires.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究表明，安德森局域化会根本改变耗散性超导电动力学：在不改变准粒子谱的情况下，将线性的 Mattis-Bardeen 破对吸收起始替换为参数上更弱的二次 Mott 吸收边。作者利用 Nambu 空间中的 Berezinskii 图技术推广，对弱无序单通道超导线进行全阶弹性杂质散射求和。局域化还会削弱 Hebel-Slichter 相干峰，该理论可作为局域化超导纳米线微波与自旋弛豫实验的基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，安德森局域化从根本上重塑了耗散性超导电动力学：在保持准粒子谱不变的同时，它将线性的 Mattis-Bardeen 破对起始替换为参数上更弱的二次 Mott 吸收边。我们针对具有空间均匀 s 波配对势的弱无序单通道导线，利用 Berezinskii 图技术在 Nambu 空间中的推广推导出这一行为；该方法将弹性杂质散射重求和至所有阶次。玻戈留波夫分支的守恒使 Nambu 图层级坍缩为一个可精确求解的局域化问题。局域化长度保持等于其正常态数值，而局域化时间则在能隙边缘发散。新的吸收边源自超导对产生相干因子与局域轨道之间受 Mott 抑制的电流矩阵元的乘积，从而产生特征性的双对数形式。局域化还会降低 Hebel-Slichter 相干峰。所得理论为局域化超导纳米线的微波和自旋弛豫实验提供了一个全阶基准。

articles.title: Layer Axial Phonons and Dipolar Thermal Response in Centrosymmetric Thin Films
articles.title_zh: 中心对称薄膜中的层轴向声子与偶极热响应
