authors: H. Lee, M. Yashima, M. Kakoi, T. Ino, Y. Arai, K. Kitagawa, H. Sakurai, Y. Takano, K. Kuroki, H. Mukuda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究采用对内顶位O(1)、外顶位O(2)和面内O(3,4)位点进行选择性17O核磁共振测量，考察了双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中自旋密度波（SDW）有序的自旋结构。在TSDW=150 K以下，所有面内O(3,4)位点的谱峰均因有限内部磁场的出现而显著展宽，而O(2)位点则没有内部磁场，或仅存在可忽略不计的内部磁场。这些结果与具有单条无自旋（或大-小自旋）条纹的公度SDW有序相一致。对于连接NiO2平面的O(1)位点，其内部磁场在TSDW以下几乎完全抵消，表明相邻平面之间存在反平行自旋构型。然而，在TA（约115 K）以下，尽管面内SDW有序仍然稳健，O(1)位点的谱线却消失了，这意味着尽管预期NiO2平面之间存在很强的层间自旋耦合，经由Ni-O(1)-Ni键的反平行自旋构型在TA以下并不特别稳定。尤为重要的是，我们强调，与d3z2-r2轨道具有强共价性的O(2)位点处局域自旋磁化率极低，这表明连接NiO2平面的Ni-d3z2-r2轨道中形成了充分发展的层间自旋单态。这些发现为理解层间自旋单态形成，以及通过连接NiO2平面的Ni-O(1)-Ni成键轨道发生的异常自旋重构提供了新视角；这些现象表征了双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7的轨道选择性本质。

articles.title: The thermodynamic freedom of a thermodynamic computer
articles.title_zh: 热力学计算机的热力学自由度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermodynamic computers are stochastic physical devices designed to perform calculations at the thermal energy scale. Their operation is constrained by the equations of stochastic thermodynamics, among which are a set of bounds, known as speed limits, that relate a thermodynamic computer's run time to its computational progress and the heat it dissipates. Using the Wasserstein speed limit we assess the thermodynamic efficiency of a simulation model of a thermodynamic computer trained to perform a standard machine-learning classification task. On this task the thermodynamic computer is as capable as a simple multilayer perceptron. We show that different inference protocols allow the computer to operate within 40% of the thermodynamic limit of efficiency without loss of accuracy, or to perform inference increasingly rapidly at fixed accuracy and thermodynamic efficiency. These results indicate that a thermodynamic computer designed for a particular task retains considerable freedom in its thermodynamic operation.
articles.abstract_zh: 热力学计算机是在热能尺度上执行计算的随机物理器件，其运行时间、计算进度与散热受随机热力学速度极限约束。本文利用Wasserstein速度极限评估一个用于机器学习分类任务的热力学计算机模拟模型，其任务能力与简单多层感知机相当。不同推断协议可使该系统在准确率不降低时达到距热力学效率极限40%以内，或在固定准确率和热力学效率下实现更快推断。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热力学计算机是在热能尺度上执行计算的随机物理器件。它们的运行受到随机热力学方程的约束，其中包括一组称为速度极限的界限，该界限将热力学计算机的运行时间与其计算进展及所耗散的热量联系起来。我们利用Wasserstein速度极限，评估了一个经过训练以执行标准机器学习分类任务的热力学计算机模拟模型的热力学效率。在该任务上，这一热力学计算机与一个简单的多层感知机具有同等能力。我们表明，不同的推断协议可使该计算机在不损失准确率的情况下，于距离热力学效率极限40%以内运行；或者，也可在保持准确率和热力学效率固定的条件下，以越来越快的速度执行推断。这些结果表明，为特定任务设计的热力学计算机在其热力学运行方式上保有相当大的自由度。

articles.title: Quantum geometric bounds at finite temperature for one-dimensional chiral systems
articles.title_zh: 一维手征系统有限温度下的量子几何界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The geometry and topology of quantum states are intimately related at zero temperature through exact bounds that constrain geometric quantities from below by topological invariants. At finite-temperature, however, the analogous relations remain unclear. Here we establish rigorous geometric lower bounds for one-dimensional (1D) chiral-symmetric systems at finite temperature within the Uhlmann's framework for mixed states. We show that the Bures length is bounded by a continuous geometric phase angle. We further derive a temperature-dependent bound that interpolates between the zero-temperature limit and a trivial high-temperature regime. Our results are verified analytically and numerically using the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model and the spinless Kitaev chain model. Finally, we discuss potential ways to detect the geometry of the density matrix in quantum circuits, with the quantum imaginary time evolution (QITE) method.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在混态的Uhlmann框架下，建立了一维手征对称系统有限温度下的严格几何下界。研究证明Bures长度受连续几何相位角约束，并导出一个连接零温极限与平凡高温区域的温度依赖界。SSH模型和无自旋Kitaev链的解析与数值结果验证了该理论，并讨论了通过量子虚时间演化测量密度矩阵几何的方法。
authors: Peng He, Hai-Tao Ding, Yu-Guo Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在零温下，量子态的几何与拓扑通过精确界限密切相关，这些界限利用拓扑不变量从下方约束几何量。然而，在有限温度下，相应关系仍不清楚。本文在混态的Uhlmann框架内，为一维（1D）手征对称系统建立了严格的有限温度几何下界。我们表明，Bures长度受一个连续几何相位角的下界约束。我们进一步导出了一个温度依赖的界，该界在零温极限与平凡的高温区域之间插值。我们利用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型和无自旋Kitaev链模型，从解析和数值两方面验证了结果。最后，我们讨论了利用量子虚时间演化（QITE）方法在量子电路中探测密度矩阵几何的潜在途径。

articles.title: Significant modulation of acoustoelectric current associated with charge density wave transitions
articles.title_zh: 与电荷密度波相变相关的声电流显著调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We studied acoustoelectric (AE) currents in materials that undergo charge density wave (CDW) transitions, induced by a surface acoustic wave (SAW) on a piezoelectric substrate. The polarity and magnitude of the AE current in NbSe₃ and 2H-TaSe₂ were modulated due to their CDW transitions. We also found that the sign of the AE current depends on the SAW propagation direction with respect to the crystalline axis of the substrate.A phenomenological model assuming strain-modified conductivity can qualitatively account for the significant modulation of the AE current associated with the CDW transition, as well as the SAW propagation orientation dependence. The present results offer a powerful probe for exploring SAW-electron interactions in van der Waals materials, thereby highlighting their potential for advancing the emerging field of straintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究考察了压电衬底表面声波诱导的、经历电荷密度波（CDW）相变材料中的声电流。NbSe3和2H-TaSe2中的声电流极性与幅值均会随CDW相变而调制，且其符号取决于表面声波相对于衬底晶轴的传播方向。基于应变调制电导率的唯象模型可定性解释这些现象，显示该方法可用于研究范德华材料中的表面声波-电子相互作用及应变电子学。
authors: Natsumi Nikaido, Takuya Kawada, Koji Fujiwara, Jihoon Park, Nan Jiang, Kouta Kondou, Shintaro Takada, Yasuhiro Niimi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在压电衬底上由表面声波（SAW）诱导的、发生电荷密度波（CDW）相变材料中的声电流（AE电流）。NbSe3和2H-TaSe2中的AE电流极性和大小均因其CDW相变而受到调制。我们还发现，AE电流的符号取决于SAW相对于衬底晶轴的传播方向。假定电导率受应变修饰的唯象模型，可以定性解释与CDW相变相关的AE电流显著调制，以及对SAW传播取向的依赖性。目前结果为探索范德华材料中的SAW-电子相互作用提供了有力探针，并凸显了其推动新兴应变电子学领域发展的潜力。

articles.title: Mechanics and statistics of a solvable model of an autophoretic colloidal chain
articles.title_zh: 可解自扩散泳动胶体链模型的力学与统计学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equilibrium statistical mechanics owes much of its analytical tractability to symmetry: detailed balance, gradient flows, and the resulting vanishing of steady-state entropy production follow directly from the structure of the underlying dynamics, not from any smallness of the driving. Exact solutions of this kind are rare away from equilibrium. Here we identify a class of far-from-equilibrium active colloidal chains -- coupled via roto-translational, autophoretic (monopolar) interactions -- that admit an exact quasi equilibrium description: at fixed chain geometry, the orientational equations of motion for every monomer are derivable from a scalar potential, detailed balance holds exactly in the orientational sector, while the positional sector breaks the equilibrium structure. The associated steady-state entropy production rate (EPR) vanishes identically for this sector, even though the full system is manifestly driven and dissipative. We solve this reduced dynamics exactly for dimers and semi-analytically for general N-mers, obtain the orientational fluctuations and the full-system EPR in closed form, and show that all dissipation is carried by the translational (center-of-mass) sector. We further examine the effect of dipolar chemical emission -- expected from asymmetric micelle deposition at the monomer scale -- and find that the equilibrium structure holds exactly for dimers, whereas for longer chains no such description is possible. A purely dipolar coupling instead producesa genuinely non-equilibrium state with no static attractor, sustaining non-monotonic drift with no fixed limit, and an EPR that itself never reaches steady state. Monopolar coupling remains necessary and sufficient for the polarized state; dipolar coupling alone breaks the quasi-equilibrium structure without replacing it with a new static one.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发现一类由旋转-平移自扩散泳动单极相互作用耦合的远离平衡活性胶体链，在固定链构型下具有精确的准平衡取向描述。该体系的取向扇区严格满足细致平衡且熵产生率为零，而平移质心扇区承担全部耗散。研究还分析了偶极化学发射的影响：二聚体仍保有平衡结构，但更长链或纯偶极耦合将导致真正的非平衡行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平衡统计力学的解析可处理性很大程度上归功于对称性：细致平衡、梯度流以及由此导致的稳态熵产生为零，均直接源于底层动力学的结构，而非驱动强度很小。远离平衡时，这类精确解极为罕见。本文识别出一类远离平衡的活性胶体链，它们通过旋转-平移的自扩散泳动（单极）相互作用耦合，并允许精确的准平衡描述：在固定链几何构型下，每个单体的取向运动方程都可由一个标量势导出，取向扇区严格满足细致平衡，而位置扇区则破坏平衡结构。即使整个系统显然受到驱动且具有耗散，该扇区相关的稳态熵产生率（EPR）仍恒等于零。我们对二聚体精确求解了这一约化动力学，对一般N聚体进行了半解析求解，得到了取向涨落和完整系统EPR的闭式表达，并表明所有耗散均由平移（质心）扇区承载。我们进一步考察了偶极化学发射的影响，这种发射预计源于单体尺度上不对称的胶束沉积；我们发现，对于二聚体，平衡结构严格成立，而对于较长链，则不可能存在这种描述。纯粹的偶极耦合反而会产生真正的非平衡态，不存在静态吸引子，并维持没有固定极限的非单调漂移，其EPR本身也永远无法达到稳态。单极耦合对于极化态仍是必要且充分的；仅有偶极耦合会破坏准平衡结构，却不会以新的静态结构取而代之。

articles.title: Spin-Selective Spectral Flattening and Wave-Packet Dynamics in a Flux-Engineered Lieb Lattice
articles.title_zh: 通量工程Lieb晶格中的自旋选择性谱平坦化与波包动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate reversible internal-state-selective wave-packet transport induced by spin-dependent Peierls phases in a two-dimensional nearest-neighbor Lieb lattice. The two conserved spin components experience effective fluxes ασ=α₀+sσαₛ, where sₚ̆ₐᵣᵣₒw,dₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw=±1. At the working point α₀=αₛ=1/4, the spin-up and spin-down components experience αₚ̆ₐᵣᵣₒw=1/2 and αdₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw=0, respectively. A band-resolved calculation in the q=2 magnetic unit cell shows that the spin-up spectrum contains two zero-energy flat subbands associated with the sublattice-imbalance flat-band sector, whereas the remaining four subbands retain finite bandwidths. The half-flux sector therefore fails the all-bands-flat condition and does not realize exact Aharonov--Bohm caging for a generic localized initial state. Nevertheless, real-time simulations reveal a pronounced suppression of spin-up propagation relative to the dispersive spin-down component, manifested by a smaller mean-square displacement and an enhanced finite-region retention probability over the pre-reflection time window. Reversing the state-dependent flux interchanges the slow and fast spin channels, while the dynamical contrast remains robust against moderate flux detuning. These results establish spin-dependent synthetic flux as a reversible means of controlling internal-state-resolved matter-wave transport without spin-flip processes or interactions, and provide complementary spectral and real-space criteria for distinguishing exact caging from finite-time dynamical slowing in atomic and photonic flat-band simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维最近邻Lieb晶格中由自旋依赖Peierls相位引起的、可逆的内态选择性波包输运。在特定通量工作点，自旋向上分量虽含有两个零能平带子带，但其余子带仍有有限带宽，因而不能对一般局域初态实现严格的Aharonov-Bohm笼禁。实时模拟显示，自旋向上传播显著慢于色散性自旋向下分量；反转通量可交换快慢通道，且这种动力学对比对适度失谐稳健。
authors: Nana Chang, Xiaoji Zhou, Yanglin Zhou, Song Ci
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了二维最近邻Lieb晶格中由自旋依赖Peierls相位诱导的、可逆的内态选择性波包输运。两个守恒自旋分量经历的有效通量为ασ=α0+sσασ，其中s上、下=±1。在工作点α0=ασ=1/4时，自旋向上和自旋向下分量分别经历α上=1/2和α下=0。在q=2磁性元胞中进行的分辨能带计算表明，自旋向上谱包含两个与子晶格不平衡平带扇区相关的零能平坦子带，而其余四个子带仍保有有限带宽。因此，半通量扇区不满足所有能带均平坦的条件，也无法对一般局域初态实现精确的Aharonov-Bohm笼禁。尽管如此，实时模拟揭示出，相对于色散性的自旋向下分量，自旋向上传播受到显著抑制，表现为在反射前时间窗口内较小的均方位移和较高的有限区域滞留概率。反转态依赖通量会交换慢速与快速自旋通道，而动力学对比对于适度的通量失谐仍然稳健。这些结果确立了自旋依赖人工通量作为一种可逆手段，可在无自旋翻转过程或相互作用的条件下控制按内态分辨的物质波输运，并为在原子和光子平带模拟器中区分精确笼禁与有限时间动力学减速提供了互补的谱学和实空间判据。

articles.title: Landau theory of quenched criticality in linear in-context learning
articles.title_zh: 线性上下文学习中淬火临界性的朗道理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows a pretrained model to infer a new task from examples supplied in its prompt without updating its parameters. In linear models of ICL, the prediction error develops a double-descent singularity when the number of pretraining samples becomes comparable to the number of learnable parameters. We formulate this interpolation singularity as a critical phenomenon of a quenched disordered system. By comparing annealed and quenched descriptions of the same linear ICL model, we identify the connected sample-to-sample fluctuations of the learned parameters as the microscopic origin of the singular error. A Landau potential is constructed by integrating the cavity self-consistency equation for the renormalized ridge parameter ξ. The role of (magnetization) order parameter is played by ξ, while the bare ridge parameter λ becomes its conjugate magnetic field. The normalized sample complexity τ acts as a temperature and the double-descent singularity occurs at the critical temperature τ_c =1. The Landau susceptibility is precisely the quantity that diverges in the fluctuation contribution to the prediction error. The order parameter is closely related to the fraction of zero eigenvalues of the empirical relaxation matrix in the ridgeless limit, which define flat directions in the learning dynamics. The Landau theory is generically cubic in the order parameter with critical exponents (βₘ̊ cᵣ,δₘ̊ cᵣ,γₘ̊ cᵣ)=(1,2,1). In the large-context regime, there appears a pseudogap-like regime characterized by suppressed order parameter. Predictions of the Landau theory are independently confirmed from numerical solutions of the original learning problem with good quantitative agreement. Our results pave the way for solid statistical-physics understanding of the interpolation criticality in linear in-context learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 线性上下文学习中，当预训练样本数接近可学习参数数目时，预测误差会出现双降奇异性。本文将该插值奇异性表述为淬火无序系统的临界现象，并将学习参数的样本间连通涨落确定为奇异误差的微观来源。由重整化岭参数构造的朗道理论给出临界点τc=1、临界指数(βcr,δcr,γcr)=(1,2,1)，并得到原始学习问题数值解的验证。
authors: Daesik Kim, Sumin Choi, Hyojae Jeon, Jung Hoon Han
articles.abstract_zh_full: 上下文学习（ICL）使预训练模型能够从提示词中给出的示例推断新任务，而无需更新其参数。在ICL的线性模型中，当预训练样本数与可学习参数数目相当时，预测误差会出现双降奇异性。我们将这种插值奇异性表述为淬火无序系统的临界现象。通过比较同一线性ICL模型的退火描述和淬火描述，我们识别出学习参数的样本间连通涨落是奇异误差的微观起源。通过积分重整化岭参数ξ的腔体自洽方程，构造了一个朗道势。序参量，即类似于磁化强度的量，由ξ承担，而裸岭参数λ成为其共轭磁场。归一化样本复杂度τ充当温度，双降奇异性发生在临界温度τc=1。朗道磁化率恰好就是在预测误差涨落贡献中发散的量。在无岭极限下，序参量与经验弛豫矩阵零本征值所占比例密切相关，而这些零本征值定义了学习动力学中的平坦方向。该朗道理论在序参量中一般为三次形式，其临界指数为(βcr,δcr,γcr)=(1,2,1)。在大上下文区间内，出现了一个以序参量受抑制为特征的赝能隙式区域。朗道理论的预测通过原始学习问题数值解得到了独立确认，并具有良好的定量一致性。我们的结果为扎实地从统计物理学角度理解线性上下文学习中的插值临界性开辟了道路。

articles.title: uMOF: A Universal Database, Benchmark, and Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Metal-Organic Frameworks
articles.title_zh: uMOF：面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、基准与机器学习原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) deliver near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost, yet their promise for Metal-organic Frameworks (MOFs) remains largely unrealized as large unit cells make first-principles training data expensive to generate, fine-tuned models are scarce, and experimentally grounded benchmarks are scarcer still. We introduce uMOF, a three-part contribution addressing this gap. First, we release the largest and most accurate density functional theory dataset for MOFs to date, computed at the r²SCAN-D4 level of theory across 85524 configurations spanning 19950 unique frameworks and 79 elements, covering empty and gas-loaded structures, geometry optimizations, equations of state, and finite-temperature molecular dynamics. Second, we release a literature-mined benchmark of 3986 verified property values (3146 experimental) extracted from 626 papers by a seven-stage, checkpointed multi-pass large language model pipeline, linked to more than 650 crystallographic information files. Third, we release two universal MLIPs for MOFs, uMOF-MH and uMOF-POLAR, fine-tuned from two architecturally distinct MACE foundation models on the uMOF dataset. On near-equilibrium, ``Tier-1'' properties (bulk modulus, phonon-derived heat capacity) the uMOF models perform comparably to existing foundation and fine-tuned baselines. On harder, dynamics-sensitive properties like gas adsorption enthalpies via Widom insertion and adsorption isotherms, the uMOF models outperform every baseline we test, including MOF-specialized gas-capture models trained on datasets up to three orders of magnitude larger, cutting error by more than 80% to within experimental uncertainty. We trace this advantage to the physical diversity of the training data and to level of theory where a small (1.7%) fraction of MD simulations is decisive for MLIP stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出uMOF，包括迄今规模最大且精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集、从文献中挖掘的经核验性质基准，以及两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势。该数据集涵盖85524个构型、19950种框架和79种元素，基准包含从626篇论文提取的3986个性质值。uMOF模型在近平衡性质上与现有模型相当，而在气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等动力学敏感性质上优于所有测试基线，将误差降低80%以上至实验不确定度范围内。
authors: Théo Jaffrelot Inizan (Materials Sciences Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA, Bakar Institute of Digital Materials for the Planet, Division of Computing, Data Science, and Society, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA), Prathami Divakar Kamath (Materials Sciences Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA, Department of Materials Science & Engineering, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA), Alin Marin Elena (Scientific Computing Department, Science and Technology Facilities Council, Daresbury Laboratory, UK), Kristin A. Persson (Materials Sciences Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA, Department of Materials Science & Engineering, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）能够以远低于计算成本的代价实现接近第一性原理的精度，但其在金属有机框架（MOF）中的前景在很大程度上尚未实现，因为大晶胞使第一性原理训练数据的生成成本高昂，微调模型稀少，而以实验为依据的基准更为稀缺。我们提出uMOF，这是一项由三部分组成的工作，旨在填补这一空白。首先，我们发布了迄今规模最大、精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集：该数据集在r2SCAN-D4理论水平下计算，涵盖85524个构型、19950种不同框架和79种元素，包括空载与气体负载结构、几何优化、状态方程和有限温度分子动力学。第二，我们发布了一个通过文献挖掘建立的基准，其中包含由七阶段、带检查点的多轮大语言模型流程从626篇论文中提取的3986个经核验性质值，其中3146个为实验值，并与650多个晶体学信息文件相连接。第三，我们发布了两种面向MOF的通用MLIP，即uMOF-MH和uMOF-POLAR；它们是在uMOF数据集上，从两个架构不同的MACE基础模型微调而来。对于近平衡的“第一层级”性质，如体积模量和由声子导出的热容，uMOF模型的表现与现有基础模型和微调基线相当。对于更困难、对动力学敏感的性质，例如通过Widom插入计算的气体吸附焓和吸附等温线，uMOF模型优于我们测试的每一种基线，包括在规模大至三个数量级的数据集上训练的MOF专用气体捕集模型，将误差降低80%以上，达到实验不确定度范围内。我们将这一优势归因于训练数据的物理多样性和所采用的理论水平，其中仅占1.7%的分子动力学模拟对MLIP稳定性具有决定性作用。
articles.focus_summary: 论文发布了面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、实验性质基准和机器学习原子间势。其数据集覆盖大量框架结构、气体负载构型、方程状态和有限温度分子动力学，并据此微调适用于 MOF 的机器学习势。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、材料数据库、主动学习和大规模分子动力学方法相关，但研究对象主要是金属有机框架，不属于团队当前重点材料体系。其数据集构建、实验基准关联和通用势微调策略可迁移到电池材料、钙钛矿或缺陷半导体研究。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可借鉴其数据集和基准测试流程，为 HfO2 铁电体、卤化物钙钛矿、固态电解质和二维材料建立面向有限温度与缺陷的机器学习势。重点应评估势函数对相变、离子迁移、长程库仑作用和极化性质的描述能力。

articles.title: Band-like Carriers in a Soft, Anharmonic Lattice: Lead-Halide Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 软非谐晶格中的能带型载流子：卤化铅钙钛矿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lead-halide perovskites APbX3 present a striking dichotomy: they exhibit band-like electronic transport despite their exceptionally soft and anharmonic lattices. Optically and electrically, they resemble conventional direct-gap semiconductors, exhibiting light carrier masses and steep absorption onsets, whereas their lattices display liquid-like dynamics, including overdamped octahedral motions, quasielastic Raman central peaks, and exceptionally low thermal conductivities. Solution-processed films nevertheless sustain micrometre-scale carrier diffusion at defect densities that would severely suppress transport in conventional semiconductors. Here, we argue that these apparently disparate properties emerge from a common microscopic framework: a soft, strongly anharmonic, and polar [PbX3]- framework, strongly influenced by the Pb 6s2 lone pair, which simultaneously shapes the antibonding orbital character of the band edges, the magnitude and multiple timescales of the dielectric response, and the slow relaxational dynamics that dress every charge carrier. We therefore invert the conventional order and develop the lattice before the electronic structure, because the nominally cubic phase is better viewed as a thermally fluctuating ensemble of locally symmetry-broken configurations rather than a single geometry. Within this framework, we discuss excitons, Frohlich large polarons in the intermediate-coupling regime, carrier transport, defect tolerance, dimensional reduction in two-dimensional and nanocrystalline derivatives, and symmetry-breaking phenomena. We critically assess three contested issues - defect tolerance, ferroelectricity, and the interpretation of the T-3/2 mobility law - and identify seven open questions together with the key measurements needed to resolve them
articles.abstract_zh: 卤化铅钙钛矿APbX3具有显著矛盾性：其晶格极软且强非谐，却表现出能带型电子输运和较长的载流子扩散距离。本文提出统一微观图像，认为受Pb 6s2孤对电子强烈影响的软、强非谐且极性的[PbX3]-骨架，同时决定带边反键轨道、介电响应与载流子弛豫动力学。文章据此讨论激子、大Fröhlich极化子、输运、缺陷容忍性及对称性破缺，并评估若干争议问题和开放问题。
authors: Young Mi Lee, Inhee Maeng, Jinwoo Park, Seung-Jae Oh, Min-Cherl Jung
articles.abstract_zh_full: 卤化铅钙钛矿APbX3呈现出显著的二分性：尽管其晶格异常柔软且高度非谐，却表现出能带型电子输运。在光学和电学性质上，它们类似于传统直接带隙半导体，表现出较轻的载流子有效质量和陡峭的吸收边；而其晶格却呈现液体般的动力学，包括过阻尼八面体运动、准弹性拉曼中心峰和异常低的热导率。尽管缺陷密度在传统半导体中会严重抑制输运，溶液法制备的薄膜仍可维持微米尺度的载流子扩散。本文认为，这些表面上彼此割裂的性质源于一个共同的微观框架：柔软、强非谐且具有极性的[PbX3]-骨架受到Pb 6s2孤对电子的强烈影响，并同时塑造带边的反键轨道特征、介电响应的幅度与多个时间尺度，以及修饰每个电荷载流子的缓慢弛豫动力学。因此，我们颠倒了通常的论述顺序，先讨论晶格后讨论电子结构，因为名义上的立方相更适合被看作局域对称性破缺构型的热涨落系综，而非单一几何构型。在这一框架内，我们讨论了激子、中等耦合区间的Fröhlich大极化子、载流子输运、缺陷容忍性、二维和纳米晶衍生物中的维度降低，以及对称性破缺现象。我们批判性评估了三个有争议的问题，即缺陷容忍性、铁电性和T⁻³/2迁移率定律的解释，并确定了七个开放问题及解决它们所需的关键测量。
articles.focus_summary: 论文研究铅卤钙钛矿中带状载流子输运与软性、强非谐极性晶格之间的关系。主要结论是，Pb 6s2 孤对电子塑造了能带边、介电响应和晶格弛豫动力学，从而使材料在低热导和强晶格涨落下仍保持较好的载流子扩散与输运特性。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的卤化物钙钛矿、载流子输运、电子-声子耦合、热载流子弛豫和非绝热动力学方向高度相关。其关于强非谐晶格、极化屏蔽和载流子-晶格耦合的统一图像，可为第一性原理分子动力学、声子重整化及输运计算提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合非绝热分子动力学或电子-声子耦合计算，定量研究软晶格对迁移率、载流子寿命和热载流子弛豫的影响。也可利用机器学习势扩展到有限温度、大尺度和含缺陷体系。

articles.title: Charge transfer and competing symmetry breaking drive orbital reconstruction and emergent ferromagnetism in insulating oxide superlattices
articles.title_zh: 电荷转移与竞争性对称性破缺驱动绝缘氧化物超晶格中的轨道重构和涌现铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron correlation, hopping, and ligand-to-metal charge transfer collectively lead to diverse electronic and magnetic phenomena in 3d transition-metal oxides, where directional d orbitals make hopping highly sensitive to symmetry-dependent orbital overlap. Heterostructure engineering with atomically flat interfaces adds symmetry-breaking charge transfer as a further route to emergent behavior, yet whether interfacial mismatch between constituent oxides of a superlattice shapes ground states independent of epitaxial strain remains unresolved. Here we examine superlattices combining NdNiO₃ with Mott-insulating NdMnO₃. Varying layer thickness and combining transport with X-ray spectroscopy, we show that electron transfer from NdMnO₃ to NdNiO₃ drives a room-temperature insulating state with a distinct electronic structure, accompanied by a reversal in orbital symmetry beyond simple strain considerations, underscoring the interface's central role. These reconstructions stabilize an emergent ferromagnetic insulating state arising from interfacial Ni²⁺-O-Mn⁴⁺ superexchange. Our results establish a pathway to interface-engineered ferromagnetic insulating phases via competing interactions, with potential for spin-insulatronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究NdNiO3与Mott绝缘体NdMnO3构成的超晶格，考察界面电荷转移和对称性破缺对基态的作用。调节层厚并结合输运和X射线谱学发现，从NdMnO3至NdNiO3的电子转移驱动室温绝缘态，并导致不能仅以外延应变解释的轨道对称性反转。界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换由此稳定涌现的铁磁绝缘态，为界面工程化铁磁绝缘相及自旋绝缘电子学应用提供了路径。
authors: Nandana Bhattacharya, Ranjan Kumar Patel, Siddharth Kumar, Sourav Chowdhury, Manav Beniwal, Suresh Chandra Joshi, Prithwijit Mandal, Jayjit Kumar Dey, Weibin Li, Manuel Valvidares, Zhan Zhang, Hua Zhou, Andrei Gloskovskii, Christoph Schlueter, Christoph Klewe, Srimanta Middey
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子关联、跃迁以及配体至金属的电荷转移共同导致3d过渡金属氧化物中多样的电子和磁性现象；在这些材料中，具有方向性的d轨道使跃迁对依赖对称性的轨道重叠高度敏感。具有原子级平整界面的异质结构工程，将由对称性破缺引起的电荷转移作为获得涌现行为的另一条途径；然而，超晶格组分氧化物之间的界面失配是否能独立于外延应变而塑造基态，仍未得到解决。本文考察了结合NdNiO3和Mott绝缘体NdMnO3的超晶格。通过改变层厚度并结合输运测量与X射线谱学，我们表明，从NdMnO3向NdNiO3的电子转移驱动了室温绝缘态及其独特电子结构，同时伴随超出简单应变考量的轨道对称性反转，凸显了界面的核心作用。这些重构稳定了一种涌现的铁磁绝缘态，该态源于界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换。我们的结果确立了通过竞争相互作用获得界面工程化铁磁绝缘相的路径，并有望应用于自旋绝缘电子学。
articles.focus_summary: 论文研究 NdNiO3/NdMnO3 氧化物超晶格中的界面电荷转移、轨道重构和对称性破缺。研究发现，NdMnO3 向 NdNiO3 的电子转移可形成室温绝缘态，并通过 Ni2+-O-Mn4+ 超交换稳定界面诱导的铁磁绝缘态。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、磁性超晶格、界面电荷转移、轨道重构和自旋相关相互作用方向相关。虽然工作以实验表征为主，但其界面诱导磁性和超交换机制适合用第一性原理、有效自旋哈密顿量及蒙特卡洛方法进一步解析。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议开展不同层厚、应变和界面终止条件下的第一性原理计算，分离电荷转移、晶格失配与应变对磁基态的贡献。还可提取交换参数和磁各向异性，研究温度依赖的界面磁序。

articles.title: Light-induced atomic motion in ionic crystals
articles.title_zh: 离子晶体中的光致原子运动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28143v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic motion in solids is conventionally driven by elastic collisions between ionizing particles and atoms, which transfer momentum and induce lattice displacements. In this work, we demonstrate a different mechanism for atomic displacement based on optical excitation of scintillating ionic crystals. Ionic crystals are unique systems because of the closed-shell electronic configuration of their constituent ions. In these materials, excitation above the band gap generates a hole that strongly distorts the lattice, resulting in the formation of a self-trapped hole (STH). The STH is Coulomb-attracted to the electron, thereby forming a self-trapped exciton (STE). Here, we demonstrate that in BaF2 - one of the fastest scintillators - the STE structure promotes the formation of long-lived electron and hole traps that persist in the lattice at room temperature. Such trapped electron-hole pairs occupy vacancy-interstitial fluorine pair positions, and can be created indiscernibly using optical or ionizing radiation excitation, as long as the STH is formed. Further, we demonstrate that it is possible to control the defect evolution with light. Selective optical stimulation of the trapped electrons or holes enables the regeneration of the STE at later times. This light-controlled defect engineering allows us to increase the yield of the STE signal appearing as optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) and to image the spatial distribution of the initial energy deposition, holding strong potential for ionizing-radiation detection. These findings provide a common framework underlying scintillation and OSL in ionic crystals of the fluorite structure, allowing for optical manipulation of atomic vacancies-interstitial pairs in similar systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种由闪烁离子晶体光激发引起原子位移的机制，不同于电离粒子碰撞传递动量的传统机制。在BaF2中，自陷空穴和自陷激子可促进室温长寿命电子与空穴陷阱形成，陷阱对占据氟的空位-间隙对位置。选择性光刺激可调控缺陷演化、再生自陷激子并增强光激发发光信号，为辐射探测和缺陷光学操控提供了基础。
authors: Jacob C. Warming, Simon P. S. Jessen, Emma A. Husted, Jan Thøgersen, Stefan Gundacker, Brian Julsgaard, Peter Balling, Rosana M. Turtos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固体中的原子运动传统上由电离粒子与原子之间的弹性碰撞驱动，后者传递动量并诱导晶格位移。在本工作中，我们展示了一种基于闪烁离子晶体光激发的不同原子位移机制。离子晶体是独特的系统，因为其组成离子具有闭壳层电子构型。在这些材料中，带隙以上的激发会产生一个强烈畸变晶格的空穴，从而形成自陷空穴（STH）。STH受到电子的库仑吸引，进而形成自陷激子（STE）。本文表明，在最快的闪烁体之一BaF2中，STE结构促进了长寿命电子和空穴陷阱的形成，这些陷阱可在室温下持续存在于晶格中。这种被俘获的电子-空穴对占据氟的空位-间隙对位置；只要形成STH，它们就可以通过光学激发或电离辐射激发以无法区分的方式产生。进一步地，我们表明，可以利用光来控制缺陷演化。对被俘获电子或空穴进行选择性光刺激，能够在更晚时间重新生成STE。这种光控缺陷工程使我们能够提高以光激发发光（OSL）形式出现的STE信号产额，并对初始能量沉积的空间分布成像，对电离辐射探测具有强大潜力。这些发现为萤石结构离子晶体中的闪烁和OSL提供了统一框架，使得能够在类似体系中对原子空位-间隙对进行光学操控。

articles.title: Quantum thermodynamics near the border of a one-dimensional Bose gas
articles.title_zh: 一维玻色气体边界附近的量子热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider an ultracold Bose gas in a half-open potential well, otherwise confined to a quasi-one-dimensional geometry. The Bogoliubov equations for its elementary excitations are solved in the continuous spectrum to explore the particle and energy content near the edge of the gas, beyond the often applied local density approximation. In particular, gradients in the condensate density enhance density-dominated excitations in the border region. We discuss excess (missing) particles and their energy by comparing to suitable reference solutions for quasi-homogeneous systems. The density profile near the edge shows no Friedel oscillations, but a dipolar feature from the spill-out of thermally excited particles. The calculations are performed in the grand-canonical ensemble and in the thermodynamic limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究处于半开放势阱、并受准一维约束的超冷玻色气体边缘区域，超越常用的局域密度近似求解其Bogoliubov激发。凝聚体密度梯度会增强边界区以密度为主导的激发，热激发粒子的外溢则导致偶极特征，而非Friedel振荡。研究在巨正则系综和热力学极限下比较准均匀参考体系，以分析边界附近过剩或缺失粒子及其能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考虑一种处于半开放势阱中的超冷玻色气体，该气体在其他方向上受限于准一维几何构型。我们在连续谱中求解其元激发的Bogoliubov方程，以探索气体边缘附近的粒子和能量含量，并超越通常采用的局域密度近似。特别地，凝聚体密度的梯度会增强边界区域中以密度为主导的激发。我们通过与适用于准均匀系统的参考解进行比较，讨论过剩（缺失）粒子及其能量。边缘附近的密度分布不显示Friedel振荡，而是呈现由热激发粒子外溢造成的偶极特征。计算在巨正则系综和热力学极限下进行。

articles.title: Two-dimensional quantum Griffith singularity in three-dimensional ZrNₓ superconducting films
articles.title_zh: 三维 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中的二维量子 Griffith 奇异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the experimental observation of two-dimensional (2D) quantum Griffiths singularity (QGS) in sim200-nm-thick epitaxial ZrNₓ superconducting films. The films possess a rock-salt structure and are three-dimensional (3D) with respect to superconductivity. For each film with x gtrsim 1.30, the low-temperature magnetoresistance isotherms under fields perpendicular and parallel to the film plane cross over at a broad magnetic field range independently rather than at a single crossing point. Despite the macroscopic 3D nature of the superconductivity, the magnetoresistance isotherms at selected adjacent temperatures follow the theoretical prediction of power-law scaling for 2D superconducting systems, rather than that for 3D systems. The effective critical exponent zν, obtained by analyzing the magnetoresistance isotherms using the 2D power-law scaling, increases with decreasing temperature and diverges as the quantum phase transition is approached. In addition, the resistivity data near the superconductor-insulator or superconductor-metal transitions obey an activated scaling form that describes the quantum phase transition of 2D superconducting systems governed by an infinite-randomness critical point. The QGS in the ZrNₓ films is attributed to quenched disorder induced by intrinsic defects, such as Zr vacancies and N interstitials, which creates spatially inhomogeneous superconducting rare regions. The dynamics of these rare regions, which may exhibit effective 2D characteristics near the quantum critical point, dominate the transport properties of the system near the quantum phase transition. Our results provide compelling evidence for the existence of QGS in 3D superconductors and highlight the crucial role of disorder-induced inhomogeneity in determining the critical behavior of quantum phase transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在约 200 nm 厚的外延 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中实验观测到二维量子 Griffith 奇异性。尽管超导性在宏观上具有三维特征，磁阻等温线却遵循二维超导系统的幂律标度，并显示出趋近量子相变时发散的有效临界指数。研究将这一现象归因于本征缺陷引起的淬灭无序及其形成的空间非均匀超导稀有区域。
authors: Zi-Yan Han, Li-Min Yu, Yu-Cheng Cong, Yang Yang, Zhi-Xiang Sun, Zhi-Qing Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在约 200 nm 厚的外延 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中报告了二维（2D）量子 Griffith 奇异性（QGS）的实验观测结果。这些薄膜具有岩盐结构，并且就超导性而言属于三维（3D）体系。对于每一片 x 大于或约等于 1.30 的薄膜，在低温下，垂直于薄膜平面和平行于薄膜平面的磁场所对应的磁阻等温线，会在一个较宽的磁场范围内分别发生交叉，而不是在单一交叉点处交叉。尽管超导性在宏观上具有三维性质，但选定的相邻温度下的磁阻等温线遵循二维超导系统幂律标度的理论预言，而不是三维系统的理论预言。通过使用二维幂律标度分析磁阻等温线得到的有效临界指数 zν 随温度降低而增大，并在接近量子相变时发散。此外，超导体-绝缘体或超导体-金属转变附近的电阻率数据遵循一种激活标度形式，该形式描述了由无穷随机性临界点支配的二维超导系统量子相变。ZrNₓ 薄膜中的 QGS 被归因于本征缺陷（例如 Zr 空位和 N 间隙原子）所诱导的淬灭无序，这些缺陷形成了空间上不均匀的超导稀有区域。这些稀有区域的动力学在量子临界点附近可能表现出有效的二维特征，并在量子相变附近主导体系的输运性质。我们的结果为三维超导体中存在 QGS 提供了有力证据，并突出了无序诱导的非均匀性在决定量子相变临界行为中的关键作用。

articles.title: Quantum Geometric Origin of Nonlinear Current Induced Orbital Magnetization
articles.title_zh: 非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的量子几何起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28231v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric generation of magnetization is a focus of condensed matter research, and has recently been advanced into the nonlinear regime. However, due to the nonlocal nature of orbital magnetism, how to properly formulate nonlinear current-induced orbital magnetization remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we develop the proper theory for this effect. This is based on the microscopic derivation of field-corrected orbital magnetic moment of a Bloch electron, a critical missing piece in the present theory. We show that the quantum geometric origin of this phenomenon lies in both the anomalous orbital polarizability and the Berry-connection polarizability, which often provide competing contributions. Combining our theory with first-principles calculations, we predict significant, experimentally accessible nonlinear orbital magnetization generated in strained bilayer graphene, monolayer 1T' MoS₂ and MoTe₂. Remarkably, nonlinear orbital magnetization can dominate over its spin counterpart in materials with topological band features, irrespective of the spin-orbit coupling strength.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的理论，核心是对布洛赫电子场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导。研究表明，该现象源于反常轨道极化率和 Berry 联络极化率，两者通常会产生相互竞争的贡献。结合第一性原理计算，作者预测了应变双层石墨烯、单层 1T′-MoS₂ 和 MoTe₂ 中显著且可实验观测的非线性轨道磁化。
authors: Xue-Jin Zhang, Yue-Xin Huang, Wei Du, Xiaolong Feng, Shen Lai, Cong Xiao, Qian Niu, Shengyuan A. Yang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电场产生磁化是凝聚态物理研究的一个重点，并且近年来已经拓展到非线性领域。然而，由于轨道磁性的非局域性，如何恰当地表述非线性电流诱导轨道磁化仍然是一个基本挑战。在此，我们建立了该效应的适当理论。该理论建立在对布洛赫电子场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导之上，而这一内容是现有理论中关键的缺失环节。我们表明，这一现象的量子几何起源同时存在于反常轨道极化率和 Berry 联络极化率之中，二者通常会提供相互竞争的贡献。我们将该理论与第一性原理计算相结合，预测了在应变双层石墨烯、单层 1T′ MoS₂ 和 MoTe₂ 中能够产生显著且实验上可实现的非线性轨道磁化。值得注意的是，在具有拓扑能带特征的材料中，无论自旋-轨道耦合强度如何，非线性轨道磁化都可能超过其自旋对应项。

articles.title: Interplay between crystal structure and magnetism in CeCrB₄
articles.title_zh: CeCrB₄ 中晶体结构与磁性的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28238v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CeCrB₄ belongs to the family of MTB₄ ternary metal borides, some of whose magnetic phases have recently been identified as quantum spin dimers. Employing density functional theory within the GGA+U framework, this work investigates the key ground-state properties of this system, including its ferromagnetic ground state, the mixed-valence nature of cerium, and the charge transfer from the cationic cerium--chromium layers to the anionic boron layers. In particular, we focus on elucidating the bonding mechanism within the structurally embedded Cr-Cr dimers. Specifically, we evaluate a previously proposed interpretation that the localized Cr 3dz^₂ states are molecular-like bonding and antibonding states. The calculated dependence of the 3dz^₂ electronic structure on the intra-dimer distance correlates with the level-splitting characteristics known for classical homonuclear diatomic molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用 GGA+U 密度泛函理论研究 CeCrB₄ 的基态性质，包括铁磁基态、铈的混合价特征以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。研究重点是结构中 Cr-Cr 二聚体的成键机制，并检验局域化 Cr 3dₓ²−y²? 原文为 3d_z² 态是否可解释为分子型成键态和反键态。计算显示，3d_z² 电子结构随二聚体内距离的变化，与经典同核双原子分子已知的能级分裂特征相符。
authors: Mirosław Werwiński, Andrzej Szajek, Andrzej Kowalczyk
articles.abstract_zh_full: CeCrB₄ 属于 MTB₄ 三元金属硼化物家族，该家族中的一些磁性相最近被确定为量子自旋二聚体。本文在 GGA+U 框架下采用密度泛函理论，研究了该体系的关键基态性质，包括其铁磁基态、铈的混合价性质，以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。特别地，我们着重阐明结构中嵌入的 Cr-Cr 二聚体内部的成键机制。具体而言，我们评估了此前提出的一种解释，即局域化的 Cr 3d_z² 态是分子型成键态和反键态。计算得到的 3d_z² 电子结构对二聚体内距离的依赖关系，与经典同核双原子分子中已知的能级分裂特征相吻合。

articles.title: QUBO-Compatible Active Learning for Inverse Design of High-Entropy Alloys
articles.title_zh: 用于高熵合金逆向设计的兼容 QUBO 主动学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned forward models can rapidly predict alloy properties, but their use for inverse design remains challenging when the search should also retain compatibility with quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO). Here, we develop a QUBO-compatible active-learning framework for inverse design of high-entropy alloys using a pretrained graph-neural-network predictor as a fixed property oracle. A property-guided binary variational autoencoder provides a binary latent representation, while an ensemble of quadratic factorization machines guides candidate selection. We systematically benchmark the framework through controlled latent-space ablations and comparison with direct composition-space optimization. The results show that candidate generation is a major determinant of search performance: local perturbations around previously high-performing latent codes provide the largest workflow-specific improvement, while surrogate-based selection further prioritizes candidates within the enriched search pool. The resulting QUBO-compatible workflow remains competitive with strong classical optimization strategies, although a composition-space genetic algorithm achieves the highest mean score. Finally, the learned quadratic surrogate can be exported directly as a QUBO. These results show that effective data acquisition can be separated from the final QUBO optimization endpoint, providing a benchmarked route for QUBO-compatible data-driven materials inverse design.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种兼容二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）的主动学习框架，用于高熵合金逆向设计，并将预训练图神经网络作为固定的性质预测器。研究表明，候选生成方式是搜索性能的主要决定因素，围绕高性能潜在编码进行局部扰动可带来最大的流程改进。该工作流与强经典优化策略具有竞争力，且学习得到的二次代理模型可直接导出为 QUBO。
authors: Giorgio Silvi, Kirsten Bark, Rolando Reiner, Nicolas Vogt, Thomas Plehn, Daniel Barragan-Yani, Marc Landmann, David Melching
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习得到的正向模型能够快速预测合金性质，但当搜索过程还必须保持与二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）的兼容性时，将其用于逆向设计仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们开发了一种兼容 QUBO 的主动学习框架，用于高熵合金的逆向设计，并使用预训练的图神经网络预测器作为固定的性质预言器。一个由性质引导的二元变分自编码器提供二元潜在表示，而由多个二次分解机组成的集成模型则引导候选选择。我们通过受控的潜在空间消融实验以及与直接成分空间优化的比较，对该框架进行了系统基准测试。结果表明，候选生成是搜索性能的主要决定因素：围绕此前表现优异的潜在编码进行局部扰动，在该工作流中带来了最大的改进；基于代理模型的选择则进一步优先选取扩充搜索池中的候选。最终得到的兼容 QUBO 工作流仍可与强大的经典优化策略相竞争，尽管成分空间遗传算法取得了最高的平均得分。最后，学习得到的二次代理模型可以直接导出为 QUBO。这些结果表明，有效的数据获取过程可以与最终的 QUBO 优化终点相分离，从而为兼容 QUBO 的数据驱动材料逆向设计提供了一条经过基准验证的路径。

articles.title: Nanolamellar Hybrid High-Entropy Alloys with Superior Micromechanical Properties
articles.title_zh: 具有优异微观力学性能的纳米层片混合高熵合金
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metallic materials with nanolamellar structures, such as pearlitic steels, exhibit high strength with appropriate ductility. Considering the potential ability of such nanolamellar structures to break the traditional strength-ductility trade-off in metallic alloys, this study aims at developing a unique nanolamellar structure with superior micromechanical properties by combining two different high-entropy alloys (HEAs). Al0.1CoCrFeNi with the face-centered cubic (FCC) structure is combined with TiZrHfNbTa with the body-centered cubic (BCC) structure using high-pressure torsion (HPT) of half discs of each alloy. That way, a layered hybrid structure was formed, with layer thickness down to about 61 nm. The BCC/FCC nanolamellar hybrid structure exhibits an exceptional combination of properties with an ultimate tensile strength of 2.4 GPa, a maximum bending strength of 4.0 GPa, and a hardness of 740 Hv, while retaining some ductility/plasticity under both tensile and bending loads. Detailed analyses by synchrotron diffraction, electron microscopy and atom probe tomography suggests that these high strength and hardness, which are superior to those of nanostructured HEAs, result from: (i) extreme grain boundary strengthening from nanograins with a mean size of 22 nm, (ii) presence of defects such as dislocations in FCC and BCC, stacking faults in FCC and twins in FCC, and (iii) interphase hardening from BCC/FCC nanolamellar boundaries with about 30% contribution to the total hardness. This work demonstrates that combining two HEAs using HPT into a defect-rich hybrid nanolamellar composite forms a promising synergy of ultrahigh strength and reasonable ductility/plasticity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过高压扭转将面心立方 Al₀.₁CoCrFeNi 与体心立方 TiZrHfNbTa 两种高熵合金结合，制备了层厚最低约 61 nm 的纳米层片混合结构。该 BCC/FCC 结构同时实现了 2.4 GPa 的抗拉强度、4.0 GPa 的最大弯曲强度和 740 Hv 的硬度，并保留了一定的延性或塑性。高强度主要来自超细晶界强化、丰富缺陷以及 BCC/FCC 纳米层片界面的相间强化，后者约贡献总硬度的 30%。
authors: Shivam Dangwal, Yoji Mine, Shohei Ueki, Xavier Sauvage, Fabien Cuvilly, Liliana Romero Resendiz, Muhammad Naeem, Kaveh Edalati
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有纳米层片结构的金属材料，例如珠光体钢，表现出高强度和适当的延性。鉴于这类纳米层片结构有可能打破金属合金中传统的强度-延性权衡，本研究旨在通过结合两种不同的高熵合金（HEA），开发一种具有优异微观力学性能的独特纳米层片结构。具有面心立方（FCC）结构的 Al₀.₁CoCrFeNi 与具有体心立方（BCC）结构的 TiZrHfNbTa，通过对两种合金的半圆片分别施加高压扭转（HPT）而结合在一起。由此形成了层状混合结构，层厚最低约为 61 nm。该 BCC/FCC 纳米层片混合结构表现出优异的综合性能：抗拉强度为 2.4 GPa，最大弯曲强度为 4.0 GPa，硬度为 740 Hv，同时在拉伸和弯曲载荷下仍保留了一定的延性或塑性。同步辐射衍射、电子显微镜和原子探针断层成像的详细分析表明，这些高于纳米结构高熵合金的高强度和高硬度源于以下因素：（i）平均晶粒尺寸为 22 nm 的纳米晶所产生的极强晶界强化；（ii）FCC 和 BCC 中存在位错等缺陷、FCC 中存在层错以及 FCC 中存在孪晶；（iii）来自 BCC/FCC 纳米层片界面的相间强化，该强化约贡献总硬度的 30%。这项工作表明，通过 HPT 将两种高熵合金结合成富含缺陷的混合纳米层片复合材料，可以形成超高强度与合理延性或塑性的有益协同。

articles.title: Nucleation and propagation of brittle fracture as a constrained energy minimization problem
articles.title_zh: 作为受约束能量极小化问题的脆性断裂成核与扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a macroscopic, or continuum, theory aimed at describing when, where, and why cracks nucleate and propagate in nominally elastic brittle materials under monotonic, quasi-static, but otherwise arbitrary mechanical loads. Motivated by recent insights, the proposed sharp theory posits that: emph{cracks nucleate and propagate exclusively in regions where the strength surface of the material is exceeded, with their evolution dictated by the minimization of the sum of the potential --- the elastic energy minus the work done by the externally applied forces --- and surface energies.} While the theory applies to materials with any elasticity (linear or nonlinear) and any material symmetry (isotropic or anisotropic), attention is restricted here to the most basic case of isotropic elastic brittle materials. For demonstration purposes, the theory is confronted with a set of nine tests that span the entire range of well-settled experimental knowledge on fracture nucleation and propagation --- the so-called ``Nine Circles of Elastic Brittle Fracture'' --- on both a hard material (a silicate glass) and a soft material (a synthetic rubber).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种宏观连续介质理论，用于描述名义弹性脆性材料在单调、准静态且任意机械载荷下裂纹何时、何处以及为何成核和扩展。该理论认为，裂纹仅在材料强度面被超越的区域成核和扩展，其演化由势能（弹性能减去外力所做功）与表面能之和的最小化决定。理论适用于线性或非线性弹性以及各向同性或各向异性材料，并通过玻璃和合成橡胶上的九项断裂测试进行检验。
authors: Oscar Lopez-Pamies, Farhad Kamarei, Gilles A. Francfort, Alessandro Giacomini
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出一种宏观的、即连续介质层次的理论，旨在描述名义上具有弹性的脆性材料在单调、准静态但除此之外任意的机械载荷下，裂纹何时、何处以及为何成核和扩展。受近期研究认识的启发，所提出的精确理论认为：裂纹只在材料的强度面被超越的区域内成核和扩展，其演化由势能（即弹性能减去外部施加力所做的功）与表面能之和的最小化所决定。尽管该理论适用于具有任意弹性性质（线性或非线性）以及任意材料对称性（各向同性或各向异性）的材料，但本文将讨论限定于各向同性弹性脆性材料这一最基本情形。作为示范，我们将该理论应用于九项测试，这些测试涵盖了关于断裂成核与扩展的全部成熟实验知识范围，即所谓“弹性脆性断裂的九个圆圈”，并分别针对硬质材料（硅酸盐玻璃）和软质材料（合成橡胶）进行检验。

articles.title: Evidence for Three-component Interlayer Coherent Exciton Condensation
articles.title_zh: 三组分层间相干激子凝聚的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Increasing the number of internal components in a quantum many-body system can host collective orders inaccessible to simpler settings. Quantum Hall bilayers provide a canonical realization of interlayer exciton condensation, yet extending such coherence across three independently addressable electronic fluids has remained elusive. Here we report evidence for three-component interlayer coherent exciton condensation in triple-layer graphene system. Using Rydberg excitons in an adjacent WSe2 monolayer as a layer-sensitive optical probe, we resolve interaction-induced incompressibility at zeroth-Landau-level crossings for all three pairwise layer combinations, establishing top-middle, middle-bottom and top-bottom exciton condensate channels within the same device. Independent control of displacement field and interlayer bias continuously tunes these pairwise states towards a regime where Landau levels from all three layers approach simultaneous degeneracy. At their convergence, incompressibility persists while the exciton energy and spectral weight evolve smoothly between the pairwise limits, suggesting coherent participation of all three layers in a single three-component state. More broadly, the ability to independently control layer potentials and engineer interlayer interactions establishes multilayer graphene as a programmable synthetic dimension for exploring higher-component quantum Hall order and simulating strongly correlated quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了三层石墨烯体系中三组分层间相干激子凝聚的证据。借助相邻 WSe₂ 单层中的里德伯激子作为具有层分辨能力的光学探针，研究在三种层对的零朗道能级交叉处均观测到相互作用诱导的不可压缩性。通过独立调节位移场和层间偏压，作者观察到成对层间状态向三层朗道能级趋于同时简并的区域连续演化，并据此推断三层可能相干参与同一个三组分状态。
authors: Subi Du, Xiaohan Zhang, Hongxi Song, Siyu Fan, Yiduo Wang, Zhenyu Wang, Song Liu, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Jiangping Hu, Yang Xu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 增加量子多体系统中的内部组分数量，可以承载在更简单体系中无法实现的集体有序。量子霍尔双层体系是层间激子凝聚的典型实现，但要将这种相干性扩展到三个可独立寻址的电子流体，一直难以实现。在此，我们报告了三层石墨烯体系中三组分层间相干激子凝聚的证据。我们使用相邻 WSe₂ 单层中的里德伯激子作为具有层敏感性的光学探针，在零朗道能级交叉处解析出所有三种层对组合的相互作用诱导不可压缩性，从而在同一个器件中确立了顶层-中间层、中间层-底层和顶层-底层激子凝聚通道。对位移场和层间偏压的独立控制，可以连续地将这些成对状态调节到一个区域，在该区域中三层的朗道能级趋于同时简并。在它们汇聚时，不可压缩性仍然存在，而激子能量和光谱权重在不同成对极限之间平滑演化，这表明三层可能相干地参与了一个单一的三组分状态。更广泛地说，独立控制层势并设计层间相互作用的能力，使多层石墨烯成为探索更高组分量子霍尔有序以及模拟强关联量子物质的可编程合成维度。

articles.title: Work Function and High-Coverage Adsorption Energy as Hydrogen-Evolution Descriptors on Ag-Au-Pd-Pt Alloys
articles.title_zh: 功函数与高覆盖度吸附能作为 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 合金析氢反应描述符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrogen-evolution activity is commonly rationalized through hydrogen adsorption energies and the Sabatier principle, yet this descriptor picture becomes ambiguous on multimetallic surfaces, where each composition exposes a distribution of local adsorption environments. Here we investigate whether the bare-surface work function, previously shown to add predictive information for monometallic surfaces, remains an activity descriptor for compositionally complex surfaces. We test this on three combinatorial Ag-Au-Pd-Pt thin-film materials libraries screened for acidic hydrogen evolution by scanning electrochemical cell microscopy. Graph neural networks provide adsorption-energy distributions and work functions for each measured composition. A work-function-only model explained most of the activity variation (mean R²ₗₒg = 0.903), as did a coverage-corrected adsorption model (mean R²ₗₒg = 0.955), outperforming dilute adsorption (mean R²ₗₒg = 0.758). Combining work function and coverage-corrected adsorption yielded the highest fit quality (mean R²ₗₒg = 0.969), but only a small gain over coverage-corrected adsorption alone. For these four metals the coverage-corrected adsorption energy and work function follow a similar trend, producing similar activity rankings, hence including both adds little beyond either one individually, although both are strong predictors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考察裸表面功函数是否能继续作为成分复杂表面的析氢活性描述符，并将其与覆盖度修正的氢吸附能进行比较。基于三组 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 薄膜组合材料库，研究发现功函数和覆盖度修正吸附模型都能解释大部分活性变化，二者结合时拟合效果最高。由于功函数与覆盖度修正吸附能在这四种金属中呈现相似趋势，同时使用二者相较单独使用其中任一指标的额外收益有限。
authors: Zacharias Liasi, Ridha Zerdoumi, Felix Thelen, Geovane Arruda de Oliveira, Rico Zehl, Natalia Pukhareva, Leonardo H. Morais, Henrik H. Kristoffersen, Alfred Ludwig, Wolfgang Schuhmann, Jan Rossmeisl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 析氢反应活性通常通过氢吸附能和 Sabatier 原理进行解释，但在多金属表面上，由于每种成分会暴露出一系列局部吸附环境，这种描述符图景会变得模糊。在此，我们研究裸表面功函数（此前已证明其能够为单金属表面提供额外预测信息）是否仍然是成分复杂表面的活性描述符。我们在三组 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 组合薄膜材料库上进行了测试，并通过扫描电化学池显微镜筛选其酸性析氢反应性能。图神经网络为每一种测量成分提供吸附能分布和功函数。仅使用功函数的模型解释了大部分活性变化（平均 R²ₗₒg = 0.903），覆盖度修正吸附模型也达到了类似表现（平均 R²ₗₒg = 0.955），并且优于稀释吸附模型（平均 R²ₗₒg = 0.758）。将功函数与覆盖度修正吸附结合后，获得了最高的拟合质量（平均 R²ₗₒg = 0.969），但相较仅使用覆盖度修正吸附，提升幅度很小。对于这四种金属，覆盖度修正吸附能和功函数遵循相似趋势，并产生相似的活性排序；因此，将二者同时纳入，相比单独使用其中任一指标所增加的信息很少，尽管二者都是强有力的预测因子。

articles.title: Crystal-phase quantum dots in AlGaAs nanowires
articles.title_zh: AlGaAs 纳米线中的晶相量子点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal-phase quantum dots (CPQDs)n̆icodex2014quantum dots in nanowires defined by crystal structure rather than material compositionn̆icodex2014constitute the only platform capable of fabricating quantum-dot arrays with the ultimate precision of a single atomic layer. This intrinsic control yields perfectly aligned quantum dots with atomically sharp interfaces, providing a unique pathway toward scalable quantum-dot-based photonic quantum technologies. To date, CPQDs have been studied primarily in binary semiconductors, such as InP and GaAs, where their emission linewidths are typically in the meV range, thereby limiting their technological potential. Here, we report, for the first time, CPQDs in AlGaAs nanowires and show bright single-photon emission with linewidths as narrow as 61 μ eV and low background emission, demonstrating optical quality well beyond typical CPQDs. We attribute this performance to a type-I band alignment, as suggested by an exciton lifetime of 1 ns, significantly shorter than that typically observed in type-II CPQDs. Additionally, we observe an exciton fine-structure splitting and a Zeeman splitting, as commonly observed in standard type-I self-assembled quantum dots.
articles.abstract_zh: 晶相量子点是在纳米线中由晶体结构而非材料成分定义的量子点，可将量子点阵列的制造精度推进到单原子层极限。本文首次在 AlGaAs 纳米线中制备晶相量子点，并观测到明亮的单光子发射，其线宽窄至 61 μeV 且背景发射较低。作者将其优异光学性能归因于 I 型能带排列，并通过约 1 ns 的激子寿命、激子精细结构分裂和塞曼分裂进一步表征了该体系。
authors: Rohan Radhakrishnan, Rodion Reznik, Gilles Patriarche, Lorenzo Leandro, Igor Ilkiv, Anna Andreeva, Artem Khrebtov, George Cirlin, Nika Akopian
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶相量子点（CPQD）是在纳米线中由晶体结构而非材料成分定义的量子点，是唯一能够以单个原子层的极限精度制造量子点阵列的平台。这种内在控制能够产生完美对齐的量子点和原子级锐利的界面，为基于量子点的可扩展光子量子技术提供了独特路径。迄今为止，CPQD 主要在 InP 和 GaAs 等二元半导体中开展研究，而在这些材料中，其发射线宽通常处于 meV 范围，从而限制了其技术潜力。在此，我们首次报告了 AlGaAs 纳米线中的 CPQD，并展示出明亮的单光子发射，线宽窄至 61 μeV，同时具有较低的背景发射，表明其光学质量远优于典型 CPQD。我们将这一性能归因于 I 型能带排列，这一点得到 1 ns 的激子寿命支持；该寿命显著短于通常在 II 型 CPQD 中观察到的激子寿命。此外，我们还观测到了激子精细结构分裂和塞曼分裂，这些现象通常见于标准的 I 型自组装量子点。

articles.title: Topological Signatures of Hardness and Structural Order in Network-Forming Materials
articles.title_zh: 成网材料中硬度与结构有序性的拓扑特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how the topology of network forming materials influences their physical properties remains a longstanding challenge. Here, we investigate the topology of experimentally compatible atomistic models of amorphous silica together with the crystalline polymorphs cristobalite and quartz. By comparing multiple atomistic models of amorphous silica that equally reproduce neutron-scattering data, we show that different microscopic descriptions can imply different topological interpretations of glass stability. To characterize the network beyond conventional geometric descriptors, we introduce the linking valence, which quantifies the average number of topological links per network loop. This topological descriptor separates silica into two distinct classes: the mechanically harder quartz exhibit values more than an order of magnitude larger than those of amorphous silica and cristobalite, despite their common tetrahedral building blocks. Spectral analysis of the loop-linking networks provides a complementary distinction, separating amorphous from crystalline phases and revealing differences in the long-range organization of topological constraints. These results establish topological linking as a new framework for connecting the structure and physical properties of network-forming materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非晶二氧化硅及晶态方石英、石英的原子模型拓扑，并引入“连接价”来量化每个网络环路的平均拓扑连接数。该指标将二氧化硅区分为两类：机械性能更硬的石英，其数值比非晶二氧化硅和方石英高一个数量级以上，尽管三者具有共同的四面体结构单元。环路连接网络的谱分析还可区分非晶相与晶相，并揭示拓扑约束在长程组织上的差异。
authors: Yair Augusto Gutiérrez Fosado, Ayobami Daramola, Davide Marenduzzo, Ciprian G. Pruteanu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解成网材料的拓扑如何影响其物理性质，一直是一个长期存在的挑战。在此，我们研究了实验上相容的非晶二氧化硅原子模型，以及晶态多形体方石英和石英的原子模型。通过比较多个同样能够再现实验中子散射数据的非晶二氧化硅原子模型，我们表明，不同的微观描述可能对玻璃稳定性给出不同的拓扑解释。为了在传统几何描述符之外表征该网络，我们引入了连接价，它量化每个网络环路上的平均拓扑连接数。该拓扑描述符将二氧化硅区分为两个不同类别：机械性能更硬的石英，其连接价值比非晶二氧化硅和方石英高一个数量级以上，尽管它们具有共同的四面体结构单元。对环路连接网络进行谱分析提供了互补的区分方式，可以将非晶相与晶相分开，并揭示拓扑约束在长程组织方面的差异。这些结果确立了拓扑连接这一新框架，用于建立成网材料结构与物理性质之间的联系。

articles.title: Quantum transport and unified scaling law in graphene with polyadic Cantor electrostatic barriers
articles.title_zh: 具有多元 Cantor 静电势垒的石墨烯中的量子输运与统一标度律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the quantum transport of Dirac electrons in graphene subjected to a polyadic Cantor-structured electrostatic potential. Using the superperiodic potential formalism, we obtain a closed-form expression for the transmission probability. As the Cantor stage increases, the transmission spectrum evolves from a sparse set of superlattice resonances to a near-transparent regime, with the polyadic order setting the rate of this evolution. The angular response depends on the doping configuration, showing distinct behavior in the n--n--n, n--p--n, and Dirac-point cases. In the near-transparent regime, the transmission follows double-logarithmic scaling laws with respect to four independent control parameters: the Cantor stage, the potential height, the initiator length, and the angle of incidence. By combining these individual scaling relations, we establish a unified scaling law governing quantum transport. These results show that the hierarchical self-similarity of the potential governs the transport properties of such systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了置于多元 Cantor 结构静电势中的石墨烯狄拉克电子量子输运，并利用超周期势形式获得透射概率的闭式表达式。随着 Cantor 阶数增加，透射谱由稀疏的超晶格共振逐渐演化为近乎透明的状态，而多元阶数决定这一演化速率。作者进一步建立了关于 Cantor 阶数、势垒高度、起始区长度和入射角的双对数标度关系，并将其合并为统一量子输运标度律。
authors: Sudhanshu Shekhar, Mohammad Umar, Bhabani Prasad Mandal
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了处于多元 Cantor 结构静电势中的石墨烯狄拉克电子的量子输运。利用超周期势形式，我们得到了透射概率的闭式表达式。随着 Cantor 阶数增加，透射谱由稀疏的超晶格共振集合演化为近乎透明的状态，其中多元阶数决定了这种演化的速率。角度响应取决于掺杂构型，在 n-n-n、n-p-n 和狄拉克点情形下表现出不同的行为。在近乎透明的状态下，透射率关于四个相互独立的控制参数，即 Cantor 阶数、势垒高度、起始区长度和入射角，遵循双对数标度律。通过结合这些独立的标度关系，我们建立了支配量子输运的统一标度律。这些结果表明，势场的分层自相似性支配着此类体系的输运性质。

articles.title: Magnonic Combinatorial Memory based on a network of coupled active ring circuits
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnonic Combinatorial Memory (MCM) is a type of memory where the bits of information are encoded in the signal propagation paths in the network. In this work, we consider MCM based on the network of a coupled active ring circuit (ARC). Each circuit includes a broadband amplifier, a magnonic delay line, an adjustable frequency filter, an adjustable phase shifter, and a power detector. The coupling between the circuits is via spin waves propagating in the common delay line - ferrite film. There may or may not be auto-oscillations in the active ring circuits, depending on the combination of circuit parameters and circuit coupling. The address of MCM is defined as the combination of the states of the phase shifters and frequency filters, while the MCM state is defined as the presence/absence of the auto-oscillations. The coupling between the circuits is achieved by placing micromagnets on top of the ferrite film. The number of bits that can be encoded in the network increases quadratically with the number of coupled circuits. This scaling provides a fundamental advantage over conventional memory. We present experimental data obtained for three magnonic ARCs connected via a single-crystal yttrium iron garnet Y3Fe2(FeO4)3 (YIG) film. The data illustrate an example of encoding a 27-bit binary response pattern, corresponding to the 27 experimentally accessible phase combinations. The results demonstrate a robust operation of MCM with an On/Off ratio exceeding 30 dB at room temperature. The advantages and shortcomings of the proposed approach are discussed.
authors: Mykhaylo Balinskiy, Paulo Julio, Jeffrey Vargas, Diana Bisono Balaguer, Jacob Greenstein, Alexander Khitun

articles.title: ScatterWorks: A Python package for building and solving scattering network models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Network models provide an efficient framework for studying non-interacting transport and wave-propagation phenomena in disordered and topological systems. We introduce ScatterWorks, an open-source Python package for building and solving network models. The package uses a compact network representation with composable transformation operations (tile, cut, relink, and union) to enable flexible construction of periodic and finite networks. Local scattering matrices on nodes can be assigned by node labels or explicit indexing, assembled into global scattering equations, and used to compute quasienergies and transport observables. The package supports sparse scattering matrices, allowing transport observables to be evaluated with Schur-based solvers. We demonstrate the package workflow on a symbolic Fabry-Perot interferometer and a numerical Chalker-Coddington model, recovering analytical expressions and the expected near-critical transport behavior of the quantum Hall transition. Plotting utilities with label-aware rendering are included to streamline debugging and reproducible setup for larger, custom network geometries.
authors: R. Johanna Zijderveld, Hélène Spring, Anton R. Akhmerov

articles.title: Gauge invariance, collective modes, and the justification of normal-state subtraction in Dirac superconductors
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28485v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Dirac superconductors, the unbounded spectrum of low-energy Dirac models is known to give rise to unphysical interband contributions from deep-lying states to the electromagnetic response. To eliminate these contributions, normal-state subtraction (NSS), in which the normal-state response is subtracted from the superconducting-state response, has been widely employed. However, the relation between NSS and a gauge-invariant electromagnetic response, particularly the role of the vertex correction required by the Ward identity, has remained unclear. In this work, we consider a massive-Dirac model with s-wave pairing and analytically investigate the electromagnetic response at zero temperature by solving the Bethe--Salpeter equation and incorporating the collective-mode contribution to the electromagnetic vertex. We show that, in the static long-wavelength limit, the vertex correction exactly cancels the bare longitudinal response with NSS, yielding the vanishing longitudinal response required by gauge invariance. In contrast, the transverse component of the vertex correction vanishes in the long-wavelength limit, so that the gauge-invariant Meissner weight coincides with that obtained from the bare transverse response with NSS. Moreover, within the class of isotropic and analytic UV regularization terms, we show that gauge invariance uniquely fixes the regularization term in the static long-wavelength limit to the value prescribed by NSS. Our results thus provide a microscopic justification for NSS.

articles.title: Wyckoff-Resolved Oxidation-State Atlas and Anion-Conditioned Priors for Materials Discovery
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a Wyckoff-resolved oxidation-state atlas and assignment utility for probabilityranked, charge-neutral assignment from compositions or Wyckoff grammars. The atlas is constructed from a May 2026 snapshot of 154,879 Materials Project-derived structures by staged exact-neutral enumeration over common and known nonzero oxidation states. The learned prior assigns 106,053 materials in composition mode and 114,403 in Wyckoff mode, compared with a broad MP all-integer possible species count of 108,642. A matched MP baseline requiring at least one charge-neutral assignment with exactly one nonzero integer oxidation state per element contains 89,374 materials; relative to this baseline, composition and Wyckoff modes increase coverage by 18.7% and 28.0%. Of the 14,665 materials recovered only in Wyckoff mode, 99.98% exhibit distinct formal oxidation states for the same element on different site tokens. The CSV/Python workflow provides a reproducible prior for structure decoration, generative crystal models, and symbolic Wyckoff-grammar workflows.

articles.title: Automated Dislocation Detection in Electron Channelling Contrast Imaging: A Comparative Study of Rule-Based, Neural Network, and Deep Learning Approaches
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantifying threading dislocations in semiconductor materials via electron channelling contrast imaging (ECCI) is heavily bottlenecked by slow manual analysis. This work benchmarks three automated detection pipelines on ECCI micrographs of gallium nitride (GaN) against a statistical ground truth. A classical rule-based computer vision approach proved unreliable due to extensive per-image tuning requirements, while a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based multi-stage classification and locator method achieved 87% accuracy but required significant time for a test image and was less efficient in high-density regions. By contrast, a unified single-stage you only look once (YOLOv8) architecture achieved a counting accuracy of 98.6%, alongside 98.7% precision and 98.7% recall across 7451 dislocations over multiple images, with rapid inference times. Successful deployment of YOLOv8 required addressing two domain-specific machine learning challenges. First, to mitigate the model's scale sensitivity, an adaptive gaussian tile-sizing algorithm was developed to optimise the field of view per image. Second, the deployed confidence threshold (0.025) differed substantially from the suggested inference default value for YOLOv8 (0.25), raising counting accuracy from 90.8% to 99.3% on a subsection of the benchmark image. In this case, low confidence scores represented physical signal strength rather than classification ambiguity. This unified, scale-adaptive approach demonstrates practical viability for high-throughput, quantitative semiconductor defect characterisation.
authors: A. Holmes, C. Trager-Cowan, J. Bruckbauer, B. Hourahine

articles.title: Hierarchical organization governs nonlinear mechanical reversibility in iota-carrageenan gels
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Carrageenan gels are thermoreversible polysaccharide networks whose mechanical properties emerge from ion-mediated helix association, yet how their molecular organization controls nonlinear deformation remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the temperature-dependent rheology of iota-carrageenan gels formed in KCl solutions using linear and nonlinear oscillatory rheology combined with normal-force measurements. iota-carrageenan forms homogeneous and mechanically reversible gels whose elastic modulus increases continuously with quench depth. Deep quenches generate pronounced strain stiffening before yielding, associated with the development of internal stresses revealed by negative normal forces. Remarkably, large deformations preserve the small-strain elastic modulus while progressively suppressing strain stiffening, demonstrating a partial mechanical reversibility of the network. We interpret these observations using a hierarchical network picture in which a persistent intermolecular network controls linear elasticity, while a more fragile mesoscale organization enables cooperative alignment and stress amplification under deformation. Our results highlight that nonlinear mechanics of thermoreversible polysaccharide gels are governed not only by molecular connectivity, but also by the reversible formation and eventually destruction of mechanically adaptive hierarchical structures.

articles.title: Switchable chiral antiferromagnetism through nonlinear magnetic susceptibility
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFM) have attracted considerable attention in recent years because a number of nontrivial, technologically relevant properties associated with time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking are discovered in many materials. However, time-reversal (TR) partners of AFM states are generally challenging to be selected deterministically except in a few cases with nonzero net magnetization. Recently, it has been shown that the TR partners of the kagome spin ice ground state in HoAgGe with strictly zero net magnetization can be selected through a nonlinear magnetic susceptibility χ⁽¹⁾. In this work, we generalize this scenario to a broad class of chiral AFM with zero net magnetization but field-switchable ground states through χ⁽¹⁾. After a general discussion of χ⁽¹⁾ and its symmetry constraints, we first present a first-principles formalism for calculating it including both mean-field and self-consistent corrections, and then apply the approach to the noncollinear AFM family Mn₃XN (X= Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn) in the Γ₅g phase. An intuitive picture of the origin of χ⁽¹⁾ in similar noncollinear AFM is illustrated using 3-sublattice toy model. The model also predicts a nontrivial temperature dependence of χ⁽¹⁾ due to competitions between the longitudinal and transverse single-spin susceptibilities. Our work shows that nonlinear susceptibility can serve as a general protocol for accessing and switching TR partners in fully compensated AFM.

articles.title: A Three-Fluid Model of Dissipation at Surfaces in Superconducting Radiofrequency Cavities
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experiments on superconducting cavities have found that under large RF fields the quality factor can improve with increasing field amplitude, a so-called ``anti-Q slope.'' We numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations at a superconducting surface in a parallel magnetic field, finding at large fields there are surface quasiparticle states with energies below the bulk superconducting gap that emerge and disappear as the field cycles. Modifying the standard two-fluid model, we introduce a ``three''-fluid model where we partition the normal fluid to consider continuum and surface quasiparticle states separately. We compute dissipation in a semi-classical theory of conductivity, where we provide physical estimates of elastic scattering times of Bogoliubov quasiparticles with point-like impurities having potential strengths informed from complementary ab initio calculations of impurities in bulk niobium. We show, in this simple yet effective framework, how the relative scattering rates of surface and continuum quasiparticle states can play a role in producing an anti-Q slope while demonstrating how this model naturally includes a mechanism for turning the anti-Q slope on and off.
authors: Matthias Liepe Michelle M. Kelley, Sean Deyo, Nathan Sitaraman, Danilo B. Liarte, Tomás Arias, James P. Sethna, Thomas Oseroff

articles.title: Super-resolution Control of Two-dimensional Quantum Emitters
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Localized interlayer excitons in semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers are quantum emitters with a static electric dipole moment, making them excellent nanoscale charge sensors to probe correlated quantum phases in a proximal layer. These emitters are electrically tunable and inherit spin-valley selection rules, yet their deterministic spatial control remains challenging due to subwavelength confinement. Here, we present a platform that combines cryogenic optical spectroscopy with scanning probe microscopy to investigate trapped interlayer excitons in WSe₂/MoSe₂ bilayers. By exploiting AFM-based local Stark shift, we achieve super-resolution localization of emitters separated by only a few tens of nanometers and demonstrate deterministic control of individual charge states, including trion formation, opening a path towards coherent inter-dot coupling. Time-resolved measurements reveal tip-induced modification of the electromagnetic vacuum around individual emitters, thus controlling their radiative emission. Our multi-point charge sensing platform with optical readout is particularly well-suited to study fractionalization and anyon dynamics in semiconducting FCIs.
authors: Bosai Lyu, Valeria Vento, Ludivine Fausten, Daniel Suarez-Forero, Klevis Domi, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Alberto Morpurgo, Iaroslav Gaponenko, Patrycja Paruch, Ajit Srivastava

articles.title: Euler Topological Metals in 1D
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27554v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We give a rigorous one-dimensional formulation of Kane's transport proposal for probing the Euler characteristic of a Fermi sea. For a clean, translation-invariant continuum Hamiltonian with real-analytic dispersion, a Fermi sea confined to a finite momentum range, and nonzero Fermi velocity at every Fermi point, we analyze a particular Abel-regularized transport response (obtained by tracing over the Fermi sea) and prove that its large-time limit equals the Euler characteristic. We derive an explicit finite-time formula, show that quantization requires the large-time limit, and obtain a convergence rate under additional nonstationarity assumptions. We also prove the lattice analog, where the sharp commutator is trace-class and a completely filled band contributes zero. Finite-volume calculations illustrate the prescribed order of the thermodynamic and large-time limits.

articles.title: Criticality and universality in network dismantling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27613v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Identifying the smallest set of elements whose removal dismantle a complex network, known as the network dismantling problem, is a fundamental task with many practical applications. Whereas network dismantling has been extensively studied over the past decade, most work has focused on developing efficient algorithms for large but finite networks. By contrast, the physics of the network dismantling process, namely how the network structural connectivity is affected by the removal of nodes or edges, remains largely unexplored in the thermodynamic limit. Here, we shed light on this understudied aspect of network dismantling by introducing an adaptive biased percolation process able to optimally dismantle a network. Through a systematic analysis of synthetic network models, we find that the proposed percolation process displays a universal phase transition, characterized by the abrupt and simultaneous disappearance of both the giant connected component and the largest 2-core, across networks with markedly different degree distributions. Simulations on real networks further support this universality, indicating that the physics of network dismantling is insensitive to a broad range of topological properties. Together, these results suggest that a topology-agnostic theory could be developed to explain the critical behavior of network dismantling.
authors: Lorenzo Cirigliano, Claudio Castellano, Minsuk Kim, Filippo Radicchi, Hanlin Sun

articles.title: Mode-Specific Dynamics of CO2 Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27850v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Catalytic hydrogenation of CO2 to formate on copper is a key elementary step for CO2 utilization. Previous experimental and theoretical studies suggested an Eley-Rideal mechanism for this reaction, promoted by bending vibrational excitation, yet direct state resolved evidence remains lacking. Here, we present accurate dynamical predictions for CO2 hydrogenation on Cu(111) based on a full-dimensional first-principles neural network potential energy surface. Our calculations near-quantitatively reproduce the measured reaction probabilities, including their nozzle-temperature and incidence-energy dependence. Our state-resolved results indicate that while vibrational excitation of the bending mode enhances reactivity, it alone cannot account for the observed reactivity increase with nozzle temperature. Instead, rotational excitation plays a dominant role, mainly attributable to the significant change in anisotropy of the molecular polar orientation as CO2 accesses the transition state. This mode-specific mechanistic insight revises the conventional interpretation and lays the foundation for the precise control of CO2 hydrogenation on catalysts.
authors: Junfan Xia, Zhikai Jiang, Yaolong Zhang, Bo Peng, Hua Guo, Bin Jiang

articles.title: Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27861v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) calculations based on tensor networks (TN) have recently achieved competitive accuracy in ground-state calculations of strongly correlated spin and fermionic systems. However, existing tensor network VMC (TN-VMC) algorithms have not been formulated in a manner that can fully utilize GPU acceleration. We tackle the key missing ingredient, namely, the vectorized evaluation of tensor network amplitudes and tensor network operations. This ensures high GPU utilization by batching over computations with identical structure. In particular, we show how to achieve vectorization for the practically relevant case of abelian symmetric tensor networks (which includes fermionic tensor networks) by developing a ``flat'' tensor network formalism for block-sparse tensor representation and contraction. Using this, we construct a GPU-adapted symmetric TN-VMC workflow with batched tensor network computation. In the two-dimensional Fermi--Hubbard model, we demonstrate a GPU speedup of up to 300 × over single core CPU implementations, for fermionic TN variational wavefunctions.
authors: Si-Jing Du, Johnnie Gray, Ao Chen, Garnet Kin-Lic Chan

articles.title: A different kind of continuum limit for the three-dimensional U(1) gauge theory
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27976v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In three-dimensional compact U(1) lattice gauge theory color confinement can be understood analytically through the dynamics of magnetic monopoles. However, its continuum limit is pathological, since the ratio of the glueball masses to the square root of the string tension vanishes as the continuum limit is approached. We investigate a simple extension of the Wilson action in which the total number of lattice monopoles is coupled to an additional parameter μ. By tuning β and μ simultaneously, we identify a line of constant physics along which the ratio of the lightest glueball mass to the square root of the string tension remains constant. We further show that the same scaling is satisfied, within numerical uncertainties, by the other low-lying glueball masses considered in this work. Along this trajectory, the string tension in lattice units decreases with increasing β, thus suggesting that the modified lattice action may provide a regularization of three-dimensional compact U(1) gauge theory with a physically well-behaved continuum limit.
authors: Andreas Athenodorou, Claudio Bonati, Ivan Soler Calero

articles.title: Compact Variational Neural Networks for Spectral Inference from a Single Nonlinear 2D Perovskite Photodetector
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27977v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spectroscopy conventionally separates optical frequencies before detection, imposing persistent constraints on footprint, complexity and scalability. Here we establish an alternative paradigm in which the nonlinear optoelectronic dynamics of a single two-dimensional perovskite photodetector physically encode the incident optical field and machine learning performs the inverse spectral reconstruction. Using a planar fluorinated phenethylammonium lead iodide (F-PEAI) photodetector, we exploit wavelength- and irradiance-dependent current-voltage signatures arising from the coupled effects of photocarrier generation, trapping, interfacial transport and field-dependent carrier dynamics. A compact variational encoder-decoder preserves the functional and history-dependent structure of these responses by independently projecting forward and reverse voltage sweeps onto a truncated Legendre-polynomial basis before mapping them through a probabilistic latent representation to continuous spectral parameters. Trained on fewer than 400 experimental voltage sweeps, the model generalises to excitation wavelengths excluded from training, reconstructing wavelength with R²⁼⁰.958 and a mean absolute error of 8.1 nm, while recovering log-normalised irradiance with R²⁼⁰.987. Voltage-resolved analysis further reveals that wavelength and irradiance are encoded differently across the nonlinear device response, with distinct bias regions carrying complementary optical information. These results establish nonlinear material and interface dynamics as a computational resource for spectroscopy and point towards hardware-algorithm co-design in which materials, interfaces and inference architectures are engineered jointly to maximise information content, enabling compact spectroscopic systems without dispersive optics or detector arrays.
authors: Karl Jonas Riisnaes, Ned Thaddeus Taylor, Hoi Tung Lam, Rosanna Mastria, Francesco Saverio Difeo, Monica Felicia Craciun, Saverio Russo
articles.focus_summary: 论文利用二维有机-无机铅碘钙钛矿光电探测器中的非线性、具有历史依赖的电流-电压响应，实现单探测器条件下的光谱反演。研究结合少量实验数据和变分神经网络，重构入射光谱参数，并利用载流子生成、俘获、界面输运等动力学响应作为信息编码。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的卤化物钙钛矿、二维材料、光电响应、载流子俘获和机器学习方向有交集，但论文主要是实验器件与数据驱动反演，而非第一性原理模拟。其对陷阱态、界面输运和非线性载流子动力学的利用，可为钙钛矿光电性质建模提供应用场景。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可用第一性原理和 GW-BSE 计算分析不同缺陷、界面和激发条件下的光生载流子与陷阱态响应，并将模拟数据用于神经网络光谱或器件状态反演。进一步可研究离子迁移和动态缺陷对历史依赖光电响应的影响。

articles.title: Full-field fluorescence computed tomography (F3CT) using a calibrated virtual cone-beam pinhole geometry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28275v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present F3CT, a synchrotron-based hyperspectral full-field fluorescence computed tomography technique that avoids raster scanning by combining a pinhole aperture with an energy-resolving 2D detector. A virtual cone-beam model and two-stage calibration-reconstruction workflow enable 3D elemental mapping under full-field illumination. The method is demonstrated on biological and geological specimens, resolving silver-stain distributions in zebrafish tissue and high-energy fluorescence signatures in rock cores. Phase-contrast tomograms acquired sequentially under the same experimental geometry provide co-registered structural context. F3CT provides a high-throughput route to 3D XRF imaging and establishes a foundation for correlated structural and chemical tomography, with potential for future in-situ and operando implementations.
authors: Thomas Zillhardt, Yunhui Chen, Alexander Rack, Matthew Veale, Matt Wilson, Philip J. Withers, Nicola Viganò

articles.title: Euclidean Fourier Neural Operators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28425v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fourier neural operators (FNOs) provide an efficient framework for learning mappings between function spaces as they are, by construction, independent of the grid resolution at which they are trained and evaluated. However, FNOs are not independent of the periodic domain they are applied to: their discrete spectral weights are indexed by integer Fourier mode numbers, which correspond to physical wavevectors. When applied to a different domain, the same trained weights act at different wavevectors, and the FNO silently represents a different operator. This makes FNOs unsuitable for tasks where transfer across domains is crucial. We propose Euclidean Fourier neural operators~(EFNOs) as a domain-independent alternative to FNOs. By parameterizing the spectral kernel as a continuous function of the physical wavevector, the EFNO can learn operators that act consistently across periodic domains of varying shape and size. We evaluate the EFNO on a simple heat equation and on a practically relevant materials science task of learning exchange-correlation potentials across different crystal structures, and demonstrate that the EFNO is able to generalize to unseen grid sizes and domains.
authors: Nathanael Bosch, Niklas Frederik Schmitz, Michael F. Herbst

articles.title: Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.17050v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solute segregation to grain boundaries (GBs) significantly impacts material behavior, with most studies focusing on substitutional solute segregation while neglecting interstitial segregation due to its increased complexity. The site preference, interstitial or substitutional, for P segregation in α-Fe still remains under debate. This work investigates both substitutional and interstitial GB segregation in a polycrystalline model using classical interatomic potentials and machine learning. The method is validated with H and Ni, whose segregation behaviors are well understood.
